entries.text: Do you have any family?
entries.translated_text: 你有家人吗？

entries.text: I'm more inclined to think that he somehow messed the experiment up.
entries.translated_text: 我更倾向于认为他以某种方式搞砸了实验。

entries.text: No, they're much larger, and sort of chewy and sour. The tartness goes well with sweet flavours.
entries.translated_text: 不，它们要大得多，有点嚼劲和酸味。酸味与甜味搭配得很好。

entries.text: Khash, look out!
entries.translated_text: 卡什，小心！

entries.text: Anything else we should hide from Calcelmo on the way out?
entries.translated_text: 还有什么是我们离开时要瞒着卡塞莫的吗？

entries.text: Incredible! How much experimenting did that take? How many mixtures with poor viscosity?
entries.translated_text: 难以置信！这需要多少实验？做出了多少种低粘性混合物？

entries.text: I think your morals may be skewed, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我认为你的道德可能有偏差，蕾米。

entries.text: Adventures are the best! Usually. Mostly. What would be your ideal adventure?
entries.translated_text: 冒险是最棒了!通常是这样。大多数情况下。你的理想冒险是什么？

entries.text: When you get tired of the cold, I'll take you to Hammerfell and show you around Sentinel. I think that'd be a good time.
entries.translated_text: 当你厌倦了寒冷，我会带你去落锤省，带你参观哨兵城。我想那会是个好时机。

entries.text: Hm. It seems suspiciously like politics. You've somehow mixed politics into thievery. Dreadful. Keep that away from my theft!
entries.translated_text: 嗯。看起来很像政治。你把政治和偷窃混为一谈了，真可怕，别和我偷东西混为一谈。

entries.text: Aha! Here are my notes for it! But... I can't seem to read my handwriting. Um...
entries.translated_text: 啊哈！这是我的笔记！但是我似乎看不懂我的字迹，嗯...

entries.text: Alright, I'll leave you be.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我就不管你了。

entries.text: Feeling alright?
entries.translated_text: 感觉还好吗？

entries.text: No, pet him like a Scrap. It's a similar process but unique in that you have to do it in such a way that Scrap enjoys it.
entries.translated_text: 不，要像抚摸小渣那样抚摸它。这个过程很像，但独特之处在于，你必须以小渣喜欢的方式去做。

entries.text: You don't mean...?
entries.translated_text: 你不会是...？

entries.text: Fine, fine.
entries.translated_text: 好的，好的。

entries.text: Surely they could help us in Labyrinthian?
entries.translated_text: 他们肯定会在迷宫中帮助我们吗？

entries.text: Look for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel (Unique Gear Found)
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔中寻找有趣的文物（发现独特的圆轮）

entries.text: Oh, we just need to find an Elder Scroll. That's all. No big deal.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我们只需要找到一个上古卷轴，就这样，没什么大不了。

entries.text: I don't want to be rude, but why isn't Dragon Bridge just part of Solitude?
entries.translated_text: 我不想无礼，但为什么龙桥不只是孤独城的一部分？

entries.text: Thank the Divines - They're safe!
entries.translated_text: 感谢诸圣灵——他们很安全！

entries.text: If you ever need anything, I'm always happy to help you. Your burdens are mine, too.
entries.translated_text: 如果你需要任何事，我总是很乐意为您提供帮助，让我们共同面对你背负的东西。

entries.text: Death.
entries.translated_text: 死亡。

entries.text: Oooh, go convince Val to buy us drinks, okay?
entries.translated_text: 去说服瓦尔请我们喝酒，好吗？

entries.text: That's great! I'm glad it worked!
entries.translated_text: 那太棒了！我很高兴它有用！

entries.text: Probably referring to the mechanism keeping the Book locked up.
entries.translated_text: 可能是指那个用来锁住这本书的装置。

entries.text: You're hardly a villain worthy of Yazakh's writings!
entries.translated_text: 你简直不配成为雅扎克笔下的恶棍!

entries.text: My parents recently relocated to Skaven, in Hammerfell. We get along with them quite well, both my sister and I.
entries.translated_text: 我的父母最近搬到了落锤省的斯卡文。我们和他们相处得很好，我和妹妹都是如此。

entries.text: Oh, that seems...
entries.translated_text: 哦，这似乎...

entries.text: Yes! Friends. Kill. Together!
entries.translated_text: 对，朋友，一起，杀敌。

entries.text: Rumarin, I meant to ask: did you attend the College of Winterhold?
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林，我想问：你加入过冬堡学院吗？

entries.text: Are we heading out, Suryvel? Let me know if we are. I don't want to get left behind.
entries.translated_text: 我们要出去了吗，苏里维尔？如果我们是，请告诉我。我不想落后。

entries.text: Who's the poor fool we're killing this time?
entries.translated_text: 这次我们要杀的那个倒霉蛋是谁？

entries.text: Suryvel.
entries.translated_text: 苏里维尔。

entries.text: Hey, I didn't study war paint application for ten years at the Lythandus school in Cheydinhal to be mocked by an amateur!
entries.translated_text: 嘿，我在香丁赫尔的雷杉杜斯学院学习了十年的战纹应用，结果被一个业余爱好者嘲笑了！

entries.text: That's the spirit! My friend, you've come to the right person.
entries.translated_text: 就是这种精神！我的朋友，你找对人了。

entries.text: In doing so, I'll be able to influence their behaviors, most importantly their ability to function.
entries.translated_text: 这样，我将能够影响他们的行为，最重要的是影响他们的功能。

entries.text: The bear said to the girl in the tree, "Come down and we'll play a game." But the girl was clever and said, "You climb up here if you want to play!"
entries.translated_text: 熊对树上的女孩说：“下来，我们玩个游戏。”可那丫头倒是机灵，说：“想玩就爬上来！”

entries.text: My scales always get the shivers in a place like this. Plenty of danger inside, I hope.
entries.translated_text: 在这样的地方，我的鳞片都在颤抖。我想里面有很多危险。

entries.text: Under that, I wrote something along the lines of,
entries.translated_text: 在这下面，我写了一些东西，大意是，

entries.text: Sweet Mara, Yaz, you're covered in blood! Please don't bleed out.
entries.translated_text: 玛拉在上，雅扎，你浑身是血！不要。

entries.text: I-I'm so sorry. You shouldn't have had to make a decision like that.
entries.translated_text: 我——我很抱歉，你不应该做出那样的决定。

entries.text: My mind and soul remain my own. I become more than either human or beast.
entries.translated_text: 我的思想和灵魂仍然是我自己的。我变得不仅仅是人类或野兽。

entries.text: It's probably not surprising, but the research performed here was miles ahead of even other dwemer research centers.
entries.translated_text: 这可能并不意外，但这里进行的研究远远领先于其他锻莫研究中心。

entries.text: The lever above the broken pipe.
entries.translated_text: 断裂管道上方的拉杆。

entries.text: Find a dwemer lever. (<Global=HLIORPCLeverCount>/<Global=HLIORPCLeverTotal>)
entries.translated_text: 找一个锻莫杠杆。(<Global=HLIORPCLeverCount>/<Global=HLIORPCLeverTotal>)

entries.text: If I can find a way to make lockpicking easier, our pockets would be overflowing with septims.
entries.translated_text: 如果我能找到一种方法让开锁变得更容易，我们的口袋里就能装满金币。

entries.text: Remi, stay home for now.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，暂时待在家里。

entries.text: Remi isn't your father. Morvic is a threat to her and her family.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米不是你父亲，莫维克是她和她家人的威胁。

entries.text: Scrap, keep Ray safe, okay?!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，保证雷的安全，好吗？！

entries.text: Are you okay, Joshua? No eyes poked out? Enough blood to live?
entries.translated_text: 你没事吧，约书亚？眼睛没被戳瞎吧？血没流干？

entries.text: Hey! Careful which way you point that-
entries.translated_text: 嘿！小心你的指的--

entries.text: Hey! Careful which way you point that-
entries.translated_text: 嘿！小心你的指的--

entries.text: How did it turn out?
entries.translated_text: 结果如何？

entries.text: Then let's get going!
entries.translated_text: 那么让我们开始吧！

entries.text: Excuse me. I read a book from cover to cover, which is to say I read the front one twice.
entries.translated_text: 请原谅我。我把一本书从头到尾看了一遍，也就是说，我把前面那本看了两遍。

entries.text: Is Bartokh someone with their name changed?
entries.translated_text: 巴托克是改了名字的人吗？

entries.text: W-what should we do now?
entries.translated_text: 我...们现在该怎么办？

entries.text: Buffy.
entries.translated_text: 巴非。

entries.text: We got him! Let's get out of here!
entries.translated_text: 抓到他了！让我们离开这里！

entries.text: You seem down, Remi, so I got you something. (Romance)
entries.translated_text: 你看起来很沮丧，蕾米，所以我给你找了点东西。（浪漫）

entries.text: I did it!
entries.translated_text: 我做到了！

entries.text: Could you just give me some time? I don't want to say something mean I'll regret.
entries.translated_text: 你能给我一点时间吗？我不想说出一些会后悔的刻薄话。

entries.text: Just be a... Oh. Well, this lantern is going to far surpass any other non-chandelier lanterns!
entries.translated_text: 只要做一个...哦。好吧，这个灯笼将远远超过其他任何非吊灯的灯笼!

entries.text: So since we killed Nimhe...
entries.translated_text: 所以自从我们杀了尼姆赫...

entries.text: Marlok? I don't know who that is...? Am I supposed to?
entries.translated_text: 马洛克？不知道是谁...？我应该知道吗？

entries.text: Remi, it's an amulet of Mara.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，这是玛拉护符。

entries.text: Well, that question came from nowhere. Did you hear about it from somewhere in particular?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这个问题不知哪里来到。你是不是从某个地方听说的？

entries.text: As she begged him to untie her, he began whispering in a strange language, like the voices that had surrounded her in the fog.
entries.translated_text: 当她求他解开她的绳子时，他开始用一种奇怪的语言低语，这分明就是浓雾中围绕她的声音。

entries.text: Yes, it's just so baffling to me. I don't know anyone who would consider killing me!
entries.translated_text: 是的，这对我来说太莫名其妙了，我不知道有谁会想杀了我！

entries.text: Let me try... altering this bit. Okay, let's give this a whirl.
entries.translated_text: 让我试试...改变这个比特。好吧，让我们试一下。

entries.text: I never much liked him, but he was at least bearable while we were betrothed.
entries.translated_text: 我从不太喜欢他，但至少在我们订婚的时候他还是能够忍受的。

entries.text: Alright, Ubbe, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好了，乌贝，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: Maybe one day he’ll be better at protecting me than you are?
entries.translated_text: 也许有一天他会比你更擅长保护我？

entries.text: Well, at least they're letting you have a bed, right? I'd prefer the Bannered Mare, personally.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，至少他们给你张床，对吧？但我个人更喜欢母马旗帜。

entries.text: Is... is that your pet? Really? Wow, he looks tough!
entries.translated_text: 那...那是你的宠物吗？哇！它看起来真不好惹！

entries.text: An Elder Scroll... Oh, I want to read it so badly... But is it worth going blind...? Maybe someday... Ugh, but it's so tempting!
entries.translated_text: 上古卷轴...哦，我好想读它...但它值得为之失明吗...？也许有一天...呃，但这太诱人了！

entries.text: Wonderful! I knew my beautiful Arkngchal would have some!
entries.translated_text: 妙呀！我就知道我美丽的阿卡切尔会有一些!

entries.text: Well, I think it's good?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我觉得不错？

entries.text: Deep in his pocket of Oblivion, he still keeps a small slice of Mundus that he cares for, the realms he poured his life essence into, and bled for.
entries.translated_text: 在他湮灭领域深处，他仍然保留着一小块他心爱的梦达斯，这片他倾注生命精华并为之流血而战的领域。

entries.text: Wait! Wait! I got one! I got-
entries.translated_text: 等、等一下！我找到了！我找到——

entries.text: Oh, hi, Simba. Do you have any snacks? I think I might be on the brink of starving to death.
entries.translated_text: 哦，嗨，辛巴。你有零食吗？我想我可能快饿死了。

entries.text: I've got your back, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 我支持你，我的朋友。

entries.text: O-oh! Ah, well, actually, me too!
entries.translated_text: 噢！啊，其实，我也是！

entries.text: Do you eat them scrambled? Or are they just for baking? Perhaps you'll get me a Kwama Egg Quiche someday? I'd love to try it.
entries.translated_text: 你把它们炒着吃吗？还是烘烤着吃？也许有一天你会给我做一个夸蚁蛋馅饼？我很想试试。

entries.text: Oh, a dwemer barracks. And I suppose this bed separate from the rest was for the legate, or the dwemer equivalent.
entries.translated_text: 哦，一个锻莫兵营。而且我想这张床与其他床分开是为副官或对应的锻莫准备的。

entries.text: Look for the researchers and for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel (Unique Gear Found)
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔中寻找研究人员和有趣的文物（发现独特的圆轮）

entries.text: Take Remi to see a dwemer ruin.
entries.translated_text: 带雷米去看一个锻莫遗迹。

entries.text: ;Time to get married
entries.translated_text: ;该结婚了

entries.text: Successful piracy requires... an investment... in one's reputation. Let's just say that I haven't had to kill anyone in a while.
entries.translated_text: 成功的海盗需要...投资...自己的声誉。就这么说吧，我已经有一段时间没有杀过任何人了。

entries.text: This place is enormous! We have to map it! We'd be the first to do so in... thousands of years!
entries.translated_text: 这个地方很大！我们必须给它画地图！我们将成为...数千年来第一个这样做的人！

entries.text: I should hope so, since I'm his creator. Sort of. He's a good automaton! Yes, you are!
entries.translated_text: 我也希望如此，因为我是他的创造者。他是一个很好的机器人！是的，你是！

entries.text: Impressive wingspan, my friend!
entries.translated_text: 令人印象深刻的臂展，我的朋友！

entries.text: Woah, woah, woah. Calm down.
entries.translated_text: 哇，哇，哇，哇。冷静下来。

entries.text: I thought you might be.
entries.translated_text: 我想你也是。

entries.text: Ganbald, you are very good at leading. At least, I think you are. I'm following you, in any case.
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德，你很擅长领导。至少，我认为你是这样。无论如何，我都在关注你。

entries.text: Do you think we could bring this body somewhere to dissect it? No? What? Don't look at me like that!
entries.translated_text: 你觉得我们能不能把这具尸体带到某个地方解剖一下？不行？怎么了？别那样看着我啊！

entries.text: After all, you're being so kind as to let me rest in your house.
entries.translated_text: 毕竟，你这么好心让我在你家休息。

entries.text: By Akatosh you're a piece of crap, though. No offense.
entries.translated_text: 不过，阿卡托什在上，你简直就是团废渣。对不起，我不想冒犯你。

entries.text: Can't you just tell me what Sam did with the staff he promised me?
entries.translated_text: 你不能告诉我山姆对他答应给我的法杖做了什么吗？

entries.text: Is everyone alive?
entries.translated_text: 大家都还活着吗？

entries.text: Should I pick up some blood for Serana? In case she gets... thirsty?
entries.translated_text: 我应该为瑟拉娜采点血吗？万一她...口渴了呢？

entries.text: You were making jokes? Like earlier when you were saying those things about me dying...?
entries.translated_text: 你在开玩笑？就像之前你说的那些关于我会死...？

entries.text: Me. Can. Hit... From. Far. Away. VERY. Far. Away.
entries.translated_text: 我，可以，打到...从，很远，很远，的地方。

entries.text: Oh, Ahmed, you're here! Perfect! Oh- Did you need something before I start asking questions?
entries.translated_text: 哦，艾哈迈德，你来了！完美！哦——在我开始提问之前，你需要什么吗？

entries.text: I know there's nothing I can say or do to take your pain away, but you'll learn to bear it.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我说什么做什么都无法消除你的痛苦，但你得学会忍受它。

entries.text: I've taken Remi to see many dwemer ruins, and she has learned how to make her dwemer spider, Scrap, powerful. Our adventures together are far from over, though. We've become great friends, but I can't help but wonder if we can become closer.. ;Spoken to Remi again, Romance Available
entries.translated_text: 我带蕾米参观了许多锻莫遗址，她也学会了如何让她的锻莫蜘蛛小渣变得强大。不过，我们一起的冒险远未结束。我们已经成为了好朋友，但我不禁想知道我们是否可以变得更亲近……；再次与蕾米交谈，浪漫可用

entries.text: I wish they'd understand that we mean them no harm.
entries.translated_text: 我希望他们明白我们对他们没有恶意。

entries.text: First taste...! Hm... Yeah, it's... Mm. Really. Really good! Yum.
entries.translated_text: 尝第一口...！嗯...真的，真的，真的很好！好美味。

entries.text: Read the note found on the assassin's corpse.
entries.translated_text: 阅读在刺客的尸体上发现的纸条。

entries.text: Well, I must say that it's unfortunate she became so angry as to try to kill you. I suppose everyone handles grief differently.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我必须说，她愤怒到想要杀了你，确实很不幸。我想，每个人处理悲伤的方式都不同吧。

entries.text: Somewhere down here is where the dwarves discovered Aetherium deposits... All this glowing rock... You don't think...? No, that's silly.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫在这里的某个地方发现了神光水晶矿床...这些发光的岩石...你不觉得...？不，这很蠢。

entries.text: You... have...?
entries.translated_text: 你已经...？

entries.text: Well, I suppose it might be if you have me use it often. Then the pride of making something useful might outweigh my guilt.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想如果你让我经常使用它的话，那么做一些有用的东西的自豪感可能会超过我的内疚感。

entries.text: Yes! I mean, hypothetically, yes.
entries.translated_text: 是的！我的意思是，这不太好说。

entries.text: Oh, what trouble will we get into once you are made Thane of the Reach? It will be so much easier to get away with whatever we please.
entries.translated_text: 哦，一旦你成为边塞领的武卫，我们还会遇到什么麻烦呢？到时候我们就可以为所欲为了。

entries.text: A lot more.
entries.translated_text: 还有很多。

entries.text: I'm so lost...
entries.translated_text: 我好失落...

entries.text: I'm sorry, Rumarin, but that is to be expected.
entries.translated_text: 我很抱歉，罗米勒，但这也能够预料。

entries.text: My father was a hunter, and my mother dabbled in priesthood. Both of them spent most of their time alone, so it was mostly me and my sister.
entries.translated_text: 我的父亲是一名猎人，而我的母亲则是祭司。他们俩大部分时间都是独自度过的，所以主要是我和我姐姐一起生活。

entries.text: There are quite a variety of those to choose from, for sure. There are many that I'm familiar with, though maybe not very in-depth.
entries.translated_text: 魔神就有很多可以选了，这是肯定的。有很多是我熟悉的，虽然可能不是了解很深入。

entries.text: Auri only eats her enemies, right? So I don't have to worry about what happens to my body  if I die in our adventures...?
entries.translated_text: 奥璃只会吃掉她的敌人，对吧？所以我不必担心如果我在冒险中死去，我的尸体会发生事...？

entries.text: Rumarin, subtly suggest she would look better with makeup.
entries.translated_text: 鲁米勒，巧妙地暗示她化妆后会更好看。

entries.text: Well, let's just say the dwemer weren't a 'good' people.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，可以说锻莫可不是‘善良’的民族。

entries.text: I-I'm not sure I follow? Why did they have to cut their outfit off?
entries.translated_text: 我-我真的能听懂吗？为什么他们必须剪掉衣服？

entries.text: Joshua, I have been having so many ideas, and none of them will ever work outside my head. Please be sorry for me.
entries.translated_text: 约书亚，我有太多的想法，但没有一个能在我脑海外实现的，真是遗憾。

entries.text: No. I carry a sword. I'm from the swamps of Black Marsh. Do you need me to continue, or can you piece it together from here?
entries.translated_text: 不。我带着一把剑。我来自黑沼泽。你需要我继续说，还是你已经明白了？

entries.text: Restoration.
entries.translated_text: 恢复系.

entries.text: Oh, friend, I...
entries.translated_text: 哦，朋友，我...

entries.text: It's... They're part of the reason I can't find myself so fanatically obsessed with knights in shining armour.
entries.translated_text: 这...他们也是戳破我对骑士的闪亮幻想的原因之一。

entries.text: Oh, so you don't think stealing is, uh...?
entries.translated_text: 哦，所以你不认为偷窃是，呃...？

entries.text: But I suppose it's something that is difficult to understand. Believe me, I'm quite used to feeling misunderstood.
entries.translated_text: 但我想这是很难理解的事情。相信我，我已经习惯了被误解的感觉。

entries.text: Mummification is common in Southern High Rock. Yet our dead do not get up again. So long as necromancers stay away.
entries.translated_text: 木乃伊在南部高岩很常见。然而我们死去的人再也起不来了，只要远离死灵法师。

entries.text: Be careful. You know how Scrap gets when he's not the one getting gifts.
entries.translated_text: 当心，你知道小渣收不到礼物时是什么样子的。

entries.text: Settle down. No need for threats.
entries.translated_text: 冷静，不要动粗。

entries.text: We could multitask.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以同时处理多项任务。

entries.text: Hm... good question! Hard to say, really. Sometimes I can enjoy writing a particular character but also hate their guts as a person.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...好问题!真的很难说。有时候我会喜欢创作某个特定的人物,但同时也憎恶这个人物本身。

entries.text: My mother used to enjoy people-watching at the market. I'm more fond of... people-talking.
entries.translated_text: 我母亲过去喜欢在市场上看茫茫众生。我呢更喜欢...与人交流。

entries.text: Oh, yuck! That one is definitely vile. Perfect choice.
entries.translated_text: 哦，恶心！这个绝对够卑鄙。完美的选择。

entries.text: Do you worship any Divines?
entries.translated_text: 你信仰什么圣灵吗？

entries.text: Yes. Wait, is that mead?
entries.translated_text: 对等等，那是蜂蜜酒吗？

entries.text: Now I have two sisters whom I love and will always cherish.
entries.translated_text: 现在我有两个姐妹，我爱她们，并将永远珍惜她们。

entries.text: I'll be here, Ganbald. And also wherever you take me next.
entries.translated_text: 我会在这里，甘巴尔德。还有你接下来带我去哪里。

entries.text: Stop.
entries.translated_text: 停。

entries.text: Of course you did! It's our home!
entries.translated_text: 你当然会了！这是我们的家！

entries.text: Well, my clothes are soaking wet.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我的衣服都湿透了。

entries.text: Okay, Nar. If you could stop leading us into danger, I'd- Well, I'd be a hyprocrite to say that, so never mind.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，纳尔 如果你能不把我们带入险境 我就... 我这么说就太虚伪了，所以算了吧。

entries.text: I must admit, I wouldn't have it any other way. I'd much rather be free and alone than caged with friends.
entries.translated_text: 我必须承认，我不会选择其他的选项。比起被朋友关在笼子里，我更愿意自由自在地独处。

entries.text: And another gem. They're sort of pretty. Can I keep one after we're done with the trials?
entries.translated_text: 另一个宝石。他们有点漂亮。试炼结束后我可以留一个吗？

entries.text: Although I'm certain I'd be able to teach him more songs than what these Skyrim bards play. What songs would you want him to sing us?
entries.translated_text: 虽然我确信我能够教他更多的歌曲，而不是这些天际游吟诗人所演奏的。你想让他给我们唱什么歌？

entries.text: That's a good start, but jewelry is where the real money is. I've lifted three rings with gemstones today. I even left the fingers behind!
entries.translated_text: 这是个不错的开始，但真正的大头在珠宝上。我今天偷了三枚镶宝石的戒指，甚至还把戴着它们的手指留在原地呢！

entries.text: Well, yes. At least it seems like it is?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，是。至少看起来是这样？

entries.text: Never mind that. If there is this much blood here, how much would have been on the killer?
entries.translated_text: 不要紧，如果这里都有这么多血，那凶手身上会沾有多少血？

entries.text: It means a lot that you were able to help me check on my parents.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你能帮我了解我的父母情况，你已经做的够多了。

entries.text: I know, I know. I'll give you a good polish next time we rest, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 我知道，我知道。下次我们休息的时候我会给你好好抛光的，小渣。

entries.text: Oh, well, I do not think they will let me buy it since I am a kid. At least, that is what the last bar owner I asked said.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，我认为他们不会让我买，因为我还是个孩子。至少，我问的最后一位酒吧老板是这么说的。

entries.text: Yaz, that's genius, brilliant, amazing! What glorious music could Scrap create?! What would it tell us about his inner psyche?!
entries.translated_text: 雅扎，这想法真是天才、绝伦、不可思议!小渣能创造出多么辉煌的音乐？它能告诉我们他的内心世界是怎样的？

entries.text: Whiterun is the center of Skyrim's commerce, huh? That's how Wayrest is to High Rock. Yet they're so different from one another.
entries.translated_text: 白漫城是天际的商业中心，对吧？这就是途歇城在高岩的地位，然而，他们彼此又是如此不同。

entries.text: I tried learning healing magic... but that didn't go to well. (Laughs) I'm all talk.
entries.translated_text: 我尝试学习治愈魔法……但那并不顺利。（笑）都只是说说。

entries.text: (Whisper) You're going ahead? Be safe.
entries.translated_text: （低语）你要走吗？注意安全。

entries.text: A Thesis on the Properties of Tonal Magic and Its Practical Applications
entries.translated_text: 论音律魔法的特性及其实际应用

entries.text: By the Eight, I don't know what Sam had me drinking, but it was... Really good. But the throbbing in my head regrets it.
entries.translated_text: 八圣灵在上，我不知道山姆让我喝了什么，但它...真的很好。但我脑袋里的抽痛让我后悔了。

entries.text: Of course, you have my support, but, ah, from a distance, so as to avoid my own personal discomfort.
entries.translated_text: 当然，我支持你，但是，啊，我会离远点，这样我好受点。

entries.text: Are they?
entries.translated_text: 有吗？

entries.text: W-why do you say that? You think it'll hold, right? The ceiling, I mean?
entries.translated_text: 你——你为什么这么说？你认为它还能撑住，对吧？天花板，我是说？

entries.text: What... do you want?
entries.translated_text: 你...想要加入吗？

entries.text: I've taken Remi to see many dwemer ruins, and she has learned how to make her dwemer spider, Scrap, powerful. Our adventures together are at an end now.. ;told her they don't want her around
entries.translated_text: 我带蕾米参观了许多锻莫遗址，她也学会了如何让她的锻莫蜘蛛小渣变得强大。我们一起的冒险现在结束了……；告诉她他们不想让她在身边

entries.text: I need to trade some things with you.
entries.translated_text: 我要和你交换物品。

entries.text: I've been reading for... By the Divines, how long has it been?
entries.translated_text: 我一直在阅读...圣灵在上，已经有多久了？

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. First I need to speak to Calcelmo about killing the giant spider that is lurking in the excavation site.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。首先我需要和卡塞莫谈谈杀死潜伏在挖掘现场的巨型蜘蛛的事情。

entries.text: I can't wait.
entries.translated_text: 我等不及了。

entries.text: Nope, no more ale on me. Only mead. Oh, and a wine! What do you think of wine?
entries.translated_text: 不，我身上没有麦芽酒了。只有蜜酒。哦，还有一种葡萄酒!你觉得葡萄酒怎么样？

entries.text: Hey!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！

entries.text: What is Aetherium?
entries.translated_text: 什么是神光水晶？

entries.text: I was thinking more adventure.
entries.translated_text: 我在想更多的冒险。

entries.text: Someday, I will get us such a great meal that you will mourn its loss when we return to adventuring.
entries.translated_text: 总有一天，我会为我们准备这样一顿大餐，当我们回到冒险的时候，你会为失去美味而后悔的。

entries.text: You should use your lantern.
entries.translated_text: 你应该使用你的灯。

entries.text: I'm trying to understand what these convectors have done to Arniel's soul gem, but I'm at a loss. How is this going to emulate the Heart of a god?
entries.translated_text: 我试图了解这些环流器对阿内尔的灵魂石做了什么，但我一窍不通，这是如何模仿神之心的？

entries.text: Pathetic! Scrap's hurt me more than that!
entries.translated_text: 真可怜，小渣对我造成了很多伤害！

entries.text: So they fight to be allowed to worship Talos?
entries.translated_text: 所以他们是为了能自由崇拜塔洛斯而战吗？

entries.text: Does this mean I'm becoming some famous, you think? If someone wanted to kill me? That's what happens to famous people, right?
entries.translated_text: 这是否意味着我已经变得有名了，你觉得呢？如果有人想杀我，那不是名人身上才会发生的事，不是吗？

entries.text: Although I'd like to see this realistic drawing. I'm hoping it isn't *too* realistic, because that would just scare people.
entries.translated_text: 尽管我很想看看这幅逼真的画。我希望它不是*太*逼真，因为那样会吓跑人的。

entries.text: Tell me what I want to know.
entries.translated_text: 告诉我想要的？

entries.text: You're a bad liar, but I appreciate the sentiment.
entries.translated_text: 你不擅长说谎是吗，但是我很喜欢你的同理心。

entries.text: Falmer are quite sad, aren't they? And a bit creepy.
entries.translated_text: 伐莫相当可悲，不是吗？而且有点令人毛骨悚然。

entries.text: I've reworked dwemer piping on less sleep.
entries.translated_text: 我熬夜重新设计了锻莫管道。

entries.text: Thorn, like on plants? Are you prickly, as well? Just a joke! Kidding!
entries.translated_text: 荆棘，就像在植物上的那种？你也刺人吗？只是个笑话！开玩笑！

entries.text: And... me? Oh, that's really kind, but you don't have to do that.
entries.translated_text: 还有…我？哦，真是太好了，但其实我能够保护好自己。

entries.text: I don't know why, but Fort Dawnguard is just so bleak.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道为什么，黎明守卫要塞实在是太荒凉了。

entries.text: Hm... Is that so they won't come after you if they discover you're the one who robbed them?
entries.translated_text: 嗯......这样一来，如果他们发现是你抢劫了他们，就不会找你麻烦了吗？

entries.text: (Gasp)
entries.translated_text: （喘气）

entries.text: (Gasp)
entries.translated_text: （喘气）

entries.text: Raiding caves is always fun.
entries.translated_text: 突袭洞穴总是很有趣的。

entries.text: O-oh! You mean, that thing that Bosmer can do with the trees... Ha-oh...
entries.translated_text: 哦——哦！你是说，波兹默可以和树木做的那种事...哈-哦...

entries.text: I'm sorry, he hasn't even spoken to this woman?! Surely Mara has more... passionate love problems to sort out?
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，他甚至还没和这个女人说过话？！玛拉还必须得解决他们的...恋爱问题？

entries.text: Oh, look how the light reflects off these walls! How pretty!
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看这些墙壁上的光线是如何反射的！多么可爱！

texts: I lost tabs on her a few years back. She could be anywhere.
几年前我失去了她的消息。她可能在任何地方。

entries.text: I lost tabs on her a few years back. She could be anywhere.
entries.translated_text: 几年前我失去了她的消息，所以她可能在任何地方。

entries.text: Wonderful!
entries.translated_text: 好极了！

entries.text: W-well. As much as it pains me to admit, very little. I've never been one for the Aedra or the Daedra. Why?
entries.translated_text: 好-好吧。尽管很难承认，但很少。我从来都不是伊德拉或魔神教派的一员。为什么这么问？

entries.text: By Sheor, I'd forgotten how cramped ships are. Makes me nauseous.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，我已经忘记了船只是多么狭窄,让我恶心。

entries.text: Of course, it requires me to have a better understanding of tonal magic. Hm, maybe a more in-depth book would do it?
entries.translated_text: 当然，这需要我对音律魔法有更深入的理解，嗯，也许一本探讨得更加深入的书能够帮助我？

entries.text: The Dwemeris writing here is so different from in High Rock. How many dialects exist?
entries.translated_text: 写在这里的锻莫语的和高岩里的很不一样，它们有多少种方言？

entries.text: Wait, is the roof a boat?
entries.translated_text: 等等，那屋顶是船吗？

entries.text: Valenwood, all the way to the south. What about you? Are you from here?
entries.translated_text: 威木省，位于最南边。那你呢？你是这里人吗？

entries.text: Oh, adventurer, just look at it! That's a tonal lock! Look at the brilliance! Give me a boost up there, will you? I *have* to get a closer look!
entries.translated_text: 哦，冒险者，看看吧！那是音调锁！看看这份巧妙的设计！扶我上去，好吗？我*必须*仔细看看！

entries.text: Calcelmo?!! Ugh, that's the last person who Mara should be extending her benevolence to. Is that bastard even capable of love?!
entries.translated_text: 卡塞莫？！！呃，这是玛拉最不该帮的人了。那个混蛋有爱人的能力吗？！

entries.text: I'd like that.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢。

entries.text: You- You do the same, then?! When have you?!
entries.translated_text: 你，你也是这样吗？什么时候？

entries.text: ...Don't tell this Nils fellow I didn't like it, okay? It ruins the whole point of this endeavor.
entries.translated_text: ...不要告诉这个纽斯这家伙我不喜欢它，好吗？它破坏了这项努力的全部意义。

entries.text: That's great, but I still can't cast magic, so the point is moot.
entries.translated_text: 这很好，但我仍然不会使用魔法，所以没有一点意义。

entries.text: Ha-ha. You ate the taffy treat I was saving, so I think we're even.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。你也吃了我省下的太妃糖，所以我想我们扯平了。

entries.text: Thorn, what would you say if I told you I needed you to hold ten dwemer levers? What does that face mean? No?
entries.translated_text: 荆棘，如果我告诉你我需要你拿着十个锻莫杠杆，你会怎么说？那张脸是什么意思？不？

entries.text: Well, how would you use it?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你会如何使用它呢？

entries.text: Uh... Cavities, I guess.
entries.translated_text: 呃...大概是蛀牙吧。

entries.text: Have you never gone to a market before? It's a bartering term! And, yes, I've met plenty of mercenaries, and I must say it seems you're all the same.
entries.translated_text: 你以前从没去过市集吗？这是一个交易术语！而且，是的，我遇到过很多的佣兵，我必须说你们似乎都一个样。

entries.text: Bring the Aetherium to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 把神光水晶带给蕾米。

entries.text: Hmm... tough one. I guess one where I don't get attacked by wolves and/or bandits every ten minutes.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...很难说。我想我不会喜欢每隔十分钟就被狼和/或强盗袭击的地方。

entries.text: Talk to you later, my love.
entries.translated_text: 以后再说吧，亲爱的。

entries.text: I do enjoy it, but now...
entries.translated_text: 我很喜欢，但现在。。。

entries.text: Are you any good at climbing trees? I think we should go tree climbing. It just sounds fun.
entries.translated_text: 你擅长爬树吗？我想我们应该去爬树。这听起来很有趣。

entries.text: Pay Attention, Remi
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，注意

entries.text: J'zargo sees what you are up to. Very well. You are kind to offer.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格看出了你的意图。很好。你真好，愿意提出帮助。

entries.text: My first kiss was... Well, he was quite lovely, and we were learning ourselves, but some of the... 'explorations'...
entries.translated_text: 我的初吻是...嗯，他相当可爱，我们自己也在学习，但有些...'探索'...

entries.text: I lived in Hammerfell.
entries.translated_text: 我住在落锤省。

entries.text: Alright, yes. Round it off, remind them of the main concern. Perfect.
entries.translated_text: 好的，对，收尾时再提醒他们关注最重要的问题，完美。

entries.text: Do you speak from experience? Did destruction magic fail you at some point?
entries.translated_text: 你有过类似的经历吗？你以前释放毁灭系法术失败过吗？

entries.text: Yeah, but you won't. Not today, anyway. Stay focused.
entries.translated_text: 对，但你不会死的，反正今天不行。保持专注。

entries.text: Wait, what do you mean by that?
entries.translated_text: 等等，你这是什么意思？

entries.text: You did it! Of course, there was hardly any question of if you would. You're rather capable. But still a cause for celebration, right?
entries.translated_text: 你做到了！当然，几乎没人问你意愿。你比较能干。但仍然值得庆祝，对吧？

entries.text: Maybe you want to carry Scrap for a bit?
entries.translated_text: 也许你想带上一会儿小渣？

entries.text: Hm. So he signifies Orc chieftains in general. This is all such a different way of exploring the world. I think I like it!
entries.translated_text: 嗯。所以他象征着一般的兽人首领。这都是探索世界的一种不同方式。我想我喜欢这！

entries.text: You ask me how to write and read... Where do you think I learned that? I'm a mercenary!
entries.translated_text: 你问和如何写字看书...你认为我去哪里学这些东西？我就只是个雇佣兵！

entries.text: (Whisper) On it.
entries.translated_text: （低语）我来搞定。

entries.text: (Whisper) On it.
entries.translated_text: （低语）我来搞定。

entries.text: It appears to be a journal kept by one of the headmasters of Arkngchal! This...
entries.translated_text: 这似乎是阿卡切尔的一位校长所写的日记!这...

entries.text: Uh, well, if he's making you sad, don't talk to him anymore?
entries.translated_text: 呃，好吧，如果他让你难过，就不要再和他说话了？

entries.text: You wouldn't understand even if I did explain. But at least we can agree on the mead.
entries.translated_text: 即使我解释了，你也无法理解。但至少我们可以在喝酒上达成一致。

entries.text: Hm. There's some ones I've transalted from Dwemeris, but they're considerably more difficult to pronounce.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。有些是我从矮人语翻译过来的，但发音要困难得多。

entries.text: And other than that, what do we really have to worry about?!
entries.translated_text: 除此之外，我们真正需要担心的是什么？！

entries.text: Oh, Ubbe, please be careful!
entries.translated_text: 哦，乌贝，请小心！

entries.text: Did... did you feel something strange just now?
entries.translated_text: 有没有...你刚才有什么奇怪的感觉？

entries.text: I think it's important for him to know how good he is, so I tell him! And I also have to discipline him sometimes, but...
entries.translated_text: 我觉得让他知道自己有多棒很重要，所以我会告诉他！不过有时候我也得管教他一下，但是...

entries.text: I'm glad Lorelius is going to fix the wagon wheel. I feel sort of bad for the poor jester, even though he does give me the creeps.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴罗瑞尤斯会修理马车车轮。我为可怜的小丑感到有点难过，尽管他确实让我毛骨悚然。

entries.text: Morvic's Journal
entries.translated_text: 莫维克的日记

texts: Okay, okay. No need to make rash decisions.

entries.text: Ah! Una, look out! We're being attacked!
entries.translated_text: 啊！尤娜，小心！我们被攻击了！

entries.text: I didn't know you were so cold-blooded...
entries.translated_text: 我不知道你居然这么冷血...

entries.text: I can do...
entries.translated_text: 我有...

entries.text: Mercenaries' Ship Key
entries.translated_text: 佣兵船钥匙

entries.text: Number three... That looks to be the location Raldbthar is found in.
entries.translated_text: 第三个...这看起来就是拉德巴尔所在的位置。

entries.text: All around her, she heard whispers and a strange sound, like when a dog whines. And she told herself not to be afraid.
entries.translated_text: 在她周围，她听到耳语和奇怪的声音，就像狗在呜呜叫。她告诉自己不要害怕。

entries.text: I'm seriously considering taking apart that chandelier to see how it's working. Hm. But first, I'd need materials for it.
entries.translated_text: 我在认真考虑怎么把那盏吊灯拆开，看看它是如何工作的。嗯。但首先，我需要相关的材料。

entries.text: Can I help you?
entries.translated_text: 我能帮你吗？

entries.text: Can I help you?
entries.translated_text: 我能帮你吗？

entries.text: Don't worry; we probably won't end up like them.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心;我们可能不会像他们那样悲惨。

entries.text: You mentioned before that you found Skyrim's array of musical choices to be... lacking. Right?
entries.translated_text: 你之前提到，你发现天际能听的音乐...很匮乏。对吗？

entries.text: I'd be more surprised if you hadn't noticed.
entries.translated_text: 如果你没有注意到，那我会更加惊讶。

entries.text: Dwarven Repair Driller
entries.translated_text: 矮人维修钻机

entries.text: But dwemer ruins are filled with priceless artifacts. And artifacts that are easily passed off as priceless if you say so with enough conviction.
entries.translated_text: 但锻莫遗址充满了无价的文物，对于有些人来说，这就是无价之宝。

texts: But dwemer ruins are filled with priceless artifacts. And artifacts that are easily passed off as priceless if you say so with enough conviction.
但矮人废墟充满了无价的文物。对于有些人来说，这就是无价之宝。

entries.text: Alright, I'm right behind you. I'll have to practice my facial expression for when we lie to him.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我会跟在你后面。我得练习一下对他撒谎时的表情。

entries.text: I can't for the life of me think of where I've heard that before.
entries.translated_text: 我这辈子都想不起来我以前在哪里听说过。

entries.text: If we're wanting to save our coin for the more important purchases- you know, like ingots or shiny gems- I prepared some food.
entries.translated_text: 我们应该把钱存起来买一些更重要的东西——你知道的，像铸块啦或闪亮的灵魂石啦之类的——我准备了一些食物。

entries.text: Oh! I think the main event is beginning!
entries.translated_text: 哦！我认为好戏要开始了！

entries.text: Yes, I agree. Thank you, Auri.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我同意。谢谢你，奥璃。

entries.text: My name is Zora Fair-Child, daughter of Riverwood.
entries.translated_text: 我叫佐拉·丽童，“河木镇的女儿”。

entries.text: He's actually offered me quite the deal.
entries.translated_text: 他实际上和我做过很多交易。

entries.text: This force field he's made just keeps growing, doesn't it?
entries.translated_text: 他制造的这个力场一直在增长，不是吗？

entries.text: The people here look at us strangely ever since Cidhna Mine. I can't quite read their expressions, to tell if they're good or not.
entries.translated_text: 自从进了希讷矿坑后，这里的人看我们的眼神都很奇怪。我看不懂他们的表情，也不知道他们是好是坏。

entries.text: I'm here for you, but you don't have to talk about it  if you don't want to.
entries.translated_text: 我是支持你的，但如果你不想谈论它，你不必谈论它。

entries.text: They're  strong, they're ugly, and they're mean! Like me. Minus the ugly part.
entries.translated_text: 他们很强壮，很丑陋，而且很卑鄙！除了丑陋这点，其他的就像我一样。

entries.text: Yea. He was like that...
entries.translated_text: 是的。他是这样的...

entries.text: Not specifically that, but more that we were... negligent. Didn't properly consecrate the body. That- That sort of thing.
entries.translated_text: 具体来说不是这样，而是我们......疏忽了。没有正确地祭奠尸体诸如此类。

entries.text: Oh! Really? Well, alright. Next time, then.
entries.translated_text: 哦！真的吗？好吧，好吧。那就下次吧。

entries.text: Filthy necromancer! I'll teach you a lesson!
entries.translated_text: 肮脏的死灵法师！我将给你一个教训！

entries.text: We won't die! At least, I don't think Revan will let us die! So there!
entries.translated_text: 我们不会死的！至少，我不认为渡鸦会让我们死的！

entries.text: Okay, let me just...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我...

entries.text: I've always been a fan of opposing authority. Opposing the will of a daedra gives me quite a bit of satisfaction.
entries.translated_text: 我一直是个反对权威的人。反抗一个魔神的意志更是让我感到相当满足。

entries.text: After the disappearance of the dwemer, ashes were found in their cities in Mournhold, implying something disintegrated their corporeal forms.
entries.translated_text: 在锻莫消失后，在哀伤要塞的城市中发现了灰烬，暗示着他们的肉身被某种东西解体了。

entries.text: Ooh, what? They were trying to kill *me*?! But why?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，什么？他们想杀我？！但为什么？！

entries.text: Oh, yes, Nordic ruins sure are. Hm. Bland? Well, then, perhaps one day you can tell me about some of the places and people you've seen beyond Skyrim?
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，诺德遗址的确有点。呃，无聊？那么，也许有一天你能讲讲你在天际外面看到的那些人和事吗？

entries.text: Apparently you don't get hangovers from Flin. Sounds good to me!
entries.translated_text: 听说喝飞令不会宿醉，很不错！

entries.text: I never cared much for treasure.
entries.translated_text: 我从来都不太关心宝藏。

entries.text: Although I imagine taking from the Prince of Domination is a bad idea.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我认为从支配魔神手中拿东西是个坏主意。

entries.text: Off we go!
entries.translated_text: 我们走吧！

entries.text: Sincerely, thank you.
entries.translated_text: 真的，谢谢你。

entries.text: Courier
entries.translated_text: 信使

entries.text: Er...
Have you been thinking of any more projects lately?
entries.translated_text: 你最近有没有想过更多的研究项目？

entries.text: I've never met a famous person before. Do we have to dress up? I don't know any spells for conjuring fine robes.
entries.translated_text: 我以前从未见过权贵。我们应该打扮一下吗？我不知道有什么魔法可以变出漂亮的长袍。

entries.text: Uh-huh! Give. Me! (Grunt) Oof... How. You. Carry. This??
entries.translated_text: 嗯！给。我（咕噜声）哦...你，怎么，拿着，这个？？

entries.text: Given that dwarven armour seems to fit modern-day men and mer, dwemer were likely of similar size to the other races, rather than 'dwarf' sized.
entries.translated_text: 鉴于矮人盔甲似乎适合现代人和莫（精灵），锻莫的体型可能与其他种族相似，而不是“矮人”大小。

entries.text: Well, they teach you a lot about how to recite things in an interesting way. Songs, poems, stories, that sort of thing.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，他们会教你很多关于如何以有趣的方式背诵东西。就像是歌曲、诗歌、故事之类的。

entries.text: Anyway, what songs would you like Skyrim bards to play, Yaz?
entries.translated_text: 总之，你希望天际的吟游诗人演奏什么歌曲，雅扎？

entries.text: I do think it's wrong.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得这是错的。

entries.text: By Mephala, that's even worse than the truth! (Sigh) My full name is... Valerius.
entries.translated_text: 梅法拉在上，真是太糟了！（叹气）我的全名是...瓦雷瑞

entries.text: Men and mer and animals and anything really- When they move or act or interact with the world, they create music to go along with Aurbis' sound.
entries.translated_text: 人、莫、动物和任何实物——当他们移动、行动或与世界互动时，他们创造出与奥比斯的声音一致的声音。

entries.text: So if Yazakh is not the music sort of bard, that means my dreams of her hitting someone upside the head with a lute are out the window, aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 所以，如果雅扎克不是音乐类的吟游诗人，那就意味着我关于她用鲁特琴打别人脑袋的梦想实现不了了，不是吗？

entries.text: Bards sure seem to lose their instruments often. Between the missing flute and the missing lute -
entries.translated_text: 吟游诗人似乎经常丢失他们的乐器。要么长笛丢了，要么鲁特琴丢了——

entries.text: Yes, I suppose that is an area that causes me quite a bit of grief. I've never been particularly great at... noticing such implications from others.
entries.translated_text: 是的，这事情曾让我有了很多的伤心事，我也从来不太擅长....注意别人的这种暗示。

entries.text: What is a 'diagram'? No, no I don't worship anyone; I don't really care. What's it to you?
entries.translated_text: 什么是“图标”？不，不，我不信仰任何人；我真的不在乎。你怎么了？

entries.text: I think I broke his heart when I told him I didn't want to remain his partner.
entries.translated_text: 我想当我告诉他我不想继续做他的伴侣时，我伤了他的心。

entries.text: I mean, tomes tell us how to cast magic, but does anyone really know how it works?
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，书上告诉我们如何施放魔法，但有人真的知道它是如何运作的吗？

entries.text: Well, learning this about you has helped me understand you more, I think. I already feel closer to you.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想，知道你的这些会让我更了解，我已经觉得离你更近了。

entries.text: Don't worry; I won't tell anyone that you secretly like being around us.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心，我不会告诉任何人你偷偷地喜欢和我们在一起。

entries.text: Oh, of course, how didn't I see it before?! That's genius!
entries.translated_text: 哦，当然，我以前怎么没看出来？真是天才！

entries.text: And what exactly stops Madanach from ordering our deaths at some point? Are we actually going to be able to get out of here alive?
entries.translated_text: 到底是什么让迈德纳奇没有下令杀死我们？我们真的能活着离开这里吗？

entries.text: Yes, there really is. I'm tired of being cold all the time. I imagine you're used to it?
entries.translated_text: 是的，确实是。我厌倦了永无止尽的寒冷。我想你已经习惯了吧？

entries.text: Ria, if you could kill them now, I'd appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 利亚，如果你现在能杀了他们，我会很感激！

entries.text: Oh! I love being in cities! Do you hear the merchants calling out their wares?! Let's go see what they have... Are you okay, Khash?
entries.translated_text: 哦！我超喜欢待在城市里！你听到那些商人叫卖他们的货物了吗？！我们去看看他们都在卖什么吧...你还好吗，卡什？

entries.text: It's going to be like carrying the Sun around! Except... Less hot. I hope.
entries.translated_text: 就像携带着太阳一样！除了...不那么热。我希望如此。

entries.text: Alright, let's get rid of these little pests!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我们摆脱这些小害虫！

entries.text: So you're going to return the Skeleton Key to Nocturnal? Sort of ironic for a thief to be on a mission to retrieve a stolen object, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 所以你要把骷髅钥匙还给诺克图娜尔？对小偷来说是一种讽刺，不是吗？

entries.text: Someone just tried to pick my pocket. I pretended not to notice, and stole their coinpurse instead.
entries.translated_text: 之前有人想偷我东西，我当时假装没注意到，然后偷走了他们的钱包。

entries.text: Well... What did you have in mind for revenge?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...你有什么报复的想法？

entries.text: The only downside to traveling is that I miss my parents very much.
entries.translated_text: 旅行的唯一缺点是我很想念我的父母。

entries.text: Not really. Some casual acquaintances, but I was never very good at making friends - definitely not close ones, at least.
entries.translated_text: 并非如此。还有一些偶然认识的人，但我从来都不擅长交朋友--至少他们绝对不是亲密的朋友。

entries.text: Y-you're joking... right? I-I...
entries.translated_text: 你、你在开玩笑...对吧？我-我...

entries.text: And for him... I was responsible for his family's suffering.
entries.translated_text: 对他来说...我要为他家人的痛苦负责。

entries.text: Please don't call me that. I hate that name.
entries.translated_text: 请别这么叫我，我讨厌那个名字。

entries.text: (Laughing) Right. I suppose there's something to be said for drinks from home.
entries.translated_text: (笑) 对。我想，家里的东西才值得留恋。

entries.text: Okay, you know the drill, Remi. Loser... Uh. Well, you know. Shall we?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，蕾米，你知道该怎么做。你这失败者……呃。嗯，你知道的。我们可以吗？

entries.text: Did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 有事吗？

entries.text: Head to Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 前往阿卡切尔。

entries.text: Head to Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 前往阿卡切尔。

entries.text: Oh. Her. Thinking... Again. Maybe. Later.
entries.translated_text: 哦，她，又在...思考，也许，以后。

entries.text: Let me take a look at it.
entries.translated_text: 让我看看。

entries.text: Oh yes, this piece is important.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，这件作品很重要。

entries.text: Yes, and I'm sure I'll enjoy its taste just as much.
entries.translated_text: 是的，而且我相信我也会同样享受它的味道。

entries.text: Hm... 'Silence of Bones'... That would be a good title for a story.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...《骨之寂静》...真是个好标题

entries.text: I can't lie, I can't imagine you dressed up like royalty.
entries.translated_text: 说实话，我无法想象你可以打扮得像个公主。

entries.text: Hmm... That's a good point.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...这是一个好观点。

entries.text: You... want to play with him? Well, that's so sweet! Let me just-
entries.translated_text: 你...想和他玩吗？哦，真是太贴心了！让我来-

entries.text: Skyrim is not my home; it was with the Ravens, so I'll spend the rest of my life with their spirits in tow,
entries.translated_text: 天际省不是我的家；群乌团才是，所以我会和他们的灵魂一起度过余生，

entries.text: My mother remarried when I was five, and I've never known him as anything other than my father.
entries.translated_text: 我五岁的时候妈妈再婚了，除了他是我父亲我对他一无所知。

entries.text: My mother remarried when I was five, and I've never known him as anything other than my father.
entries.translated_text: 我五岁的时候妈妈再婚了，除了他是我父亲我对他一无所知。

entries.text: Now that you've cleansed the All-Maker Stones, hopefully I won't wake up in the middle of the night hammering away at them anymore.
entries.translated_text: 既然你已经净化了所有的造物主之石，希望我不会再半夜醒来敲打它们了。

entries.text: Buffy, I have been having so many ideas, and none of them will ever work outside my head. Please be sorry for me.
entries.translated_text: 巴非，我一直有很多想法，，但没有一个能在我脑海外实现的，真是遗憾。

entries.text: Did- Did you just hear something?
entries.translated_text: 你刚才听到什么了吗？

entries.text: Yep! His name is Numi.
entries.translated_text: 是的！他叫纳米。

entries.text: Paarthurnax... is a dragon?
entries.translated_text: 帕图纳克斯...是龙？

entries.text: Please don't die, okay, Yaz?!
entries.translated_text: 请不要死，好吗，雅扎？

entries.text: <Alias=Remi> is waiting for you.
entries.translated_text: <Alias=Remi>正在等着你。

entries.text: I definitely was! And those are memories that I keep for myself when I am feeling lonely. To remember that I could connect with someone so deeply.
entries.translated_text: 毫无疑问!而这些是我在感到孤独时为自己保留的记忆。要记住我可以与某人如此深入地联系。

entries.text: (Startled Laugh) Again? That's something that happens often then? Perhaps that'd be useful for saving food for later?
entries.translated_text: （愕然一笑）又？看来经常发生？以后可以利用这保存好食物？

entries.text: But violence can be a really good solution. I think you should punch them if they are. They deserve it then.
entries.translated_text: 但暴力可能是一个非常好的解决方案。如果他们是，我认为你应该打他们。那时他们应得的。

entries.text: Tell me about who hired you.
entries.translated_text: 告诉我谁派你来的。

entries.text: Oh, sorry. You know how it is when I'm thinking too hard about something. I forget about all sorts of things.
entries.translated_text: 哦，抱歉。你知道的，当我在认真思考某件事时，我会忘记所有其他的事情。

entries.text: Both.
entries.translated_text: 两者都是。

entries.text: Both.
entries.translated_text: 两者都是。

entries.text: Both.
entries.translated_text: 两者都是。

entries.text: I don't condone thievery.
entries.translated_text: 我不会容忍盗窃。

entries.text: Using that Bend Will Shout freed those enslaved at the Wind Stone, so there's no reason we can't free the other brainwash victims, too.
entries.translated_text: 用“意志屈服”的吼声解放了被风石奴役的那些人，所以我们完全可以解救其他被洗脑的受害者！

entries.text: Are you all right?
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？

entries.text: I am not that good with puzzles. Though I do like 'I Spy.' It is like 'I Spy?'
entries.translated_text: 我不擅长拼图。虽然我很喜欢《我是间谍》。这就像《我是间谍》”

entries.text: As a child, Otero and I would pass the time on the road by playing Withershins.
entries.translated_text: 小时候，奥特罗和我会在路上玩接首字游戏来打发时间。

entries.text: Y-yeah. Well, thank you for hearing me out. Let's get back to our relaxation time. We deserve it!
entries.translated_text: 是的，嗯，谢谢你听我说完，让我们回到我们的放松时间，那是我们应得的！

entries.text: Don't forget me here, okay?
entries.translated_text: 别忘了我在这，好吗？

entries.text: What do you know of Daedra worship, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你对魔族信仰了解多少？

entries.text: Um. Scrap. No. Like. Me?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，小渣，不，喜欢，我？

entries.text: Did you see that person's amulet? It was so pretty! Maybe I'll just do some... shopping.
entries.translated_text: 你看到那个人的护符了吗？太漂亮了！也许我会做一些...购物。

entries.text: Any ideas?
entries.translated_text: 有什么想法？

entries.text: Oh Gods, Remi, please program it to love me. It's perfect. Can it kill people?
entries.translated_text: 天啊，蕾米，请给它编写让它喜欢我的思维。这太完美了。它能杀人吗？

entries.text: Do you ever just watch Giants sometimes? They're sort of cute, in their own way.
entries.translated_text: 你有没有偶尔观察过巨人？他们有点可爱，以自己的方式来说。

entries.text: Yes... Well, not the Hunters themselves, obviously.
entries.translated_text: 是的...好吧，显然不是他们本身。

entries.text: Ugh, why would you tell me such wondrous news and then in the next breath tell me to wait?!
entries.translated_text: 唉，你为什么告诉我这么好的消息后，下一秒又突然让我等等呢？

entries.text: Point it at the target...
entries.translated_text: 瞄准目标...

entries.text: The wind blows bitter cold in this place. Skyrim was not J'zargo's first choice.
entries.translated_text: 这地方寒风凛冽，天际并不是吉'扎格的首选。

entries.text: These old Nord tombs smell like sweat and flies.
entries.translated_text: 这些诺德人的古墓有汗水和苍蝇的味道。

entries.text: Tell me if you spot any ghosts!
entries.translated_text: 告诉我你找到幽灵了吗！

entries.text: Well, it's hardly my fault that your friend here agreed to 200. Perhaps you should hash out your business dealings with them prior to taking on work?
entries.translated_text: 呃，你的朋友已经答应了只要200金币，这不是我的错。也许你应该在开始工作之前应该和你朋友谈谈合作问题了？

entries.text: Oh good. I'm glad you understand my perspective here. Scrap will keep helping us in battle.
entries.translated_text: 哦，很好。我很高兴你能理解我的观点。小渣将继续帮助我们战斗。

entries.text: 裂谷城
entries.translated_text: 裂谷城

entries.text: The Imperials outlawed the selling of dwarven artifacts, you know. They claim ownership over them. No one really abides by that silly law, though.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，帝国禁止出售锻莫文物。他们声称对他们拥有所有权。不过，没有人真正遵守这一愚蠢的法律。

entries.text: I'm trying to be nice, Val, don't ruin it.
entries.translated_text: 我是想对你好，瓦尔，别破坏气氛。

entries.text: Remember, Dragonborn. Resist Hermaeus Mora's influence while delving into the Black Books, or I fear you'll be lost to us.
entries.translated_text: 记住，龙裔。在深入探索黑暗经书的同时要抵御赫麦尤斯·莫拉的影响，否则我担心我们会失去你。

entries.text: Is this it?
entries.translated_text: 是这个吗？

entries.text: I don't know, it doesn't seem so impressive to me. And the people aren't either.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，这对我来说似乎没有那么令人印象深刻。这儿的人们也没有。

entries.text: While I can dream of the first idea, I do imagine you're right that they'll just go with the second.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我希望是第一个想法，但我想你是对的，他们会选择第二个想法。

entries.text: Good work out there, Buffy!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，巴非！

entries.text: No, sorry.
entries.translated_text: 没有，抱歉。

entries.text: Thankfully, there was an elder who took pity on him. Knowing Rodard was tight on coin, he paid the hunter a bounty. A powerful wraith had been seen.
entries.translated_text: 幸好有一位长老可怜他。知道罗达德的钱包很紧，他付给猎人一笔赏金。因为一个强大的幽灵出现了。

entries.text: What...? Sorry, I didn't notice you for a second.
entries.translated_text: 什么...？抱歉，我刚才没注意到你。

entries.text: Your little parlour tricks are an insult to mages!
entries.translated_text: 你的小伎俩是对法师的侮辱!

entries.text: I'm definitely familiar with impulsive decisions surrounding treasure, but that mace was hardly what I would consider treasure.
entries.translated_text: 我也经常因为宝藏做出很多冲动决定，但我可不会把那把钉锤视作宝藏。

entries.text: You turn it until a reasonable flow of ale is being poured.
entries.translated_text: 你转动它，直到倒出适量的麦酒流出。

entries.text: Oh, I wish you had, so I could read them! I think we'll have no trouble with our enemies with you wielding this!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我真希望你有，这样我就能读到它们了！我想你拿着这个后，我们的敌人就不会找我们的麻烦了！

entries.text: Alright, I suppose I can accommodate you, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这么想我还是可以接受。

entries.text: Oh! Yes! Yes, of course, Khash! Anytime!
entries.translated_text: 哦！当然可以，卡什！随时都行！

entries.text:
The Order of the Hour took me for questioning, as some fool had written to them regarding evidence that I worship daedra. This letter, coupled with the fact that I'd been previously investigated due to the Charoud family, made them confident that they investigate me and my family once again. Ignoring the looks I've been receiving at market, the city guard and the Order looking into my affairs in such a short passing of time is suspicious.

Fortunately, my name holds some sway still, and the Order allowed me to review this "tip-off." The letter itself was ridiculous - I can hardly believe they'd give credence to it - but the sign-off was so obvious that I cannot say I'm surprised. Simply an "-R." Remiel.

-----------------------------------------------

I'm packed and ready. It will not be long before I arrive in Skyrim. Those foolish mercenaries clearly couldn't handle their assignment. Such a waste of coin. I will be finishing this myself, it seems.

------------------------------------------------

I've crossed the border into Skyrim. While traveling, I studied Skyrim's locations extensively, trying to deduce where Remiel would have gone. The problem remains that I have not seen hide nor hair of her for years, and I have no clue how long she's been in Skyrim. She could be anywhere.

However, my readings describe the city of Markarth as built within the ruins of an ancient dwemer city. Such a city, so close to the Hammerfell border, is an obvious destination. I will begin my investigations there.

--------------------------------------------------

I've asked about at the local inn, the "Silverblood Inn," about a dwemer researcher. The innkeep was rather forthcoming with information; I have the distinct impression that he both dislikes his career and disliked Remiel. No matter-that's worked in my favour here. 

Apparently she departed some time ago in the company of some adventurous type. The innkeep was under the impression that this individual is likely still in Skyrim, which means Remiel is, too. Good. Now if the innkeep's loud-mouthed wife can just keep quiet about my presence, I can continue my search in peace.

----------------------------------------------------

I questioned the local "dwemer expert," Calcelmo, about dwemer ruins in the area. He listed a number of names, all unpronounceable, but one stuck with me. A relatively small ruin, perhaps a satellite of sorts for the purposes of researching the stars. The details elude me, but the main point is that the ruin was "curiously unguarded" by automaton. This would be where Remiel would first search.

----------------------------------------------------

I've set camp outside Arkngchal. I will search for clues about Remiel's location. Surely, she'll have left something behind that will point me in her direction.
entries.translated_text:
时序团审问了我，因为有个傻子给他们写了信，说我信仰魔族。有了这封信，再加上我之前因为夏鲁家族的事被调查过，让他们确信要再次调查我和我的家族。虽然我在市场上受到的那些目光我可以无视，但城市卫队和教团在如此短的时间内调查我的事情，这实在令人怀疑。


幸运的是，我的名字仍然有一定的影响力，时序团允许我查看“密报”。信件本身荒谬至极——我简直无法相信他们会信它——但署名确是如此明显，我并不感到惊讶。仅仅是一个“-R。” 蕾米尔。



-----------------------------------------------



我已打包准备好了。不久之后我就会到达天际省。那些愚蠢的雇佣兵显然无法完成他们的任务。真是浪费钱财。看来我得亲自去完成了。


------------------------------------------------



我已经越过了天际省的边境。在旅行的途中，我全面地研究了天际省的各个地点，试图推测蕾米尔可能去了哪里。问题在于我已经很多年没有见过她，也不知道她在天际省待了多久。她可能在任何地方。

不过，我的研究显示马卡斯城建在古代矮人城市的废墟之上。这样一座城市，距离落锤的边界那么近，是一个明显的目标。我将从那里开始我的调查。



--------------------------------------------------



我在当地的旅馆，"银血旅馆"打听了关于一个矮人研究者的事。旅店老板很乐意提供信息;我清楚地感觉到，他既不喜欢自己的职业生涯，也不喜欢蕾米尔。没关系，这对我很有利。



显然她在不久前与某个像冒险者的人离开了。店主认为这个人很可能还在天际省，这意味着蕾米尔也还在这里。很好。现在只要店主那多嘴的妻子能保持安静，我就能继续平静地搜查。


----------------------------------------------------



我向当地的“矮人专家”卡塞莫询问了该地区矮人遗迹的情况。他列出了许多名字，全都难以发音，但有一个我记住了。那是一个相对较小的遗址，可能是用于研究星象的附属建筑。我不知道细节，但重点是，遗址“奇怪地没有被机器人保护”。这就是蕾米尔首先寻找的地方。



----------------------------------------------------



我在阿卡切尔外扎营。我会去寻找蕾米尔所在位置的线索。她肯定会留下某些指向她方向的痕迹。

entries.text: Oh, I remember this room! There are gates that lead further into the ruin, but they shut on me when I tried to go through.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我记得这个房间！这有一些门可以进一步进入遗址，但当我试图通过时，它们却对我关闭了。

entries.text: There was a man. He said he was from the Psijic Order.
entries.translated_text: 有一个男人，他说他来自赛伊克教团。

entries.text: So this is the Staff of Magnus. It's pretty.
entries.translated_text: 这就是马格努斯之杖，真漂亮。

entries.text: It's just so hard to not become distracted by a new stimulus, whether it's in the physical world or the internal one!
entries.translated_text: 无论是物质世界还是内心世界，要想不被新的刺激分心实在是太难了！

entries.text: Are all pirates- er, I mean... people who steal and maybe murder and then sail away- Are they all quite so intelligent as you?
entries.translated_text: 难道那些海盗，呃，我是说...那些偷窃、谋杀然后扬长而去的人，都像你这么聪明吗？

entries.text: Oh? What page is that on?
entries.translated_text: 哦，那是哪一页？

entries.text: Free bonemeal!
entries.translated_text: 免费骨粉！

entries.text: I know Yaz and I don't look it, but we are a dangerous pair to pick a fight with!
entries.translated_text: 我知道雅扎和我看起来不像，但我们是一对危险的挑衅者！

entries.text: Now to find a mercenary.
entries.translated_text: 现在找一个佣兵。

entries.text: I hate to ask, but is it flirting if Alva's been looking at me like she wants to make a meal of me?
entries.translated_text: 我虽然不想问，但阿尔瓦一直看着我，好像她想吃掉我，这是在调情吗？

entries.text: You could hire me.
entries.translated_text: 你可以雇我。

entries.text: I... Oh, that's so nice of you. You really think it'll look nice?
entries.translated_text: 我...哦，你真好，你真的觉得它会好看吗？

entries.text: You know, your blushing bride and I got on quite well, although I was terribly offended when you chose Sam to be your best man over me.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，你那脸红的新娘和我相处得很好，尽管当你选择山姆做你的证婚人而不是我时，我非常生气。

entries.text: I'd also have trouble keeping track of which deity was in charge of which thing.
entries.translated_text: 我也很难记住哪个神灵负责哪个领域。

entries.text: Excuse me, I have skill, but no stamina.
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，我有技术，但没有耐心。（Excuse，E开头）

entries.text: And you figured that was probably fine?! At least it makes sense now why that priest man attacked us.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得这样就没事了？至少现在明白为什么那名祭司要攻击我们了。

entries.text: Alright, I'm ready-ish.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我准备好了。

entries.text: Alright, I'm ready-ish.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我差不多准备好了。

entries.text: So, after her parents finally fell asleep, she slipped out from bed and crept to the door. She slid the lock open and stepped bravely into the night.
entries.translated_text: 于是，等她父母终于睡着后，她从床上溜了出来，蹑手蹑脚地走到门口。她推开锁，勇敢地走进夜色中。

entries.text: Oh! I...
Oh no, but then that means that fellow can't-- Wait, what's he doing?! H-he just threw it away?! He could've come to ask what it said, at least!
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，但这意味着那个家伙不能--等等，他在干什么？他就这么扔了？他至少可以来问问上面写了什么！

entries.text: And that's all of them!
entries.translated_text: 就这些！

entries.text: Sure, if you find the beautiful tones and melodies of horker screams to be compelling. You just have to believe me on this one. I don't sing.
entries.translated_text: 当然，除非你觉得海兽的尖叫声那种美丽的音调和旋律很吸引人。你只需要相信我，我真的不唱歌。

entries.text: What. This. Button. Do?
entries.translated_text: 这，按钮，按？

entries.text: Sometimes Yaz says something, and it takes me a while to realize it was a joke. She says her jokes so seriously!
entries.translated_text: 有时雅扎说了一些话，我得花了好一会儿才意识到这是一个笑话。她说她的笑话时好认真！

entries.text: Well, that's not good. I better fix that, or you'll be the one hauling all the Dwemer artefacts out of the ruins.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那可不好。我最好解决这个问题，否则那些锻莫制品以后就该你来搬了。

entries.text: We are unstoppable, Raven!
entries.translated_text: 我们是势不可挡，雷！

entries.text: You- You were arrested for murder! And in Markarth of all places! Cidhna Mine is the absolute worst place to be imprisoned, I'm sure of it!
entries.translated_text: 你——你明明因为谋杀罪被捕了！而且还是关在马卡斯的所有地方里最糟糕的希讷矿坑！我十分确信，这里是最糟糕的监狱！

entries.text: Remi, look at this note.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，看看这张纸条。

entries.text: Can you imagine me trying to stay attentive while a priest droned on and on about a being that hardly holds sway in my life?
entries.translated_text: 你能想象当一个牧师滔滔不绝地讲述一个在我的生活中几乎没有影响力的存在时，我还能保持注意力吗？

entries.text: Hmm... This building is called the 'Hall of Rumination'. Perhaps used as a site for meditation, do you think?
entries.translated_text: 嗯……这座结构叫做‘沉思大厅’。也许被用作冥想的场所，你觉得呢？

entries.text: Remiel's Contraption
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的装置

entries.text: Hello, Doc. Were you going to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 你好，医生，你打算问我一些事情吗？

entries.text: No, it... It really isn't encouraged. It's... It makes their worshippers targets.
entries.translated_text: 不，它……它是完全被禁止的。这...使魔族的信仰者成为被猎杀的目标。

entries.text: I guess it would've been asking too much for a leisurely walk to the treasure.
entries.translated_text: 我想，宝藏不是那么能轻易得到的。

entries.text: Take this! And now an arrow from Auri!
entries.translated_text: 拿着这个！现在是支来自奥璃的箭！

entries.text: Whispering to gravestones in dead of night.
entries.translated_text: 在夜深人静时对墓碑低语。

entries.text: Based on the piping, I'd have expected it to open with the power turning on. The age must be getting to it.
entries.translated_text: 根据这些管道，我猜测当动力源启动时，它就会打开，这已经有一定年头了。

entries.text: At sea, dining - if you'd even call it that - can be pretty grim.
entries.translated_text: 在海上，吃饭——如果你甚至愿意这么说的话——可能相当糟糕。

entries.text: And that's not overwhelming? You can keep ahold of your sense of self?
entries.translated_text: 那不会让你感到不堪重负吗？你能保持自我吗？

entries.text: Don't lie to me, Doc. Am I dying? It feels like I'm dying.
entries.translated_text: 别骗我，医生，我快死了吗？感觉就像我快死了。

entries.text: Scrap and I are here for you.
entries.translated_text: 小渣和我会在这里等你。

entries.text: Look for the researchers and for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel (Unique Cog Found)
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔中寻找研究人员和有趣的文物（发现独特的齿轮）

entries.text: I can't believe this mage fellow stole those books. I'd definitely never ever do something like that.
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信这个法师家伙偷了那些书，我就绝对不会做那样的事。

entries.text: I'm exhausted. Couldn't sleep last time we rested. I just had too many thoughts running through my mind. Do you ever have that problem?
entries.translated_text: 我累极了，上次休息的时候没睡着，就是有太多的想法在我的脑海中流过，你有过这样的问题吗？

entries.text: Yes. I'm glad that made sense to you.
entries.translated_text: 是的。我很高兴这对你有意义。

entries.text: Is this what you call a knight's honour?
entries.translated_text: 这就是你所说的骑士荣誉吗？

entries.text: Exactly! I'm glad I could sway you to reason.
entries.translated_text: 是啊！我很高兴我能说服你。

entries.text: Me, sarcastic? Why would I ever do that?
entries.translated_text: 我，讽刺？我为什么要这么做？

entries.text: Well, I don't see why not. I'm sure people will want to buy some of my inventions... Not to mention everything you find while exploring.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我不明白为什么不。我相信人们会想要购买我的一些发明...更不用说你在探索时发现的那些。

entries.text: W-what was that?! Oh. Nothing. I-I thought it might be another assassin. But it wasn't.
entries.translated_text: 那是什么？哦，没什么。我还以为是另一个刺客，结果不是。

entries.text: Take this, you great ugly fish thing!
entries.translated_text: 尝尝这个，你这个丑陋的大鱼！

entries.text: Okay, what specifically did you want to discuss?
entries.translated_text: 好的，你具体想讨论什么？

entries.text: Please, take me somewhere fascinating so that I do not have to think of such things anymore.
entries.translated_text: 请带我去一个山清水秀的地方，这样我就不用再想这些事情了。

entries.text: Let's continue the letter.
entries.translated_text: 我们接着写这封信。

entries.text: Remi's Backpack
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的背包

entries.text: Honestly, I have no clue what just happened.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我不知道刚刚发生了什么。

entries.text: Cut its heel! That's all we can reach anyway!
entries.translated_text: 砍断它的脚跟！无论如何，这就是我们所能做到的！

entries.text: I often wonder what technology the dwemer would have if they still existed on Nirn today. Likely they'd have somehow destroyed the world, though.
entries.translated_text: 我经常想知道如果锻莫今天仍然存在于奈恩，他们会有什么技术。不过，他们很可能会以某种方式摧毁世界。

entries.text: What in Oblivion is that Thalmor doing to the Eye?! Hey, that's our arcane orb of immense power! Find your own!
entries.translated_text: 该死，梭默对马格努斯之眼做了什么？！嘿，那是我们奥术之球体！想要自己去找！

entries.text: It's fine. It can just be kind of a sore subject.
entries.translated_text: 没关系。只不过这话题有点触动神经。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel was once a sort of base of operations for a vampire called 'Lady Belain', who attacked Markarth from below.
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔曾经是一个名为“贝兰夫人”的吸血鬼的行动基地，她从地下袭击了马卡斯城。

entries.text: How does a roasted rabbit cooked with minced garlic and a sprinkle of frost mirriam sound?
entries.translated_text: 一只烤兔子配上蒜末和寒霜甘草，听起来怎么样？

entries.text: It was a spectacular journey! Everything about it was just so awe-inspiring and educational and fun!
entries.translated_text: 这是一次壮丽的旅程!它的一切都让人敬畏，能涨见识，也很有趣!

entries.text: Ganbald.
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德。

entries.text: Were you aware that blacksmiths don't like you using their smelters? Why didn't you tell me? I got my ear yelled off for not getting 'permission.'
entries.translated_text: 你知道铁匠不喜欢你用他们的熔炉吗？你为什么不告诉我？我因为没有得到 "允许 "而被骂得狗血淋头。

entries.text: And with our mutual friend keeping our enemies distracted, they'll never know what hit them.
entries.translated_text: 我们共同的朋友会骚扰我们的敌人，他们永远也不会知道会遭受什么攻击。

entries.text: Hey, I know I've probably said it before...
entries.translated_text: 嘿，我知道我可能以前说过...

entries.text: (Mumbling) He always did have good advice...
entries.translated_text: （喃喃自语）他总是有很好的建议...

entries.text: All's fair in love and war, my new friend.
entries.translated_text: 爱情和战争都很公平，我的新朋友。

entries.text: Yes, I did.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我做了。

entries.text: Yes, I guess it is.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想是的。

entries.text: Have Remi Lockpick a door in front of the player.
entries.translated_text: 让蕾米在玩家面前开锁。

entries.text: All these shops and stalls! There's just so much ripe for the taking!
entries.translated_text: 看这些商店和摊位！有这么多好东西等着我们去拿！

entries.text: Actually no - I don't think the Dwemer ever really came to Cyrodiil. Sorry to disappoint you.
entries.translated_text: 事实上没有--我觉得锻莫曾经没有真正来到过赛瑞迪尔。对不起，让你失望了。

entries.text: Then again, Riften's guards don't seem the most... moral. I can definitely see them 'confiscating' it to keep for themselves.
entries.translated_text: 话说回来，裂谷城守卫似乎并不是太...有道德。我肯定他们"没收"这些只是为了自己享用。

entries.text: He wants me to bring a priest of Boethiah to him.
entries.translated_text: 他要我带一个波耶西亚祭司去见他。

entries.text: As I think on it, it's quite lucky Scrap doesn't need to be fed in the traditional sense. I'd have forgotten to feed him and he'd have died by now.
entries.translated_text: 我想了想，很幸运，小渣不需要在传统意义上进食。如果我忘了喂它，它现在就已经死了。

entries.text: Well, maybe not *all* figured out. But I thought with your help, I could put it all together.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，也许我还没有完全弄明白。但我想在你的帮助下，我可以把这一切都解决。

entries.text: Luck? I think it has more to do with hard work.
entries.translated_text: 运气？我认为是因为努力工作得来的。

entries.text: Sheor, this ale is... Is this even ale? Hey, uh, Yaz, I've gotten you a drink! It was definitely meant for you this whole time!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔啊，这麦芽酒是...这还是麦芽酒吗？嘿，呃，雅扎，我帮你搞了一瓶！这绝对是一直一来为你量身打造的好酒！

entries.text: I think I'd get bored in a small village like this.
entries.translated_text: 我想我会在这样的小村庄里感到无聊。

entries.text: Mortu. Mortu, look at me. Do not forget I am standing here. Don't forget me, Mor.
entries.translated_text: 莫尔图，莫尔图，看着我。别忘了我还站在这里，别忘了我，莫尔。

entries.text: Well, I'm... sorry for that as well. I just- I'll work on it.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我......也很抱歉，我会努力的。

entries.text: Great! What are we drinking?
entries.translated_text: 太棒了我们喝什么？

entries.text: Why try to take it? And how did you manage to get out of that trap?!
entries.translated_text: 为什么要拿走它？你又是如何脱困的？

entries.text: What happened to her?
entries.translated_text: 她遭遇了什么？

entries.text: You can't scare me into submission. Leave me alone.
entries.translated_text: 你吓唬不了我，让我一个人呆着。

entries.text: If the food was so good, why isn't your heart in eating?
entries.translated_text: 如果美食这么美妙，那你为什么还没有吃东西的心思？

entries.text: Okay, Ren, lead the way!
entries.translated_text: 好的，雷，带路！

entries.text: Me? Definitely not. I could never quite figure magic out.
entries.translated_text: 我？绝对不行。我一直都搞不太懂魔法是怎么回事。

entries.text: So you're telling me these little catchphrases aren't unique to you? And here I thought you were being creative.
entries.translated_text: 你是说这些话不是你独创的吗？我一开始觉得你很有创意。

entries.text: You're so beautiful! I'm sorry to kill you!
entries.translated_text: 你非常漂亮！杀了你我很抱歉！

entries.text: I wish we could have some Seared Venomsteaks.
entries.translated_text: 我希望我们能有一些烤毒蛇。

entries.text: Oof... Arms. Hurt. Have. Fun!
entries.translated_text: 哦...手臂，好痛，玩的，开心！

entries.text: Well, the mace looks prettier now, at least. Er, well, maybe not *pretty*, but certainly not so rusty.
entries.translated_text: 至少，这钉锤现在看起来更漂亮了。呃，好吧，也许不是*漂亮*，但肯定不那么锈迹斑斑了。

entries.text: Ruth!
entries.translated_text: 鲁斯（该死）！

entries.text: Right you are.
entries.translated_text: 你是对的。

entries.text: So corners, junk closets, places that no one pays much attention to. It's gotta be around here somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 因此，角落、垃圾柜、没有人注意的地方。它一定就在这附近的某个地方。

entries.text: Bandits are always complaining about their illegitimate children.
entries.translated_text: 强盗们总是在抱怨他们那些私生子。

entries.text: I'm thinking the Eye allows telepathy, which just makes me want to take it back from Ancano even more.
entries.translated_text: 我认为马格努斯之眼能让人产生心灵感应，这让我更想从安卡诺那里夺回它。

entries.text: Woah, look at these big plants! They look like they're about to bloom. Wait, it's opening-(Coughing) What in Oblivion-(Coughing).
entries.translated_text: 哇，看看这些大植物！它们看起来好像要开花了。等等，它正在开-（咳嗽）该死这是什么-（咳嗽）。

entries.text: He's taking you to face Alduin, then? Please, do come back alive, won't you? I'll be waiting.
entries.translated_text: 那么他要带你去见奥杜因？拜托，一定要活着回来，好吗？我会等你的。

entries.text: This place is the worst!
entries.translated_text: 这个地方最糟糕了！

entries.text: I just thought you might be familiar with that last thief, due to how close they were standing to you.
entries.translated_text: 我只是以为你可能会比较熟悉那个最后的小偷,因为他们站得离你那么近。

entries.text: Remiel, do you know about Y'ffre?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔，你知道伊’弗尔吗？

texts: 而为什么要把我留在身边？

entries.text: Take us somewhere fun, Rennic!
entries.translated_text: 带我们去一个有趣的地方，雷内克！

entries.text: Let me drink against him! Especially if there's something worthwhile to be won!
entries.translated_text: 让我来和他喝酒！尤其是在这种有不菲奖品的情况时！

entries.text: I wish that thing you bring around could carry some of this, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我希望你随身携带的东西能带一些这样的东西。

entries.text: I could never get into history unless it involved some sort of interesting technology or mystery.
entries.translated_text: 除非涉及什么有趣的技术或谜团，否则我看不进历史书。

entries.text: You're always talking to me but never to Scrap. Is there something you're not telling us?
entries.translated_text: 你总是在和我说话，但从来没有和小渣说过话。你有什么没告诉我们的吗？

entries.text: You know, I might have noticed that Farkas is, well, a werewolf.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，我可能注意到了法卡斯是个...嗯，狼人。

entries.text: I wonder how my father's moonsugar sales are? Maybe I could get some for some Lavender Dumplings...
entries.translated_text: 我想知道我父亲的月亮糖销量如何？也许我可以买一些薰衣草饺子。。。

entries.text: Hey, hey, don't look like you're about to walk away. Wait.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，嘿，别一副要走开的样子。等等。

entries.text: Did you go into them alone? I would be scared to go into ruins alone. Were you scared?
entries.translated_text: 你是一个人进去的吗？我会害怕一个人走进遗址。你害怕吗？

entries.text: What?! Rude.
entries.translated_text: 什么？太冒犯了！

entries.text: What happened to him wasn't your fault.
entries.translated_text: 他的事不是你的错。

entries.text: And yet, only one of us sounds out of breath. What are you, Auri?!
entries.translated_text: 然而，我们中有一个人听起来喘不过气来。你在干什么，奥璃？！

entries.text: Although this room in the back is... concerning.
entries.translated_text: 虽然后面的这个房间...让人有些担忧。

entries.text: (Sigh) No, it wasn't just the scandal. It was also... my fault.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）不，这不仅仅是件丑闻。这也是...我的错。

entries.text: I brought Remi some dwarven oil to use for Scrap, but now she says she is hungry. She asked me to get her something sweet to eat.
entries.translated_text: 我给蕾米带了一些矮人油送给小渣，但现在她说她饿了。她让我给她拿点甜食吃。

entries.text: When it comes to mistakes, I understand. It doesn't really matter. We're still a company of fighters.
entries.translated_text: 说到错误，我理解。这并不重要。我们仍然是一个战士连。

entries.text: Well, if you're so against me doing what is right for my family, Valerius, you can just wait here for us to come back.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你这么反对我为我的家人做正确的事，瓦雷瑞，你就在这里等我们回来吧。

entries.text: I'd be happy to have you at my side.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你能在我身边。

entries.text: Hm? I am from Cyrodiil. What about you?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？我来自赛瑞迪尔。那你呢？

entries.text: Come on! Lift this rock and whatnot up, so that I can get through. Then I'll help you get through, okay?
entries.translated_text: 快快！你要把把这块石头举起来或者做点别的什么，我就可以过去了。然后我再帮你进来，好吗？

entries.text: Remi, I have some junk metal for you and Val to take care of.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我有些废金属要你和瓦尔处理。

entries.text: Don't think too much about how much rock is above our heads right now.
entries.translated_text: 不要在想我们头上有多少石头上想太多。

entries.text: I started to avoid him more, and vice versa. I haven't seen him in years, but I can definitely see him being spiteful enough to try to kill me.
entries.translated_text: 我开始更多地避开他，他也是。我已经很多年没见过他了，但我绝对能感受到他想杀我的恶意。

entries.text: Yaz, great news, I handed out the flyer I made up regarding your writing and your beautiful way of conveying stories!
entries.translated_text: 雅扎，好消息，我把记录着你的创作以及你书写故事的每秒方式的传单送出去了！你知道吗？

entries.text: No, I always sleep well.
entries.translated_text: 不，我总是睡得很好。

entries.text: Can you see if you can find anything like that?
entries.translated_text: 你能看看你是否能找到类似的东西吗？

entries.text: To remember that I could connect with someone so deeply.
entries.translated_text: 提醒我，我可以与一个人有如此深入的联系。

entries.text: Have you ever had a Ginkgo Leaf? I used to swim when I visited Sentinel as a kid and find them growing along the shore. They're really good!
entries.translated_text: 你吃过银杏叶吗？我小时候去哨兵城时经常游泳，发现它们在岸边生长。他们真的不错！

entries.text: We're not stealing for Degaine.
entries.translated_text: 我们不是为德加因才偷这东西的。

entries.text: Okay, Ahmed, let's neither of us die!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾哈迈德，我们俩都不要死！

entries.text: So... Val. As in... Valentino?
entries.translated_text: 那么...瓦尔。就像...瓦伦蒂诺吗？

entries.text: That's all I know. I'm outta this backwater. I'm goin' home. That asshole would have to pay me a lot more to show me mug around here again.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我所知道的一切，我要离开这个落后的地方，我要回家了。那个混蛋必须付给我更多的钱，否则我不会再回这个鸟不拉屎的地方了。

entries.text: I'm from High Rock, too.
entries.translated_text: 我也是高岩的。

entries.text: Now that we finally have time to just relax, I wanted to say something.
entries.translated_text: 现在我们终于有时间放松一下了，我想说点什么。

entries.text: I heard you offering my adventurer a little game, and I thought that I'd actually like to play.
entries.translated_text: 我听说你给我的冒险者提供了一个小游戏，我想我真的很想参与。

entries.text: Oh, you can probably guess.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你可能猜到了。

entries.text: Oh, you can probably guess.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你可能猜到了。

entries.text: I know that I'm safe with you, so... You do what you have to. I'll still be seeing dwemer ruins, I assume?
entries.translated_text: 我知道我和你在一起很安全，所以...你做你该做的，我想我还是会看到锻莫遗址吧？

entries.text: Do you know much about the College of Winterhold?
entries.translated_text: 你对冬堡学院了解得多吗？

entries.text: I wonder why? Hmm...
entries.translated_text: 我想知道为什么？嗯...

entries.text: I don't think I could sleep here either. I'm much too excited to just lay down.
entries.translated_text: 我想我也不能睡在这里。我太兴奋了，不能躺下。

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Slaughterfish Scales
entries.translated_text: 食人鱼鳞

entries.text: Did Val say anything to you about our latest sale? I've been wanting to buy a new necklace, but I'm waiting for our profits to come in.
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔有没有跟你说过我们最近的销售情况？我一直想买条新项链，但我在等我们的利润到账。

entries.text: To feel the warm sands of Elsweyr and sleep out under the twin bodies of Masser and Secunda.
entries.translated_text: 或者感受艾斯维尔温暖的沙滩，睡在马萨尔和赛库达的照耀下安然而眠。

entries.text: I'm so fascinated to see what Wylandriah's genius is going to create with these items! She has such a lovely way of thinking that I envy terribly!
entries.translated_text: 我很想看看维兰瑞亚的天才想法会用这些物品创造什么！她的思维方式如此可爱，我非常羡慕！

entries.text: I don't know any magic.
entries.translated_text: 我什么魔法也不知道。

entries.text: Some people find peace in the idea of going on to a realm in Oblivion.
entries.translated_text: 有些人在归于湮灭的途中找到了平静。

entries.text: Now, Yaz, I don't mean to be rude, but you're awfully un-sing-y for a bard.
entries.translated_text: 对了，雅扎，我无意冒犯，但作为一个吟游诗人，你歌唱的真不行。

entries.text: Morvic's Outfit
entries.translated_text: 莫维克的服装

entries.text: What is it, Ubbe?
entries.translated_text: 乌贝，这是什么？

entries.text: What things did they take?
entries.translated_text: 他们拿了什么东西？

entries.text: It's about protecting for me.
entries.translated_text: 这是为了保护我。

entries.text: I was framed for murder.
entries.translated_text: 我被他们陷害谋杀。

entries.text: Strange Machine
entries.translated_text: 奇怪的机器

entries.text: Don't worry. (Chuckle)
entries.translated_text: 不用担心。（轻笑）

entries.text: Oh, it's so lovely!
entries.translated_text: 哦，它真可爱！

entries.text: Educated is different than intelligent, though. Although I do like to think I'm both. I hope I am, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 不过，有教养和聪明是两码事。虽然我认为自己两者兼备。但无论如何，我希望自己是这样。

entries.text: Woah, this guy is off his rocker. Not that I'm judging! I think I'm always a step awa from losing my own mind.
entries.translated_text: 哇，这家伙完全疯了。不过我不是在评判他！我觉得我自己也随时可能离发疯只差一步了。

entries.text: ...Uh. It... Uh.... (Mumbling) How to say this...
entries.translated_text: ...呃。它...呃...（喃喃自语）怎么说...

entries.text: Any ideas where we can find this skooma?
entries.translated_text: 我们在哪里可以找到这些斯库玛？

entries.text: 1,000 Gold.
Oh, I got quite a deal if I'm getting more than one bodyguard! It's like a two-for-one bargain! What is your name?
entries.translated_text: 哦，如果我还能再多一名侍卫，我就赚翻了！简直就是买一送一！你叫什么名字？

entries.text: By the Divines, I thought you'd never leave me alone.
entries.translated_text: 以圣灵之名，我以为你永远不会让我一个人呆着。

entries.text: So... Do you feel blessed? With Mara's Blessing? Because I just feel scarred from having to witness Calcelmo make eyes at someone.
entries.translated_text: 所以...有了玛拉的祝福后，你觉得幸福吗？对我来说，我只是看到卡塞莫对人暗送秋波而感到受伤。

entries.text: All we need is one of you to go down, for Serana to raise you to fight for us!
entries.translated_text: 我们只需要你们中的一个倒下，就能让瑟拉娜复活你们为我们而战!

entries.text: Hello, my love.
entries.translated_text: 你好啊，亲爱的。

entries.text: I just wonder, aren't you ever... afraid? What if you're too slow swinging the sword, or what if a spell explodes in your face?
entries.translated_text: 我只是想知道，你难道不……害怕吗？如果你挥剑太慢，或者法术在你脸上爆炸怎么办？

entries.text: I'm not looking for Aetherium that may or may not be here.
entries.translated_text: 我不会去找这些神光水晶的。

entries.text: I'm so envious!
entries.translated_text: 我好羡慕！

entries.text: Of course, the ruin itself is already visual poetry!
entries.translated_text: 当然，遗迹本身就是一场视觉史诗！

entries.text: What do you think about them?
entries.translated_text: 你对他们有什么看法？

entries.text: Aww, why not? It could be so much fun!
entries.translated_text: 哇，为什么不呢？这可能会很有趣！

entries.text: I think you said 'soup' when you meant to say 'poison'. It was an honest mistake, I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: 我想你说“汤”的意思是说“毒药”。真相往往很残酷。

entries.text: What did you have in mind?
entries.translated_text: 你在想什么？

entries.text: I won't need to refuel it! It will just... work.
entries.translated_text: 我不需要给它加油！它就能...工作。

entries.text: Good, because you don't have a choice.
entries.translated_text: 很好，因为你别无选择。

entries.text: Which apparently is something I'm not supposed to actually point out.
entries.translated_text: 这显然是我是我应该说出来的话。

entries.text: Of course I care about Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 我当然在乎小渣！
