entries.text: When the other guy has his shield up, regular blows are useless. Wind up and hit him with a really powerful attack to get past that shield.
entries.translated_text: 当对手架起盾牌时，一般击打是无效的。看准时机用一记强有力的攻击打掉他的盾牌。

entries.text: My mother taught me a trick or two.
entries.translated_text: 我妈妈教了我一两个小把戏。

entries.text: But we never got to burn anything for that celebration! Well, not officially.
entries.translated_text: 但是我们从来没有为了那个庆典烧过任何东西！嗯，至少没正式烧过。

entries.text: I'm sure I could find someone who'd be willing to come with me.
entries.translated_text: 我相信我能找到愿意和我一起去的人。

entries.text: I'd love that!
entries.translated_text: 我会喜欢的！

entries.text: But when you've seen a side to people that I have...
entries.translated_text: 但是当你看到我所拥有的人的一面时...

entries.text: Oh, what a prick. He conned us out of some good wine and now off he goes.
entries.translated_text: 哦，真是个混蛋。他骗我们喝了一些好酒，现在他走了。

entries.text: I know I am typically enthused about ghosts, but the ghost of a child seems... Less enthusing.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我通常对鬼魂很感兴趣，但孩子的鬼魂似乎......不那么令人兴奋。

entries.text: So there's a way to help Kodlak still? Wait, what's that axe? Is that Wuuthrad? It's fixed? I assume that's Eorland's doing.
entries.translated_text: 所以还有办法帮助克拉科吗？等等，那是什么斧头？是精灵屠戮者吗？修好了？我认为那是厄伦德做的。

texts: I just had to explore a little! I'm not really sure what it was for. Clearly some sort of observatory.
我只需要探索一点点！我不太确定它是干什么用的。显然是某种天文台。

entries.text: That's... I... I'd rather not talk about it.
entries.translated_text: 那...我...我不想谈这个。

entries.text: Beauty tends to make monsters of us all. How sweet could he be?
entries.translated_text: 美貌往往会把我们所有人都变成怪物。他有多可爱？

entries.text: It doesn't really matter what I believe, now does it?
entries.translated_text: 我相信什么其实并不重要，是吧？

entries.text: It's unfortunate when we find caved in halls in these cities. Just like the first ruin I explored in Skyrim, I'm disappointed I can't see everything.
entries.translated_text: 在这些城市中发现塌陷的大厅真是遗憾。就像我在天际省探险的第一处遗迹那样，我很失望自己无法看到全部。

entries.text: Oh? Well...
entries.translated_text: 哦？太好了...

entries.text: Sorry to hear it.
entries.translated_text: 很抱歉听到它。

entries.text: I'm a little worried about how competent Khash is for her age... Do you think she's been on her own awhile?
entries.translated_text: 我有点担心卡什这个年纪的能力...你觉得她已经独自生活一段时间了吗？

entries.text: Keep it up, Ray!
entries.translated_text: 继续加油，雷！

entries.text: Of course, that does sound like an awful lot of extra work, to worship so many.
entries.translated_text: 当然，这听起来确实有很多工作，要同时信仰这么多神。

entries.text: Don't be surprised if you find some whips and chains in the room.
entries.translated_text: 如果你在我房间里发现一些鞭子和铁链，请不要感到惊讶。

entries.text: My name is Auri.
entries.translated_text: 我的名字是奥璃。

entries.text: Okay, but what about the restorative properties?
entries.translated_text: 好的，但是它的恢复效果怎么样？

entries.text: Let me just adjust this...
entries.translated_text: 让我调整一下...

entries.text: (Gasp) A Lexicon! Can you imagine the knowledge contained in this little cube? That's rhetorical, by the way, because you could not hope to imagine.
entries.translated_text: （喘气）一个方典！你能想象这个小立方体中包含的知识吗？顺便说一句，这是修辞，因为你无法想象。

entries.text: We've got quite the reputation out here.
entries.translated_text: 我们在这里名声响亮。

entries.text: Funny, since we want to kill everyone on this boat, including you. (Intimidate)
entries.translated_text: 有趣的是，我们也想杀死这艘船上的所有人，包括你。 （威吓）

entries.text: Have I told you that I used to read about Valenwood quite a bit, pretend to live in trees.
entries.translated_text: 我是否告诉过你，我以前经常阅读关于威木省的书，假装自己住在树上。

entries.text: I could show you, if you like? There's a couple different methods. One does require magic, but a few others don't.
entries.translated_text: 如果你愿意，我可以演示给你看？有几种不同的方法，其中一种需要魔法，其他几种不需要。

entries.text: G-good! Okay, well. Uh. Are we... friends now?
entries.translated_text: 好！好吧。嗯，我们现在是...朋友吗？

entries.text: Okay, sounds great. Are you getting the drinks, or am I this time?
entries.translated_text: 好的，听起来很棒。你去拿酒，还是我这次来？

entries.text: Good work out there, Nar!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，纳尔！

entries.text: Although... That means that we get to see these automaton in action!
entries.translated_text: 虽然...这意味着我们可以看到这些机器人的行动！

entries.text: Tamriel's Tastiest Stew
entries.translated_text: 泰姆瑞尔最美味的炖菜

entries.text: Maybe I'll just tag along for the ride?
entries.translated_text: 也许我会能着搭一程？

entries.text: Drilling
entries.translated_text: 钻击

entries.text: Drilling
entries.translated_text: 钻击

entries.text: Una.
entries.translated_text: 尤娜。

entries.text: Here, Zora. I *bought* this necklace for you, rather than stealing it.
entries.translated_text: 这里，佐拉。我给你买了这条项链，绝不是偷的。

entries.text: Scrap, you keep Meeko safe now, okay?!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，你现在保护好米科的安全，好吗？！

entries.text: You don't seem very religious.
entries.translated_text: 你看起来不太虔诚。

entries.text: But it doesn't sound like you want to see it with me... Do you?
entries.translated_text: 不过听起来你似乎并不想和我一起去看...是吗？

entries.text: I was hoping you'd take me back here every now and then, though, seeing as I've put so much work into it.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我希望你能不时带我回到这里，因为我已经投入了很多工作。

entries.text: It'd be rude of me to assume, right?
entries.translated_text: 我贸然这样假设是很不礼貌的，对吧？

entries.text: No way. Find someone else.
entries.translated_text: 没门，找别人。

entries.text: No way. Find someone else.
entries.translated_text: 没门，找别人。

entries.text: Well, I guess we'll just have to ask around, then.
entries.translated_text: 那么，我想我们应该需要四处打听一下。

entries.text: We should practice this first. Do you think our mutual friend would mind...?
entries.translated_text: 我们应该先练习一下，你觉得我们共同的朋友会介意......吗？

entries.text: I'll harvest your insides!
entries.translated_text: 我要收割你的内脏！

entries.text: But, uh, the Legion? How... How was that?
entries.translated_text: 但是，呃，军团？怎么...那是怎么回事？

entries.text: No, I didn't hear- M-Molag Bal?! W-what?! When?!
entries.translated_text: 不，我没听到-莫-莫拉格·巴尔？什么？什么时候？

entries.text: Are we heading back into Blackreach? I'm certainly not opposed, but do we have the supplies for the expedition?
entries.translated_text: 我们要回到黑境吗？我当然不反对，但是我们有远征的物资吗？

entries.text: Maybe the College of Winterhold?
entries.translated_text: 也许可以去冬堡学院看看？

entries.text: Remi hates pc
entries.translated_text: Remihatespc

entries.text: By Sheor... That's not a dragon priest, is it? Oh adventurer, I hope you know what you're doing.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔...那不是龙祭司吧？哦冒险者，我希望你知道你在做什么。

entries.text: It's... Oh by the Eight, it's right there.
entries.translated_text: 这是...哦，天哪，就在那里。

entries.text: Yes, lots and lots of stone.
entries.translated_text: 是的，很多很多的石头。

entries.text: How exactly can Gore wave that huge old sword around? It seems like it'd be like trying to fight using a mammoth as a weapon.
entries.translated_text: 格雷那把巨大的古剑到底是怎么挥舞的？看起来就像举起一头长毛象攻击。

entries.text: I know most inventions are designed to make life easier, but I like to create things just to see if it's possible.
entries.translated_text: 我知道大多数发明都是为了让生活更轻松，但我创造东西只是为了看看是否有可能。

entries.text: That should be everything you asked for.
entries.translated_text: 你要的东西应该都齐了。

entries.text: You're just fine.
entries.translated_text: 你很好。

entries.text: Sorry, you were saying something?
entries.translated_text: 对不起，你在说什么？

entries.text: Okay, Ilia, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，伊利亚，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: Attuned Assassination
entries.translated_text: 调谐刺杀

entries.text: Somehow, I don't think I believe that. I mean, I wouldn't survive more than a day without you protecting me.
entries.translated_text: 简直不敢相信。我的意思是，如果没有你保护我，我活不过一天。

entries.text: They sound hazardous.
entries.translated_text: 它们听起来很危险。

entries.text: This place... makes me very uneasy.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方...让我很不安。

entries.text: Where would that be?
entries.translated_text: 哪里？

entries.text: Would you care to see the rest of Skyrim-and beyond-with me?
entries.translated_text: 你愿意和我一起看遍天际的其余部分吗？

entries.text: If you mean a less... official arrangement, then, yes- a few.
entries.translated_text: 如果你指的是不那么...正式的安排，那么，是的--有一些。

entries.text: So, Auri, you're from Valenwood. Would you... tell me about it?
entries.translated_text: 所以，奥璃，你来自威木省。能...给我讲讲那里吗？

entries.text: How do I... I feel terrible about it! It-It's the worst thing that has ever happened to me! It's the-the worst thing that ever happened to my father!
entries.translated_text: 我如何...我对此感到很糟糕！这是发生在我身上的最糟糕的事情！这是发生在我父亲身上的最糟糕的事情！

entries.text: All the gourds in town were stolen by him.
entries.translated_text: 镇上所有的葫芦都会被他偷走。

entries.text: Some of them complained about my 'attitude' during lessons, even though I was just voicing my opinions on certain songs.
entries.translated_text: 他们中的一些人抱怨我在上课时的 "态度"，尽管我只是对某些歌曲发表了自己的看法。

entries.text: Feels like I just got off a trade boat to Hammerfell.
entries.translated_text: 感觉就像我刚从一艘去落锤省的贸易船上下来。

entries.text: I've taken Remi to see many dwemer ruins, and she has learned how to make her dwemer spider, Scrap, powerful. Our adventures together are far from over, though. She's still a bit of a puzzle to me, but we've become good friends. ;Spoken to Remi, romance unavailable
entries.translated_text: 我带蕾米参观了许多锻莫遗址，她也学会了如何让她的锻莫蜘蛛小渣变得强大。不过，我们一起的冒险远未结束。她对我来说仍然有点困惑，但我们已经成为了好朋友。；对蕾米说，无法谈恋爱

entries.text: All the sailors I've known can hold their liquor very well. What I'm saying is, don't offer to pay for Val's drinks, or you'll quickly be destitute.
entries.translated_text: 我认识的所有水手酒量都很好。我想说的是，不要为瓦尔的酒买单，否则你很快就会穷困潦倒的

entries.text: You hold your weapon like you're afraid of it, sister.
entries.translated_text: 姐妹，你拿武器的样子就像你在害怕它。

entries.text: Magic is for the weak.
entries.translated_text: 魔法是为弱者准备的。

entries.text: Wait a moment. Does that mean I'm also married to this mystery lover? I think I might be confused about the nuances of our relationship here.
entries.translated_text: 等一下。这是不是意味着我也和这位神秘爱人结婚了？我觉得我可能对我们关系的微妙变化有些困惑。

entries.text: Tusk them up, Remi!
entries.translated_text: 戳穿他们，蕾米！

entries.text: Remi is good friends with pc
entries.translated_text: Remiisgoodfriendswithpc

entries.text: Mercenary work for two hundred gold? You've got to be kidding me. I hope this doesn't take long.
entries.translated_text: 两百金币就想请个雇佣兵？开什么玩笑。我希望这不会花很长时间。

entries.text: Ohhhh, Scrap, look what you've done now! My dumb little automaton...
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，看看你现在做了什么！我愚蠢的小机器人...

entries.text: Ohhhh, Scrap, look what you've done now! My dumb little automaton...
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，看看你现在做了什么！我愚蠢的小机器人...

entries.text: Ohhhh, Scrap, look what you've done now! My dumb little automaton...
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，看看你现在做了什么！我愚蠢的小机器人...

entries.text: I don't want you in my way, but don't wander too far.
entries.translated_text: 我不想让你挡住我的路，但不要走得太远。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel Armory
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔武器室

entries.text: I'm happy I haven't disappointed. I really think we'll achieve any goals we set ourselves.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴我没有让你失望。我真的认为我们会实现我们为自己设定的任何目标。

entries.text: Until next time.
entries.translated_text: 下回见。

entries.text: Bark!
entries.translated_text: （犬吠）！

entries.text: Bark!
entries.translated_text: （犬吠）！

entries.text: Bark!
entries.translated_text: （犬吠）！

entries.text: You've never been interested in someone?
entries.translated_text: 你从来没有对某人感兴趣过？

entries.text: Oh, just the normal. They... care about me. But awhile back, our family went through some hard time. We've done... questionable things.
entries.translated_text: 哦，都是些常见的类型。他们...关心我。但很久以前，我们家经历了一些困难时期。我们做过一些...有争议的事情。

entries.text: Couldn't you just say you'd rather not go inside this one? I'm sure our friend would listen.
entries.translated_text: 你就不能说你其实不想进去吗？我相信我们的朋友会听的。

entries.text: ... (Mumbling) Wouldn't lift a finger for 200 septims, 100, if I even *get* half. Unbelievable.
entries.translated_text: ...（喃喃自语）200金币，即使我拿一半也才100个，这生意太亏本了。

entries.text: You know a lot about magic, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你对魔法很了解吗？

entries.text: A ghost! A ghost haunting the town! I love ghosts! Let's find him immediately right now! I want to ask him why he murdered this Wyndelius fellow!
entries.translated_text: 一个鬼魂！一个鬼魂在镇上出没了！我喜欢鬼魂！我们现在就马上去找他！我想问问他为什么要谋杀这个叫韦德留斯的家伙！

entries.text: (Laughs) That seems like an oversimplification, but you're probably right. How much do you know about the dwarves?
entries.translated_text: （笑）这听起来有点过于简单了，但你可能是对的你对矮人了解多少？

entries.text: (Laugh) It sounds like you're buttering me up to get something out of me.
entries.translated_text: （笑）听起来你在拍我马屁，想从我身上弄出点什么来。

entries.text: It is! You know, maybe you just need to get to know him. Why don't you try petting him?
entries.translated_text: 是的！也许你只需要了解一下他。你为什么不试着摸摸他？

entries.text: Maybe when the bard starts playing again, you'll dance with me? I promise I won't step on your foot this time. Or trip onto a table and spill ale.
entries.translated_text: 也许当吟游诗人再次开始演奏时，你会和我一起起舞？我保证这次不会踩到你的脚。或者绊倒在桌子上并弄洒啤酒。

entries.text: ...Oh, you're upset at me for stealing it. It's okay, I promise. They weren't using it, so it's better with us.
entries.translated_text: ...哦，你在为我偷了它而生气。没关系的，我保证。他们不会使用它，所以它放在我们这里会更好。

entries.text: I mean, I have been trying to teach myself some read-Wait, really?!
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，我一直在尝试自学一些阅读-等等，真的吗？！

entries.text: I... I hope so. Some days it feels like I'm breaking down. It frightens me.
entries.translated_text: 我...我希望如此。有几天感觉自己快崩溃了。它让我害怕。

entries.text: Well, I know that you worship him. Well, you and other Bosmer, I assume.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你信仰他。我想你和其他波兹默都是如此。

entries.text: (Whisper) Right.
entries.translated_text: （低语）没错。

entries.text: It sounds like it could've been worse than it was.
entries.translated_text: 听起来情况可能比之前更糟。

entries.text: Exactly right!
entries.translated_text: 非常正确！

entries.text: Remi has an idea for making lockpicking a quicker process. We traveled to the Markarth Forge, where she created her prototype tension wrench, and now she has tasked me with testing it out. I should pick some locks and let her know how well it works.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米有个想法，让开锁变得更快。我们去了马卡斯城锻造厂，她在那里制造了她的原型张力扳手，现在她委托我进行测试。我应该试着开一些锁，让她知道它有多好用。

entries.text: It makes me sad.
entries.translated_text: 这让我很难过。

entries.text: I worship a deity often forgotten about.
entries.translated_text: 我信仰的是一个经常被遗忘的神灵。

entries.text: Remi, you said before you visited Hamerfell. What was it like there?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你说过你去以前去过落锤。哪里怎么样？

entries.text: Well... They were kind enough to let us know that others are waiting for us in Solitude.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...他们至少让我们知道有人在独孤城里等着我们。

entries.text: But...?
Damn that Thalmor. This is why I don't trust mages.
entries.translated_text: 该死的梭默。这就是为什么我不相信法师。

entries.text: Ugh!
entries.translated_text: 呃！

entries.text: Ugh!
entries.translated_text: 呃！

entries.text: Ugh!
entries.translated_text: 呃！

entries.text: He likes his space, and I... don't like to give it to him.
entries.translated_text: 他喜欢独霸他的地盘，而我……不喜欢和他分享。

entries.text: Y'know, I'm honestly not sure.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，说实话，我不确定。

entries.text: Remi is Here!
entries.translated_text: 蕾米来了！

entries.text: It must be a very complex, precise forge, in order to handle aetherium.
entries.translated_text: 必须由非常复杂，精密的锻造，才能处理神光水晶。

entries.text: Of course, I can't promise that I'll say the right things, or, well... I'll try anyway.
entries.translated_text: 当然，我不能保证我会说对的话，或者说得恰到好处...但我会尽力的。

entries.text: D-d-die!? Oh, Sweet Mother Mara, get us out of here soon!
entries.translated_text: 死...死！？哦，亲爱的圣母玛拉，请把我们带离这里！

entries.text: I've been wondering, what's your greatest fear?
entries.translated_text: 我一直在想，你最大的恐惧是什么？

entries.text: I must admit, it's a relief to know that you said the wrong thing to someone whose brother was slated for execution.
entries.translated_text: 我必须承认，知道你对那个兄弟被判决执行死刑的人说错话后，让我也感到了些宽慰。

entries.text: He had lived alone for so long, since his lover had run out on him, never able to bring himself out of his sadness to meet anyone new.
entries.translated_text: 自从他的爱人离开了他之后，他一直无法摆脱悲伤，去认识新的人，所以独自生活了许多年，

entries.text: O-oh! You-you can't just say that out of nowhere! I wasn't prepared!
entries.translated_text: 哦！你...你可不能突然这么说！我没有准备好啊！

entries.text: You're lucky I've decided to acknowledge you.
entries.translated_text: 你很幸运，我决定认可你。

entries.text: That means you grew up in Riverwood, then? I can't imagine a small town like that would be very exciting.
entries.translated_text: 那意味着你是在河木镇长大的？在这样的小镇里一定非常开心。

entries.text: Are you okay?!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？

entries.text: Oh wow, that was way more eventful than I was expecting. I just took a carriage ride straight from the Imperial City to Solitude.
entries.translated_text: 哦,这出乎我的意料,精彩多了。我只是直接坐马车从帝都直达独孤城。

entries.text: Ack, sorry, J'zargo. By the Divines, why do so many of my friends have tails? I'm too clumsy for this.
entries.translated_text: 啊，对不起，吉'扎格。天啊，为什么我的很多朋友都有尾巴？我对此太不小心了。

entries.text: I used to think people in Skyrim rode giant sleds pulled by wolves!
entries.translated_text: 我曾经以为天际的人会坐着巨大的狼拉雪橇!

entries.text: I'm thinking... two dwemer cogs, eight dwemer gears, one dwemer lever, three pieces of wood, and six dwarven metal ingots.
entries.translated_text: 我在想...两个锻莫圆轮、八个锻莫齿轮、一个锻莫杠杆、三块木柴和六个矮人金属锭。

entries.text: Oh, you didn't have to do that.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你不必那样做。

entries.text: You know, back home it's common for Bretons to- Oh, you certainly know that already, though. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，在布莱顿人的家乡...噢，你肯定已经知道了。别管我。

entries.text: We are going to live, Doc! Right?
entries.translated_text: 我们会活下去的，博士！对吧？

entries.text: Hmm...
Hmm...
Hmm...
Hmm...
I feared I wasn't going to meet my quota of life-threatening circumstances and adventures for this month.
entries.translated_text: 我之前还担心我这个月的“生命透支”配额凑不齐了呢。

entries.text: Calls Remiel to your side.
entries.translated_text: 把蕾米尔召唤到你身边。

entries.text: Okay, that fight is done. Now we wait for Ahmed to lead us to another one.
entries.translated_text: 好了，这场战斗结束了，现在我们等待艾哈迈德带领我们去往另一个。

entries.text: After reading the book I gave her about Chaurus Pie, Remi has decided she wants to try it. I should gather all the ingredients and tell Remi once I have them all. We'll need chaurus chitin, a tomato, honey, salt, a potato, a carrot, and an apple.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米读了我给她的关于巢蚁薄饼的书后，决定尝试一下。我应该把所有的材料都收集起来，一旦我把它们都拿到手就告诉蕾米。我们需要巢蚁甲壳素、西红柿、蜂蜜、盐、土豆、胡萝卜和苹果。

entries.text: Well, I wouldn't call Xel mysterious, but we are great friends. Is that like egg-siblings, you think?
entries.translated_text: 我不会说塞尔神秘，但我们是好朋友。你觉得这像是血缘上兄弟姐妹吗？

entries.text: Aela is sort of scary, right? I think I might like her.
entries.translated_text: 艾拉有点吓人，对吧？我想我可能会喜欢她。

entries.text: Zora, you... get along with Rumarin, don't you?
entries.translated_text: 佐拉，你…和鲁米勒相处得很好，是吗？

texts: 在高岩，洛克汗对我们来说被称为朔尔。他被称为“坏人”，所以你可能会明白这不是一件好事。
在高岩，洛克汗对我们来说被称为朔尔。他被称为“恶男”，所以你可能会明白这不是一件好事。

entries.text: However Aurbis came to be, when it did, it came along with a baseline sound. This is the essence of Aurbis, in a way.
entries.translated_text: 总之，奥比斯诞生了，当它出现的时候，伴随着一个基线之音出现，从某种程度上说，这就是奥比斯的精华。

entries.text: Morvic!
entries.translated_text: 莫维克！

entries.text: Alright, Scrap, let's go. Farillae is leading us somewhere fun, right?
entries.translated_text: 好了，小渣，我们走吧。法里拉正在带我们去一个有趣的地方，对吧？

entries.text: Yes, I guess they have.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我猜是这样的。

entries.text: ;Had dialogue about potions with Remi
entries.translated_text: ;与蕾米有过关于药水的对话

entries.text: Mercenaries' Ship
entries.translated_text: 佣兵船

entries.text: Mercenaries' Ship
entries.translated_text: 佣兵船

entries.text: Yes, why do Falmer have to skulk about like children?
entries.translated_text: 是的，为什么伐莫要像孩子一样到处溜达呢？

entries.text: Let me preface this by saying I don't care about politics, but... Elisif is just a puppet ruler, isn't she?
entries.translated_text: 首先我要说，我不关心政治，但是...艾利西弗只是一个傀儡，不是吗？

entries.text: I'm rather suspicious of Madanach wanting us to listen to stories. It sounds like... manipulation. But maybe I should keep an open mind.
entries.translated_text: 我很怀疑迈德纳奇是想让我们听他讲故事。这听起来像是...洗脑。但也许我应该心态放开点。

entries.text: Gore, I think you should wear one of these funny hats the bards wear and take up the lute. It'd be quite humourous for me to witness.
entries.translated_text: 格雷，我认为你应该戴上一顶吟游诗人戴的滑稽帽子，然后拿起鲁特琴。对我来说，看上去会很好玩。

entries.text: Well. We- An Order did do something about it. But it was... more an investigation into my family.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们--骑士团确实做了些事情但是... 更多的是调查我的家族。

entries.text: Where did he disappear to? He must be somewhere in this Temple still.
entries.translated_text: 他消失到哪里去了？他一定还在这座神殿的某个地方。

entries.text: (Sigh) It's more complex than simply liking them or not. Some Orders are far better than others.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）这不是简单的喜欢或者不喜欢。有些骑士团远比其他骑士团要好。

entries.text: And... I love eating. I'll eat anything. And I want to try everything.
entries.translated_text: 还有……我喜欢吃。我什么都吃。我想尝试一切。

entries.text: And... I love eating. I'll eat anything. And I want to try everything.
entries.translated_text: 还有……我喜欢吃。我什么都吃，什么都想尝试。

entries.text: Are you *sure* they weren't actually after you?
entries.translated_text: 你确定他们实际上不是在追杀你吗？

entries.text: Stopped... time...?
Oh, I guess that's fair. Another time then.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我想那也合理。那就改天吧。

entries.text: I do love a good ghost story.
entries.translated_text: 我确实喜欢一个好的鬼故事。

entries.text: I don't get how blue and green skin tones are meant to be a bad thing, though. Maybe the Daedra have a warped sense of what constitutes 'bad'.
entries.translated_text: 不过我不明白蓝色和绿色的肤色怎么会是一件坏事。也许魔族对“坏”的理解不同。

entries.text: I've always liked stories, but Yazakh has made me think of them in new ways. Explorations of others' minds... It's... interesting!
entries.translated_text: 我一直很喜欢听故事，但雅扎克让我对故事有了新的认识。探索别人的思想...这...很有趣

entries.text: Amateurs.
entries.translated_text: 真业余。

entries.text: Amateurs.
entries.translated_text: 真业余。

entries.text: And I thought, 'Wow, wouldn't it be great if I could carry that around with me on a string?'
entries.translated_text: 我想，'哇，如果我可以用绳子把它带在身边，那不是很好吗‘？

entries.text: I just... There is a lot going on here. So many people, and sounds, and stuff...
entries.translated_text: 我只是...这里发生的事情太多了。人很多，声音很多，还有各种各样的东西...

entries.text: Incredible. It's fantastic!
entries.translated_text: 难以置信。太棒了！

entries.text: She's not famous by any means, but enough merchants pass through the city that she makes a decent income.
entries.translated_text: 她一点也不出名，但经过这座城市的商人很多，她赚了一笔可观的收入。

entries.text: She's not famous by any means, but enough merchants pass through the city that she makes a decent income.
entries.translated_text: 她一点也不出名，但有足够多的商人经过这座城市，她赚了一笔可观的收入。

entries.text: I can't believe I lost it... I could have sworn. Wait! Oh, Val is going to get it one of these days!
entries.translated_text: 我竟然把它弄丢了...我发誓，等等！瓦尔总有一天会遭殃的！

entries.text: Ha! This Sam fellow thinks he can beat us in a drinking contest?! Pst, adventurer, come here for a moment. I have a secret.
entries.translated_text: 哈！山姆这家伙认为他能在一场饮酒比赛中击败我们？等等，冒险者，过来一下，我有个秘密。

entries.text: I can't imagine what he'd do with such a collection of gourds, but surely it wouldn't be good.
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象他会用这么多葫芦做什么，但肯定不是好事。

entries.text: Yes! I got this! I have been trying to read from this for months.
entries.translated_text: 太好了！我就用这本！我已经试着读它好几个月了。

entries.text: Wha- He- Oh, never mind.
entries.translated_text: 什么-他-哦，别在意。

texts: Oh, that rhymes, actually! Maybe I should try my hand at being a bard!
哦，这确实押韵！也许我应该尝试成为一名吟游诗人！

entries.text: Back to it. Er... Mortu, what were we doing again? I'll just follow you.
entries.translated_text: 回到...额...莫尔图，我们又在做什么？我就跟着你好了。

entries.text: The story goes that Boethiah ate Trinimac, turned him into Malacath, and turned his followers into us. Don't know how literal that's supposed to be.
entries.translated_text: 传说波耶西亚吃掉了崔尼马克，把他变成了玛拉凯斯，并把他的追随者变成了我们现在的样子。我不知道这句话的字面意思是什么。

entries.text: F-forest couple?! W-what-I-I...?
entries.translated_text: 森-森林伴侣？！什-什么-我-我...？

entries.text: Do you get lonely?
entries.translated_text: 你会感到孤单吗？

entries.text: Wouldn't be the first time someone kept a secret from me.
entries.translated_text: 这不是第一次有人对我保守秘密。

entries.text: Well, you can't really read.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你真的不懂我。

entries.text: I would have trouble sleeping.
entries.translated_text: 我会睡不着的。

entries.text: Thank you for worrying, but I'll be fine.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你的关心，但我会没事的。

entries.text: Do you think Kodlak would be happy we destroyed the Silver Hand in his honour? Surely he'd be happy we got the Wuuthrad fragments back.
entries.translated_text: 你认为克拉科会高兴我们以他之名摧毁了白银之手吗？他肯定会很高兴我们拿回了精灵屠戮者碎片。

entries.text: I know, we'll just go around asking people what their favourite type of Dwemer automaton is! That'll get you back in practice.
entries.translated_text: 我知道，我们只会四处询问人们最喜欢的矮人机械类型是什么！这也能帮你找回感觉。

entries.text: I thought we had more food packed away... Wait, did we finish off all our rations?
entries.translated_text: 我还以为我们储存了很多的食物...等等，我们是不是把所有的口粮都吃完了？

entries.text: So!? How are they?! Have you made the ghosts fall in love?! Ghosts in love!!
entries.translated_text: 所以他们怎么样了？！你让鬼魂坠入爱河了吗？！恋爱中的鬼魂！！

texts: Stop! Stop it! Let go of me!

entries.text: Peryite.
entries.translated_text: 魄伊特。

entries.text: They're High Rock's pride and joy. No matter the differences between fiefdoms, knights are seen as heroes.
entries.translated_text: 他们是高岩的骄傲和喜悦。无论封地之间有什么差异，骑士都被视为英雄。

entries.text: I mean, he was. He raised me. So I guess he was.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，他是。他养大了我。所以我猜他是。

entries.text: Why can't you necromancers just let the dead lay?
entries.translated_text: 为什么你们死灵法师不能让亡者躺着？

entries.text: Well, the Reachmen aren't *really* Bretons. Or maybe they are. That would explain why the Nords hate them so much.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，边塞人并不是真正的布莱顿人。也许他们是。这就解释了为什么诺德人如此痛恨他们。

entries.text: That's a positive outlook.
entries.translated_text: 前景不错。

entries.text: I should have Khash show me how to hunt sometime.
entries.translated_text: 我得让卡什教我怎么打猎。

entries.text: Why are you in Skyrim?
entries.translated_text: 你为什么在天际？

entries.text: Okay... You know that was suspicious, right? But I'll drop it.
entries.translated_text: 好吧...你知道那看起来有点可疑，对吧？不过我就不再深究了。

entries.text: Don't attack me! Attack the adventurer!
entries.translated_text: 别攻击我！攻击冒险者！

entries.text: 天际
entries.translated_text: 天际

entries.text: That Stendarr worshipping fellow appeared in Markarth shortly after me. He's rather aggressive in his questioning, so be prepared for that.
entries.translated_text: 那个信仰斯坦德尔的家伙在我来这之后不久就到了马卡斯成。他的问话相当冲，最好做好心理准备。

entries.text: D-did I know about this?! You're joking, right?!
entries.translated_text: 我知道这个吗？！你在开玩笑吧？！

entries.text: Rude.
entries.translated_text: 真粗鲁。

texts: Arguably the most useful. And I bet it's fun to throw around fireballs. Just don't hit me, okay?
可以说是最实用的。而且我敢打赌，到处扔火球一定很有趣。只是不要打到我，好吗？

entries.text: It's good to hear you say that.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴听到你这么说。

entries.text: It's good to hear you say that.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴听到你这么说。

entries.text: It's good to hear you say that.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴听到你这么说。

entries.text: It's good to hear you say that.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴听到你这么说。

entries.text: Lift some of this rubble for me so I can crawl through!
entries.translated_text: 帮我除去一些瓦砾，这样我就可以爬过去了！

entries.text: I think your awkwardness is endearing, you know.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得你尴尬的样子很可爱，你知道吗。

entries.text: I-I can barely keep track of my own things. How am I meant to keep an eye on yours, too?
entries.translated_text: 我连自己的东西都管不好。我怎么能把你的东西也看管好呢？

entries.text: It's just not something that occurs to me, so I forget to consider that others might be desiring something carnal when approaching me.
entries.translated_text: 只不过是我没有想到这一点，所以我忘记了别人在接近我时可能会有肉体上的欲望。

entries.text: (Laughs) We'd have to get caught for that to happen. Don't hold your breath!
entries.translated_text: （笑）我们得被抓住才行。别紧张！

entries.text: Meeko, kill!
entries.translated_text: 米科，杀！

entries.text: Well, good enough for me! I'm glad we're on the same page.
entries.translated_text: 那对我来说就够好了！很高兴我们想法一致。

entries.text: My friend, you missed out on asking so many questions!
entries.translated_text: 朋友，你错过了问那么多问题的机会！

entries.text: Hm. If the Lexicon starts calling to me, should I tell you? Or just keep that bit of insanity to myself?
entries.translated_text: 嗯。如果方典开始呼唤我，我应该告诉你吗？或者只是对自己保持这种疯狂？

entries.text: Oh, I feel kind of bad lying to this fellow. He's definitely... uncomfortable... but he hasn't really done anything wrong, has he?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我觉得对这个家伙撒谎有点不好。他肯定...不舒服...但他并没有真正做错什么，不是吗？

entries.text: Really? That sounds so fun!
entries.translated_text: 真的？听起来很有趣！

entries.text: Okay. In Rivenspire, there was a hunter named Rodard. He was not your typical hunter.
entries.translated_text: 好的。在碎裂山峰，有一位名叫罗达德的猎人。他不是你这种类型的猎人。

entries.text: ...Of course you do. What Breton wouldn't?
entries.translated_text: ……你当然可以。有什么是布莱顿人不会的吗？

entries.text: What sort of qualities?
entries.translated_text: 什么样的素质？

entries.text: Is it true your people lay eggs? Oh, is that- Is that appropriate to ask?
entries.translated_text: 你们的人会下蛋吗？这样问合适吗？

entries.text: Are you doing okay out there, Ria?
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗，利亚？

entries.text: Oh, it's you. Have you changed your mind?
entries.translated_text: 哦，是你。你改变主意了吗？

entries.text: Oh, it's you. Have you changed your mind?
entries.translated_text: 哦，是你。你改变主意了吗？

entries.text: They actually care about mortals and seem to have our wellbeing in mind. For the most part anyway.
entries.translated_text: 他们实际上也关心凡人，似乎把我们的福祉放在心上。反正在大多数情况下是这样。

entries.text: But Scrap is itching for action, and I've fixed him up a bit.
entries.translated_text: 但是小渣已经迫不及待要行动了，而且我稍微修理了他一下。

entries.text: You don't have to worry, Ilia. I'll keep up. Probably.
entries.translated_text: 你不用担心，伊利亚，我会跟上的，可能吧。

entries.text: Well... I wouldn't *kill* anyone to rob a city now. I have standards.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我现在不会杀人放火了，我有原则。

entries.text: Do you know anything about the Skyforge? It sounds interesting.
entries.translated_text: 你对天空熔炉一无所知吗？那听起来很有趣。

entries.text: Let's go, then!
entries.translated_text: 那我们走吧！

entries.text: Oh, sorry, I wasn't paying attention. Let me get out of the way.
entries.translated_text: 哦，对不起，我没注意。让我让开。

entries.text: That's why the Divines invented heroes. And sellswords.
entries.translated_text: 这就是为什么圣灵塑造了英雄。还有卖剑。

entries.text: And I have quick fingers and a penchant for bringing interesting and expensive artifacts out of dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 而且我的手指敏捷，能从锻莫遗址中带出有趣而昂贵的文物。

entries.text: Scrap, I highly doubt that Gore wants to pet you. No, I'm not going to ask him.
entries.translated_text: 小渣，我很怀疑格雷想让你成为他的宠物。不，我不会问他的。

entries.text: A wrist certainly isn't an elbow, no. It can bend and twist in ways an elbow could only dream of.
entries.translated_text: 当然是手腕不是肘部。它也可以弯曲和扭曲，就像肘部一样。

entries.text: I guess not everyone from there is as bad as I thought.
entries.translated_text: 我想不是那里的每个人都像我想象的那么糟糕。

entries.text: Oooh, I have so many ideas! I can't wait to get working on them!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我有很多想法！我迫不及待地想为他们工作！

entries.text: So... Do you want me to get you food now?
entries.translated_text: 那么...你想让我现在给你拿食物吗？

entries.text: Revan, what would you say if I told you I needed you to hold ten dwemer levers? What does that face mean? No?
entries.translated_text: 雷文，如果我告诉你我需要你拿着十个锻莫杠杆，你会怎么说？那张脸是什么意思？不？

entries.text: It's messy, but I suppose Madanach and the rest are making a point. And clearing your name in the process is a lovely bonus.
entries.translated_text: 虽然很迷惑，但我觉得迈德纳奇和其他人是在表明自己的观点。在这个过程中还自己一个清白也是不错的收获。

entries.text: Hey, so I was thinking...
entries.translated_text: 嘿，所以我在想...

entries.text: Of course. Approximately fifty-four have gone through my mind in the last day.
entries.translated_text: 当然，在昨天我就想到了大约五十四个。

entries.text: You were a bit closer to Skyrim than I was. There were probably more Witchmen about as well, right?
entries.translated_text: 你比我更靠近天际。可能还有更多的巫族吧？

entries.text: What do you mean? What are you reading..? Oh, "A Brief History of the Empire." Ugh. I'd say history is as good a joke as any. Is that what you meant?
entries.translated_text: 什么意思？你在看什么？哦，《帝国简史》。我认为历史是一个笑话。这就是你的意思吗？

entries.text: Ok then, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 那好吧，我的朋友。

entries.text: Nocturnal is a clear choice, being a patron of thieves, but also because she watches over those who live by the dark of night.
entries.translated_text: 诺克图娜尔也是我的一个明显选择，她是小偷的守护神，但也因为她看护着那些生活在黑夜中的人。

entries.text: Actually, yes! I was laying on the floor, as I do sometimes, and I noticed the chandelier above.
entries.translated_text: 事实上，是的！我当时和平时一样躺在地板上，然后我注意到上面的吊灯。

entries.text: Not bad, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 不错，我的朋友。

entries.text: The Forsworn! T-they have *plans*?! I always assumed them to attack at random, without thought.
entries.translated_text: 弃誓者！他——他们竟然有*计划*？！我一直以为他们只是随意攻击，不动脑子。

entries.text: You ever been walking through the woods and sen a sheet of muddy linen hung off a tree limb or a bush, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你曾经穿过树林时，看过到满是污泥亚麻布挂在树枝或灌木丛上吗？

entries.text: I was... eh... easily swayed by other kids. They'd convince me that something was fun, and I was... naive.
entries.translated_text: 我...呃...很容易被其他孩子动摇。他们会让我相信有些事情很有趣，而我...很天真。

entries.text: Now to make sure you don't attack me...
entries.translated_text: 现在得确保你不攻击我...

entries.text: I've heard stories about Bretons and their Knightly Orders.
entries.translated_text: 我听说过关于布莱顿人和他们的骑士团的故事。

entries.text: Ubbe, if you could kill them now, I'd appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 乌贝，如果你现在能杀了他们，我会很感激！

entries.text: Maybe the Bard's College?
entries.translated_text: 去诗人学院吗？

entries.text: I used to try hard to use magic. I'd stare for hours at a marble, trying to use alteration to lift it. It took awhile to accept that I just couldn't.
entries.translated_text: 我曾经努力使用魔法。我会盯着一个大理石几个小时，试图用变换系法术抬起它。我花了一段时间才接受我做不到。

entries.text: Reading, writing, and of course science!
entries.translated_text: 读书、写字，当然还有科学！

entries.text: We won't die! At least, I don't think Josh will let us die! So there!
entries.translated_text: 我们不会死的！至少，我认为约书不会让我们死的！

entries.text: Hah! That's what you get for attacking me and Revan!
entries.translated_text: 哈！这就是你攻击我和渡鸦的下场！

entries.text: If the falmer begin to break into Understone Keep, that's technically our fault?
entries.translated_text: 如果伐莫开始闯入石下要塞，那从技术上来说是我们的错吗？

entries.text: Someday, I'm going to show those nobles in High Rock the unfortunate consequences of their actions.
entries.translated_text: 总有一天，我要让高岩的那些贵族们自食其果。

entries.text: I know- OH no. I meant in general. My knowledge of magic is... lacking... in comparison.
entries.translated_text: 我了解-哦，不。我的意思是一般。相比之下，我的魔法知识...不多...

texts: I know- OH no. I meant in general. My knowledge of magic is... lacking... in comparison.
我知道-哦，不。我的意思是一般。相比之下矮人，我的魔法知识……不多……。

entries.text: You know you don't need to try to kill Doctor? Or me?
entries.translated_text: 你知道你没必要去杀医生吗？或者我？

entries.text: After reading the book I gave her about Chaurus Pie, Remi has decided she wants to try it. I gathered all the necessary ingredients for Remi. We've arrived at the Candlehearth Hall kitchen, and now I just need to wait for Remi to make the pie.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米读了我给她的关于巢蚁薄饼的书后，决定尝试一下。我为蕾米收集了所有必要的原料。我们已经到了烛炉堂的厨房，现在我只需要等蕾米做馅饼。

texts: Perhaps. Perhaps not. Tell me what you're looking for and maybe we can make a deal.
也许。也许不是。告诉我你在找什么，也许我们可以达成协议。

entries.text: I'm a little disappointed there wasn't a ghost, though.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我有点失望，没有鬼。

entries.text: Chaurus Pie
entries.translated_text: 巢蚁薄饼

entries.text: I- I am glad to see you. I feared the worst. It's good to know that you're safe.
entries.translated_text: 我-我很高兴见到你。我很担心会发生最坏的情况。很高兴知道你安然无恙。

entries.text: And... Thank you. For taking me, that is.
entries.translated_text: 还有...谢谢你愿意带上我，就是这样。

entries.text: That fight wasn't anything to *write home about*. Right, Yaz? Right?
entries.translated_text: 那场战斗没什么*值得写信回家*的。对吧，雅扎？对吧？

entries.text: Definitely not.
entries.translated_text: 当然不。

entries.text: I've never been able to grow food. Everything I plant dies. It's a shame, really.
entries.translated_text: 我从来没有种活过食物，我种下的一切都会死，好可惜，真的。

entries.text: Hi, Mortu. Did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，莫尔图。您需要什么吗？

entries.text: You've treated me poorly, and I can hardly stand to even look at you half the time.
entries.translated_text: 你对我很差劲，我有一半时间都不想看你。

entries.text: Ha. Here I thought I was in trouble for the spadetail incident with Remi's waterskin.
entries.translated_text: 哈，在这里，我想我因蕾米水袋的而遇到麻烦了。

entries.text: Good work out there, Josh!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，约书！

entries.text: Oh well. Welcome to our very professional business!
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧。欢迎加入我们的专业团队！

entries.text: Or... doesn't work.
entries.translated_text: 或者……完全没用。

entries.text: Or... doesn't work.
entries.translated_text: 或者……完全没用。

entries.text: Ah, a dragon! Kill it!
entries.translated_text: 啊，一条龙！杀了它！

entries.text: 'A man of violence,' he says. This is a tree, not his kin.
entries.translated_text: “你是这么暴力的人，”他说。这是一棵树，不是他的亲属。

entries.text: That's true.
entries.translated_text: 是这样的。

entries.text: There are just as many I'm not too familiar with. I also have some... misgivings about a few of them, but I couldn't tell you why.
entries.translated_text: 也有很多我不太熟悉的。我对其中一些人也有一些...疑虑，但我无法告诉你原因。

entries.text: As if we didn't have enough to worry about already.
entries.translated_text: 仿佛我们现在的烦心事还不够多似的。

entries.text: I did spend a lot of time with my mother, but she saw me more like a protege. My father... My father and I don't really get along.
entries.translated_text: 我确实和母亲相处了很长时间，但她更像是把我当作学徒来对待。至于我的父亲...我们关系并不怎么融洽。

entries.text: Okay, okay, that's fine. I'm sure they have some for sale here.
entries.translated_text: 好的，好的，没关系。我敢肯定他们这肯定会出售一些。

entries.text: Just... How I'm going to get by that court wizard and see Nchuand-zel.
entries.translated_text: 只是...我要怎么从那个宫廷巫师那里过去，看看楚安德-泽尔。

entries.text: Well, that'd be after we finished the modifications. If we have it able to cause explosions we'll have to be careful it doesn't harm you in doing so.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，那得等我们完成改造之后再说。如果我们让它具备引发爆炸的功能，那就得小心别让你被波及到。

entries.text: Got it! And a new ring for me. Now we'll be looking good.
entries.translated_text: 知道了！拿到一个新戒指，现在我们看起来就棒极了。

entries.text: ...Uh, I should clarify that the irony in my statement was unintentiional.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我应该澄清一下，我那句话中的讽刺是无意的。

entries.text: That's wrong.
entries.translated_text: 这不对。

entries.text: Yes! You just point the sharp end at your enemies, and stab at their hearts.
entries.translated_text: 没错！你只需将锋利的一端指向您的敌人，然后刺入他们的心脏。

entries.text: Altmer are little... stuck up. Aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 傲尔特莫有点...自负，不是吗？

entries.text: It wasn't your fault, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 这不是你的错，蕾米。

entries.text: ...Well, since you already agree with me, I don't see the harm in it. Yes, if they deserve it, I'll knock their teeth out for you!
entries.translated_text: ...好吧，既然你已经同意我的观点，我看不出它有什么害处。是的，如果他们应得的，我会为你敲掉他们的牙齿！

entries.text: Excellent!
entries.translated_text: 太好了！

entries.text: I've been annoyed at how slowly I've been picking locks lately.
entries.translated_text: 我一直对我最近开锁的速度感到烦恼。

entries.text: Finally you're done talking.
entries.translated_text: 终于讲完了。

entries.text: Er. Thank you? Um, why say this all of a sudden, though?
entries.translated_text: 呃，谢谢？嗯，为什么突然这么说呢？

entries.text: If I learned to play a lute, do you think having that musical knowledge would make tonal energy easier to understand?
entries.translated_text: 如果我学会了演奏鲁特琴，你认为这种音乐知识会帮助理解音调能量吗？

entries.text: Well, sometimes I base them on the people I've met or heard or read about. Sometimes they even are just that person, but with their name changed.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，有时我以我遇到的或听到的或读到的人为基础。有时他们甚至就是那个人，但改了名字。

entries.text: ...Friends. No. Not really, anyway. Convenient idiots, maybe. Gods, are you really out-drinking me right now?
entries.translated_text: ...朋友。不，不是真朋友，怎么说呢。用起来方便白痴，也许吧。天哪，你现在真的比我喝多了？

entries.text: Perhaps she was unconscious as it was occurring?
entries.translated_text: 也许她在案发的时就无意识了？

entries.text: He's apparently all settled in Skaven with my mother, and business is going well.
entries.translated_text: 他显然已经和我母亲一起在斯卡文定居了，生意也很顺利。

entries.text: Oh, but maybe that happens to you everyday? I suppose I'd also get tired of it.
entries.translated_text: 哦，但也许你每天都会遇到这种事？我想我久而久之也会厌倦的。

entries.text: Falkreath is perfect for it. The power of the Green is strong here.
entries.translated_text: 佛克瑞斯就非常适合。绿色之力在这里很强大。

entries.text: Incredible. I've found another insufferable Nord in the land of insufferable Nords. Tell me, what is your name?
entries.translated_text: 难以置信，我在令人难以忍受的诺德土地上找到了另一个令人难以忍受的诺德人。告诉我，你叫什么名字？

entries.text: (Clears throat) Hey, if you ever want to go kill everyone responsible, I'm on your side.
entries.translated_text: （清了清嗓子）嘿，如果你想杀了所有该为此负责的人，我站在你这边。

entries.text: You really confuse me sometimes.
entries.translated_text: 你有时真的把我搞糊涂了。

entries.text: Okay, you've convinced me. Some mead. Just so long as it isn't the Black-Briar kind.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你说服了我，来点儿蜜酒，只要不是黑棘家的就行。

entries.text: You don't like it? I thought you'd like green, but I suppose I should have asked.
entries.translated_text: 你不喜欢它？我以为你会喜欢绿色，但我想我应该问问你的一件。

entries.text: Here, Gore, I've gotten you a book. You have some sort of complex regarding manliness and orcs, so I figured I should find you a book about orcs.
entries.translated_text: 喂，格雷，我给你买了一本书。你似乎对兽人和他们的刚毅很喜欢，所以我给你带了一本关于兽人的书。

entries.text: I think it must just be the way they were spoken about back home, and even here in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 我认为这一定是他们在我家乡甚至在天际通常的认知。

entries.text: Scrap likes you! Ow! Scrap, don't poke me like that!
entries.translated_text: 小渣喜欢你!嗷！小渣，别这样戳我！

entries.text: Eccentric. Hm. Yes, that fits.
entries.translated_text: 怪人，嗯，是的，很合适。

entries.text: Well, you can love shiny treasure, adventure, and good company all at once.
entries.translated_text: 那么，你可以同时爱上闪亮的宝藏、冒险和好伙伴。

entries.text: What is it, boy? No, I can't let you out. You'll scare the townfolk!
entries.translated_text: 这是什么，男孩？不，我不能让你出去。你会吓到镇上的人的！

entries.text: (Squeal) Look! Look, look, look! A spider friend. Ahhhh, Scrap, look. You guys are like twins. Two spiders! Ohh, this is the best day of my life!
entries.translated_text: （尖叫）看！看，看，看！一个蜘蛛朋友。啊，小渣，看。你们就像双胞胎。两只蜘蛛！哦，这是我一生中最美好的一天！

entries.text: I wonder what Brelyna's spell was even supposed to do in the first place?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道布莱丽娜的咒语最初是做什么的？

entries.text: On the bright side, maybe we'll find something worth some gold?
entries.translated_text: 从好的方面来说，也许我们会找到些值钱的东西？

entries.text: Ruth, something is coming!
entries.translated_text: 鲁斯（该死），有什么东西来了！

entries.text: Oh, almost certainly. Dwarves kept stores of gems and other valuable materials. Not to mention their metal itself is worth quite a bit.
entries.translated_text: 哦，几乎可以肯定。矮人有大量的宝石和其他有价值的材料储备。更不用说他们的金属本身价值不菲。

entries.text: He wants me to find the Augur of Dunlain.
entries.translated_text: 他要我找到占卜师杜兰。

entries.text: It's definitely your turn. What do they even need the coin for, anyway? Maybe they use it to pay off their bounties.
entries.translated_text: 该你了。无论如何，他们要钱做什么？也许他们用它来支付赏金。

entries.text: Oh, they're just protective! But really, they're nothing to worry about with Scrap around.
entries.translated_text: 哦，它们只是有点保护欲强而已！但事实上，有了小渣在，就根本不用担心。

entries.text: Is it normal for someone to ask to sleep with you? The last town we were in, someone asked me. Do you suppose he just didn't want to pay for a room?
entries.translated_text: 有人要求和你睡觉是正常的吗？有人问过我，在我们的最后一个城市。你认为他只是不想付房费吗？

entries.text: Simba.
entries.translated_text: 辛巴。

entries.text: Speak to Calcelmo about the spider in the excavation site.
entries.translated_text: 与卡塞莫谈谈挖掘现场的蜘蛛。

entries.text: Yes, but I've known that since you joined the Brotherhood.
entries.translated_text: 是的，但自从你加入兄弟会后我就知道了。

entries.text: I know you're not going to destroy the Skaal. Storn has nothing to worry about. Right?
entries.translated_text: 我知道你不会摧毁斯卡尔。史东没有什么可担心的。对的？

entries.text: Yes, much of what you yell at them seems to have that effect.
entries.translated_text: 是的，你战斗时也常常说类似的话。

entries.text: I don't feel badly when I steal and I don't have to face the person afterward. It's just... Different.
entries.translated_text: 偷东西的时候我不觉得难受，事后我也不必面对那个人，只是...不一样。

entries.text: I felt the car get hit with something big, and then I look over and see this huge club in the cart.
entries.translated_text: 我感觉马车被什么巨大的东西撞了一下，然后我转头一看，看到一根巨大的木棒插在车里。

entries.text: We used to lie on a bed of moss and watch the starlight.
entries.translated_text: 我们曾经躺在苔藓床上看星光。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. However, it seems Morvic has decided to take matters into his own hands, as rumour has it he has been spotted in Markarth. By the time we arrived in Markarth, Morvic had moved on, but Remiel thinks we should investigate Arkngchal, a dwemer ruin she stayed in when first crossing the border.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。然而，莫维克似乎决定自己动手，因为有传言说他在马卡斯被发现了。当我们到达马卡斯时，莫维克已经继续前进，但蕾米尔认为我们应该调查阿卡切尔，这是她第一次越境时住过的锻莫遗址。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. However, it seems Morvic has decided to take matters into his own hands, as rumour has it he has been spotted in Markarth. By the time we arrived in Markarth, Morvic had moved on, but Remiel thinks we should investigate Arkngchal, a dwemer ruin she stayed in when first crossing the border.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。然而，莫维克似乎决定自己动手，因为有传言说他在马卡斯被发现了。当我们到达马卡斯时，莫维克已经继续前进，但蕾米尔认为我们应该调查阿卡切尔，这是她第一次越境时住过的锻莫遗址。

entries.text: You know, Ubbe, with all this walking, I'm surprised our legs aren't the size of tree trunks.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，乌贝，走了这么多路，我很惊讶我们的腿竟然没有树干那么大。

entries.text: Keep it up, Ilia!
entries.translated_text: 继续加油，伊利亚！

entries.text: No, Scrap. Tomorrow maybe. No, absolutely not. My answer won't change no matter how much you ask.
entries.translated_text: 不，小渣。也许明天吧。不，绝对不行，无论你问多少次，我的回答都不会改变。

entries.text: (Laugh) Someday, Val, we will go on a tour of Tamriel, eating everything tasty we find!
entries.translated_text: （笑）有一天，瓦尔，我们会环游泰姆瑞尔，吃遍所有美味！

entries.text: These people living in squalor... While those Silverbloods peacock around. Disgusting.
entries.translated_text: 当这些人悲惨地活着...而那些银血家族人却招摇过市，恶心。

entries.text: I *knew* they wouldn't let you near the food without looking the part.
entries.translated_text: 我就知道，他们不会让你靠近食物，除非你看起来像那么回事儿。

entries.text: Behold your future, Remiel.
entries.translated_text: 见证你的未来，蕾米尔。

entries.text: It's a little awkward that the emperor essentially gave us a contract on the man who gave us a contract on him.
entries.translated_text: 有点尴尬的是，皇帝本质上是给了我们一份契约去杀给我们契约杀他的人。

entries.text: Ha-Ha. Do you have more bad jokes? Because then I'd be out of a job.
entries.translated_text: 哈-哈。你还有别的烂笑话吗？那我就没事干了。

entries.text: You remember I told you about my blood-related father? How his body was raised by necromancers?
entries.translated_text: 你记得我告诉过你我的生父吗？他的尸体是如何被死灵法师复活的？

entries.text: We'll talk some more later, then, Raven.
entries.translated_text: 那么，我们稍后再谈，渡鸦。

entries.text: After powering up Arkngchal, the door allowing me to progress became stuck. Remi has relayed to me her 'notes' on how to make a metal lubricant, although she apparently cannot read her handwriting. Going off her drawings, she's informed me to mix together "three golden bowls" and "two grey ferns" in the cauldron. I've made the lubricant and need to use it on the door blocking my way.
entries.translated_text: 给阿卡切尔供能后，前进的门被卡住了。蕾米向我转述了她写的如何制作金属润滑剂的 "笔记"，尽管她显然看不懂自己的笔迹。根据她的图纸，她告诉我把 "三个金碗 "和 "两个灰色蕨类 "混合在大锅里。我做制作了润滑剂，需要把它用在挡在我面前的门上。

entries.text: Well, I don't want to waste more time looking for someone else.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我不想浪费更多时间寻找其他人。

entries.text: Yay! A ghost!
entries.translated_text: 耶！一个鬼！

entries.text: And while I haven't been back to check recently, I was wanted by the fair City of Anvil for...
entries.translated_text: 虽然我最近没有回去查看，但我被美丽的铁砧城通缉了，因为...

entries.text: Aren't you forgetting something?
entries.translated_text: 你没忘什么吧？

entries.text: Every day is a fight to keep him alive.
entries.translated_text: 每一天都在为了让他活着而操劳。

entries.text: At least I'd feel like I'm actually useful, you know?
entries.translated_text: 至少我会觉得我真的很有用，你知道吗？

entries.text: He is 'good?'
entries.translated_text: 他很“好”？

entries.text: My father used to say things like that... right after he insisted I murder someone I didn't even know. Much like this scenario.
entries.translated_text: 我父亲曾经说过这样的话...就在他坚持要我杀一个我根本不认识的人之后，就像现在这样。

entries.text: W-well, ah. For example... Do you... Actually collect Altmer ears on a necklace?
entries.translated_text: 好-好吧，啊。比如说……你……真的把高精灵的耳朵收集在项链上了吗？

entries.text: Maybe not your mind, but I've always wanted to learn from automaton!
entries.translated_text: 也许你不在意，但我一直想向机器人学习！

entries.text: You chose your target poorly. Here's your consolation prize.
entries.translated_text: 你选错目标了，这是你的安慰奖。

entries.text: Oh, it was so much fun!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太有趣了！

entries.text: Rude!
entries.translated_text: 真是粗鲁！

entries.text: I don't blame the Nords for never rebuilding this town... It's s-s-so c-c-old.
entries.translated_text: 我不怪诺德人从来没有重建过这个小镇...它太古老了。

entries.text: They seemed rather disillusioned as a whole, although some still retained their adherence to protecting the weak.
entries.translated_text: 虽然有些人仍然保留着对保护弱者的坚持，但他们整体上似乎堕落了。

entries.text: His family was ruined, just like mine. And I know how that feels, so I...
entries.translated_text: 他的家族被毁了，就像我的一样，我知道那是什么感觉，所以我...

entries.text: Honestly, having an automaton to fight for me would be great, but I haven't yet met one who likes me enough.
entries.translated_text: 说实话，有一个机器人为我战斗会很好，但我还没有遇到一个足够喜欢我的机器。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. Remi doesn't know who might want her dead, and we don't have the time to look into it right now. When I have free time next, I should ask her to begin investigating.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。蕾米不知道谁可能想要她死，我们现在没有时间调查。等我下次有空的时候，我应该请她开始调查。

entries.text: This Temple of Kynareth... It's the most magic I've seen performed in Skyrim's everyday society.
entries.translated_text: 这座凯娜瑞丝神殿...这是我在天际的日常社会中看到的最神奇的表演。

entries.text: Well, at least you had some leverage over them. Nobles really are the worst of the worst.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，至少你对他们有一些威慑力。贵族们真的是最坏的人。

entries.text: Do you have any foods you wish you could have right now?
entries.translated_text: 你有什么希望现在就能吃到的食物吗？

entries.text: Well, you've forgotten that there are many things I love that cannot be attained living such a life.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你忘了有很多我喜欢的东西是无法通过这样的生活来实现的。

entries.text: Not a full one! You can have a sip of mine.
entries.translated_text: 不能给你整杯！你可以喝一小口我的。

entries.text: See, this is what I'm talking about, with him wanting us to kill the dog. This is not a healthy relationship that Barbas as with Mr. Vile here.
entries.translated_text: 看，这就是我要说的，他要我们杀了那狗。这不是巴巴斯与维尔先生在这里建立的健康关系。

entries.text: Ah! Ubbe! Something is attacking us!
entries.translated_text: 啊！乌贝！有什么东西在攻击我们！

entries.text: How much more time and money do I have to waste on you?!
entries.translated_text: 我还要在你身上浪费多少时间和金钱？

entries.text: Do we actually have to go, or is this an optional field trip?
entries.translated_text: 我们真的必须去吗，或者这个实地考察是门选修课？

entries.text: Secret? What makes you think there's a secret?
entries.translated_text: 秘密？你为什么觉得我会有秘密？

entries.text: Okay. What now?
entries.translated_text: 好的。现在怎么办？

entries.text: Then I will call you Jasrah. Jas? How about I just call you either? It's decided!
entries.translated_text: 然后我就称呼你为贾斯拉。贾斯？我也这样叫你如何？这样决定了！

entries.text: I really don't want to try it, but now I feel pressured. How bad is it? Don't lie to me, Remi. Not about this.
entries.translated_text: 我真不想去试，但是我现在压力很大。到底有多糟？别骗我，雷米，别这样。

entries.text: You already got revenge by defaming him. This is too far, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 你已经让他受到了报应。我们走的太远了，蕾米。

entries.text: Oh, what a clever thief you are.
entries.translated_text: 噢，你真是个聪明绝顶的小偷。

entries.text: W-wait! I think I just saw-
entries.translated_text: 等等！我想我刚刚看到——

entries.text: He was used to the damp chill of the unmarked graves they guarded. He was used to the pain in his mind as they shrieked with fury and despair.
entries.translated_text: 他已经习惯了无名坟墓的潮湿寒冷。当鬼魂们愤怒和绝望地尖叫时，他已经习惯了脑海中的痛苦。

entries.text: You can be a prick sometimes. Just thought you should know.
entries.translated_text: 有时你可能是个混蛋，我只是觉得你应该知道。

entries.text: I got you that book we talked about.
entries.translated_text: 我给你买了我们谈论过的那本书。

entries.text: Oh wonderful! Thank you so much!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太棒了！太感谢了！

entries.text: Oh wonderful! Thank you so much!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太棒了！太感谢了！

entries.text: Oh wonderful! Thank you so much!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太棒了！太感谢了！

entries.text: Oh wonderful! Thank you so much!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太棒了！太感谢了！

entries.text: You'd be surprised. One time I was stuck out in the Pale and only survived because I found three entire bowls of horker stew on them.
entries.translated_text: 听完你会感到惊讶的。有一次，我被困在苍原领，最终在它们上发现了三大碗的海象炖肉才活了下来。

entries.text: Very well. You can steal it.
entries.translated_text: 很好，你可以去偷。

entries.text: It's meant to be wielded in conjunction with Wraithguard, a gauntlet to protect from it from taking your life force.
entries.translated_text: 它应该与怨灵守卫一起使用，怨灵守卫是一种保护它免于夺走你生命力的手套。

entries.text: Being in a mine by itself is miserable, but there is something about being imprisoned that makes it a thousand times worse.
entries.translated_text: 身在矿井中本身就很悲惨，而被囚禁的感觉更是雪上加霜。

entries.text: Mercenary's Notes
entries.translated_text: 佣兵的笔记本

entries.text: Mercenary's Notes
entries.translated_text: 佣兵的笔记本

entries.text: Riddles!? What fun! Excellent, this should be a great start. A couple words, like 'neither' might be difficult at first, but we can work around that.
entries.translated_text: 谜语！？太有趣了！太棒了，这应该是个很好的开始。有几个词，比如“都不是”，一开始可能会有点难，但我们可以慢慢来，想办法解决。

entries.text: Ahmed, take us somewhere fun, okay?
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德，带我们去个好玩的地方，好吗？

entries.text: Do you think Kodlak is angry with us?
entries.translated_text: 你认为克拉科生我们的气吗？

entries.text: Well, except- No, never mind, I only want my mind to focus on this exciting moment for now!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，除了--不，算了，我现在只想把注意力集中在这个激动人心的时刻！

entries.text: If they're still alive but can't fight, I try and find a healer, or a potion. At least something to ease the pain.
entries.translated_text: 如果他们还活着但失去了战斗力，我则会尝试寻找治疗师或药水。至少这样可以减轻疼痛。

entries.text: One of the more interesting schools, for sure. Especially if you aren't much of a fighter.
entries.translated_text: 肯定是更有趣的流派之一。尤其是如果你不是一个战士的话。

entries.text: One of the more interesting schools, for sure. Especially if you aren't much of a fighter.
entries.translated_text: 这确实是个更有趣的流派，尤其是你如果不擅长战斗的话。

entries.text: Do you hope to see it someday, then?
entries.translated_text: 那你希望有一天能看到它吗？

entries.text: Not now! I mean, Argonians I have met before did. I am just scared to meet ones that do now.
entries.translated_text: 现在没有！我的意思是，以前遇到的那些亚龙人想杀我。我只是有点害怕再遇到那种人。

entries.text: Oooh, this one had some desserts on them!
entries.translated_text: 哦，这个上面还有甜点呢！

entries.text: I need your advice on something. Greater soul gem with a shorter length wiring, or a lesser soul gem with a longer wire?
entries.translated_text: 我需要你的建议。是具有较短接线长度的较大灵魂石，或具有较长接线的较小灵魂石？

entries.text: Remi has decided she wants to make a 'portable chandelier'. She thinks that the only metal that could withstand the power necessary to create this is Aetherium, and she's under the impression some Aetherium should be located in her Dwemer ruin, Arkngchal. I should look around for some.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米已经决定要做一个 "便携式吊灯"。她认为唯一能承受制造这个所需能量的材料是神光水晶，而她的印象中，一些神光水晶应该就位于她的锻莫遗迹阿卡切尔内。我应该到处找找看。

entries.text: Remi has decided she wants to make a 'portable chandelier'. She thinks that the only metal that could withstand the power necessary to create this is Aetherium, and she's under the impression some Aetherium should be located in her Dwemer ruin, Arkngchal. I should look around for some.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米已经决定要做一个 "便携式吊灯"。她认为唯一能承受制造这个所需能量的材料是神光水晶，而她的印象中，一些神光水晶应该就位于她的锻莫遗迹阿卡切尔内。我应该到处找找看。

entries.text: (Offended gasp) Don't be rude!
entries.translated_text: (受冒犯的喘息)别无礼！

entries.text: Oh? And what school do you favour?
entries.translated_text: 哦？那你喜欢什么学派？

texts: Oh? And what school do you favour?
哦？还有你喜欢什么学校？

entries.text: Let me get it real quick.
entries.translated_text: 让我快点搞定。

entries.text: (Mumbling) It's not at all like 'I Spy.' Why did I say that...?
entries.translated_text: （喃喃自语）这根本不像《我是间谍》。我为什么这么说...？

entries.text: Breton Sailor
entries.translated_text: 布莱顿水手

entries.text: Well, hello there, Calcelmo.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你好，卡塞莫。

entries.text: I hear them shouting that every so often. "Skyrim is for the Nords!"
entries.translated_text: 我经常听到他们大喊大叫。“天际是诺德人的天际！”

entries.text: I admit, I've had reservations about it in the past, but... it's just so fascinating to watch. Where'd you learn it?
entries.translated_text: 我承认，过去我对它有些成见，但...看着它真是太迷人了。你是从哪里学到的？

entries.text: (Laugh) This is just the headmaster bragging about how great Arkngchal is! I mean, they were right, but it's still a bit funny.
entries.translated_text: （笑）这只是校长在吹嘘阿卡切尔的厉害！我是说尽管他们没说错，但还是有点好笑！

entries.text: Whether it is by killing your enemies or by lending an ear.
entries.translated_text: 无论是帮你杀死敌人还是聆听你的需求。

entries.text: Walking through ash is more of a workout than I anticipated. Can we take a break soon?
entries.translated_text: 穿过灰烬比我预期的更像是一种锻炼。我们能快点休息吗？

entries.text: Psst...
Oh, you're in luck! I just finished up charring a skeever hide! I seasoned it with some salt piles and lavender. I hope you like it!
entries.translated_text: 哦，你走运了！我刚刚烧焦了一个恶鼠！我用一些盐和薰衣草调味。我希望你喜欢！

entries.text: Oh, really? Let's see, then. This is...
entries.translated_text: 哦真的吗？那我们来看看吧。这是...

entries.text: You know they caused me quite a bit of grief?
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗？他们可真让我吃了不少苦头。

entries.text: Oh, there he goes. Okay, that's a relief. I think I might almost have it, though.
entries.translated_text: 哦，他回来了，好吧，真是松了一口气，不过，我想我可能快成功了。

entries.text: Mages in High Rock are generally more skilled than even Skyrim's most impressive counterparts.
entries.translated_text: 高岩中的法师通常都比天际那些鼎鼎有名的法师魔法修行更高。

entries.text: Gore, I noticed that you use Dunmeri expeltives. When you said before that you've seen all sorts, was Morrowind included?
entries.translated_text: 格雷，我注意到你使用了丹莫咒语。你之前去过各种各样的地方，也包括晨风吗？

entries.text: I've had people promise me things before and fail to follow through. Enough so that I've long since learned that I should just take what I want.
entries.translated_text: 我曾经听过很多承诺，但都没有兑现，所以我早就明白，我应该主动去拿我想要的东西。

entries.text: Rest in peace, chief. May your soul find peace in whatever place Rieklings believe souls go to.
entries.translated_text: 安息吧，酋长。愿你的灵魂在任何蓝客灵的灵魂归处都能找到安宁。

entries.text: Mages in Cyrodiil are all about politics.
entries.translated_text: 赛瑞迪尔的法师都是政客。

entries.text: Discover who sent the assassin.
entries.translated_text: 找出是谁派来了刺客。

entries.text: Discover who sent the assassin.
entries.translated_text: 找出是谁派来了刺客。

entries.text: Hey, um, your Psijic fellow is leaving? Hello? Wait! We have so many questions. He's ignoring me!
entries.translated_text: 嘿，嗯，你的赛伊克伙计要走了？你好？等下！我们有很多问题。他不理我了！

entries.text: Some gears fit alright, but some...don't. And sometimes soul gems have too big of souls.
entries.translated_text: 有些圆轮合适，但有些……不合适。有时候灵魂宝石的灵魂太大了。

entries.text: Some gears fit alright, but some...don't. And sometimes soul gems have too big of souls.
entries.translated_text: 有些圆轮合适，但有些...不合适。有时候灵魂石的灵魂太大了。

entries.text: Although I imagine it had something to do with your... friend there.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我想这和你那里的...朋友有关。

entries.text: Mhm.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。

entries.text: I'd say you're about to learn an important lesson about who you attack, but I don't think Gore will let you live long enough!
entries.translated_text: 我希望你会从你攻击的人身上学到一个重要的教训，但格雷可不会让你活着！

entries.text: Someone taught me, of course. How else are you supposed to know what sounds the symbols make?
entries.translated_text: 当然，有人教过我。不然你怎么知道这些符号读什么？

entries.text: You know how people say 'my blisters have blisters'? Well, I definitely get it now.
entries.translated_text: 你知道人们说的“我的水泡长水泡了”是怎样吗？好吧，我现在肯定明白了。

entries.text: Also I enjoy scenic adventures, where I can just stare off into the distance at something vaguely pretty. Woodlands are especially good for that.
entries.translated_text: 我也喜欢风景如画的冒险，在那里我可以茫然地眺望远方某些漠然美丽的景色。森林尤其合适。

entries.text: Do. Not. Hit. Ahmed!
entries.translated_text: 不要，艾哈迈德！

entries.text: Anyway, perhaps if you were thinking you'd rather not go through the trouble of sneaking into a temple, you'd rather send me?
entries.translated_text: 不管怎么说，如果你不想麻烦地潜入神殿，也许你可以让我去？

entries.text: You said something about an arranged marriage before?
entries.translated_text: 你之前提到过一桩包办婚姻？

entries.text: I actually take it back - Cyrodiil sounds miserable. How did you ever survive there? Knowing there was something so fascinating you could never see?
entries.translated_text: 我实际上收回刚才的话——赛瑞迪尔听起来真是个痛苦的地方。你是怎么活下来的？明知有一些你永远无法见到的迷人东西？

entries.text: And so, all of these characters, you conceive of them within your mind? How are you able to think from so many different perspectives?
entries.translated_text: 那么，所有这些角色，你都是在你的脑海中构想出来的？你怎么能从这么多不同的角度来思考？

entries.text: I've always been a night owl.
entries.translated_text: 我一直是个夜猫子。

entries.text: Good to see you on your feet.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴看到你站起来。

entries.text: You will take me to look around, won't you?
entries.translated_text: 你会带我到处看看的，不是吗？

entries.text: (Laughing)
entries.translated_text: （笑声）

entries.text: (Laughing)
entries.translated_text: （笑声）

entries.text: Ed is alive. I'm alive. That means we win!
entries.translated_text: 艾德还活着。我还活着。这意味着我们赢了！

entries.text: This place was as perfectly preserved as possible given the passage of time. Or it was, until Morvic's mercenaries came stomping through.
entries.translated_text: 时间流逝，这里会依然完好无损。或者，直到莫维克的雇佣兵闯进来。

entries.text: Come on, you aren't afraid of a little spider, are you?!
entries.translated_text: 来吧，你不怕小蜘蛛，是吗？！

entries.text: Maybe a swift kick to the head will make him come to his senses. On the other hand, some messages are more clear when they're in writing.
entries.translated_text: 也许一记猛踢他的头就能让他清醒过来。另一方面，有些信息在书写时能更清晰地传达出来。

entries.text: Good to know. I want you to know that I don't care.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你告诉我这个。但我想让你知道我不在乎。

entries.text: Good to know. I want you to know that I don't care.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你告诉我这个。但我想让你知道我不在乎。

entries.text: Well, this is Nords we're talking about. They certainly have no room to judge our fashion sense. What we're wearing is fine.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我们说的可是诺德人啊。他们可没资格来评判我们的时尚品味，我们穿得很体面。

entries.text: Now back to the adventures of Remi and her best friend!
entries.translated_text: 现在回到蕾米和她最好的朋友的冒险中！

entries.text: What is it, Jaxon? Please don't tell me you want me to carry something. I'm running out of room in my bag because of- Er. Nevermind.
entries.translated_text: 贾克森，这是什么？请不要告诉我你想让我带什么东西。我的包里空间快用完了，因为——呃，没啥。

entries.text: You handle yourself quite well in battle, Yaz. You don't even need an automaton to help you! Where did you learn to fight?
entries.translated_text: 你的战斗打得真好，雅扎。甚至你都不需要一个机器人来帮你！你是在哪里学习的战斗？

entries.text: I... (Sigh)
J'zargo knows many things other do not.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格知道很多其他人不知道的事情。

entries.text: I suppose I never thought of it that way. Figuring out why people behave in certain ways. I've always just assumed-
entries.translated_text: 我想我从未这样想过。弄清楚人们为什么会有某些行为。我一直只是假设...

entries.text: I've drafted an advert for Yazakh's writings! I even made a drawing of her in the process of writing. It's quite good.
entries.translated_text: 我已经为雅扎克的作品起草了一份广告!我甚至在写字的过程中为她画了一幅画。相当不错。

entries.text: My wounds, they're closing! Thank you so much!
entries.translated_text: 我的伤口正在愈合！非常感谢！

entries.text: Then I will call you Ahmed. Maybe Ed. Oh! How about both? Both it is!
entries.translated_text: 然后我就叫你艾哈迈德。两个都叫怎么样？就两个！

entries.text: You really care about Scrap. It's heart-warming.
entries.translated_text: 你真的很在乎小渣。真是暖心。

entries.text: ...Maybe if I poison him...?
entries.translated_text: ...如果我毒死他的话...？

entries.text: You've excellent taste, Gore! The craftsmanship is astounding, the balance impeccable, the machines beyond genius! Oh, I could die happy here!
entries.translated_text: 你很有品味，格雷! 这里的工艺令人惊叹，平衡无懈可击，机器超越天才！哦，我可以在这里快乐地死去了！

entries.text: This poor Anton probably felt so lucky to get a signed copy of Uncommon Tastes. Little did he know that getting it would lead to his death.
entries.translated_text: 这个可怜的安东可能觉得有幸能得到一本签名的《奇珍异味》，但他不知道这会导致他的死亡。

entries.text: There's a cave here.
entries.translated_text: 这里有一个山洞。

entries.text: Really? Okay. I would love to!
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？好的。我喜欢！

entries.text: We're in Morrowind! I've always wanted to go! Of course, Solstheim originally belonged to Skyrim... So does it really count?
entries.translated_text: 我们在晨风！我一直想去！当然，索瑟海姆原本是属于天际的...所以它真的算吗？

entries.text: You failed at dying the first time, but we'll give you a second chance!
entries.translated_text: 你第一次没有死，但我们会给你第二次死的机会！

entries.text: Well, you know, I made this to be a sort of advanced cure wounds potion. And, well, vampire dust had restorative properties.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你知道，我把它做成了一种高级治疗药水。而且，吸血鬼灰烬具有恢复作用。

entries.text: Land is land. It belongs to all who walk Nirn. At least, that's how I've always seen it.
entries.translated_text: 土地就是土地。它属于所有奈恩的人。至少，我一直是这么认为的。

entries.text: Excellent. Maybe I'll nap some extra gold while I'm at it.
entries.translated_text: 很好，也许我可以额外顺点金币。

entries.text: I should've done it sooner. Perhaps it would have been the example your despicable parents needed.
entries.translated_text: 我早就该这么做了，也许这会成为你那卑劣父母最该得到的教训。

entries.text: It smells... damp down here. I think I like it.
entries.translated_text: 闻起来...潮了，我想我喜欢。

entries.text: Operating out of Skaven...
entries.translated_text: 在斯卡文以外的地方经营...

entries.text: Yes, I was.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我是。

entries.text: Ria, please be careful!
entries.translated_text: 利亚，小心！

entries.text: Do you ever get claustrophobic in these mines?
entries.translated_text: 你在这些矿井里有过幽闭恐惧症吗？

entries.text: Absolutely.
entries.translated_text: 当然。

entries.text: Alright, Una, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，尤娜，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: Oooh, no, Festus. These Oculatus agents have a reckoning coming. I'll wait out here for anymore that come along.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，菲斯图斯。这些洞察之眼密探即将到来。我会在这里等着。

entries.text: Oooh, I wish I could be reading the Scroll! I'm so envious!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我希望我也能读到卷轴！我好羡慕！

entries.text: That is very kind of you.
entries.translated_text: 你真是太好了。

entries.text: Remi's Crossbow
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的弩

entries.text: That's perfect advice! Wait, I... asked where your parents are. Oh no, *I* was one of those strangers.
entries.translated_text: 那真是完美的建议！等等，我……我刚才问过你父母在哪。天哪，我就是那些陌生人的一员。

entries.text: Really? It sounds so pretty! Maybe you can show me there one day? Or maybe we could all visit?
entries.translated_text: 真的？听起来好漂亮啊！也许哪天你能带我去看看？或者我们大家一起去？

entries.text: And that week I spent lost, wandering about Hammerfell, thinking I was going to starve to death.
entries.translated_text: 而那一周，我迷失了方向，在落锤省游荡着，以为自己会饿死了。

entries.text: I don't understand.
entries.translated_text: 我不明白。

entries.text: This old man is pretty spry!
entries.translated_text: 这老头子可真够有活力！

entries.text: It means one of two things.
entries.translated_text: 这说明了两件事。

entries.text: Well, this is the part where we both conjure up some courage. If only I knew the spell.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这是我们都鼓起勇气的部分。要是我会这个法术就好了。

entries.text: All done!
entries.translated_text: 全部完成！

entries.text: Wow, are you sure you meant to speak to me? To what do I owe the honour?
entries.translated_text: 哇，你确定是想跟我说话吗？我何德何能受到如此厚爱？

entries.text: And this attack is for Ria!
entries.translated_text: 这是为了利亚！

entries.text: But I also wouldn't say that I worship them. Likewise, kings and queens hold much power, and people surely revel in that.
entries.translated_text: 但我也不会说我信仰他们。同样，国王和王后拥有很多权力，人们肯定会陶醉于此。

entries.text: No, I did not choose. Marlok raised me in the wilds and we just stayed there. But I do not mind.
entries.translated_text: 不，我不是自己选择的。是马洛克在荒野里把我养大的，我们就一直待在那里。不过，我并不介意。

entries.text: I must say, Rumarin is much funnier now that I know he's joking half the time.
entries.translated_text: 我必须说，鲁马林现在更有趣了，因为我知道他一半时间都在开玩笑。

entries.text: I just want to see. I promise not to get in the way.
entries.translated_text: 我只是想看看，我保证不碍事。

entries.text: He's going to turn toward me when I ask him for directions; that's when you make your grab from the other side.
entries.translated_text: 当我向他问路时，他会转向我。

entries.text: Well, then, it sounds to me like they weren't worth your time anyway. I think it's wonderful that you decided to just stop doing what you disliked.
entries.translated_text: 那么，在我看来，反正他们也不值得你花时间。我觉得你就该停止做不想做的事情。

entries.text: Temples used to be relaxing. Now they just bring up bad memories.
entries.translated_text: 神殿本应是放松的，现在他们只会带来不好的回忆。

entries.text: So that's the Daedra who owns your soul. She's beautiful. But cold.
entries.translated_text: 所以那就是掌握你灵魂的魔神了，她很漂亮，但是很冷酷。

entries.text: You're brilliant. Don't let anyone tell you otherwise.
entries.translated_text: 你很出色，不要让其他人瞎说。

entries.text: Okay, I have prepared my brain to memorize this. Proceed.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我会好好记住的。

entries.text: Sounds good.
entries.translated_text: 听起来不错。

entries.text: Sounds good.
entries.translated_text: 听起来不错。

entries.text: Sounds good.
entries.translated_text: 听起来不错。

entries.text: Sounds good.
entries.translated_text: 听起来不错。

entries.text: I haven't really planned that far.
entries.translated_text: 我还没有真的规划那么远。

entries.text: By Sheor, more fighting?!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔啊，更多的战斗？！

entries.text: In Wayrest, the Order of the Hour worked closely with the governing powers, and they were able to sway public opinion.
entries.translated_text: 在途歇城，时序团与执政者紧密合作，他们能够左右公众舆论。

entries.text: Surely if the others call him 'unlucky', Grisvar must have had some idea that things with Madanach would not work out in his favour?
entries.translated_text: 如果其他人说他是倒霉蛋，那么格利斯瓦肯定早就知道迈德纳奇的事情对他没好处。

entries.text: You have a very active imagination. How much time have you spent alone in these ruins, exactly?
entries.translated_text: 你的想象力很丰富，你一个人在遗址里待了多久？

entries.text: How, er, how did you know what I wanted, though?
entries.translated_text: 你怎么知道我想要什么？

entries.text: And I have to watch him transform again! I wish I could slow time to watch it in detail.
entries.translated_text: 而且我得再看他变身一次！真希望我能让时间慢下来，好细细观察每个细节。

entries.text: Yes, there are traps everywhere, but at least they built us benches to relax and lick our wounds.
entries.translated_text: 是的，到处都是陷阱，但至少他们为我们搭建了长椅，让我们放松并舔舐伤口。

entries.text: I am partial to 'revolution', but I've only ever read of it, or thought of it. Reality is more... violent.
entries.translated_text: 我更喜欢“革命”一些，但从来都我只在书中读到或想到过。但不知道现实更加...暴力。

entries.text: Hm. Was he really paranoid if someone actually *was* out to get him?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，如果真的有人想害他，那他还算多疑吗？

entries.text: I don't know, this place is incredibly dark and scary.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，这个地方非常黑暗和可怕。

entries.text: Has the store made any money?
entries.translated_text: 商店有赚钱吗？

entries.text: Oh! Where are you from?
entries.translated_text: 你从哪里来的？

entries.text: They want me to join the Brotherhood.
entries.translated_text: 他们希望我加入兄弟会。

entries.text: I stayed with the ship most of the time during and after the fighting. I'm really glad to hear your family was all right.
entries.translated_text: 在战斗期间和之后的大部分时间里，我都待在船上。我很高兴听到你家人没事。

entries.text: Yes, I'm from High Rock. I'm exploring Skyrim with this adventurer. They decided to take a detour to become a Companion.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我来自高岩。我正在和这位冒险者一起探索天际。他们决定绕道成为一名战友。

entries.text: Well, I figured I could write a tip-off to the Order of the Hour in Wayrest, framing Morvik as a daedra-worshipper.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想我可以给途歇城的时序团写一封信，诬陷莫维克是个魔族信徒。

entries.text: Oh, that's a good point.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这想法不错。

entries.text: Scrap says his legs hurt, and he wants to take a break.
entries.translated_text: 小渣说他的腿很痛，他想休息一下。

entries.text: You're right. It's hard to believe you were anything beyond an old bastard.
entries.translated_text: 你说得对。很难相信你曾经不仅仅是个老混蛋。

entries.text: We're not stealing.
entries.translated_text: 我们不会偷窃。

entries.text: Captain Frostbane, your orders? Sorry, I couldn't help myself.
entries.translated_text: 冰霜克星队长，有何命令？对不起，我忍不住了。

entries.text: My sister was... I'd rather not get into it right now.
entries.translated_text: 我姐姐...我现在不想谈论她。

entries.text: Do you need me to lend you anything? This seems dangerous. Do you want some of my lockpicks? Just to be safe?
entries.translated_text: 你需要我借给你什么吗？这似乎很危险。你想要一些我的开锁器吗？以防万一？

entries.text: Right, okay.
entries.translated_text: 对，好的。

entries.text: As he approached the location the elder had described, he found a cover of gnarled, dead bushes and settled in to wait for the wraith to appear.
entries.translated_text: 当他靠近长老所描述的位置时，他发现了一片粗糙枯死的灌木丛，并安顿下来等待幽灵出现。

entries.text: Do you think... You know what, never mind.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得...你知道吗，没关系。

entries.text: (Laughing) I won't tell our mutual friend you said such a thing, don't worry.
entries.translated_text: (笑)我不会告诉我们共同的朋友你说过这样的话，别担心。

entries.text: Yes, I think you're right.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想你是对的。

entries.text: If you could just frown a bit more obviously for me?
entries.translated_text: 你能不能换成对着我更明显地皱皱眉？

entries.text: We're going to try.
entries.translated_text: 我们要试试。

entries.text: Naturally, the place would be infested with falmer. This is also the animonculory, so be prepared for automaton ambushes.
entries.translated_text: 毫无疑问，这个地方会有很多伐莫。当然也会存在很多矮人机械，所以我们得为可能面临的伏击做好准备。

entries.text: You're making a mistake attacking Ahmed!
entries.translated_text: 你敢攻击艾哈迈德，真是弥天大罪！

entries.text: But- But you're here. You're here. You're out! W-what happened?!
entries.translated_text: 但是，但是你却在这里。你出来了！发生了什么？

entries.text: I can pretend to.
entries.translated_text: 我可以装死。

entries.text: Do you know anything about a ship recently docked here?
entries.translated_text: 你知道最近停靠在这里的一艘船吗？

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. We have explored Nchuand-zel together, following in the footsteps of a lost expedition. Remi found and repaired a dwemer spider, who she named Scrap, and has asked to accompany me on my adventures.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯的银血旅馆遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我们一起探索了楚安德-泽尔，追随迷途探险的脚步。蕾米找到并修复了一只矮人蜘蛛，她将其命名为小渣，并要求陪我一起冒险。

entries.text: So, do you plan to finish Cicero off? What will the Night Mother do without a speaker?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你打算干掉西塞罗吗？没有发言人，夜母会怎么做？

entries.text: Good to know I'm appreciated.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴知道我很感激。

entries.text: Think of it as an extension of your own arm, counter-balance the added weight, think of your wrist as a second, more useful elbow.
entries.translated_text: 把它想象成你自己手臂的延伸，确保平衡的配重，把你的手腕想象成第二个更有用的肘部。

entries.text: What is that supposed to mean?
entries.translated_text: 这是什么意思？

entries.text: I found some Aetherium.
entries.translated_text: 我找到了一些神光水晶。

entries.text: What do you want back there?!
entries.translated_text: 你想回到那里做什么？！

entries.text: We're killing Maro, right? The bastard has it coming.
entries.translated_text: 我们要杀了马洛，对吧？那混蛋来了！

entries.text: There's no way to know if they deserved it, but I enjoyed killing them.
entries.translated_text: 虽然无法确定他们是否应得，但我确实享受了杀掉他们的过程。

entries.text: I'm hardly ambidextrous, though. I just don't think I'll ever get better at this fighting thing.
entries.translated_text: 不过我可不是双手灵活的人。我只是觉得自己永远也学不好战斗这回事。

entries.text: Any sign of the skooma?
entries.translated_text: 有任何斯库玛的痕迹吗？

entries.text: Certainly.
entries.translated_text: 当然。

entries.text: I know another spider that'd love to meet you!
entries.translated_text: 我知道有另一只蜘蛛很想见你！

entries.text: Let's try... this!
entries.translated_text: 让我们试试...这个！

entries.text: (Laughs) Now that's why the Divines invented blades!
entries.translated_text: (笑)这就是为什么圣灵发明了刀剑!

entries.text: What were you thinking about?
entries.translated_text: 你在想什么？

entries.text: If I were any good at magic besides healing... Telekinesis would be my go-to spell. Too lazy to grab a sweet roll? Just magic it over!
entries.translated_text: 如果我除了治疗系还擅长其他魔法...念动术将是我的首选法术。甜卷都懒得吃？直接用魔法解决！

entries.text: That's quite an understatement.
entries.translated_text: 那可不止是“不错”。

entries.text: Ahhhhh! Oh my poor Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 啊啊！哦，我可怜的小渣！

entries.text: I have things to study, what is it?
entries.translated_text: 我还有东西要研究。什么事？

entries.text: Hm? Oh, yea.
entries.translated_text: 嗯？哦，是的。

entries.text: A letter of credit? I suppose Astrid must really trust Delvin if she accepts credit. Then again, it's likely not wise to scam the Brotherhood.
entries.translated_text: 凭证？我想如果阿斯垂德接受了，那她一定真的信任戴尔文。话又说回来，欺骗兄弟会可能是不明智的。

entries.text: Probably... failure. That's probably predictable, though.
entries.translated_text: 可能是...失败。不过，这可能是可以预见的。

entries.text: Khash, I notice you curse quite a bit.
entries.translated_text: 卡什，我注意到你挺常骂脏话的。

entries.text: Anyway, I've only ever stolen from a temple once before. This sounds like fun! Can I ask you a favour, adventurer?
entries.translated_text: 总之，我以前只在神殿里偷过一次东西。这听起来很有趣我能请你帮个忙吗，冒险者？

entries.text: So, what's the plan now, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么，现在有什么计划呢？

entries.text: We could just tell Urag that we couldn't find them and then never ever talk to anyone at all at the college again.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以直接告诉乌拉格我们找不到他们，然后以后再也不和学院里的任何人说话。

entries.text: Time to kick back and eat!
entries.translated_text: 是时候回去吃饭了！

entries.text: If you're sure, then I guess I won't strain myself.
entries.translated_text: 如果你确定，那么我想我不会让自己紧张。

entries.text: Do you think we should set up a store?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得我们应该开家店吗？

entries.text: And that day I was chased by bandits on the road and had to hide out in an abandoned cabin that smelled of sweaty feet.
entries.translated_text: 而就在那天，我在路上被强盗追赶，不得不躲进一间废弃的小屋，里面有一股脚臭味。

entries.text: Remi, you should steal that statue for Degaine now.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你现在应该帮德加因偷雕像了。

entries.text: Is it absolutely necessary for you to bother me right now? What do you want?
entries.translated_text: 你非得现在打扰我吗？你想要什么？

entries.text: I can think of a thousand other things I could waste my time on.
entries.translated_text: 我可以想出一千件其他可以打发时间的事情。

entries.text: I'd love to. What would you like to hear about?
entries.translated_text: 我很乐意，你想听什么？

entries.text: Oh, don't get me wrong. I'm not questioning your decision. I'm sure you have it all figured out.
entries.translated_text: 哦，别误会。我不是在质疑你的决定。我相信你已经想清楚了。

entries.text: But actually talking to people, in a more social context? Not so much. A lot of us still struggle in that area.
entries.translated_text: 但在实际社交中与人交流？没教太多。我们很多人仍然为此苦恼。

entries.text: Not to mention, I think the last battle really tangled half of it.
entries.translated_text: 更何况，我觉得最后一场战斗还把它搞乱了。
