entries.text: I think I'd like a peacock roast.
entries.translated_text: 我想我想吃烤孔雀肉。

entries.text: If a competent Mer were to lead a Skyrim hold to greatness, would they be shunned simply because of their ears?
entries.translated_text: 如果一个伟大的莫（精灵）要带领天际再次伟大，他们会因为他的尖耳朵而讨厌他吗？

entries.text: My name is... (Names A-G)
entries.translated_text: 我的名字是...（A-G）

texts: He's offered to send me anything that doesn't sell, so long as I'm able to pay for its transportation to me.
只要我愿意支付运费，他愿意把卖不出去的东西给我。

entries.text: Hah! That's what you get for attacking me and Ganbald!
entries.translated_text: 哈！这就是你攻击我和甘巴尔德的下场！

entries.text: And you know Bretons are famous for magic, right? Why even keep me around?
entries.translated_text: 你知道布莱顿人以魔法闻名，对吧？为什么还要留着我？

entries.text: I'm good with machinery. Something about it just clicks for me.
entries.translated_text: 我擅长机械，某种程度上它们对我来说很合拍。

entries.text: Uh, well, no. I mean, sort of? Just now? But not really.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，不，我是说，有点？刚才但并非如此。

entries.text: I can tell just by glancing at that amulet that it's worth a fortune. I guess it'd better be, to contract a hit on the emperor himself.
entries.translated_text: 我看一眼那个护符就知道它值钱。我想最好是，毕竟这是用来雇人暗杀皇帝的。

entries.text: I spent almost the entire time following orders and carrying stuff. Not exactly an experience I'd want to repeat.
entries.translated_text: 我几乎整段时间都在遵守命令和搬运东西。这绝非我想重温的经历。

entries.text: I'm funny that way. But, we're adventurers, right?
entries.translated_text: 我这样很有趣。但是，我们是冒险者，对吧？

entries.text: Yes, and look at the items being sold next to it! Are you thinking what I'm thinking?
entries.translated_text: 是的，看看它旁边正在出售的物品！你在想我在想什么吗？

entries.text: No matter the circumstances, that doesn't justify anything those necromancers did. They were responsible for their actions. Everyone has a choice.
entries.translated_text: 无论情况如何，那都不能为那些死灵法师的所作所为开脱。他们要为自己的行为负责，每个人都有自己的选择。

entries.text: Absolutely not! I will not be missing out on drinking with you.
entries.translated_text: 绝不可能！我可不会错过和你一起喝酒的机会！

entries.text: I hear the Night Mother's will. I hear who our next contract is from her.
entries.translated_text: 我听到了夜母的旨意，我听说我们的下一份契约是谁从她那里得到的。

entries.text: ;Has heard Remi talk about arranged marriage failure
entries.translated_text: ;HasheardRemitalkaboutarrangedmarriagefailure

entries.text: Perhaps we can pay them a visit? They've piqued my curiosity, so I'd like to ask them a few questions. What do you think?
entries.translated_text: 也许我们可以去拜访他们？他们已经激起了我的好奇心，所以我想问他们几个问题。你怎么看？

entries.text: Really? Okay. I'll practice right away so that I'm ready to help in our next fight!
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？好的。我将立即练习，以便为我们的下一场战斗做好准备！

entries.text: Can we do it in the Drunken Huntsman instead? Mead for you, mead for me. Sounds perfect!
entries.translated_text: 我们能在醉猎户里做这个吗？我们各来一点蜜酒，听起来很棒！

entries.text: It is dusty and gross and noisy and everything in here wants to kill us.
entries.translated_text: 尘土飞扬，粗暴而嘈杂，这里的一切都想杀死我们。

entries.text: If you say so.
entries.translated_text: 如果你这么说的话。

entries.text: If you say so.
entries.translated_text: 如果你这么说的话。

entries.text: If you say so.
entries.translated_text: 如果你这么说的话。

entries.text: If you say so.
entries.translated_text: 如果你这么说的话。

entries.text: If you say so.
entries.translated_text: 如果你这么说的话。

entries.text: I'm glad to fight with you and not against you, Raven.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴和你一起战斗，而不是和你对抗，渡鸦。

entries.text: But... You conjure, so you know magic, right?
entries.translated_text: 但是...你会施法，所以你学过法术，对吗？

entries.text: Oh, believe me, it is. That's what makes it so fun! Uh... like puzzles? Do you like puzzle games?
entries.translated_text: 哦，相信我，是的。这就是让它如此有趣的原因！呃...像谜题？你喜欢益智游戏吗？

entries.text: Remi, I have an important question to ask... (Romance)
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我有一个重要的问题要问...（浪漫）

entries.text: Do you think the dwemer could make a lute into a tool for tonal architecture?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得锻莫能把鲁特琴做成音律结构的工具吗？

entries.text: Summons Scrap for <dur> seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
entries.translated_text: 在施法者指向的任何地方召唤小渣，持续<dur>秒。

entries.text: Summons Scrap for <dur> seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
entries.translated_text: 在施法者指向的任何地方召唤小渣，持续<dur>秒。

texts: Summons Scrap for <dur> seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
在施法者指向的任何地方召唤小渣，持续<dur>秒。

entries.text: Summons Scrap for <dur> seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
entries.translated_text: 在施法者指向的任何地方召唤小渣，持续<dur>秒。

entries.text: Summons Scrap for <dur> seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
entries.translated_text: 在施法者指向的任何地方召唤小渣，持续<dur>秒。

entries.text: Summons Scrap for <dur> seconds wherever the caster is pointing.
entries.translated_text: 在施法者指向的任何地方召唤小渣，持续<dur>秒。

entries.text: Okay, Mor, then I will see you... Well, I'll still *see* you, we just won't be talking. I will *talk* to you later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，莫尔，那我再“见”...好吧，我还是会“看见”你，只是我们不会说话。我稍后会和你“聊”。

entries.text: Oh. Uh. Okay... Well, Marlok gave you great advice. I think it's wonderful that you are exploring and learning at thirteen-and-a-half.
entries.translated_text: 哦，呃，好吧...嗯，马洛克给了你很好的建议。我觉得你在十三岁半时就勇于探索、热爱学习，真的很棒。

entries.text: We need to find Madanach.
entries.translated_text: 我们得找到迈德纳奇。

entries.text: Back home, I'd have to be on the lookout for dreugh while walking the beaches. Here, we just have to worry about mudcrabs.
entries.translated_text: 回家时，我必须在海滩散步时注意防风避雨。在这里，我们只需要担心泥沼蟹。

entries.text: Wait for Remi to finish her project.
entries.translated_text: 等待蕾米完成。

entries.text: Maybe we'd have both been in the wilds of High Rock, worshipping nature.
entries.translated_text: 也许我们都会在高岩的荒野中，信仰大自然。

entries.text: Man Called 'L'
entries.translated_text: 叫'L'的男人

entries.text: I can hardly stand to be around you.
entries.translated_text: 我快受不了你了。

entries.text: Yes? What is it?
entries.translated_text: 是？怎么回事？

entries.text: I've been better.
entries.translated_text: 我好多了。

entries.text: I've been better.
entries.translated_text: 我好多了。

entries.text: So what now?
entries.translated_text: 那么现在呢？

entries.text: So what now?
entries.translated_text: 那么现在呢？

entries.text: Okay, well, when you have time, let me know.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那你有时间就告诉我。

entries.text: I couldn't get through. Hm...
entries.translated_text: 我过不去，嗯...

entries.text: Oh, chandelier... Tell me your secrets! I promise I'll dismantle you gently.
entries.translated_text: 哦，吊灯...告诉我你的秘密!我保证我会温柔地拆解你。

entries.text: Well, it's turned me off of eating for the moment. It will pass, though. You can count on that.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这让我暂时不喜欢吃东西了。不过会过去的。你可以相信我。

entries.text: Because of me, we lost our method of income and fell into poverty.
entries.translated_text: 因为我，我们失去了收入来源，陷入了贫困。

entries.text: I can't believe Remi called me old. Over thirty doesn't seem that old, does it? I'm not entirely sure how long my lifespan is, now that I think it...
entries.translated_text: 真不敢相信蕾米说我老，三十多岁也不算老吧？我不太确定我的寿命有多长，现在想想...

entries.text: Mm. I... No, I don't imagine you would. Not yet. Uh, well, if you ever need to talk more about it, I am... open to it.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。我...不，我想你现在还不会明白。至少，还没到那时候。呃，不过，如果你哪天想多聊聊这件事的话，我……随时愿意听你说。

entries.text: And not even the most important tool?
entries.translated_text: 甚至不是最重要的工具？

entries.text: Oh? Are you finally ready to assist me in this absolutely integral endeavor? Going to find me some Aetherium?
entries.translated_text: 你终于准备好协助我进行这项重要工作了吗？要去给我找一些神光水晶吗？

entries.text: What is- Oh, you're trying to heal me? But I'm not injured?
entries.translated_text: 哦，你想治好我吗？但我没受伤？

entries.text: I... I think so? My heart has stopped beating out of my chest, at least.
entries.translated_text: 我...我想是的？至少，我的心脏还没停止跳动。

entries.text: (Whisper) Okay, just be quiet.
entries.translated_text: （低语）好吧，安静点。

entries.text: There's something here.
entries.translated_text: 这里有东西。

entries.text: (Sigh) Don't you worry.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）别担心。

entries.text: And I only burned off the first layer of my skin!
entries.translated_text: 而且我只烧掉了我的一层皮！

entries.text: So if you don't face the consequences, it doesn't bother you.
entries.translated_text: 所以，只要不面对后果，你就不会感到困扰。

entries.text: Looking good, my friend!
entries.translated_text: 看起来不错，我的朋友！

entries.text: It's time for us to part ways.
entries.translated_text: 是时候分道扬镳了。

entries.text: The bastard won't let me in to see the dwemer ruin! Something about a giant spider.
entries.translated_text: 那贱人不让我进去看锻莫遗址！就因为巨型蜘蛛。

entries.text: Well, I think you have a pretty face, Rumarin.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我觉得你有一张漂亮的脸，鲁米勒。

entries.text: Oh, me too. Wait, can you even cook?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我也是，等等，你会做饭吗？

entries.text: Ask Remi about her father's Third Consecration while relaxing somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 在某处放松时，向蕾米询问她父亲的第三次奉献。

entries.text: I'm not sure that you've noticed, but your sneaking did not go so well!
entries.translated_text: 我不确定你是否注意到了，但你的潜行没那么顺利！

entries.text: Stay still, and I'll give you a shave!
entries.translated_text: 别动，我给你刮胡子！

entries.text: Wait, you're telling me one elder scroll with unimaginable knowledge isn't enough?
entries.translated_text: 等等，你是在告诉我，一本拥有超乎想象知识的上古卷轴还不够？

entries.text: Oooooh, I can't wait! Hurry up and set, sun! We're celebrating tonight!
entries.translated_text: 哦哦，我等不及了！快点落山吧，太阳，我们今晚要庆祝！

entries.text: So, I figured I should try and start showing other people some courtesy. Even if they really, really don't deserve it.
entries.translated_text: 所以，我想我应该试着开始对其他人礼貌一些。即使他们真的，真的不值得。

entries.text: Said I wasn't good for anything. 'I'm just a little girl.'
entries.translated_text: 说我什么都不好。“我只是一个小女孩。”

entries.text: What did you think of that story of mine? The part with the mammoth tusk didn't put you off, did it?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得我的故事怎么样？长毛象牙的那个还不错吧？

entries.text: What?! Really?! That's so kind of you! What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么！？真的？！你真是太好了！这是怎么一回事？

entries.text: Okay, and now...
entries.translated_text: 好的，现在...

entries.text: The Black Books are very dangerous, Dragonborn. But also very seductive. If we're going hunting for them, I hope you can resist their pull.
entries.translated_text: 黑暗经书非常危险，龙裔，即便他们如此诱人。如果我们要寻找他们，我希望你能抗拒他们的诱惑。

entries.text: When my family lost their ship, lost their business, lost their home... Well, I can't say I didn't think of killing those responsible.
entries.translated_text: 当我的家人失去了他们的船，失去了他们的生意，失去了他们的家...好吧，我不能说我没有想过要杀死那些负责任的人。

entries.text: I wanna be able to read this... I don't know what that says. Yeah, no,  if you got something more interesting, go ahead!
entries.translated_text: 我也想读懂。。。我不知道它在讲什么。是的，不，如果你有更有趣的东西，那继续吧！

entries.text: I don't think Skyrim is known for its libraries.
entries.translated_text: 我不认为天际的图书馆很有名。

entries.text: Yeah?
entries.translated_text: 耶？

entries.text: Yeah?
entries.translated_text: 耶？

entries.text: Oh, yes, building out from a natural cave is so smart. Way smarter than building out into the, I dunno, open air. On the surface.
entries.translated_text: 噢，是的，在一个天然洞穴中建筑是个好想法。我不知道，但这比在户外建筑要聪明得多。

entries.text: I can't help but notice there are similarities between us and this expedition party.
entries.translated_text: 我不禁注意到我们和这个探险队之间的相似。

entries.text: Have fun with your mysterious Underforge meeting. I expect a full report afterwards.
entries.translated_text: 享受神秘的锻炉会议。我希望之后有一份完整的报告。

entries.text: There is something so eerie about Dwemer ruins. All these lonely, abandoned halls.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫遗迹里有些诡异的东西。就像这些孤独、废弃的大厅一样。

entries.text: What's this!?
entries.translated_text: 这是什么！？

entries.text: Besides, we face really dangerous monsters every day. Nothing compares to what we overcome on the daily.
entries.translated_text: 此外，我们每天都要面对非常危险的怪物。没有什么能比得上我们每天所要克服的。

entries.text: I got into a lot of trouble as a kid because I'd tend to become... destructive... to ward off boredom.
entries.translated_text: 我小时候惹过很多麻烦，因为我会...用破坏...来抵御无聊。

entries.text: Besides, you're all forgetting the best part, which is acquiring more knowledge!
entries.translated_text: 此外，你们都忘记了最重要的部分，那就是获得更多的知识！

entries.text: Kill them, Meeko!
entries.translated_text: 杀了他们，米科！

entries.text: A little coin always greases the wheels.
entries.translated_text: 一点金币总能左右逢源。

entries.text: People's motivations are always more complex than they seem.
entries.translated_text: 人们的动机总是比表面看起来更复杂。

entries.text: What is it?! You're too good to me.
entries.translated_text: 那是什么？！你对我太好了。

entries.text: That little old lady murdered Betrid! That's amazing! Little old ladies are cute but murderous little old ladies are magnificent! A shame she's dead.
entries.translated_text: 那个小老太太杀害了贝垂德！天呐！小老太太固然可爱，但杀人不眨眼的小老太太更厉害！可惜她死了。

entries.text: Pretty neat, right?
entries.translated_text: 很简介，对吧？

entries.text: Wait, she didn't even show us everything!
entries.translated_text: 等等，她甚至没有把一切都展示给我们！

entries.text: No problem! You know that I enjoy these projects anyway.
entries.translated_text: 没问题！你知道我还是喜欢这些东西。

entries.text: Well, anyway, I'm sure it's someone else who bewitched you. Maybe we should go see a healer?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，无论如何，我敢肯定是别人迷住了你。也许我们应该去看治疗师？

entries.text: Where are you from?
entries.translated_text: 你从哪儿来？

entries.text: So Arniel didn't pay for this mystery item? Then why is he surprised he hasn't received it?
entries.translated_text: 所以阿内尔没有为这件神秘物品买单？那他为什么还对没收到感到惊讶呢？

entries.text: Wait, you can understand him?
entries.translated_text: 等等，你能理解他在说什么吗？

entries.text: What now?
entries.translated_text: 现在怎么办？

entries.text: Remi! Can. Bigpig. Meet. Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米！可以，大猪，见，小渣？

entries.text: Okay. Then let's head to Riften.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我们去裂谷城。

entries.text: W-what was that?! Do you... Do you think it's ghosts?! Daedric ghosts?! Oh, I hope it's Daedric ghosts!
entries.translated_text: 那是什么？你...你觉得是鬼魂吗？魔族鬼魂？噢，我希望是魔族鬼魂！

entries.text: Well, I am, too!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我也是！（Well，W开头）

entries.text: Oh, was that my stomach? That would be very unladylike.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那是从我的胃传来的吗？那太不淑女了。

entries.text: I'm so excited! There's so much to see! So much left to do!
entries.translated_text: 我太激动了！有很多东西要看！还有很多事情要做！

entries.text: Hasn't been an issue, 'til you made it one. I can learn any time I want to. Watch. Can't be that hard...
entries.translated_text: 在你提出这个问题之前，这都不是一个问题。我想什么时候学就什么时候学。没那么难...

entries.text: Hmm... Teldryn...
entries.translated_text: 嗯...泰卓因...

entries.text: Oooh, that person's circlet had an emerald in it! Did you see?
entries.translated_text: 哦哦，那个人的头饰里有一颗绿宝石！你有没有看到？

entries.text: Um... No, not really. How in Oblivion can I be funny without being funny?
entries.translated_text: 嗯……不，不准确。我怎么能在不想搞笑时搞笑呢？

entries.text: Revan. I promise to remember it. Revan, Revan.
entries.translated_text: 雷文。我保证会记住它。雷文，雷文。

texts: Perhaps it was a satellite research center? Either way, I stayed here several weeks. I just couldn't bring myself to leave!
也许它是一个星象研究院？不管怎样，我在这里住了几个星期。我就是舍不得离开！

entries.text: Wha-?
Wha-?
Whatever we were.
entries.translated_text: 无论我们是什么关系。

entries.text: Excellent work, Ganbald! We make a good team!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，甘巴尔德！我们是一支优秀的团队！

entries.text: Good! Well. I assume we're off to kill more people? Off we go, then.
entries.translated_text: 很好！嗯，我猜我们要去杀更多人了？那就出发吧。

entries.text: Someday I'm going to show you how to forest-couple.
entries.translated_text: 总有一天我会告诉你如何成为森林情侣。

entries.text: I'm glad we can both enjoy our stay here, then!
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴我们都能在这里过得愉快！

entries.text: This is the end to your story! (Laugh) Do you get it, Yaz? Yaz?
entries.translated_text: 这是你的故事的结尾！(笑) 你明白吗，雅扎？雅扎？

entries.text: Remi loves pc; only available after romance questline
entries.translated_text: Remilovespc;onlyavailableafterromancequestline

entries.text: We could try the College of Winterhold.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以试试冬堡学院。

entries.text: They are a little creepy, aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 他们有点毛骨悚然，不是吗？

entries.text: It's dangerous in its raw form, and it has to be kept outside. Some sort of unpredictable tonal reactivity when unrefined.
entries.translated_text: 它的原始形态非常危险，必须存放在室外，未经精炼时会产生某种不可预测的音调反应。

entries.text: I love the sun on my face. Let's enjoy it while we can!
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢阳光照在我脸上，让我们尽情享受吧！

entries.text: I didn't take you for the criminal type, adventurer. Don't you worry; my lips are sealed.
entries.translated_text: 我没把你当成罪犯，冒险者。别担心，我的嘴很严。

entries.text: It's cold. I'm cold.
entries.translated_text: 天气真冷。我好冷。

entries.text: Hmmm...?
Well, are you regretting attacking Revan yet?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你后悔攻击渡鸦了吗？

entries.text: Yes, I think I'd accompany you in doing so, in that other life. If things were a bit different for us, well, who knows?
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想我会陪着你这样做，在那另一种生活中。是否事情都会不同，不过，谁知道呢？

entries.text: It's okay to be confident in your abilities. Just don't underestimate your opponent's.
entries.translated_text: 对自己的能力有信心是好事。只是不要低估你的对手。

entries.text: Remiel's Draught of Resist Shock
entries.translated_text: 雷米尔的耐电药剂

entries.text: I... Um.... I will be, I think...
entries.translated_text: 我...嗯...我会的，我想...

entries.text: Hmm... If I were a guard who wanted to keep illicit items for myself... I'd hide them away somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...如果我是一个想为自己偷藏非法物品的守卫...我就会把它们藏在某个地方。

entries.text: Ubbe? Oh, good. You lived. Me too, in case it wasn't obvious.
entries.translated_text: 乌贝？哦，很好，你还活着，我也是，可能还不明显。

entries.text: What?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: Be careful if you go down to the beach. I've heard horror stories about the Sea of Ghosts.
entries.translated_text: 如果你去海滩要小心。我听说过关于幽灵之海的恐怖故事。

entries.text: I grow tired of talking in circles with you! Should I begin by taking off your fingers?
entries.translated_text: 我不想和你兜圈子了！我是不是该先剁下你的手指？

entries.text: So you hate Bartokh. Do you... write any character that you like? Both in writing and as a person?
entries.translated_text: 所以你讨厌巴托克。你...是否写过你喜欢的角色？无论是在写作上还是在为人上？

entries.text: If I moved to Solsthiem, I'd start a Netch ranch.
entries.translated_text: 如果我搬到索瑟海姆，我会开一家气母牧场。

entries.text: Your spears are nothing but toothpicks to us! Do you realize that?
entries.translated_text: 你的长矛对我们来说不过是牙签！你意识到了吗？

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. However, it seems Morvic has decided to take matters into his own hands, as rumour has it he has been spotted in Markarth. By the time we arrived in Markarth, Morvic had moved on, but Remiel insisted we search Arkngchal. It seems Remi ran into Morvic without me. Things are looking grim.
entries.translated_text: 我们遭遇了一名来刺杀蕾米尔的刺客，这个刺客是蕾米的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米将莫维克诬陷为魔族信徒。然而，莫维克似乎决定自己亲自出手了。传言说有人在马卡斯发现了他。当我们到达马卡斯城时，莫维克已经离开了，但蕾米尔坚持要我们搜查一下阿卡切尔。似乎蕾米独自遇到了莫尔奇。事情看起来很糟糕。

entries.text: Alright, Mortu, then we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，莫尔图，那我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: Well, bye, Ria. Bye for now, at least.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，再见，利亚，至少现在是再见。

entries.text: Scrap, what have I told you about gossiping? Besides, they're standing right there! Hush!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，我不是跟你说八卦吗？而且，他们就在那儿呢！

entries.text: He's the only Aedra I still respect, and every Orc that people look on with disgust...
entries.translated_text: 他仍是我唯一尊重的伊德拉，而那些被人们厌恶的兽人...

entries.text: No, Scrap, you can't kill our... 'hired brute'. I need them for research, unfortunately.
entries.translated_text: 不，小渣，你不能杀死我们...‘雇畜’。不幸的是，我需要它们进行研究。

entries.text: Anytime, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 任何时候都行，蕾米。

entries.text: Yes, isn't it?! The metalworking, the stonework, the use of advanced technologies to both protect and enhance life within!
entries.translated_text: 是的，不是吗？！金属加工，石材加工，使用先进的技术来保护和增强内部的生命！

entries.text: Hi, Suryvel, what did you need?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，苏里维尔，你需要什么？

entries.text: Woah, watch out.
entries.translated_text: 哇，小心。

entries.text: There's a whole other wing over there!
entries.translated_text: 那边还有另外一栋！

entries.text: Oh- Uh, and congratulations, of course, on being accepted to the College.
entries.translated_text: 哦——呃，当然，恭喜你被学院录取了。

entries.text: No, Rodard hunted wraiths. As the twin moons shone down on him, he'd draw his silver sword and send those wretched souls to their final rest.
entries.translated_text: 不是，罗达德是幽灵猎手。当双月的月光照耀在他身上时，他会拔出他的银剑，将那些可怜的灵魂带去最后的安息。

entries.text: Yes, the trees grow tall and wide, and each one has a spirit of their own. The light would slip through the cracks between the branches.
entries.translated_text: 是的，树木高大而宽阔，每一棵都有自己的灵魂，阳光会从枝叶间的缝隙中洒落下来。

entries.text: Ew! Calcelmo wants to buy things from you? I can make better use of whatever it is he wants.
entries.translated_text: 呕!卡塞莫想从你那里买东西？我才可以更好地利用他想要的任何东西。

entries.text: Does anyone actually want to be a footsoldier for a land dispute between nobles?
entries.translated_text: 真的有人想成为贵族们纷争的炮灰吗？

entries.text: Please tell me the food at ports is worth it, or I will feel a terrible amount of pity for you.
entries.translated_text: 最好告诉我港口的食物真的值得，不然我都要替你们觉得可怜了。

entries.text: But no matter how much I tried to summon such feelings within myself, I never really... got it.
entries.translated_text: 但无论我如何努力在自己的内心深处唤起这种感觉，我从来没有真正...感受到它。

entries.text: This College is certainly pretty to look at.
entries.translated_text: 这所学院当然很漂亮。

entries.text: Amazing! Look at this ball of energy! If I could replicate this advanced power somehow...
entries.translated_text: 天呐！看看这个能量球！要是我能用什么方法复制这种先进的力量...

entries.text: Rodard readied his blade, steeling himself against the uncanny aura that wraiths so often have. He snuck silently toward her, ready to kill.
entries.translated_text: 罗达德准备好他的刀刃，释放光环与之对抗。他悄悄地向她靠近，准备动手。

entries.text: Maybe an alteration spell to detect the shape of a key hole... Combined with an automatic lockpick powered with a soul gem...?
entries.translated_text: 或许可以用一个变换系法术来探测锁眼的形状...再结合一个由灵魂石驱动的自动开锁器...？

entries.text: Hello, Ahmed. What did you need?
entries.translated_text: 你好，艾哈迈德，你需要什么？

entries.text: Buffy it is, then!
entries.translated_text: 好，巴非！

entries.text: Wait. I heard something.
entries.translated_text: 等等，我听到了什么。

entries.text: Pesky little rats!
entries.translated_text: 讨厌的小老鼠！

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. We found a smuggler in Riften who gave us information about Remi's family. I should read the note he gave me.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，他对蕾米尔对自己家族名声的影响而心怀怨恨。我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，他向我们提供了关于蕾米家人的信息。我应该看看他给我的字条。

entries.text: I'm right behind you, Una.
entries.translated_text: 我就在你身后，尤娜。

entries.text: It must be nice to relax in your own space after your adventures.
entries.translated_text: 冒险后在自己的空间里放松一定很好。

entries.text: Murder is, shall we say, an essential tool of the trade.
entries.translated_text: 可以说，杀人是干这行必不可少的。

entries.text: You did so good, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 你做得真棒，小渣！

entries.text: Oh, come on. You've never been curious enough to do something a little bit dangerous? Sneak up on some dwemer automaton? Taste a falmer stew?
entries.translated_text: 哦，别呀。你就没好奇到去做点危险的事吗？偷偷接近某个锻莫机械？尝块炖肉吗?

entries.text: I feel so energized!
entries.translated_text: 我觉得很精力充沛！

entries.text: Let me help you gather materials.
entries.translated_text: 我来帮你收集材料。

entries.text: Stars are the doorways to Aetherius. And the moons are the broken corpse of a god. Both amazing, but definitely in different ways.
entries.translated_text: 星星是通往艾瑟瑞斯的大门，月亮是神的残骸。两者都很棒，但又完全不一样。

entries.text: See, adventurer, I told you that you'd make a fortune down here. Just look at these chests.
entries.translated_text: 看吧，冒险者，我就说你在这里会大发一笔。看看这些箱子。

entries.text: So. Yes. Three golden bowls and two gray ferns. Or something like that. Throw those in that cauldron and I'm sure it will work out. Probably.
entries.translated_text: 所以，是的。三个碗和两个蕨类植物。或者类似的东西。把这些扔到大锅里，我肯定会成功的。可能吧。

entries.text: We are going to live, Buffy! Right?
entries.translated_text: 我们会活下去，巴非！对吧？

entries.text: So you don't know anything about it?
entries.translated_text: 所以你对此一无所知？

entries.text: She begged to be let inside, and he obliged. He told her she could stay until sunrise, and next to the warm fire, she eventually fell asleep.
entries.translated_text: 她请求让她进去，他答应了。他告诉她，她可以一直待到日出，在温暖的火炉旁，她终于睡着了。

entries.text: I-I mean. Not that I advocate violence, or want to-to model violence as a solution...
entries.translated_text: 我-我的意思是。并不是说我提倡暴力，或者想将暴力作为一种解决方案...

entries.text: A proper city. It's spectacular.
entries.translated_text: 一座真正的城市，真是壮观。

entries.text: Well, let me think... Hm, I *suppose* I can keep it a secret.
entries.translated_text: 让我想想...嗯，我想我可以保密。

entries.text: I'm after information about... unsavory traders from Wayrest. Know anything?
entries.translated_text: 我在寻找关于...一些来自途歇城的灰色商人的消息，你知道点什么？

entries.text: Your dragon worship has made you strong... but not strong enough!
entries.translated_text: 你的龙族信仰让你变得强大...但还不够强大！

entries.text: This seems rather like it's bound to cause some confusion. Unless...
entries.translated_text: 这似乎看起来一定会引起一些混乱，除非...

entries.text: Alright! Yep! Time to poison only the skeever nest. Nothing else. Just taking care of the pest problem, like we were asked.
entries.translated_text: 好吧！是的！是时候向恶鼠巢穴下毒了，没别的，就像我们被问到的那样，只是处理害虫问题。

entries.text: Don't ask how I run our store AND accompany you on adventures. You don't want to know how little I sleep.
entries.translated_text: 别问我是怎么既经营我们的商店又陪你一起冒险的，你不会想知道我究竟睡了多么少的觉。

entries.text: It sounds like you were happy.
entries.translated_text: 听起来你很高兴。

entries.text: You do not want to fight Ubbe! Or me!
entries.translated_text: 你不会想和乌贝战斗的！或者我！

entries.text: Does that mean you're ordering a goat roast?
entries.translated_text: 你是说你想吃烤羊肉吗？

entries.text: 'The Exodus?' I can't believe you actually went out of your way to find me a copy!
entries.translated_text: 《远行记》吗？我不敢相信你真的特意给我找了一份！

entries.text: Family has always been important to me. I just never realized I'd find more family in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 家庭对我来说一直很重要。我只是从未意识到我会在天际找到第二个家。

entries.text: My hair is so frizzy today. I hate when it's like this. It sticks to my face and is just so annoying.
entries.translated_text: 我今天的头发很油。我讨厌这样，它粘在我的脸上，真是太烦人了。

entries.text: Well, I'm sure you'll figure it out.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我相信你会弄清楚的。

entries.text: I remember all the struggles I have back home, but now when I think of them... I feel like I can tackle anything, with you by my side.
entries.translated_text: 我记得在家乡时经历的所有挣扎，但现在，当我回想起那些事...有你在我身边，我觉得我可以应对任何事情。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. We found a smuggler in Riften who gave us a note detailing Remi's family and their move to Skaven. It sounds like they're doing well. I should tell Remiel.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，他对蕾米尔对自己家族名声的影响而心怀怨恨。我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，他给了我们一张便条，详细说明了蕾米的家人以及他们搬到斯卡文斯卡文的地方。听起来他们做得很好。我应该告诉蕾米尔。

entries.text: Ah, well... That's very nice.
entries.translated_text: 啊，嗯...那真不错。

entries.text: My cat.
entries.translated_text: 来自我的猫。

entries.text: Remi has an idea for making lockpicking a quicker process. She wants to create a 'tension wrench' from a bit of iron at the forge in Markarth. I should take her to the forge and give her an iron ingot.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米有个想法，让开锁变得更快。她想在马卡斯城的锻造厂用一点铁制造一个“张力扳手”。我应该带她去锻造厂，给她一个铁锭。

entries.text: Will you pass on a message to Gore for me? I'm going to get him back for that last little prank. Tell him to be ready.
entries.translated_text: 你能帮我转告格雷吗？我要算他上次恶作剧的账。告诉他做好准备。

entries.text: Dragons.
entries.translated_text: 龙。

entries.text: I love what you've done with your feathers!
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢你用羽毛做的事！

entries.text: What do you mean? Being a scholar is far from 'horrifyingly dull'!
entries.translated_text: 你这是什么意思？做一名学者才不是“无聊到死”！

entries.text: I think my back is broken.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得我的背断了。

entries.text: Hm. Well, sometimes. But I'm not really lonely. Even though you and our friends are different from me...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，有时候会吧。但我并不是真的感到孤单。即使你们——还有我们的朋友们——和我不一样...

entries.text: Just a little longer, Tazvir! Stay alive a little longer!
entries.translated_text: 再多一会儿，塔兹维尔！多活一会儿！

entries.text: Is this the Silent City's sewage system? It seems to lead out into their river and water source, though...
entries.translated_text: 这是寂静之城的下水道吗？它似乎通向他们的河流和水源，虽然...

entries.text: A-afraid? Who, ah, who said anything about being afraid? Oh. You didn't? Well, neither did I.
entries.translated_text: 害。。。害怕？谁，啊，谁说过害怕？哦你没有？嗯，我也没有。

entries.text: Ah, to murder, I assume?
entries.translated_text: 啊，我猜是去谋杀吧？

entries.text: Or something like that.
entries.translated_text: 或者类似的。

entries.text: Everything okay?
entries.translated_text: 一切都好吗？

entries.text: Yuck! Ugh, that's it! I'm never using dwarven oil in a potion again! Unless...
entries.translated_text: 呸！啊，够了！我再也不会在药水里加矮人油了，除非...

entries.text: Suryvel, I know you may have already told me, but what is our next stop? Oh, did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 苏里维尔，我知道你可能已经告诉我了，但我们的下一站是什么？哦，你需要什么吗？

entries.text: I'm feeling a little down.
entries.translated_text: 我感觉有点沮丧。

entries.text: I just ended up going to a traditional college instead of a mage's college.
entries.translated_text: 我只是最终去了传统学院，而不是法师学院。

entries.text: Well, you don't have to be rude about it. I can handle myself. Besides, I'm only helping my associate here in *their* Companion endeavors.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你不必那么粗鲁。我能应对得了。而且，我只是帮助我的同伴来这里成为战友。

entries.text: ...Did you actually...?
Ask Remi to Lockpick
entries.translated_text: 让蕾米去开锁

entries.text: Ask Remi to Lockpick
entries.translated_text: 让蕾米去开锁

entries.text: Don't make that face! You have to admit, some of my potions are pretty useful!
entries.translated_text: 不要做出那种表情！你必须承认，我的一些药水非常有用！

entries.text: Ugh, yes, Skyrim music...
entries.translated_text: 呃，是的，天际音乐...

entries.text: I wouldn't change anything.
entries.translated_text: 我不会变得。

entries.text: On the side was some fried battaglir with a dip of rich goat cheese. And to finish it off... Honey cakes, powdered with sugar.
entries.translated_text: 旁边是一些油煎糖饼，上面沾着丰富的山羊奶酪。最后是...涂满糖粉的蜂蜜蛋糕。

entries.text: On the side was some fried battaglir with a dip of rich goat cheese. And to finish it off... Honey cakes, powdered with sugar.
entries.translated_text: 旁边是一些油煎糖饼，上面沾着丰富的山羊奶酪。最后是...涂满糖粉的蜂蜜蛋糕。

entries.text: What if we could find a way to make dwemer lights portable?
entries.translated_text: 如果我们能找到一种方法让锻莫灯变得便携，会怎么样？

entries.text: Yes, I rather think I do. Living free from the shackles of the law. No one save nature itself telling you what is wrong or right.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我希望我也能这样。从法律的桎梏中自由地生活。除了大自然本身，没有人告诉你什么是错的或对的。

entries.text: Yes, and the silence lets the sounds of the machines echo strangely down the empty corridors.
entries.translated_text: 是啊，安静得只有机器的运行声在空荡荡的走廊中奇怪地回响。

entries.text: It was the day before her brother Roggvir was gonna be executed.
entries.translated_text: 那是她哥哥罗吉维尔即将被处决的前一天。

entries.text: Worship is attending sermons dedicated to a Divine.
entries.translated_text: 信仰是参加对应圣灵的布道。

entries.text: I have such fond memories of this place. Morvic better not change that.
entries.translated_text: 我在这个地方留下了最美好的回忆，莫维克最好不要改变了它。

entries.text: Oo, with what?
entries.translated_text: 哦，用什么？

entries.text: "This worship can be observed by his practice of..."
entries.translated_text: “你可以通过观察他...的行为来确认这一点”

entries.text: (Sigh) My full name is... Valerius.
entries.translated_text: (叹气）我的全名是......瓦雷瑞。

entries.text: Nar, I need you to give me inspiration. I hope that's why you've stopped to talk with me.
entries.translated_text: 纳尔，我需要你给我灵感。我希望这就是你停下来和我交谈的原因。

entries.text: Remi, if someone's bothering you, point me at them, and I'll teach them to disrespect you.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，如果有人骚扰你，你就把他们指出来，我会教他们不尊重你的下场。

entries.text: Scrap weighs more than dragon bones, so don't expect me to carry too much.
entries.translated_text: 小渣比龙骨还重，别指望我带太多。

entries.text: Scrap weighs more than dragon bones, so don't expect me to carry too much.
entries.translated_text: 小渣比龙骨还重，别指望我带太多东西。

entries.text: I'm a bit unclear. Is Pantea's flute able to make people dance or not? Well, I suppose all flutes can make people dance, if the player is any good.
entries.translated_text: 我有点不清楚。潘提亚的长笛能不能让人跳舞？好吧，我想所有的长笛都能让人跳舞，如果演奏得好的话。

entries.text: Look at this engraving! Oh! Look at this furniture! And look at this piping!
entries.translated_text: 看看这个雕刻！哦！看看这设备！看看这个管道！

entries.text: I've always like stories, but Yazakh has made me think of them in new ways. Explorations of others' minds... It's... interesting!
entries.translated_text: 我一直都喜欢故事，但雅扎克让我以新的方式思考它们。对他人思想的探索...这...真有趣!

entries.text: I really hope Rumarin decides to talk with Scrap. That way he can't call me crazy anymore. Or I guess he could, but then he'd also be crazy.
entries.translated_text: 我真的希望鲁马林决定和小渣谈谈。这样他就不能再叫我疯子了。或者我猜他仍然会这么叫我，但他也变成疯子了。

entries.text: Me? I'm all sorts of confused.
entries.translated_text: 我？和我有什么关心。

entries.text: Hello, Joshua. Were you going to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 你好，约书亚。你打算问我什么吗？

entries.text: Hmm... Well, let's write out a draft. Are you able to help with that right now?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...好吧，让我们写一个草稿，你现在能帮忙吗？

entries.text: No, I don't have any money to spare. I've already spent it, you see, and there's still stuff here I'd love to have...
entries.translated_text: 不，我没有多余的钱。我已经花掉了，你看，这里还有我想要的东西。。。

entries.text: I can't help but notice that Skyrim doesn't have any Schools of Julianos. Really, no wonder Nords are so... like that.
entries.translated_text: 我不禁注意到天际没有任何尤里安诺斯学院。真的，难怪诺德人如此...

entries.text: She'd taken the lives of several people who ventured too near her during the night. Rodard took the job without question and headed into the dark.
entries.translated_text: 她已经夺走了好几个在夜间在她附近冒险的人的生命。罗达德毫无疑问地接受了这份工作，然后走入了黑暗。

entries.text: Anyway, I have plenty of books, and I'm sure we can pick one up next time we stop in a city.
entries.translated_text: 总之，我这儿有很多书，而且我相信我们下次进城的时候一定能再买一本。

entries.text: So about making picking locks easier...
entries.translated_text: 所以关于让撬锁更容易...

entries.text: Ilia, you're always so impressive while fighting.
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚，你在战斗时总是那么令人印象深刻。

entries.text: Why are you looking at me like that? You're freaking me out a little.
entries.translated_text: 你为什么这样看着我？你有点吓到我了。

entries.text: Huh? Oh, my name is Khash. I, uh, I have been here for a bit. Who are you?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？哦，我叫卡什。我，呃，我来这里有一段时间了。你是谁？

entries.text: Family doesn't always have to be blood related.
entries.translated_text: 并不总是有血缘关系的人才能组成家庭。

entries.text: Oh. Good. Oh, that's a relief.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好的。哦，真是送了一口气。

entries.text: ...Although, yes, if I'm dead, I suppose I can't see the ruin.
entries.translated_text: ...虽然，好像是这样，如果我死了，我想我就看不到遗址了。

entries.text: You have to believe me! You believe me, right?
entries.translated_text: 你必须相信我！你相信我的，对吧？

entries.text: Bizarre that these draugr walk about. Surely not every crypt has a Dragon Priest keeping them in servitude? What is keeping them from eternal rest?
entries.translated_text: 这些尸鬼走来走去很奇怪。肯定不是每个地穴都有龙祭司奴役他们吗？是什么让他们无法得到永恒的安息？

entries.text: Safe
entries.translated_text: 保险箱

entries.text: Hm... I used to pretend that I lived in the forests in Valenwood. Are they as amazing as the stories say?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我曾经假装自己住在威木省的森林里。那里真的像故事所说的那么神奇吗？

entries.text: Then I have named you Simba. Well, *I* haven't named you that. I-I will call you Simba, which someone else has named you.
entries.translated_text: 那么我给你起名叫辛巴。嗯，不是我给你起的这个名字，我-我会叫你辛巴，这是别人给你起的名字。

entries.text: I know you might be thinking, 'Why keep Remi around if Val is a better thief?' Well, just keep in mind that it can be useful to have two thieves.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你们可能会想，'如果瓦尔的盗贼当得更好，为什么还要留着蕾米呢？'那么，请记住，两个盗贼很有用。

entries.text: I put pieces together, connect wires, and just fiddle around until something works.
entries.translated_text: 我把零件拼装起来，连上线路，然后调试直到东西能用。

entries.text: I put pieces together, connect wires, and just fiddle around until something works.
entries.translated_text: 我把零件拼装起来，连接线路，然后调试直到有东西能用。

entries.text: Oh! Good! I should've known, since you didn't kill me. Well, I'm glad you're alright.
entries.translated_text: 哦！好的！我就该知道，因为你没有杀我，好吧，我很高兴你没事。

entries.text: Look out, Ganbald! Something is trying to kill us!
entries.translated_text: 当心，甘巴尔德！有什么东西想杀死我们！

entries.text: Does that mean you like being green-ish?
entries.translated_text: 这是否说明你喜欢绿色的东西？

entries.text: This is just like every trip back from my college days.
entries.translated_text: 这就像我学院时代的每次旅行一样。

entries.text: It's in my stomach.
entries.translated_text: 在我肚子里。

entries.text: Okay, great, and then just pull this back, I assume?
entries.translated_text: 对，就这样，然后我猜把它拉上？

entries.text: You know, since you don't like to study, you really should avoid skooma. It's likely to rot what little brain you have.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吧，既然你不喜欢学习，那你就真的要少喝斯库玛。这很可能会毁掉你的小脑袋。

entries.text: You know, since you don't like to study, you really should avoid skooma. It's likely to rot what little brain you have.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吧，既然你不喜欢学习，那你就真的要少喝斯库玛。这很可能会毁掉你的小脑袋。

entries.text: Shhh... I got you something. It's a venison chop. Don't tell your master.
entries.translated_text: 嘘……我给你找了点东西。这是鹿排。不要告诉你的主人。

entries.text: Sometimes. Most of the time they are really loud and there are just so many people. I mean, I hate to be lonely, but that many people?
entries.translated_text: 有时候吧。大多数时候他们真的很吵，人太多了。我的意思是，我讨厌孤独，但他们人太多了？

entries.text: Ironic that the dwemer scoffed at aedra and daedra, and yet they used the heart of a god in their own attempt to transcend mortality.
entries.translated_text: 具有讽刺意味的是，锻莫虽然对伊德拉和迪德拉（魔族）嗤之以鼻，但他们却试图用神之心来超越凡人。

entries.text: So tell me, what is it like if your scales get too dry? Correct me if I'm wrong, but your people are made for the water, aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 告诉我，如果你的鳞片太干了会是什么样？如果我错了，请纠正我，但你人天生就是水灵灵的，不是吗？

entries.text: Yes, yes, yes! Quickly, let's go in! I'm beyond ready to explore!
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，是的！快，我们进去吧！我已经准备好去探索了!

entries.text: Verulus was right to close off the Hall. But surely that woman couldn't have been eating all those corpses herself, right?
entries.translated_text: 维鲁鲁斯关闭大厅是对的但那个女人不可能亲自吃掉那些尸体吧？

entries.text: (Laugh) You seem much more excited knowing that I can keep pace.
entries.translated_text: （笑）知道我能跟上，你似乎更兴奋了。

entries.text: If I can do anything, let me know, okay?
entries.translated_text: 如果我能做点什么，请告诉我，好吗？

entries.text: I follow no one's instructions. Save yours on occasion, but that's because you take me on adventures.
entries.translated_text: 我不听从任何人的指示。偶尔会考虑你的，但那是因为你在带我去冒险。

entries.text: (Humming)
entries.translated_text: （哼歌）

entries.text: (Humming)
entries.translated_text: （哼歌）

entries.text: (Humming)
entries.translated_text: （哼歌）

entries.text: Hey, uh, that dog... You hear it... talking, right? Or has my mind finally broken?
entries.translated_text: 嘿，呃，那条狗...你听到它...在说话，对吧？还是我的心智终于崩溃了？

entries.text: (Laugh) Maybe.
entries.translated_text: （笑）也许吧。

entries.text: What is that? Probably blood, knowing our adventures.
entries.translated_text: 那是什么？大概是血吧，鉴于我们的冒险经历。

entries.text: I hope by 'we' you meant 'you'. I don't want to go get it.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你所说的“我们”是指“你”。我不想去拿它。

entries.text: I'm listening.
entries.translated_text: 我在听。

entries.text: Actually I'm pretty new to Skyrim. I mostly grew up in Cyrodiil.
entries.translated_text: 其实我对天际很陌生。我主要是在赛瑞迪尔长大的。

entries.text: The sound my crossbow makes when it fires is just so satisfying.
entries.translated_text: 我的弩发射时的声音非常令人满意。

entries.text: As you may or may not know, I am quite fond of developing my skills. It's especially rewarding when I'm already good at something!
entries.translated_text: 你们可能知道，也可能不知道，我非常喜欢发展自己的技能。尤其是当我已经擅长某件事时，这种感觉尤其令人满足！

entries.text: So we have! Okay, I really want to stay as faithful to this recipe as possible. Surely there's a cooking pot somewhere around here?
entries.translated_text: 所以我们来了！好吧，我真的想尽可能忠实还原这个食谱。这附近肯定有个烹饪锅吧？

entries.text: It- He- The body, that is-
entries.translated_text: 它--他--那句尸体，就是--

entries.text: I wonder if this is what my birth father's ship looked like, after it capsized.
entries.translated_text: 我想知道这是否是我生父的船倾覆后的样子。

entries.text: The only good thing about the snow is eating snowberries.
entries.translated_text: 下雪唯一的乐趣就是吃雪浆果。

entries.text: I could scarcely pay attention to lectures in university, even when I found the topic ceaseless fascinating.
entries.translated_text: 我在大学里几乎无法注意听课，即使我觉得这个话题很吸引我。

entries.text: But Cyrodiil sounds lovely, except for the boring part. Are there many Dwemer ruins there?
entries.translated_text: 但是赛瑞迪尔听起来很可爱，除了那些无聊的部分。那里有很多锻莫遗迹吗？

entries.text: Gallus all alone here... Is this the fate you'll meet after this life, now that you're a Nightingale?
entries.translated_text: 加卢斯孤零零地待在这里...现在你是夜莺了，这就是你今生要面临的命运吗？

entries.text: Travelling by boat sounds familiar, though. But I imagine the boats there are much different from the boats I'm used to.
entries.translated_text: 不过，乘船旅行听起来很熟悉。但我想那里的船和我习惯的船有很大不同。

entries.text: Rumarin confuses me. How can he claim he's not a mage when he's clearly a conjurer?
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林让感到我困惑。明明会魔法，他怎么能声称自己却不是法师？

entries.text: Flin.
entries.translated_text: 飞令。

entries.text: It hasn't escaped my notice that Revyn amended his fencing by asking somone to break into a house. Truly, is there any problem crime can't solve?
entries.translated_text: 我注意到，瑞温靠指使人入室盗窃来拓展销赃渠道？说真的，这世上还有犯罪解决不了的难题吗？

entries.text: You know, your projects really are quite impressive.
entries.translated_text: 您知道，你的项目确实很厉害。

entries.text: 秘藏馆
entries.translated_text: 秘藏馆

entries.text: Somehow, I don't think I agree.
entries.translated_text: 不知为何，我觉得我不同意。

entries.text: Thank you, wanderer.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你，流浪者。

entries.text: Oh, I just noticed your outfit! You look lovely!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我刚注意到你的衣服！你看起来很可爱！

entries.text: Good to see you!
entries.translated_text: 很高兴见到你！

entries.text: For more what?
entries.translated_text: 还要什么？

entries.text: Do you really think they'll notice you that way? Wouldn't it be more effective to go talk with Elisif?
entries.translated_text: 你真的觉得他们会那样注意到你吗？直接去和艾利西弗谈谈不是更有效吗？

entries.text: The- The prank? We just did? I- Oh, never mind. Yes, we're a team!
entries.translated_text: 恶作剧？我们刚刚做的那个？我——哦，算了。不管怎样，是的，我们是一个团队！

entries.text: I just wish so many of them weren't so... hateful.
entries.translated_text: 我只是希望他们中的许多人不要那么...可恨。

entries.text: We could even make a game of it! See who has the stronger grip, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 我们甚至可以把它做成一个游戏！看看谁的握力更强，对吧？

entries.text: I barely remember a thing, honestly.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我几乎都不记得了。

entries.text: Anyway, usually they're after you, right? This is a strange turn of events.
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，以前都是别人追杀你，对吧？现在怎么轮到我了。

entries.text: When I was young, my father used to tell me that the moons were lovers from different villages. Mara saw their love and immortalized them in the sky.
entries.translated_text: 小时候，父亲常告诉我，月亮是来自不同村庄的恋人，玛拉看到了他们的爱情，并在天空中使他们不朽。

entries.text: Mhm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Mhm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Mhm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Mhm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Mhm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Mhm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: Oh, well, I love my home city, Wayrest. But what I loved more were the ruins nearby. I spent a lot of time in them. They're basically my second home.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，我爱我的家乡，途歇城。但我更喜欢的是附近的遗址。我花了很多时间在它们身上。它们基本上是我的第二个家。

entries.text: Whatever it is Sam gave you to drink, I'm so jealous I didn't get to have any.
entries.translated_text: 不管山姆给你喝什么，我都嫉妒没喝到。

entries.text: (Laugh) You caught me! I am sincere, though.
entries.translated_text: （笑）这都你发现了！不过，我是认真的。

entries.text: Yeah. If anyone ever wanted to write about me, I'd hope they'd think about me like that.
entries.translated_text: 是的，如果有人想写我，我希望他们能这样想我。

entries.text: ...Betrothed to a Daedra worshipper...
entries.translated_text: ...与一个魔族信徒订婚...

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: Mudcrab Chitin
entries.translated_text: 泥沼蟹壳

entries.text: So you had to drag me down with you!? How childish can you be?!
entries.translated_text: 所以你就一定要把我拖下水！？你到底有多幼稚？

entries.text: Honestly, no. He tends to say rude things. Just thinking of it now is making me-ugh!
entries.translated_text: 老实说，没有。他总是说粗鲁的话。现在一想到它就让我很难受！

entries.text: What?! Don't be rude! Besides, I also prepared some soup, so it's not like it's only meat!
entries.translated_text: 什么？不要这么无礼！此外，我还准备了一些汤，所以并不仅仅是肉！

entries.text: So... that spider was the only thing protecting Markarth from the falmer.
entries.translated_text: 所以...那只蜘蛛是唯一能从伐莫手中拯救马卡斯城的东西。

entries.text: Oh, Scrap, it's just a little cut. I'd much rather have to repair myself than repair you.
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，只是擦伤。不用太在意。

entries.text: What do you mean by 'doesn't work'?
entries.translated_text: 你是什​​么意思'完全没用'？

entries.text: But... Well, you're smart than you let on. I mean, you know so much about other cultures and religions.
entries.translated_text: 但是……好吧，你比表面上看起来更聪明。我的意思是，你对其他文化和宗教了解得真多。

entries.text: Oh. I... Hm.
Keep breathing, Remi. Imagine the open sky. Don't think about being entombed in this stone for all eternity. Happy thoughts only.
entries.translated_text: 保持呼吸，蕾米。想象一下开阔的天空。不要想着永远被埋在这块石头里，只想快乐的事。

entries.text: Ehh, I'd rather not. Thanks, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我还是算了吧。不管怎样，谢谢你。

entries.text: Yeah, we'll just start with that instead. Stay behind me.
entries.translated_text: 好，我们就从这个开始。待在我身后。

entries.text: You're going to kill the previous champion. So you can become the champion. And you're not concerned about the longevity of your status as champion?
entries.translated_text: 你会杀了之前的勇士。这样你就可以成为勇士。而且你不担心你的勇士的地位是否长久？

entries.text: I don't really think about it much. Just whatever I think is gonna get 'em to drop their guard a little.
entries.translated_text: 我真的没有多想。不管我怎么想都是想让他们放松一点警惕。

entries.text: The theory is that Hroggar set his family alight so that he could... lay with Alva? Would someone do that just to be able to lay with another?
entries.translated_text: 理论上说，赫鲁加放火烧了他的家人，这样他就可以......和阿尔瓦做爱？有人会为了和别人上床而这么做吗？

entries.text: Of course! How could we ever doubt it?
entries.translated_text: 当然！我们怎么可能怀疑他呢？

entries.text: I think the crabs in Morrowind have a sweeter flavour than the ones in Skyrim for some reason.
entries.translated_text: 不知道为什么，我觉得晨风的螃蟹比天际的更甜。

entries.text: I think you may have wasted your money, friend.
entries.translated_text: 你的钱可能都白花了，朋友。

entries.text: Does this mean I have to keep a tighter hold on my coin purse?
entries.translated_text: 这是不是意味着我得好好护着我的钱包？

entries.text: Dwemer metal is impossibly resilient. Just think of how long all of this has existed, untended, and it's still functioning!
entries.translated_text: 锻莫金属的韧性简直不可思议，想想这一切已经存在了多久，无人照管，且还在运作！

entries.text: Gods, that does sound awful. Admittedly, I am sort of biased by all the inane banter they make.
entries.translated_text: 天啊，这听起来真可怕。诚然，我对他们的愚蠢玩笑有点偏见。

entries.text: We live another day! Unless we die in the next fight Ria leads us to.
entries.translated_text: 我们又活了一天！除非我们在利亚带着我们在下一场战斗中死去。

entries.text: Yes, and whatever you don't know, I do.
entries.translated_text: 是啊，不管是不是你知道的事，我都知道。

entries.text: (Squeal) Wow, how did you get them to give you so much?! This is amazing, incredible, fantastic!
entries.translated_text: （尖叫）哇，你是怎么让他们给你这么多的？！这太神奇了，不可思议，太棒了！

entries.text: And they just get so big.
entries.translated_text: 而且他们那么大。

entries.text: Yes, it seems that way if he followed me to Markarth...
entries.translated_text: 是的，如果他跟着我去马卡斯的话，似乎就是这样...

entries.text: Ah, this is good.
entries.translated_text: 啊，太好了。

entries.text: Ooooh! This is- Well, it's not the *best* day of my life; that would be that one time with the dwemer ruin and the moonsugar and the flail-
entries.translated_text: 噢！这是-嗯，这不是我人生中最好的一天；那天应该是一次与锻莫遗址的相遇，有月亮糖和-

entries.text: The worst?! What do you mean? Look at the machines, look at the fine craftsmanship! This place is a goldmine of knowledge!
entries.translated_text: 最差的？！你是什​​么意思？看机器，看工艺！这个地方是知识的金矿！

entries.text: Hmm...?
Hmm...?
Hmm...?
And with that strange trap...
entries.translated_text: 而且这个奇怪的陷阱...

entries.text: I hope you don't mind if I leave it to you to wield.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你不介意让我来掌控它。

entries.text: Yes, they're rather popular, aren't they? I suppose for good reason.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他们相当受欢迎，不是吗？我想这是有原因的。

entries.text: I might've wanted to join them in another life.
entries.translated_text: 我也许也想加入他们过另一种生活。

entries.text: Um. I'll just wait here until you get to the floor below.
entries.translated_text: 呃。我会在这里等你到下面那层。

entries.text: Actually, is it just me, or are the ceilings really low?
entries.translated_text: 实际上，是我太高了，还是天花板真的很低？

entries.text: Let's stop at a smelter later. I need to melt down all this dwarven metal.
entries.translated_text: 让我们稍后在熔炉停一下。我要把这些矮人金属全熔炼了。

entries.text: Food, food, food! It's always food with you, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 食物，食物，食物！总是在说吃的，不是吗？

entries.text: There was a time when a group of kids my age set out on an adventure to "honour their lord." I joined them just to go exploring.
entries.translated_text: 曾经有一群和我同龄的孩子踏上了一场“为了荣耀他们领主”的冒险。我加入他们只是为了去探险而已。

entries.text: Well, if that happens, you could just drink that skooma I saw you with before to forget all your woes.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，要是真那样的话，你大可以喝点我之前看到你带的那瓶斯库玛，好好忘掉所有烦恼。

entries.text: Oh, yes, of course! I'm almost disappointed I didn't think of that first!
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，当然！我很失望，我没有想到这一点！

entries.text: It's nice to meet you.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴认识你。

entries.text: Of course, I feel a bit bad when the people we kill maybe don't deserve it. But it's still... removed.
entries.translated_text: 当然，当我们杀的人可能不该死时，我会觉得有点内疚。但这仍然是...有距离感的。

entries.text: If this moth priest is out and about in Skyrim, that means he's looking for a Scroll, right? Do you think he knows about Serana's somehow?
entries.translated_text: 如果这个先祖蛾祭司在天际四处走动，那意味着他正在寻找卷轴，对吗？你觉得他知道瑟拉娜的事吗？

entries.text: That's right! We can be different together, Khash.
entries.translated_text: 没错！我们可以一起与众不同，卡什。

entries.text: Don't leave me here too long, Ren. You know I'll get bored and do something we both regret.
entries.translated_text: 不要把我留在这里太久，雷，你知道我会感到无聊，做一些我们都后悔的事情。

entries.text: Hmm... I was afraid of that.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...就担心这个。

entries.text: I feel... powerful.
entries.translated_text: 我感受到了...力量。

entries.text: Even if it's nothing compared to High Rock, there's got to be something we can learn here.
entries.translated_text: 即使与高岩相比算不上什么，我们也必须在这里学到一些东西。

entries.text: Even if it's nothing compared to High Rock, there's got to be something we can learn here.
entries.translated_text: 即使和高岩相比算不了什么，这里也一定还有我们可以学到的东西。

entries.text: (Muttering) I imagine repurposing a dwemer sphere to my intentions would be inconvenient... Not a big enough backpack...
entries.translated_text: （喃喃自语）我没有足够大的背包...这样我怎么装下这些锻莫球呢...

entries.text: I got out. That's all that matters.
entries.translated_text: 我逃出来了这才是最重要的。

entries.text: Me! Yay!
entries.translated_text: 是我！耶！

entries.text: I love you, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我爱你，蕾米。

entries.text: Ugh, it smells like rotting meat here. Oh! Just like Markarth! Strangely comforting now that I think of it like that.
entries.translated_text: 这里闻起来像腐肉一样。噢！就像马卡斯一样！现在想起来，还真有种奇怪的舒适感。1

entries.text: Ugh... You're a cheap date. 200 septims...
entries.translated_text: 呃...你的开价真低，只要200金币...

entries.text: Great! And when do we get to blow stuff up?
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！我们什么时候才能把这些东西弄炸？

entries.text: Nordic ruins give me the creeps... Don't you just love that feeling?
entries.translated_text: 诺德遗址让我毛骨悚然...你不就是喜欢那种感觉吗？

entries.text: And how is that, exactly? I mean, how would I tell if it- I mean, he, liked it?
entries.translated_text: 这到底是怎么回事？我是说，我怎么知道他喜不喜欢？

entries.text: You are not well versed in destruction magic. It would be like me having an opinion on tails.
entries.translated_text: 你不了解毁灭系魔法。就像我对尾巴有看法一样：你不了解毁灭系，而我也没有尾巴。

entries.text: Here it is... I... I can berely believe we're here...
entries.translated_text: 在这里...我...我可以相信我们在这里...

entries.text: Remi's cute, like a little sister or something. Don't let her get hurt. Not certain she could take a blow from a dragon.Thought's kinda funny though.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米很可爱，像个小妹妹。不要让她受到伤害。我不确定她能否接得住龙哪怕一招。不过这个想法有点好笑。

entries.text: In High Rock, adhering to society and moving up the ranks they've devised is very important. Really, though, status and ettiquette are idiotic.
entries.translated_text: 在高岩，坚持维护并提升社会地位是非常重要的事。但事实上，地位和礼仪蠢到家了。

entries.text: Oh, now this is interesting! The dwemer clearly farmed here. I wonder if the mushrooms were the original crop?
entries.translated_text: 哦，现在这很有趣！锻莫显然是在这里养殖的。我想知道蘑菇是不是原来的作物？

entries.text: J'zargo, your thirst for knowledge is so relatable to me.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格，你对知识的渴望让我感到非常认同。

entries.text: My advice is to spend part of it on something that'll leave you with good memories, then save the rest for a rainy day.
entries.translated_text: 我的建议是，把一部分钱花在能给你留下美好回忆的地方，然后把剩下的钱留着以备不时之需。

entries.text: At least, it's supposed to? Is it broken?
entries.translated_text: 至少，它应该是这样？是坏了吗？

entries.text: Scrap's Extra Damage 1.5
entries.translated_text: Scrap's Extra Damage 1.5

entries.text: Lightning bolt that does <mag> points of shock damage to Health and half to Magicka, then leaps to a new target.
entries.translated_text: 发出闪电箭造成目标<mag>点伤害以及一半的法力减损，之后跳射到下一个目标。

entries.text: I wonder if I should try making Auri some arrows from metal, in case she runs out of bone arrows.
entries.translated_text: 我想我是否应该为奥璃准备一些金属箭以备骨箭用光。

entries.text: Here's the cooking pot.
entries.translated_text: 这有个烹饪锅。

entries.text: Here's the cooking pot.
entries.translated_text: 这有个烹饪锅。

entries.text: Who in Oblivion are you? What 'r you doin'?
entries.translated_text: 你到底在干嘛？你在做什么？

entries.text: Yes, I imagine Daedra do have a strange idea of good or bad. Well, so do a lot of mortals, I suppose. It's all subjective anyway.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想魔族确实对好或坏有一些奇怪的想法。嗯，我想很多凡人也是如此。无论如何，这都是主观评价。

entries.text: Back home, the upper class like to make themselves seem pure by claiming to have no elven ancestry. Nords' distrust of Mer reminds me of that.
entries.translated_text: 诺德人对莫（精灵）们并不信任，让我想起在我家乡，上层阶级喜欢通过声称自己没有精灵血统来让自己看起来很纯净。

entries.text: Don't talk such rot.
entries.translated_text: 别胡说。

entries.text: I'm always happy to talk with my best friend.
entries.translated_text: 我总是很高兴和我最好的朋友聊天。

entries.text: Your father sounds great.
entries.translated_text: 你父亲听起来很棒。

entries.text: I-I didn't notice... I don't think I'm going to be able to get you through...
entries.translated_text: 我没注意到...我觉得我没法帮你过来了...

entries.text: Doesn't it get old?
entries.translated_text: 难道不会腻吗？

entries.text: Don't touch... my automaton...
entries.translated_text: 别碰...我的机器人...

entries.text: Ma, you're different, aren't you? Not like anyone else.
entries.translated_text: 妈妈，你不一样，不是吗？不像其他人。

entries.text: I don't really understand it, honestly?
entries.translated_text: 我真的不明白，说实话？

entries.text: But friends make secrets! Er, we are friends, right?
entries.translated_text: 但朋友会制造秘密！呃，我们是朋友，对吧？

entries.text: Hm. That sounds like a great idea! Thanks!
entries.translated_text: 嗯。听起来是个好主意！谢谢！

entries.text: I used to play-pretend that I lived in Valenwood.
entries.translated_text: 我过去常常假装我住在威木省。

entries.text: I'm not about to die when I haven't even finished looking through this place!
entries.translated_text: 我还没看完这个地方，我不会死在这个地方的！

entries.text: What's that?
entries.translated_text: 什么事？

entries.text: What's that?
entries.translated_text: 什么事？

entries.text: (Gasp) Oh! Oh, Sweet Dibella, look at you! You beautiful speciman! I could dissect you all day! Not that I will, seeing as you're our friend now.
entries.translated_text: （喘气）哦！哦，亲爱的蒂贝拉，看看你！你这完美的生物！我真想一整天都解剖你！不过当然不会这样做，毕竟你现在是我们的朋友了。

entries.text: So, have you been playing with that boy...?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你和那个男孩玩过吗...？

entries.text: Doctor. I feel I've heard that term before. Oh! I think they called healers 'doctors' in a book I read once. Seems a good name, in that case.
entries.translated_text: 医生，我觉得我以前听说过这个词。哦！我想他们在我读过一本书的一本书中称治疗师为“医生”。这样的话，这似乎是个好名字。

entries.text: Oh Sinding... to have to live with what he's done for the rest of his life... I don't know that I'd have the strength.
entries.translated_text: 哦，辛丁...不得不忍受他在余生中所做的一切...我不知道我是否还有力量。

entries.text: She wants the corundum ore. Not sure why you can't see where she's pointing. Your mother drop you on your head, or what?
entries.translated_text: 她想要刚玉矿。不知道为什么你不知道她在指什么。是因为妈妈把你头摔地上了，还是别的什么？

entries.text: (Whisper) Moving on, then.
entries.translated_text: （低语）继续移动。

entries.text: Magic in High Rock is much more accepted. Actually it's more than accepted.
entries.translated_text: 在高岩，人们更容易接受魔法。实际上，他们不仅仅只是接受。

entries.text: When I lived with the traveling artists, I once played an Argonian with surprising accuracy.
entries.translated_text: 当我和旅行艺术家们住在一起时，我曾经把一个亚龙人演的唯妙唯肖。

entries.text: We're actually standing in Blackreach... Incredible... A dwemer super highway, connecting all the major cities in the area...
entries.translated_text: 我们实际上站在黑境...难以置信...一条锻莫地下公路，连接该地区的所有主要城市...

entries.text: Well, is there anything here that catches your eye?
entries.translated_text: 那么，这里有什么你喜欢的东西吗？

entries.text: Actually, yes! I worked pretty hard on it. It tastes good! Just ignore the bites taken from it.
entries.translated_text: 其实有的！我做了很久，挺用心的，味道不错！只不过，忽略掉那些被咬过的地方吧。

entries.text: Have we met? I'm sorry if I've forgotten.
entries.translated_text: 我们见过面吗？如果我忘了，我很抱歉。

entries.text: Riften smells weird. There's the smell from the market, the sweetness from the meadery, but also the stench of sewage water and unwashed beggars.
entries.translated_text: 裂谷城闻起来很奇怪。有来自市场的气味，有来自农场的甜味，还有来自污水和乞丐不洗澡的恶臭。

entries.text: Some think that it is Oblivion, spilling over into Nirn.
entries.translated_text: 有人认为它从湮灭流出，蔓延到了奈恩。

entries.text: And now he knew that she had never meant to leave him. She'd met a terrible fate, the proof her body hidden haphazardly in a shallow grave.
entries.translated_text: 而现在他知道，她从未想过要离开他。她遭遇了可怕的命运，这浅墓中的尸体就是最好的证明。

entries.text: First thing's first: tell me what you're good at!
entries.translated_text: 首先，告诉我你擅长什么！

entries.text: That's one more resonance gem. Another step closer to destroying an army of automaton for sport.
entries.translated_text: 那是另一个共鸣宝石。距离摧毁一支运动的自动机器大军又近了一步。

entries.text: Oh! Okay, well...
entries.translated_text: 哦！好吧，好吧...

entries.text: Then the pie itself has potatoes, carrots, and apples.
entries.translated_text: 然后馅饼本身需要土豆、胡萝卜和苹果。

entries.text: I don't mean to pry, but I cannot just *not* ask... What- What, er, happened, with that abandoned house and that trap?
entries.translated_text: 不是我好奇，但我必须得问...那个废弃的房子和陷阱是怎么回事？

entries.text: Well, nothing that some studying and experimenting can't uncover for us.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，没有什么是一些研究和实验无法为我们发现的。

entries.text: Of course I won't get killed. I have Scrap and our friend with me.
entries.translated_text: 我当然不会被杀，小渣和我们的朋友都在我身边。

entries.text: I can understand that.
entries.translated_text: 我可以理解。

entries.text: I wonder what could be hidden in Dimhollow Crypt? Maybe an everlasting blood spring?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道幽窟地穴中可能隐藏着什么？也许是永恒血泉？

entries.text: Well, the old Nord ruins are like a swamp of traps and stone.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，古代诺德的遗址就像一个陷阱和石头的沼泽。

entries.text: Tell me if you see any bats! I want to catch one!
entries.translated_text: 如果你看到了蝙蝠，请告诉我！我想抓一只！

entries.text: Oh, I'm so sorry.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我很抱歉。

entries.text: You bring out all the best qualities of Nordic culture.
entries.translated_text: 你有诺德文化的所有最佳品质。

entries.text: I'm alright.
entries.translated_text: 我没事。

entries.text: I'm alright.
entries.translated_text: 我没事。

entries.text: O-oh! Uh. It- It, um. It is. Illegal, that is.
entries.translated_text: 哦哦！呃。它——它，嗯。是的。这是非法的。

entries.text: No... Wait, do the Dibellan arts count as forbidden knowledge?
entries.translated_text: 不...等等，蒂贝拉艺术算不算禁忌知识？

entries.text: I think I'd have spent my life in Arkngchal, had I been a Dwemer. And born a bit earlier. A lot earlier.
entries.translated_text: 如果我是锻莫，我想我会在阿卡切尔度过我的一生。而且我也出生会的早一点。早很多。

entries.text: What else am I going to do with it?
entries.translated_text: 我还能用它做什么？

entries.text: Elsweyr was my home.
entries.translated_text: 我的家在艾斯维尔。

entries.text: He is.
entries.translated_text: 他的确。

entries.text: There's a dwemer ruin nearby, near the border to Hammerfell. I... might have spent some time there first thing after arriving in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 靠近落锤省份的边界附近，有一个锻莫遗址。我在那里呆过一段时间....这可能是我来天际做的第一件事。

entries.text: The Nightmother has given you a new target, I assume?
entries.translated_text: 夜母给了你一个新的目标，我猜？

entries.text: I find that I often blurt things out when I perhaps shouldn't, such as that Lisbet seems to always have an odor reminiscent of roadkill.
entries.translated_text: 我发现我经常在不该说话的时候说话，比如利斯拜特似乎让人觉得他是拦路贼。

entries.text: Alright, let's get going.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我们开始吧。

entries.text: Do you... think it will wear off? It'd be awfully cumbersome if he was invisible from now on.
entries.translated_text: 你...你觉得它会坏掉吗？如果现在我失去了它，那就麻烦大了。

entries.text: It was fine.
entries.translated_text: 这很好。

entries.text: But Molag Bal, he let you out of that little trap he'd set. Why?!
entries.translated_text: 但如果是莫拉格·巴尔那就不一样了，他让你逃出了他设下的小陷阱，为什么？

entries.text: (Whisper) Sorry, I can't get this one.
entries.translated_text: （低语）对不起，我做不到这个。

entries.text: They really are like walking stink bombs intent on murdering us. I have to suppress the urge to just vomit when I see them.
entries.translated_text: 他们真就是打算杀死我们的移动臭气弹。当我看到他们时，必须得压制住直接呕吐的冲动。

entries.text: Essentially, I want to create a device to align with specific tones of the songs of automaton.
entries.translated_text: 本质上，我想创造一个设备来与自动机器所属歌声的特定音调对齐。

entries.text: Anyway thank you. Most pirates can barely read. Officers need to be able to understand charts and navigate, but even still I'm considered eccentric.
entries.translated_text: 总之谢谢你。大多数海盗几乎不识字。即便头头们需要能看懂海图和导航，但即便如此，我还是被认为是个怪人。

entries.text: Some of the dwemer spiders in here shoot electricity. Interesting...
entries.translated_text: 这里的一些锻莫蜘蛛会释放电流，有趣...

entries.text: Heat this until it's flexible...
entries.translated_text: 加热到它有弹性...

entries.text: Sometimes I miss her, but I think even having the time we did was... It was good.
entries.translated_text: 有时我很想念她，但我认为即使有我们的时光也是...很好的。

texts: Some of the Jarl's men came by... As if business wasn't slow enough. Idiots! Sure, take all my things!
一些领主的手下走过来……好像生意还不够慢似的。白痴！当然，拿走我所有的东西！

entries.text: Implying there is no pattern of tones related to this machine.
entries.translated_text: 这意味着与这台机器相关的音调并没有特定的模式。

entries.text: Right, right, sorry.
entries.translated_text: 对对对，对不起。

entries.text: Ghost regicide! First you participate in Imperial regicide, then in Ghost regicide!
entries.translated_text: 弑幽灵君王！首先你弑了帝国皇帝，又弑了幽灵君王！

entries.text: There's something so peaceful about cemeteries.
entries.translated_text: 墓地有一种宁静的感觉。

entries.text: Isn't there any College business we need to take care of?
entries.translated_text: 没有我们需要处理的学院事务吗？

entries.text: Remi wants to try her hand at creating a crossbow. She's asked me to help her gather the necessary materials. We will need Dwemer Cogs, Dwemer Gears, a Dwemer Lever, fire wood, and dwarven metal ingots.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米想尝试制作一把弩。她让我帮她收集必要的材料。我们需要锻莫齿轮、锻莫圆轮、锻莫杠杆、木柴和矮人金属锭。

entries.text: Oh, it wasn't too bad. I know a guy. You're welcome, by the way. I figured it was a little hard to come by in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 哦，还不错。我认识一个人。顺便说一句，不客气。我觉得在天际里这有点难找。

entries.text: He was a bandit.
entries.translated_text: 他是个强盗。

entries.text: Hopefully I can latch back onto my train of thought from before.
entries.translated_text: 希望我能重新找回之前的思路。

entries.text: You don't need to worry about me getting you in trouble.
entries.translated_text: 你不用担心我给你找麻烦。

texts: 那你呢？你的父母是怎么样的人？
那你呢？你的父母是怎么样的人？

entries.text: I guess you're right. It doesn't feel right, but...
entries.translated_text: 我想你是对的，我感觉不对，但是...

entries.text: Yes. It is exactly like 'I Spy.'
entries.translated_text: 是的。这和《我是间谍》一模一样。

entries.text: Exploring the college grounds, for example?
entries.translated_text: 例如，探索学院城堡？

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. Morvic decided to take matters into his own hands, traveling to Skyrim to hunt down Remiel. Despite his plotting, we managed to kill him. Remi wanted to stay in Arkngchal, saying she had "design plans" for the ruin. I should return to her to see what she's done.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。莫维克决定自己动手，前往天际追捕蕾米尔。尽管有他的阴谋，我们还是设法杀死了他。蕾米想留在阿卡切尔，说她对遗址有“设计计划”。我应该回到她身边，看看她做了什么。

entries.text: How do you feel about being pink-ish?
entries.translated_text: 你喜欢粉红色吗？

entries.text: I'm not certain how many scholars you're accustomed to dealing with, but I can assure you that personal wealth is our lowest priority.
entries.translated_text: 我不清楚你跟多少学者打过交道，但我能向你保证我们并不看重个人财富。

entries.text: Not to mention how much I could brag about it...
entries.translated_text: 更不用说我能吹多少牛了...

entries.text: I'm pretty sure I've told you I'm not so great with magic. Haven't I?
entries.translated_text: 我很确定我已经告诉过你我不擅长魔法，不是吗？

entries.text: I always wondered what the dwarves actually looked like. I hear they're like elves, but with beards.
entries.translated_text: 我真想知道矮人到底长什么样子。听说他们像精灵，但是有胡子。

entries.text: Are you from Skyrim? Or somewhere else?
entries.translated_text: 你来自天际吗？或者别的地方？

entries.text: Sisters. You know, I like the sound of that!
entries.translated_text: 姐妹。你知道，我喜欢这说法！

entries.text: I was surprised to learn that Rumarin is a rather excellent cook! With both him and Xel with us, I'll never go hungry again!
entries.translated_text: 我很惊讶鲁马林是一位相当出色的厨师！有了他和赛尔，我再也不会饿了！

entries.text: Worship is believing in and reveling in a Divine's power.
entries.translated_text: 信仰是沉醉于圣灵的力量。

entries.text: What did he have to say anyway?
entries.translated_text: 他到底要说什么？

entries.text: Has being in your workshop inspired any new project ideas?
entries.translated_text: 你在工作室里有新灵感吗？

entries.text: Do you not think your soul will live on?
entries.translated_text: 你不认为你的灵魂会继续存在吗？

entries.text: I used to hate big crowds, but then I realized the more people, the more likely they'd find someone else to stare at.
entries.translated_text: 我以前讨厌人山人海，但后来我意识到，人越多，他们就越不会只在一个人身上花费太多时间。

entries.text: Come, break upon me. Not them.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，冲我来。

entries.text: I'm here.
entries.translated_text: 我在这。

entries.text: You better look out for my dwemer spider! ...Is what I would say if he was allowed to fight with us.
entries.translated_text: 你最好小心我的锻莫蜘蛛...如果他能与我们一起战斗，我就会这么说。

entries.text: I'm afraid not. Lurbuk graduated before I joined. A shame, really- I feel like I'd have learned a lot from him.
entries.translated_text: 恐怕不行。卢布克在我加入之前就毕业了。很遗憾，真的--我觉得我可以从他那里学到很多东西。

entries.text: I just said I thought the Skyrim musical canon was too limited; I don't know why anyone would get offended over that!
entries.translated_text: 我只是说我认为天际的音乐作品太少了；我不知道为什么有人会因此不高兴！

entries.text: Talking to the shopkeeper makes me a little nervous. Will you ask them for new boots for me? Mine are wearing thin.
entries.translated_text: 和店主说话让我有点紧张，你会向他们给我要双靴子吗？我的穿得很薄。

entries.text: You know, Gore, I've imagined most Nords as quite dumb. I'll be honest, between the bear trap to the leg and the illiteracy, I thought that of you.
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，格雷, 我即使认为大多数诺德人都很愚蠢。老实说，诺德人中有谁能蠢到踩中捕熊陷阱的同时还是一名文盲的话，那就只有你了。

entries.text: Oh, I could see a dwemer trap from a mile away. Most likely.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我一里外就能看出那是个锻莫陷阱，大概吧。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. However, it seems Morvic has decided to take matters into his own hands, as rumour has it he has been spotted in Markarth. By the time we arrived in Markarth, Morvic had moved on, but Remiel insisted we search Arkngchal. Now that we are here, we should be cautious as we look around.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。然而，莫维克似乎决定自己动手，因为有传言说他在马卡斯被发现了。当我们到达马卡斯时，莫维克已经继续前进，但蕾米尔坚持要我们搜索阿卡切尔。既然我们在这里，我们在环顾四周时应该小心。

entries.text: Yes, it sounds a bit... romantic, doesn't it?
entries.translated_text: 是的，这听起来有点...浪漫，不是吗？

entries.text: Some Jagga Tartes would be tasty.
entries.translated_text: 一些贾嘎点心会很美味。

entries.text: And here I was beginning to think you never slept.
entries.translated_text: 在这里，我甚至开始认为你从未睡过觉。

entries.text: Mm. Same here. Not a lot of people know about Daedra worship. It's not exactly encouraged. That's the point.
entries.translated_text: 恩。我那也一样。没有多少人知道魔族信仰。重点是，并不被允许。

entries.text: (Gasp) When- When we're done fighting, Joshua, I had an idea for- Never mind!
entries.translated_text: （倒抽一口气）当——当我们打完架后，约书亚，我有个主意——没关系！

entries.text: I bought you a drink, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我给你买了一杯，蕾米。

entries.text: Oh yes, I already do this one. I call it a 'tactical retreat'. Sometimes I retreat before the battle even starts, though.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，我已经在这样做了。我称之为“战术撤退”。不过，有时我会在战斗开始前撤退。

entries.text: As it stands, I think we're usually underwhelmed in these things.
entries.translated_text: 目前来看，我认为我们通常对这些事情没什么兴趣。

entries.text: I'm sure once he hears I met someone like you, he'll be relieved.
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定，一旦他听说我遇到了像你这样的人，他会松口气的。

entries.text: I need you to do something for me.
entries.translated_text: 我需要你为我做件事情。

entries.text: Do you ever get distracted from a thought by accidentally thinking of another thought?
entries.translated_text: 你是否曾经因不小心想到另一个想法而分心？

entries.text: Be wary.
entries.translated_text: 小心谨慎。

entries.text: Well. First of all, the author seems to have something against Bretons, which is rather rude.
entries.translated_text: 好。首先，这作者似乎有点不喜欢布莱顿人，这是相当粗鲁。

entries.text: Well, she might be.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，她可能在。

entries.text: Well, she might be.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，她可能在。

entries.text: I have to admit, this 'crimson nirnroot' is a bit of a spectacle. I wonder what about Blackreach allows for its growth?
entries.translated_text: 我不得不承认，这个“深红奈恩根”有点厉害。我想知道是什么让它能在黑境生长？

entries.text: Can you imagine if I got a signed copy of a book and then someone came to kill me for it? Tragic.
entries.translated_text: 能想象如果我得到一本签名书，然后有人为了那本书来杀我吗？真是悲剧。

entries.text: Yeah, I can't do that.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我不能那样做。

entries.text: This fellow better actually have useful information. If he's having us search after this skooma while he really knows nothing, I'll... I'll...
entries.translated_text: 这个家伙最好真的有有用的信息。如果他让我们在这间屋子里瞎找，而他真的什么都不知道，我就...我...

entries.text: It's like I'm being ambushed by scholars every waking moment. What is it now?!
entries.translated_text: 就好像我每时每刻都在被学者们埋伏。现在是什么情况？！

entries.text: P-piles of machinery??? Scrap is *not* a slave! He's my... friend.
entries.translated_text: 一...堆机器？小渣*不是*奴隶他是我的......朋友。

entries.text: After all, the Dwemer also held great power, much beyond our understanding, and I certainly 'revel' in their power.
entries.translated_text: 毕竟，锻莫也拥有巨大的力量，远远超出我们的理解范围，我当然也'沉醉'于他们的力量。

entries.text: Oh, what a lovely idea! Perhaps I could find a way to have Scrap play music. A portable little music bot.
entries.translated_text: 哦，多好的主意啊!也许我可以找到一种方法，让小渣播放音乐。一个便携式的小音乐机器人。

entries.text: So they turned to... more underground trading. It's mostly stolen items and illicit merchandise. Nothing too extravagant.
entries.translated_text: 所以他们转向...更深的地下交易。主要是被盗物品和非法商品，也不是什么大生意。

entries.text: Less talk, more hunt.
entries.translated_text: 少说话，多搜索。

entries.text: He's really not, I promise. He'll protect you, too. Just try to trust him?
entries.translated_text: 他真的不危险，我保证。他也会保护你。试着相信他好吗？

entries.text: Tell Remi what order to pull the levers.
entries.translated_text: 告诉蕾米拉动杠杆的顺序。

entries.text: That's right. Let's not let any of these eyeless freaks smell tomorrow.
entries.translated_text: 这就对了。让我们不要让这些没有眼睛的怪胎闻到明天的味道。

entries.text: Anything you want to get rid of, just give it to Remi. I'll see to it that you get a share of the profits.
entries.translated_text: 任何你想处理掉的东西都给蕾米吧，我保证你也能分一杯羹。

entries.text: Poor Tilma, cleaning up after these Companions all the time. Seems like a lot of work for a little old lady.
entries.translated_text: 可怜的提尔玛，一直在打扫着战友团。对于一个小老太太来说，似乎有很多工作。

entries.text: We figured out in what order to pull the levers in Arkngchal and are now able to explore further. Remi seems to think that the ruin isn't adequately powered and asked me to find a machine that acts as a heat source, and then something that will give it the kinetic jumpstart it needs to get going.
entries.translated_text: 我们搞清楚了阿卡切尔的杠杆顺序，现在可以进一步探索了。蕾米似乎认为这个遗址没有足够的动力，并要求我找到一台作为热源的机器，然后找一些能给它带来动能的东西来启动它。

entries.text: While I enjoy some alone time, I find that I begin to get antsy if I haven't spoken to anyone in awhile. It's good to have you around to talk with.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我很享受独处的时光，但我发现我如果有一段时间没有和人说话，就会开始焦躁不安。有你在身边聊天真好。

entries.text: You know, Nar, I am looking forward to our next Dwemer ruin. We're going to another one. Right?
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，纳尔，我很期待我们的下一个锻莫遗址。我们又要去一个了，是吗？

entries.text: There are no good options here.
entries.translated_text: 这里没有好的选择。

entries.text: So we're off, then, Doctor? Lead the way.
entries.translated_text: 那么，我们出发了，医生？带路。

entries.text: Oh, of course I do. The men in the camps were practically tearing each other to pieces to see who would get the opportunity to teach me first.
entries.translated_text: 哦，当然。营地里的人几乎每天都在厮杀，我不知道有谁会教我。

entries.text: Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 小渣?

entries.text: It's a shame we have to return the Lexicon. Perhaps From-Deepest-Fathoms couldn't handle the knowledge, but us on the other hand...
entries.translated_text: 真遗憾，我们得把方典还回去。也许源于深寻也无法理解这些知识，但另一方面，我们...

entries.text: Oh no. I want a lot of space between us and him. I know it sounds immature, but if I see a button, I have to press it.
entries.translated_text: 哦不，我觉得我们应该保持距离，如果我在他身上看到有什么按钮的话我会忍不住按下去。

entries.text: Mercenary's Notebook
entries.translated_text: 佣兵的笔记本

entries.text: Here I thought 'adventurer' was suitable. But you'd rather be called something else?
entries.translated_text: 我觉得叫你“冒险者”很好，但你更想被叫别的？

entries.text: Not to mention, if any of them told me to do something, my innate instinct would kick in to tell them where they can stick it.
entries.translated_text: 更不用说，如果他们中的任何一个人让我做某件事，我与生俱来的本能会告诉他们，他们哪凉快哪待去。

entries.text: But you know a lot more about me than I know about you... so. Tell me, what are you doing here?
entries.translated_text: 但你对我的了解比我对你的了解多得多……所以。告诉我，你在这里做什么？

entries.text: I bet this area has an abundance of ghost stories.
entries.translated_text: 我敢打赌这个地区有很多鬼故事。

entries.text: ;Has heard Remi's TragicTM backstory
entries.translated_text: ;HasheardRemi'sTragicTMbackstory

entries.text: As if that matters!
entries.translated_text: 好像这很重要！

texts: Gold solves most problems, doesn't it?

entries.text: You sent assassins after me! This is *your* doing!
entries.translated_text: 你派刺客来追杀我！这都是你的阴谋！

entries.text: I worship a Daedra.
entries.translated_text: 我信仰着一个魔神。

entries.text: Can I help you with something?
entries.translated_text: 我能帮上忙吗？

entries.text: Well, I was hoping you'd say that! There should be enough for everyone.
entries.translated_text: 我就希望你这么说，应该够每个人吃的了。

entries.text: By Sheor! Where did that horse just come from? Why does it look so evil? Actually, silly question. This is the Dark Brotherhood, after all.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上！那匹马是从哪里来的？为什么看起来那么邪恶？实际上，真是愚蠢的问题。毕竟这是黑暗兄弟会。

entries.text: Don't worry, you still have a job. For now.
entries.translated_text: 别担心，你现在还有事能做。就目前而言。

entries.text: Rivenspire.
entries.translated_text: 碎裂山峰。

entries.text: Find eight dwemer gears. (<Global=HLIORPCGearsCount>/<Global=HLIORPCGearsTotal>)
entries.translated_text: 找到八个锻莫圆轮。（<Global=HLIORPCGearsCount>/<Global=HLIORPCGearsTotal>）

entries.text: Do. Not. Hit. Ilia!
entries.translated_text: 不要。伊利亚！

entries.text: You have to help me. Do you know how to bake? Can you make things with moon sugar without explosions? I can't let Val find out I don't know how!
entries.translated_text: 你得帮我。你会烘焙吗？你会用月亮糖做不会爆炸的东西吗？我不能让瓦尔发现我不会！

entries.text: Wonderful! I'm glad it's going to get some use!
entries.translated_text: 太好了！我很高兴它会派上用场！

entries.text: This is astounding. I'd heard of the Dwemer architecture, but it puts the old Ayleid ruins I grew up around to shame...
entries.translated_text: 这太惊人了。我早听说过锻莫建筑，但它我从小长大的古亚历德遗址与之相比简直相形见绌...

entries.text: Thank the Divines for that. Or you'd be unlovable.
entries.translated_text: 为此感谢各位圣灵。否则你不会讨人喜欢的。

entries.text: Know that you *could* be in a Dwemer ruin, somewhere out there, but you couldn't right then in that moment?
entries.translated_text: 要知道，就在那时那刻，你本可以在某个锻莫遗迹里，但你却无法去那儿。

entries.text: I would never do something like that.
entries.translated_text: 我永远不会做那样的事情。

texts: O-ouch! M-my bag is stuck- just a moment. Come on through, bag, you do not want to be there when the rubble settles.
哎哟！我-我的背包卡住了​​-等一下。来吧，背包，当碎石落下时，你不想待在那里。

entries.text: O-ouch! M-my bag is stuck- just a moment. Come on through, bag, you do not want to be there when the rubble settles.
entries.translated_text: 哎哟！我-我的背包卡住了​​-等一下，来吧，背包，当碎石落下时，你会不想待在那里的。

entries.text: You did better!
entries.translated_text: 你更厉害些！

entries.text: How about drink? I think you'll find it quite pleasing to your palate.
entries.translated_text: 这酒怎样？我想你会喜欢它。

entries.text: I'm glad to have met you. I'm usually not great at meeting new people, so I feel very lucky to be by your side.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴认识你。我通常不擅长结识新朋友，所以我很幸运能在你身边。

entries.text: (Whisper) Perfect!
entries.translated_text: （低语）完美！

entries.text: Oh, yes, a mistake I've made many times. You have to ensure that you've connected it just so, distributing energy use more evenly.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，这是我犯过很多次的错误。你必须确保连接得恰到好处，这样才能更均匀地分配能源。

entries.text: Hm? Oh, that thing? Yes, I am loathe to give up useful artefacts, but I unfortunately need gold for things I can't hide in a bag.
entries.translated_text: 嗯？哦，那东西？是的，我不愿意放弃有用的工艺品，但很遗憾，我需要金币来购买那些我无法藏在包里的东西。

entries.text: Ah.
entries.translated_text: Ah.

entries.text: Well, aren't you a strange one.
entries.translated_text: 你真是个怪人。

entries.text: No, no, no! That stuff is itchy! I don't like how it feels on my skin!
entries.translated_text: 不，不，不！那东西很痒！我不喜欢它在我皮肤上的感觉！
