entries.text: Yes, you can't always judge someone based on their exterior. It's what's interior that counts.
entries.translated_text: 是的，你不能总是根据一个人的外表来判断他。内在才是最重要的。

entries.text: Oh, the Skaal village is... ah... cute!
entries.translated_text: 哦，斯卡尔村...啊...好可爱！

entries.text: Yes, Remi. Will you marry me?
entries.translated_text: 是的，蕾米。你愿意嫁给我吗？

entries.text: Thank you, Gore.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你，格雷。

entries.text: (Laugh) Oh, that's a bit funny. Do you really think I have time to attend sermons?
entries.translated_text: （笑） 哦，这有点好笑。你真的认为我有时间去参加布道吗？

entries.text: I could just tell that he was someone of class. Look, he's reading through the flyer right now!
entries.translated_text: 我可以看出，他是一个有品位的人。看，他现在正在翻阅传单!

entries.text: Hmm? Oh yeah, that happens sometimes. All the gears, you know?
entries.translated_text: 唔？哦，是的，有时会发生这种情况。那些圆轮，你知道吗？

entries.text: What's your mother like?
entries.translated_text: 你妈妈是怎样的人？

entries.text: I-I-I... Oh, that's so kind! I still feel like I'm missing something, but I'll very graciously take the compliment and move on.
entries.translated_text: 我、我、我……哦，你真好！我虽然觉得我错过了什么，但我还是会欣然接受赞美继续做自己。

entries.text: I like to think being a bard is broader than just being a musician.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢认为作为一个吟游诗人比作为一个音乐家更自由。

entries.text: Aw, Scrap, that's so sweet. What do you mean, 'Don't tell Val'? He'd love you to tell him that!
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，真漂亮。什么叫 "别告诉瓦尔"？他会喜欢你告诉他的！

entries.text: Of course not. You do, however, *need* a distraction. You also need the right situation.
entries.translated_text: 当然不是。然而，你确实*需要*分散注意力。你还需要对的情况。

entries.text: But the Forsworn have always been dangerous to me! When arriving in Skyrim, I stayed in a ruin near the border.
entries.translated_text: 但对我来说，弃誓者一直都很危险！刚到天际的时候，我住在边境附近的一个遗址里。

entries.text: Oh, I know! Why don't you introduce yourself to him? You could talk with us and get to know him!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我懂了了！你为什么不向他自我介绍一下？你可以和他谈谈，去了解下他！

entries.text: Another 'engaging' conversation over at last.
entries.translated_text: 又一次“引人入胜”的谈话终于结束了。

entries.text: Oh, yes, the dwemer were very fond of traps. The automaton will be a bit of an obstacle, too.
entries.translated_text: 哦，对了，锻莫非常喜欢陷阱。机器人也会成为一个障碍。

entries.text: We'll send you back to Oblivion!
entries.translated_text: 我们将把你送回湮灭!

entries.text: These are all things that life isolated from society would be missing. So, I've had to find my own ways to undermine the restraints of society.
entries.translated_text: 这些都是与社会隔离的生活会缺少的东西。因此，我不得不找到自己的方式来破坏社会的约束。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel Excavation Site
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔挖掘场

entries.text: Why did you call him Numi?
entries.translated_text: 为什么叫他纳米？

entries.text: Okay, then I'm off!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那我去了！

entries.text: Mmmmm... Juniper berries taste so good.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...刺柏的味道好极了。

entries.text: J'zargo is ready for more adventure.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格已经准备好踏上冒险旅程了。

entries.text: Well, I for one think it's for the best that they don't raise their kids. It seems like it'd be bad for their upbringing.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我个人认为他们最好不要抚养孩子。这似乎对他们的职业生涯不利。

entries.text: One of my favourite meals is mudcrab cakes with marshmerrow.
entries.translated_text: 我最喜欢的美食之一是泥沼蟹饼配药葵。

entries.text: Aarrgh!
entries.translated_text: 哈呀啊啊啊！

entries.text: In that case, maybe I ought to be a legendary knight, then.
entries.translated_text: 这样的话，也许我应该成为一名传奇骑士。

entries.text: It... sort of helped. It's a habit I've kept ever since.
entries.translated_text: 这...还是有点用的。从那以后，我一直保持着这个习惯。

entries.text: Well, at least you're having fun, I guess.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，至少你玩得很开心，我猜。

entries.text: Right you are. To the next fight, traveler!
entries.translated_text: 你是对的。为下一场战斗干杯，旅行者!

entries.text: Val, you're not- You're not *actually* planning on selling that dynamo, are you?
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔，你不会真的打算卖掉那个动力核心吧？

entries.text: We'd swim in the Bay, climb buildings and pretend we were Bosmer in trees, and sometimes swipe a pastry or two from market stalls.
entries.translated_text: 我们会在海湾里游泳，爬上房子，假装我们是树上的波兹默，有时还会从市场摊位上偷一两个糕点。

entries.text: Uh, well. I guess I'll just go along with you, then.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，嗯。我想我会和你一起走的。

entries.text: Okay. Your call. If that's what you want, then... that's what we'll do.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，决定权在你，如果这是你想做的，那我们就照办。

entries.text: I'll believe it when I see it for myself.
entries.translated_text: 当我亲眼看到它时，我才会相信它。

entries.text: Ilinalta's Deluge
entries.translated_text: 伊琳娜塔进水区

entries.text: Although, I think Scrap likely heard.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我认为小渣很可能听到了。

entries.text: Skull
entries.translated_text: 头骨

entries.text: D'you just down that in one sip...? By Azura... That's a neat trick! See if you can keep it up.
entries.translated_text: 你是不是一口就倒了……？阿祖拉...你还有两下子！让我看看你能不能坚持下去。

entries.text: Broken Dwemer Spider
entries.translated_text: 坏掉的矮人蜘蛛

entries.text: I found them near the old dwemer bridge.
entries.translated_text: 我在老锻莫桥附近找到了它们。

entries.text: You know, you don't hear of too many people useing magic *and* big swords.
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，很少有能同时使用魔法和大剑。

entries.text: The Direnni took Nedes as slaves. Well, they didn't call them slaves, of course. Anyway, the Direnni aren't around anymore.
entries.translated_text: 迪瑞尼把人类当作奴隶。当然，他们不叫他们奴隶。总之，迪瑞尼家族已经不在了。

entries.text: Is he... okay to leave like this? Of course, he's survived before, so I suppose this is working for him. I'm not one to judge the way others manage.
entries.translated_text: 他...可以离开吗？当然，他以前也幸存下来过，所以我想这对他来说是可以的,我不想过多评价他人。

entries.text: Sanguine would quite enjoy me as a follower, I think. I certainly drink and dance and have enough fun.
entries.translated_text: 我想，桑吉恩也会很喜欢我这个追随者的。我当然会喝酒、跳舞，寻找足够的乐趣。

entries.text: (Laugh)
(Laugh)
You'd stay by my side even as I kill people?
entries.translated_text: 即使我杀人，你也会留在我身边？

entries.text: But that is your decision.
entries.translated_text: 但这是你的决定。

entries.text: Far, I had this amazing idea that I was going to run by you, but it was replaced by a different idea. I thought I'd let you know, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 到目前为止，我有一个很棒的想法，我打算由你来做，但我又有了另一个想法。无论如何，我想我会让你知道的。

entries.text: Yes, finally! We're going to explore the secret underground of the college!
entries.translated_text: 没错，终于！我们要去探索学院的地下秘密了！

entries.text: This 'enthralling' you do is very interesting. Just... don't use it on me, okay?
entries.translated_text: 你所做的这种“控制”非常有趣。只是...不要对我使用它，好吗？

entries.text: Are they really going to believe you're The Gourmet with you dressed like that? I wouldn't let you anywhere near the emperor's food.
entries.translated_text: 穿成这样，他们真的会相信你是美食家吗？我不会让你靠近皇帝的食物。

entries.text: I could have sworn I had... Hey! Remi... Where is my sweetroll?
entries.translated_text: 我发誓我...蕾米...我的甜卷呢?

entries.text: I hope you know that I'm counting carrying all of this stuff as a workout, which means I'll have earned dessert by the end of the day.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你知道，我把搬这些东西当作锻炼了，所以到今天结束时，我就有理由犒劳自己吃甜点了！

entries.text: Where is this Morvic?
entries.translated_text: 这个莫维克在哪里？

entries.text: I hope I didn't overestimate my ability to repair this place.
entries.translated_text: 我希望我没有高估我修复这个地方的能力。

entries.text: You should read this, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 你应该看看这个，蕾米。

entries.text: That sounds awful. How fascinating.
entries.translated_text: 听起来真可怕，好有趣。

entries.text: I agree. I can't feel my toes.
entries.translated_text: 我同意。我感觉不到我的脚趾了。

entries.text: See? Killing Falmer is a public service.
entries.translated_text: 看吧？伐莫人人得而诛之。

entries.text: Do you find the celebrations in High Rock or in Skyrim to be more enjoyable? I'm partial to the festivals back home, of course.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得高岩和天际哪里的庆典更有趣？当然，我更喜欢家乡的节日。

entries.text: I have a bad feeling about asking Arngeir about this shout. It seems like something he'll be angry at us for. You won't let him Shout at me, right?
entries.translated_text: 我对向艾恩盖尔询问这种吼声有一种不好的感觉。看起来他会因为什么而生我们的气，你不会让他对我吼叫，对吧？

entries.text: Oh, so we're going undercover. Alright, alright. Just be natural. Normal. Not suspicious. We got this.
entries.translated_text: 哦，所以我们要潜入伪装了。好吧，好吧。只要自然一点，正常一点，不要显得可疑。我们一定能搞定的。

entries.text: The note says 'until I can break his will'. You don't think they're torturing him, do you?
entries.translated_text: 纸条上写着“让我击溃他的意志”。你不认为他们在折磨他，是吗？

entries.text: The note says 'until I can break his will'. You don't think they're torturing him, do you?
entries.translated_text: 纸条上写着“让我击溃他的意志”。你不认为他们在折磨他，是吗？

entries.text: Oh. You got any books that aren't about that self-centered s'wit? You saved me from being bored to death.
entries.translated_text: 哦。你有什么书不是写那些以自我为中心的聪明人的吗？看这些要无聊死了。

entries.text: My name is Serana. Good to meet you.
entries.translated_text: 我叫瑟拉娜，很高兴见到你。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. Although I already explored the ruins, it seems I missed some artifacts in my initial adventure, and we've recovered some items that Remi has deemed interesting. There's just a little more of the ruin left to show her.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。虽然我已经探索过遗迹，但在我最初的冒险中似乎错过了一些文物，而且我们还发现了一些蕾米认为有趣的物品。只剩下一点遗址给她看。

entries.text: G-Gore!
entries.translated_text: 格-格雷!

entries.text: I think I might be getting hungry.
entries.translated_text: 我想我可能饿了。

entries.text: Fascinating! Is it just like talking to alive people? I imagine her vocal chords don't work, so is it mind-to-mind, then?
entries.translated_text: 太有趣了！这就像和活人交谈一样吗？我想她的声带应该不能用了，所以是心灵对话吗？

entries.text: I can still give you a look of disapproval. See if you can read this one.
entries.translated_text: 我可以给你一个眼神表达不满，就看你能不能读出来了。

entries.text: Who in Oblivion is she?
entries.translated_text: 她到底是谁？

entries.text: Don't look at me like that!
entries.translated_text: 不要这样看我！

entries.text: After reading the book I gave her about Chaurus Pie, Remi decided she wants to try it, but we don't have time for that.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米读了我给她的关于巢蚁薄饼的书后，决定尝试一下，但我们没有时间。

entries.text: Vengeance, of course! He sent someone to kill me! It's only natural I'd want to return the favour!
entries.translated_text: 复仇，当然了！他派人来杀我！我想回敬他，这是再自然不过的事情！

entries.text: And besides, if you'd met my weapon, you'd know that it is in fact trying to hit me. At least, I'm pretty sure.
entries.translated_text: 另外，如果你观察我的武器，你会知道实际上它只想攻击我，至少我很确定这点。

entries.text: And while I haven't been back to check recently, I was wanted by the fair City of Anvil for Piracy on the High Seas, smuggling...
entries.translated_text: 虽然我最近没有确认过，但是我应是被安维尔城以海盗、走私...罪而通缉了。

entries.text: We are far from home, and this is a cold, hard land. Skyrim could not be more different from Elsweyr.
entries.translated_text: 我们远离家乡，这是一片寒冷艰苦的土地。天际与艾斯维尔完全不同。

entries.text: Ohhh I'm so excited!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我太兴奋了！

entries.text: I suppose to give you a brief answer to your original question...
entries.translated_text: 我想对你最初的问题做一个简单的回答...

entries.text: Let me know if you need anything else.
entries.translated_text: 需要帮助请叫我。

entries.text: You say that like it's so simple.
entries.translated_text: 你说的好像很容易似的。

entries.text: You've never heard of Bthar-Zel?
entries.translated_text: 你从未听说过巴泽尔吗？

entries.text: Jasrah.
entries.translated_text: 贾斯拉。

entries.text: We have a lot of fun, but... I-I don't know what to do.
entries.translated_text: 我们玩得很开心，但是...我-我不知道该怎么办。

entries.text: You're a good daughter.
entries.translated_text: 你是个好女儿。

entries.text: I think... I think I need to rethink our partnership.
entries.translated_text: 我认为...我认为我需要重新考虑我们的伙伴关系。

entries.text: I think... I think I need to rethink our partnership.
entries.translated_text: 我认为...我认为我需要重新考虑我们的伙伴关系。

entries.text: Fair enough. Look, I didn't ask for this job. I got stuck with it.
entries.translated_text: 这很公平。听着，我并不想干这活，我身不由己。

entries.text: But when I did notice, I thought... I thought that perhaps I just hadn't noticed that I was having similar feelings toward others.
entries.translated_text: 但是当我确实注意到这情况时，我想...我想，也许我只是没有注意到，我对别人也有类似的感觉。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. Although I already explored the ruins, it seems I missed some artifacts in my initial adventure. I should keep an eye out for more.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。虽然我已经探索过遗迹，但在最初的冒险中似乎错过了一些文物。我应该留意更多。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. Although I already explored the ruins, it seems I missed some artifacts in my initial adventure. I should keep an eye out for more.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。虽然我已经探索过遗迹，但在最初的冒险中似乎错过了一些文物。我应该留意更多。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. Although I already explored the ruins, it seems I missed some artifacts in my initial adventure. I should keep an eye out for more.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。虽然我已经探索过遗迹，但在最初的冒险中似乎错过了一些文物。我应该留意更多。

entries.text: If you haven't been hitting the skooma and you actually did see this 'Psijic Monk' fellow...
entries.translated_text: 如果你还没有喝过斯库玛并且你确实看到了这个“赛伊克僧侣”...

entries.text: You really don't know me at all, do you?
entries.translated_text: 你真的一点都不了解我，是吗？

entries.text: What just happened...?
entries.translated_text: 刚才发生了什么...？

entries.text: Yes, we aren't typically in positions to be picky, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想我们通常没有资格挑三拣四。

entries.text: Ugh, you're no fun.
entries.translated_text: 呃，你真没意思。

entries.text: Conjuration.
entries.translated_text: 召唤系。

entries.text: Oh! I think I like her! How dreadful to work for some noble day in and day out. I don't blame her for snapping.
entries.translated_text: 哦！我想我喜欢她！为某个贵族日复一日地工作该是多么痛苦。我不怪她会崩溃。

entries.text: Ganbald, if you could kill them now, I'd appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德，如果你现在能杀了他们，我会很感激的！

entries.text: Let me see that!
entries.translated_text: 让我看看！

entries.text: Avanchnzel translates to eternal city. Really, most dwemer cities seem eternal, considering how long they've been around.
entries.translated_text: 阿旺晨泽尔意为永恒之城。真的，考虑到它们已经存在了多久，大多数锻莫城市似乎都是永恒的。

entries.text: Lorkhan is said to have created Nirn. Who created Lorkhan? And who created whoever created Lorkhan?
entries.translated_text: 据说洛克汗创造了奈恩。那又是谁创造了洛克汗？

entries.text: Hello, Thorn. Were you going to ask me something? I hope it's a fun question.
entries.translated_text: 你好，荆棘。你打算问我什么吗？我希望这是一个有趣的问题。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. Morvic decided to take matters into his own hands, traveling to Skyrim to hunt down Remiel. Remi wanted to exact her own revenge on him, but I told her that she was taking it too far and convinced her to stop with her plotting.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。莫维克决定自己动手，前往天际追捕蕾米尔。蕾米想对他进行报复，但我告诉她她太过分了，并说服她停止她的阴谋。

entries.text: Okay, let's get looking.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我们开始寻找。

entries.text: Ha! You're right, of course. Thank you.
entries.translated_text: 哈!你是对的，当然了。谢谢你。

entries.text: It's different from... but... it alsoe doesn't feel different. I-I feel a bit sick.
entries.translated_text: 这与...不一样，但...感觉也没什么不同。我觉得有点不舒服。

entries.text: Well, I am getting an ale... You can have a sip of it.
entries.translated_text: 我去拿麦芽酒...你可以喝一口。

entries.text: Well, it's certainly a welcome bonus of the whole situation. So, what do you say?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这确实是整件事中一个正向的额外收获。那么，你怎么看？

entries.text: Where do we start?
entries.translated_text: 我们从哪里开始？

entries.text: Do we really need to be talking?
entries.translated_text: 我们真的得说话吗？

entries.text: Yes, well. Kids tend not to care about right and wrong. So long as it's fun, why not?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，孩子们往往不关心对与错。只要有趣，为什么不呢？

entries.text: I've been considering seeking out Hermaeus Mora. The possibility of obtaining knowledge others can only dream of is so tempting.
entries.translated_text: 我一直在考虑寻找赫麦尤斯·莫拉。获得别人只能梦想的知识的可能性是如此诱人。

entries.text: Did you forget to sleep, too, Una? You and me, two peas in a pod.
entries.translated_text: 你也忘了睡觉吗，乌娜？你和我，一个豆荚里的两颗豌豆。

entries.text: Remi is here!
entries.translated_text: 蕾米来了！

entries.text: I suppose grasping the reality of one's own death is bound to come with some... complications.
entries.translated_text: 我想，理解自己死亡的现实必然会伴随着一些...复杂的情况。

entries.text: I couldn't resist! I stayed there for awhile, actually, before heading out to see Nchuand-Zel.
entries.translated_text: 我对它无法抗拒！实际上，我在那里呆了一段时间后，然后才去了楚安德-泽尔。

entries.text: You really wouldn't mind?
entries.translated_text: 你真的不会介意吗？

entries.text: I wasn't aware that Halls of the Dead *could* be closed. I figured that would be sacrilege. No wonder Verulus isn't too popular around here.
entries.translated_text: 我还从不知道亡者之厅*还*能关闭。我想这简直是亵渎之举，难怪维鲁鲁斯在这类不受欢迎。

entries.text: I've been keeping increasingly ridiculous items in my pockets, to see at what point I'll notice Val taking them. I'll let you know once I catch him!
entries.translated_text: 我一直在口袋里放越来越荒谬的东西，想看看我什么时候会发现到瓦尔把它们拿走了。一旦我抓到他，我会告诉你的！

entries.text: But I'm not my parents, and I agree whole-heartedly. There's just something about their living in the wilds, adhering to only the laws of nature...
entries.translated_text: 但我不是我的父母，我对此完全认可。他们生活在荒野中，只遵守自然法则，就是有一点...

entries.text: Why didn't you join them, then?
entries.translated_text: 那你为什么不加入他们？

entries.text: Are you okay?! I woke up and you were gone! Scrap led me here, and thank the Divines you seem okay!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？！我醒了后，你不见了！是小渣把我带到了这里，感谢圣灵们，你看起来还好！

entries.text: Did you call me 'sister', by the way? Is this some term that comes from The Ravens?
entries.translated_text: 顺便问一下，你叫我“姐妹”吗？这是群鸦团中的某个术语吗？

entries.text: Be careful. Scrap's gonna get jealous. Nothing worse than a jealous automaton.
entries.translated_text: 当心，小渣会吃醋的，没有什么比嫉妒的机器人更糟的了。

entries.text: You're afraid of being different from Argonians? Hm. Well, you are different.
entries.translated_text: 你害怕和其他亚龙人不一样吗？嗯...确实，你的确和他们不一样。

entries.text: Of course, we'd need to find Aetherium deposits... And figure out how to mine it in the first place... Hmm..
entries.translated_text: 当然，我们得先找到神光水晶矿床...而且首先要弄清楚如何开采它...嗯...

entries.text: Great, let's dispose of this Miraak and go sightseeing around the island!
entries.translated_text: 太好了，让我们处理掉这个秘拉克去环岛观光吧！

entries.text: These animunculi keep trying to kill us, Scrap. We have no choice but to return the favour.
entries.translated_text: 这些蒸汽机械一直试图杀死我们，小渣，我们别无选择，只能反击。

entries.text: All alone in this dark place. It makes me so sad.
entries.translated_text: 独自在这个黑暗的地方。这让我很难过。

entries.text: Why spend money when you can show off your skill in thievery? You've certainly impressed me.
entries.translated_text: 当你可以白嫖时为什么还要花钱？你确实让我欣赏。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔

entries.text: Ask Remi if she'll cook something for us, would you? Her meals are always an adventure.
entries.translated_text: 问问蕾米会不会给我们做饭，好吗？吃她做的饭就总是一场冒险。

entries.text: I am thirteen-and-a-half, and 'cause I like the wilderness. It is nice there.
entries.translated_text: 我十三岁半，因为我喜欢荒野。那里很好。

entries.text: Ohhh, Bigpig, it's okay! Scrap isn't that vicious! Scrap, go show him you're nice!
entries.translated_text: 哦，大猪，没事的！小渣没那么凶狠！小渣，去让他看看你很和善！

entries.text: The falmer remind me of dreugh. Both were once intelligent races, and both devolved due to the influence of mer.
entries.translated_text: 伐莫让我想起了蟹灵，两者都曾经是聪明的种族，都因莫（精灵）的影响而退化。

entries.text: Now I'm thinking of installing a moondial whenever I get a house.
entries.translated_text: 现在我正在考虑每当我有房子时也装一个月晷。

entries.text: He didn't sign it. Well, at least not in any way apparent to someone who isn't me.
entries.translated_text: 他没有写签名。如果不是我的话，其他人很难认出是他的字迹。

entries.text: So there is one abandoned house in Windhelm, and no one thought to check it before us?
entries.translated_text: 那么，在风舵城有这么一座被废弃房屋，而在我们之前没有人想到去检查它？

entries.text: What are your skills?
entries.translated_text: 你会什么技能？

entries.text: That's my Morvic impression. I suppose you wouldn't know, but believe me. It's incredibly accurate.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我对莫维克的印象。相信我。这很准确。

entries.text: Rennec, I'm being very serious. Look at my serious face. I'm hungry.
entries.translated_text: 雷内克，我是认真的。看看我严肃的脸。我饿了。

entries.text: Oh, just the usual dwemechanic-ery. It's sort of... volatile right now, so maybe you should go play?
entries.translated_text: 哦，只是通常的装饰机械。现在有点...不稳定，所以也许你应该去玩会？

entries.text: Well that's a little rude.
entries.translated_text: 这可有点不太礼貌。

entries.text: Now, I know we've murdered someone, but really, I feel like we've done a good thing. Do you think something's wrong with my ability to empathize?
entries.translated_text: 现在，我知道我们杀了人，但说真的，我觉得我们做了一件好事。你觉得我的同理心有问题吗？

entries.text: My mother has always had a knack for charming information out of people. It's a skill I am forever envious of.
entries.translated_text: 我母亲总是有一种从人们身上获取有趣信息的本领。这是我永远羡慕的本领。

entries.text: So, this is your college, Yaz? I quite like that it has so many books lying around. Enough that a few probably won't be missed, right?
entries.translated_text: 那么，这就是你的学院吗，雅扎？这么多书，我太喜欢了。好多，我可不想错过，不是吗？

entries.text: I would say I am just so unbelievably intelligent to have surmised this, but realistically it's a very predictable outcome.
entries.translated_text: 我想说我真是聪明绝顶，竟然猜到了这一点，但现实情况是，这些结果都是可以预料的。

entries.text: I find these stories enthralling, too, so I hope it's not bad.
entries.translated_text: 我也觉得这些故事很吸引人，所以我觉得它还不错。

entries.text: But it's not nearly as fun.
entries.translated_text: 但这几乎没有那么有趣。

entries.text: Goodbye, then.
entries.translated_text: 再见。

entries.text: As much as I tell myself that I'm out here trying to make it up to them, trying to restore our family name by spreading knowledge...
entries.translated_text: 尽管我告诉自己，我在这里是为了弥补他们，试图通过传播知识来恢复我们的家族名誉……

entries.text: I just feel so much guilt. Sometimes so much it physically hurts.
entries.translated_text: 我只是感到非常内疚。

entries.text: Mephala shield you, Teldryn.
entries.translated_text: 愿梅法拉庇护你，泰卓因。

entries.text: Yeah, but it was also so beautiful... I bet we could stay outside the city, near the ocean! And that'd be fun for us both!
entries.translated_text: 是啊，不过那里真的很美...我打赌我们可以住在城外、靠近海边的地方！那样我们俩都能玩得很开心！

entries.text: No problem.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: You rush them, and I'll circle to their rear!
entries.translated_text: 你冲向他们，我绕到他们后面去！

entries.text: Alright, first round's on Remi. Time to pay me back for all this body guardin' I've been doing.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，第一轮是蕾米。是时候回报我一直以来的保护了。

entries.text: Fame.
entries.translated_text: 名望。

entries.text: Viella.
entries.translated_text: 维埃拉。

entries.text: So I imagine they call it Dragon Bridge due to the big dragon bridge? How inspired.
entries.translated_text: 所以我想他们之所以叫它龙桥，是因为那座大龙桥？多么厉害。

entries.text: Are you... Are you feeling okay?
entries.translated_text: 你……你还好吗？

entries.text: I rather think you just made that scale up. It hardly sounds official.
entries.translated_text: 我倒觉得你那个判断标准只是凭空想出来的。听起来一点也不算权威。

entries.text: You're going to be a Nightingale? How exciting!
entries.translated_text: 你要做夜莺吗？多么激动人心！

entries.text: Funny, that's how most describe how swamps smell as well.
entries.translated_text: 有趣的是，大多数人也是这样描述沼泽地的气味的。

entries.text: If you think it'll help. I'm not going to be blamed for whatever happens.
entries.translated_text: 如果你认为它有用的话，不过无论发生什么，可别怪我。

entries.text: I'm a growing boy. I need as much food as I can get.
entries.translated_text: 我是个正在长身体的孩子，我需要尽可能足够的食物。

entries.text: I hope he knows a good fence, otherwise he'll never be able to sell it without the priestesses finding out.
entries.translated_text: 我希望他认识一个靠谱的销赃人，否则他一卖掉雕像就会被女祭司发现。

entries.text: And if I can't find any wayward adventurers, I hire mercenaries to watch my back.
entries.translated_text: 如果我找不到任何的其他冒险者，我会佣兵来保护我。

entries.text: And if I can't find any wayward adventurers, I hire mercenaries to watch my back.
entries.translated_text: 如果我找不到任何的其他冒险者，我会佣兵来保护我。

entries.text: B-Before... the rule of... what in Mara's name does this say- "tibber"? Is that a name? Is this a joke, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 以-以前……统治……以玛拉之名，这说的是什么——“台伯”？那是一个名字吗？这是在开玩笑吗，蕾米？

entries.text: In the interest of advancing the skills of their colleagues, they should be wholeheartedly supportive. Shouldn't they?
entries.translated_text: 为了提高同事们的技能，他们应该全力支持。难道不应该吗？

entries.text: Are you alright?
entries.translated_text: 你没事吧？

entries.text: Take this back.
entries.translated_text: 把这个拿回去。

entries.text: It's thin enough that if I use the right tool...
entries.translated_text: 它足够薄，如果我使用对的工具...

entries.text: That extends to other mechanisms... Like locks. I learned I had a knack for getting into places I shouldn't when I was a teenager.
entries.translated_text: 这也延伸到了其他方面...比如锁。我发现自己在青少年时期就很擅长进入不该进去的地方。

entries.text: Silver-Blood Inn
entries.translated_text: 银血旅店

entries.text: It was quite a shock.
entries.translated_text: 这还真是让我震惊了一下。

entries.text: After travelling to Sentinel, I always loved coming back home. You can just never truly unwind unless it's your own space.
entries.translated_text: 去哨兵城旅行后，我一直很喜欢回家。除非它是你自己的空间，否则您永远无法真正放松。

entries.text: <Laugh>
entries.translated_text: <Laugh>

entries.text: It's a bit ironic, isn't it? Such a big deal is made over a murder we didn't commit. And such a small deal made over the one we did.
entries.translated_text: 这有些讽刺，不是吗？我们没有犯过的谋杀被大肆宣扬而我们犯过的事却无人问津。

entries.text: Chest
entries.translated_text: 箱子

entries.text: Chest
entries.translated_text: 箱子

entries.text: Chest
entries.translated_text: 箱子

entries.text: Chest
entries.translated_text: 箱子

entries.text: Ugh, that's what we get for helping that old man.
entries.translated_text: 呃，这就是我们帮助那个老头的下场。

entries.text: Oh, excellent! I wonder what I should make this one look like? It will be convincing, whatever it ends up being.
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了！不知道我应该把它做成什么样子？不管最后是什么样子，都会让人想买的。

entries.text: My mother and my father are back in Wayrest. My sister is also out in the world somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 我的父母回到了途歇城。我姐姐也在世界某个地方。

entries.text: My mother and my father are back in Wayrest. My sister is also out in the world somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 我的父母回途歇城了。我姐姐还在世界某个地方。

entries.text: No! I'm not going into that Mine, I'm not!
entries.translated_text: 我才不去那个矿坑呢，我才不去！

entries.text: Ugh! This place is the worst!
entries.translated_text: 啊！这个地方最糟了！

entries.text: Well, I'm not most people. Besides, what I really care about is how you treat people you care about.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我不是大多数人。此外，我真正关心的是你如何对待你关心的人。

entries.text: Hmm... Well, I know that the Altmer worship Jephre, which is basically the same god.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...嗯，我知道傲特莫们信仰伊夫瑞，这基本上是同一个神。

entries.text: I care about you, you know.
entries.translated_text: 我在乎你，你知道的。

entries.text: I was just thinking about...
entries.translated_text: 我只是在想...

entries.text: Morvic will never leave Remi and her family alone. I'm going to help her.
entries.translated_text: 莫维克绝不会放过蕾米和她的家人，我得帮助她。

entries.text: Nar is alive. I'm alive. Everyone is alive? Good.
entries.translated_text: 纳尔还活着，我还活着，每个人都活着？好。

entries.text: Usually, those mismatches are... benign. But sometimes they are a little more... explosive.
entries.translated_text: 通常，这些不匹配是...无害的。但有时候，它们会有点儿...爆炸。

entries.text: Usually, those mismatches are... benign. But sometimes they are a little more... explosive.
entries.translated_text: 通常，这些不匹配是……良性的。但有时它们更...爆炸性的。

entries.text: I've got this one off balance! Shoot them, Auri!
entries.translated_text: 我打倒这个家伙了！快射击，奥璃！

entries.text: I *knew* it had to be someone in power, someone able to orchestrate the abysmal investigations to this point.
entries.translated_text: 我就知道这一定是某个权贵，某个能够精心策划这场糟糕的调查到这一步的人。

entries.text: And the great part about steam is that it's renewable! It will just turn back to water, so that it can be turned to steam again!
entries.translated_text: 而蒸汽的伟大之处在于它是可再生的!它只是会变回水，这样它就可以再次变成蒸汽!

entries.text: Little Agryval thought all of that was nonsense. At age eight-and-a-half, she was smarter than to think a mist was evil.
entries.translated_text: 小阿格里瓦尔认为这一切都是无稽之谈。在八岁半的时候，她自认为比那些愚昧之人都要聪明。

entries.text: The first time she woke up in my arms, I was... so happy. Nothing untoward had happened during the night, before you assume.
entries.translated_text: 她第一次在我怀里醒来的时候，我...非常高兴。在你瞎猜前，我先说好，我们没有发生任何事情。

entries.text: Me too! That's why I'm in Skyrim. It's a long way from home.
entries.translated_text: 我也是！这就是我在天际的原因。这儿离家太远。

entries.text: I'm getting really tired, Nar! Can you kill them now?
entries.translated_text: 我真的很累，纳尔！你现在可以杀了他们吗？

entries.text: Oh! Um, yeah, of course. Sorry.
entries.translated_text: 哦！嗯，是的，当然。对不起。

entries.text: Great! Then its decided!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！那么，就这么决定了!

entries.text: Never in my life have I murdered someone innocent just to feast on their flesh.
entries.translated_text: 我这辈子从来没有为了吃肉而谋杀无辜的人。

entries.text: You know how I love all food. Especially Chaurus! Tasty.
entries.translated_text: 你知道我多么喜欢这些食物。尤其是巢蚁！非常可口。

entries.text: Ha-ha. I'll have you know this is an organized mess! That pile is sorted by the order in which I figured out what each piece does.
entries.translated_text: 哈-哈。我给你说这是我故意的！这堆东西是按照我弄清楚的每件东西的作用的顺序来分类的。

entries.text: Oh, well, my friend here found me in the Silverblood Inn. But really I'm from High Rock. But Cyrodiil, huh? Are there many Argonians there?
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，我的朋友在银血旅馆找到了我。但实际上我来自高岩。但是赛瑞迪尔，嗯？那里有很多亚龙人吗？

entries.text: A disgusting necromancer, just living in the basement of the Palace of the Kings?
entries.translated_text: 一个恶心的死灵法师，只是住在众王宫殿的地下室？

entries.text: Please be careful, Ed!
entries.translated_text: 请小心，艾德！

entries.text: And now...
entries.translated_text: 现在...

entries.text: I think this cold is freezing Scrap's cogs.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得这冷得快把小渣的齿轮冻住了。

entries.text: The heat of battle is the fire that forges the strongest blades.
entries.translated_text: 战斗之心可以锤炼出最强大的锋刃。

entries.text: If this moth priest is out and about in Skyrim, that means he's looking for a scroll, right? Do you think he knows about Serana's somehow?
entries.translated_text: 如果这个先祖蛾祭司在天际四处活动，那意味着他正在寻找卷轴，对吗？你觉得他知道瑟拉娜的事吗？

entries.text: (Gasp) Well, Ganbald, we aren't dead!
entries.translated_text: （倒抽一口气）好吧，甘巴尔德，我们还没死！

entries.text: The Argonian was right, you know. Avanchnzel is an archive of sorts, chronicling Divines know how much dwemer history.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，亚龙人是对的。阿旺晨泽尔有各种档案，记载着圣灵才知晓的锻莫的历史。

entries.text: We have the dwemer lever here.
entries.translated_text: 我们这里有锻莫杠杆。

entries.text: He's not a particularly great guard, if he allows people through so long as they give him a gift or use the right words. Don't tell him I said that.
entries.translated_text: 他并不是一个特别出色的守卫，只要有人送他礼物或说对了话，他就会让他们过去。别告诉他这是我说的。

entries.text: I get lost sometimes, but I come home.
entries.translated_text: 我有时会迷路，但我能回家。

entries.text: Have you been here all alone, you little heap of scrap-metal?
entries.translated_text: 你一个人来到这里吗，你这小小金属渣？

entries.text: That's good to hear.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴听到这个消息。

entries.text: Oh! It sounds like you were in Rivenspire. It's not very pleasant there.
entries.translated_text: 听起来你在碎裂山峰，那里不是很舒服。

entries.text: Ganbald, I wanted you to know I was thinking. I don't remember about what, but I thought I should let you know anyway.
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德，我想让你知道我在想的事，我不记得是什么了，但我想无论如何我都应该让你知道。

entries.text: Don't worry, boy. Scrap won't hurt you, will he?
entries.translated_text: 别担心，男孩。小渣不会伤害你的，是吧？

entries.text: You better watch out! Remi will tusk you up!
entries.translated_text: 你最好小心点！蕾米会戳到你的!

entries.text: Oh, right, scales! I almost forgot about the scales.
entries.translated_text: 哦，对，鳞片!我差点忘了鳞片的事。

entries.text: Let's go!
entries.translated_text: 来吧！

entries.text: Let's go!
entries.translated_text: 来吧！

entries.text: Do you know anything about the Aetherium Forge?
entries.translated_text: 你知道神光水晶熔炉吗？

entries.text: It was, in a way. It wasn't done on purpose, but my family's ruin did lead to his.
entries.translated_text: 在某种程度上，确实如此。这不是故意的，但我家的破产确实导致了他家的衰落。

texts: Well, I've already seen the ones in High Rock. And Hammerfell is too hot for me.
好吧，我已经看过高岩的那些遗址了。而落锤省对我来说太热了。

entries.text: That would make sense, considering it seems to be controlled with steam engineering.
entries.translated_text: 考虑到它似乎是由蒸汽工程控制的，这也有一定道理。

entries.text: And definitely not because I programmed that desire into you?
entries.translated_text: 而绝不是因为我给你设置了这个愿望？

entries.text: Like...? Oh! I've never- That's so secure! Incredible! Perhaps this will increase the success rate to twenty percent!
entries.translated_text: 就像... ？哦，我从来没这么靠谱过，难以置信，也许这能把成功率提高到百分之二十！

entries.text: I imagine if I said 'the pleasure of joining me in my studies,' you'd turn and run.
entries.translated_text: 我想如果我说“很高兴能和我一起学习”，你会不会转身离开。

entries.text: Whew, we're getting a real workout...
entries.translated_text: 呼，我们正在接受真正的锻炼...

texts: 奥舒尔，看看这个地方。完全被摧毁了。真让人寒心。。。安静。
舒奥尔，看看这个地方。完全被摧毁了。真让人寒心。。。安静。

entries.text: She ruined him, now he ruins her.
entries.translated_text: 她毁了他，现在他也要毁了她。

entries.text: Oh no. You must not see a lot of dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 并不会，锻莫遗址并非随处可见。

texts: Oh no. You must not see a lot of dwemer ruins.
并不。矮人废墟并非随处可见。

entries.text: Now, Gore, tell me: are you one of the Nords who believe Talos is a Divine, and if so, please provide your rationale.
entries.translated_text: 现在，格雷，告诉我：你是否和那些诺德人一样相信塔洛斯是神，如果是的话，说一说你的理由。

entries.text: It'll be quite a task to convey it through words, but I don't think there's anyone better for the job than you!
entries.translated_text: 要通过言语将它表达出来会是一项相当艰巨的任务，但我认为没人比你更适合这项工作了!

entries.text: Attacks with this crossbow ignore 60% of armour.
entries.translated_text: 使用这把弩的攻击无视60%的护甲。

entries.text: You wanted to say something, my friend?
entries.translated_text: 你想说点什么，我的朋友？

entries.text: I'm curious what causes Dwarven power nodes to contain so much energy? I've read that they're important to the construction of miters.
entries.translated_text: 我很好奇是什么让矮人的动力节点蕴含有如此多的能量？我以前读到过，这对斜面的建造很重要。

entries.text: Actually, I'm not even sure I'm laughing with you.
entries.translated_text: 事实上，我也不确定你是否在和我开玩笑。

entries.text: On it!
entries.translated_text: 我来！

entries.text: Way to get my hopes up! Rude.
entries.translated_text: 真让我白期待一场。

entries.text: I'd say your life will flash before your eyes, but... well...
entries.translated_text: 我本该说你的生命会在眼前闪回，但...嗯...

entries.text: I'm just saying, we have no idea where it's been.
entries.translated_text: 我只是说，我们不知道散发的味道从何而来。

entries.text: You won't break, I promise. And even if you did, I'd be right here to sew you back together again.
entries.translated_text: 你不会崩溃的，我保证。即使你真这样了，我也会想办法让你恢复如初。

entries.text: I wonder what this says about the occupants.
entries.translated_text: 我想知道这说明了住户什么情况。

entries.text: Yes, and the lush floodplains of Stormhaven are far from here, too.
entries.translated_text: 是的，风暴港肥沃的河漫滩也离这里很远。

entries.text: Oooh, stole it for me?
entries.translated_text: 哦，给我偷的？

entries.text: If you're sure, then I'm glad to explore more.
entries.translated_text: 如果你确定的话，那么我很高兴能探索更多地方。

entries.text: Not that there's anything wrong with chatting with you, I mean, but it's just so menial!
entries.translated_text: 不是说和你聊天有什么问题，我的意思是，只是太大材小用了！

entries.text: I do feel bad killing those little guys, but they brought it on themselves.
entries.translated_text: 杀了那些小家伙我确实感觉很糟糕，但他们自找的。

entries.text: He didn't actually say what he'd give me.
entries.translated_text: 他其实没说要给我什么。

entries.text: And I'm Remiel. I'll have you know, I know the ins and outs of Dwarven ruins, so just try to keep up and you'll earn your pay, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我是蕾米尔。我想告诉你，我知道矮人遗址非常聊着，所以试着跟着我们，你会得到报酬的，好吗？

entries.text: You do realize that they've made you their errand boy, right?
entries.translated_text: 你确实意识到他们让你做他们的差事，对吧？

entries.text: Ohhh, look, your handwriting is so legible! Amazing! Shall I read it right here and now?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，看，你的字迹是如此清晰可辨！太神奇了！要不要我现在就在这里读？

entries.text: This Lexicon you're carrying... some of the Dwemeri writing is familiar. Hm... Incredible! It's so simple, yet so effective! This will be use useful!
entries.translated_text: 你带着的这个方典...有些锻莫文字很熟悉。嗯...不可思议！它是如此简单，但又是如此高效！如此有用！

entries.text: Blast it. It's quite clear who wins there.
entries.translated_text: 该死，很明显谁赢了。

entries.text: Not saying you aren't. Just speaking from personal experience.
entries.translated_text: 我不是说你不行，只是说一些个人经验。

texts: Not saying you aren't. Just speaking from personal experience.
不是说你不是。只是从个人经验来说。
Ahh, yes. I know just what you mean. Now that I think on it, I did hear something rather interesting the other day.
啊，是的。我知道你的意思。现在我想了想，前几天我确实听到了一些相当有趣的事情。

entries.text: Okay, what is it this time?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这次是什么？

entries.text: This wasn't my intention, but it is a rather tempting outcome. Would you really pour out all your secrets in this state?
entries.translated_text: 这不是我的原意，但确实很吸引我。你真的会在这种状态下倾诉你所有的秘密吗？

entries.text: (Laughs) I didn't know Elves had scales!
entries.translated_text: （笑）我可不知道精灵也有鳞片！

entries.text: Pick locks with the tension wrench in your inventory. (<Global=HLIORPLLocksPickedCount>/<Global=HLIORPLocksPickedTotal>)
entries.translated_text: 使用库存中的张力扳手撬锁。(<Global=HLIORPLLocksPickedCount>/<Global=HLIORPLocksPickedTotal>)

entries.text: I must ask... What causes the green colouration of your skin?
entries.translated_text: 我必须问问...你的皮肤为什么是绿的？

entries.text: So this is a twist. The Guild Master is actually the killer. Well, you know, no honour among thieves.
entries.translated_text: 所以反转了，会长才是凶手，好吧，你知道，小偷可没有荣誉。

entries.text: Sometimes other kids would bully me because of it.
entries.translated_text: 有时其他孩子会因此而欺负我。

entries.text: A very powerful family. A dastardly group, but they're more than simple brigands. Shrewd. Clever. Not to be trifled with.
entries.translated_text: 一个极其强大的家族，一伙人卑鄙之徒，但他们绝非普通的强盗。精明、狡猾，绝不能小觑。

entries.text: Find the confiscated Skooma.
entries.translated_text: 找到没收的斯库玛。

entries.text: J'zargo's confidence really inspires me. And it seems to serve him well.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格的自信真的让我很感动。这似乎对他很有帮助。

entries.text: Wrothgar.
entries.translated_text: 沃斯嘉古

entries.text: Not to mention, the pressure of saving the college would be all on me, and I just can't function like that.
entries.translated_text: 更何况，拯救学院的压力都压在我身上，我实在没法在这种情况下发挥作用。

entries.text: I've sensed the blood pulsing a little stronger, of late.
entries.translated_text: 最近，我感觉到血液的脉动变得更强了。

entries.text: Oh, I didn't even see you poison that mead barrel! Quick thinking.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我甚至没看到你在那个蜂蜜酒桶里下毒了，反应真快！

entries.text: Instead, it just makes me sad.
entries.translated_text: 相反，它只会让我难过。

entries.text: Try to hit each other with fireballs without catching on fire ourselves.
entries.translated_text: 在确保自己不会着火的情况下互相扔火球。

entries.text: Well, the inns are better in Cyrodiil. I'll take that as a consolation.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，赛瑞迪尔的旅店要舒适一些。这倒可以成为些我的慰藉。

entries.text: Out on the street...? Who is saying that?
entries.translated_text: 街上...？谁说的？

entries.text: I'm not in the best of moods.
entries.translated_text: 我的心情不是很好。

entries.text: Either way, I suppose I can tell you what I know, although it's not much.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，我想我可以告诉你我所知道的，尽管不多。

entries.text: What's your idea?
entries.translated_text: 你的想法是什么？

entries.text: All those people, looking up to you.
entries.translated_text: 这些人都仰望着你。

entries.text: Are you trying to get out of answering my question? You know- Oh, Sweet Mara, are you about to puke? N-not on me! Aim elsewhere!
entries.translated_text: 你想回避话题吗？哦，亲爱的玛拉啊，你要吐了吗？不要在我身上！吐别处！

entries.text: A mage that studies stars, huh? I'd like to talk with him for my own reasons.
entries.translated_text: 研究星辰的法师？我倒是想和他聊聊，有我自己的理由。

entries.text: And I'm glad you're here, too!
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你也在这里！

entries.text: That's the spirit!
entries.translated_text: 就是这股气势！

entries.text: Not many people understand the appeal. You keep surprising me.
entries.translated_text: 没多少人能理解这种兴趣。你总是让我感到意外。

entries.text: Oh, you'd have loved Stormhaven, then! Very idyllic, perfect for staring at. Although, there are still wolves and bandits.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那你一定会喜欢风暴港！那里的田园风光非常适合发呆。虽然，那里仍然有狼和土匪。

entries.text: Oh, I'm Morvic and my life is so terrible while I live in luxury safely at my home. Guess I'll have to murder Remiel because my life is so miserable.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我是莫维克，我的生活是如此糟糕，虽然我在家里安全地过着奢华的生活。我想我必须要杀死蕾米尔，因为我的生活如此悲惨。

entries.text: Well, realistically, I prefer them dead more quickly! Vivisection with an unwilling subject is a chore!
entries.translated_text: 实际上，我更希望他们死得痛快点！对非自愿的对象进行活体解剖是一件苦差事！！

entries.text: I've always felt the Forsworn were no better than Witchmen. Ever since Cidhna Mine, I've felt vinidicated in that belief.
entries.translated_text: 我一直觉得弃誓者并不比巫族好多少。自从希讷矿坑的事情发生后，我就更一直坚信这一点。

entries.text: What?! When?! You mean that old bastard was lying to me?!
entries.translated_text: 什么？！什么时候？！你的意思是那个老混蛋在骗我？！

entries.text: Um, Josh, I think we're being attacked!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，约书，我觉得我们被攻击了！

entries.text: Ah, Stur'cherakac. A bit like 'asshole.'
entries.translated_text: 啊，斯图'切拉卡克。有点像“混蛋”。

entries.text: The first time I was here, I couldn't get beyond the first level of security. This place was designed to protect its inhabitants' research.
entries.translated_text: 我第一次来这里时，我无法越过一级安全模式。这个地方的存在是为了保护居民的研究生活。

entries.text: No, I come from a clan deep within Greenshade.
entries.translated_text: 不，我来自绿荫深处的一个氏族。

entries.text: I know I couldn't have done anything to help him, but I still feel like maybe I should have tried.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我无法帮助他，但我仍然觉得也许我应该尝试一下。

entries.text: Take this!
entries.translated_text: 尝尝这个！

entries.text: Yes! We did it!
entries.translated_text: 是的！我们做到了！

entries.text: Well, in that case, maybe I'll get you something nice... legally, for once!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，既然这样，也许我会给你买点好东西......合法的，就这一次！

entries.text: Cyrodiil has some pretty intelligent people, from what I hear.
entries.translated_text: 据我所知，赛瑞迪尔有一些非常聪明的人。

entries.text: A Job For You
entries.translated_text: 给你的一份活

entries.text: Don't you?
entries.translated_text: 不是吗？

entries.text: So you've seen Nchuand-Zel. Are there any other dwemer ruins you want to see?
entries.translated_text: 所以你已经去过了楚安德-泽尔。你还有其他想看的锻莫遗迹吗？

entries.text: So you've seen Nchuand-Zel. Are there any other dwemer ruins you want to see?
entries.translated_text: 所以你已经去过了楚安德-泽尔。你还有其他想看的锻莫遗迹吗？

entries.text: Hi, Nar. Oh, Scrap also wanted me to tell you 'hi.'
entries.translated_text: 嗨，纳尔。哦，小渣还想让我跟你说个“嗨”。

entries.text: Vokun's Throne Room
entries.translated_text: 沃坤王座室

entries.text: Um... Your door down there seems not to have opened. Is it stuck?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...你楼下的门好像没打开，卡住了吗？

texts: Every ruin is a chance to discover some new machine. To learn secrets of Nirn beyond our wildest dreams.
每一个废墟都是一个发现一些新机器的机会。了解奈恩的秘密，超越我们最疯狂的梦想。

entries.text: Every ruin is a chance to discover some new machine. To learn secrets of Nirn beyond our wildest dreams.
entries.translated_text: 每一个遗址都有机会发现一些新机器，能了解奈恩那些超脱我们最疯狂的梦的秘密。

entries.text: Hyahh!
entries.translated_text: 啊！

entries.text: Yes, more than friends. Sisters.
entries.translated_text: 是的，不仅仅是朋友。姐妹。

entries.text: Of course, not that you're mean! I- I just meant- Well, you understand.
entries.translated_text: 当然，并不是说你刻薄！我-我只是想说-嗯，你懂得。

entries.text: Cicero really got Arnbjorn good. Let's hope he gave as good as he got.
entries.translated_text: 西塞罗真的把艾恩乔恩伤得够呛。希望他也能还以颜色。

entries.text: Sheor, Sinding ripped the girl to pieces? What sort of monster...?
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔啊，是辛丁把女孩撕成碎片？什么样的怪物...？

entries.text: No. I carry a sword. I'm from the swamps of Black Marsh. That's it.
entries.translated_text: 堆，我带着一把剑。我还来自黑沼泽的沼泽地。这就是原因。

entries.text: You were in the Sanctuary awhile. I assume some sort of Brotherhood drama is going on?
entries.translated_text: 你在圣所待了有一段时间了。我想某种兄弟会的戏剧正在上演？

entries.text: Oh, so do you like cities, then? They're definitely a lot less lonely than roughing it on your own.
entries.translated_text: 哦？那你喜欢城市吗？毕竟，城市可比一个人在荒野里要少孤单得多。

entries.text: Second of all, after doing some digging, I've found that he's apparently residing in Windhelm.
entries.translated_text: 其次，在调查一番之后，我发现他显然住在风舵城。

entries.text: I wonder if he's... retracing my footsteps, so to speak?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道他是不是在...追随我的足迹，可以这么说吗？

entries.text: Oh, you mean because of your scar?
entries.translated_text: 哦，你是说因为你的伤疤？

entries.text: You know there are a lot of things I wouldn't have ever thought about before beginning my adventuring lifestyle. Like the important of quality shoes!
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，在我还没开始冒险前，很多事情我从来没考虑过，就像一双好鞋的重要性！

entries.text: This is very exciting! Nchardak is considered advanced, even by Dwemeri standards!
entries.translated_text: 这真让人兴奋！即便以锻莫标准，纳查达克也很先进！

entries.text: I'm going to be a soldier!
entries.translated_text: 我要当兵！

entries.text: Wait... Isn't this...?
entries.translated_text: 等等...这不是...？

entries.text: You know, there's a nasty rumour going around that I live here!
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，有一个讨厌的谣言，说我住在这里！

entries.text: You're not alone in that opinion. Their lifestyle is certainly... particular. But I think looking at it from the outside is part of the intrigue.
entries.translated_text: 你不是唯一有这种看法的人。他们的生活方式当然是...特别的。但我认为，在外人看来，这也是阴谋的一部分。

entries.text: A castle alone on an island? What an aesthetic! Let's hurry and see it!
entries.translated_text: 一座孤岛上的城堡？多美啊！让我们快点去看看吧！

entries.text: I'm no stranger to making poor decisions after a night of drinking, but in this case, I decided to accompany them completely of my own volition.
entries.translated_text: 我常常酒后做错事，但这时候，我都会遵循内心的想法。

entries.text: I've never spoken with a Divine before in my life. Or a Daedra.
entries.translated_text: 我这辈子从来没有和圣灵说过话。魔神也是。

entries.text: Ah!
entries.translated_text: 阿！

entries.text: Ah!
entries.translated_text: 阿！

entries.text: Ah!
entries.translated_text: 阿！

entries.text: Ah!
entries.translated_text: 阿！

entries.text: Ah!
entries.translated_text: 阿！

entries.text: Ah!
entries.translated_text: 阿！

entries.text: Didn't you hear Molag Bal?
entries.translated_text: 你没听到莫拉格·巴尔的话吗？

entries.text: And he made a strange sound, like when a dog whines. And his shadow stretched behind him with too many arms and too many heads.
entries.translated_text: 他发出一种奇怪的声音，就像一只狗在发出呜呜声。而他的影子在他身后伸展着无数的手臂和脑袋。

entries.text: You'll be skeever food in a moment!
entries.translated_text: 一会儿你就吃不消了！

entries.text: A Thesis on Properties of Tonal Alignment
entries.translated_text: 论音律的频率对齐

entries.text: Thank you for listening to me. You are a true friend.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你听我说这些。你是一个真正的朋友。

entries.text: A pie and a sweet roll before bedtime! Well, some say madness and happiness are one and the same.
entries.translated_text: 睡前一个派和一个甜面包卷！有人说疯狂和快乐是一回事。

entries.text: Clearly the joys of life, just out of reach! It really shows the longing toward living of a person jailed away from life.
entries.translated_text: 显然，生活的乐趣，只是可望而不可及！它真的显示了一个被监禁的人对生活的渴望。

entries.text: Okay, let's head there.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我们快去那里。

entries.text: Idiot. I like your fire, though.
entries.translated_text: 笨蛋，不过我喜欢你的热情。

entries.text: I'll be here, Doctor. And also wherever you take me next.
entries.translated_text: 我会在这里的，医生，还有你接下来带我去哪里。

entries.text: You want to try and guess what I find most attractive about you?
entries.translated_text: 你想猜猜我觉得你最吸引我的是什么吗？

entries.text: I am so pleased that Erik will be pursuing a life of adventure! There needs to be more of us adventurous types in this world, I think.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴艾瑞克将踏上冒险生活！我认为这个世界上需要更多我们这些冒险者。

entries.text: Hm... Me. Think. Him. Scared. Of. Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我，想，他，害怕，小渣。

entries.text: Unique Dwemer Cog
entries.translated_text: 独特的锻莫齿轮

entries.text: He put on a show with coloured fire, the ongoing adventures of a warrior and his wolf companion.
entries.translated_text: 他会用彩色的火焰展示一个战士和他的狼伙伴正在进行的冒险。

entries.text: Oh. Er, that sounds... Sad?
entries.translated_text: 哦。呃，这听起来...是个悲伤的故事？

entries.text: Nice work! We make a great team!
entries.translated_text: 干得好！我们是一支伟大的团队！

entries.text: Really?! Oh, this is the greatest, most wonderful, amazing, exciting thing you've ever done for me!
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？！哦，这是你为我做过的最棒、最美妙、最惊人、最令人兴奋的事情！

entries.text: I think all of my muscles are screaming in agony.
entries.translated_text: 我的每片肌肉都好痛。

entries.text: I'm so lucky to call you my friend.
entries.translated_text: 我很幸运能叫你一声朋友。

entries.text: Oh, you got everything! Excellent, because I'm hungry.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你什么都有！太好了，因为我饿了。

entries.text: How long do you think it took for this cave to form?
entries.translated_text: 你认为这个洞穴形成需要多长时间？

entries.text: Upgrades
entries.translated_text: 升级

entries.text: Yes! Kinda... I broke my arm. But then I saw Marlok fight a troll! He had to come save me. It was so cool!
entries.translated_text: 对！算是吧……我把胳膊摔断了。不过后来我看到马洛克和巨魔打起来！他来救我——那一幕太酷了！

entries.text: Oh? Are you trying to imply you're *not* a good Imperial citizen, *Valerius?*
entries.translated_text: 你是想说你没当好帝国公民吗，瓦雷瑞？

entries.text: Summon Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Summon Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Summon Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Summon Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Summon Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: (Laugh) No! You weren't supposed to notice. I at least got it off, though, so that's progress!
entries.translated_text: 不，你不应该注意到的，不过我至少把它弄掉了，这也算是进步吧！

entries.text: Sliced fox tongues? That sounds disgusting.
entries.translated_text: 切片的狐舌薄片？这听起来很恶心。

entries.text: Don't ask me! You're the Arch-Mage!
entries.translated_text: 别问我！你是首席法师！

entries.text: Oh by Mara, your Nord is showing, Gore. I'll have you know that I drink more than wine. Well, wine is good. But I also like mead.
entries.translated_text: 哦，玛拉，你的诺德人格雷正在炫耀。我会让你知道我能喝的可不只是啤酒。嗯，啤酒确实不错。但我也喜欢蜜酒。

entries.text: Plenty of those, aren't there?  Like the Hist, or I believe the Nedes spoke of a 'Fat Mother', which sounds a bit rude, to be honest.
entries.translated_text: 有很多这样的神，不是吗希思特神树？，或者我相信尼德人提到过一个'胖母亲'，说实话，这听起来有点粗鲁。

entries.text: Hm. I never took you for a philosopher, but you continue to surpise me, Gore. I think you're right. Love accepts others' flaws.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。我从来没有把你当成哲学家，但你总是让我感到惊讶，格雷。我想你是对的。爱一个人就要接受他的缺点。

entries.text: Alteration.
entries.translated_text: 变换系。

entries.text: visiting the places they described to me with broad smiles and warm drink in their bellies.
entries.translated_text: 走过他们向我描述过地方时，总能回想起那时他们脸上洋溢的灿烂笑容，与一起喝下的热饮。

entries.text: Dead Men's Respite
entries.translated_text: 亡者之栖

entries.text: First hunting trip was with an Orc, actually!
entries.translated_text: 实际上，我第一次狩猎是和一个兽人一起进行的！

entries.text: Well, he does have quite a few legs. I'd imagine anyone would be clumsy with so many. Likely, it'd just be funny to watch.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，他的腿还挺多的。我想任何人拥有那么多腿都会笨手笨脚的。很可能，看着他就会觉得好笑。

entries.text: You saw some animal tracks, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你看到了一些动物的足迹吗？

entries.text: Excellent, then this should make perfect sense to you.
entries.translated_text: 很好，那么这对你来说应该很有意义。

entries.text: Yes, well, I was trying to be... calm... about it.
entries.translated_text: 是的，好吧，我试图保持...冷静...对这事。

entries.text: Are we heading out, Ed?
entries.translated_text: 我们要出去了吗，艾德？

entries.text: How would you interpret that scene? Would love to hear your thoughts!
entries.translated_text: 你会如何描述这一幕呢？很想听听你的想法!

entries.text: Did you need something, Ria?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，利亚？

entries.text: I'm glad we could meet despite our different backgrounds.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴我们能见面，尽管我们的背景不同。

entries.text: I'm having a hard enough time separating you from that ritual in my mind. I don't need it to be any more difficult.
entries.translated_text: 将你和我心中的仪式分开已经够难受了。

entries.text: What are you hiding from, sister?
entries.translated_text: 你在躲避什么东西，姐妹？

entries.text: And here I thought mines and prisons were all Markarth has.
entries.translated_text: 在这里，我认为矿洞和监狱是马卡斯的全部。

entries.text: Really?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？

entries.text: Really?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？

entries.text: Really?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？

entries.text: Traps, probably.
entries.translated_text: 也许是陷阱。

entries.text: Oh, thank the Divines, rain! Finally you'll be able to wash that stench off, Gore!
entries.translated_text: 哦，谢天谢地，下雨了！格雷，你终于可以洗掉那股恶臭了！

entries.text: Well, yeah, sometimes. But I have Scrap and our adventurous friend here.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，是的，有时。但我有小渣和我们喜欢冒险的朋友在这里。

entries.text: K-kill you?! Who? Who wants to kill you? Are you in danger?
entries.translated_text: 杀、杀你？！谁？是谁想杀你？你有危险吗？！

entries.text: (Whisper) This seems like a strange time to ask me to leave, but ok.
entries.translated_text: （低语）真奇怪，现在让我走，但没关系。

entries.text: By Sheor, what is this ugly thing?
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔啊，这丑陋的东西是什么？

entries.text: They were master engineers, with technology far beyond anything any of the other races have achieved.
entries.translated_text: 他们是工程大师，技术远超其他种族。

entries.text: They were master engineers, with technology far beyond anything any of the other races have achieved.
entries.translated_text: 他们是工程大师，技术远超其他种族。

entries.text: Don't pretend you didn't just take my ring.
entries.translated_text: 别假装你没拿我的戒指。

entries.text: Hey, friend, I got you something. It was practically falling out of their pocket, so I doubt they'll miss it.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，跟你说，我给你带了点东西。它几乎就是从他们口袋里掉出来的，所以我想他们大概不会发现少了吧。

entries.text: Well... Okay! But I hope you're a patient teacher...
entries.translated_text: 哦，那好吧！但我希望你是一个耐心的老师...

entries.text: There are more cannibals lurking about, surely. Unless she had a big appetite.
entries.translated_text: 肯定还有其他潜伏的食人族，除非她胃口特别大。

entries.text: Oh... You do? You could be... a-a sailor, or something, though. Sailing is fun.
entries.translated_text: 哦...你会吗？不过，你可以当...水手之类的，航海很有趣。

entries.text: Really? I didn't know that. Why did the Aedra abandon him? And why did the Orcs keep following him?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？我不知道。为什么伊德拉抛弃了他？为什么兽人一直跟着他？

entries.text: Okay. No. Poke. Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 好的，不，笑，小渣。

entries.text: You know, this is why I love you. Let's head out!
entries.translated_text: 这就是我爱你的原因。让我们出发！

entries.text: Being in Winterhold is so miserable. It's desolate and sad and full of snow.
entries.translated_text: 待在冬堡真让人难受。这里荒凉、凄冷，到处都是雪。

entries.text: Oh! No, no no! Don't-
entries.translated_text: 哦不，不，不！不要-

entries.text: Is it just me, or is there a lack of air to breathe down here?
entries.translated_text: 是我的错觉，还是这里的空气真的太稀薄了？

entries.text: You must have some impressive mental fortitude to be able to sleep after all that you've seen in your adventures.
entries.translated_text: 经历了那么多冒险后还能安然入睡，你的心理素质一定非常强大。

entries.text: Five gems should be more than enough, right? Is the extra one for me?
entries.translated_text: 五颗宝石应该绰绰有余吧？额外的一份是给我的吗？

entries.text: Typical bureaucracy. The goings-on of those in power take priority over this poor woman dreading the fate of her daughter.
entries.translated_text: 典型的官僚主义。掌权者的事务比这位可怜女人为她女儿的命担忧更重要。

entries.text: Here. Why don't you try it?
entries.translated_text: 给你，你为什么不试试呢？

entries.text: I'm just trying to find things I don't like about everyone to lessen the impact if they die.
entries.translated_text: 我只是在努力找出每个人身上我不喜欢的地方，这样如果他们死了，对我的影响就会小一些。

entries.text: I'm just trying to find things I don't like about everyone to lessen the impact if they die.
entries.translated_text: 我只是在努力找出每个人身上我不喜欢的地方，这样如果他们死了，对我的影响就会小一些。

entries.text: (Whisper) There's nothing for me to even unlock!
entries.translated_text: （低语）我甚至没有什么可以解锁的！

entries.text: Are you... Are you serious?
entries.translated_text: 你...你是认真的吗？

entries.text: I'll be right behind you, Mortu.
entries.translated_text: 我会在你身后，莫尔图。

entries.text: If I were looking for a fugitive Blade, the underground of a shady city is the absolute first place I'd look. It's a wonder he's stayed hidden.
entries.translated_text: 如果我要寻找逃亡的刀锋卫士，那座阴暗城市的地下绝对是我首先要看的地方，他能一直隐藏起来真是个奇迹。

entries.text: Yes, and I've found that it's the personal things that people will kill over. Were the Boethiah faithful you knew like that?
entries.translated_text: 是的，而且我发现人们会因为这些私事而厮杀。你认识的波耶西亚信徒是这样的吗？

entries.text: That's not what I said; you're twisting my words-
entries.translated_text: 我可没这么说。

entries.text: The Verse really is written on paper... And is illegible.
entries.translated_text: 这节写在纸上的诗真是...难以辨认。

entries.text: I guess you're right.
entries.translated_text: 我想你是对的。

entries.text: Hi. I think we'll be travelling together. My name is Remi.
entries.translated_text: 你好。我想我们将一起旅行。我叫蕾米。

entries.text: Maybe I'll try it again someday, with a more open mind.
entries.translated_text: 也许有一天我会换种心态再试试。

entries.text: I've had time to brew a few.
entries.translated_text: 我有时间酿了一些。

entries.text: So Solitude was where you were dropped off after leaving Cyrodiil, Yaz? How does it compare to the Imperial City?
entries.translated_text: 那么说来独孤城就是你离开赛瑞迪尔后落脚的地方对吗，雅扎？它和帝都相比怎么样？

entries.text: I've noticed it's hard for you to understand when you're being propositioned.
entries.translated_text: 我注意到当有人向你求婚时，你很难理解。

entries.text: The dwemer called this place 'Fal'Zhardum Din', or 'The Blackest Reaches'. Thus, 'Blackreach'.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫称这个地方为“Fal'ZhardumDin”，或“最黑暗的地方”。因此得名'黑境'。

entries.text: Oh, wow! That sounds-wait, what? You *broke*... And it was... You know what, yeah, that does sound awesome, Khash!
entries.translated_text: 哇！那听起来——等等，什么？你摔断了...而且还是...算了，总之，是啊，那听起来真的很棒，卡什！

entries.text: Is the name 'Aetherium' hinting at its origin being of Divine essence?
entries.translated_text: “神光水晶”这个名字，是不是暗示它的起源是圣灵精华？

entries.text: Ohh, that'll get their attention if nothing else. Relating the city's fate to that of the dwemer... How chilling!
entries.translated_text: 哦，这样一来，即使别的没奏效，也一定能引起他们的注意。把这座城市的命运与锻莫的相提并论...多么吓人！

entries.text: Some things just never cross your mind, until they do.
entries.translated_text: 有些事在它真的会发生前，我根本想都没想过。

entries.text: Revan, Scrap is shy, but you should know that he likes you.
entries.translated_text: 雷文，小渣很害羞，但你应该知道他喜欢你。

entries.text: No, no, no- Wait, are you actually interested in those things?
entries.translated_text: 不，不，不...等等，你真的对这些东西感兴趣吗？

entries.text: A beetle-puff would be good right now.
entries.translated_text: 现在有一只甲虫泡芙就不错了。

entries.text: Glad to hear it, otherwise this would become very dull.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴听到这个，否则这一路会变得很沉闷。（Glad，G开头）

entries.text: I have to ask, though... Hasn't the Thalmor occupation... changed the forests?
entries.translated_text: 不过，我不得不问...梭默的占领...难道没有改变那些森林吗？

entries.text: Do you- Do you suppose he typically sits staring at his corpse? I can think of a million more entertaining things to do as a ghost.
entries.translated_text: 你——你认为他通常都坐在那里盯着他的尸体吗？我能想到好多件做一个幽灵可做的有趣事情。

entries.text: The only ones brave enough to continue following him were the Orcs.
entries.translated_text: 唯一勇敢地继续跟随他的是兽人。

entries.text: (Laugh) Right, right! You *just* told me you want ale. Let me see...
entries.translated_text: (笑)对，对!你**告诉我你想要麦芽酒。让我看看...

entries.text: I am *very* interested in this control cube Neloth has. How does it work, exactly?
entries.translated_text: 我对尼洛施拥有的这个控制魔方*非常*感兴趣。它究竟是如何运作的？

entries.text: Oh, oh, get some wine!
entries.translated_text: 噢，噢，喝点酒！

entries.text: Oh.
entries.translated_text: 噢。

entries.text: Alright, Scrap, let's get them! I mean- Not you. You're not allowed to fight. Sorry!
entries.translated_text: 好了，小渣，我们来处理他们！我是说-不是你。你不能战斗，抱歉。

entries.text: Ilia, if you could kill them now, I'd appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚，如果你现在能杀了他们，我将不胜感激！

entries.text: And that definitely bothers me more than it bothers you, believe me.
entries.translated_text: 相信我，我肯定比你更加困惑。

entries.text: Oh. Don't scare me like that! (Sigh)
entries.translated_text: 哦。不要那样吓我！（叹）

entries.text: I do not get how Remi can stand this place? It is just so, ugh!
entries.translated_text: 我不明白蕾米怎么能忍受这个地方？这里实在是...唉！

entries.text: You know, Ilia, Scrap likes you. He's never told you because he's shy.
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，伊利亚，小渣喜欢你。他从来没有告诉你，因为他很害羞。

entries.text: Hm... Yeah, I guess so.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...是的，我想是的。

entries.text: (Gasp) Don't be rude! He has feelings, you know. Besides, it's not like he's some wild beast! He's my sweet, beautiful Dwemer spider!
entries.translated_text: （喘气）别这么无礼！他也有感情，你知道的。再说了，他又不是什么野兽！他是我可爱、漂亮的锻莫蜘蛛！

entries.text: \It's been hundreds of years since Valerica entered the Soul Cairn. Who knows how far she could've gone in that time?
entries.translated_text: \自从瓦蕾莉卡进入灵魂石冢以来，已经有数百年的历史了。谁知道那段时间她能走多远？

entries.text: I sort of assumed I was coming with already, so...
entries.translated_text: 我有点以为我已经要一起去了，所以…

entries.text: We should take all the artifacts we can carry from here. If any locked doors get in your way, let me know, and I'll take care of them.
entries.translated_text: 我们应该从这里拿走所有能带走的文物，如果有什么上锁的门挡了你的路，请告诉我，我会处理好它们。

entries.text: Yes, yes. I hope you're planning on taking me to a nice ruin, since I'm missing out on what could have been a night to remember.
entries.translated_text: 没错没错，我希望你正在考虑带我去一片神秘的遗址，因为我错过了一个本可以值得纪念的夜晚。

entries.text: Although, I do feel a bit guilty, planning this without your input...
entries.translated_text: 虽然，我确实感到有点内疚，背着你的情况下计划这个...

entries.text: (Squeal) This is amazing, Val! You're the best! We will share it tonight, right? You'll have some with me?!
entries.translated_text: （尖叫）这太神奇了，瓦尔！你是最好的！我们今晚就分享，对吧？你会和我一起尝尝吗？！

entries.text: Yay, I love being able to use my lantern! She's so pretty!
entries.translated_text: 耶，我就喜欢用我的灯！她太漂亮了！

entries.text: Have you had the chance to cook anything?
entries.translated_text: 你有机会做饭吗？

entries.text: O-oh! I-I... Sorry, I wasn't thinking! I shouldn't have... without permission. So sorry!
entries.translated_text: 哦！我...对不起，我没过脑子！我不应该...未经允许就那样做。真的很抱歉！

entries.text: Temple of Dibella
entries.translated_text: 蒂贝拉神殿

entries.text: 'The Bonded City', then?
entries.translated_text: “结盟之城”，是吗？

entries.text: I love talking about home! I'm glad to have found someone else from High Rock to discuss it with!
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢谈论家！我很高兴能找到其他来自高岩省的人一起讨论这个话题！

entries.text: Was that all, Raven?
entries.translated_text: 就这些吗，渡鸦？

entries.text: Yes, I thought your muscles were getting a bit thin. Didn't you notice?
entries.translated_text: 是的，我觉得你的肌肉有点变小了。你没注意到吗？

entries.text: Marlok was really upset with me afterwards, though... I was grounded for weeks...
entries.translated_text: 事后马洛克对我很生气...我被禁足了好几个星期...

entries.text: Wow, vampire politics are *almost* as bad as Breton politics.
entries.translated_text: 哇，吸血鬼政治*几乎*与布莱顿政治一样糟糕。

entries.text: She's my father's daughter, so my step-sister. She's also a good twelve years older than I am.
entries.translated_text: 她是我父亲的女儿，所以是我的继妹。她也比我大十二岁。

entries.text: She's my father's daughter, so my step-sister. She's also a good twelve years older than I am.
entries.translated_text: 她是我父亲的女儿，所以是我的继妹。她也比我大十二岁。

entries.text: Scrap did not eat the Dwemer! He's not a traitor. And he's not a 'magic spider'!
entries.translated_text: 小渣才没有吃锻莫！他不是叛徒！他也不是 "魔法蜘蛛"!

entries.text: You know, Suryvel, Scrap likes you. He's never told you because he's shy.
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，苏里维尔，小渣喜欢你。他从来没有告诉你，是因为他很害羞。

entries.text: Now that Gore is picking up more and more quickly on reading, sticking notes making fun of him to his back is much more fun!
entries.translated_text: 现在格雷看书越来越快，在他背后贴取消的笔记越来越有意思了！

entries.text: ...The throne of Wayrest, pft...
entries.translated_text: ...途歇城的宝座...

entries.text: Well, at least they're letting you have a bed, right? I'd prefer the Bannered Mare, personally, but I suppose I'll keep you company, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，至少他们给你张床，对吧？虽然我个人更喜欢母马旗帜，但我想我会陪你，我的朋友。

entries.text: Traveling about, accidentally begin thinking about the genius of a potential experiment, and leave behind everything you own.
entries.translated_text: 在旅行时，不小心开始思考一个潜在实验的天才构想，然后把自己所有的东西都落下了。

entries.text: Maybe. What else am I going to do with it?
entries.translated_text: 也许，我还能指望他做什么呢？

entries.text: Ew... Listen to the sounds it's making!
entries.translated_text: 呃...听听它发出的声音！

entries.text: A pleasure to meet you.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴见到你。

entries.text: The wild clans bow to nobody except Y'ffre and the Wilderking.
entries.translated_text: 森林氏族只向伊’弗尔和荒野之王屈膝。

entries.text: Especially considering Neloth's 'Control Cube'.
entries.translated_text: 特别是考虑到尼洛施的“控制魔方”。

entries.text: Always a silver lining.
entries.translated_text: 凡事总有好的一面。

entries.text: You'd have to be more specific. I don't even think I remember most of what I say in these little tiffs we get into.
entries.translated_text: 你得说得更具体些。我都不记得我到底说过哪些了。

entries.text: You know, you're very quiet. I wasn't sure I'd like that when I first met you but I like being able to talk so much without fear of interrupting you.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，你很安静。我第一次见到你的时候还不确定自己是否喜欢这样的，但我喜欢能和你说这么多话，而不用担心打扰到你。

entries.text: will get what's coming to them. One way or another.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，也要付出代价！

entries.text: (Laugh) Oh, I think it would be worth it, either way.
entries.translated_text: （笑）哦，不管怎样，我认为这都是值得的。

entries.text: This is a rather... strange family. 'Our brothers.' We hardly know these people.
entries.translated_text: 这真是一个相当...奇怪的家庭。“我们的兄弟”，我们就几乎不认识这些人。

entries.text: You've been causing me a lot of problems, Remiel. And I've grown tired of it. Your little stunt with the Order of the Hour sealed your fate.
entries.translated_text: 你一直在给我制造很多麻烦，蕾米尔。而我已经受够了。你在时序团那出小把戏决定了你的下场。

entries.text: Yes, I'll let him know.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我会让他知道的。

entries.text: We're in a dwemer ruin! Are you excited? Because I am!
entries.translated_text: 我们在锻莫遗址中！你兴奋吗？因为我就很兴奋！

entries.text: Did I just put my Elsweyr Fondue or my Damage Health Potion into my stew? Ummm... I'm sure it's fine.
entries.translated_text: 我刚刚把我的艾斯维尔起司锅或生命伤害药水放进炖菜里了吗？嗯...我确定没问题。

entries.text: What do you know about the Charoud family?
entries.translated_text: 你对夏鲁家族了解多少？

entries.text: Shoot them, Khash!
entries.translated_text: 射他们，卡什！

entries.text: He only has so many fingers.
entries.translated_text: 他只有这么多手指。

entries.text: J'zargo and I get along very well. I've never had a friend quite like him before. He's very sure of himself.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格和我相处得很好。我以前从未有过像他这样的朋友。他对自己非常有把握。

entries.text: I mean, of course I always meant to uphold my end of the deal.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，我当然一直打算履行我这边的约定。

entries.text: By Sheor, Yaz, I'm not doing too great!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，雅扎，我做得不太好！

entries.text: Thanks, but it's...
entries.translated_text: 谢谢，不过...

entries.text: Ahh, yes. I know just what you mean. I did hear something rather interesting the other day.
entries.translated_text: 啊，是的。我知道你是什么意思。某天我确实听到过一些相当有趣的事情。

entries.text: That's alright. Let me know if you find any.
entries.translated_text: 没关系，如果你找到了点，请告诉我。

entries.text: Maybe he'd dance! Oh, Scrap, I'd *love* to dance with you!
entries.translated_text: 也许他愿意跳舞！哦，小渣，我*爱*和你跳舞!

entries.text: Watch where you're throwing that lightning, J'zargo! I think you've singed some of my hair!
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格，注意你在投掷闪电的地方！我想你已经把我的头发烧焦了！

entries.text: Wait, they want to eat that Priest of Arkay?! I-I... You must understand, this... use of corpses is...
entries.translated_text: 等等，他们想吃掉阿尔凯祭司？我...你得明白，这...要用的尸体是...

entries.text: Oh, this Alain Dufont sounds like a prick. Suddenly Muiri's request to the Brotherhood sounds good to me. He deserves what's coming to him.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这个亚兰·杜锋特听起来像个混蛋，突然间，暮蕊对兄弟会的请求听起来不错，这是他应得的。

entries.text: Then it seems we're on the same page.
entries.translated_text: 然后看起来你已经知道了。

entries.text: I'm from Skyrim. Born and raised.
entries.translated_text: 我来自天际。土生土长。

entries.text: I hate to admit it, but I have forgotten how to mingle with strangers.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我不愿意承认，但我已经快忘记了如何与陌生人交往。

entries.text: One time, they convinced me that there was a sunken treasure in the sewer system.
entries.translated_text: 有一次，他们让我相信下水道中有一个沉没的宝藏。

entries.text: Er, m-maybe I'm getting ahead of myself. It's my home, so I'm very glad you liked it there!
entries.translated_text: 也许我说得太多了。那是我的家，所以我很高兴你喜欢那里！

entries.text: I'm not surprised that Igmund's father was betrayed by the Forsworn. In my experience, they aren't particularly open to talking.
entries.translated_text: 我对依格蒙德的父亲被弃誓者背叛并不感到惊讶。根据我的经验，他们并不是特别愿意交谈。

entries.text: He's made the arrangements through his contact in Riften. Should we want him to send us things, all we'll need to do is talk with this contact.
entries.translated_text: 他通过他在裂谷城的联系人做了点安排。如果我们想让他给我们寄东西，我们只需要和这个联系人说就行。

entries.text: Here, let me write in a translation for you.
entries.translated_text: 来，让我为你写一份翻译。

entries.text: Oh Sweet Mara. Isn't that... dangerous for us?! Won't the rest of the Forsworn... know?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，亲爱的玛拉。这对我们来说...是不是很危险？其他的弃誓者不会... 知道吗？

entries.text: Well, how do you feel?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你感觉如何？

entries.text: I think we're just the right height to stick it in the ass!
entries.translated_text: 我认为以我们的身高正好适合把它放在屁股上！

entries.text: And in my mind's eye, the food that was layed out was a first course of stuffed capon, accompanied by sliced fox tongues.
entries.translated_text: 而在我的想象中，呈上餐桌的第一道美食就是酿制山羊肉搭配狐舌薄片。

entries.text: And in my mind's eye, the food that was layed out was a first course of stuffed capon, accompanied by sliced fox tongues.
entries.translated_text: 而在我的想象中，呈上餐桌的第一道美食就是酿制山羊肉搭配狐舌薄片。

entries.text: Did you need something, Thorn?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，荆棘？

entries.text: But I can heal myself alright.
entries.translated_text: 但我可以治愈自己。

entries.text: Ok.
entries.translated_text: 好的。

entries.text: Ughhhh, I'm so bored! Don't you wish we were in a dwemer ruin, Auri?
entries.translated_text: 呜呜呜，我好无聊！你不希望我们去锻莫遗址玩吗，奥璃？

entries.text: Hey! To be fair, I have seen dozens of mechanical spiders, and Scrap is the first one that wasn't trying to kill me.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，公平地说，我见过几十只机械蜘蛛，而只有小渣是第一个不想杀死我的。

entries.text: Falkreath is a beautiful little town. And it has a cemetary! Let's go ghost hunting!
entries.translated_text: 佛克瑞斯是一个漂亮的小镇，它有一个墓地！我们去抓鬼吧！

entries.text: I feel ridiculous. It is pretty cute when his soul gem glows and he waves his little front legs like that, though...
entries.translated_text: 我觉得很可笑。不过，当他的灵魂石发光时，他挥动小前肢的样子还是挺可爱的......

entries.text: Oh, you heard that, too, then? I thought I was imagining things.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那你也听到了吗？我以为是我的想象。

entries.text: How about your family? What are they like?
entries.translated_text: 你的家人呢？他们是什么样的人？

entries.text: That's what I was wondering.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我想知道的。

entries.text: Maybe they won't be so hateful towards me.
entries.translated_text: 也许他们不会那么讨厌我。

entries.text: Oh, he's an especially awful one! Great idea!
entries.translated_text: 哦，他的确是一个特别可怕的魔神！很好的主意！

entries.text: I got caught up in a scheme that guards themselves were in on.
entries.translated_text: 我被卷入了一个连守卫自己也参与了的阴谋。

entries.text: The first mistake is thinking I couldn't keep up.
entries.translated_text: 最大的错误是认为我会喝不过你。

entries.text: Search Markarth for Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 在马卡斯中搜索莫维奇。

entries.text: Search Markarth for Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 在马卡斯中搜索莫维克。

entries.text: Sorry, I'll try to come up with better ideas in the future.
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，以后我会努力想出更好的主意。

entries.text: What are you scheming, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 你在策划什么，蕾米？

entries.text: That seems like it matters.
entries.translated_text: 这似乎很重要。

entries.text: Keening is supposed to harness the raw power of the Heart of Lorkhan, which makes it incredibly dangerous to wield.
entries.translated_text: 哀恸应该利用了洛克汗之心的原始力量，这使得使用起来非常危险。

entries.text: This letter tells us next to nothing. What is this little symbol for the signature all about? Oh, I hope Maven doesn't get angry about this.
entries.translated_text: 这封信几乎什么都没有告诉我们，这个签名的小符号是什么？哦，我希望玛雯不会因此而生气。

entries.text: Oh a healer, then? I guess we're leaving the fighting to Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 哦，一个治疗师，然后呢？我想我们要把战斗留给小渣吧？

entries.text: Oh a healer, then? I guess we're leaving the fighting to Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 哦，治疗师，然后呢？我想我们要把战斗留给小渣去打？

entries.text: With the corsair...?
entries.translated_text: 那艘海盗船......？

entries.text: No, I'll handle this myself.
entries.translated_text: 不，我会自己处理好。

entries.text: Giving you a little present is a plus, though!
entries.translated_text: 不过，还能顺便送你个小礼物！

entries.text: Tusk them up, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 戳穿他们，小渣！

entries.text: That must be where he got the name.
entries.translated_text: 那一定是他得到这个名字原因。

entries.text: ...But doesn't have the wherewithall to acknowledge you're not this 'Hjalti'.
entries.translated_text: ...但却没法承认你不是这个"希雅提"。

entries.text: I'm happy to say our first joint business venture went quite well! Here's your share of the gold, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我很开心，我们首次合作很顺利！这是你的那份，蕾米。

entries.text: I was pretty spoiled. And I guess I got lucky.
entries.translated_text: 真是娇生惯养，回想起来我真幸运。

entries.text: Ubbe. Ubbe. Look at me. Do not forget me here. Ubbe, I will be so sad. Do not forget me.
entries.translated_text: 乌贝，乌贝，看着我。在这里别忘了我。乌贝，我会很伤心的，别忘了我。

entries.text: Yes! Imagine what I could create if I understood how Aetherium items are forged!
entries.translated_text: 是的！想象一下，如果我了解了神光水晶物品是如何锻造的，我能创造出什么！

entries.text: The Gourmet. I'm with The Gourmet. I'm supposed to be, ah, going in with them.
entries.translated_text: 美食家。我和美食家在一起。我应该，啊，和他们一起进去。

entries.text: Hey! You remember that book you gave me 'Chaurus Pie: A Recipe'?
entries.translated_text: 嘿！你还记得你给我的那本《巢蚁薄饼：食谱》吗？

entries.text: Did you ever think we'd end up travelling with a vampire?
entries.translated_text: 你有没有想过我们最终会和吸血鬼一起旅行？

entries.text: On a scale of Korir to Tolfdir, I'd say I'm probably somewhere in the middle.
entries.translated_text: 如果以科利尔和托夫迪尔作为两极,我想我自己可能处在中间程度。

entries.text: Yuck, my socks are soggy.
entries.translated_text: 哎呀，我的袜子湿透了。

entries.text: Yeah, yeah, I've heard it all before. It won't change my mind.
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，我以前都听说过。但这不会改变我的想法。

entries.text: How are your lungs? All that ash... Does it mean that you can breathe better than the average Mer when you're not in Morrowind?
entries.translated_text: 你的肺还好吗？那里有那么多灰烬...这是否说明，当你不在晨风时，你比一般的莫呼吸质量更好？

entries.text: Okay, I think I'm sorry I asked.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想我很抱歉我问了这个问题。

entries.text: I grew up in the city of Blacklight, in Morrowind.
entries.translated_text: 我在晨风的黑光城长大。

entries.text: 'Ideally.' It sounds like a lot of extra work to do it that way.
entries.translated_text: “理想情况下”，这样做听起来要花费很多额外的工作。

texts: I... No... Not right now. Maybe someday, when I know you better, and you know me better.
我……不……现在不行。也许有一天，当我更了解你，而你更了解我的时候。

entries.text: U-uh! Well. It-It's not-not finished yet. So...
entries.translated_text: 呃呃！真棒。它——它还没有——还没有完成。所以...

entries.text: I love books. It's like being able to talk to someone, but without the risk of them becoming angry or sad.
entries.translated_text: 我爱书。这就像能与人交流一样喜欢，但这又不会让别人生气或伤心。

entries.text: Did you need something, Joshua?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，约书亚？

entries.text: Oh, that's genius, Remi! Write that down, write that down...
entries.translated_text: 哦, 我真是天才, 蕾米！写下来，写下来...

entries.text: We will have wine and steak, lavender and roses. This may take months to plan, but it will be a labour of love.
entries.translated_text: 我们要葡萄酒、牛排、薰衣草和玫瑰。这可能需要几个月的准备，但这将是一场充满爱的行动。

entries.text: But yeah, I don't think most people think about how they look until the rest of the world gives them a reason to.
entries.translated_text: 但是，是的，我认为大多数人不会在意他们的外表，直到别人问起。

entries.text:
</font>

<font face='$HandwrittenFont'>Ingjen,

We've been saddled with some milk-drinking researchers. The old man has employed us all to head into some Dwemer city, or the like, and I can't say I'm looking forward to it. It's looking to be a difficult couple of weeks, trying to keep an eye out for several researchers who can barely keep focused on one thing at a time. Doesn't help that some of them seem a little shifty. I'll write you again once this job is over and I can rinse my hands of this Dwemer business.

Alethius
</font>
entries.translated_text:
</font>

<fontface='$HandwrittenFont'>英杰恩，

我们被派去照顾一些怯懦的研究员。那位老头子雇佣了我们所有人，要我们前往某个矮人城市之类的地方，我可不怎么期待这次任务。接下来的几周恐怕会很难熬，得时刻留意这些研究员，而他们几乎连一件事都难以集中注意力。更糟糕的是，其中有些人看起来还有点可疑。等这次任务结束后，我会再给你写信，到时候我就可以把这锻莫生意撇清了。

阿勒修斯
</font>

entries.text: If you see a big wind-up, get out of the way or bash them with your shield.
entries.translated_text: 如果你看到一个大挥击时，躲开或用你的盾牌猛击它们。

entries.text: Hmm... Well, probably to work on some projects. That's what workshops are for, right?!
entries.translated_text: 嗯...好吧，应该是做一些项目。这就是工作室的目的，不是吗？

entries.text: We didn't have servants bringing us the platters. No, we were all in the kitchen together before the meal, and then we shared the table during.
entries.translated_text: 但我们没有仆人给我们参茶倒水。是的，我们在用餐前都在厨房里忙活，然后在用餐时一起在餐桌上共享美味。

entries.text: Who in Oblivion is that?
entries.translated_text: 那究竟是谁？

entries.text: They built inside a natural cavern and then expanded it to suit their needs... That's smart. It makes construction simpler.
entries.translated_text: 他们在一个天然洞穴内建造巢穴，然后根据需要进行扩展...这很聪明。这使得施工变得更简单。

entries.text: Hey! I can hear you!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！我能听见你说啥！

entries.text: Well, little Scrap, maybe you want to see the world?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，小小渣，也许你想看看这个世界？

entries.text: (Sigh) Fine.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）好吧。

entries.text: At least one good thing came out of your drunken decision, seeing as I'm going to be traveling with you as well!
entries.translated_text: 至少你做的酒后决定带来了一件好事，因为我也要和你一起旅行！

entries.text: Don't worry, I would've run into that if you hadn't.
entries.translated_text: 别担心，如果你没有，我会的。

entries.text: Aren't you supposed to be on the floor above?
entries.translated_text: 你不是应该在楼上吗？

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city, since I had already killed the giant spider, Nimhe, who was infesting it. I recall seeing a dead body near there; maybe it will have something of interest to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经同意带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗址，因为我已经杀死了侵扰它的巨型蜘蛛尼姆赫。我记得在附近看到一具尸体；说不定会引起蕾米的兴趣。

entries.text: I think it's time for a drink.
entries.translated_text: 我想该喝一杯了。

entries.text: I know some people find it boring, but I like poring over research notes. It's like a game, solving puzzles.
entries.translated_text: 我知道有些人觉得这很无聊，但我喜欢仔细研究研究笔记。解决难题，这就像一个游戏一样。

entries.text: It's not that I'm keeping a secret from you! It-It...
entries.translated_text: 这并不是说我有什么秘密!它-它-它...

entries.text: O-oh. Right. Okay, er, whenever you're ready!
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，呃，只要你准备好了！

entries.text: Hey the-Woah, wait, why aren't you wearing anything?
entries.translated_text: 嘿 - 哇，等等，你怎么什么都没穿？
