entries.text: At last! Why is it time passes so slowly when I'm waiting to have gold to spend? Thank you, Val.
entries.translated_text: 终于到了，为什么我等着花金币的时间过得这么慢？谢谢你，瓦尔。

entries.text: It's so warm in here.
entries.translated_text: 这里好暖和。

entries.text: Why would you steal a goat? Actually, now that I think about it, I have vague memories of holding a rope and... Hm. Do you think the giant paid me?
entries.translated_text: 你为什么要偷山羊？事实上，现在我想起来了，我对牵着绳子和...嗯。你认为巨人付给我钱吗？

entries.text: She tried to teach me once. It didn't go well.
entries.translated_text: 她曾经教过我一次。并不顺利。

entries.text: She tried to teach me once. It didn't go well.
entries.translated_text: 她曾经教过我一次，但并不顺利。

entries.text: You didn't like when we had to confront people with the Thieve's Guild.
entries.translated_text: 你不喜欢我们必须面对盗贼公会的时候。

entries.text: What in Oblivion does that mean?
entries.translated_text: 这到底是什么意思？

entries.text: You know, you're starting to make me think you don't like Markarth after all. You think the beauty is outweighed by the foreman and bad meat?
entries.translated_text: 你知道，你开始让我觉得你根本不喜欢马卡斯城。你是觉得它的美丽根本比不上那些监工和烂肉？

entries.text: Ria, are you okay? Alive and well? At least alive?
entries.translated_text: 利亚，你还好吗？还活着吗？至少还活着？

entries.text: Let's talk about projects.
entries.translated_text: 让我们聊聊项目。

entries.text: Let's talk about projects.
entries.translated_text: 让我们聊聊项目。

entries.text: Let's talk about projects.
entries.translated_text: 让我们聊聊项目。

entries.text: Let's talk about projects.
entries.translated_text: 让我们聊聊项目。

entries.text: Ah! I passed through there on my way to Skyrim. The ruins there were astounding, and not just the Dwemer ones, even though it pains me to admit.
entries.translated_text: 我在去往天际的路上经过了那里。那里的遗址令人震惊，而且不仅仅只是锻莫的废墟，尽管我不得不承认这一点。

entries.text: Well, if I was one, I'd get seriously irritated by all the clanking my body made. Would really make me appreciate the comparative silence of bones.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果我是其中一员，我也会很烦我身体发出的叮当响。我还是更喜欢骨头的安静。

entries.text: Remiel. Call me Remi. So... you're a mercenary? I guess that means you're good with a sword?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔，叫我蕾米。所以...你是佣兵？我想这意味着你擅长使剑？

entries.text: I suppose Wuunferth was innocent after all. Oh well. Any mistakes in pursuit of ridding the world of a disgusting necromancer is worth the cost.
entries.translated_text: 我想巫恩菲斯毕竟是无辜的。哦，好吧。宁可杀错一千，不可放过一人。

entries.text: You're no fun.
entries.translated_text: 你好没意思。

entries.text: Skyrim would be so much more palatable if there were automatons in the cities.
entries.translated_text: 如果城市里有机器人，天际将会变得更宜人。

entries.text: That's how I feel every time I go into a dwemer ruin, too.
entries.translated_text: 我每次走进锻莫遗址也是这样的感觉。

entries.text: Look out for its tentacles! They can give you quite a shock!
entries.translated_text: 小心它的触手！它们可以麻痹你！

entries.text: If we used something else to help apply pressure or tension, that would make those locks a breeze.
entries.translated_text: 如果我们使用其他东西来帮助施加压力或张力，那会让那些锁开得轻而易举。

entries.text: Or perhaps you're more afraid of where it will be moving on to.
entries.translated_text: 或者也许你更害怕它会被带到哪里。

entries.text: Yes, Sunder.
entries.translated_text: 是的，桑德。

entries.text: I swear, if you hurt Remi!
entries.translated_text: 我发誓，要是你敢伤害蕾米的话！

entries.text: 'En' as a suffix adds to the meaning of 'kagr.' Perhaps 'En' as a prefix, subtracts from the meaning.
entries.translated_text: “En”作为后缀增加了“kagr”的含义。或许“En”作为前缀时，会反而削弱了其含义。

entries.text: No, no, no! Do not attack Buffy! Do not attack me!
entries.translated_text: 不 不 不！不要攻击巴非！不要攻击我！

entries.text: I keep mistaking Remiel's spider for an enemy. I can't tell you how many times I've almost shot it. Don't tell her.
entries.translated_text: 我一直误以为蕾米尔的小蜘蛛是敌人，我好多次都差点射向它，别告诉她。

entries.text: I mean look at me. I'm rather delicate.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是看看我。我很脆弱。

entries.text: Oh, you're breathtaking! And very much on fire!
entries.translated_text: 哦，你真是惊艳绝伦！而且，确实火力全开！

entries.text: It's absolutely dreadful.
entries.translated_text: 听起来就可怕。

entries.text: Wow, did you read my mind? Or was it my facial expression?
entries.translated_text: 哇，你会读心术吗？还是从我的表情看出来的？

entries.text: We work well together, don't we, Joshua?
entries.translated_text: 我们合作得很好，不是吗，约书亚？

entries.text: Oh no. Why do we have to be the ones to tell her? Aldis should be telling her! It's not our job to make old ladies sad! What if she starts crying?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，不。为什么要由我们来告诉她？应该由艾迪斯来告诉她!让老太太伤心不是我们的工作!如果她开始哭了怎么办？

entries.text: I think we better get going. I hear someone calling me somewhere over there. Away from the crazy person.
entries.translated_text: 我想我们最好走了。我听到那边有人在叫我。我要远离那个疯子。

entries.text: I suppose it doesn't really matter what it is, so long as it works.
entries.translated_text: 我想这并不重要，只要它能发挥作用就行。

entries.text: Uh, yeah. I'm sure we'll become the best of friends. Y'know, once I've cleaned my teeth.
entries.translated_text: 呃，是的。我相信我们会成为最好的朋友。你知道的，一旦我洗干净了牙齿。

entries.text: Divines know I was the same way.
entries.translated_text: 圣灵作证，我那时候也是一样想的。

entries.text: I've got swords, spells, and a few other tricks up my sleeve.
entries.translated_text: 我有剑术、法术，还有一些其他的隐藏招数。

entries.text: I can't believe we actually have three Elder Scrolls. So much knowledge in the palms of our hands...
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信我们居然有三本上古卷轴。如此多的知识在我们的手掌中...

entries.text: Uh! Well. I... Maybe we can start small. Um. Oh, I know! Like the sewers! I always played in the sewers as a kid!
entries.translated_text: 呃！嗯。我...也许我们可以从小的开始。嗯。哦，我知道了！比如下水道！我小时候总是在下水道里玩！

entries.text: Maybe the ability could be distilled from your blood, for example?
entries.translated_text: 例如，也许这种能力可以从你的血液中提取出来？

entries.text: Yeah, yeah. I know you know what I mean. You can't actually like it here?
entries.translated_text: 对，对，我知道你懂我的意思。你真的不喜欢这里吗？

entries.text: For more of what?
entries.translated_text: 为了更多的什么？

entries.text: Are you okay?! I was debating the merits of going off exploring on my own when I heard the news!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？听到这个消息的时候，我正在犹豫是否独自去探险！

entries.text: So... how do you feel about it? My father's a heartless bastard, but I still wouldn't want to see his corpse wandering around.
entries.translated_text: 所以。。。你对此有何感想？我爸爸即使是个无情的混蛋，但我还是不想看到他的尸体四处游荡。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. Morvic decided to take matters into his own hands, traveling to Skyrim to hunt down Remiel. Despite his plotting, we managed to kill him. Remi now wants to stay in Arkngchal, saying she has "design plans" for the ruin. I should take care of any other business I have and then return to see her progress.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。莫维克决定自己动手，前往天际追捕蕾米尔。尽管有他的阴谋，我们还是设法杀死了他。蕾米现在想留在阿卡切尔，说她对遗址有“设计计划”。我应该处理我拥有的任何其他业务，然后再回来看看她的进展。

entries.text: (Laughs) I've never felt my heart beat so fast!
entries.translated_text: (笑)我活得好得很!

entries.text: That... wasn't as unpleasant as I thought it would be.
entries.translated_text: 这...没有我想象那么糟。

entries.text: Excellent. I think you'll be glad that you made this decision.
entries.translated_text: 太棒了，我想你会庆幸你做了这个决定。

entries.text: I hope I don't run into anyone I know.
entries.translated_text: 我希望我不会碰到任何我认识的人。

texts: So the next place is here. Although I think I swung too far away from hot. How do you people stand the cold?
所以我的下一站是这里。但这里太冷了。你们这些人是如何忍受寒冷的？

entries.text: We'll show this Nils fellow just how diverse a Breton's palate is!
entries.translated_text: 我们将向这位纽斯展示布莱顿人的口味是多么多样！

entries.text: It's rather odd that they were able to remain undetected so long whilst bleeding a woman dry.
entries.translated_text: 很奇怪的是，他是怎么能够在让一个女人流血不止的情况下保持这么长时间不被发现的。

entries.text: Speak your mind.
entries.translated_text: 说出你的想法。

entries.text: I can't even tell you how many times I've been told by some Nord to go back to my precious forests.
entries.translated_text: 我都不知道有多少次诺德人叫我回我那瑰丽的森林去。

entries.text: Oh, nice. I've got books, smarts, and dwemer spiders. Well, one spider, at least.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不错。我有书，有智慧，还有小蜘蛛们。好吧，至少有一只蜘蛛。

entries.text: Then I'll have two bottles of mead and some wine. We must hurry. I cannot wait a second longer.
entries.translated_text: 然后我要两瓶蜂蜜酒和一些葡萄酒。我们必须快点。我不能再等了。

entries.text: Their... motivations? What motivation could they possibly have to kill me?! I'd done nothing to them.
entries.translated_text: 他们的...动机？他们有什么杀我的动机？我什么都没做。

entries.text: I realize it protects you and all, but... it seems dangerous.
entries.translated_text: 我知道它可以保护你和其他人，但是...它看起来很危险。

entries.text: If someone's bothering you, point me at them, and I'll teach them to disrespect you.
entries.translated_text: 如果有人打扰你，把我指向他们，我会教他们不尊重你。

entries.text: Listen close, adventurer...
entries.translated_text: 听着，冒险者……

entries.text: You can clearly see me standing here!
entries.translated_text: 你明明能看见我站在这里！

entries.text: With all the studying I'll be doing, I bet I'll be able to fix Scrap up to Dwemeri standards in no time!
entries.translated_text: 随着我的不断研究，我敢打赌，很快我就能把小渣修复到锻莫的标准！

entries.text: Well, sorry to let you down, but I'll be just fine.
entries.translated_text: 很抱歉让你失望了，但我会没事的。

entries.text: Part of me feels like-like... Well, it's better for my family if I am away. So. That's what I'm hiding from.
entries.translated_text: 我的隐隐感觉到……好吧，如果我不在，这对我的家人更好。所以。这就是我要躲避的。

entries.text: It's done. They're going to pay us a lot, right? Don't let them try and be cheap after we slayed a gods damned master vampire!
entries.translated_text: 搞定了。他们会付给我们很多钱，对吧？在我们杀了一个该死的吸血鬼大师之后，他们可别想小气。

entries.text: Oh, I hate these things.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我讨厌这些东西。

entries.text: The patterns that the wind makes in the ash are beautiful.
entries.translated_text: 风在灰烬中留下的图案很漂亮。

entries.text: I'm not sure why, but my stomach churned like I was on a ship, and I felt like I needed to escape from my skin.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道为什么，但我的胃像在船上一样不停翻腾，我觉得我浑身都起鸡皮疙瘩。

entries.text: You're not much of a fighter. How have you made it this far?
entries.translated_text: 你不是一个战士，又怎能走这么远？

entries.text: Ow!
entries.translated_text: 哇！

entries.text: (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: (笑声)

entries.text: (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: (笑声)

entries.text: (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: (笑声)

entries.text: (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: (笑声)

entries.text: (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: (笑声)

entries.text: (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: (笑声)

entries.text: Oh! I- Wait- I just realized we never got a ghost lute from that Ghost Bard! This is the worst.
entries.translated_text: 哦！我——等等——我刚刚意识到我们从来没有从那个幽灵吟游诗人那里拿到过幽灵鲁特琴！太糟了。

entries.text: Oh, the courier!
entries.translated_text: 哦，信使！

entries.text: Oh, great, now I forgot what I was going to ask Yazakh. Wait... No, it's gone.
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了，现在我忘了我要问雅扎克什么。等等...不，它已经消失了。

entries.text: Look at our matching spiders!!
entries.translated_text: 看看我们这配对的蜘蛛！！

entries.text: Could you actually heal me in combat?
entries.translated_text: 你真的能在战斗中治愈我吗？

entries.text: So, Remi, why don't you tell us one of those ghost stories?
entries.translated_text: 那么，蕾米，你为什么不给我们讲一个鬼故事呢？

entries.text: I don't have time to talk, though. Why don't you go chat with the other bar patrons?
entries.translated_text: 不过我没时间说话。你为什么不去和其他酒馆顾客聊天？

entries.text: No, he doesn't. (Sigh)
entries.translated_text: 是的，他不在。（叹气）

entries.text:
You read the request from our employer. I dunno 'bout this bloke's flowery words, but he's good for the gold. You're the sneaky one, so this one's on you. Kill the engineer girl, the one with the dwarven contraption. Kill anyone with her, too, if you have to. Then come back to Solitude so we can set sail. The boat will be ready.

-L
entries.translated_text:
你读过了我们雇主的要求。我不知道这家伙说了什么花言巧语，但显然能赚钱。你是潜行好手，所以这事交给你来做。杀了那个拥有矮人装置的工程师女孩。如果有必要的话，也可以杀死和她一起的其他人。然后返回独孤城，这样我们就可以扬帆起航了。我们的船随时准备着。



-L

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. I killed Nimhe in the excavation site, but others weren't so lucky. There's a guard's body near the Nchuand-zel entrance I should investigate.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。我在挖掘现场杀死了尼姆赫，但其他人就没那么幸运了。楚安德-泽尔入口附近有一个守卫的尸体，我应该调查一下。

entries.text: The food here tastes... Well, you smell that sewer water? I think the scent is practically an ingredient.
entries.translated_text: 这里的食物尝起来...嗯，你闻到那股下水道的味道了吗？我觉得这味道简直像是配料之一。

entries.text: I will try my best.
entries.translated_text: 我会尽力的。

entries.text: Hmm... I was going to say no, but somehow I feel like i do. Does that make any sense?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我想说是的，但不知怎的，我觉得我没有。这有任何意义吗？

entries.text: You make it sound so easy. It's certainly possible, but I doubt it.
entries.translated_text: 虽然听起来很简单，但我对此表示怀疑。

entries.text: OW!
entries.translated_text: 哦！

entries.text: Oh, I am ready for a huge bowl of vegetable stew.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我准备好了一大碗炖蔬菜。

entries.text: I know that Maven is... a bad person... But is it wrong to admire her just a bit?
entries.translated_text: 我知道玛雯是...一个坏人...但只是有点佩服她有错吗？

entries.text: I've read legends of something called a 'Dark Heart' that existed somewhere near Blackreach. The dwemer stole it from a Vampire Clan.
entries.translated_text: 我读过关于存在于黑境附近某处的被称为“黑暗之心”的传说，锻莫从一个吸血鬼氏族那里偷走了它。

entries.text: Yeah, I'm sure you do. But I don't drink wine or whatever they liked back at your 'university' for sipping on.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我相信你会的。但我不喝葡萄酒或他们在你的“大学”喜欢喝的那些。

entries.text: Sounds like a deal, then!
entries.translated_text: 那就这么说定了！

entries.text: But I can see you'd rather believe yourself infallible.
entries.translated_text: 但我看得出来，你宁愿相信自己是不会犯错的。

entries.text: Right behind you.
entries.translated_text: 我紧随在后。

entries.text: Right behind you.
entries.translated_text: 我紧随在后。

entries.text: Right behind you.
entries.translated_text: 我紧随在后。

entries.text: I suppose I can understand such things. But I had nothing to do with hurting them before! I'd barely arrived in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 我想我能理解这种事。但我之前并没有伤害过他们！我那时在天际才初来乍到。

entries.text: Aetherial Lantern Enchantment
entries.translated_text: 神光水晶灯附魔效果

entries.text: It's makeup.
entries.translated_text: 这是妆扮。

entries.text: And I thought Chaurus were awful!
entries.translated_text: 而且我认为巢蚁很糟糕！

entries.text: Are you hungry? I have a snack in my bag that I found laying around.
entries.translated_text: 你饿了吗？我包里有点零食，是我刚随手捡到的。

entries.text: 'Nothing personal,' he says as he insults my wealth. Look, I'm sure you'll find plenty of riches in Nchuand-Zel.
entries.translated_text: 他一边鄙视我的财富，一边说'这可不是个人恩怨'。听着，我相信你会在楚安德-泽尔找到很多财富。

entries.text: Well, that definitely did not deactivate him.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这绝对没有让他关机。

entries.text: Have you seen my compass? I swear, if I find it in Remi's backpack...
entries.translated_text: 你看见我的指南针了吗？我发誓，如果我在蕾米的背包里找到它...

entries.text: Do you have a spare copy on you? I'd like to take a look at it without bothering that guy. He looks kind of intimidating.
entries.translated_text: 你随身带了份额外的副本吗?我想在不打扰那个家伙的情况下看一看。他看起来有点吓人。

entries.text: Arkngchal Key
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔钥匙

entries.text: Incredible.
entries.translated_text: 令人难以置信。

entries.text: Here I am, whole and healthy. My mother and father were able to scrape together enough for a small home in the poorer districts of Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 我还在这儿，完整又健康。我的父母能够在途歇城的角落再修一座自己的房子。

entries.text: Are you very familar with thieves, Yazakh?
entries.translated_text: 你对小偷很了解吗，雅扎克？

entries.text: Perfect! Okay, don't mind me, Ghorza.
entries.translated_text: 完美！好吧，别在意我，果扎。

entries.text: Don't lie to me, Ubbe. Am I dying? It feels like I'm dying.
entries.translated_text: 别骗我，乌贝，我快死了吗？感觉就像我快死了。

entries.text: Just... make sure the guard doesn't see you do it. Obviously.
entries.translated_text: 只是...确保别被发现。

entries.text: Wait, he wants us to get him another staff? You have to be kidding me.
entries.translated_text: 等等，他想让我们再给他找一根法杖？你在跟我开玩笑。

entries.text: Talk to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 与蕾米交谈。

entries.text: Talk to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 与蕾米交谈。

entries.text: Talk to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 与蕾米交谈。

entries.text: Talk to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 与蕾米交谈。

entries.text: Talk to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 与蕾米交谈。

texts: Oh sure, keep pestering me, then, by all means.
哦，当然，继续纠缠我，那么，无论如何。

entries.text: I come from Argonia. You know it as Black Marsh.
entries.translated_text: 我来自阿尔贡尼亚，你知道它是黑沼泽吧。

entries.text: All sorts of incredible plants must thrive in this swamp!
entries.translated_text: 各种不可思议的植物只能在这片沼泽才能长出！

entries.text: You said something about Keening being broken?
entries.translated_text: 你说哀恸坏了？

entries.text: You said something about him retracing your footsteps?
entries.translated_text: 你说他在寻找你？

entries.text: Stay safe.
entries.translated_text: 注意安全。

entries.text: Take that! Nar, did you see that?!
entries.translated_text: 拿走那个！纳尔，你看到了吗？！

entries.text: Oh, I see, we're *lying* to Verulus. 'Yes, Brother, the Hall is most certainly safe. No cannibals around, I swear.' What do you think? Believable?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我明白了，我们是在*欺骗*维鲁鲁斯。‘是的，兄弟，亡者之厅肯定很安全了。周围不会有食人族，我发誓。’你怎么看？你会信吗？

entries.text: Back home, there are witches who live in the wilds. They come into cities sometimes to sell their wares. I don't see that going well for Hagravens.
entries.translated_text: 回家那里，有住在荒野的女巫。他们有时会进城卖她们的商品，我认为这对乌鸦鬼婆来说不会顺利。

entries.text: Yes, dear?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了，亲爱的？

entries.text: Do you read them right to left, or left to right?
entries.translated_text: 你是从右到左读，还是从左到右读？

entries.text: Really? I'm sorry, I couldn't tell.
entries.translated_text: 真的？对不起，我不该说出来。

entries.text: These ashstorms are more brutal than Skyrim's blizzards!
entries.translated_text: 这些沙尘暴比天际的暴风雪更残酷！

entries.text: Remi's Boots
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的靴子

entries.text: So the next place is here. Although it's a lot different from Hammerfell. How do you people stand the cold?
entries.translated_text: 所以我的下一站就是这里，尽管它与落锤有很大不同。你们这些人不怕冷吗？

entries.text: Could you try watching where you're going?
entries.translated_text: 你能不能试着注意点你走的路？

entries.text: And that's why you never split up. Never ends well, from the books I've read, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 所以你们才没分开。从我读过的书来看，结局总是不好的。

entries.text: Well, I've already seen the ones in High Rock. And Hammerfell.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，是因为高岩和落锤的我已经看过了。

entries.text: You likely just haven't met the one who will make you feel these things.
entries.translated_text: 你很可能只是还没有遇到那个能让你感受到这些东西的人。

entries.text: Since we're in town, let's see how much gold I have... one, two... ten... Oh, something smells good! Wait, what was I doing?
entries.translated_text: 既然我们在城里，让我们看看我有多少金币...一，二...十...哦，闻起来很香！等等，我在做什么？

entries.text: The distinction is murder. With piracy, you kill people first. Then you steal their artefacts. While sailing on a ship.
entries.translated_text: 区别在杀人上，海盗们是在航行时，先杀人，然后偷走他们的神器。

entries.text: Ugh, I hate this place.
entries.translated_text: 呃，我讨厌这个地方。

entries.text: How did the Augur beome some sort of ethereal, incorporeal mass of magicka?
entries.translated_text: 占卜师是怎么变成某种空灵的、无形的魔法物质的？

entries.text: You're an alchemist?
entries.translated_text: 你是炼金术士？

entries.text: Alright, time to tusk up some tusker, Remi!
entries.translated_text: 好了，是时候戳穿些野兽了，蕾米!

entries.text: What if I had been carrying it while getting paralyzed like that?
entries.translated_text: 如果我带着它时却被麻痹了，那会怎么样呢？

entries.text: I guess they were pretty mysterious. Sometimes I like to think I know a bunch about them, but then I remember how little I actually know.
entries.translated_text: 我想他们确实相当神秘。有时我觉得自己知道很多关于他们的事情，但随后我又意识到我其实了解得非常少。

entries.text: (Laugh) And how much is your bounty worth, then?
entries.translated_text: （笑）那你的赏金有多少呢？

entries.text: Don't tell Yaz, but I think some food was left on her tusks again. Maybe we should tell her actually. Would it be rude *not* to tell her?
entries.translated_text: 不要告诉雅扎，但我想有些食物又留在她的牙上了。也许我们真的应该告诉她。不告诉她会不会很不礼貌？

entries.text: I can't imagine Zora without her burn. It wouldn't really be her without it, right?
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象佐拉没有烧伤的样子。没有那个伤疤就不是她了，对吧？

entries.text: So, Gore... You've brought up the Ravens a few times. They were your... mercenary-ish group?
entries.translated_text: 所以，格雷……你已经提过好几次群鸦团了。那是你的……佣兵团？

entries.text: Where could he have gone?
entries.translated_text: 他去哪儿了？

entries.text: Which might mean that 'En' refers to some organization or pattern. Giving purpose to the tones to create music.
entries.translated_text: 这可能意味着“En”指的是某种组织或模式。赋予音调以创作音乐的目的。

entries.text: No. Press. Scrap. Buttons. Him... No like.
entries.translated_text: 不要，按，小渣，的，按钮，他，不喜欢。

entries.text: By the Mane, look. A dwarven city.
entries.translated_text: 凭鬃毛起誓，看。一座矮人城市。

entries.text: You do know you're dead, don't you?
entries.translated_text: 你知道你已经死了，不是吗？

entries.text: And I can only imagine the kinds of alchemical ingredients I could find in the rainforests.
entries.translated_text: 我只能想象我能在热带雨林中找到的各种炼金材料。

entries.text: Well, it's not really like they have to hide. It seems that it's rare for the Jarls to send people to clear them out.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，他们并不是真的要躲起来。领主们似乎很少派人清剿他们。

entries.text: I don't wanna play with him anymore.
entries.translated_text: 我不想再和他玩了。

entries.text: No, don't be. I barely knew him. My step father has always been my "real" father to me.
entries.translated_text: 不，不要。我几乎不认识他。我的继父才一直是我“真正的”父亲。

entries.text: Do you ever worry animunculi are sentient? Alone in these ruins for eons, only to be cut down by us in the end?
entries.translated_text: 你担心过矮人机械是有知觉的吗？它们在这些废墟中孤独地度过漫长岁月，最终被我们斩杀？

entries.text: Until my mother would call me home, and I'd have to figure out how to get down from the branches without breaking my neck.
entries.translated_text: 直到我母亲叫我回家，我才得想办法从树枝上下来而不折断我的脖子。

entries.text: Sure. There's Jeem-La, an Argonian servant who spends most of her time cleaning her employer's gargantuan mansion.
entries.translated_text: 当然，有一个叫吉姆-拉的亚龙人女仆，她大部分时间都在为她的雇主打扫巨大的豪宅。

entries.text: We seem to have stumbled upon some Imperial scheming. It's a lofty goal, sure, but in High Rock, kings and queens are targeted on the regular.
entries.translated_text: 我们似乎偶然发现了一些帝国的阴谋。这目标倒是挺高贵的，但在高岩中，国王和王后是常客。

entries.text: I must say, the College is lovely, but being surrounded by so many mages makes me feel... lacking.
entries.translated_text: 我必须说，冬堡学院很可爱，但被这么多法师包围让我感到...不足。

entries.text: N-no! No, it's not the people you least expect!
entries.translated_text: 不——不！才不是那些你想不到的人！

entries.text: Probably refers to its membership to the alliance.
entries.translated_text: 可能是指它加入联盟的身份。

entries.text: Hey, I found you something. Just don't ask where it came from, okay?
entries.translated_text: 嘿，我给你找到了件东西，不要问它是从哪里来的，好吗？

entries.text: Woah, this is an elaborate set-up she has.
entries.translated_text: 哇，这是她的精心设计。

entries.text: Can't stop me if he's dead...
entries.translated_text: 如果他死了就不能阻止我...

entries.text: Okay, so that's one less problem for us, then. No bodies to hide.
entries.translated_text: 好的，那么这对我们来说就少了一个问题了，不用藏尸体了。

entries.text: For the weak? If you hate it that much, why come here at all?
entries.translated_text: 弱者？如果你那么讨厌它，为什么要来这里呢？

entries.text: For the weak? If you hate it that much, why come here at all?
entries.translated_text: 弱者？如果你那么讨厌它，为什么要来这里呢？

entries.text: Ah... This is...
Well... I just have so many. No, they can wait. There's just one important question I need to get out of the way.
entries.translated_text: 好吧...我只是有太多问题了。不，不急。只是有一个重要的问题我必须先问清楚。

entries.text: Alright! Mead Hall defended! Let's see if the chief wants to celebrate!
entries.translated_text: 好吧！蜜酒大厅保卫住了！看酋长要不要庆祝！

entries.text: They assumed I must have ties to them because of you. And now I've been removed from the Council and removed from my chance at the crown!
entries.translated_text: 他们认为我一定因为你而与他们有联系。而现在我已经被从议会中除名，也失去了获得王位的机会！

entries.text: I wonder how far Gore could throw Scrap. He's not a ranger, but maybe we could make our own ranged attacks in this way?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道格雷能把小渣扔多远。他虽然不是游侠，但也许我们可以用这种方法来远程攻击？

entries.text: The Forsworn must be that sort of family, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 我想，弃誓者一定是那种家庭。

entries.text: My understanding of pirates stems from stories my father would tell me when sailing. And, well, books.
entries.translated_text: 我对海盗的了解源于父亲出海时给我讲的故事。还有，嗯，书。

entries.text: Right behind you!
entries.translated_text: 就在你后面！

entries.text: Okay! Well, I'm wondering if we'd need to attach the machinery to your nervous system somehow, so you could control it?
entries.translated_text: 好吧！嗯，我在想——我们是不是得想办法把这些机械装置接到你的神经系统上，这样你才能控制它？

entries.text: How do you know so much about the Dwemer?
entries.translated_text: 你怎么对锻莫了解这么多？

entries.text: Dumac
entries.translated_text: 杜马克

entries.text: Remi, pack up! We're heading out.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，收拾东西！我们要出门了。

entries.text: By Sheor! Adventurer! Gore's not doing too great!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔啊！冒险者！格雷做得不太好！

entries.text: Oh great. I'll just eat what we have packed. Shouldn't be too rotten.
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了。那我就吃我们带的那些吧。应该还没烂得太厉害。

entries.text: A toast to a beautiful friendship! Down the hatch!
entries.translated_text: 为美好的友谊干杯！

entries.text: Yes, so it seems.
entries.translated_text: 是的，看起来是这样。

entries.text: Remi, about that piece of junk you had me pass off to the shopkeeper earlier. It looked convincingly rare. Did you work that up on your own?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，关于你之前让我转交给店主的那件破烂。看起来很稀有，是你自己做出来的吗？

entries.text: I'm really curious about how Zora lifts her sword and yet her arms are so skinny. Does she lift it with pure willpower? I could see that.
entries.translated_text: 我真的很好奇佐拉是如何举起她的剑的，但她的手臂却如此纤细。她是用纯粹的意志力举起的吗？我看得出来。

entries.text: Shall I buy you an ale, love? Or maybe snatch one while the bartender is distracted by your beautiful ass...ets?
entries.translated_text: 我给你买杯麦酒怎么样，亲爱的？或者趁酒保被你的美丽的屁...呃，吸引住的时候，顺手“借”一杯？

entries.text: Probably more familiar than I should be. Ahem.
entries.translated_text: 我本应更熟悉的。咳咳。

entries.text: Demonstrate how Nchuand-Zel's Defenses Activate
entries.translated_text: 演示楚安德-泽尔的防御如何激活

entries.text: Maybe Keening began to harness his energy, and since he didn't have Sunder to control how much of his power was accessed...
entries.translated_text: 或许哀恸开始使用自己的能量了，既然他没有桑德来控制自己的能量消耗了多少……

entries.text: You disgust me, necromancer! Let's see how well your spellcasting works without a throat!
entries.translated_text: 你让我感到恶心，死灵法师！让我们看看你的咒语在喉咙破碎后还有多大的作用!

entries.text: You're my friend, of course!
entries.translated_text: 你当然是我的朋友！

entries.text: Were you talking with someone just now? Or talking with yourself? Not that I'm in a position to judge the latter, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 你刚才是在和别人说话还是在自言自语？我想我并是很能确定后者。

entries.text: I mean, you've seen Braith in Whiterun, right?
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，你在白漫城见过布赖丝，对吧？

entries.text: And it's not mud.
entries.translated_text: 而且这不是泥。

entries.text: Anyway, I said to Greta that I was sick of them 'biting my head off' over little things, and she screamed obscenities at me and stormed off.
entries.translated_text: 总之，我对格瑞塔说，我讨厌他们为一些小事'咬我的头（大发雷霆）'，她就对我大喊着脏话跑了出去。

entries.text: Isn't this place impressive! Designed to go underwater, and so the metal is strong against corrosion! Perhaps I'll try something similar with Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方让人打开眼界!它被设计用于水下，所以其材料有很强的抗腐蚀能力!也许我可以在小渣身上尝试类似的东西。

entries.text: Isn't this place impressive! Designed to go underwater, and so the metal is strong against corrosion! Perhaps I'll try something similar with Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方让人打开眼界!它被设计用于水下，所以其材料有很强的抗腐蚀能力!也许我可以在小渣身上尝试类似的东西。

entries.text: Hi, Ray. Were you about to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，雷。你是想问我什么吗？

entries.text: Frost Atronach
entries.translated_text: 寒霜元素

entries.text: What in Oblivion is a "two-for-one"? Have you ever met a mercenary in your life?
entries.translated_text: 什么叫“买一送一”？你在以前遇到过佣兵吗？

entries.text: I know!
entries.translated_text: 我知道了！

entries.text: Okay, okay.
entries.translated_text: 行，行。

entries.text: Okay, okay.
entries.translated_text: 行，行。

entries.text: Don't you have one in your bag?
entries.translated_text: 你的包里不就有吗？

entries.text: Hm. Perhaps this is as close as we will get to that without the, er, complicated-ness.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。也许这就是我们在舍去，呃，复杂性的情况下所能达到的最接近的结果。

entries.text: No! It shouldn't be this way! No, chief, we don't want to kill you! You're our friend!
entries.translated_text: 不！不应该是这样的！不，酋长，我们不想杀你！你是我们的朋友！

entries.text: I tend to be very... intense in my interests. My father used to say I was never half-full. I was either a full glass, or an empty one.
entries.translated_text: 我的兴趣往往非常...强烈。我父亲常说我从不半饱，不是满杯就是空杯。

entries.text: Hall of the Dead
entries.translated_text: 亡者之厅

entries.text: Something's occurred to me-You, ah, you aren't under the influence of our Daedric ghost friend, are you? Not taking me to the basement to kill me?
entries.translated_text: 我突然想到一件事，啊，你不会是被我们的魔族鬼魂朋友影响了吧？不带我去地下室杀掉我？

entries.text: But I'll ask you the same question I did before we started out on our adventure.
entries.translated_text: 但是我会问你在我们开始冒险之前我做过的同样的问题。

entries.text: Finally! I've run out of things to do here! Let's go!
entries.translated_text: 终于！我在这里没有事情可做！我们走吧！

entries.text: Oh, Anum-La! I found this in someone's pocket! I wanted to give it to you.
entries.translated_text: 哦，安努姆菈！我在某人的口袋里发现了这个！我想把它送给你。

entries.text: "Beyond his worship, he threatens the peace of Wayrest with..."
entries.translated_text: “除了他对魔神的信仰之外，他还威胁着途歇城的和平...”

entries.text: You won't hit yourself, I promise.
entries.translated_text: 我保证你不会打到自己的。

entries.text: Doc, it's essential for me to tell you- Uh. It's essential that you know- Well, I'm sure it will come back to me.
entries.translated_text: 医生，我必须告诉你——呃。你知道这一点很重要——嗯，我确信它会回到我身边。

entries.text: Now, to see Nchuand-Zel proper.
entries.translated_text: 现在，去看看楚安德-泽尔。

entries.text: Of all the crimes... Thievery makes the most sense. Everyone's got to get by somehow.
entries.translated_text: 在所有的罪行中...盗窃是最能让人理解的。毕竟每个人总得想办法活下去。

entries.text: Hooray! Although I suppose that means we'll have less gold for each of us. I should've thought this through first.
entries.translated_text: 万岁！不过我想这会意味着我们每个人都分得更少，我应该一开始就想明白的。

entries.text: I've been collecting cloth I've found for Khash, so she can braid them.
entries.translated_text: 我一直在收集给卡什用来编织的布料，是我一路上找到的那些。

entries.text: Imagine sitting down for an ale and being teleported into battle.
entries.translated_text: 想象一下，你在家里吃着炖锅唱着歌，然后突然就被法师召唤了。

entries.text: Imagine sitting down for an ale and being teleported into battle.
entries.translated_text: 想象一下，你在家里吃着炖锅唱着歌，然后突然就法师召唤了。

entries.text: It we're being completely honest, I'm inclined to agree. Still, I do prefer Honningbrew.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，你是对的。不过，我还是更喜欢蜜之酿的。

entries.text: It's good for me to see you in one piece. Please, let's... go.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴看到你完好无损。好了，我们...走吧。

entries.text: Can't believe I used to spend weeks on ships like this as a kid. I can barely stand minutes aboard now.
entries.translated_text: 不敢相信我小时候曾经在这样的船上度过数周。我在船上几乎几分钟都站不稳。

entries.text: I imagine it must be some sort of security measure. I'm sure the accessway above us is the key to bypassing it.
entries.translated_text: 我想这一定是某种安全措施。我敢肯定，我们上面的通道是绕过它的关键。

entries.text: I... can understand that. I assume you aren't close with them, then.
entries.translated_text: 我...可以理解。我猜你和他们关系不太亲近吧。

entries.text: Save your breath! I know better than you what it's like to lose it all!
entries.translated_text: 省口气吧！我比你更清楚失去这一切是什么滋味！

entries.text: Surely, she'd have time to meet you, at least? Maybe I'll go with you!
entries.translated_text: 当然，她至少有时间见你？也许我会和你一起去！

entries.text: Don't forget about Khash. She's short, so she's easier to miss in a headcount.
entries.translated_text: 别忘了卡什。她个子矮，所以数人头时更容易被忽略。

entries.text: My love...
entries.translated_text: 亲爱的...

entries.text: Go on.
entries.translated_text: 继续。

entries.text: Go on.
entries.translated_text: 继续。

texts: My family name is destroyed! What sway we held has gone up like smoke!
我的姓氏被毁了！我们所掌握的权势已如烟消云散！

entries.text: I can't believe Morvic got to see further into Arkngchal than I did! How did he even get in? Certainly not of his own abilities.
entries.translated_text: 我不相信莫维克比我还了解阿卡切尔！他是怎么进来的？肯定不是靠他自己办成的。

entries.text: This place is falling apart! I can see the weaknesses that caused it not to last as long as others. I'll avoid these mistakes when working on Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方正在崩塌！我能看出让它为什么更易崩塌的愿意，等我在小渣上动工时，我一定会避免这些错误。

entries.text: This place is falling apart! I can see the weaknesses that caused it not to last as long as others. I'll avoid these mistakes when working on Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方要崩溃了！我可以看到导致它不能像其他人那样持久的弱点。在改造小渣时，我会避免这些错误。

entries.text: This place is falling apart! I can see the weaknesses that caused it not to last as long as others. I'll avoid these mistakes when working on Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方要崩溃了！我可以看到导致它不能像其他人那样持久的弱点。在改造小渣时，我会避免这些错误。

entries.text: No.
entries.translated_text: 不。

entries.text: No.
entries.translated_text: 不。

entries.text: Alright, Buffy, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，巴非，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: How sad. They couldn't get into this room. Not very good thieves, are they? You, on the other hand, came prepared with a thief of your own.
entries.translated_text: 真可怜，他们连这个房间都进不去。不算是很高明的小偷吧？不过你就不一样了，身边还带了一个自己的小偷！

entries.text: Ah. Yes, I suppose that does sound rather... serene. I'm from Wayrest, which is much different. I suppose I'm used to... more people.
entries.translated_text: 啊，我想这听起来确实很…安宁。我来自途歇城，这很不一样。我想我已经习惯了…热闹。

entries.text: You can tell the falmer are blind based on how they keep chaurus as pets. (Shudder)
entries.translated_text: 你可以从把巢蚁当宠物来判断出伐莫们都是瞎子（颤抖）。

entries.text: Oh, uh, hello. I just noticed- Well, anyway, I'm Remiel. What is your name?
entries.translated_text: 哦，呃，你好。我只是注意到-- 好吧，不管怎样，我是蕾米尔。你叫什么名字？

entries.text: Oh, I don't know, this project is really complex... And my experiments can be... dangerous...
entries.translated_text: 哦，我不知道，这个项目真的很复杂...而且我的实验可能...很危险...

entries.text: Well, it's hard to move both my feet and my hand. But I'll keep it in mind.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，同时动我的双手双脚很困难，但我会记住的。

entries.text: I don't know what's more inviting: the smell or the fire.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道什么更诱人：家的气味或炉火。

entries.text: Hi, love.
entries.translated_text: 嗨，亲爱的。

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Frost Salts
entries.translated_text: 霜盐

entries.text: Oh, yeah, it's a lot of fun! Maybe you should come with us on our next adventure.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，这很有趣！也许你应该和我们一起进行下一次冒险。

entries.text: Errrgh!
entries.translated_text: 呃！

entries.text: Interesting. Congrats? Is that the right reaction?
entries.translated_text: 有趣，恭喜？这反应对吗？

entries.text: Like I said, I don't know what you're talking about.
entries.translated_text: 就像我说的，我不知道你在说什么。

entries.text: I didn't realize people could claim 'professional adventurer' as a job title. Although, I suppose I do call my friend here 'adventurer.'
entries.translated_text: 我没有意识到有人可以把“职业冒险者”作为一个头衔。不过，我想我确实经常把我的朋友叫做“冒险者”。

entries.text: It's like they just went and made themselves at home. Although I must admit that it seems to be detering the Forsworn.
entries.translated_text: 就像他们刚刚去把自己当成了家一样。虽然我必须承认，这似乎对附近的弃誓者产生了威慑。

entries.text: I-I... You... and me?
I'm good at learning.
entries.translated_text: 我善于学习。

entries.text: I won't! I'll just look with my eyes and not my hands, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我不会的！我只用眼睛看，不用手碰，好吗？

entries.text: Something like that.
entries.translated_text: 差不多。

entries.text: Something like that.
entries.translated_text: 差不多。

entries.text: I'm sure you'll make a great soldier.
entries.translated_text: 我相信你会成为一名伟大的士兵。

entries.text: Okay. I agree.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我同意。

entries.text: The... thief one? Yeah. Sounds good.
entries.translated_text: 小偷那本？啊对，听起来不错。

entries.text: When we stop next, Ilia, let's eat so much that we never want to eat again. Until a few hours pass, and we get hungry again.
entries.translated_text: 当我们下次停下来时，伊利亚，让我们大吃一顿，直到再也不想吃东西了。得等好几小时后才会饿的那种。

entries.text: Oooh! How boring! But fine, I'll find a way to occupy myself.
entries.translated_text: 噢！太无聊了！不过好吧，我会找点事来打发时间的。

entries.text: Even I can hear your sarcasm. Fine, take it.
entries.translated_text: 连我都能听懂你的讽刺。好吧，拿着。

entries.text: Imagine if we crafted a way to catch lightning. The sheer power...
entries.translated_text: 想象一下，如果我们创造出一种捕捉闪电的方法，纯粹的力量...

entries.text: I don't understand beggars. Why sit around asking for money you'll never get, when you can just take what you need?
entries.translated_text: 我不懂乞丐。当你能得到你所需要的东西时，为什么要坐着要钱？

entries.text: I didn't need treasure, but I thought I needed their approval.
entries.translated_text: 我不需要宝物，但我想我需要他们的认可。

entries.text: You're going to have to be a bit more descriptive for me. What is this Listener?
entries.translated_text: 你得给我描述得更清楚一点，这个聆听者到底是什么？

entries.text: Val's technical knowledge is astounding! I quite admire him. Oh, what could we invent together?!
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔的技术知识令人震惊！我非常钦佩他。我们能一起发明什么呢？

entries.text: Here are the eight dwemer gears.
entries.translated_text: 这是八个锻莫圆轮。

entries.text: Punch it in the snout!
entries.translated_text: 打鼻子！

entries.text: There seem to be mostly merchant ships docking here. No wonder there's such a variety at the markets!
entries.translated_text: 这里似乎是商船停靠的主要地点。难怪市场上有这么多种类的东西！

entries.text: Oh, come on. I think this is one of my better ideas.
entries.translated_text: 噢，别这样。我想这是我的一个好点子。

entries.text: Don't worry! I've learned a lot, and I definitely probably won't blow us up.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心！我学到了很多东西，而且我绝对不会炸到我们。

entries.text: Don't worry! I've learned a lot, and I definitely probably won't blow us up.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心！我学到了很多东西，而且我绝对不会炸到我们。

entries.text: Vampire Hunters?
entries.translated_text: 吸血鬼猎人？

entries.text: Oh, um, yes. I guess they already know, so I should tell you, too. He was the person who raised me.
entries.translated_text: 哦，嗯，​​是的。我想他们已经知道了，所以我也应该告诉你。他是抚养我长大的人。

entries.text: So, Anum-La, what was your company like?
entries.translated_text: 那么，安努姆菈，你的伙伴是什么样的？

entries.text: Let's see if we can find them.
entries.translated_text: 让我们看看能不能找到他们。

entries.text: Fine, fine, I'll say it: I love you.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，好吧，我会说：我爱你。

entries.text: Knowing that you depend on me, that you trust me to watch your back, means everything to me.
entries.translated_text: 你的信赖对我来说意味着一切。

entries.text: They've agreed to a truce because Alduin is a threat. So as soon as Alduin is defeated, they'll just go back to killing each other, won't they?
entries.translated_text: 他们同意休战，因为奥杜因是个威胁，所以一旦奥杜因被击败，他们就会继续自相残杀，不是吗？

entries.text: So, their sole role in the world is to kill bandits?
entries.translated_text: 那么，他们在世界上唯一的角色就是杀死强盗？

entries.text: That's the real question, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 这才是真正的问题，不是吗？

entries.text: Buffy! Fluffy Buffy! How cute!
entries.translated_text: 巴非！蓬松的巴非！多可爱！

entries.text: Yes! I mean... If you insist.
entries.translated_text: 是的！我的意思是...如果你还想的话。

entries.text: We're done talking then, Nar?
entries.translated_text: 那我们聊完了，纳尔？

entries.text: (Laugh) Yes, I definitely agree!
entries.translated_text: （笑）是的，我完全同意！

entries.text: That's right! You stay over there, far away from me!
entries.translated_text: 这是对的！你呆在那里，离我远点！

entries.text: Remiel's Fire Resist Potion
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的火抗药水

entries.text: Yes. Let's see what we can come up with.
entries.translated_text: 好，让我们看看我们能想出什么。

entries.text: Windhelm is a beautiful city, but the townsfolk here are fearful of magic.
entries.translated_text: 风舵城是一座漂亮的城市，但这里的居民害怕魔法。

entries.text: If you're going to eat now, Auri, can I watch?
entries.translated_text: 如果你现在要吃饭，奥璃，我可以看吗？

entries.text: (Whispering) Scrap, you didn't eat Dwarves, right?
entries.translated_text: （低语）小渣，你没有吃矮人，对吗？

entries.text: Luckily, I have you here to watch my back. And my front.All my sides, really.
entries.translated_text: 幸好有你在这里保护我的背后，还有我的正面...其实是我的四面八方。

entries.text: Oh! That sounds nice, actually. I imagine it must be a bit like working on machines, something to get lost in and keep your hands busy.
entries.translated_text: 哦！听起来不错，实际上。我想这一定有点像在装置上工作，有些东西会让你迷失方向，让你的双手忙碌。

entries.text: Your sister isn't in High Rock?
entries.translated_text: 你姐姐不在高岩？

entries.text: No, that's all yours. Thanks for the thought, though.
entries.translated_text: 不用了，那是你的，还是谢谢你的好意。

entries.text: Uh, well... I don't have any on me at the moment. I've got some of my work in my room in the Bard's College, in a desk somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 呃，好吧...我现在身上没有任何东西。我的一些作品放在我在诗人学院的房间里，在某个桌子上。

entries.text: Using the flow of water to cut lumber is smart, but we could use water wheels for other contraptions, too, I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: 使用水流来切割木材很聪明，但我们也可以将水轮用于其他装置，我敢肯定。

entries.text: Suspicious Assassin
entries.translated_text: 可疑的刺客

entries.text: He also had dumb hair.
entries.translated_text: 他的头发也很乱。

entries.text: Oh! Yeah, I... Yeah, that was... silly of me, wasn't it?
entries.translated_text: 哦！是的，我...嗯，我真是太傻了，不是吗？

entries.text: Khash's name is a bit odd, isn't it? Then again, I suppose I've no room to judge.
entries.translated_text: 卡什这个名字有点奇怪，不是吗？不过话说回来，我好像也没什么资格评价。

entries.text: Can I keep him, pleeease?
entries.translated_text: 请问我可以留下他吗？

entries.text: Besides, that's why I have you, right?
entries.translated_text: 再说了，这不正是我有你在的原因吗？

entries.text: Okay then...
entries.translated_text: 那好吧...

entries.text: Okay then...
entries.translated_text: 那好吧...

entries.text: Yes, let's.
entries.translated_text: 是的，就是这样。

entries.text: Nar.
entries.translated_text: 纳尔。

entries.text: Hi. Um. Hello, I was wanting. Oh, what is the word for it? It's that thing? You know, it's shaped like... so?
entries.translated_text: 嗨。额。你好，我才是这样。哦，这个词是什么意思？就是那个东西？你知道的，它的形状像。。。所以？

entries.text: Why do bandits have to smell like week-old cheese left out in the sun?
entries.translated_text: 为什么强盗们一定得闻起来像在阳光下放了一周的奶酪？

entries.text: Just go it with it, Remi, come on. What does that even mean...?
entries.translated_text: 让它过去吧，蕾米，别这样，这是什么意思。。。？

entries.text: Your death here will not be quick. I'm going to take great satisfaction in your prolonged suffering.
entries.translated_text: 你很快就会死在这里，我也会对你长期遭受的痛苦感到愉悦。

entries.text: There's a lot of snow in Skyrim, isn't there?
entries.translated_text: 天际有很多雪，不是吗？

entries.text: I can't believe I got caught.
entries.translated_text: 真不敢相信我竟然被逮到了。

entries.text: I'm so excited!
entries.translated_text: 我太激动了！

entries.text: Now, any worth pursuing is a different question.
entries.translated_text: 现在每个值得去做的项目都有不同的问题。

entries.text: (Chuckle) No pressure.
entries.translated_text: （笑）别有压力。

entries.text: Yes, I...
entries.translated_text: 是的，我...

entries.text: Hopefully that smell isn't coming from it.
entries.translated_text: 希望那味道不是从它身上散发出来的。

entries.text: So, you have to tell me: do you brush your fur? I'd never have the patience for all that.
entries.translated_text: 所以，你必须告诉我：你刷毛吗？我永远不会有耐心去做这一切。

entries.text: This isn't hide and seek!
entries.translated_text: 这可不是捉迷藏！

entries.text: Alright, I'll admit it. I'm too drunk. Speak, Remi. I can see you foaming at the mouth.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我承认。我喝醉了。说话吧，蕾米。我可以看到你口吐白沫。

entries.text: Blood on the wind today. Good hunt ahead of us.
entries.translated_text: 风带有血味。今天的狩猎会很丰收。

entries.text: Also, you probably don't want to hear me singing anyway. Non-Orcs don't tend to react well to my, uh, style.
entries.translated_text: 另外，你可能不想听我唱歌。非兽人的往往对我的，呃，风格没有什么反应。

entries.text: And they also taste...really awful.
entries.translated_text: 而且它们的味道...真的很糟糕。

entries.text: And they also taste...really awful.
entries.translated_text: 而且它们的味道……真的很糟糕。

entries.text: You'll have to forgive me, but I'm almost certain that's a rude thing to point out in casual conversation.
entries.translated_text: 请你原谅我，但我几乎可以肯定，在闲谈中指出这一点是很不礼貌的。

entries.text: So now you decide you want me around? No... I have more self respect than to come crawling back just because you changed your mind.
entries.translated_text: 所以现在你决定想让我留下了？不……我还有自尊，不会因为你改变了主意就卑微地爬回来的。

entries.text: Remi Automaton Disable
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的机器人禁用

entries.text: Leave me alone.
entries.translated_text: 请让我独处。

entries.text: Leave me alone.
entries.translated_text: 请让我独处。

entries.text: You'll regret it. But I'm not exactly a mother. It's your call.
entries.translated_text: 你会后悔的。但我不会像你妈一样一直管着你。这是你的决定。

entries.text: Well, in that case, I think it will likely be worth the trouble.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，在这种情况下，我认为这麻烦可能是值得的。

entries.text: It seems that some of the Dwemer here were learning the process for constructing automaton.
entries.translated_text: 似乎这里的某些锻莫当时在研究锻莫机器人的生产过程。

entries.text: Let me see!
entries.translated_text: 让我看看！

entries.text: The most important tool?
entries.translated_text: 最重要的工具？

entries.text: Is this... It feels like a handful of gears. But they're so small!
entries.translated_text: 这是...感觉就像一把圆轮，但它们太小了！

entries.text: Well, oh mighty huntress, why don't you teach me the right way to fight, then?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，哦，强大的女猎手，那你为什么不教教我正确的战斗方式呢？

entries.text: Oooh! Look at this plant! She's beautiful!
entries.translated_text: 哦！看看这种植物！太漂亮了！

entries.text: I hope you know where we are, because I was *not* paying attention to where we were going.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你知道我们在哪里，因为我*没有*注意我们要去哪里。

entries.text: I loved it!
entries.translated_text: 我很喜欢！

entries.text: Fine, fine. (Laughing)
entries.translated_text: 好的，好的。（笑）

entries.text: Are- Are you alright, Farillae? Still have enough blood in your body to live?
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗，法里拉？你体内的血液还够活吗？

entries.text: Ubbe, I'm being very serious. Look at my serious face. I'm hungry.
entries.translated_text: 乌贝，我是认真的，看看我严肃的脸。我饿了。

entries.text: Maybe you can help me?
entries.translated_text: 也许你能帮帮我？

entries.text: But I helped kill a Minotaur, and it was aweome!
entries.translated_text: 但我帮忙杀死了一只牛头怪，真是太棒了！

entries.text: He's an odd little man. Always poking around the ruins and wasting time in his museum.
entries.translated_text: 他是个古怪的小人。总是在遗址里闲逛，在他的博物馆里浪费时间。

entries.text: Hey! Be careful, or I'll give you the gross parts of dinner to eat!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！小心点，否则我会把晚餐的恶心部分给你吃！

entries.text: It would have set my father up for life. His merchantalism would have been renowned.
entries.translated_text: 这会让我父亲终生受益。他的商业帝国会遍布大陆。

entries.text: Yes, you too. Uh, so Serana. I could be wrong, but you seem to be a, uh...
entries.translated_text: 我也是。嗯，所以瑟拉娜。我可能搞错了，但你似乎是一个，呃...

entries.text: What's on your mind?
entries.translated_text: 你在想什么？

entries.text: Now, what would the fun be in that?! I had a front row seat to all your escapades last night, and now I have one to you cleaning them up!
entries.translated_text: 现在，那还有什么意思？昨晚我对你的所作所为可是看得清清楚楚，现在我又看你试图给这些事擦屁股！

entries.text: Ah, I understand. People look at Bretons and expect us to be brilliant mages. But our roles seem to be reversed. I'm the thief out of the two of us.
entries.translated_text: 啊我懂了。人们看着布莱顿人时总期望我们是出色的法师。但我们的角色似乎颠倒了。我是我们中的贼。

entries.text: I think I'm gonna pass... It's for the good of the group, you understand. What if all of us had food poisoning at the same time? Can't risk it.
entries.translated_text: 我想我还是算了...这是为了大家好，你明白的要是我们同时食物中毒怎么办？不能冒险。

entries.text: But it seems there are other aspects to 'being interested' in someone. Acts that I... I thought were more obligation than done out of desire.
entries.translated_text: 但似乎对某人 "感兴趣 "以及其他方面。我认为这些行为...我认为更多的是出于义务，而不是出于欲望。

entries.text: I'm perfectly aware of what a metaphor is, Yaz.
entries.translated_text: 我完全知道什么是隐喻，雅扎。

entries.text: The name's Rumarin. Professional adventurer, bladebinder, and graverobber.
entries.translated_text: 我叫鲁马林。职业冒险者、束刃者兼盗墓专家。

entries.text: Hm? Like what?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？比如？

entries.text: Let's get them!
entries.translated_text: 拿下他们！

entries.text: It's much better to explore the underground dwemer ruins. The ones at the surface are often completely looted and near useless.
entries.translated_text: 探索地下锻莫遗迹要好得多。地表的那些通常被完全洗劫一空，几乎毫无用处。

entries.text: I think my legs are going to fall off.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得我的腿快要掉了。

entries.text: Perfect! This must be where Nils makes his Chaurus Pie, so this is where I will be making mine! Give me just a moment...
entries.translated_text: 完美！这一定是纽斯制作巢蚁薄饼的地方，所以我也会在这里制作我的！给我一点时间...

entries.text: Perfect! This must be where Nils makes his Chaurus Pie, so this is where I will be making mine! Give me just a moment...
entries.translated_text: 完美！这一定是纽斯制作巢蚁薄饼的地方，所以我也会在这里制作我的！给我一点时间...

entries.text: I'll be fine in a minute.
entries.translated_text: 我一会儿就好了。

entries.text: You were just so impressive. I'm so lucky to be adventuring with you, you know?
entries.translated_text: 你真是让我欣赏，我很幸运能和你一起冒险，你知道吗？

entries.text: Do you want to hear one? My father used to tell me all sorts of good ones.
entries.translated_text: 你想听一个吗？我父亲过去给我讲过不少不错的。

entries.text: So? How was the Sanctuary? Did they give you a job, then?
entries.translated_text: 所以？圣所里怎么样？那他们给你工作了吗？

entries.text: Let's take a look.
entries.translated_text: 让我们来看看。

entries.text: No matter the circumstances, that doesn't justify what those necromancers did. They were responsible for their actions. Everyone has a choice.
entries.translated_text: 无论在什么情况下，那都不能为那些死灵法师的行为辩护。他们要为自己的所作所为负责。每个人都有选择的权利。

entries.text: I'm programming him to love *me*, seeing as I'm the one who has adopted him. But I suppose it wouldn't hurt for him to like you as well.
entries.translated_text: 我正在编程让他喜欢我，因为我才是收养他的人。但我想他也会喜欢你的。

entries.text: No! Doctor, are you okay? You don't look so great!
entries.translated_text: 不！医生，你还好吗？你看起来没那么好！

entries.text: That's certainly true. I mean, ideally I'd be free and with friends, but in practice that can turn out a little complicated.
entries.translated_text: 确实如此。我的意思是，最理想的情况是我能自由自在地和朋友们在一起，但实际上这可能会变得有点复杂。

entries.text: And... there!
entries.translated_text: 还有...好了！

entries.text: Yeah, uh, I'm sorry, but I don't like mammoth steaks. They still look like noses and it freaks me out.
entries.translated_text: 是的，呃，我很抱歉，但我不喜欢长毛象肉排。它们看起来仍然像鼻子，这让我很害怕。

entries.text: I'd love to know the ins and outs of how it works, but there isn't much documentation about it, and even if there were...
entries.translated_text: 我很想知道它是如何工作的，但没有太多关于它的文档，即使有...

entries.text: I've seen some rough breakups, but the way this Muiri wants to end things takes the cake.
entries.translated_text: 我见过不少粗暴的分手，但个暮蕊想要结束关系的这种方式简直是绝了。

entries.text: Of course I knew about Blackreach, Fal'Zhardum-Din, The Blackest Kingdom Reaches, only one of the most sought after Dwemer settlements in Skyrim!
entries.translated_text: 我当然知道黑境或者叫“Fal'Zhardum-Din”和“最黑暗的地方”，它是天际最知名的矮人定居点之一！

entries.text:
<font face='$HandwrittenBold'>

Damn Dwarven metal is too strong to be hacked down with a pickaxe. We're trying to dig our way through the part that's been caved in, but it's slow going. The others were able to climb over the gate, but they left us behind and don't seem in any hurry to help us out.

I'm sure those Dwarves wouldn't have made a gate with no way to open it. The others think I'm overthinking it, but I'm sure those chests down the hall have something to do with it. They're right across from those big Dwarven machine things, almost like they're for offerings. I might try putting some things into the chests, but I don't really know what to put in. Must have something to do with the big machine statues. Seems like some sort of test or something. But what would they be testing?

</font>
entries.translated_text:
该死的矮人金属太坚固了，镐头都敲不懂。我们正试图挖开被洞穿的部分，但进展很慢。其他人能够爬过大门，但他们把我们抛在后面，似乎并不急于帮助我们。

我相信那些矮人不会做一个没有办法打开的门。其他人认为我想多了，但我确信大厅里的那些箱子与此有关。它们就在那些大型矮人机器的对面，几乎就是用来供奉的雕像。我可能会尝试把一些东西放进箱子里，但我真的不知道该放什么。一定和那些大机器雕像有关系。这似乎是某种用于测试之类的东西。但他们会测试什么呢？

entries.text: I suppose that's one way of describing them.
entries.translated_text: 那些武器的确不错。

entries.text: So, you're mainly into Dwemer, huh?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你对锻莫很感兴趣，是吗？

entries.text: Well, if you call salted meat food. Here's a hint. It isn't.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你说的是腌肉。我可以告诉你，还是算了吧。

entries.text: I hope you're a good student then. But if they become aggravated, you'll, uh, take a more hands-on approach. Right?
entries.translated_text: 我希望你是个好学生。但如果病情加重，你就采用更实际的方法，好吗？

entries.text: The good stuff! Here you are!
entries.translated_text: 好东西！给你

entries.text: Rumarin keeps trying to get me to learn a bound weapon spell. Surely he of all people should understand that I'm not a mage!
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林一直想让我学会一个束缚武器法术，他当然应该明白我不是法师！

entries.text: Yikes... the treasure vault, empty. Although, I'm more concerned that they apparently don't take inventory of their profits regularly.
entries.translated_text: 哎呀...宝库，空了。虽然，我更关注他们显然没有定期盘点他们的利润。

entries.text: It has inherent magical properties, but accessing those properties, by the Eight, even just attempting to *smelt* the stuff, is nigh impossible.
entries.translated_text: 它本身就具有魔法特性，但想要利用这些特性——圣灵在上，甚至只是尝试熔炼这种东西，几乎是不可能的。

entries.text: Of course, we should've expected the place to be heavily guarded! We won't die here! I need to use that Forge!
entries.translated_text: 当然，我们早该料到这里戒备森严！我们不会死在这里！我需要使用那个锻炉！

entries.text: Somehow, those don't seem fun.
entries.translated_text: 不知怎么的，这些看起来并不有趣。

entries.text: Another's eyes had to behold him.
entries.translated_text: 必须时刻监视他。

entries.text: Well, in High Rock, we use 'cur,' but that sounds a bit too fancy, in my opinion.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，在高岩省我们用“野狗”这个词，不过我觉得那听起来有点太讲究了。

entries.text: Una, please don't make me carry anything. Scrap already has limited space in the bag.
entries.translated_text: 尤娜，请不要让我带任何东西。小渣在袋子中的空间已经有限了。

entries.text: No, I'm from High Rock, all the way to the west. I'm travelling with my friend here for protection. I'm not very good with blades or magic.
entries.translated_text: 不，我来自高岩，在天际西部。我和我的朋友一起旅行，以求保护。我不太擅长剑或魔法。

entries.text: So they're fighting against the rules that are protecting them.
entries.translated_text: 所以他们正在与保护他们的规则作斗争。

entries.text: What do you want, then?
entries.translated_text: 那你想要什么？

entries.text: Hah! You are unstoppable!
entries.translated_text: 哈！你真厉害！

entries.text: Well, that battle's definitely going in the book.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这场战斗将会永垂不朽。

entries.text: This is so easy, I almost feel bad for doing it. Almost.
entries.translated_text: 这太简单了，我差点都要为自己的行为感到自责了。差点。

entries.text: Eating raw skeevers.
entries.translated_text: 吃生恶鼠肉。

entries.text: Let's just hurry and get the Staff.
entries.translated_text: 我们快点去找法杖。

entries.text: You noticed how the observatory was a mess, right? I have a suspicion Forsworn and bandits often came inside to raid it.
entries.translated_text: 你注意到天文台有多乱了，对吧？我怀疑弃誓者和土匪经常进来搜刮。

entries.text: As a kid, I accidentally made the other children cry very often. I never understood why- I'd just say something very plainly.
entries.translated_text: 小时候，我经常不小心把其他孩子弄哭。我一直不明白为什么--我只是很平淡地说了一些话。

entries.text: Your remarks on ideologies, behaviors, and actions make them seem funny by pointing out their flaws.
entries.translated_text: 你批判别人的想法、观念和做法的时候看起来很有趣。

entries.text: Oooh, interesting. Imagine the contraptions I could power with a soul gem that never shatters.
entries.translated_text: 哦，有趣。想象一下我可以有用永不破碎的灵魂石驱动的装置。

entries.text: It's so drafty in here. Can't Isran patch it up better?
entries.translated_text: 这里很破旧，伊士冉就不能好好修补一下吗？

entries.text: Remiel Follower
entries.translated_text: Remiel Follower

entries.text: Remiel Follower
entries.translated_text: Remiel Follower

entries.text: I'll be here, Ria. And also wherever you take me next.
entries.translated_text: 我会在这里的，利亚，还有你接下来带我去哪里。

entries.text: I mean, it's not a very good or even likely explanation, but it's an explanation at least.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，这虽不是一个很好的解释，甚至是不可能的解释，但它好歹是一个解释。

entries.text: G-guess... Guess we're a rare breed, then.
entries.translated_text: 我猜...那我们这种就很少见。（Guess，G开头）

entries.text: Ah. Yes, I suppose there is a lot happening. Um. Maybe I should create something that helps nullify sound for you... Hm...
entries.translated_text: 啊，是的，我想确实发生了很多事。嗯...也许我该做点什么，帮你屏蔽噪音...嗯...

entries.text: Do you think there's treasure here?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得这里会有宝藏吗？

entries.text: This Paarthurnax lives all alone on the tallest mountain on Tamriel? Isn't he... cold?
entries.translated_text: 这个帕图纳克斯独自一人住在泰姆瑞尔最高的山上？他不...冷吗？

entries.text: What?! I do not think so. Wait... But what if they are?!
entries.translated_text: 什么？！我不这么认为。等等...但如果他们是呢？！

entries.text: What is this feeling?! I can take on an entire bandit fort myself, I'm sure of it!
entries.translated_text: 这是什么感觉？我一个人就能拿下一整个强盗堡垒，我很确信！

entries.text: A perfectly legal, perfectly delicious pastry...
entries.translated_text: 完全合法、完全美味的点心...

entries.text: Yes, everything is just fine, just great. We are freeing you, and you don't have to look too much into it at all, I promise.
entries.translated_text: 是的，一切都很好，非常好。我们正在让你解脱，你完全不用太在意，我保证。

entries.text: Okay, that's a little better.
entries.translated_text: 好的，这也没啥用。

entries.text: Some can't separate the animal from themselves. Go feral.
entries.translated_text: 有些人无法把动物与自己分开，最终变得野性难驯。

entries.text: That really spoke to me as the fire of life, restrained and stuffed away inside a cave. And the... items on the table...
entries.translated_text: 这句话真的触动了我，就像生命之火，被禁锢并埋藏在洞穴深处。而桌上那些...物件...

entries.text: Oooooh no. Oh no, oh no. Hermaeus Mora *killed* Storn! Sweet Mother Mara, we helped him assassinate the Skaal shaman!
entries.translated_text: 噢，噢，不，哦，不，赫麦尤斯·莫拉杀了史东！亲爱的玛拉母亲，我们帮他杀害了斯卡尔萨满！

entries.text: Okay, okay. How about 200 gold up front. AND whatever you pick up in the ruins.
entries.translated_text: 好吧好吧。预付200金怎么样，以及你在遗址中捡到的任何东西。

entries.text: You didn't tell me you had a kid. It's so nice you brought her along on your adventures.
entries.translated_text: 你没告诉我你有个孩子啊。你带她一起去冒险，真是太好了。

entries.text: I'm sooooo hungry!
entries.translated_text: 我太太太太太饿啦！

entries.text: But you travelled quite a ways to get here. You really are an experienced adventurer, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 但是你走了很多路才到这里。你真的是一个经验丰富的冒险者，不是吗？

entries.text: It'd be dangerous for us not to deal with him at this point, right?
entries.translated_text: 如果放着他不管，我们现在会很危险，对吧？

entries.text: I don't think I completely get it, but maybe I won't until I see Valenwood for myself.
entries.translated_text: 我不认为我能完全明白，但也许直到我亲眼看到威木省之后我才会明白。

entries.text: Oh! Well done! I'm glad that worked. Good thing I keep such detailed notes, right?
entries.translated_text: 哦！做得好！我很高兴这奏效了，还好我有详细的笔记，对吧？

entries.text: I don't have an iron ingot.
entries.translated_text: 我没有铁锭。

entries.text: As much as I think flowers are pretty, I do hope this party will have food.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我认为花很漂亮，但我确实希望这个派对会有食物。

entries.text: Remi, can you lockpick doors for me?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你能帮我开锁吗？

entries.text: Let me see.
entries.translated_text: 让我看看。

entries.text: Just ate a sweetroll I picked up from a vendor.
entries.translated_text: 刚吃了我从小贩那里买的甜卷。

entries.text: Oh no. Look, I can explain. Wait, you don't know, do you? Never mind; ignore me. What did you need?
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，听着，我可以解释。等等，你不知道，是吗？不要介意；别理我，你需要什么？

entries.text: Is that your way of saying I'm too loud?
entries.translated_text: 这是你说我太大声了吗？

entries.text: Hello, Buffy. Were you about to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 你好，巴非，你是想问我什么吗？

entries.text: Where's your kitchen? Just asking. No reason.
entries.translated_text: 你的厨房在哪里？只是问问而已，没原因。

entries.text: Now if only you'd never speak to me again.
entries.translated_text: 要是你现在再也别跟我说话就好了。

entries.text: Don't die, Buffy! I'd be very upset with you!
entries.translated_text: 别死，巴非！我会对你非常不满！

entries.text: The dwemer built a library near Blackreach, to study the Void. If only we could find it...
entries.translated_text: 锻莫在黑境附近建造了一座图书馆，用于研究虚空。如果我们能找到它...

entries.text: Oh. Oh, well, if you'd like, I could make jokes about baser things? Although none come to mind at the moment...
entries.translated_text: 哦。哦，好吧，如果你愿意，我可以开一些下流的玩笑？虽然暂时没有想到...

entries.text: So, Yaz, you said before you like to explore who characters are. What are some of your favourite characters you've explored in your writing?
entries.translated_text: 那么，雅扎，你之前说服你喜欢探索什么角色。你创作中，最喜欢哪些你探索过的人物？

entries.text: Ha! You can be so... entertaining.
entries.translated_text: 哈！你可以这么...有趣。

entries.text: Amazing! I've always wanted to participate in regicide! I-I mean- No, that's, er, bad. What a terrible thing that Ghost Bard did.
entries.translated_text: 了不起！我一直想弑君！我——我的意思是——不，那是，呃，太糟了。那个幽灵吟游诗人做了一件多么可怕的事情。

entries.text: There's always something new and interesting to see.
entries.translated_text: 总有一些新的和有趣的东西可以看。

entries.text: There's always something new and interesting to see.
entries.translated_text: 总有一些新的和有趣的东西可以看。

entries.text: I-I... Oh! Oh! You like me! And you admitted it! You talked about feelings! Are you well? A fever coming on?
entries.translated_text: 我——我……哦！哦！你喜欢我！而且你承认了！你谈论了感受！你没事吧？发烧了吗？

entries.text: Is something- Ganbald, did you hear that?
entries.translated_text: 是不是——甘巴尔德，你听到了吗？

entries.text: Ugh! You want to keep me in the dark? I suppose light isn't conducive to stealth, if that's what you're thinking.
entries.translated_text: 哼！你想让我待在黑暗中？我猜测你是在想光线不太适合隐匿对把。

entries.text: I hope you don't mind if I dissect you after we're done here!
entries.translated_text: 我希望你不介意我们在这里完成后我解剖你！

entries.text: Why don't you live here while you explore Skyrim?
entries.translated_text: 探索天际时为什么不住在这里？

texts: Need some time for yourself? I get it. Let me know when you need me.
需要一些时间吗？我明白了。你需要我的时候告诉我。

entries.text: Need some time for yourself? I get it. Let me know when you need me.
entries.translated_text: 需要一些私人时间吗？我明白了。你需要我的时候告诉我。

entries.text: To her relief, it opened and there stood a little boy, beaming at her as though she were the sun ending a dark night.
entries.translated_text: 令她松了一口气的是，门打开了，里面站着一个小男孩，朝她微笑，仿佛她是结束黑夜的太阳。

entries.text: I love you, too.
entries.translated_text: 我也爱你。

entries.text: Margret was gathering information on the Silver-Bloods? I suppose I'm not one to notice such things, but it's so odd to me she was a spy all along.
entries.translated_text: 玛格丽特在收集银血家族的情报？我想我没注意到这些事情，但知道她一直都是名间谍后感觉怪怪的。

entries.text: It's part of my charm. Helps me stand out from the crowd.
entries.translated_text: 这是我魅力的一部分，让我从人群中脱颖而出。

entries.text: Really?! You've never been curious about it?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？你从来没有好奇过？

entries.text: So fascinating that the ghost is apparently aware he's been waiting hundreds of years for this sword...
entries.translated_text: 真迷人，这鬼魂显然意识到他已经为这把剑等待了几百年...

entries.text: Alright, one famous chef killed, one step closer to murdering the emperor.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，一位名厨被杀了，离弑杀皇帝又近了一步。

entries.text: Do you think the dwemer are out there somewhere?
entries.translated_text: 你认为锻莫会在某个地方吗？

entries.text: No, I feel like taking a nap. I think I'll do that.
entries.translated_text: 不，我现在只想打个盹，我想我会这样做的。

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Fire Salts
entries.translated_text: 火盐

entries.text: Friend! Remi. Want. You. Have!
entries.translated_text: 朋友！蕾米，希望，你，拿着！

entries.text: Not all of them share your sentiments, but if they see another stormcloak treating me nicely...
entries.translated_text: 并非所有人都同意你的观点，但如果他们看到另一个风暴斗篷对我很好...

entries.text: We figured out in what order to pull the levers in Arkngchal and are now able to explore further.
entries.translated_text: 我们弄清楚了在阿卡切尔中拉动杠杆的顺序，现在可以进一步探索了。

entries.text: Yes! Alright!
entries.translated_text: 是的！这就对了！

entries.text: Yes! Alright!
entries.translated_text: 是的！这就对了！

texts: Stealing Daedra from oblivion. I've always wondered what that must be like for them.
从湮灭中召唤迪德拉。我一直想知道这对他们来说被召唤的滋味如何。

entries.text: Stealing Daedra from oblivion. I've always wondered what that must be like for them.
entries.translated_text: 从湮灭中召唤魔族。我一直想知道对他们来说被召唤的滋味如何。

entries.text: No!
entries.translated_text: 不！

entries.text: No!
entries.translated_text: 不！

entries.text: No!
entries.translated_text: 不！

entries.text: No!
entries.translated_text: 不！

entries.text: Viola Giordano's House
entries.translated_text: 维欧拉·乔尔丹诺的家

entries.text: You want in there? Here's my spare key. Take whatever you want.
entries.translated_text: 你想去那里吗？那就带着我的备用钥匙，需要什么就拿什么吧。

entries.text: A mixture of theory and practicality is always the best for mechanics and blacksmiths. It seems Tacitus just needs a bit more of the former.
entries.translated_text: 对于机械师和铁匠来说，理论与实践的结合总是最好的。看来塔西佗只需要多学一点前者。

entries.text: Ilia. Ilia, are you alive? Oh- Oh, good, you are.
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚，伊利亚，你还活着吗？哦——哦，很好，还活着。

entries.text: I can't believe we were able to help Kodlak. But I'm glad we could. Enjoy your eternal feast, Kodlak.
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信我们能够帮助克拉科。但我很高兴我们能做到，愿你享受永恒的盛宴，克拉科。

entries.text: Wrong. Button! Fa-ka!
entries.translated_text: 错误！按钮！法-卡！

entries.text: And it would seem that Morvic's crew hauled in a cauldron. He really overworks those people.
entries.translated_text: 看起来，莫维克的船员们把一个大锅拖了上来，那些人肯定累死了。

entries.text: I'm not sure how those mercenaries failed in the task, if I'm honest.
entries.translated_text: 说实话，我不知道那些雇佣兵怎么这点任务都做不好。

entries.text: Someone's sold us out? But why!? We were going to have the kill of the Era! And now Maro's sent people to destroy the Sanctuary!
entries.translated_text: 有人出卖了我们？可为什么！？我们本来要完成这个时代最重要的刺杀！而现在，马洛派人去毁灭圣所了！

entries.text: I knew it was weird that there were so few automatons.
entries.translated_text: 我知道机器人这么少很奇怪。

entries.text: By the Eight... This is necromancy, isn't it? Those cuts on the murder victim... Were they to... acquire material?
entries.translated_text: 八圣灵在上...这就是亡灵法术，不是吗？受害者身上的那些伤口...他们是为了...获得材料吗？

entries.text: I dunno, Remi. Suppose we'd just die.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，蕾米。可能我们会死。

entries.text: You're really going to regret fighting Ganbald!
entries.translated_text: 你会后悔与甘巴尔德战斗的！

entries.text: Maybe I'll show you around? I've been to Alcaire, Wayrest, Camlorn, Evermore, and some smaller hamlets in between!
entries.translated_text: 也许我可以带你四处转转？我去过阿尔凯瑞、途歇城、卡姆洛恩、永恒城，还有中间的一些小村庄！

entries.text: Morvic's Boots
entries.translated_text: 莫维克的靴子

entries.text: The fog rolls in, without err, as the sun sinks below the horizon. Some say that the fog is smoke from witches' brews.
entries.translated_text: 当太阳入山，雾气蔓延。有人说这雾气是出自女巫的手笔。

entries.text: Oh, great.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不错。

entries.text: The Gourmet is an orc? Huh. Explains why the Sunlight Souffle recipe is so strange. Definitely not how we make it in High Rock.
entries.translated_text: 美食家是兽人？嗯。解释了为什么阳光蛋奶酥的配方如此奇怪。绝对不是我们在高岩的做法。

entries.text: Perfect timing, Ed. Do you have any snacks?
entries.translated_text: 完美的时机，艾德。你有零食吗？

entries.text: Oh, I have heard of spectres roaming about, but as far as I can tell, that seems to be a Morrowind specific occurence.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我听说有幽灵在四处游荡，但据我所知，这似乎是晨风的一次特殊事件。

entries.text: Do you remember when you asked if you should heal me?
entries.translated_text: 你还记得你问你说你能治愈我吗？

entries.text: I'll likely be at the Silverblood Inn, for when you next want to meet up. Please be safe.
entries.translated_text: 你下次想见我时，我可能会在银血旅店。注意安全。

entries.text: Remi
entries.translated_text: 蕾米

entries.text: I'm hardly in a position to judge another's subtlety, but doesn't holding secret meetings at a Shrine of Talos seem like it will make it less secret?
entries.translated_text: 我不好评判别人的小动作，但在塔洛斯神殿里密会就会显得很隐秘吗？

entries.text: Kwama Eggs?! I've heard of those. I've only ever been able to imagine chicken eggs when I think of them. Are they similar?
entries.translated_text: 夸蚂蛋？我听说过。我只能联想到鸡蛋。它们很相似吗？

entries.text: Not for nothing. Is this enough? (Bribe)
entries.translated_text: 没有复出就没有回报，这些够了吗？（贿赂）

entries.text: Oh, you'll have to let me see the gem after we've put it in the convectors!
entries.translated_text: 哦，在我们把灵魂石放进环流器之后，你得让我看看！

entries.text: Yes, they're always looking down on us. Especially mages like Ancano.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他们总是看不起我们。特别是像安卡诺这样的法师。

entries.text: Hi, Viella! Is there something you wanted to talk about?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，维埃拉！你有什么想谈的吗？

entries.text: Wow. No offense, but that sounds like a terrible idea.
entries.translated_text: 哇。无意冒犯，但这听起来是个糟糕的主意。

entries.text: I do think you High Elves have such beautiful skin.
entries.translated_text: 我真的认为你们高等精灵的皮肤很漂亮。

entries.text: I care greatly for you, and I'm so proud to adventure alongside you.
entries.translated_text: 我非常在乎你，我很自豪能和你一起冒险。

entries.text: Tell me when I can! It's going to be the only thing I can think about until it's done!
entries.translated_text: 告诉我什么时候可以动手！在得手前，我只会想这事！

entries.text: Mistveil Keep Barracks
entries.translated_text: 雾隐堡垒营房

entries.text: Maybe measure his canines? And I'm sure he wouldn't miss some fur, right? And his claws, I'm certain those would grow back.
entries.translated_text: 也许可以量一下他的犬齿？我想他不会介意掉点毛吧，对吧？还有他的爪子，我确信那些会长回来的。

entries.text: I think my father was pretty upset by her career choice, but he never said anything about it.
entries.translated_text: 我认为我父亲对她的职业选择感到非常沮丧，但他从来没有说过这件事。

entries.text: I think my father was pretty upset by her career choice, but he never said anything about it.
entries.translated_text: 我想我父亲对她选的职业很失落，但他从没有提过这件事。

entries.text: Elisif really liked the Verse. Her entire court liked it! I know royalty are up their own asses, but this is a new height of stupidity! I love it!
entries.translated_text: 艾利西弗真的很喜欢这诗。她的整个宫廷都喜欢它！我知道皇室成员都是自认为高人一等，但这真是愚蠢到了新的高度！我喜欢！

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. However, it seems Morvic has decided to take matters into his own hands, as rumour has it he has been spotted in Markarth. By the time we arrived in Markarth, Morvic had moved on, but Remiel insisted we search Arkngchal.  It seems Remi ran into Morvic without me. Things are looking grim.
entries.translated_text: 我们遭遇了一名来刺杀蕾米尔的刺客，这个刺客是蕾米的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米将莫维克诬陷为魔族信徒。然而，莫维克似乎决定自己亲自出手了。传言说有人在马卡斯发现了他。当我们到达马卡斯城时，莫维克已经离开了，但蕾米尔坚持要我们搜查一下阿卡切尔。似乎蕾米独自遇到了莫尔奇。事情看起来很糟糕。

entries.text: Marlok took a job to fight one that was terrorizing a farmstead. And he was hired with some other mercenaries.
entries.translated_text: 马洛克接下了一份活，要去对付一头在农庄作乱的牛头怪。他和另外一些雇佣兵一起受雇去完成这件事。

entries.text: The fauna here is fascinating! They're beautiful. I wonder what besides their fur has adapted to match this environment?
entries.translated_text: 这里的动物群很迷人！他们很漂亮。我想知道除了它们的皮毛外，还有什么可以适应这种环境的？

entries.text: Are you talking to me to give me the sweetroll you have? Yes, I know you have one. No, I won't tell you how I found out.
entries.translated_text: 你是在跟我说要把你的糖果给我吗？是的，我知道你有一个。不，我不会告诉你我是怎么发现的。

entries.text: It wasn't me, honest!
entries.translated_text: 不是我,真的!

entries.text: No. Not even the Thalmor are stupid enough to wander into the forests of Greenshade.
entries.translated_text: 不，即使是梭默也不会愚蠢到可以在绿荫的森林中游荡。

entries.text: Okay, just give me some time to put it together!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，给我点时间整理一下吧！

entries.text: Raven, I've been thinking, and I think we should go to a Dwemer ruin.
entries.translated_text: 雷文，我一直在想，我觉得我们应该去一个锻莫遗址。

entries.text: I'm freezing my ears off.
entries.translated_text: 我的耳朵要被冻掉了。

entries.text: You've sure travelled a lot. Comes with the job, I imagine.
entries.translated_text: 你肯定去过很多地方。我是因为工作才到处走，我想。

entries.text: In Hammerfell, there are animunculi shaped like scarabs. Those are beetles found in desert regions. Someday I'll go see them.
entries.translated_text: 在落锤，有形似圣甲虫的蒸汽机械，那是在沙漠地区出没的甲虫，总有一天我会去看它们。

entries.text: We found a smuggler in Riften who gave us a note detailing Remi's family and their move to Skaven. It sounds like they're doing well. Emboldened by her family's safety, Remiel wants to write an anonymous letter to the Order of the Hour in Wayrest to frame Morvic as a daedra worshipper. She's asked me to help her when I have time.
entries.translated_text: 我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，他给了我们一张便条，详细说明了蕾米的家人以及他们搬到斯卡文的地方。听起来他们做得很好。受到家人安全的激励，蕾米尔想给途歇城的时序团骑士团写一封匿名信，将莫维克诬陷为魔族信徒。她让我在我有时间的时候帮助她。

entries.text: I don't follow.
entries.translated_text: 我不明白。

entries.text: Are you sure? You seemed rather enamoured by that mace.
entries.translated_text: 你确定？但你好像很喜欢那把锤子。

texts: Magic in High Rock is much more accepted, which means that mages are much more skilled.
高岩省的魔法普遍被人们接受，这意味着那里法师的法术会更强。

entries.text: Well, I suppose they do. B-but that's just even more reason to hate them!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我想他们也的确如此。但-但这只是会让我更讨厌他们！

entries.text: Auri, I was wondering about something you said. Let me think, I just had it in mind. Ugh, what was it?? Think, Remi!
entries.translated_text: 奥璃，我想知道你说的什么。让我想想，我只是想到了。呃，那是什么？？快想想，蕾米！

entries.text: I can't believe Margret was killed! People die all the time, but it's so odd when it's someone I saw every morning at the inn.
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信玛格丽特被杀了！虽说死人这事总是家常便饭，但如果死的是我每天早上都能在旅馆见到的人，就太惊悚了。

entries.text: You know, few are willing to put up with me for more than a day.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，很少有人愿意忍受我超过一天。

entries.text: Really? Could I try reading it sometime?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？我可以试着读一下吗？

entries.text: Of course, as a young girl, we'd often gossip about what sort of beautiful knight might whisk us away to a grand manor.
entries.translated_text: 当然，作为一个年轻的女孩，我们经常会八卦什么样的美丽骑士会把我们带到一个大庄园。

entries.text: Oh, aren't these ruins astounding?! Look at how intricate some of the metal working is!
entries.translated_text: 哦，这些遗迹是不是很惊人？！看看这些金属加工是多么复杂！

entries.text: (Laugh) Uh-huh.
entries.translated_text: （笑）嗯嗯。

entries.text: Funny, most can't do either.
entries.translated_text: 有趣，大多人都无法得偿所愿。（Funny，F开头）

entries.text: Aw, come on, are you really apologizing? We had a good back-and-forth, you and I!
entries.translated_text: 噢，拜托，你真的在​​道歉吗？你和我，我们的相处都很不错！

entries.text: But, uh, thanks for reacting in a more positive way than most readers do! I appreciate it.
entries.translated_text: 但是，呃，感谢你比大多数读者的反应都更积极！我很感激！我很感激。

entries.text: I can't say I've ever had that. Kwama Eggs are... Dunmeri, right? I've always been fascinated with Morrowind, as it just seems so bizarre.
entries.translated_text: 我不能说我有过这样的经历。夸蚁蛋是...丹莫食物，对吗？我一直对晨风很着迷，因为它看起来实在太奇怪了。

entries.text: Wait, how did he even find out you had it...? He isn't... spying on me, is he?
entries.translated_text: 等等，他怎么会发现你有这个东西...？他不会是...在监视我吧？

entries.text: I'm actually a bit excited to see it again! Let's go!
entries.translated_text: 再次看到它时，我真的有点兴奋！我们走吧！

entries.text: Have you had any success? I've had success on my end!
entries.translated_text: 你找到了吗？我这边已经成功了!

entries.text: You don't like knights, then.
entries.translated_text: 看起来，你不喜欢骑士。

entries.text: Report to Remi about lockpicking with the tension wrench next time you two are relaxing.
entries.translated_text: 下次你们两个放松时，向蕾米报告关于用张力扳手开锁的事情。

entries.text: You're too kind. What is it?
entries.translated_text: 你太客气了，那是什么？

entries.text: (Whisper) Don't trip, don't trip, don't trip...
entries.translated_text: （低语）不要绊倒，不要绊倒，不要绊倒...

entries.text: Let's head out.
entries.translated_text: 我们出去吧。

entries.text: Let's head out.
entries.translated_text: 我们出去吧。

entries.text: Let's head out.
entries.translated_text: 我们出去吧。

entries.text: Yes, well. That means it'll be good. I think. Once you have all the ingredients, just let me know, and then we'll move on to the action phase!
entries.translated_text: 是的，嗯。这意味着它会很好。我想。一旦你收集到了所有的材料，就告诉我，然后我们就进入制作阶段！

entries.text: That's all I want to know.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我想知道的。

entries.text: Really? Hm. It's always the people you least expect.
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？嗯，总是那些你最意想不到的人。

entries.text: Hello, my dear friend.
entries.translated_text: 你好，我亲爱的朋友。

entries.text: Wait, Hircine is happy we killed his hunters? Damn. And here I was excited to make him angry.
entries.translated_text: 等等，海尔辛很高兴我们杀死了他的猎人？该死，我还是很高兴让他生气。

entries.text: I'm certain I could take him. It's the Markarth guard I was more concerned about. But it doesn't matter because we're finally allowed in!
entries.translated_text: 我肯定我可以带着他。我更关心的是马卡斯卫兵。但都不重要了，因为我们准许进入了！

entries.text: "I write to alert you to a daedra worshipper hiding in plain sight within Wayrest."
entries.translated_text: “我写信是为了提醒你注意一个隐藏在途歇城内的魔族信徒。”

entries.text: Can I read it when it is?
entries.translated_text: 什么时候可以读？

entries.text: I hope Sinding can find some peace...
entries.translated_text: 我希望辛丁能找到一些平静...

entries.text: And then... two... er...
entries.translated_text: 然后...两个...

entries.text: Um, Remi, you talk to Scrap a lot, and he talks back? And knows what you mean?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，蕾米，你跟小渣说了很多，他回你了？他懂你意思吗？

entries.text: Give Remi an iron ingot at the Markarth Forge.
entries.translated_text: 在马卡斯城熔炉给蕾米一个铁锭。

entries.text: Desecrated? So that means it's not... necromancers? I fear some people say desecrated and mean one thing, whilst I think of... Well, something else.
entries.translated_text: 亵渎？那就是说...不是...死灵法师？我担心有些人说亵渎就是一个意思，而我想的是...嗯，另一个意思。

entries.text: Something's not right.
entries.translated_text: 不太对劲。

entries.text: I'm not sure how comfortable I am relying on the word of a Daedric Prince, but if the risk is with worth it for you, I'll follow.
entries.translated_text: 我不确定我是否能够相信一个魔神的话，但如果你认为值得冒这个险，我会跟着你的。

entries.text: Remi, I have questions about what's going on with Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我对莫维克的情况有疑问。

entries.text: Unless you're wanting to hang out in the Arcanaeum, which I'm certainly not opposed to.
entries.translated_text: 除非你想在秘藏馆中闲逛，我当然不反对。

entries.text: Broke and sick to his stomach. Yeah, he got the authentic "Remi Experience".
entries.translated_text: 他的胃生病坏了。是的，他得到了权威的“蕾米经验”。

entries.text: It sounds so... complicated. Your relationship with them. I imagine being surrounded by so many different cultures, you've picked up on a lot?
entries.translated_text: 听起来...很复杂。你和他们的关系。我想周围有这么多不同的文化交融，让你学到了很多？

entries.text: Uuh, some. I do not know. I really mainly stayed in the wilderness. But, probably.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，有一些吧。我不太清楚。我主要是待在荒野里。不过，大概有吧。

entries.text: Do you want to have a competition to see whose spider is the strongest?
entries.translated_text: 你想来一场比赛，看看谁的蜘蛛最强吗？

entries.text: (Laugh) You say the sweetest things to me.
entries.translated_text: (笑）你对我说了最动听的话。

entries.text: Surely the letter I sent off will have had its intended effect by now? Maybe that shady fellow in Riften will have heard something?
entries.translated_text: 我寄出的那封信有用吗？也许裂谷城地下的家伙会知道一些消息？

entries.text: Well, first and foremost, I captured your likeness in a rather dramatic lighting as you write your latest story. It's a very realistic drawing.
entries.translated_text: 嗯,首先，我在你写最新故事时，画了张你在非常戏剧性的光照下的肖像。这是一张非常逼真的画。

entries.text: A-a bandit?! What?! That can't have afforded you a very proper education at all!
entries.translated_text: 强、强盗？！什么？！那你根本不可能受过什么像样的教育啊！
