entries.text: Even when I wear thick gloves, somehow metal pieces always jab through them.
entries.translated_text: 即使我戴着厚手套，也不知何故金属碎片总是刺穿它们。

entries.text: I don't know what I could've done to make someone this angry.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道究竟做了些什么能让一个人这么生气。

entries.text: Surely it'd be better to have Gore carry this stuff? Wouldn't you prefer that?
entries.translated_text: 这种东西不该是让格雷来背着？你不喜欢这样吗？

entries.text: When we stop next, Jaxon, let's eat so much that we never want to eat again. Until a few hours pass, and we get hungry again.
entries.translated_text: 下一站，贾克森，让我们大吃一顿，直到再也不想吃东西了。得等好几小时后才会饿的那种。

entries.text: Ah! Raven! Don't let me die! Wait, don't let you die!
entries.translated_text: 啊！渡鸦！别让我死了！等等，你别死了！

entries.text: Do you suppose that sailor is going to have to walk home after this? She looked to be from High Rock.
entries.translated_text: 你认为那个水手在这之后还得走回去吗？她看起来是来自高岩的。

entries.text: Have you ever gone delving into dwemer ruins and seen something cooking over a spit in a falmer camp? And really wanted to just have a taste?
entries.translated_text: 你有没有在锻莫遗址时，看到在伐莫营地里在煮一些东西？你想过尝尝吗？

entries.text: Some have said that I'm indecisive. I'm far from it! I know everything that I want; it's a matter of figuring out which thing I want most.
entries.translated_text: 有人说我优柔寡断。我完全不是！我知道我想要的一切；我只是有时要弄清楚自己需要什么。

entries.text: I'm an only child personally. Always wondered what it'd be like to have a sibling.
entries.translated_text: 我是个独生子女。一直想知道有一个兄弟姐妹会是什么样子。

entries.text: Okay, just be aware that you are leaving me in a marketplace with a lot of shiny things. Whatever happens isn't my fault, okay?
entries.translated_text: 好的，请注意，你将把我留在一个有很多闪亮东西的市场中，不管发生什么事都不是我的错，好吗？

entries.text: The Dwemer Specialist
entries.translated_text: 锻莫专家

entries.text: Easy Job
entries.translated_text: 简单的活

entries.text: Did I hear you say 'moon sugar'? What's in the wind?
entries.translated_text: 我听到你说 "月亮糖 "了吗？有什么新鲜事？

entries.text: Of course. What would you ever do without me?
entries.translated_text: 当然。如果没有我你会怎么做？

entries.text: Yes, and don't forget males, females, beasts, goats, the list goes on and on.
entries.translated_text: 是的，别忘了男人、女人、野兽、山羊，这名单还可以更长。

entries.text: Well, I did get a little sick afterward... But it's an experience you'll never get anywhere else! You'll have to try it sometime!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，后来我确实生了点小病...但这是你在其他任何地方都无法获得的体验！有时间你一定要试试！

entries.text: Please stop healing me in combat.
entries.translated_text: 不用在战斗中治疗我了。

entries.text: (Laughing) You, uh, you really look the part. Although nothing can really hide how dangerous you look. You just look like a rather murderous chef.
entries.translated_text: （大笑）你啊，还真有那么点儿意思。虽然无论怎么伪装，也掩盖不了你危险的气质。现在看起来就像个颇具杀气的厨师。

entries.text: I love to read. I'll read anything as long as it isn't history.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢看书。只要不是历史，我都会读。

entries.text: I love to read. I'll read anything as long as it isn't history.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢看书。只要不是历史，我都会读。

entries.text: "My regards to Alexandre Simon, the High Priest of the Akatosh Chantry..."
entries.translated_text: “我向阿卡托什教会的大祭司亚历山大·西蒙问好...”

entries.text: He has that kind of power and uses it just to chat with you?
entries.translated_text: 他有那种力量，只是为了和你聊天？

entries.text: No, what we had was enough gold to share with neighbors and have a delicious home-cooked buffet.
entries.translated_text: 对，我们是有一些足够与邻里分享的小钱，然后能吃上美味的家常盛宴。

entries.text: You're sympathizing with him now?
entries.translated_text: 你现在同情他了？

entries.text: I'm all ears. Pointy ones at that.
entries.translated_text: 我听得很清楚。我的尖耳朵很灵敏。

entries.text: What's even holding you together?!
entries.translated_text: 是什么让你们在一起？！

entries.text: I suppose we have no choice, then.
entries.translated_text: 看来我们别无选择了。

entries.text: I honestly don't know how to use a crossbow. Maybe you want it?
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我不知道如何使用弩。你想要这把弩吗？

entries.text: I wasn't being serious earlier. In fact, I'm absolutely dedicated to not taking life seriously.
entries.translated_text: 我刚才不是认真的。事实上，我对生活比较游戏人生。

entries.text: Sorry it's not a very exciting answer. I think that's why my work struggles to find willing readers.
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，这不是什么让人兴奋的答案。我想这就是为什么想看我作品的人少的原因。

entries.text: What is it, Mortu?
entries.translated_text: 莫尔图，这是什么？

entries.text: Such dirty talk would be unbecoming for a Lady of Riverwood. Maybe I ought to reconsider who I call my favourite companion.
entries.translated_text: 这样的脏话对河木镇的女士来说是不合适的。也许我应该重新考虑一下我最喜欢的战友团是谁。

entries.text: Oh, have some faith.
entries.translated_text: 拜托，有一点信心。

entries.text: Wrong?! After all he did to me?
entries.translated_text: 错的？！在他对我做了这一切之后？

entries.text: Sorry, I can't get this one.
entries.translated_text: 对不起，我做不到这个。

entries.text: Oh hey, so Remi, I found some of my writing if you'd like to take a look? It's a bit old though.
entries.translated_text: 哦，嘿，蕾米，我找到了一些我写的东西，你想看看吗？都是我的老古董了。

entries.text: Although now I'm imagining what sort of sounds bones would make if we could hear them whilst walking.
entries.translated_text: 不过现在我在想象，如果我们能在走路时听到骨头发出的声音，它们会发出什么样的声音呢？

entries.text: Well... Sought no more. Whatever that means.
entries.translated_text: 好吧...不用再找了。不管那意味着什么。

entries.text: Huh. I wonder how difficult it would be to learn to do that. I imagine some combination of letters wouldn't work well backwards.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我想知道要学会这样做有多难，我想一些字母组合很难倒着念。

entries.text: Wispmothers. Dwarven Centurions. Goats, maybe.
entries.translated_text: 幽魂之母。矮人百夫长。山羊，也许把。

entries.text: If you say so...
entries.translated_text: 如果你这么说...

entries.text: What is going on in this town? All these people going missing, one is a ghost, one turns up as a vampire?
entries.translated_text: 这个小镇到底发生了什么？所有的人都失踪了，一个是鬼魂，一个变成了吸血鬼？

entries.text: Leave me alone!
entries.translated_text: 别管我！

entries.text: You're so good! Good boy!
entries.translated_text: 你真棒！好孩子！

entries.text: This Lexicon you're carrying... some of the Dwemeri writing is familiar. Hm... Incredible! It's so simple, yet so effective! This will be useful!
entries.translated_text: 你携带的这本方典...有些锻莫文字很熟悉。嗯...令人难以置信!它是如此简单，但又如此有效！这很有用!

entries.text: This Lexicon you're carrying... some of the Dwemeri writing is familiar. Hm... Incredible! It's so simple, yet so effective! This will be useful!
entries.translated_text: 你携带的这本方典...有些锻莫文字很熟悉。嗯...令人难以置信!它是如此简单，但又如此有效！这很有用!

entries.text: Here are the ingredients for the chaurus pie.
entries.translated_text: 这是巢蚁薄饼的配料。

entries.text: So the creepy jester man actually attacked Astrid? Are we going to kill him, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么这个令人毛骨悚然的小丑男居然攻击了阿斯垂德？那我们要杀了他吗？

entries.text: Come on. Let's go.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，该走了。

entries.text: I just don't want to let my family down. After all my exploration, I want to make a fortune for us. Maybe make a name for myself by writing a book.
entries.translated_text: 我只是不想让我的家人失望，经历了这些探险后，也许我可以通过写一本书让自己出名，这样还能发大财。

entries.text: But wasn’t there another researcher mentioned in the notes? Where is he?
entries.translated_text: 但是笔记里不是提到过另一位研究员吗？他在哪里？

entries.text: Terrible. Absolutely terrible. I thought there'd be some kind of grim poetry to it at least, but I was shocked by how boring it was.
entries.translated_text: 太糟糕了。简直糟糕透顶。我以为至少会有点冷峻的诗意,但我被它的无聊程度惊呆了。

entries.text: Aaand that's my stomach rumbling. Luckily, I prepared some snacks! Roasted sugar apples? Or charred chaurus chitin? Sweet or savory? Hmm...
entries.translated_text: 并且——那是我的胃在隆隆作响，幸运的是，我准备了一些零食！烤糖苹果？还是烧焦的巢螋角质素？甜的还是咸的？唔...

entries.text: Fear not, Suryvel, I've come prepared. I brought a sweetroll- Oh, I ate it. Well, I also brought- Oh, I ate that, too. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 别怕，苏里维尔，我是有备而来的。我带来了一个甜面包——哦，我吃了。嗯，我还带来了——哦，我也吃了那个，没事了。

entries.text: Any others with us... I don't want to get them mixed up in this any more than they already have been.
entries.translated_text: 任何和我们一起的人...我不想让他们在这件事上有更多的牵连。

entries.text: Yes, precisely the problem.
entries.translated_text: 是的，正是问题所在。

entries.text: But don't worry! It doesn't matter how tired I am, I won't hold you back!
entries.translated_text: 但别担心！不管我有多累，我都不会拖你后腿的！

entries.text: Erm... Who are you talking to?
entries.translated_text: 呃……你在和谁说话？

entries.text: My childhood? What about it?
entries.translated_text: 我的童年？关于什么？

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. Remiel is worried about the safety of her parents, and suggested we head to Riften to search for merchants who may be familiar with her family. We found a smuggler who seems to have the information we need.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，他对蕾米尔对自己家族名声的影响而心怀怨恨。蕾米尔担心她父母的安全，并建议我们前往裂谷寻找可能与她家人熟悉的商人。我们找到了一个走私者，他似乎掌握了我们需要的信息。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. Remiel is worried about the safety of her parents, and suggested we head to Riften to search for merchants who may be familiar with her family. We found a smuggler who seems to have the information we need.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，他对蕾米尔对自己家族名声的影响而心怀怨恨。蕾米尔担心她父母的安全，并建议我们前往裂谷寻找可能与她家人熟悉的商人。我们找到了一个走私者，他似乎掌握了我们需要的信息。

entries.text: I would love to pet Scrap, by the way. Just in case you were wondering...
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，我很想养小渣。以防万一你想知道...

entries.text: Can't say I'm enjoying this cold and snow, though I do like adventuring otherwise.
entries.translated_text: 我很难说我很享受这寒冷和雪，尽管我确实喜欢冒险。（Can't，C开头）

entries.text: (Flirt)
entries.translated_text: （调情）

entries.text: I feel bad killing these Nords when they just want their home back, but... I also want to be friends with the Reiklings. So let's get killing!
entries.translated_text: 我有点为这些诺德人感到难过，他们只是想要回自己的家园，但...我也想和蓝客灵做朋友。所以，开杀吧！

entries.text: I have to see what all the fuss is about!
entries.translated_text: 我倒要看看为什么要大惊小怪！

entries.text: What does he want?
entries.translated_text: 他想要什么？

entries.text: So, am I not allowed to be upset, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么，难道我连生气都不被允许吗？

entries.text: My ears are ringing from the sounds of metal clashing.
entries.translated_text: 金属碰撞的声音真是震耳欲聋。

entries.text: And then add in the fact that we arrive at an inn, and the food is... Nord-y.
entries.translated_text: 然后再加上我们来到一家旅馆，食物是...诺德....

entries.text: No, I mean their crossbows.
entries.translated_text: 不，我是说他们的弩。

entries.text: We are just incredible investigators, aren't we? Eltrys will surely give us a magnificent reward. Or at least, he should.
entries.translated_text: 我们真是传奇的调查员，不是吗？艾翠斯一定会给我们丰厚的奖赏。至少，他应该给。

entries.text: Ah... A beetle-puff. I've heard of them, but in the context of...
entries.translated_text: 啊...甲虫泡芙。我听说过它们，但那时...

entries.text: After reading the book I gave her about Chaurus Pie, Remi has decided she wants to try it. I gathered all the necessary ingredients for Remi. She wants to make the pie at the Candlehearth Hall, just like Nils does.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米读了我给她的关于巢蚁薄饼的书后，决定尝试一下。我为蕾米收集了所有必要的原料。她想在烛炉堂做馅饼，就像纽斯一样。

entries.text: You're not scared of a few sleeping metal men, are you?
entries.translated_text: 你不怕几个熟睡的金属人吧？

entries.text: Well, I have an idea. If I can allow for the wrench to have different lengths...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我有个主意，如果我可以让扳手有不同的长度...

entries.text: If you use two wires approximately the length of a standard dress cord and alternate the pattern in a one-two-three sort of way-
entries.translated_text: 如果你使用两根长度与标准裙带差不多的线，并以一二三的方式交替使用图案--

entries.text: Driller Steam
entries.translated_text: 钻机蒸汽

entries.text: Driller Steam
entries.translated_text: 钻机蒸汽

entries.text: I don't wanna be a sailor! I want to be a warrior!
entries.translated_text: 我不想当水手！我想成为一名战士！

entries.text: O-okay! If you're sure! Thank you!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你确定的话！谢谢！

entries.text: Psst... Meeko... Come here.
entries.translated_text: 嘘...米科...过来。

entries.text: I'm working on it! Give me time!
entries.translated_text: 我在做这个工作！给我点时间！

entries.text: Remi's Crossbow Bolt
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的弩箭

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Sure thing.
entries.translated_text: 没问题。

entries.text: Margret was attacked by a Forsworn? And you're the one who saved her? I wish I was so quick to react as you. It's a good thing it wasn't me there.
entries.translated_text: 玛格丽特被一个弃誓者袭击了？是你救了她吗？真希望我也能像你一样反应迅速，幸好当时我没有在场。

entries.text: I think, and this is just a guess, that for every four Draugr I attack, one of them is actually alive.
entries.translated_text: 我想，这只是一个猜测，我每攻击四个尸鬼，只有一个不是真的尸体。

entries.text: It also helps that I'm familiar with the Divines, including Talos, if we're doing that, so it's less likely I will offend you somehow.
entries.translated_text: 如果是这样的话，我对包括塔洛斯在内的圣灵也都很很熟悉，所以我不太可能冒犯到你。

entries.text: But to do that, I'd have to have a test subject of a more mechanical nature.
entries.translated_text: 但要做到这一点，我需要一些自动机器做一些重复测试。

entries.text: Una, please don't forget I'm standing here. I'm serious, Una. Don't forget me.
entries.translated_text: 尤娜，请不要忘记我站在这里。我是认真的，尤娜，别忘了我。

entries.text: And  I imagine you learned to hold your liquor through your mercenary endeavors?
entries.translated_text: 我想你说为了以此牟利才喝出的酒量？

entries.text: I hope it's worth the trouble.
entries.translated_text: 我希望这麻烦是值得的。

entries.text: The... Swamp Knight? I must say, you don't look much like a knight. Oh! I-I mean...
entries.translated_text: 那个...沼泽骑士？我必须说，你看起来不太像一个骑士。哦，我是说...

entries.text: Although, given his substandard stand-in for the Heart of Lorkhan...
entries.translated_text: 虽然，鉴于他替换洛克汗之心中的那个劣质替代品...

entries.text: Hey, that's not entirely fair. Falkreath also has a lot of trees, and... other trees.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，这并不完全公平。佛克瑞斯也有很多树，还有...其他树。

entries.text: He does work! And not by eating Dwarves!
entries.translated_text: 他确实在发挥作用！而且这个作用不是吃矮人！

entries.text: Oh, you spoil me!
entries.translated_text: 哦，你把我宠坏了！

entries.text: That's probably closer to the truth, Remi, yeah.
entries.translated_text: 这可能更接近事实，蕾米，是的。

entries.text: Hah, got you! Ahmed, did you see that?!
entries.translated_text: 哈，打到你了！艾哈迈德，你看到了吗？！

entries.text: Lovely. That's one less bastard in the world, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 不错，这世界上少了一个混蛋，是吗？

entries.text: Look at this... I've never seen such a design before... Is this... custom?!
entries.translated_text: 看看这个...我从没见过这样的设计...这是... 定制的？

entries.text: I know it isn't much, but I want you to know that I'm here to share your burdens in any way I can.
entries.translated_text: 我知道这并不算什么，但我想让你知道，我会在这里尽我所能分担你的负担。

entries.text: What in Oblivion...?!
entries.translated_text: 湮灭在下...？！

entries.text: The Arch-Mage... dead? Just like that? Sorry, I think I might be in shock.
entries.translated_text: 首席法师...死了？就这样？对不起，我想我可能有点震惊。

entries.text: Really!? That's great news! I get a bit lonely when he's not allowed to relax with me.
entries.translated_text: 真的！？这真是个好消息！？当他不被允许和我一起放松的时候，我就会感到有些孤独。

entries.text: The audacity! Get out of here!
entries.translated_text: 厚颜无耻！离开这里！

entries.text: I must agree; Wayrest puts Solitude to shame as well.
entries.translated_text: 我必须同意； 和途歇城相比独孤城也相形见绌了。

entries.text: Of course, it's less surprising for regicide to be something tasked of you as a Dark Brotherhood assassin than as a member of the Bard's College.
entries.translated_text: 当然，作为黑暗兄弟会的刺客，被派去弑君并不奇怪，但作为吟游诗人学院的成员就有些令人意外了。

entries.text: I have a couple (2).
entries.translated_text: 我有一对(2)。

entries.text: The Dwemer spent all this time building spiders. Maybe it was the spiders that did them in.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫花了这么多时间制造蜘蛛。也许正是这些蜘蛛害了他们。

entries.text: He helped us kill Morvic... (Sigh)
entries.translated_text: 他帮我们杀了莫维克...（叹气）

entries.text: A good, great, wonderful, perfect dwemer spider?
entries.translated_text: 是小好，中好，大好，还是完美无暇的锻莫蜘蛛？

entries.text: Do you suppose the guards will be upset when they find all their imprisoned workers dead? I hope you have a plan for getting out before then.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得狱卒们发现所有被监禁的工人都死了后，会不高兴吗？我希望你能在那之前想好脱身之计。

entries.text: So now the mystery begins to unravel!
entries.translated_text: 所以现在谜团要揭开了！

entries.text: Trying to stay within family expectations while also yearning to follow her heart. I can understand her struggle, though perhaps in a different way.
entries.translated_text: 既想回应家里的期待，也想追寻自己的内心，我能理解他的内心挣扎，尽管也许是以另一种方式。

entries.text: Belethor's...? No, I'd have noticed that. Don't tell me you picked these up in Markarth?
entries.translated_text: 贝莱托尔的......？不，我会注意到的别告诉我你是在马卡斯城捡的？

entries.text: And 'Kagren' is something along the lines of 'Music'.
entries.translated_text: 而“Kagren”则类似于“音乐”。

entries.text: I'm sure he does.
entries.translated_text: 我相信他会的。

entries.text: By Stendarr, I don't think I've ever felt this strong in my life!
entries.translated_text: 斯坦德尔在上，我想我这辈子都没感觉这么强烈过！

entries.text: Can we please see the dwemer museum while we're here?
entries.translated_text: 我们来的时候可以看看锻莫博物馆吗？

entries.text: Your breath is awful!
entries.translated_text: 你的气息好难闻！

entries.text: Val... erius?
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔...莱里乌斯？

entries.text: Ahh! What was that?!
entries.translated_text: 啊！那是什么？！

entries.text: I think your writing just hasn't found its target audience! It's clearly meant for people who enjoy thinking deeply!
entries.translated_text: 我认为你的作品只是没有找到它的目标读者!它显然是为那些喜欢深入思考的人而写的!

entries.text: Honestly, I ask myself every day why I'm following you.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我每天都在问自己为什么要跟着你。

entries.text: When I finally get a contraption working, I feel this huge bolt of energy. It always makes me want to create something else!
entries.translated_text: 当我终于让一个装置运转时，我感受到了巨大的能量，这总是让我想创造别的东西！

entries.text: I doubt it.
entries.translated_text: 我对此表示怀疑。

entries.text: What if he turns out to be better at creating music than dancing to it? That's been the case with most of the bards I've met.
entries.translated_text: 如果他原来更擅长创造音乐而不是随音乐跳舞呢？我见过的大多数吟游诗人都是这种情况。

entries.text: But do you... I don't know, have any hobbies?
entries.translated_text: 但是你...我不知道，有什么爱好吗？

entries.text: Speaking in reverse.
entries.translated_text: 反着说话。

entries.text: I know that my family is safe, and... that's more than enough. Thank you for your help.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我的家人很安全，而且...这就足够了，谢谢你的帮助。

entries.text: Thought you should know: one of our favoured trade partners is... relocating. The Charoud family will be operating out of Skaven, should you have need of their more exotic wares. Their quality of business has not deteriorated from this move. In fact, I'd say their newfound infamy has made many a buyer curious about their merchandise, and the demand has made some of their items quite valuable indeed. You can mail them via the usual routes, but direct the carriers to Skaven instead of Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 如果你有需要他们那些更为奇特的商品的话，我认为你应该知道：最喜欢的贸易伙伴之一正在...搬迁。夏鲁家族将会在斯卡文展开业务。他们的业务质量并没有因此降低。事实上，我认为他们新获得的臭名已经让许多买家对他们的商品产生了兴趣，这些需求也使得他们的一些物品变得相当有价值。你仍然可以通过常规的渠道与他们联系，但请将信件的投递地点改为斯卡文，而不是途歇城。

entries.text: Remi, I honestly can't wait anymore for you to find it, so why don't you have a look at what I put in your backpack?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你找得让我看不下去了，你为什么不看看我在你背包里放了什么？

entries.text: Yeah, yeah. Let's just get back to our brief time of respite, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 是啊。让我们回到我们短暂的休息时间，是吗？

entries.text: I'm here, Joshua. If not in mind, at least in body. But I'll try to keep my mind here for you, too.
entries.translated_text: 我在这里，约书亚。即使不是心灵，至少也有身体 但我也会试着把我的心留在你身边。

entries.text: They were good men. I suppose. Some of them, anyway. You'd have liked talking with the scholars that we picked up from the city.
entries.translated_text: 他们是好人。我想。无论如何，其中一些人是。你会喜欢和我们从城里挑选的那些学者交流的。

entries.text: I suppose this is goodbye, Gore. You truly were so much a Nord.
entries.translated_text: 我想这是永别了，格雷. 你是个真正的诺德人。

entries.text: Remi has decided she wants to make a 'portable chandelier'. She thinks that the only metal that could withstand the power necessary to create this is Aetherium, and she guessed correctly that some could be found in Arkngchal. She used it to build a lantern for herself. If I ever want her to stop using it, she said to just tell her as much.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米已经决定要做一个 "便携式吊灯"。她认为唯一能承受制造这种东西所需力量的材料是神光水晶，她猜对了，在阿卡切尔的确可以找到一些。她用它为自己造了一个灯笼。如果我想让她停止使用它，她说只要告诉她就行了。

entries.text: Oooh, shiny and practical. You really know what a girl likes, huh?
entries.translated_text: 哦，闪亮又实用，你真懂一个女孩喜欢什么，对吧？

entries.text: I don't really want to talk about it.
entries.translated_text: 我真的不想谈论它。

entries.text: Ack! Scrap, don't let my books get wet!
entries.translated_text: 确认！小渣，别让我的书弄湿了！

entries.text: Coin is the only counterweight for a bad reputation.
entries.translated_text: 金钱是唯一能平衡坏名声的砝码。

entries.text: (Muttering)
entries.translated_text: （喃喃自语）

entries.text: I mean, I think I know a lot about surviving and living in the woods. Does that count as education?
entries.translated_text: 我是说，我觉得我很懂怎么在森林里生存、生活。这个也算是一种教育吧？

entries.text: Driller Fx
entries.translated_text: Driller Fx

entries.text: What?! Then why are we here?
entries.translated_text: 什么？！那我们为什么在这里？

entries.text: If I recall from my reading, the Skaal Village is difficult to reach. Maybe we should stop by Raven Rock to rest up before we head out?
entries.translated_text: 如果我没记错的话，斯卡尔村挺难到达的。或许我们应该先去鸦石镇休息一下再出发

entries.text: Watch those traps- I had a skeever problem when while I was here.
entries.translated_text: 注意那些陷阱——我在这里的时候有不少恶鼠。

entries.text: Somewhere dust gathers. That implies the spot is never seen.
entries.translated_text: 我会放在一些堆满灰尘从未有人注意过的地方。

entries.text: The dwemer used tonal forces for their buildings, but also for manipulating weak minds. Good thing for you they aren't around anymore. Kidding!
entries.translated_text: 锻莫为他们的建筑使用音调力量，但也用于操纵弱小的心灵。不过对你来说好事情，因为他们已经不在了。开玩笑啦！

entries.text: Time for a hug.
entries.translated_text: 是时候抱下了。

entries.text: Remi's not entirely innocent, either. Just make sure you know what her end game is.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米也不是完全无辜的，确保你知道她的最终目的是什么。

entries.text: It's either that or one of us is going to have to learn how to cook properly!
entries.translated_text: 要么这样，要么我们当中得有人学会怎么好好做饭！

entries.text: But... So, you don't consider yourself a conjurer?
entries.translated_text: 但是...所以，你不认为自己是法师吗？

entries.text: You ruined your own life, so you had to see others as miserable as you?!
entries.translated_text: 你毁了自己的人生，就非得看别人和你一样惨？！

entries.text: Not *always*. Just mostly.
entries.translated_text: 并非总是如此。只是大多数时候。

entries.text: It was only a matter of time until we found the seedy underside of Skyrim again.
entries.translated_text: 我们迟早会再次发现天际那些阴暗的一面，这只是时间问题。

entries.text: I'm delegating!
entries.translated_text: 我来！

entries.text: Wow! Okay, then, I guess we'd better tell someone that we're going to be getting rid of a cult of assassins, then!
entries.translated_text: 哇！好吧，那我想我们最好还是告诉某些人，我们打算除掉一个刺客教派！

entries.text: Ah! Fighting again! Don't let me die, Josh! Don't let you die!
entries.translated_text: 啊！再战一场！别让我死，约书！别死了！

entries.text: So your writing of characters, it's also to feel... empathetic?
entries.translated_text: 所以你写人物，也是为了感受...感同身受？

entries.text: Argh!
entries.translated_text: 啊！

entries.text: Well, we were still working out the details. We could use your help in, uh, acquiring the raw materials.
entries.translated_text: 我们还在研究细节，我们需要你的帮助，来获取原材料。

entries.text: Well, I suppose I do agree with you, though.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想我确实同意你的看法。

entries.text: And he looked at her, too many eyes opening over his skin and Agryval realized with ice in her veins that she'd been tricked into this strange cabin.
entries.translated_text: 他看着她，数不清的眼睛在他的皮肤上睁开，阿格里瓦尔害怕得颤抖，她被骗进了这个奇怪的小屋。

entries.text: I don't think they're that bad.
entries.translated_text: 我不认为他们有那么糟糕。

entries.text: Perhaps I should have realized my interests were a bit off-kilter then. Oh well.
entries.translated_text: 也许当时我应该意识到我的兴趣有点不正常。哦，好吧。

entries.text: Don't touch her!
entries.translated_text: 不要碰她！

entries.text: What do you think of Skyrim's Civil War?
entries.translated_text: 你如何看待天际的内战？

entries.text: Scrap, keep Revan safe!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，保护渡鸦！

entries.text: Let's continue on, then?
entries.translated_text: 那我们继续吧？

entries.text: Oh! Congratulations on your wedding! I hope the ring was beautiful! I must say, I'm excited to meet your new spouse!
entries.translated_text: 哦！新婚快乐！我希望婚戒漂亮！我必须说，我很高兴见到你的新配偶！

entries.text: Is this your idea of a joke? Don't even think about it.
entries.translated_text: 这是你的笑话吗？别再想了。

entries.text: Seems like things are looking up. It's a nice change.
entries.translated_text: 似乎事情正在好转，这是一个很好的转变。

entries.text: That creates more questions than answers.
entries.translated_text: 这带来了更多的问题。

entries.text: Oh! I don't believe I've ever met a follower of Boethiah. Are they all so similar? What are they like? Were you close with any of them?
entries.translated_text: 噢！我想我从没见过波耶西亚信徒。他们都很相似吗？他们是什么样的？你和他们中的谁很熟吗？

entries.text: Yeah, he should have been able to recognise me from your drawing. It really is surprisingly realistic.
entries.translated_text: 是啊，他应该能从你的画里认出我来。这画得出奇的逼真。

entries.text: Ahmed, what did we do to make everything want to kill us?!
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德，我们做了什么让所有人都想杀了我们？！

entries.text: Hey! Do you like riddles?
entries.translated_text: 嘿！你喜欢谜语吗？

entries.text: I'll let you know when I've got the gist of it, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我知道后会告诉你的，好吗？

entries.text: Yes, we can probably afford to sharpen your blade, for once.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我们大概能负担得起帮你磨一次刀了。

entries.text: I hope you're open to listening to my ideas.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你愿意倾听我的想法。

entries.text: No, but I've visited.
entries.translated_text: 不是，但我去过。

entries.text: Something tells me these Bretons have their eyes trained elsewhere, Elf.
entries.translated_text: 直觉告诉我，这些布莱顿人的眼睛盯着别处呢，小精灵。

entries.text: ...I see. When-uh... Well, how are you handling that?
entries.translated_text: ...我懂了。什么时候-呃...嗯，你是怎么处理的？

entries.text: Hiiii-yah!
entries.translated_text: 嘿呀！

entries.text: An outsider, eh?
entries.translated_text: 外地人，嗯？

entries.text: Remi... Reeeemi?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米...蕾——米？

entries.text: How are you faring, Ahmed?! I'm getting tired!
entries.translated_text: 你过得怎么样，艾哈迈德？！我累了！

entries.text: You said you had a secret?
entries.translated_text: 你说你留有后手？

entries.text: Alright, J'zargo, we've got this!
entries.translated_text: 好的，吉'扎格，我们搞定了！

entries.text: The gods gave me ten fingers, but I never seem to use more than one.
entries.translated_text: 圣灵们给了我十根手指，但我似乎从未用过超过一根。

entries.text: Oh, by the Eight.
entries.translated_text: 哦，八圣灵在上。

entries.text: I read about Arkngchal while staying in Evermore. Researchers hadn't been able to get the lift working, so only the observatory had been seen.
entries.translated_text: 我在永恒城时阅读了一些有关阿卡切尔的文章，研究人员们无法让这里的升降机运行，所以只能看到观测台。

entries.text: Remi is waiting for me to signal in what order to pull the levers blocking our way in Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米正在等我发出信号，准备按照我的顺序拉动拉杆打通拦住我们的通道。

entries.text: Just look at this observatory! It's so lovely. I stayed here several weeks. I just couldn't bring myself to leave!
entries.translated_text: 看看这个观测台吧！它是如此可爱。我在这里呆了好几个星期。让我流连忘返!

entries.text: Okay, Ilia, lead the way!
entries.translated_text: 好的，伊利亚，带路吧！

entries.text: Yes, bandits aren't the gentlest of forest creatures.
entries.translated_text: 没错，强盗可不是森林里最温顺的生物。

entries.text: Really? Does Black-Briar taste so different from the other kinds?
entries.translated_text: 真的？黑棘酒的味道和其他种类的那么不同吗？

entries.text: Oh, now that looks promising!
entries.translated_text: 哦，现在看起来很有希望！

entries.text: Oh, now that looks promising!
entries.translated_text: 哦，现在看起来很有希望！

entries.text: I worry that the people of Markarth can tell we've been taken into the Forsworn 'family'. We would know if they knew, right?
entries.translated_text: 我担心马卡斯城的人会知道我们已经加入了弃誓者的“大家庭”。如果他们真的知道了，我们应该也会察觉到的，对吧？

entries.text: And now, my friend, I have another question for you.
entries.translated_text: 现在，我的朋友，我还有一个问题要问你。

entries.text: The Thalmor are assembling an army of dragons? No peace treaty will be able to stop that. Are we doomed? We're doomed, aren't we?
entries.translated_text: 梭默正在集结一支巨龙大军？任何和平条约都无法阻止这一点。我们注定要失败吗？我们注定要失败，不是吗？

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. However, it seems Morvic has decided to take matters into his own hands, as rumour has it he has been spotted in Markarth. Remiel wants to hunt him down. We should head to Markarth to look.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信徒。然而，莫维克似乎决定自己动手，因为有传言说他在马卡斯城，蕾米尔想抓住他，我们应该去马卡斯城看看。

entries.text: I still think we should help each other through the caved in hall. I think it leads to the security access above.
entries.translated_text: 我仍然认为我们应该互相帮助来通过塌陷的大厅，我认为它通向上面的安全通道。

entries.text: Remi's Tension Wrench
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的张力扳手

entries.text: The villagers never saw Rodard again after that night, but they whispered of a tortured soul, unable to rest with the weight of its guilt.
entries.translated_text: 那天晚上之后，村民们再也没有见过罗达德，但他们窃窃私语着一个饱受折磨的灵魂。

entries.text: A handful of cogs, some kind of differential gear assembly I've never seen before, and... this bent tuning fork.
entries.translated_text: 一把齿轮、某种我从未见过的差速圆轮组件，还有...这把弯曲的音叉。

entries.text: How is the city doing now?
entries.translated_text: 这座城市现在怎么样了？

entries.text: That's good to know.
entries.translated_text: 那还挺不错的。

entries.text: The dwemer were master tonal architects. They used sound to manipulate reality, including to build ruins like these.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫是音调工程大师，他们用声音来操纵现实，建造这样的遗址也包括在内。

entries.text: A book! Really?! Let me see that!
entries.translated_text: 一本书！真的吗？让我看看！

entries.text: The Winking Skeever is as good as I've found, and well, how much can you expect from a place named like that?
entries.translated_text: 眨眼恶鼠是我发现的最好的餐厅，而且，你能对这样一个餐厅有多少期待呢？

entries.text: Yes. Beautiful, sad, and angry.
entries.translated_text: 是的，美丽、悲伤和愤怒。

entries.text: I didn't. Lucky guess? Maybe I did, I dunno. Just glad I was around to snap that "fool" out of his slack-jawed trance.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道。侥幸猜对了？我不知道。但我很高兴能让那个“傻瓜”不再抓耳挠腮。

entries.text: Unable to repay our debts and end up paying with our lives instead.
entries.translated_text: 债务累积无法偿还，最后只能命偿。

entries.text: But I'll admit it's beautiful here. But I can't imagine living in constant darkness, day and night.
entries.translated_text: 但我承认这里很漂亮。但我无法想象生活在暗无天日的环境中。

entries.text: I'd wake up before dawn just so I could be in time to watch my favourite street performer.
entries.translated_text: 我会在黎明前醒来，以便及时观看我最喜欢的街头艺人。

entries.text: Are we going to find it? Please say we are.
entries.translated_text: 我们会找到它吗？请说我们会。

entries.text: Ah. Yes, he doesn't seem to have a very good plan for what he wants to do with the statue after, as far as I can tell.
entries.translated_text: 啊是的，据我所知，他似乎连处理雕像后的靠谱计划都没有。

entries.text: Well, I'm watching my weight.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我在控制我的体重。

entries.text: Any ideas where Morvic might be?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得莫维克可能在哪里？

entries.text: Ow! You hit me!
entries.translated_text: 噢你打我了！

entries.text: Moments like these... remind me I'm not just the good looking pack mule! Come here, you!
entries.translated_text: 每当这种刺激的时候...都在提醒我，我不仅仅是一头英俊的骡子！过来，你！

entries.text: You're embarrassing me! But okay.
entries.translated_text: 你这让我很尴尬！不过还好啦。

entries.text: Which is just the way we like it.
entries.translated_text: 这正是我们喜欢的。

entries.text: Destroying yourself wasn't enough? You had to ruin my life as well?
entries.translated_text: 毁了自己还不够吗？你也要毁了我的生活？

entries.text: Let's go see those ruins! I can't wait!
entries.translated_text: 我们去看看那些遗迹吧！我等不及了！

entries.text: I'll get to working on him as soon as we're out of here!
entries.translated_text: 我们一离开这里，我就会开始帮他升级！

entries.text: You had something to say?
entries.translated_text: 你有话要说吗？

entries.text: I get the feeling that what we're seeing of Avanchnzel is actually just a small portion. I bet the paths to the rest have been lost to cave-ins.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得我们看到的阿旺晨泽尔实际上只是一小部分。我敢打赌，通往其他地方的道路已经因塌方而丢失。

entries.text: How so?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？

entries.text: At times, it feel like there is no one in the world, which is nice with someone, but not if you do not have anyone with you.
entries.translated_text: 有时候，会觉得这世上仿佛一个人都没有——如果身边有人，这种感觉还挺美好的；但若是孤身一人，那就有点难受了。

entries.text: I read up on Nchuand-Zel's history before arriving in Markarth, so I hope you don't mind if I talk about my research.
entries.translated_text: 在来马卡斯成去楚安德-泽尔，我读过楚安德-泽尔的历史，希望大家不要介意我讲自己的研究。

entries.text: Oh, no, no, no! Don't-
entries.translated_text: 不，不，不！不要-

entries.text: That means she had fun, I'm pretty sure.
entries.translated_text: 这说明着她很开心，我很确定。

entries.text: What are we stopping for?
entries.translated_text: 我们停下来做什么？

entries.text: Not that I have any inkling as to how to use either, but I can pretend to.
entries.translated_text: 我可以假装听懂你说的东西。

entries.text: Yes. What else could she have possibly meant? Can't see you being a labourer or a housemaid. Think, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 对。她还能有什么意思？我完全看不出你是个工人或女佣。动脑想想，蕾米。

entries.text: They're very unique; I think they likely have some useful qualities.
entries.translated_text: 它们独一无二，我认为他们中的一些还能使用。

entries.text: Are you trying to say I'm going to die?
entries.translated_text: 你想说我要死了吗？

entries.text: You're definitely a step above most adventurers I've been around.
entries.translated_text: 但你绝对比我身边的大多数冒险者都重要。

entries.text: Nothin' personal!
entries.translated_text: 不是私人恩怨!

entries.text: Oh, you came back! I told myself that if you took much longer, you couldn't be mad at me for looking around on my own. That's out the question now.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你回来了！我告诉自己，如果你再花更长的时间，你就不会因为我一个人瞎逛而生我的气了，现在这不是问题了。

entries.text: Surely you haven't always fought just Argonians? I mean we fight Nords often enough, but it seems different for you?
entries.translated_text: 你肯定不是一直只和亚龙人战斗吗？我的意思是我们经常与诺德人战斗，但对你来说似乎不同？

entries.text: In the end, vengeance won't change what happened.
entries.translated_text: 最后，复仇并不能改变已发生的事情。

entries.text: ;intro scene done
entries.translated_text: ;introscenedone

entries.text: ;intro scene done
entries.translated_text: ;introscenedone

entries.text: Look, I appreciate your company.
entries.translated_text: 看，我很喜欢你的陪伴。

entries.text: I can't disagree more.
entries.translated_text: 我完全不同意。

entries.text: Then, as the sun rose, other kids would come out to play.
entries.translated_text: 然后，随着太阳升起，其他孩子会出来玩。

entries.text: Well, it that happens, you could just drink that skooma I saw you with before to forget all your woes.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果发生这种情况，你可以喝下我以前看到你喝的那种斯库玛，来忘掉你所有的痛苦。

entries.text: Well, one time, I did have to fight a Minotaur. But I was not, like, alone or anything.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，有一次，我确实不得不和一只牛头怪战斗。不过也不是说，我是一个人之类的。

entries.text: Ask Remi about the assassin.
entries.translated_text: 向蕾米询问刺客的事。

entries.text: So you *wouldn't* rob a city now?
entries.translated_text: 所以你现在*不会*抢劫城市？

entries.text: No, no! I just- Never mind. I'm Remiel. What's your name?
entries.translated_text: 不，不！我只是我只是... ...不要紧。我是蕾米尔。你叫什么名字？

entries.text: Yes, more than just knowledge, I gained a desire to see these places and people.
entries.translated_text: 是的，不仅仅是知识，我还渴望去那些地方看看那里的人。

entries.text: Why don't you, then?
entries.translated_text: 那你为什么不呢？

entries.text: I never actually met any of their knights, but the Order of the Dragon is renowned as quite adept.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我从来没有真正见过他们的任何一人，但龙之团以相当精明著称。

entries.text: I wasn't a *noble*. We were simply well-off. Nobles probably eat gold. I assume.
entries.translated_text: 我不是一个*贵族*。我们只是小康。贵族可能吃的是金子。我猜的。

entries.text: Oh, Revan, are you okay? Were you going to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 哦，雷文，你还好吗？你打算问我什么吗？

entries.text: I've been trying to recall pirate stories from my childhood. Does Val greet you with 'ahoy'? I wonder if I should be saying that to him?
entries.translated_text: 我一直在努力回想儿时的海盗故事。瓦尔跟你打招呼时会说 "啊哟 "吗？我想知道我是否应该对他这么说？

entries.text: (Whisper) A strange thing to do while being sneaky, but okay.
entries.translated_text: （低语）在潜行时做这些真奇怪，不过还好啦。

entries.text: Rumarin is incredibly tall. It almost seems like that'd be a hazard. Does he hit his head on door frames all the time? I feel that he must.
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林高得离谱。这简直都成了安全隐患了吧。他是不是经常撞到门框？我总觉得肯定是的。

entries.text: First it's 'Fetch me a drink, Zora!' Then it's 'I am hungry for a goat roast.'
entries.translated_text: 首先是说'给我拿杯酒，佐拉！'。然后是'我饿了，想吃烤羊肉'。

entries.text: Ah, you remembered that, huh?
entries.translated_text: 啊，你记起来了，嗯？

entries.text: No, they just pick a peasant and foist him into whatever armour they can find.
entries.translated_text: 不，他们只是找一个农民，然后给他穿上他们能找到的随意什么铠甲。

entries.text: After I found that out, I was too afraid of being poisoned to eat it again. Of course, logically, I'm well-aware that it's prepared to be safe.
entries.translated_text: 在我发现这一点后，我很害怕被毒死，就不敢再吃它了。当然，从逻辑上讲，我很清楚，它是被处理好了的，是安全的。

entries.text: Cidhna Mine
entries.translated_text: 希讷矿坑

entries.text: Just let me know if you need something else, okay?
entries.translated_text: 如果您还需要其他东西，请告诉我，好吗？

entries.text: I will be in charge of planning, of course. Imagine the music and the dancing, and the flower arrangements.
entries.translated_text: 当然，我将负责筹备。编排音乐、舞蹈和插花。

entries.text: Really, the only thing that matters is that you treat those important to you well.
entries.translated_text: 真的，唯一重要的是你对待那些对你很重要的人。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin, and when I searched the body, I found a letter outlining a hit on Remiel. I should ask her what's going on.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名刺客袭击了，当我搜查尸体时，我发现了一封信，其中概述了蕾米尔遭到袭击的情况。我应该问问她发生了什么事。

entries.text: And it was some of the best-tasting food, when everyone came together to share it.
entries.translated_text: 只有当大家一起分享时，食物才会最美味。

entries.text: Your lack of planning fills me with confidence.
entries.translated_text: 你这种缺乏计划的做法真让我“信心满满”。

entries.text: Anyway, I got you this. I really hope you like it.
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，我给你这个,我真的希望你喜欢它。

entries.text: Before our next expedition, I'm just going to work on Scrap a bit, okay? I think I have some parts stored away here somewhere...
entries.translated_text: 在我们下一次探险之前，我只想研究一下小渣，好吗？我想我有一些零件存放在这里的某个地方...

entries.text: Dwarven Drilling
entries.translated_text: 矮人钻击

entries.text: Dwarven Drilling
entries.translated_text: 矮人钻击

entries.text: Okay, here goes. Hello, I'm Remiel. Who are you?
entries.translated_text: 好的，开始吧。你好，我是蕾米尔。你是谁？

entries.text: Pht, the thought is nice enough, but it's a thought and your actions say otherwise. I'm not a killer for hire. I owe our friend a debt and so do you.
entries.translated_text: 哼，心意是不错，但你的行动却不是这么回事。我没有雇佣杀手。我欠我们的朋友一个人情，你也一样。

entries.text: You face down your greatest fear on the regular?
entries.translated_text: 你经常面对你最大的恐惧吗？

entries.text: Ancient Nords sure did build a lot of burial crypts.
entries.translated_text: 古代诺德人确实建造了很多墓穴。

entries.text: That was rough for me. I think seeing directly how we're affecting people is not so good for my conscience. Can we stick to anonymous robbery?
entries.translated_text: 这对我来说很难，我想直视我们对人们的影响很亏良心，我们还能匿名劫掠吗？

entries.text: What? Why?
entries.translated_text: 什么？为什么？

entries.text: If you weren't so mean, I could take you home. Feed you. Keep you in my icebox.
entries.translated_text: 如果你不那么卑鄙，我可以带你回家，喂饱你，把你放在我的冷藏库里。

entries.text: There is plenty of time for that, after we are all drunk.
entries.translated_text: 我们都喝醉了之后，还有很多时间。

entries.text: Well... Yes, fine, I will grant you that. I suppose I should be happy that you're finally letting Scrap know how amazing he is!
entries.translated_text: 井。。。是的，好吧，我会答应你的。我想我应该很高兴你终于让小渣知道他有多了不起！

entries.text: Er, no I tend to view the Divines a bit... differently. But with Y'ffre... you're pretty religious. Tell me about them?
entries.translated_text: 呃，不，我对圣灵们的看法有点...不同。但是对于伊’弗尔... 你很虔诚。跟我说说他们？

entries.text: So what happened?
entries.translated_text: 所以发生了什么事？

entries.text: Of course I have. I just haven't gotten the chance to go.
entries.translated_text: 我当然好奇，我只是没机会去而已。

entries.text: But a dry branch snapped under his boot, and the wraith spun with dizzying speed to shriek in his face.
entries.translated_text: 但是一根干枯的树枝在他的靴子底下折断了，幽灵以令人眼花缭乱的速度旋转着，冲着他的脸尖叫。

entries.text: The point is, whatever it is he wants, it's much better served being with me.
entries.translated_text: 关键是，无论他想要什么，给我都会更好。

entries.text: Ganbald. Very Nord-y. I suppose it fits, in that case!
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德。很有诺德味儿。我想，在那种情况下，它很合适！

entries.text: We can do this, Joshua! Probably!
entries.translated_text: 我们能做到，约书亚！大概率！

entries.text: I think I'd rather fight a hoard of chaurus than suffer kids like that.
entries.translated_text: 我想我宁愿与一大群巢蚁作斗争，也不愿忍受这样的孩子。

entries.text: I was about eighteen. I'm guessing you would have been just a kid, right?
entries.translated_text: 我那时大约十八岁。我猜你那时还是个孩子，对吧？

entries.text: Some say gems are a girl's best friend, but I doubt you would sell your best friend for money.
entries.translated_text: 有人说宝石是女孩最好的朋友，但我怀疑你会为了钱卖掉你最好的朋友。

entries.text: Be careful! My friend here will tear you to pieces!
entries.translated_text: 当心！我的朋友会把你撕成碎片的！

entries.text: I know, isn't he just- Wait, *unexpected*?! What do you mean 'unexpected'?! He's been nothing but loyal!
entries.translated_text: 我知道，他是不是--等等，*意料之外*？什么叫 "意料之外"？他一直都很忠诚！

entries.text: You know about my past, so I don't feel like I have some awful secret bubbling under the surface.
entries.translated_text: 你了解我的过去，所以我不觉得自己有什么可怕的秘密在内心深处藏着。

entries.text: I've heard Windhelm is cold and lonely, but seems this city is much more beautiful than I thought.
entries.translated_text: 我听说风舵城很冷很孤独，但这座城市似乎比我想象的要漂亮得多。

entries.text: You do, however, need a distraction. You also need the right situation. We could... create a situation.
entries.translated_text: 不过，你确实需要一个分散注意力的办法。还需要合适的时机。我们可以……制造一个时机。

entries.text: Always getting into trouble.
entries.translated_text: 总是惹麻烦。

entries.text: Adventurer, I have something to ask you, if you have a moment.
entries.translated_text: 冒险者，如果你有时间的话，我有件事要问你。

entries.text: The neighborhood kids would get them from exotic merchants and we'd dare one another to eat them.
entries.translated_text: 邻里家的孩子们可以从外地商人那里买到它们，然后我们都跃跃欲试。

entries.text: A dragon who doesn't want to burn us to a crisp... It's a nice change of pace, honestly.
entries.translated_text: 一条不想把我们烧成脆皮的龙……老实说，这是一个不错的节奏变化。

entries.text: Bring spare linen. Thank me later.
entries.translated_text: 带点亚麻布包裹。晚点再来谢我。

entries.text: All right, but if you get arrested, don't blame it on me.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，但如果你被捕了，别怪我。

entries.text: Wait! Wait. I... I'm not ready to leave yet.
entries.translated_text: 等等！等等。我...我还没准备好离开。

entries.text: Hey, thanks! Any idea what meat it is? I'll probably eat it regardless, though.
entries.translated_text: 嘿,谢谢！你知道这是什么肉吗？不过，无论是什么我大概都会吃的。

entries.text: Hello again.
entries.translated_text: 又见面了。

entries.text: Hello again.
entries.translated_text: 又见面了。

entries.text: Hello again.
entries.translated_text: 又见面了。

entries.text: I realized in my youth that this was apparently a... typical... development. I also realized that I don't seem to share such inclinations.
entries.translated_text: 我在还比较小时就意识到，这显然是一种...普遍的...情况。我还意识到，我似乎并没有这种倾向。

entries.text: In Wayrest, children play pranks on each other with Illusion spells, and street performers show off their mastery of fire spells.
entries.translated_text: 在途歇城，孩子们用幻术互相恶作剧，街头艺人用他们精湛的火法术的表演。

entries.text: So, who were these previous drinking partners? Friends?
entries.translated_text: 那么，这些以前的酒伴是谁？朋友？

entries.text: They said what?!
entries.translated_text: 他们说什么？！

entries.text: It's a little embarrassing for me to say, but you're very dear to me.
entries.translated_text: 我说起来有点尴尬，但你对我来说很珍贵。

entries.text: Yes, I mean, you being the stabby-stabby sort, I'm sure you get it.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我是说，你作为一个常年战斗的人应该懂得这些。

entries.text: It says the first thing we'll need is some chaurus meat, which is fairly obvious.
entries.translated_text: 它说我们首先需要的是一些巢蚁肉，很显然。

entries.text: Ughhh, fine. I'll work on it.
entries.translated_text: 呃，好吧。我会努力的。

entries.text: It'll likely need something to heat it up and get it primed. And then some sort of kinetic force to really start it!
entries.translated_text: 它可能需要一些东西来加热它，然后再用一些动能推动来以某种方式真正启动它！

entries.text: Joshua, do you think the amount of blood that left my body is acceptable? Josh? Joshua?
entries.translated_text: 约书亚，你觉得我的血量可以还接受吗？乔希？乔舒亚？

entries.text: But really what you mean is 'big, strong, forgiving, and loyal.' Am I right?
entries.translated_text: 但你真正的意思是“高大、强壮、宽容和忠诚”。我对吗？

entries.text: These little tricksters are always a pleasure to fight!
entries.translated_text: 这些小骗子总是乐于战斗！

entries.text: Wow, where did he get them all? Where has he been keeping them? I suppose the details don't matter.
entries.translated_text: 哇，他从哪里弄来的？他把它们放在哪里了？我想细节并不重要。

entries.text: Yes, I imagine Daedra do have a strange idea of good or bad. Well, so do a lot of mortal, I suppose. It's all subjective anyway.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想魔族确实对好或坏有一些奇怪的想法。嗯，我想很多凡人也是如此。无论如何，这都是主观评价。

entries.text: An alliance of dwemer cities mined and smelted aetherium using the Forge, and the alliance existed primarily in this country.
entries.translated_text: 曾有个锻莫城市联盟，它们通过熔炉开采和冶炼神光水晶，这联盟主要存在于这片土地上。

entries.text: What's going on, Far? You look like you need to say something.
entries.translated_text: 怎么回事，法尔？你看起来需要说点什么。

entries.text: That is very sweet. Wow, it's like wearing a flower that never wilts.
entries.translated_text: 这很浪漫。哇，就像戴着永不凋谢的花。

entries.text: Although if they are the ones who helped you escape, I can see why you'd... trust them.
entries.translated_text: 不过，既然是他们帮你逃出来的，那么我明白你为什么会...相信他们了。

entries.text: Then we'll talk later, Revan.
entries.translated_text: 那我们稍后再谈，渡鸦。

entries.text: Don't get too close to the bars here. The prisoners can still reach through and grab you.
entries.translated_text: 别靠栏杆太近，这里的囚犯还能伸手出来抓你呢。

entries.text: Why are you attacking us?! We're just trying to plunder your tombs!
entries.translated_text: 为什么要攻击我们？！我们只是想搜刮你的坟墓！

entries.text: Of course! I can't believe you didn't ask me sooner.
entries.translated_text: 当然，真不敢相信你们没有早点问我。

entries.text: You're still going to stay with me?
entries.translated_text: 你还要和我在一起吗？

entries.text: Can't even remember what we were talking about exactly, but at one point I started ranting about a couple of the college bards.
entries.translated_text: 甚至不记得我们到底在谈什么了，但有一次我开始对几个学院的吟游诗人大发牢骚。

entries.text: Wha- Oh! You're healing me! Thank you!
entries.translated_text: 什么——哦！你在治疗我！谢谢！

entries.text: I don't know, I think I prefer fighting something like... rats. Less chance of your head being chopped off.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，我想我更喜欢和……老鼠打架。你的头被砍断的可能性更小。

entries.text: So... That whole business, with that trap in the basement... What exactly happened?
entries.translated_text: 那么...地下室陷阱那事...到底发生了什么？

entries.text: The guards everywhere are so incompetent that you must go about solving murders. First Windhelm, now Morthal.
entries.translated_text: 各地的守卫都非常无能，以至于得必须让你去解决谋杀案。先是风舵城，现在又是墨索尔。

entries.text: I could really go for a warm bath right about now.
entries.translated_text: 我现在真的可以去洗个热水澡了。

entries.text: Well, ha, that's...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，哈，那是...

entries.text: Oh, what's this? That's quite a word; I don't normally see it paired with that noun, I must say. Really, this whole passage is... fascinating.
entries.translated_text: 哦,这是什么?那个词用得相当高级;我必须说,我通常不会在那个名词后看到它。真的,整段话都...令人着迷。

entries.text: Ahhhh, Auri, Auri! Get this one over here!
entries.translated_text: 啊啊啊啊啊啊啊啊，奥璃，奥璃！把这个家伙解决掉！

entries.text: And a glass of water.
entries.translated_text: 还有一杯水。

entries.text: Ah, hello! Sam, right?
entries.translated_text: 啊，你好！山姆，对吧？

entries.text: So, you admit I'm funny. I was starting to wonder if my jokes had any impact.
entries.translated_text: 所以，你承认我很有趣了。我都开始怀疑我的笑话还有没有效果了呢。

entries.text: Here. I did well, though, didn't I? I'm sure Val will be proud when I tell him!
entries.translated_text: 给你，我做得很好，不是吗？我相信当我告诉瓦尔时，他会为我感到骄傲的！

entries.text: It will be a shame you won't be able to reflect on your poor choices after Gore's removed your head from your neck!
entries.translated_text: 真遗憾，你不会有机会后悔选格雷当你的对手了！

entries.text: is just scoffing at those who didn't turn their back on him for the crime of a momentary lapse of judgement.
entries.translated_text: 只不过在嘲笑那些没有因为一时失误而背信弃义的人罢了。

entries.text: So this Septimus fellow became obsessed with the dwemer and lost his mind in his pursuits... Why are you looking at me like that?
entries.translated_text: 所以这个塞普汀默斯迷上了锻莫，在他的追寻中失去了理智...你为什么这样看着我？

entries.text: Besides, you're hardly in a position to be judging that, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 况且，你似乎也不太处于能评判这个的立场，不是吗？

entries.text: Remi, can you invent a weather machine?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你能发明一台气象机吗？

entries.text: Probably not in places that are regularly examined, like my belongings chest.
entries.translated_text: 我不会把赃物放在比如财务箱这种定期检查的地方。

entries.text: So, Jasrah, was there something you needed? You look like you need something.
entries.translated_text: 那么，贾斯拉，你需要什么吗？你看起来需要什么。

entries.text: Oh, I'm fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我很好。

entries.text: I've made the prototype, my-ah-"tuning fork". It's a matter of determining the correct frequency for it to do what I want.
entries.translated_text: 我做了原型，我的“音叉”。剩下的无非就是确定正确频率了。

entries.text: She's a mercenary. Pretty handy with a battleaxe. She goes anywhere, as long as there's coin.
entries.translated_text: 她是佣兵。用战斧很厉害。只要有钱，她就可以去任何地方。

entries.text: She's a mercenary. Pretty handy with a battleaxe. She goes anywhere, as long as there's coin.
entries.translated_text: 她是佣兵，战斧使得很厉害，只要有钱，她就可以去任何地方。

entries.text: Did you need something, Una?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，尤娜？

entries.text: Oh yeah? What is it?
entries.translated_text: 哦耶？它是什么？

entries.text: Either way, maybe he knew I stayed at the Silver Blood Inn. We should look around there, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，也许他知道我住过银血旅店，我们应该看看周围，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: You did eat one of the sweet rolls I was saving. I wasn't going to say anything, but you brought it up.
entries.translated_text: 你确实吃了我准备的一个甜卷。我本来不想说的，但你提出来了。

entries.text: Well, Kodlak. I hardly knew you. But I hope you can find some sort of peace in Hircine's Hunting Grounds.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，克拉科。我几乎不认识你了，但我希望你能在海尔辛的狩猎场找到某种平静。

entries.text: I'm not a mercenary.
entries.translated_text: 我不是雇佣兵。

entries.text: I wonder if Igmund's father was being condescending to the Forsworn he was talking with. I wouldn't negotiate with someone like that either.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道依格蒙德的父亲是否在对与他谈判的弃誓者也如此傲慢。要我也不会和这样的人谈判。

entries.text: You want to carry a chandelier everywhere?
entries.translated_text: 你想带着一盏吊灯到处走吗？

entries.text: Farms smell...really bad.
entries.translated_text: 农场闻起来...真的很糟糕。

entries.text: Are you a witch, because you've bewitched me.
entries.translated_text: 你是女巫吗，对我下了迷魂药。

entries.text: I'm sure there are less dangerous people to align yourself with. (Persuade)
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定，你可以选择与不那么危险的人结盟。（说服）

entries.text: Oh, I get it! Like when I was little I always wanted to fight a troll, and I kept getting told I would get killed.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我懂！就像我小时候一直想和巨魔打一架，可大家总是跟我说那样会被干掉一样。

entries.text: How are you still alive?!
entries.translated_text: 你怎么活下来的？！

entries.text: I'm not great at keeping up on current events. I just feel that other things are more important. Uncovering the secrets of Aetherius, for example.
entries.translated_text: 我不擅长跟上时事。我只是觉得其他的事情更重要。例如，揭开艾瑟瑞斯的秘密。

entries.text: Remi has decided she wants to make a 'portable chandelier'. She thinks that the only metal that could withstand the power necessary to create this is Aetherium, and she guessed correctly that some could be found in Arkngchal. I should bring what I found to her.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米已经决定要做一个 "便携式吊灯"。她认为唯一能承受制造这个所需力量的材料是神光水晶，而且她猜对了，在阿卡切尔就可以找到一些。我应该把我找到的东西带给她。

entries.text: Oh, is that the perfect man to you? It's rather specific, don't you- Wait. What do you mean 'what's a diagram'?
entries.translated_text: 哦，这是你心目中的完美男人吗？这很形象，不是吗-等等。“什么是图标”是什么意思？

entries.text: But expecting this soul gem to stand in place of the Heart of Lorkhan is... impractical. Isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 但指望这颗灵魂宝石代替洛克汗之心是...不切实际的。不是吗？

entries.text: Pick a Divine and pray.
entries.translated_text: 好好祈求你的神灵吧。

entries.text: (Whisper) Hey! You could just ask next time instead of grabbing.
entries.translated_text: （低语）嘿！下次你可以直接问，而不是抢。

entries.text: Agryval called out for the boy, frightened and panicked. He appeared over her, still smiling that same smile.
entries.translated_text: 阿格里瓦尔惊慌失措地喊着男孩。他出现在她面前，仍然带着同样的笑容。

entries.text: Ah, take a deep breath. That's the smell of the criminal underworld. I do hope you have some perfumes to cover it up.
entries.translated_text: 啊，深呼吸。那是犯罪的味道，我希望你有一些香水来掩盖它。

entries.text: Oh, Revan, please be careful!
entries.translated_text: 哦，渡鸦，请小心！

entries.text: Those Greybeards can shout *really* loudly. If we're going to see them, remind me to stick some cotton in my ears before we meet.
entries.translated_text: 那些灰胡子吼声真大，如果我们要去见他们，请提醒我在见面之前在我的耳朵里塞一些棉花。

entries.text: I get the feeling that this expedition group from before us did not have a happy ending. Why is it we always end up following researchers' failures?
entries.translated_text: 我觉得我们之前的这个探险队没有一个圆满的结局，为什么我们总是追随着研究者的失败？

entries.text: I hope you've been committiing to memory the specific variations in the architecture in here. I want to test you later. Just for fun.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你能记住这里架构的具体变化。我想稍后考考你。只是为了好玩。

entries.text: Yes. Thank you.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，谢谢你！

entries.text: Are you doing okay, Raven?! Enough blood in your body still?
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗，渡鸦？！你体内的血液还够吗？

entries.text: Who do you think has killed more Draugr?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得谁杀的尸鬼更多？

entries.text: So all cats are mean! Good to know!
entries.translated_text: 所以所有的猫都很卑鄙！辛亏我知道！

entries.text: Let's work on your crossbow project.
entries.translated_text: 让我们来完成你的弩项目。

entries.text: It's okay if you trail behind.
entries.translated_text: 落后点也没关系。

entries.text: This should be good. If only I could see his face when the Order comes knocking at his door.
entries.translated_text: 这应该能成，真希望骑士团来敲他的门时，我能看见他脸上的表情。

entries.text: Perhaps we'll go over them? Oh! And writing! Maybe I'll give you little things to write as well! This is a bit exciting, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 也许我们看一看？哦还有写作！也许我也可以给你写一些小东西！这真令人兴奋，不是吗？

entries.text: I assume we're not going to tell him, 'Oh yes, we're taking you to the Prince of Domination, who will likely do worse than kill you.'
entries.translated_text: 我想我们不会告诉他：“哦，是的，我们要带你去见支配魔神，他可能会让你生不如死。”

entries.text: That sounds familiar. Hmm...
entries.translated_text: 这听起来很熟悉。唔...

entries.text: Really? But you fight them all the time!
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？但是你一直在和他们战斗！

entries.text: Candlehearth Hall
entries.translated_text: 烛炉堂旅店

entries.text: Excellent work, Yaz! And you didn't even need to stab them with a quill! I really must think of something better to say after fights...
entries.translated_text: 干得漂亮，雅扎！你甚至用不上你的羽毛笔！我真的得想出更好的战后宣言...

entries.text: They had some 'colourful' language.
entries.translated_text: 他们有一些“丰富多彩”的语言。

entries.text: Bold move on your part to take the lead.
entries.translated_text: 你主动带头，可真是大胆。（Bold，B开头）

entries.text: It doesn't get more satisfying than that.
entries.translated_text: 没有比这更令人满足的事情了。

entries.text: Yeah, exactly. Sometimes being strange is a strength.
entries.translated_text: 是的，正是。有时古怪也是一种力量。

entries.text: I'm not sure that I necessarily follow her tenets either, though.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我也不确定我是否一定要遵循她的信条。

entries.text: Oh, it wasn't that hard! You're familiar with the power transference between soul gem and kinetic pistons within automata?
entries.translated_text: 没那么难，你熟悉机器人内的灵魂石和动能活塞之间的能量转移吗？

entries.text: Are you sure?
entries.translated_text: 你确定？

entries.text: Ohhh, Scrap. Are you okay? I'll fix you right up, I promise.
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣。你还好吗？我会马上把你修好，我保证。

entries.text: Oh, wow. That's quite the legacy.
entries.translated_text: 哦，哇。那真是传承。

entries.text: And I don't have to see her myself, so...
entries.translated_text: 而且我又不必亲自见她，所以...

entries.text: (Laugh) No need for that. Yet. I'll keep it in mind, though, thank you.
entries.translated_text: （笑）没必要。然而。不过我会记住的，谢谢。

entries.text: I'm an Argonian, remember?
entries.translated_text: 我是一个亚龙人，记得吗？

entries.text: The stuff tastes horrible. In hindsight, the whole process would have gone a lot faster if I'd taken notes.
entries.translated_text: 这东西味道太难吃了。事后想想，如果我做了笔记，整个过程会快很多。

entries.text: Hmm... Do bandits put out bounties? Like on guards they don't like?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...强盗们会发布悬赏吗？比如他们不喜欢的守卫？

entries.text: I can't afford to become addicted to skooma, sorry.
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，我可不能染上斯库玛的瘾。

entries.text: It's nice and warm!
entries.translated_text: 真是漂亮又暖和！

entries.text: Alright, I'll let you take a stab at it.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我会让你试一试。

entries.text: Suspicious Merchant
entries.translated_text: 可疑的商人

entries.text: And... open!
entries.translated_text: 然后。。。打开

entries.text: I, um, it is hard to explain. I mean... I just have met a lot of mean Argonians and a lot that want to kill me.
entries.translated_text: 呃，这个...很难解释。我的意思是...我遇到过很多刻薄的亚龙人，还有不少想杀我的。

entries.text: Just gotta get the context. I assumed you needed that for some type of alloyed bond with the Dwemer materials.
entries.translated_text: 只需要了解一下背景。我假设你需要这一个东西，用于与锻莫金属融合成某种合金。

entries.text: Such as the... gravestones? And all the... other gravestones?
entries.translated_text: 比如那些...墓碑？和所有其他的...墓碑？

entries.text: I'll probably go back there someday. Maybe we can go together?
entries.translated_text: 我可能有一天会回到那里。也许我们可以一起去？

entries.text: Yes. Yes, you're right. I'll try to... suppress all my questions. Which will be hard work, so I hope you appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，你说得对我会尽量...憋回我的问题。这会很难，所以希望你能理解！

entries.text: If we can avoid what went wrong with binding himself to the college... Imagine the possibilities!
entries.translated_text: 如果我们能避免他那样把自己束缚在学院里的问题...想想那种可能性！

entries.text: Kill Nimhe.
entries.translated_text: 杀死尼姆赫。

entries.text: Remiel, I'd recommend caution going forward here.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔，我建议在这里谨慎行事。

entries.text: Wow, that's really profound. But I was thinking maybe you've killed a, uh? Sabrecat or something. That'd be impressive.
entries.translated_text: 哇，这话可真有深度。不过我本来以为你是杀过那种，呃...剑齿虎之类的？那可就真厉害了。

entries.text: Yea! Oo, I am so excited!
entries.translated_text: 好耶！哦，我好激动！

entries.text: Wow, it's a good thing I had you carry the Staff.
entries.translated_text: 哇，我有你法杖真是太好了。

entries.text: Hagravens are terrifying. And intriguing. The best combination.
entries.translated_text: 乌鸦鬼婆既令人恐惧，又让人着迷，最完美的组合。

entries.text: Frankly, my hearing is not what it used to be. Too many blows to the head.
entries.translated_text: 坦率地说，我的听力已不比从前。我的头受过了太多打击。

entries.text: Well, naturally, I won't say 'no'. At least, I usually wouldn't. My heart just really isn't in it right now, though.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，当然，我不会说'不'。至少，我通常不会。不过，我现在还没这个心思。

entries.text: Hmm... Yes, yes, I think it is! It will take me a moment to read through this. Don't you worry, though, I'm excellent at multitasking.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...是的，是的，我想是的！我要花一点时间读完这本书。不过，别担心，我擅长一心多用。

entries.text: Maybe some Skooma. Bottles of Moon Sugar.
entries.translated_text: 也许是一些斯库玛，几瓶月亮糖。

entries.text: Ilia, I meant to tell you- Well, I suppose it's a little late for that. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚，我是想告诉你——嗯，我想现在说得有点晚了。没关系。

entries.text: You sound like someone trying to sell me skooma. Why are you even trying to get me to use them?
entries.translated_text: 你听起来像是个想卖给我斯库玛的毒贩。你为什么要让我使用它们？

entries.text: I hate that it happened. Were you able to do anything about it? All those knightly orders in High Rock... Surely they're not all useless...
entries.translated_text: 我讨厌发生这种事你能做点什么吗？高岩的那些骑士团...他们肯定不全都一无是处...

entries.text: Do you have anyone in Cyrodiil other than your parents?
entries.translated_text: 你在赛瑞迪尔除了父母之外还有其他人吗？

entries.text: The warm sand of Elsweyr is far away from here.
entries.translated_text: 艾斯维尔温暖的沙子离这里太远了。

entries.text: That makes sense. I can certainly relate. But I'm sure you could resist pressing buttons for a moment? For bonding?
entries.translated_text: 这很有道理。我当然能理解。但我敢肯定你可以暂时按捺住这种想法？因为信任？

entries.text: Well, it certainly doesn't seem like you're all talk, given our kill count. But...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，考虑到我们的杀人数，你不想只是说说。但是...

entries.text: Look! It's the Red Mountain! It's still spitting out ash after all this time!
entries.translated_text: 看！是红山！这么久了还在冒烟！

entries.text: If they ever made a competition out of eating Elsweyr Fondue, I'd be Grand Champion.
entries.translated_text: 如果他们用吃艾斯维尔奶酪来比赛的话，我会是总冠军。

entries.text: How's it going, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 怎么样，蕾米？

entries.text: ...Well, that explains why I can't find my copy of Last Scabbard of Akrash.
entries.translated_text: ...好吧，这就解释了为什么我找不到我的《阿卡拉什的最后剑鞘》了。

entries.text: Are you okay?! Where did you go?!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？！你去哪儿？！

entries.text: It's not like there's other things she needs to address.
entries.translated_text: 看起来她没有其他事要做。

entries.text: Excellent! Okay.
entries.translated_text: 太好了！行。

entries.text: Yes, what is it?
entries.translated_text: 是的，怎么了？

entries.text: Yes, what is it?
entries.translated_text: 是的，怎么了？

entries.text: But yes, I do have a spare. Here.
entries.translated_text: 但是，是的，我确实有一个备用的。给你。

entries.text: I'm sure I can brew you a potion to fix you right up!
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定，我可以给你酿一瓶药水，让你马上恢复元气！

entries.text: But really? No big food desires? Even your wildest food fantasies are just... whatever we can scrounge up?
entries.translated_text: 但是你说的是真话吗？你就没有什么幻想要吃的东西？即使你最疯狂的食物幻想也只是...有啥吃啥？

entries.text: Can still hear you!!
entries.translated_text: 我还是能听到！！

entries.text: But that requires... ugh... studying, and that does sound absolutely boring.
entries.translated_text: 但这需要...呃...学习，听起来确实很无聊。

entries.text: You want to pick a fight with Ilia?! That's rather stupid!
entries.translated_text: 你想和伊利亚战斗吗？！这真是太愚蠢了！

entries.text: An unseen enemy, crippling you from within.
entries.translated_text: 一个看不见的敌人，从内部削弱你。

entries.text: Of course, I make sure to keep it professional! It's mostly a thesis on the dwemer, with a little... fun mixed in.
entries.translated_text: 当然，我一定要保持专业！它主要是关于矮人的论文，夹杂着一点...乐趣。

entries.text: Good example of that is Chief Bartokh, from my play 'The Ecstasy of Bartokh of the Void'.
entries.translated_text: 举个例子比如我的剧本《虚空的巴托克的狂喜》的巴托克酋长。

entries.text: Partly your fault?
entries.translated_text: 是你的错?

entries.text: Sentinel? What is that?
entries.translated_text: 哨兵城？那是什么？

entries.text: Does that mean you enjoy my company?
entries.translated_text: 这是否意味着你喜欢我的陪伴？

entries.text: My living father also took a pretty hard hit from it.
entries.translated_text: 我在世的那个父亲也受到了很大的打击。

entries.text: Like I said, I'm certain Arkngchal would've had some stored away somewhere. Just... look around.
entries.translated_text: 就像我说的，我确信阿卡切尔会有一个储存它的地方。只要...到处找找。

entries.text: Yes, yes, Scrap, I'm fine, I promise.
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，小渣，我很好，我保证。

entries.text: Take Remi to Candlehearth Hall.
entries.translated_text: 带蕾米去烛炉堂。

entries.text: Fine, fine. You got the important stuff now anyway.
entries.translated_text: 好的，好的。反正你现在了解了最重要的东西了。

entries.text: The passage to it is back upstairs.
entries.translated_text: 通往它的通道在后面的楼上。

entries.text: This is Keening?! As in the dagger used to access the power of the Heart of Lorkhan?
entries.translated_text: 这是哀恸？！就是那把用来获取洛克汗之心力量的匕首？

entries.text: Thanks, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢，蕾米。

entries.text: Sometimes. Like around strangers, I get told to go home, or they ask where my parents are.
entries.translated_text: 有时候会这样。比如在陌生人身边时，他们会让我回家，或者问我的父母在哪里。

entries.text: Then, we'll make the sauce. In you go tomatoes and water! And some salt. And it says that if we want it sweet, to add as much honey as I want, so...
entries.translated_text: 然后，我们来做酱汁。你把西红柿和水放进去！还有一些盐。上面说，如果我们想要甜味的话，可以添加我想要的蜂蜜，所以...

entries.text: A few months after I joined. There wasn't one big incident that made me decide to leave; I just gradually stopped showing up.
entries.translated_text: 我加入几个月后。也没有什么大事件促使我决定离开。我只是逐渐不再出现了。

entries.text: You'll let me, won't you?
entries.translated_text: 你会让我去的，不是吗？

entries.text: I'm with you, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 我和你在一起，我的朋友。

entries.text: Aaaaand this is why I don't go around singing. I'd be dead within the week.
entries.translated_text: 这————就是为什么我从不到处唱歌的原因,我估计一个星期内就会没命。

entries.text: Okay, Doctor, let's neither of us die!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，医生，我们俩都不要死！

entries.text: We'll talk some more later, then, Rennic.
entries.translated_text: 我们稍后再谈，那么，雷内克。

entries.text: You're not half-bad, you know?
entries.translated_text: 你不是一般的坏，你知道吗？

entries.text: Do rounder faces coincide with warmer weather? I've never noticed such a thing, but I admit I haven't been paying attention to it.
entries.translated_text: 更圆的脸与温暖的天气有关系吗？但我承认我一直没有注意到这一点。

entries.text: I was thinking about it while you were testing, and I realized that the wrench might take up too much space in the lock sometimes.
entries.translated_text: 我在你测试时正在想，然后我意识到扳手有时可能会占用锁里的太多空间。

entries.text: I think I see danger ahead. And wouldn't you know it, I think my back just went out on me.
entries.translated_text: 我好像看到前面有危险。而且你猜怎么着——我好像闪到腰了。

entries.text: I thought you were supposed to be winning us a staff?
entries.translated_text: 我想你会为我们赢得法杖？

entries.text: Ha ha ha ha! Yeah, I sure did! It was one of my best pranks, yet!
entries.translated_text: 哈哈哈哈！没错，我确实做到了！这是我迄今为止最棒的恶作剧之一！

entries.text: Yes, I suppose you did. I'm glad you made it out of there in one piece.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我猜你确实做到了，我很高兴你能安然无恙地走出来。

entries.text: Do you have something you'd prefer to be attacked by?
entries.translated_text: 你更想被什么东西攻击呢？

entries.text: By Sheor, this Borkul the Beast really does live up to his name. And I mean that in a... complimentary way. Mostly.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，这个野兽波库尔果然名不虚传。我是说...主要在...夸奖。

entries.text: How deep is the water?
entries.translated_text: 水有多深？

entries.text: Well, I was wondering... No, it's stupid. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想知道...不，这很愚蠢。没事。

entries.text: Don't be jealous, Scrap. Our friend's spider isn't replacing you.
entries.translated_text: 不要嫉妒，小渣。我们的蜘蛛朋友不会取代你。

entries.text: You look like you want to ask me something.
entries.translated_text: 你看起来想问我什么。

entries.text: Oh, sorry, did you say something?
entries.translated_text: 哦，对不起，你说什么了吗？

entries.text: So, Auri, what is your family like?
entries.translated_text: 那幺，奥璃，你的家人是什么样的？

entries.text: It focuses raw power to the extent that it will drain your life force unless you handle it with a very particular gauntlet.
entries.translated_text: 它将原始力量集中到极致，如果不使用特定的护腕来控制，它会耗尽你的生命力。

entries.text: You're definitely right. It'd help if draugr took baths, probably.
entries.translated_text: 你肯定是对的。如果尸鬼会洗澡可能会好一些。

entries.text: Khash, do you... do you do anything for fun? You just seem to go adventuring, which I totally understand, don't get me wrong...
entries.translated_text: 卡什，你会...做些什么娱乐吗？你看起来总是在冒险——我完全能理解，别误会我的意思——但除此之外呢？

entries.text: Sure, if you can fit it in with Scrap in the way.
entries.translated_text: 当然，如果小渣在里面还放得下的话。

entries.text: I'm actually in the middle of some complex mental calculations, so can you make this quick?
entries.translated_text: 实际上我正在进行一些复杂的心算，你能快点吗？

entries.text: Aw, you've matured with age, Val.
entries.translated_text: 噢，随着年龄的增长，你已经成熟了，瓦尔。

entries.text: Now, would you prefer dwemeris architecture, dwemeris law, dwemeris culture, a book about a thief meeting a terrible end, or dwemeris philosophy?
entries.translated_text: 现在，你更喜欢锻莫建筑、锻莫法律、锻莫文化、一本关于小偷最终下场的书，还是锻莫哲学？

entries.text: You know, Nchuand-Zel wasn't my first choice of dwemer ruin to see in Skyrim. I first tried exploring another one, closer to the Hammerfell border.
entries.translated_text: 要知道，在天际中，楚安德-泽尔并不是我的第一选择。我首先试着探索了另一个遗址，那离落锤省边境更近。

entries.text: Wonderful! Leave it to me, okay?
entries.translated_text: 太好了！包在我身上，好吗？

entries.text: Are we heading out, Revan?
entries.translated_text: 我们要出去了吗，渡鸦？

entries.text: By Sheor, that had to have been at least ten of them, though!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔啊，至少拿了十个！

entries.text: I wish I could understand how a group of people can hate others so much that they'd go to war over it.
entries.translated_text: 我真希望能明白，一群人怎么会如此憎恨他人，以至于愿意为此发动战争。

entries.text: We are a great team, Ahmed!
entries.translated_text: 我们是一个很棒的团队，艾哈迈德！

entries.text: Well, my father died when I was very young.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我父亲在我很小的时候就去世了。

entries.text: It was Marlok.
entries.translated_text: 是马洛克。

entries.text: Oh, well, we covered reading... I... Well, this is sort of silly, but I actually write. About our adventures, mostly.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，我们涵盖了阅读...我...嗯，这有点傻，但我实际上是在写作。关于我们的冒险，主要是。

entries.text: You know, you don't have to pretend for me.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，你不必在我面前假装。

entries.text: The way these automotons have been wired to protect these cultists is ingenious! I'm sure I can apply these techniques to strengthen Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这些锻莫机械保护这些邪教徒的方式非常巧妙！我确信我可以应用这些技术来强化小渣。

entries.text: The way these automotons have been wired to protect these cultists is ingenious! I'm sure I can apply these techniques to strengthen Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这些锻莫机械保护这些邪教徒的方式非常巧妙！我确信我可以应用这些技术来强化小渣。

entries.text: The way these automotons have been wired to protect these cultists is ingenious! I'm sure I can apply these techniques to strengthen Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这些机器保护这些邪教徒的方式非常巧妙！我确信我可以应用这些技术来强化小渣。

entries.text: Wow, you learn *really* quickly, adventurer. Are you sure you shouldn't be training the Greybeards?
entries.translated_text: 哇，冒险者，你学得真的快。你确定你不应该训练下灰胡子吗？

entries.text: Aela, will you tell me about your family?
entries.translated_text: 艾拉，你能告诉我你的家人吗？

entries.text: Teldryn Sero, blade for hire.
entries.translated_text: 在下泰卓因·西荣，职业是佣兵。

entries.text: Really, of all the books Gore could've chosen, it was a history book? Adventurer, we need to get that man some standards.
entries.translated_text: 真的，格雷选的书，居然是本历史书？冒险者，我们得给那个男人一点标准。

entries.text: I've never seen such ingenuity beyond the Dwemer's creations! How did you manage... All this in such a small space?
entries.translated_text: 我从未见过比锻莫更聪明的东西你是怎么...在这么小的空间里做到的？

entries.text: Oh! Er. Well, I suppose if you weren't raised there, you wouldn't have any strong feelings about it.
entries.translated_text: 哦！好吧，我想如果你不是在那里长大的，你就不会有什么强烈的感觉了

entries.text: Hello, handsome. What do you need?
entries.translated_text: 你好，帅哥，你需要什么？

entries.text: W-wow! I think I'm really getting the hang of this fighting thing!
entries.translated_text: 哇！我想我真的了解这件战斗的事了！

entries.text: Although, they were able to sync up minds to project thoughts... But it's still not quite the same.
entries.translated_text: 虽然，他们能够将思想与项目思维同步...但还是不太一样。

entries.text: That's right. I hope it brings you the same comfort it has for me.
entries.translated_text: 是的。我希望它能给我带来同样的慰籍。

entries.text: It's really okay.
entries.translated_text: 真的没关系。

entries.text: (Surprised Laugh) Well! I have always learned best from diagrams, but in this case, your words paint a clearer picture.
entries.translated_text: （吃惊的笑）嗯！我曾以为图标才能让人了解到最多的东西，但你说的话比任何图标都要清楚明了。

entries.text: Wait, actually, there appears to be some Dwemeris here, too.
entries.translated_text: 等等，其实这里好像也有锻莫语。

entries.text: *Astrid* betrayed us? And then begged you to mercy kill her? I... What has she done...? The brotherhood is... Oh no.
entries.translated_text: 是阿斯垂德背叛了我们？然后求你杀了她？我...她做了什么...？兄弟会是...哦，不。

entries.text: Congrats on being named Arch-Mage, by the way.
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，恭喜你被任命为首席法师。

entries.text: Glad that you've finally caught up. (Laugh)
entries.translated_text: 很高兴你终于赶上趟了（笑）。

entries.text: Okay, Nar, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，纳尔，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: So, you really don't like scholarship, Rumarin?
entries.translated_text: 所以，你真的不喜欢知识，鲁马林？

entries.text: The Empire banned worship of Talos with the White-Gold Concordat.
entries.translated_text: 帝国通过白金协定禁止了对塔洛斯的信仰。

entries.text: Okay, Nar, back to- What were we doing? Don't tell me; I'll remember eventually.
entries.translated_text: 好的，纳尔，回到——我们在做什么？别告诉我;我最终会记得的。

entries.text: Every light in the sky is a small hole torn to Aetherius as the Gods turned tail and fled Mundus.
entries.translated_text: 天空中的每一道光都是艾瑟瑞斯撕开的一个小洞，那是诸神掉头逃离梦达斯的痕迹。

entries.text: Aghhhh, why aren't all the cogs fitting together!?
entries.translated_text: 啊啊啊，为什么不是所有的齿轮都装配在一起！？

entries.text: You look like you're up to mischief. And why was I not included?
entries.translated_text: 你看起来像是在逗我玩。为什么我没有被包括在内？

entries.text: I need to know that my family is safe, though. They dealt frequently with Skyrim's less savory merchants.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我需要确保我的家人是安全的，他们经常与天际那些不太干净的商人打交道。

entries.text: Remi, in Valenwood, being a thief is considered a virtue.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，在威木省，盗窃被认为是一种美德。

texts: Have you ever delving into dwemer ruins and seen something cooking over a spit in a falmer camp? And really wanted to just have a taste?
你是否曾经深入过锻莫遗迹，看到伐莫过营地的烤架上煮着什么？而且真的想尝尝？

entries.text: It's true that Trinimac was defeated. I believe that, and most Orcs will, too, if you can get them to admit it.
entries.translated_text: 崔尼马克确实被打败了。我相信，如果你能让他们承认这一点，大多数兽人也会这样做。

entries.text: Hall of Attainment
entries.translated_text: 成就大厅

entries.text: Don't answer that. I'm sure I'm wrong, but I want to pretend that the world has a bird that tastes like a dessert.
entries.translated_text: 不要回答我。我肯定我错了，但我想假装世界上有一种鸟，它的味道像甜点。

entries.text: I must admit Maven is a cunning woman. And also I'm terrified to be meeting her. You can do all the talking, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我必须承认玛雯是一个狡猾的女人。我也很害怕见到她。所有和她交谈的活就交给你了，好吗？

entries.text: And for me... Well, I guess I only have my brain. Actually, now that I'm thinking about it, I'm pretty weak. Maybe I'll disappoint you, after all.
entries.translated_text: 对我来说...嗯，我想我只有我的大脑。其实，现在想想，我挺弱的。也许到头来我会让你失望。

entries.text: Anyway, we would spend quite a bit of time together. We never declared an official term for our relationship.
entries.translated_text: 总之，我们会花相当多的时间在一起。我们从未为我们的关系宣布一个正式的术语。

entries.text: Skyrim is a big place. He won't be able to find you.
entries.translated_text: 天际是一个很大的地方。他会找不到你的。

entries.text: Look at how big these mushrooms grow here! Maybe because they are left alone for thousands of years?
entries.translated_text: 看看这些蘑菇在这里长多大！也许是因为他们被单独留下了数千年？

entries.text: Oh well, I am sure you'll find me eventually if that happens.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，如果这样的话，我相信你最终会找到我的。

entries.text: Maybe we'll find something fun this time?
entries.translated_text: 也许这次我们会找到有趣的东西？

entries.text: Will she pay for our food, too? Ideally, I want a balanced meal.
entries.translated_text: 她也会为我们的食物买单吗？如果可以，我希望营养均衡。

entries.text: While I stayed in Arkngchal, I got food by stealing from the neighboring Forsworn camps. I can't say their cuisine is very palatable.
entries.translated_text: 当我待在阿卡切尔时，我从附近的弃誓者营地偷食物吃，不过他们做的菜可不好吃。

entries.text: Yep, definitely the most frightening person I've ever met.
entries.translated_text: 是的，绝对是我见过的最可怕的人。

entries.text: So we're like... friends?
entries.translated_text: 所以我们就像...朋友？

entries.text: I just hope you don't get hurt in the course of it.
entries.translated_text: 我只希望你在这个过程中不要受伤。

entries.text: Metal Lubricant
entries.translated_text: 金属润滑剂

entries.text: There are a lot of things I did back then that I don't do anymore.
entries.translated_text: 我当年做的很多事情现在都不做了。

entries.text: There are a lot of Bretons in Markarth. When you first approached me, I thought you were just another homebody Markarth citizen.
entries.translated_text: 马卡斯城有很多布莱顿。当你第一次来找我时，我还以为你只是另一个宅在家里的马卡斯城市民。

entries.text: Number four, well, that has to be Mzulft.
entries.translated_text: 第四个，嗯，那肯定是树皮遗址。

texts: No one can decide on who should rule it now, so it's been in the hands of a council until a decision is made.
现在没有人能决定由谁来统治它，所以在作出决定之前，它一直掌握在一个理事会的手中。

entries.text: Where Is Remi Living?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米住在哪里？

entries.text: Picking Remi's Brain
entries.translated_text: 听取蕾米的意见

entries.text: (Whispering) Why are we whispering? (Normal) And why won't they let you get a drink? Are they... racist...?
entries.translated_text: （低语）我们为什么要这么小声？（正常）他们为什么不让你喝一杯？他们是...种族主义者...？

entries.text: Yes, there are so many, might as well pick out all the ones you want.
entries.translated_text: 是的，既然有这么多的神，不如挑出所有你想要的。

entries.text: That's what my potions usually taste like.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我的药水通常的味道。

entries.text: That's what my potions usually taste like.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我的药水通常的味道。

entries.text: Giants seem to really love their mammoths... It's so endearing.
entries.translated_text: 巨人似乎真的很喜欢他们的长毛象...太可爱了。

entries.text: Oh! Wow! That's a lot of blood I'm losing! That's probably bad!
entries.translated_text: 哦哇！我流了好多血！我感觉很糟糕！

entries.text: He implied I would get the mace afterward.
entries.translated_text: 他暗示我之后会给我那个钉锤。

entries.text: I'm sorry, what?
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，你说什么？

entries.text: Well, maybe if you ate with me more, I'd talk about it less?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许如果你多和我一起吃饭，我会少谈论它？

entries.text: Oh, we're going this way now?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我们现在走这条路吗？

entries.text: Oh, yes, sorry. My mistake.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，对不起。我的错误。

entries.text: Oh, yes, sorry. My mistake.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，对不起。我的错误。

entries.text: Oh, yes, sorry. My mistake.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，对不起。我的错误。

entries.text: (Laugh) Sorry, I just was not expecting that.
entries.translated_text: （笑）抱歉，我只是没想到会那样。

entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？

entries.text: Are you okay?
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？

entries.text: It sounds like an honour, to be a second to the blessing. Hopefully Hrothmund doesn't mind me being a third.
entries.translated_text: 这听起来像是一种荣誉，成为第二个赐福者。希望哈洛斯蒙不介意我成为第三名。

entries.text: I'll keep that in mind. Braig's story does make me rather sad, but that's the point of the stories in the first place.
entries.translated_text: 我会记住的。布莱吉的故事确实让我很难过，但这故事本身的意义就是如此。

entries.text: About that assassin from before, Remi...
entries.translated_text: 关于之前那个刺客，蕾米...

entries.text: Should we take a job while we're here?
entries.translated_text: 我们在这里的时候应该找份工作吗？
