entries.text: So it was just good luck?
entries.translated_text: 所以只是运气好？

entries.text: No... Most of my drinking partners end up losing all their coin... when they can't keep up with me...
entries.translated_text: 不...我的大多树酒伴都在喝不过我时...输光了...

entries.text: You just go out and do whatever it is you need to do... And when you're done, come back. I should be finished by then!
entries.translated_text: 你可以出去做你需要做的任何事情...当你完成后就回来。到时候我应该完成了！

entries.text: J'zargo understands.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格懂你。

entries.text: I guess you do seem like the type who disregards their own life in favour of gold.
entries.translated_text: 我猜你看起来确实是那种刀口上舔血的人。

entries.text: They even have considerable influence over the counsel that is ruling temporarily until someone swoops in to claim they should be king.
entries.translated_text: 他们甚至对暂时执政的议会有相当大的影响力，直到有人突然出现声称自己应该成为国王。

entries.text: The steam running through pipes sometimes sounds like screaming. ...Those... are the pipes, right?
entries.translated_text: 流经管道的蒸汽有时听起来像是在尖叫...那些...是管道，对吧？

entries.text: And their big ones, too! For example, all the automaton they left behind!
entries.translated_text: 还有他们的大家伙！例如，他们留下的所有自动机械！

entries.text: Ubbe, I hope whatever you are about to ask me is something fun.
entries.translated_text: 乌贝，我希望你接下来要问我的都是有趣的。

entries.text: Shh. Leave it to me.
entries.translated_text: 嘘。交给我吧。

entries.text: Well, that's just grand.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这确实很厉害。

entries.text: Yes, well. Ah. Nice to meet you.
entries.translated_text: 是的，啊。很高兴认识你。

entries.text: Remi has been thinking of a new project, and it has something to do with Tonal Magic. She's not sure where to begin, but she thinks if we can find a book with more information, she might be able to get an idea of what to do. We're heading to the College of Winterhold to see if they have anything to help.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米一直在考虑一个新项目，这与音调魔法有关。她不知道从哪里开始，但她认为如果我们能找到一本包含更多信息的书，她可能会知道该怎么做。我们将前往冬堡法师学院，看看他们是否有什么需要帮助的。

entries.text: That's what I was taught growing up, yes.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我在成长过程中所接受的教育，是的。

entries.text: We live another day! Unless we die in the next fight Josh leads us to.
entries.translated_text: 我们又活了一天！除非我们在乔希带领我们的下一场战斗中死去。

entries.text: But I honestly don't care much. I've never been into politics.
entries.translated_text: 但老实说，我并不在乎。我从不关心政治。

entries.text: But I honestly don't care much. I've never been into politics.
entries.translated_text: 但老实说，我并不在乎，我从不关心政治。

entries.text: Any further skill gain just makes me that much more impressive. Er, not to- not to *boast*, of course.
entries.translated_text: 任何技能的精进都会让我更加兴奋。当然，才不是为了*炫耀*。

entries.text: Ulfric wants to rule Skyrim... but he can't even rule Windhelm.
entries.translated_text: 乌弗瑞克想要统治天际……但他甚至无法统治风舵城。

entries.text: Is this propaganda? Love propaganda?
entries.translated_text: 这是宣传吗？爱的宣传？

entries.text: Yes, that's part of what makes me able to work on Scrap. Look.
entries.translated_text: 是的，这就是让我能够修好小渣的部分原因，看。

entries.text: 'Grim' is not what I want to hear when it comes to my meals.
entries.translated_text: “糟糕”不是我想在吃饭时听到的。

entries.text: (Laughs) Oh, Remi. You're kidding, right?
entries.translated_text: （笑）哦，蕾米。你在开玩笑吧？

entries.text: Hm. Well. I guess it wouldn't hurt... After all, I know what I'm doing.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。太棒了。我想这不会有什么伤害...毕竟，我知道我在做什么。

entries.text: And I don't have the patience not to kick him somewhere sensitive and make a run for it.
entries.translated_text: 我没有耐心忍住不揍他。

entries.text: Well, how do you want to start it?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你想怎么开始写呢？

entries.text: I'm sorry, but I don't know anything about that.
entries.translated_text: 对不起，但我对此一无所知。

entries.text: Now back to that thought I was thinking...
entries.translated_text: 现在，我继续想我之前的事...

entries.text: ...And the fact that he only had Keening, which is likely broken...
entries.translated_text: ...而他只有哀恸，还很可能已经坏掉了...

entries.text: Just assist! As an assistant. Really, if I don't go with, The Gourmet's cooking will be subpar for the emperor.
entries.translated_text: 只要帮忙就行！作为助手。真的，如果我不去，美食家的烹饪会让皇帝失望。

entries.text: Have Remi lockpick doors or chests.
entries.translated_text: 让蕾米给门或箱子开锁。

entries.text: It would have set my father up for life. His mercantalism would have been renowned.
entries.translated_text: 这会让我父亲终生受益。他的商业帝国会遍布大陆。

entries.text: You grew up in a paradise! Well, in some ways, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 你是在天堂里长大的！不管怎么说，在某些方面是。

entries.text: If you leave me here too long, Ahmed, I will take no responsibility for the outcome.
entries.translated_text: 如果你把我留在这里太久了，艾哈迈德，我不会对结果负责。

entries.text: The truth is, I never cared much for snow.
entries.translated_text: 事实上，我从不太在乎雪。

entries.text: They were a constant threat to my safety, despite me clearly having no ill intentions toward them.
entries.translated_text: 他们时刻威胁着我的安全，尽管我对他们显然没有恶意。

entries.text: Oh, Remi, it's okay. You're alright. I'm sure it's only your imagination that the ceiling is sinking closer to you.
entries.translated_text: 哦，蕾米，没事了，你没事的。我相信你就要重建天日了，这只是你的想象而已。

entries.text: But you being an...adventurous one, I'm sure you'll end up in some more dwemer ruins eventually.
entries.translated_text: 但你是一个...喜欢冒险的人，我敢肯定你最终还是会跑去探索更多锻莫遗迹。

entries.text: After all the walking we've been doing, we need something to drink. Let's hurry and get some water.
entries.translated_text: 走了这么多路，我们得喝点东西。我们赶紧去找水喝吧。

entries.text: Mmm... I've been craving fish!
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我一直想吃鱼！

entries.text: Surely a young woman has better things to do than put up with my bad hygiene and worse jokes on the road, eh?
entries.translated_text: 一个年轻女人总有更好的事情可以做，而不是忍受我糟糕的卫生习惯和在路上讲的烂笑话，不是吗？

entries.text: Aela, sometimes I just have no idea what you're talking about.
entries.translated_text: 艾拉，有时我只是不知道你在说什么。

entries.text: Redcap, I think you should tell Nazeem that he should get to the Cloud District sometime. He'll understand what it means.
entries.translated_text: 红帽子，我想你应该告诉纳奇姆，他应该找个时候去一次云顶区，他会明白是什么意思的。

texts: It looks like a bunch of diamond shapes all overlapping one another. Like a fern? I doubt it's a fern.
这看起来像一堆相互重叠的菱形。像是蕨类植物？我怀疑这是蕨类植物。

entries.text: The audacity! I'll see to it the Jarl hears of your abuse of a court scholar!
entries.translated_text: 大胆！我会确保领主将得知你虐待宫廷学者的消息！

entries.text: After reading the book I gave her about Chaurus Pie, Remi has decided she wants to try it. I gathered all the necessary ingredients for Remi. We've arrived at the Candlehearth Hall kitchen, and Remi made the pie. She didn't like it, but at least I get a Chaurus Pie out of it.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米读了我给她的关于巢蚁薄饼的书后，决定尝试一下。我为蕾米收集了所有必要的原料。我们到了烛炉堂厨房，蕾米做了馅饼。她不喜欢，但至少我从中得到了一个巢蚁薄饼。

entries.text: Inner Sanctum
entries.translated_text: 内部圣所

entries.text: Excellent! This partnership was a wonderful idea!
entries.translated_text: 非常棒！这种合作关系真是一个绝妙的主意！

entries.text: When I grow up, I wanna join the Legion!
entries.translated_text: 等我长大了，我要加入帝国军团！

entries.text: Please, just leave me be. I need to... Never mind. I'll be here when you're... done.
entries.translated_text: 请让我静一静。我需要...没关系我会在这里等你......搞完。

entries.text: Now, let's not fight.
entries.translated_text: 我们认为最好还是别针锋相对。

entries.text: Oh! Is 'love propaganda' prostitution? I'd think that'd be more the Temple of Dibella's field.
entries.translated_text: 哦！"爱的宣传"是指卖淫吗？我想这更应该是蒂贝拉神殿干的事。

entries.text: After this, it'd be great to stop at an inn.
entries.translated_text: 在这之后，最好找一家旅店停下来。（他们又开始玩起接首字了，After，A开头）

entries.text: (Whisper) They leave so much out on the counter. Easy pickings...
entries.translated_text: （低语）他们在柜台上留下了这么多。轻松拿到...

entries.text: Are you very familiar with thieves, Yazakh?
entries.translated_text: 你对盗贼很熟悉吗，雅扎克？

entries.text: You know ale is used to make Elsweyr Fondue? Not that I'm going to cook with this; I'm too excited to drink it.
entries.translated_text: 你知道艾斯维尔起司锅是用麦芽酒做的吧?并不是说我要用它来烹饪，我太兴奋了，喝不下去。

entries.text: (Whisper) They'll never see us coming, with us crouched down. They'll look right over our heads, I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: （低语）他们永远不会看到我们来了，我们蹲下。我敢肯定，他们会只会看过我们的头顶。

entries.text: Animunculi weren't just used as guards. The dwemer often led them into battle. Imagine fighting an army that doesn't feel pain or fear.
entries.translated_text: 蒸汽机械不仅被当作卫兵，锻莫还经常将他们带入战斗里，想象一下与一支不会感到痛苦或恐惧的军队作战。

entries.text: I don't know why I can't get this out of my mind, but...
entries.translated_text: 我不知道为什么我无法摆脱这种想法，但是...

entries.text: We lost our source of income, fell into poverty, became more familiar with the... underside of Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 我们失去了收入来源，陷入了贫困，再次了解了...途歇城的阴暗面。

entries.text: You didn't really think that seeing just some of Skyrm's ruins would satisfy me, did you?
entries.translated_text: 你不会真的认为只看到一些天际的遗址就会让我满意，对吧？

entries.text: What can I do for my doting spouse?
entries.translated_text: 我能为我的爱人做些什么？

entries.text: I wish I didn't have to hurt you...
entries.translated_text: 我希望我不必伤害你...

entries.text: I mean, you don't have to help. I just thought it might be fun.
entries.translated_text: 我是说，你不必帮忙。我只是觉得这可能很有趣。

entries.text: Come on, you've never wanted to have a conversation with an automaton?
entries.translated_text: 拜托，你从来都没想过和机器人对话？

entries.text: I'm not particularly fond of, um, skooma, but moon sugar makes a very nice ingredient in some foods.
entries.translated_text: 我并不特别喜欢"月亮糖"，但 "月亮糖"在某些食物中是很好的配料。

entries.text: Yeah... I guess that's the adventurer's life for you. It doesn't tend attract people who are tethered to something.
entries.translated_text: 是啊......我想这就是冒险者的生活吧。它往往不会吸引那些会被什么东西给束缚住的人。

entries.text: But she supports me on the path I decided to travel. The path of a scholar, obviously.
entries.translated_text: 但她在我决定走的道路上支持我，学者之路，当然了。

texts: But she supports me on the path I decided to travel. The path of a scholar, obviously.
但她在我决定走的道路上支持我。显然是学者的道路。

entries.text: Truly, the metaphors are quite brilliant! The... Flame atronach contained by conjuration magic...
entries.translated_text: 真的,那些隐喻相当精彩!那个...由召唤魔法束缚的火焰元素...

entries.text: 'Our brothers', he says. As though brothers regularly murder one another. I suppose I don't have any brothers to actually verify that claim, though.
entries.translated_text: 他说 "我们的兄弟"。好像兄弟之间经常互相残杀似的。不过，我想我可没有任何能证实这种说法的兄弟。

entries.text: This dwemer armour is so beautifully crafted. But how am I meant to be robbing people while wearing it?
entries.translated_text: 这件锻莫盔甲制作得非常漂亮。但我怎么会在穿着它的时候抢劫别人呢？

entries.text: Uhhh...
You don't think they have bed bugs here, do you? You can take the bed, okay?
entries.translated_text: 你不认为他们这里有臭虫，是吗？你睡的可是床，好吗？

entries.text: Wonderful! I'm looking forward to it.
entries.translated_text: 好极了！我很期待。

entries.text: Well, you stopped Ancano. I just sort of laid on the floor.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你阻止了安卡诺，我只是躺在地板上。

entries.text: There was a few people fighting him.
entries.translated_text: 我们有几人一起与他战斗。

entries.text: Noooo, you have to get some actually tasty food!
entries.translated_text: 不，你必须吃一些真正美味的食物！

entries.text: As a side note, I am not joining this cult with you. While it's different from... Other things... It's too similar for me to simply... go along with.
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，我不会和你们一起加入这个邪教。虽然它和其他东西...不同...但对我来说似曾相识，我不能...就这么...加入你们。

entries.text: Isn't Markarth amazing?
entries.translated_text: 马卡斯城是不是很棒？

entries.text: Why don't I teach you how to use it?
entries.translated_text: 我可以试着教会你？

entries.text: I prefer not to kill Spriggan, but they seldom leave me any choice.
entries.translated_text: 我不想杀树精，但他们很少让我有选择的余地。

entries.text: What sort of cruelty is this, to imprison people underground?
entries.translated_text: 把人监禁在地下，这是何等的残忍？

entries.text: Oh, Ganbald, please be careful!
entries.translated_text: 哦，甘巴尔德，小心！

entries.text: Why do they leave the beds so barren? They do know the dwemer had cushioning, right? It just didn't last all the thousands of years since they left.
entries.translated_text: 为什么他们把床弄得这么简陋？他们知道锻莫是有垫子的吧？只是那些垫子没能熬过矮人离开后的几千年罢了。

entries.text: I scrambled out and... got yelled at my Marlok...
entries.translated_text: 我爬了出去，然后...对我的马洛克呼喊...

entries.text: Una, I have been having so many ideas, and none of them will ever work outside my head. Please be sorry for me.
entries.translated_text: 尤娜，我有太多的想法，但没有一个能在我脑海外实现的，真是遗憾。

entries.text: No, let's part ways for now.
entries.translated_text: 不，我们暂时分道扬镳吧。

entries.text: Grab me an iron ingot? Then we can head to the Markarth Forge, the one where that Orc and her Imperial apprentice work.
entries.translated_text: 给我一块铁锭？然后我们可以前往马卡斯锻造厂，去那个兽人和她的帝国人学徒工作的地方。

entries.text: Amazing! I'm so happy you took me to a dwemer ruin!
entries.translated_text: 真棒！我很高兴你带我去了一个锻莫遗址！

entries.text: Oh! It's a bit frightening there, what with the skirmishes always going on.
entries.translated_text: 哦！那里有点吓人，总是发生小规模战斗。

entries.text: Trinimac served the Aedra for years as one of their champions, until they saw fit to just... abandon him.
entries.translated_text: 崔尼马克作为他们的勇士之一为伊德拉们服务多年，直到被他们认为适合的时机……被抛弃了。

entries.text: Remi, how are you doing?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你好吗？

entries.text: Stay focused, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 保持专注，蕾米。

entries.text: You do not want to fight Ria! Or me!
entries.translated_text: 你不会想和利亚战斗的！或者我！

entries.text: I don't know, I'm a very picky person, and it's very hard to find a Nord beverage that suits my palate.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，我是一个非常挑剔的人，很难找到适合我口味的诺德饮品。

entries.text: You can see why I'm considering a career change.
entries.translated_text: 你现在知道我为什么要考虑转行了吧。

entries.text: Leave Remi in Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 将蕾米留在阿卡切尔。

entries.text: Leave Remi in Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 将蕾米留在阿卡切尔。

entries.text: Morvic is almost certainly in there, the bastard.
entries.translated_text: 莫维克几乎肯定在里面，这个混蛋。

entries.text: Well, that's not great, seeing as that's where we're currently living.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，听起来不太妙，我们目前还住在那里呢。

entries.text: Ow! Aww, you remind me of Numi!
entries.translated_text: 哦！哇，你让我想起了纳米！

entries.text: Well, when I left, it was... fine.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，当我离开时，它……很好。

entries.text: Well, when I left, it was... fine.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，当我离开时，它……很好。

entries.text: Get 'em, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 抓住他们，小渣！

entries.text: Get 'em, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 抓住他们，小渣！

texts: You've been causing me a lot of trouble, Remiel. And I've grown tired of it. Your little stunt with the Order of the Hour sealed your fate.
你给我添了很多麻烦，蕾米尔。我已经对此厌倦了。你对时序会骑士团耍的小把戏决定了你的命运。

entries.text: Tell me what sort of book you'd like. I want to get one for you.
entries.translated_text: 告诉我你想要什么样的书，我想给你弄一本。

entries.text: Molag Bal.
entries.translated_text: 莫拉格·巴尔。

entries.text: And that'd be another victory for Gore and I! Oh, and I suppose you, too, adventurer.
entries.translated_text: 这将是另一场格雷和我的胜利！哦，我想你也是，冒险者。

entries.text: Come here, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 过来，小渣。

entries.text: Remi has an idea for making lockpicking a quicker process. We traveled to the Markarth Forge, where she created her prototype tension wrench, and I tested how it works. However, it doesn't seem to have any real effect on my lockpicking. I should tell Remi about this.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米有个想法，让开锁变得更快。我们去了马卡斯城锻造厂，她在那里制造了她的原型张力扳手，我测试了它是如何工作的。但是，它似乎对我的开锁没有任何实际影响。我应该把这件事告诉蕾米。

entries.text: Shouldn't we burn the draugr so they can't rise again?
entries.translated_text: 我们不应该烧掉尸鬼，让他们再也不能复活了吗？

entries.text: I think if I practiced, I could power down automaton before being noticed, almost like a sneak kill. Maybe someday.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得如果我练习一下，我可以在不被察觉的情况下关闭自动机器，就像悄悄暗杀一样。也许有一天能做到。

entries.text: Look out!
entries.translated_text: 小心！

entries.text: The Dunmeri architecture is so fascinating! Shaped like shells, braced against the ash.
entries.translated_text: 丹莫建筑太迷人了！形状像贝壳，覆盖着灰烬。

entries.text: The researchers that were here before us are people after my own heart. Dissecting animunculi, setting camp inside a dwemer city...
entries.translated_text: 在我们之前在这里的研究者和我心意，拆解蒸汽机械，在锻莫城市里扎营...

entries.text: It feels unfair to attack someone who can't see me.
entries.translated_text: 攻击一个看不见我的人是不公的。

entries.text: Does that make them heroes, or murderers?
entries.translated_text: 这让他们成为英雄还是杀人犯？

entries.text: No, nothing important.
entries.translated_text: 没，没什么重要的。

entries.text: Snow? In Skyrim? Surprising, that.
entries.translated_text: 天际会下雪，哇哦，真是一件奇事呢。

entries.text: Nchardak was actually designed to flood, you know. The Nords once tried to invade it, and the dwemer flooded it in response until they gave up.
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，纳查达克实际上是为了洪水而设计的。诺德人曾经试图入侵它，锻莫淹没了它，直到他们放弃。

entries.text: Absolutely not! I'll have no part of your scam.
entries.translated_text: 绝对不行，我不会参与你们的骗局。

entries.text: You already know what I'm going to say about this ring delivery and its... recipient. I'll leave the particular words to your imagination.
entries.translated_text: 你已经知道我想说什么了，关于这枚戒指的交付和它的......收件人。至于具体要说什么，就留给你自己去想吧。

entries.text: 呕吐气母
entries.translated_text: 呕吐气母

entries.text: Oh, Scrap, I'm just glad the assassin didn't demolish you or something. I don't think I could've emotionally recovered.
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，我只是很高兴那个刺客没有弄坏你哪个零件，不然我可要伤心死了。

entries.text: Remi, let's write that tip-off to the Order of the Hour.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，让我们把这个举报信写给时序团。

entries.text: I don't feel any different.
entries.translated_text: 我不觉得有什么不同。

entries.text: Oh, sorry I was thinking about something.
entries.translated_text: 哦，对不起，我在想一些事情。

entries.text: Okay, stay safe!
entries.translated_text: 好的，注意安全！

entries.text: You mean do two things at the same time?
entries.translated_text: 你是说同时做两件事？

entries.text: I like the pretty lights! Yay!
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢漂亮的灯！耶！

entries.text: It's fun most days, but hard work. I'm tired.
entries.translated_text: 大多数时候很有趣，但工作很辛苦，我很累。

entries.text: It's such a sad story. Is it bad I think it's exciting?
entries.translated_text: 这是一个多么悲伤的故事。是不是很糟糕，我认为这很令人兴奋？

entries.text: Oh! I also made some doodles, though! Let's see... It looks like three... Uh...
entries.translated_text: 哦！不过还好我也做了一些涂鸦！让我们看看...看起来有三个...嗯...

entries.text: 'Bcharn' is something like 'technology' or 'control.' A machine that can be controlled.
entries.translated_text: “Bcharn”类似于“技术”或“控制”。可以控制的机器。

entries.text: Jarl Idgrod seems to be quite wise. I hear she has visions, too. Finally a Jarl worthy of their position.
entries.translated_text: 艾德格洛德领主似乎很聪明。我听说她也有灵视。终于有了一个配得上他们位置的领主。

entries.text: Oh, can we please take a netch home? Just look at them! Please!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我们可以带一只气母回家吗？看看它们吧！求你了！

entries.text: So about your chandelier project...
entries.translated_text: 那么关于你的吊灯项目...

entries.text: (Sigh) Alright. I suppose he did ask you, after all, and I shouldn't deny you your fun.
entries.translated_text: 好吧我想，毕竟他要求的是你，我不应该剥夺你的乐趣。

entries.text: I have always wanted to be a princess! Life is not a fairy tale. Yet I have always dreamed that one day it might be.
entries.translated_text: 我一直想成为公主！虽然生活不是童话。然而，我一直梦想着有一天能这样。

entries.text: The most dangerous sort of man - quick to anger, but patient in his vengeance. Be careful. Both of you.
entries.translated_text: 最危险的那种人——易怒，但对复仇却极其耐心。当心点，你们两个。

entries.text: In my mind, it was a delicacy unrivaled by anything I'd ever tried before.
entries.translated_text: 在我看来，这是我吃过最美味的佳肴。

entries.text: Nar and I will kill you! You've made a terrible mistake fighting us!
entries.translated_text: 纳尔和我会杀了你！敢和我们战斗，真是可怕的错误！

entries.text: Can we get some food instead?
entries.translated_text: 我们可以换点吃的吗？

entries.text: Simba, I was thinking... I- Uh. What- What was I thinking about? Oh well. Were you about to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 辛巴，我在想...我——呃。什么——我在想什么？哦，好吧。你是想问我什么吗？

entries.text: Well, it's certainly irrefutable that many Divines hold great power. However, I fear your definition might be a bit vague.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，许多圣灵都拥有无可匹敌的力量，这当然是无可辩驳。然而，我担心你的定义可能有点含糊。

entries.text: Hah. The Ravens would've loved you.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。群鸦团会喜欢你的。

entries.text: Oh, I've never been that far east! How was it there?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我从来没有去过那么东的地方！那里怎么样？

entries.text: What, you can't break down the door, my big, strong Adventurer?! Or perhaps you're hoping to catch a glimpse of our Daedric ghost!
entries.translated_text: 怎么，你不能破门而入吗，我高大威猛的冒险者？或许你是想看一眼我们的魔族鬼魂！

entries.text: A Stewed Mammoth Stomach would fill my stomach nicely.
entries.translated_text: 炖猛犸象胃就可以很好地填饱我的肚子。

entries.text: Were you able to do anything about it? All those knightly orders in High Rock... Surely they're not all useless...
entries.translated_text: 你能做些什么吗？高岩的那些骑士团......当然，他们也不全是废物......

entries.text: Then why have you been letting me explain High Rock to you like you don't know?
entries.translated_text: 那为什么你一直让我像对不懂的人一样给你解释高岩的事情？

entries.text: O-oh? They are? I suppose that means you *didn't* attend the College.
entries.translated_text: 噢？他们看不上？我想这意味着你“没有”加入学院。

entries.text: I know he doesn't look like it now, but I'm sure I can get him in tip-top shape.
entries.translated_text: 我知道他现在看起来不像，但我相信我可以让他变得越来越厉害。

entries.text: Trust me when I say you won't stay curious very long, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 相信我，蕾米，你不会好奇太久的。

entries.text: Ah! Revan, we seem to be under attack!
entries.translated_text: 啊！渡鸦，我们似乎受到了攻击！

entries.text: Here, give me that thing.
entries.translated_text: 来，把那个东西给我。

entries.text: Do you suppose Yaz writes any stories meant to frighten people? I wonder if she'd let me read them. I quite like scary stories.
entries.translated_text: 你认为雅扎会写一些用来吓唬人的故事吗？我想知道她是否会让我读一读。我很喜欢恐怖的故事。

entries.text: Are we moving on, then?
entries.translated_text: 那我们继续前进吗？

entries.text: Bandits aheads. I'm not sure whose turn it is to pay the bandit toll.
entries.translated_text: 强盗在前面，我不知道该轮到谁来付强盗的过路费了。

entries.text: Whoever saw a natural archway and thought 'I'm putting a city on that' was an artistic genius and maybe just a little mad.
entries.translated_text: 看到一座天然拱门就想 “我要在上面建一座城市 ”的人绝对是个艺术天才，也许只是有点疯。

entries.text: That was not what I expected you to say, but honestly this is even better. Do you bake?
entries.translated_text: 我没想到你会这么说，不过说实话，这个更好。你会烘焙吗？

entries.text: I wish I could be an adventurer like you and go wherever I want!
entries.translated_text: 我希望我能像你一样成为冒险者，去任何我想去的地方！

entries.text: I'll pretend with you, then, and if you're ever ready to face your fears, I'll be by your side.
entries.translated_text: 那么我会和你一起伪装，如果你准备好了面对你的恐惧，我会一直在你身边。

entries.text: Well, uh... thank you. I try my best.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，呃...谢谢你。我尽力了。

entries.text: I also prefer the Gods of Reason and Logic.
entries.translated_text: 我也更喜欢理性和逻辑之神。

entries.text: Oh, nice! I found a gem rolled in that last linen wrap!
entries.translated_text: 不错哦！我在最后的亚麻裹尸布里发现了一颗宝石！

entries.text: I'll be around.
entries.translated_text: 我会在附近。

entries.text: I'll be around.
entries.translated_text: 我会在附近的。

entries.text: Yes, my name is Remi. You're J'zargo, right? I haven't met many Khajiiti mages before.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我叫蕾米。你是吉'扎格，对吧？我以前没见过太多虎人法师。

entries.text: By the Eight, did you see how that Centurion moved! So active even after thousands of years! And the steam power seemed so precise! I'm in love!
entries.translated_text: 八圣灵在上，你看到那个百夫长的动作了吗！即使在数千年后仍然如此活跃！蒸汽动力似乎如此精确！我恋爱了！

entries.text: Yea... I just... I was taught I am different from them, I guess?
entries.translated_text: 是啊...我只是...我想，大概是因为从小就被教导自己和他们不一样吧？

entries.text: The army that fought at the Battle of Red Mountain was created here for the most part.
entries.translated_text: 参加红山之战的军队，大部分都是在这里创造的。

entries.text: You won't have to worry about that! You can hit things with your big sword. I can obtain trinkets from pockets. We both have our skills.
entries.translated_text: 你不用担心！你可以用你的大剑看人。我可以从别人口袋里借来一些小饰品。我们都有自己的技能。

entries.text: Relieved... I think.
entries.translated_text: 松了一口气吧...我想。

entries.text: I was wondering if I might (clears throat) owe you an apology. The Dark Rose was ah, involved... with that corsair incident back in one eight-eight.
entries.translated_text: 我在想我是不是（清清嗓子）欠你一个道歉。黑玫瑰号，呃，参与了那次发生在188年的海盗事件。

entries.text: Ah! Fighting again! I'll just try to stay near you, Buffy!
entries.translated_text: 啊！再战一场！我会尽量待在你身边，巴非！

entries.text: (Sigh) I wonder if I'll be back in High Rock to celebrate our reunion. It'd be nice to have some dessert and watch the fireflies as we release them.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）我想知道我是否会回到高岩庆祝我们的重逢。最好能吃点甜点，在我们放飞萤火虫的时候看着它们。

entries.text: Oh, was that a joke? A stomach to fill your stomach?
entries.translated_text: 哦，那是一个笑话吗？用胃来填饱胃？

entries.text: Excellent work, Ubbe! We make a good team!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，乌贝！我们是一支优秀的团队！

entries.text: I know a bit.
entries.translated_text: 我知道一点。

entries.text: Letter from Alethius
entries.translated_text: 阿勒修斯的来信

entries.text: Scrap, that doesn't make any sense whatsoever. Leave the stories to Yazakh, okay?
entries.translated_text: 小渣，这根本没有任何意义。把故事留给雅扎克，好吗？

entries.text: Well dressed... walking around like he owns the place... and most importantly, distracted. Definitely worth it.
entries.translated_text: 衣冠楚楚......走起路来好像这里是他的地盘......最重要的是，他心无旁骛。绝对值得。

entries.text: Sometimes I go so far into my mind that I forget I exist, so if I'm quiet for awhile, that's probably why.
entries.translated_text: 有时我的想得太深以至于我忘记了自己的存在，所以如果我安静了一会儿，这可能就是原因。

entries.text: Using two weapons mean you've got no defense. You can't block anything. But if you hit him with both at the same time, he may not get up again.
entries.translated_text: 使用双武器意味着你没有防御，什么都挡不住。但如果你同时用两个武器击中他，他可能就再也爬不起来了。

entries.text: Probably worth it.
entries.translated_text: 大概值得一试。

entries.text: Yes, it does. I anticipate this project of his ending up just as messy.
entries.translated_text: 是的，它确实。我预计他的这个项目最终会变得一团糟。

entries.text: Don't worry about me, I'll be fine!
entries.translated_text: 别担心我。我不会有事的。

texts: 只有少数人才懂这吸引力。你真是令我猜不透啊。
只有少数人才懂这吸引力。你真是令我猜不透啊。

entries.text: Remi has an idea for making lockpicking a quicker process. She wants to create a 'tension wrench' from a bit of iron at the forge in Markarth. Remi and I have arrived at the forge, and now I just need to wait for her to finish her crafting.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米有个想法，让开锁变得更快。她想在马卡斯城的锻造厂用一点铁制造一个“张力扳手”。我和蕾米已经到了熔炉，现在只需要等她完成制作即可。

entries.text: I wouldn't say it put me off, but that in conjunction with the shriveled dreugh did confuse me. At first! I figured it out eventually, of course.
entries.translated_text: 我不能说它让我失望了，但它和干瘪的蛸人确实让我困惑。一开始是这样！当然，我最终还是想通了。

entries.text: Oh, it's just a potion I made. Brewed it with some bone meal and charred skeever hide.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这只是我制作的药水。用一些骨粉和焦黑的恶鼠皮酿造的。

entries.text: Oh, like your dad, then? That's nice.
entries.translated_text: 哦，和你爸爸一样吗？那很好。

entries.text: Arguably the most useful. And throwing around fireballs looks like fun. Just don't hit me, okay?
entries.translated_text: 可以说是最有用的了。扔火球看起来很有趣。只是不要打我，好吗？

entries.text: Arguably the most useful. And throwing around fireballs looks like fun. Just don't hit me, okay?
entries.translated_text: 可以说是最有用的了。扔火球看起来很有趣。只是不要打到我，好吗？

entries.text: I don't care how dangerous it is!
entries.translated_text: 我不管它有多危险！

entries.text: Hey, Remiel, I bet this area has an abundance of ghost stories.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，蕾米尔，我敢打赌这地方出现过很多鬼故事。

texts: <Sigh> You're not the first person I've tagged along with.
<叹息>你不是第一个跟我一起的人了。

entries.text: I've been looking for you. Got something I'm supposed to deliver - your hands only.
entries.translated_text: 我一直在找你，我替人带东西给你——而且必须亲自交予你手。

entries.text: And off we go.
entries.translated_text: 我们走吧。

entries.text: We have to get out of here for Scrap! He's probably so afraid and confused!
entries.translated_text: 为了小渣，我们必须离开这里！他可能正惶恐又迷茫！

entries.text: Look, I love you, but I am engaged in some serious studying here! What is it?
entries.translated_text: 听着，我爱你，但我在这里认真学习！这是怎么一回事？

entries.text: Do you ever worry that animunculi are sentient? Alone in these ruins for eons only to be cut down by us in the end?
entries.translated_text: 你有没有担心过蒸汽机械会有感情？孤身一人地在这些遗址中度过漫长时光，最终被我们砍倒？

entries.text: Ooooh, aren't you frightening? Not as frightening as Gore, though!
entries.translated_text: 哦，你不害怕吗？不过，没有格雷可怕！

entries.text: Search Arkngchal for Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 在阿卡切尔中搜寻莫维奇。

entries.text: Search Arkngchal for Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 在阿卡切尔中搜寻莫维克。

entries.text: The Book... So close, yet so far. They used their steam technology to keep it safe. Amazing it's still in there, after all this time.
entries.translated_text: 这本书...近在咫尺，却远若天涯。他们使用他们的蒸汽技术来保证它的安全。经过这么长时间，它仍然在那里，真让人惊讶。

entries.text: It's quite a shame that I can't remember our adventures with Sam. I have the feeling they'd be memories I'd treasure.
entries.translated_text: 很遗憾我不记得我们和山姆的冒险经历了，我有一种感觉，它们会成为我珍藏的回忆。

entries.text: I got really sick.
entries.translated_text: 我好想吐。

entries.text: Good. Me too.
entries.translated_text: 很好。我也是。

entries.text: When's the last time I had water?
entries.translated_text: 我最后一次喝水是什么时候？

entries.text: Oh, so like oakflesh? You must not mind taking a hit. A little masochistic, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 哦，就像木甲术，看来你不会介意被人打，有点受虐倾向，是不是？

entries.text: Oh, so like oakflesh? You must not mind taking a hit. A little masochistic, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 哦，就像龟壳一样，那你一定皮糙肉厚对吗？

entries.text: Better hope I get to you before she does! She likes to watch you suffer first.
entries.translated_text: 你最好祈祷我比她先找到你！她喜欢看着你先受苦。

entries.text: The people of Skyrim are more open-minded about certain things than people in other places.
entries.translated_text: 天际的人们在某些事情上比其他地方的人更开明。

entries.text: You should watch your gold closer, my friend. Someone was trying to snatch your coin purse back there.
entries.translated_text: 我的朋友，你应该注意你的钱，刚才有人试图偷走你后面的钱袋。

entries.text: I don't know. I guess I want to try and figure out why people like him are the way they are.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道。我想我想试着弄清楚为什么像他这样的人是这样的。

entries.text: Remi, are you able to make more of your special crossbow bolts?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你能制造更多你的特殊弩箭吗？

entries.text: Pull the lever.
entries.translated_text: 拉动杠杆。

entries.text: We're getting a room for the night, right? I'm exhausted.
entries.translated_text: 我们要找个房间过夜，对吧？我累极了。

entries.text: Besides, if you'd just let me drink, I'm sure we would have the staff, some coin, and a new best friend. That'd be Sam.
entries.translated_text: 另外，如果你让我去喝酒，我相信我们会得到一根法杖、一些钱币和一个新的好朋友——那就是山姆。

entries.text: Thank you so much! This means the world to me.
entries.translated_text: 太感谢了！这对我来说意味着全部。

entries.text: The Forsworn ravaged Markarth because we helped them to escape. I struggle to feel bad, though, as its citizens wrongfully locked us up.
entries.translated_text: 是因为我们帮助他们逃出了马卡斯，他们才能在马卡斯城里肆虐。但我还是很难感到难过，因为是它的居民先把我们错关了起来。

entries.text: While I appreciate your intentions, Gore, the wrist is hardly the same as an elbow.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我欣赏你的想法，格雷,但是手腕和肘部完全不一样。

entries.text: Erm... Remi, who are you talking to?
entries.translated_text: 呃...蕾米，你在跟谁说话？

entries.text: Well, that very little was going through their heads.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，他们的脑子里很少有这样的想法。

entries.text: They were hurt in the past, so they hurt others now. It's wrong.
entries.translated_text: 他们过去受到过伤害，所以现在也会伤害别人。这当然不对。

entries.text: Not to be rude or anything, but your handwriting's a little... um, hard to interpret?
entries.translated_text: 不是我无礼，而是你的笔迹有点......嗯，难以理解？

entries.text: Can we forget this ever happened? Please?
entries.translated_text: 我们能把这事忘掉吗？拜托。

entries.text: Now, Scrap, don't be rude. Yazakh is our friend. No, she's not going to steal you, I promise!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，别那么粗鲁。雅扎克是我们的朋友。是的，她不会偷走你的，我保证！

entries.text: Hm. Okay. Well, Scrap, you are good.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。好的。嗯，小渣，你很好。

entries.text: Scrap says 'hello,' Josh.
entries.translated_text: 小渣说“你好”，约书。

entries.text: You... Wow, you know about that?! I... I suppose I shouldn't be so surprised. You're not as stupid as I first thought. For a Nord, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 你...哇，你知道吗？！我...我想我不应该表现得这么惊讶。你没有我一开始想的那么笨。无论如何，至少对于一个诺德人来说。

entries.text: If you ever need a taste-tester, I'm willing! As good as you are at figuring out machines, I can't imagine a pastry recipe giving you any trouble.
entries.translated_text: 如果你需要品尝师，我随时愿意！你这么擅长研究机器，我想不出有什么糕点食谱能难倒你。

entries.text: A circlet. I know how much you like shiny things.
entries.translated_text: 一个头环，我知道你有多喜欢闪闪发光的东西。

entries.text: Whether it's in this world or the next, we'll all be together again. That's what it means to be a family, and the same is true for home.
entries.translated_text: 无论是在这个世界还是在下一个世界，我们都会再次相聚。这就是家庭的意义，对家来说也是如此。

entries.text: What?! Sheor, why?!
entries.translated_text: 什么？舒奥尔在上，为什么？

entries.text: Translated Book from a Coffin in Arkngchal
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔棺材里的书的翻译

entries.text: And they discovered some new talents.
entries.translated_text: 他们发现了一些新的天赋。

entries.text: By the Eight, whatever they were trying to cook in this camp, it smells like they failed miserably. Poor bandits can't even get a good meal.
entries.translated_text: 八圣灵在上，不管他们想在这个营地里做什么，闻起来都很糟糕。可怜的土匪连顿好饭都吃不上。

entries.text: If there's a creature out there that emulates the arrogance of creating a god, it's got to be a cat.
entries.translated_text: 如果有一种生物能表现出创造神灵般的傲慢，那一定是猫。

entries.text: Old guys making poor decisions and the students suffering for it.
entries.translated_text: 老家伙们乱指挥，学生们遭殃。

entries.text: Excellent. Oh! Be sure to get confused about the directions he gives, so he has to focus more on explaining.
entries.translated_text: 太好了。哦！一定要对他给的方向表示不解，这样他就得更解释得更认真点。

entries.text: It's me, Remi, snap out of it. (Skips Intro Quest)
entries.translated_text: 是我，蕾米，清醒点吧。(跳过介绍任务)

entries.text: Maybe if I grew up here, I would have gotten into college.
entries.translated_text: 如果我在这里长大，也许我会考进学院。

entries.text: I think it's clear that we're not friends.
entries.translated_text: 我想很明显我们不是朋友。

entries.text: Why yes.
entries.translated_text: 怎么会。

entries.text: Don't worry, Ubbe, I haven't died yet!
entries.translated_text: 别担心，乌贝，我还没死呢！

entries.text: You mean you want me to cook? Well, that's a fantastic idea, because I happen to be an excellent one.
entries.translated_text: 你是说你想让我做饭？好吧，这是一个很棒的主意，因为我恰好是一个优秀的厨师。

entries.text: Oh, it's so pretty! This is going to be the most beautiful portable chandelier to ever be created!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太漂亮了！这将是有史以来最漂亮的便携式吊灯！

entries.text: When it comes to mistakes, I understand. It doesn't really matter. We're still a company.
entries.translated_text: 每个人都犯过错，我能理解。这其实并不重要。我们仍然是同伴。

entries.text: You've been trying to bite your bottom lip off since I mentioned you were funny, Remi. Let me clarify: I'm not laughing at you.
entries.translated_text: 自我提到你很有趣时，你就一直试图咬住你的下唇，蕾米。让我澄清一下：我不是在嘲笑你。

entries.text: W-what? What are you talking about? Gore, you can't leave me in the dark like this! My curiosity will kill me!
entries.translated_text: 什-什么？你在说什么？格雷，你不能这样丢下我！我的好奇心受不了了！

entries.text: I can't believe we just met an actual living Snow Elf! I thought they were all... like the falmer. This is amazing!
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信我们刚刚遇到了一个真正活着的雪精灵！我以为他们都...像伐莫一样。这真太了不起了！

entries.text: I can't imagine you being able to kill him.
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象你能杀了他。

entries.text: I'm feeling pretty great!
entries.translated_text: 我感觉非常棒！

entries.text: Lucky for us, I am a genius and decided I don't need your permission to  begin working on it. No offense.
entries.translated_text: 幸运的是，我是个天才，在你没许可前我就已经开始了工作。无意冒犯。

entries.text: Well, thanks! The way you were able to get more power and keep the accuracy is very impressive.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢！你这样既能获得更强的动能，又能保持精度，这种方法真是厉害。

entries.text: Surely if we keep killing this many people, Skyrim will run out of citizens?
entries.translated_text: 如果我们继续杀这么多人，天际省的居民肯定会用光吗？

entries.text: Well, let's let Danica know pilgrims will be running to Whiterun from all across Nirn. Do they pay her to look at the tree? I think I'm confused.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们得让丹妮卡知道朝圣者将从奈恩各地跑到白漫城，他们付她钱去看那棵树吗？我想我很困惑。

entries.text: Perhaps a tonal resonance between the soul gem and the core...
entries.translated_text: 也许是灵魂石和核心之间的音调会共鸣...

entries.text: I'm surprised we're the first ones to take these Aetherium shards. Divines know if I'd grown up in Skyrim, I'd have had all these shards years ago.
entries.translated_text: 我很惊讶我们是第一个拿到这些神光水晶碎片的人。圣灵们是否知道我在天际长大，那几年前我就会拥有所有这些碎片。

entries.text: I'm sorry! I know you're just trying to protect your forests!
entries.translated_text: 对不起！我知道你只是想保护你的森林！

entries.text: Yaz, I've not been around many Orcs.
entries.translated_text: 雅扎，我接触的兽人很少。

entries.text: Not to mention the trees. The bark is different, and they only grow leaves at the very top! But it's so warm and just bustling with life.
entries.translated_text: 更别提那些树了。树皮跟别处的不一样，叶子只长在最顶端！不过这里真的很温暖，充满了生机。

entries.text: Hermaeus Mora comes to mind, as a Prince whose tenets involve acquiring as much knowledge as possible.
entries.translated_text: 我想到了赫麦尤斯·莫拉，作为一个魔神，他的信条是获得尽可能多的知识。

entries.text: You know what? That's-er-completely fine! There's the room down below. You head down and I'll stay up here, and we can help each other.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗？那-呃-完全没问题！看下面房间。你先下去，我留在上面，我们可以互相帮忙。

entries.text: Ah, you're really attacking us?! Well, in that case, let me introduce you to Gore!
entries.translated_text: 啊，你真的想攻击我们？！好吧，那样的话，让我给你介绍一下格雷!

entries.text: Ok. If you can't find me again when you need me, I'm probably, you know, in a dwemer ruin. See you around.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。如果你需要我时又找不到我了，可能吧，你知道的，我会在哪个锻莫遗址中，晚点见。

entries.text: I'm glad Xel is with us. I don't think I'm quite capable of caring for a child like Khash, no matter how independent she is.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴赛尔和我们在一起，我不认为我有能力照顾像卡什这样的孩子，不管她有多独立。

entries.text: And I was also thinking- Oh. Nar, you're walking away. Oh, were we done talking? Oops.
entries.translated_text: 我也在想——哦。纳尔，你要走开了。哦，我们聊完了吗？哎呀。

entries.text: Hazards of the job and all that.
entries.translated_text: 冒险总是充满危险挑战。

entries.text: So... If, uh, if the ceiling in here d-doesn't hold, w-would you be able to dig us out, Gore? Y-you know, since you're strong, and whatnot?
entries.translated_text: 所以…如果，呃，如果这里的天花板垮塌了，你能把我们挖出来吗，格雷？你知道，既然你这么强壮，可以吧？

entries.text: Okay... Great... Just let me... catch my breath...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...太好了...让我...喘口气...

entries.text: I was just thinking... How is it you came to be in control of Nchuand-Zel out of every scholar in Skyrim? What's your secret?
entries.translated_text: 我只是在想...你是如何从天际的每个学者手中控制楚安德-泽尔的？你的秘诀是什么？

entries.text: I'm not entirely sure.
entries.translated_text: 我并不完全确定。

entries.text: Oh, well that's good! I think. No residual pain? No urge to chase after a stick if I threw one?
entries.translated_text: 哦，那很好！我想是吧。没有残留的疼痛吗？如果我扔根棍子，你不会有去追的冲动吗？

entries.text: I don't really care if he's a Divine, or not. Far as I'm concerned, you are more divine than he is. You actually paid for drinks.
entries.translated_text: 我其实不在乎他是不是神。就我而言，你比他更有神性。你真的付了酒钱。

entries.text: It smells weird here, right? Or is that just me? When's the last time I bathed? You'd tell me if I smelled bad, right?
entries.translated_text: 这里闻起来很奇怪，对吧？还是只有我？我最后一次洗澡是什么时候？如果我闻起来很臭你会告诉我的，对吧？

entries.text: I get it, I get it. I'll drop it.
entries.translated_text: 我明白了，我明白了，我会放下这个想法的。

entries.text: Rumarin keeps saying things about me dying. Are you sure he's not secretly a murderer? Sure, he can be funny, but maybe that's to be disarming...
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林一直在说我要死的事。你确定他私底下不是个杀手吗？当然，他可能很有趣，但也许这是为了让人麻痹放松...

entries.text: Excuse me.
entries.translated_text: 不好意思。

entries.text: His insatiable hunger for sweet rolls.
entries.translated_text: 他对甜面包的贪得无厌的渴望。

entries.text: She will eat just about anything.
entries.translated_text: 她几乎什么都能吃。

entries.text: Of course, I am! They are incredibly fascinating, and their technology is beyond compare! Imagine if we could recreate their devices!
entries.translated_text: 当然喜欢！他们真是无比吸引人，有着无法比拟的技术！想象一下，如果我们能重新制造他们的装置！

entries.text: Quite the opposite. You want them to know exactly who you are. The trick is to leave a few alive - the ones that don't fight.
entries.translated_text: 恰恰相反。你要让他们清楚地知道你是谁。诀窍就是留几个活口--那些不反抗的。

entries.text: Well, as lively as Skyrim inns can get, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，无论如何，天际的旅店都会很热闹。

entries.text: It took me awhile to notice, as I had my mind focused on more useful thoughts, such as Dwemer technology.
entries.translated_text: 但我花了好长一段时间才注意到，因为我的心思集中在更有用的想法上，比如锻莫技术。

entries.text: So? What happened? How did you end up in a shack out in the middle of nowhere?
entries.translated_text: 所以？发生了什么？你是怎么落到一个偏僻的小屋里的？

entries.text: I must admit, I don't know very much about Summerset.
entries.translated_text: 我必须承认，我对夏暮岛了解不多。

entries.text: Remi, I'm curious about your childhood.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我很好奇你的童年。

entries.text: Vampires? Trolls? Spiders?
entries.translated_text: 吸血鬼？巨魔？蜘蛛？

entries.text: Zora talks about 'watching her figure' sometimes. I think she should eat whatever and whenever she wants!
entries.translated_text: 佐拉有时会谈到“保持她的身材”。我想她想吃什么就吃什么，想什么时候吃就什么时候吃！

entries.text: Never mind. Just let me know when it's time!
entries.translated_text: 没什么。到时候告诉我一声就行！

entries.text: So where did you like? In High Rock, I mean.
entries.translated_text: 那你喜欢哪里？在高岩，我的意思是。

entries.text: Don't die, Una! I'll be very upset with you!
entries.translated_text: 别死，乌娜！我会对你伤心的！

entries.text: But if we can find it... I could devote my entire life to learning how to use it, just for the sake of saying I could.
entries.translated_text: 但是，如果我们能找到它...我可以用我的一生来学习如何使用它，只是为了说句我可以。

entries.text: I guess. I guess as long as I have you all, I am not alone, right?
entries.translated_text: 我猜。我想只要我有你们，我就不孤单，对吧？

entries.text: Something with the Altmer, I think?
entries.translated_text: 我认为与高等精灵有什么关系？

entries.text: Where do you think we can find the remaining parts of the Aetherium Key?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得我们可以在哪里找到神光水晶钥匙的剩余部分？

entries.text: Oh no. I know that look. You are NOT turning me in for the bounty with a promise to help me escape prison 'later.'
entries.translated_text: 哦，不。我认得你这种眼神。你绝对不可能用‘之后帮我越狱’的承诺，把我交出去换取赏金。

entries.text: Let's drink a lot of mead and then see who can swipe the most off the nearest guard before getting caught.
entries.translated_text: 我们喝好多的蜜酒，然后看看谁能在被抓住之前从最近的卫兵那里偷走最多的东西。

entries.text: Teldryn, where are you from?
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因，你来自哪里？

entries.text: I might have the information you seek. What do you need? Ask anything.
entries.translated_text: 我可能有你要找的信息。你需要什么？随便问。

entries.text: He called me down to the basement and trapped me.
entries.translated_text: 他呼唤我到地下室，然后困住了我。

entries.text: Yes! Thank you! I'll be here, okay? I'll have the secrets of this chandelier uncovered by the time you're back!
entries.translated_text: 好耶!谢谢你！我会待在这里，好吗？等你回来的时候，我会把这个吊灯的秘密揭开的！

entries.text: You realize it takes three of you guys to measure up to our height, right?
entries.translated_text: 你知道你们三个人才能达到我们的身高，对吧？

entries.text: Business? Like... We will be business partners?
entries.translated_text: 生意？比如...我们会成为生意伙伴？

entries.text: But that does make it easier to be away, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 但我想，这确实让离开变得更没有顾虑。

entries.text: But without Sunder, it's like you just popped the spigot off entirely and now the ale is flying out everywhere.
entries.translated_text: 但如果没有桑德，就好像你刚刚完全打开了龙头，现在麦酒四处飞溅。

entries.text: It's very possible I could have just never noticed before now. Hm. Well, I've enjoyed this deeper look into your day-to-day life.
entries.translated_text: 很有可能我以前从未注意到，嗯，好吧，我很想对你的日常生活进行更深入的了解。

entries.text: Spiders.
entries.translated_text: 蜘蛛。

entries.text: But does it not feel lonely...? Like, there is no one else like you?
entries.translated_text: 可那不会让人觉得孤单吗...就像，世界上再也没有一个人和你一样？

entries.text: You forgot murder plots, secret notes, and duplicitous strangers. Oh no, I think I'm going to like this town.
entries.translated_text: 你忘记了说谋杀、秘密笔记和口是心非的陌生人。哦，不，我想我会喜欢这个城市的。

entries.text: Oh, great job, Remi. Now you're bleeding all over the place.
entries.translated_text: 哦，干得好，蕾米。现在你到处都在流血。

entries.text: I'll be fine! After all, I have a hero with me!
entries.translated_text: 我会没事儿的！毕竟，我身边有一个英雄！

entries.text: Doc is alive. I'm alive. That means we win!
entries.translated_text: 医生还活着，我还活着，这意味着我们赢了！

entries.text: Honestly, I'm not sure the automatons like being automatons either. Assuming they're capable of having feelings on the subject, that is.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我也不确定机器人会喜欢成为机器人。如果他们能对这事有想法的话。

entries.text: And being at such a grand table, surrounded by people you care about laughing and joking. Well. That just makes it taste all the better.
entries.translated_text: 而在这样一个丰盛的大餐旁，被你所关心的人包围着，笑着、闹着。嗯。这只会让它的味道变得更好。

entries.text: So not only is the dagger somehow broken, but he only has one of the tools used to create the Numidium.
entries.translated_text: 不仅匕首不知何故坏了，而且他还只一种用于制造纳米迪安的工具。

entries.text: You have nothing to fear from me.
entries.translated_text: 你对我没什么好怕的。

entries.text: I said it's in my stomach! And it was only mildly greasy!
entries.translated_text: 我说在我肚子里！而且只是有点油腻！

entries.text: 'f I didn't, you wouldn't be here. Certainly not armed.
entries.translated_text: 如果我不信任你，你不会待在这儿的，更不可能带着武器。

entries.text: Did you attend the College with Lurbuk, Yaz? He's the only other Orc I know of who pursued a bard's life.
entries.translated_text: 你和卢布克一起学习的吗，雅扎？他是我知道的唯一一个想当吟游诗人的兽人。

entries.text: That's good news.
entries.translated_text: 真是好消息。

entries.text: Yes, I conjure weapons, but I'm not a mage.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我可以召唤武器，但我不是法师。

entries.text: That old man better appreciate our work.
entries.translated_text: 那位老头挺赞赏我们的工作。

entries.text: It's really not! Studying is what made me able to figure out how Scrap works! He's my dwemer spider, and I've used my studies to make him friendly!
entries.translated_text: 才不是！学习使我能够弄清楚小渣是如何运行的！他是我的锻莫蜘蛛，而且我还靠学习让他变得很友好！

entries.text: Don't blame me. Blame that smell coming from their kitchen.
entries.translated_text: 不要怪我。要怪就怪他们厨房里传出的香味。

entries.text: You're a fool to fight the Dragonborn!
entries.translated_text: 与龙裔战斗，你真是个傻瓜！

entries.text: Oh, I just love you so much, Scrap! You're so good!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我太喜欢了你了，小渣！你真好！你真棒!

entries.text: Oh, now that would be exciting!
entries.translated_text: 哦，那太令人兴奋了！

entries.text: Take Remi to see another dwemer ruin.
entries.translated_text: 带着雷米去看另一个锻莫遗迹。

entries.text: You still look a little green. You're not going to be sick, are you? Just aim away from me, if so.
entries.translated_text: 你看起来还是有点难受。你不会生病吧？如果是这样，请离我远点。

entries.text: Oh. Well, that's good to hear. And yeah, I think it's great that you don't care what others think of you! Who taught you that?
entries.translated_text: 哦。嗯，很高兴听到这个。是的，我认为你不必在乎别人对你的看法真是太好了！谁教你的？

entries.text: Of course he is! Haven't you looked at him and just wanted to scoop him up and hug him?
entries.translated_text: 当然是啊！你难道没看着他，就有种想把他一把抱起来、狠狠拥抱的冲动吗？

entries.text: The ones on the walls are noisy and the ones that move want us dead. I guess if they were not noisy and did did not try and kill us it would be cool.
entries.translated_text: 墙上的那些很吵，那些移动的要我们死。我想如果他们不吵闹并且没有试图杀死我们，那会很酷。

entries.text: Yes! Of course, I'll start right away!
entries.translated_text: 太好了！当然，我马上就开始！

entries.text: Don't worry, I meant no offense.
entries.translated_text: 别担心，我没有冒犯的意思。

entries.text: I'd rather have a metal sword.
entries.translated_text: 我宁愿有一把金属剑。

entries.text: I found this note...
entries.translated_text: 我找到了这个笔记...

entries.text: Is there something you needed?
entries.translated_text: 有什么你需要的吗？

entries.text: Aha! Look what I've done, Anum-La! Your sword has never looked sharper!
entries.translated_text: 看看我做了什么，安努姆菈！看看你的剑从未有过的锋利！

entries.text: I'm glad you like it. Despite being a warrior, you seem to appreciate pretty things.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你喜欢它。尽管你是一名战士，但你似乎很会欣赏漂亮的事物。

entries.text: You started issuing orders like a captain taking her ship into battle.
entries.translated_text: 你开始发号施令，就像船长带着她的船进入战场。

entries.text: But other than this eerie apparition, the village was never haunted by another wraith again.
entries.translated_text: 但除了这个怪异的幻影之外，这个村庄再也没有被其他幽灵困扰过。

entries.text: If you keep talking, I'm going to end up turning around and leaving.
entries.translated_text: 如果你继续说话，我就会转身离开。

entries.text: Now that's truly a crime waiting to happen! Imagine someone coming through and eating all the sweet rolls in Wayrest! Awful.
entries.translated_text: 这种犯罪确实可能发生!想象一下，有人吃光了途歇城的所有甜面包！太可怕了！

entries.text: Who would want you dead?
entries.translated_text: 是谁要你死？

entries.text: Growing up, many of the other kids would vie for the nobles' attention. They'd often do silly tasks hoping to earn regard toward their social status.
entries.translated_text: 小时候，很多其他的孩子都会争着引起贵族的注意。他们经常会做一些傻乎乎的事情，希望能提升自己的社会地位。

entries.text: You're not dying, are you?
entries.translated_text: 你不会死吧？

entries.text: Well, the other youth in the city, they seemed to develop these interests in more... ah... intimate activities.
entries.translated_text: 那么，城里的其他年轻人，他们似乎在更多对...啊...亲密活动的发展感兴趣。

entries.text: If you change your mind, you know where to find me.
entries.translated_text: 如果你改变主意了，你知道在哪里可以找到我。

entries.text: Did you forget to sleep, too, Ilia? You and me, two peas in a pod.
entries.translated_text: 你也忘了睡觉吗，伊利亚？你和我，一个豆荚里的两颗豌豆。

entries.text: The third couldn't hold his liquor, either, which is why he woke up with a hangover and significantly less gold than he went to sleep with.
entries.translated_text: 第三个人酒量不行，这也是为什么他常常从宿醉中醒来，还总发现钱少了一些。

entries.text: A-anyway, Yaz, why are you traveling with our friend here?
entries.translated_text: 总之，雅扎，你为什么和我们的朋友来这的？

entries.text: Ask Remi about her arranged marriage while relaxing somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 在某处放松时，向蕾米询问她的家族联姻。

entries.text: Ask Remi about her arranged marriage while relaxing somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 在某处放松时，向蕾米询问她的家族联姻。

entries.text: Well, don't be afraid to rest early tonight. Don't worry, I'll drink enough for the both of us!
entries.translated_text: 好了，今晚不要害怕，早点休息。别担心，你的那份酒我会帮你喝的!

entries.text: Yes, they seem to have convinced the general populace that they are descended from some fringe members of the Gardner Dynasty.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他们似乎让普通民众相信他们是加德纳王朝的一些边缘成员的后裔。

entries.text: Wait, Dragonborn, this book... I think I know what it is. Maybe think twice before opening it. It's up to you, though, obviously.
entries.translated_text: 等等，龙裔，这本书...我想我知道它是什么。也许在打开它之前要三思而后行。不过，这显然取决于你。

entries.text: I'm right behind you, Ilia.
entries.translated_text: 我就在你身后，伊利亚。

entries.text: ;Has heard Remi talk about father's Third Consecration
entries.translated_text: ;HasheardRemitalkaboutfather'sThirdConsecration

entries.text: Whiterun is a nice enough town, if a little plain.
entries.translated_text: 白漫城是一个不错的小镇，虽然有点朴素。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. Morvic decided to take matters into his own hands, traveling to Skyrim to hunt down Remiel. Despite his plotting, we managed to kill him. Inspired by seeing the ruin again, Remi stayed and cleaned it up a bit. She insists that we use the space as her workshop, and as the site for any future projects she may come up with.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。莫维克决定自己动手，前往天际追捕蕾米尔。尽管有他的阴谋，我们还是设法杀死了他。再次看到遗址的启发，蕾米留下来清理了一下。她坚持认为我们将这个空间用作她的工作室，并作为她未来可能提出的任何项目的场地。

entries.text: Should I be worried of some guards whisking you off to Cidhna Mine again? It seems like you got off so easy...
entries.translated_text: 我是不是又该担心会有卫兵把你抓去希讷矿坑？现在你好像很容易就能脱身了......

entries.text: Oh, but Revan, I still wanted to tell you- Er. I- I forgot. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 哦，但是渡鸦，我还是想告诉你——呃。我——我忘了。没关系。

entries.text: Although, it makes sense considering Arniel's experiment, but... How did he get ahold of it?
entries.translated_text: 虽然，考虑到阿内尔的实验，这有道理的，但是...他是怎么得到它的？

entries.text: What will the rest of the letter say?
entries.translated_text: 信的剩下部分怎么写？

entries.text: C'mon, Scrap, you can ride in my bag.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，小渣，你可以躺进我的包里。

entries.text: If storekeepers didn't want to be robbed, they wouldn't put all their wares out so openly. Don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 如果店主不想被抢劫，他们就不会这么心大地把所有的商品都放在外面。你不觉得吗？

entries.text: The Companions live very different lives from mine.
entries.translated_text: 战友团们过着与我截然不同的生活。

entries.text: I've actually had it before. Wayrest was very much a hub for people from all across Nirn, and also for food from all across Nirn.
entries.translated_text: 其实我以前也吃过。途歇城在很大程度上是整个奈恩的中心，也是整个奈恩的美食之都。

entries.text: I can't believe he's in Skyrim! In Markarth!
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信他在天际！在马卡斯城！

entries.text: Ah! Don't be rude, Daedric ghost thing! You're going to end up hitting me with something!
entries.translated_text: 别那么粗鲁，你这魔族鬼东西！你居然敢拿东西砸我！

entries.text: Although, I have to say, I've never *seen* that happen to you. Which isn't to say it doesn't happen, of course.
entries.translated_text: 虽然，我不得不说，我从未*见过*你身上发生过这事，当然，这并不是说它不会发生。

entries.text: Mm-hm.
entries.translated_text: 哼嗯。

entries.text: Perhaps we can pay them a visit? They've peaked my curiosity, so I'd like to ask them a few questions. What do you think?
entries.translated_text: 也许我们也可以拜访他们？他们激发了我的好奇心，所以我想问他们几个问题。你怎么看？

entries.text: Ray, something is trying to kill us again!
entries.translated_text: 雷，有什么东西又想杀了我们！

entries.text: Wait, you were First Mate way back then? How old are you?!
entries.translated_text: 等等，你那时是大副？你多大了？

entries.text: Uh...
Although that doesn't really help at the moment.
entries.translated_text: 不过，那现在也没什么用。

entries.text: I'm sorry, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 对不起, 蕾米。

entries.text: You didn't make any stops during the carriage ride to investigate the ruins?! That sounds dreadful.
entries.translated_text: 在去独孤城的那段路上你居然没有停下来探索遗迹？！听起来那真是场令人窒息的旅程。

entries.text: Was it the Deathbell? Or maybe the Mammoth Cheese? Or it could have been the Leg of Goat Roast I picked up last week? Or maybe... Urgh...
entries.translated_text: 是丧钟花吗？或者也许是长毛象奶酪？或者它可能是我上周买的烤羊腿？或者也许是...呕...

entries.text: They thought your family was involved with necromancy? To raise your own father?
entries.translated_text: 他们认为你们家和死灵法术有关？复活你的亲生父亲？

entries.text: If you're wearing the amulet, won't the next couple you help be confused about your intentions?
entries.translated_text: 如果你戴着玛拉护符，你帮助的下一对夫妇不会对你的意图感到困扰吗？

entries.text: Wait, how did you take it?
entries.translated_text: 等等，你怎么在你手上？

entries.text: Read the note by the guard's body.
entries.translated_text: 阅读警卫尸体旁的纸条。

entries.text: Read the note by the guard's body.
entries.translated_text: 阅读警卫尸体旁的纸条。

entries.text: Yes, I suppose the evidence of my success is obvious. But what about the evidence of your success?
entries.translated_text: 当然，很明显我已经成功了，这些东西就是证据。但你成功的证据呢？

entries.text: Now, if you were kindly asking me to spend a night drinking with you, well, you should just say so. I do love drinking.
entries.translated_text: 如果你是想请我们晚上和你喝酒，那么，你应该直接说出来。我很爱喝酒。

entries.text: I-I-I- Uh.
entries.translated_text: 我 -我 -我

entries.text: We can wipe our hands of them.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以洗净双手，摆脱他们。

entries.text: That must have been traumatic.
entries.translated_text: 那一定是件伤心事。

entries.text: Lead the way!
entries.translated_text: 带路！

entries.text: I hope this water doesn't get in your wiring, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 我希望这水不会渗进你的线路，小渣。

entries.text: Ooooh dear. Bujold lost her right to lead. This is not going to end well.
entries.translated_text: 哦，亲爱的。布娇失去了领导权，这不会有好的结局的。

entries.text: And?
entries.translated_text: 然后呢？

entries.text: (Gasp) This Riekling can speak our language! I want to be his friend so badly!
entries.translated_text: （喘气）这个蓝客灵会说我们的语言！我好想成为他的朋友！

entries.text: Why on Nirn is the way forward through a grate in the floor? Why are Nord tombs like this? At least Dwemer ruins have appropriate paths. Usually.
entries.translated_text: 为什么在奈恩上这些路都坑坑洼洼？为什么诺德人的坟墓是这样的？至少锻莫遗址都有好路可走，通常吧。

entries.text: Adventurer Ilia. A bit of a mouthful. I suppose simply Ilia would be better. No matter what titles you receive now, I will call you Ilia.
entries.translated_text: 冒险者伊利亚。有点拗口。我想伊利亚会更好。无论你现在有什么头衔，我都叫你伊利亚。

entries.text: Maybe one day he'll be better at protecting me than you are?
entries.translated_text: 也许有一天他会比你更能保护我？

entries.text: What about you?
entries.translated_text: 你呢？

entries.text: No, the artifacts I've discovered will make me rich one day.
entries.translated_text: 不，我发现的器物总有一天会让我变得富有。

entries.text: That's done. Well, until you lead us to another fight. Anything to say for yourself, Ilia? Hm?
entries.translated_text: 就这样，好吧，直到你带领我们进行另一场战斗。有什么要说的吗，伊利亚？嗯？

entries.text: No. I want to go it on my own from now on.
entries.translated_text: 不，我想从现在开始独自行动。

entries.text: Did you just wipe that on me?
entries.translated_text: 你刚刚在我身上抹​​了那个吗？

entries.text: Oh, hush. I'll survive just to spite you.
entries.translated_text: 哦，安静。我偏要活着，就是为了气你。

entries.text: But...
entries.translated_text: 但是...

entries.text: That sounds delicious.
entries.translated_text: 这听起来是很美味。

entries.text: ;Remi showed the kid Scrap
entries.translated_text: ;RemishowedthekidScrap

entries.text: ... I'm not part of this. This is an area that I will leave to you.
entries.translated_text: ...我不会参与这事，你得自己来。

entries.text: How far you've fallen to surround yourself with this filth!
entries.translated_text: 你已经堕落到什么程度了，才会待在这种肮脏的东西周围！？

entries.text: Keep your face down. Your bounty might land you on the wrong side of the bars if a guard recognizes you here.
entries.translated_text: 保持着低头，如果守卫在这里认出你，凭你的悬赏可能得在铁栏那边待着了。

entries.text: Remi is ambivalent about pc
entries.translated_text: Remiisambivalentaboutpc

entries.text: Maybe it's wrong of me, but I'm glad Muiri doesn't regret her decision. She's already been the victim of so much she doesn't need to turn on herself.
entries.translated_text: 也许是我错了，但我很高兴暮蕊没有后悔她的决定。她已经是太多事情的受害者了，她不需要自责。

entries.text: Oo! Nice!
entries.translated_text: 哦！好的！

entries.text: Ha-ha, very funny.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈，真有趣。

entries.text: You are now the proud owner of an incredibly powerful Aetherium artifact. Now, I'd like to be the owner of another. Please let me remain here awhile.
entries.translated_text: 现在已经拥有了一件极其强大的神光水晶神器。我呢，也想再拥有一件。请让我在这里多待一会儿吧。

entries.text: Or maybe they could just write another version of Ragnar the Red, with slightly altered lyrics. That seems more realistic.
entries.translated_text: 或者，他们可以写另一个版本的《红衣拉格纳》，只要小改一下歌词。这样似乎更现实。

entries.text: Well, if you put it that way, it makes us sound like heroes. Sort of. If you ignore the 'slaughtering creatures who can't see us' part.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你这么说，那我们听起来就像英雄了。算是吧如果你忽略 "杀掉了看不见我们的生物 "这部分的话。

entries.text: You know, Anum-La, a bound sword never dulls.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，安努姆菈，一把束缚剑永远不会变钝。

entries.text: Wow, this killer wasn't just in it for the murder. Did you see the corpse? The cuts were... rather deliberate. I'm sure it means something.
entries.translated_text: 哇，这个杀手不只是为了谋杀，你看到那具尸体了吗？那些伤口是...故意的，我相信这一定意味着什么。

entries.text: It's really just simple power transference. The real mystery is in giving the machine intelligence.
entries.translated_text: 这真的只是简单的能量转移。真正的奥秘在于赋予机器智能。

entries.text: "There are witnesses, including myself, to Morvik Riscel following the tenets of..."
entries.translated_text: “在城里，包括我自己，有一群人都秘密信仰着魔族...，这些人中有莫维克·里塞尔。”

entries.text: Let me see what I have...
entries.translated_text: 让我看看我有多少...

entries.text: Let me see what I have...
entries.translated_text: 让我看看我有多少...

entries.text: It was! Some of my happier memories.
entries.translated_text: 没错！我的一些快乐的回忆。

entries.text: Of course, I'd rather it be processed Aetherium rather than raw Aetherium. Raw Aetherium is written as incredibly volatile and dangerous.
entries.translated_text: 当然，我宁愿它是加工过的神光水晶，而不是原始神光水晶。原始神光水晶据描述非常不稳定而且充满危险。

entries.text: ...But honestly, the answer is 'I was drunk, and impulsively agreed to tag alone on adventures, and now it's far too late for me to back out'.
entries.translated_text: ...但说实话，答案是'我当时喝醉了，冲动地答应了一个人去冒险，现在想退缩时已经太晚了'。

entries.text: I'm fine. You?
entries.translated_text: 我很好。你呢？

entries.text: Mzulft? Yes! Being an errand boy really pays off sometimes, doesn't it? Let's go before these Synod fellows get all the good loot!
entries.translated_text: 树皮遗址？没错！做一个跟班有时候确实能有回报，不是吗？赶紧出发吧，免得希诺学会的人先行一步拿走了好东西！

entries.text: He... Um... He died...
I will make it worth your while.
entries.translated_text: 我会让你觉得值得的。

entries.text: Skjor really should've just waited for us to help him. Sorry, that probably sounded cold. I know he meant something to you. I'm sorry for your loss.
entries.translated_text: 斯科约尔真的应该等我们来帮助他。抱歉，这可能听起来很冷血。我知道他对你意味着什么，我对你失去他表示遗憾。

entries.text: I've had to hire someone to do that on jobs in the past, and what with the markup, bribes, extra materials, and all, it gets expensive.
entries.translated_text: 我过去曾雇人做过这样的工作，讨价还价、贿赂、额外材料等等，费用不菲。

entries.text: You know, I think I'm getting pretty good at this 'joking around' thing! I'll have to ask Rumarin if he agrees.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我觉得我在这开玩笑的事情上越来越在行了！我得问问鲁马林是否同意。

entries.text: I am glad to have seen you in one piece. I was worried.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴看到你安然无恙。我之前好担心。

entries.text: Although I worry it'd be a coin flip as to whether we'd get on or hate each other's guts.
entries.translated_text: 尽管我担心我们要么会很投缘,要么会彼此厌恶。这都不好说。

entries.text: But he is the Prince of Domination. I doubt his motivation here is so simple.
entries.translated_text: 但他是“支配魔神”，我不认为他的动机会如此简单。

entries.text: What!? Nooooo.
I can't get this off my mind. Your story with the miniature horse trying to drink the giant flagon of ale...What was the frostbite spider signifying?
entries.translated_text: 这已我脑海里挥之不去了。你的故事是小马试图喝下一大壶麦芽酒的...霜噬蜘蛛意味着什么？

entries.text: Oh, look at this place! Isn't it beautiful?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看这个地方！是不是很漂亮？！

entries.text: Leave that to me! I have an eye for this sort of thing.
entries.translated_text: 这事交给我吧！我对这种事情很有眼光。

entries.text: I've helped Remi explore Nchuand-Zel where she met and fixed up a dwemer spider she named Scrap. She still wants to see more dwemer ruins, so I've let her accompany me in my adventures.
entries.translated_text: 我帮助蕾米探索了楚安德-泽尔，她在那里相遇并修复了一只她命名为小渣的蜘蛛。她还想看更多的矮人遗迹，所以我让她陪我去冒险。

entries.text: I've helped Remi explore Nchuand-Zel where she met and fixed up a dwemer spider she named Scrap. She still wants to see more dwemer ruins, so I've let her accompany me in my adventures.
entries.translated_text: 我帮助蕾米探索了楚安德-泽尔，她在那里相遇并修复了一只她命名为小渣的蜘蛛。她还想看更多的矮人遗迹，所以我让她陪我去冒险。

entries.text: I've helped Remi explore Nchuand-Zel where she met and fixed up a dwemer spider she named Scrap. She still wants to see more dwemer ruins, so I've let her accompany me in my adventures.
entries.translated_text: 我帮助蕾米探索了楚安德-泽尔，她在那里相遇并修复了一只她命名为小渣的蜘蛛。她还想看更多的矮人遗迹，所以我让她陪我去冒险。

entries.text: I've helped Remi explore Nchuand-Zel where she met and fixed up a dwemer spider she named Scrap. She still wants to see more dwemer ruins, so I've let her accompany me in my adventures.
entries.translated_text: 我帮助蕾米探索了楚安德-泽尔，她在那里相遇并修复了一只她命名为小渣的蜘蛛。她还想看更多的矮人遗迹，所以我让她陪我去冒险。

entries.text: And why should they?
entries.translated_text: 他们为什么要这样做？

entries.text: Are you doing okay out there, Ilia?
entries.translated_text: 你外面还好吗，伊利亚？

entries.text: So, Khash, does anyone ever give you any trouble about your age and how you adventure?
entries.translated_text: 那么，卡什，有人因为你的年龄和你去冒险的事而为难你吗？

entries.text: You really think so?!
entries.translated_text: 你真的这么认为吗？！

entries.text: Well, obviously, yes!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，毫无疑问，是的！

entries.text: (Laugh) I don't know about that. I dropped out of school when I was a kid. I'm not educated, like you are.
entries.translated_text: （笑）我不知道。我小时候就辍学了。我没受过教育，就像你一样。

entries.text: But other than that, it was such a pleasant journey!
entries.translated_text: 但除此之外，这是一次非常愉快的旅程！我想，这也是一个非常好的机会！

entries.text: Me neither.
entries.translated_text: 我也是。

entries.text: Very funny.
entries.translated_text: 你这么问还真有趣。

entries.text: I bet you could do anything!
entries.translated_text: 我打赌你什么都能做！

entries.text: You really think so? Oh, I hope so...
entries.translated_text: 你真的这么认为？哦，我希望如此...

entries.text: The dwarves were a clever race. I wonder what happened to them?
entries.translated_text: 矮人是很聪明的种族。不知道他们发生了什么事？

entries.text: Oooh, look at this laboratory! I want a laboratory like this! Adding it onto my wishlist, right under 'personal workshop'.
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看这个实验室！我想要一个这样的实验室！将它添加到我的愿望清单中，就在“个人工作坊”下方。

entries.text: What would you like to discuss?
entries.translated_text: 你想讨论什么？

entries.text: I don't know what you're talking about.
entries.translated_text: 我不懂你在说什么。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel? I've already been there.
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔？我已经去过那里了。

entries.text: Or sometimes down on you.
entries.translated_text: 或者有时对你不利。

entries.text: Mother of-Ouch!
entries.translated_text: 哎哟！

entries.text: They took Scrap and just tossed him around like some hunk of metal!
entries.translated_text: 他们抓走了小渣，把他像矿石一样扔来扔去！

entries.text: As much as I'd like to see for myself, we have enough dangers to handle for right now.
entries.translated_text: 尽管我很想亲眼目睹，但我们现在的危险已经够多了。

entries.text: I'm a bit lightheaded, Revan. You don't think I'm dying, do you?
entries.translated_text: 我有点头晕目眩，渡鸦，你不觉得我快死了吧？

entries.text: Scrap, don't get too close to Teldryn's atronach!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，不要太靠近泰卓因的元素！

entries.text: You'd regret attacking me, if Ganbald were going to let you live!
entries.translated_text: 你会后悔攻击我的，如果甘巴尔德会让你活命的话！

entries.text: Makeup is traditionally a sign you will service wealthy nobles for gold.
entries.translated_text: 传统意义上，化妆象征着你将为了钱向富有的贵族提供服务。

entries.text: Dibella's tits, that stings!
entries.translated_text: 该死的蒂贝拉乳头，好疼！

entries.text: We'll talk later, then, Ed?
entries.translated_text: 我们稍后再谈，那么，艾德？

entries.text: Uh, sort of? So, do you think I belong here? With you guys?
entries.translated_text: 呃，有点？那么，你认为我属于这里吗？和你们一起？

entries.text: So! I don't know if you know this, but I've had my fair share of drinking contests, and I can handle myself.
entries.translated_text: 那是！我不知道你是否知道，但我确实参加过相当多的饮酒比赛，我能拿下它。

entries.text: I'm glad we're out of the snow and all... But it's cold in here too...
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴我们已经走出了雪地...但是这里也很冷...

entries.text: I wonder what we'll find in this cave. Vampires? Trolls? Spiders?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道我们会在这个山洞里找到什么。吸血鬼？巨魔？蜘蛛？

entries.text: I agree.
entries.translated_text: 我同意.

entries.text: I agree.
entries.translated_text: 我同意.

entries.text: The stuff tastes terrible. In hindsight, the whole process would have gone a lot faster if I'd taken notes.
entries.translated_text: 这东西味道很糟糕。但事后看来，如果我做好了笔记，整个过程会快得多。

entries.text: I... Thank you, Auri.
entries.translated_text: 我...谢谢你，奥璃。

entries.text: Hm. That's a shame. Oh well. Let's get you some water, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 嗯。太可惜了。那好吧。给你倒点水好吗？

entries.text: Well... I suppose changing the venue for our classes wouldn't hurt.
entries.translated_text: 好吧...我想换个上课地点也不会有什么坏处。

entries.text: I think that's just you, Zora.
entries.translated_text: 我想只有你这么想，佐拉。

entries.text: Show the note to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 向蕾米出示便条。

entries.text: Gladly.
entries.translated_text: 荣幸之极。

entries.text: The automotons here are impressively strong. Scrap, what do you think?
entries.translated_text: 这里的自动机械非常强大。小渣，你怎么看？

entries.text: F-funny?! I-I don't think I said anything funny, though? Did I? Hm. Well, I'll try not to-to overthink it...
entries.translated_text: 有-有趣？！不过我觉得我说的没什么好笑的？是吗？嗯，我会尽量不要想得太多。。。

entries.text: Excellent! It's finished!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！都完成了！

entries.text: I'm telling you, Aela, I can fight for myself. I've had a dagger on my hip since I was a child.
entries.translated_text: 我告诉你，艾拉，我可以自己战斗。从小我腰间就别着一把匕首。

entries.text: Lever puzzles... Ingenious. I'm sure I can use a similar method to make sure no one else can rewire Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 杠杆谜题...巧妙。我确信我可以使用类似的方法来确保没有其他人可以重新覆写小渣。

entries.text: Oh, Gore! I managed to get something from the store keep on my own this time! I got you some strength potions while I was at it.
entries.translated_text: 哦，格雷! 我在商店淘了一点东西！我给你买了一些力量药水。

entries.text: I understand that the Nords probably have their musical preferences and would like to stick with it, but they can't add a couple more to the mix?!
entries.translated_text: 我理解诺德人可能有他们的音乐偏好，并希望他们能坚持下去，但他们就不能再加一些吗！？

entries.text: Here, take this. It's all in this note.
entries.translated_text: 来，拿着这个，都在这张纸条上了。

entries.text: And yet the rest of the family still insists that you've always been so close and 'oh, how wonderful to see you together again.'
entries.translated_text: 然而，家里的其他人却一直在说，你们一直都很亲密，'哦，能再次看到你们在一起真是太好了'。

entries.text: Oh, was he very educated, then? A professor? A scholar?
entries.translated_text: 哦，那他受过很好的教育吗？是一位教授？或学者？

entries.text: The world smells so fresh after a good rain.
entries.translated_text: 一场大雨过后，世界闻起来如此清新。

entries.text: That sounds great, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 听起来不错，蕾米。

entries.text: Yazakh, here is a pie. I just found out that it contains meat instead of fruits. N-not that that is why I'm giving it to you, of course.
entries.translated_text: 雅扎克，给你一个派。我才发现这是肉馅而不是水果馅的。当然啦，我才不是因为这个才给你的。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Fine.
entries.translated_text: 好。

entries.text: Hope you're aware I was always good with words.
entries.translated_text: 希望你知道我总是能说会道。（Hope，H开头）

entries.text: What are you thinking?
entries.translated_text: 你在思考什么？

entries.text: What are you thinking?
entries.translated_text: 你在思考什么？

entries.text: (Coughing) Damn all this ash. (Coughing)
entries.translated_text: （咳嗽）这些该死的灰烬。（咳嗽）

entries.text: Thanks, Mama!
entries.translated_text: 谢谢，妈妈！

entries.text: But I was wondering...
entries.translated_text: 但我想知道...

entries.text: Animals, bandits, or maybe both.
entries.translated_text: 动物，强盗，或者两者兼而有之。

entries.text: Well, yes... but every time I've tried to redirect the power feed, it's drained the soul charge.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，是的......但每次我试图重新引导能量馈送时，都会耗尽灵魂能量。

entries.text: Yes, I knew you'd love it! I'm just the best, aren't I?
entries.translated_text: 是的，我就知道你会喜欢它！我就是最好的，不是吗？我是最棒的，不是吗？

entries.text: A ring. Less likely to fall off in a fight.
entries.translated_text: 一枚戒指，在战斗中更不容易掉。

entries.text: I was rather confused how a ghost had swayed his mind and actions so easily.
entries.translated_text: 我当时相当困惑，一个鬼魂怎么能就如此轻易地左右他的思想和行动。

entries.text: I'd be glad to have you with me.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你能和我同行。

entries.text: Doing fine, thanks.
entries.translated_text: 做得很好，谢谢。

entries.text: Oh, uh, I'm sorry. That was insensitive.
entries.translated_text: 哦，呃，抱歉，有些不妥。

entries.text: That one's my favorite. Please. You first. I insist.
entries.translated_text: 那是我最喜欢的。请你先。我随后。

entries.text: It'd be great if you *didn't* run right into me.
entries.translated_text: 要是你别直接撞上我就好了。

entries.text: I think they smell, and far too aggressive for their own good.
entries.translated_text: 我认为他们很臭，而且过于好斗，这于它们自身无益。

entries.text: You're so handsome, aren't you, Scrap? Look at how shiny you are! My handsome boy.
entries.translated_text: 你真帅，对吧，小渣？看看你有多闪亮！我帅气的男孩。

entries.text: I think it's time for us to look into who sent them.
entries.translated_text: 我认为是时候让我们调查一下是谁派来的了。

entries.text: In the meantime, I'll think about what we should have for dinner, okay?
entries.translated_text: 同时，我会考虑我们晚餐应该吃什么，好吗？

entries.text: So, Khash, you lived in Cyrodiil, right? But in the wilderness? How, eh, was it, I guess?
entries.translated_text: 所以，卡什，你以前住在赛洛迪尔，对吧？不过是在荒野里？嗯...那是种什么样的感觉呢？

entries.text: Well, it just seems like you've mentioned them so fondly before; I figured they must be important to you?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你以前好像亲切地提到过它们；我想他们一定对你很重要吧？

entries.text: I don't think I'm comfortable giving my blood to some loony experiments.
entries.translated_text: 我可不想将自己的血液用于一些疯狂的实验。

entries.text: (Laugh) Your clothes are soaking wet! You look so silly!
entries.translated_text: （大笑）你的衣服都湿透了！你看起来真傻！

entries.text: (Whisper) Stealth isn't your strong suit, is it?
entries.translated_text: （低语）隐匿身形不是你的强项，是吗？

entries.text: Bring Remi the supplies for her crossbow project while she's relaxing.
entries.translated_text: 趁她休息的时候，给蕾米带来她的弩所需的材料。

entries.text: Oh, off to see what silly nonsense you got up to in Rorikstead now? I'm very excited for you to find out. You really don't remember, then?
entries.translated_text: 哦，去看看你现在洛利克镇干了什么蠢事？我很高兴你能知道。那你真的不记得了？

entries.text: Revan? Revan, you didn't die, did you? Oh, you're alive. Good.
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦？渡鸦，你没死，对吧？哦，你还活着。好。

entries.text: I think I've just realized I don't much like Mjoll. She advocates against thievery, as though it doesn't require skill of its own.
entries.translated_text: 我想我刚刚意识到我不太喜欢穆月尔，她主张反对偷窃，仿佛偷窃不需要本事一样。

entries.text: We'll steal it, but I want to be the one to do so.
entries.translated_text: 我们当然会偷，但我想亲自出马。

entries.text: Hm? Oh, hello. Oh, wow, you look- Sorry, I momentarily forgot you were so pretty.
entries.translated_text: 嗯？哦，你好哦，哇，你看起来... 对不起，我一时忘了你这么漂亮。

entries.text: You're back from the ominous castle! And still human, so that's a relief. I was afraid they might turn you against your will.
entries.translated_text: 你从不祥的城堡回来了！仍然是人类，真是惊险。我担心他们会违背你的意愿让你留下。

entries.text: You aren't serious? Scrap makes for an excellent pet!
entries.translated_text: 你不是认真的吧？“小渣”是很好的宠物！

entries.text: I have... Er...
entries.translated_text: 我有……呃……

entries.text: I heard about what you did for our friends, little guy. You really saved the day!
entries.translated_text: 我听说了你为我们朋友做的事，小家伙，你真的救了他们。

entries.text: If these Skeever give me a disease, promise me you'll study the effects it has on me!
entries.translated_text: 如果这些恶鼠让我得了病，答应我你会研究它对我的影响！

entries.text: Of course the dwemer dealt with Hermaeus Mora's Books. Can't say I blame them. I wouldn't mind learning some forbidden knowledge myself.
entries.translated_text: 果然锻莫也接触过赫麦尤斯·莫拉的书籍。我倒不怪他们，我自己也不介意学点禁忌知识。

entries.text: In Vvardenfell, if a dwemer automoton is taken too far away from the Red Mountain, it powers off. These machines don't seem to share that weakness.
entries.translated_text: 在瓦登费尔，如果将锻莫机械带离红山太远，就会断能。这些装置似乎没有这个弱点。

entries.text: In my experience, someone like Revyn, who so emphatically claims to commit no crimes, is often trying to convince *themselves* of their good morals.
entries.translated_text: 根据我的经验，像瑞温这样的人，越是强调自己没有犯罪，就越是在自欺欺人。

entries.text: It's not right.
entries.translated_text: 你不该这样。

entries.text: Bandits are pathetic. There are more elegant ways to rob people blind.
entries.translated_text: 强盗真可怜。其实还有更优雅的方法可以让人们失明。

entries.text: Can I hug you?
entries.translated_text: 我可以抱抱你吗？

entries.text: Can I hug you?
entries.translated_text: 我可以抱抱你吗？

entries.text: Smell that?
entries.translated_text: 闻到了吗？

entries.text: Morals. Standards. A thief spends their whole life breaking those things.
entries.translated_text: 道德。标准。盗贼鼠辈们一生都在破坏这些东西。

entries.text: There's got to be easier prey for you to hunt!
entries.translated_text: 这里肯定有更容易捕猎的猎物！

entries.text: Ray, we lived! Oh, maybe I should try to sound less surprised. I'll work on that.
entries.translated_text: 雷，我们活了下来！哦，也许我应该试着听起来不那么惊讶，我会努力解决这个问题。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. Although I already explored the ruins for myself, Remi thinks we will still find interesting artifacts. I should keep a lookout.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。虽然我已经亲自探索过遗迹，但蕾米认为我们还是会找到有趣的文物。我应该保持警惕。

entries.text: "Please, I beg of you to keep Wayrest free of his vile influences. I could not bear if..."
entries.translated_text: “拜托，我请求你让途歇城免受他的邪恶影响，我无法忍受...”

entries.text: And then it kept happening, and when I finally asked if I could kiss her, well...
entries.translated_text: 然后气氛不断升温，当我最后问我是否可以吻她时，嗯...

entries.text: The parts of the castle that are in disrepair just add to the ambience.
entries.translated_text: 年久失修的城堡部分增添了氛围。

entries.text: Oh! Sam was Sanguine?! Ohhh, why didn't he tell me?! I wish I could have gotten a way to communicate with him. I could find him when I got bored!
entries.translated_text: 哦！山姆是桑吉恩？！哦，他为什么不告诉我？！我希望能找到一种与他沟通的方式，无聊的时候可以找到他！

entries.text: An invite to the notorious Thieves' Guild? What do you think, my friend? Seems a shame to waste the opportunity.
entries.translated_text: 臭名昭著的盗贼公会的邀请？你怎么看，我的朋友？浪费机会的话似乎很可惜。

entries.text: One of these days, I'm going to have to come up with something catchy to say when we win a fight.
entries.translated_text: 总有一天，当我们赢得一场战斗时，我会想出一些有趣的话。

entries.text: And Rodard froze. Not with fear, no, but shock and dread and despair.
entries.translated_text: 罗达德僵住了。并非害怕，，而是震惊、恐惧和绝望。

entries.text: By Sheor, look at this place. Absolutely destroyed. It's chilling how... quiet it is.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔，看看这个地方。完全被摧毁了。真让人寒心。。。安静。

entries.text: I'm going to have nightmares about these things!
entries.translated_text: 我会为这些事情做噩梦的！

entries.text: Do you not often have capable drinking partners?
entries.translated_text: 你不是少有能喝的酒伴吗？

entries.text: Well, yes, but... Oh, I get it.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，好，但是...哦，我懂了。

entries.text: You'll regret it. But it's your call.
entries.translated_text: 你会后悔的。这是你的决定。

entries.text: You could pretend to be happy for me at least.
entries.translated_text: 至少你应该假装为我高兴一下。

entries.text: What do you mean 'what about him'? Do you know him?
entries.translated_text: “他怎么了？”是什么意思？你认识他吗？

entries.text: Wha-? Sorry!
entries.translated_text: 什么？抱歉！

entries.text: That soul gem is... something. If it can't hold a soul, what is Arniel planning to do with it? I've only ever used filled soul gems for my projects.
entries.translated_text: 那颗灵魂石是...什么东西。如果它不能容纳灵魂，阿内尔打算用它做什么？我只在我的项目中使用过填充的灵魂石。

entries.text: You want me to leave you behind?
entries.translated_text: 你想让我留下你吗？

entries.text: Does that clarify it a little?
entries.translated_text: 你能明白吗？

entries.text: Nar. It sounds like star! Nar, bright as a shining star. I'm certain that's better poetry than much of what you can find in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 纳尔。听起来像星星！纳尔，像一颗闪亮的星星一样明亮。我敢肯定，这比你在天际能找到的大部分诗歌都要好。

entries.text:
L,

I have finalized our agreement, per our last correspondence. The Order of the Hour may have judged her to be of no threat to the stability of High Rock, but that doesn't mean that the rest of the city excused her worship of The Bad Man. My name, that I had nearly shared with her, was tarnished. Despite cutting off the engagement and refusing to engage in trade relations with her family, others saw me as a sympathizer. It took years of denouncing her family and driving them from market to regain even a scrap of my former dignity.

And just when I had finally overcome the humiliation of being betrothed to a daedra worshipper, her parents reveal themselves as the scum they are! Running a fencing operation, whispering vile words into the nobility's ears, selling illicit merchandise-even skooma! And now it's not the Order interrogating me but the damned city guard!
