My chance at the throne of Wayrest is destroyed, and instead of capturing those damned fools, the guard let them slip between their fingers. While they're out there somewhere, likely getting further and further from my grasp, these guards have the nerve to investigate me!

Now, her parents may have vanished, but I have heard suspicious rumours. Our neighbors to the east have been whispering of a powerful individual, roaming the Nords' land. And in this person's company is an odd girl, with a dwemer machine for a pet. I may not have seen Remiel for some time but there is no doubt this is her.

I have heard terrible things about your band of mercenaries, and I mean that as a compliment. Kill her. Bring me her head as proof, give me the vengeance I deserve. I'm tired of her actions haunting my life. My pay will be generous, but you'll find me in a more giving mood should you prove she suffered before the end.

-Morvic Riscel
entries.translated_text:
L，

根据我们上次的通信，我已经敲定了我们的协议。时序团可能认为她不会对高岩的稳定构成威胁，但这并不意味着这座城市的其他人可以原谅她对恶棍的信仰。我与她共享的名誉也几乎被玷污了，尽管我已经与她的家族断绝交往并终止贸易，但其他人仍将认为我偏袒她。我花了数年时间谴责她的家族并将他们赶出市场，以恢复我以前的尊严。

而就在我几乎要洗脱与一个魔神信徒联姻的屈辱时，她的又暴露了他们的渣滓本性！经营走私，向贵族耳边低语恶毒的言辞，贩卖非法商品——甚至斯库玛！现在来质询我的甚至不是教团，而是该死的城市守卫！

我登上途歇城王座的机会被毁了，守卫没有抓住那些该死的傻瓜，反而让他们从指缝中溜走了。他们现在可能在某个地方，离我越来越远，而这些卫兵竟还有脸来调查我！

现在，她的父母可能已经消失了，但我听到了一些可疑的传闻。我们东边的邻居在低语着一个强大的存在，游荡在诺德人的土地上。而在此人身边，有一个古怪的女孩，带着一台矮人制造的机械宠物。我虽然有段时间没见到蕾米尔了，但毫无疑问，那就是她。

我听过你佣兵团的恐怖事迹，我很欣赏。杀了她，把她的头带回来作为证据，给有应得的复仇。我厌倦了她的所作所为在我的生活中阴魂不散。我的报酬很丰富，但如果你能让她在死前受尽折磨，我会开更高的价码。

-莫维克·里塞尔

entries.text: So perhaps you're right! It does sound like you!
entries.translated_text: 所以也许你是对的！听起来确实像你！

entries.text: Ah! J'zargo, fry them!
entries.translated_text: 啊！吉'扎格，烧死他们！

entries.text: I've tested your tension wrench.
entries.translated_text: 我已经测试了你的张力扳手。

entries.text: Okay! You-you don't have to. You repayed whatever debt they think you owed them.
entries.translated_text: 好的！你——你不必加入，你偿还了他们认为你欠他们的全部债务。

entries.text: I've been wondering... What do you think of me?
entries.translated_text: 我一直在想...你觉得我怎么样？

entries.text: Ain't nothing a boy can do that I can't do better!
entries.translated_text: 没有什么是男孩能做，我不能做得更好的！

entries.text: Oooh, Dexion was blinded. That's... our fault, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 哦，戴希翁失明了。那是……我们的错，不是吗？

texts: In Valenwood, being a thief is considered a virtue.
在威木省，做小偷被认为是一种美德。

entries.text: Okay! Here we go! And now... to test it.
entries.translated_text: 好了！我们快了！而现在...要测试一下。

entries.text: This seems like a long shot, but I'll look.
entries.translated_text: 这似乎是大海捞针啊，但我会看看的。

entries.text: Really? Well, I guess I'm not really all that shocked.
entries.translated_text: 你认真的？嗯，我想我并没有那么夸张。

entries.text: Ideally, the next time your ship comes over the horizon, everyone is scared and no one fights. Easy profit.
entries.translated_text: 理想的情况是，下一次你的船从地平线上驶过时，所有人都害怕了，没有人反抗。轻松拿下。

entries.text: Apparently setting fire to things for entertainment is not acceptable in class.
entries.translated_text: 显然，课堂上是不允许放火娱乐的。

entries.text: I think I'll use your teeth to chill my ale!
entries.translated_text: 我想我会用你的牙齿来冷冻我的啤酒！

entries.text: Good luck. I know you're going into Apocrypha to defeat Miraak, but please also keep track of every detail in the realm to tell me when you're back!
entries.translated_text: 祝你好运。我知道你要进入阿波科法来打败秘拉克，但也请密切关注领域中的每一个细节，以便在你回来时告诉我！

entries.text: While we're here, Gore, I'll show you what a two-for-one deal is, okay? Whiterun's market is perfect for such a demonstration.
entries.translated_text: 格雷，我在这里先告诉你什么叫做买一送一的交易，好吗？等到了白漫城的市场上我再给你演示一遍。

entries.text: Maybe it'd be better to show you...
entries.translated_text: 也许给你看会更好...

entries.text: You know, they seem to be enjoying themselves here. Good for them.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，他们似乎在这里玩得很开心，祝愿他们。

entries.text: Remi's Tuning Fork
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的音叉

entries.text: In between my figuring out how the chandelier functions, which is powered by steam, surprise, surprise, I gathered the necessary materials.
entries.translated_text: 吊灯的这些功能我都全部搞清楚了，这全都是由蒸汽推动的，真是惊喜，因为我收集了必要的材料。

entries.text: Let me show you the power of the mighty Centurion! He who is both Dwarf and Machine!
entries.translated_text: 让我向你展示百夫长的强大力量！他既是矮人又是机器！

entries.text: I've gotten worse cuts from reading!
entries.translated_text: 我读书时都割得比这还惨！

entries.text: Anyway, this poor guy clearly didn't make it.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，这可怜的家伙显然没有成功。

entries.text: That's it. Lessons start immediately. Right now.
entries.translated_text: 就这么定了。立刻开始上课。现在马上！

entries.text: Lucky for you, you've acquired a master alchemist as a friend.
entries.translated_text: 幸运的是，你得到了一位炼金大师作为朋友。

entries.text: How convenient! If Nepos hadn't sent that fellow along to fight you, it would've taken us much longer to figure out he was 'N'. Thank you, Nepos!
entries.translated_text: 得来全不费工夫！如果奈波斯没有派那个家伙来和你打架，我们得花更长的时间才能弄清楚他是“N”。谢谢你，奈波斯！

entries.text: That's a bit conceited, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 这有点自负，不是吗？

entries.text: Put the thought out of your mind, and do not speak of it again.
entries.translated_text: 快忘掉这个想法，也别再提起它了。

entries.text: Oh, no, I have an idea... But, well, don't get angry?
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，我有个主意……但是，你别生气，好吗？

entries.text: Oh, and-er-you can use it, too, of course!
entries.translated_text: 哦，当然，你也可以使用它！

entries.text: Rumarin used to be a jester.
entries.translated_text: 鲁米勒以前是个小丑。

entries.text: Oh. Yea. That does sound like a lot.
entries.translated_text: 哦。是的。这听起来确实很多。

entries.text: I can use these in my crossbow; they're the perfect size. Thank you, my friend! Very thoughtful of you!
entries.translated_text: 我可以在我的弩中用上这些！

entries.text: O-okay! I'm alive. Buffy is alive. Scrap is alive. Everyone is alive.
entries.translated_text: 哦——好吧！我还活着，巴非还活着，小渣活着，每个人都活着。

entries.text: I don't need you alive to find out what I want. (Intimidate)
entries.translated_text: 我不需要你活着就能知道我想要的。（威吓）

entries.text: Well, forget I said anything about it, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那当我什么都没说过。

entries.text: Since you apparently overheard, you'll know that Val and I are business partners now!
entries.translated_text: 既然你显然偷听到了，那你就知道我和瓦尔现在是生意伙伴了！

entries.text: Exploring Arkngchal
entries.translated_text: 探索阿卡切尔

entries.text: Anyway, let's head on out, then. Shall we?
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，那我们就出发吧，怎么说？

entries.text: All those games are dangerous!
entries.translated_text: 这些游戏都很危险！

entries.text: Oh, Ria, you're here! Perfect! Oh- Did you need something before I start asking questions?
entries.translated_text: 哦，利亚，你来了！完美！哦——在我开始提问之前，你需要什么吗？

entries.text: I'm clumsy enough without the floor itself rocking under my feet. Just ignore if I fall, okay?
entries.translated_text: 就算地板不晃，我都够笨拙的了。要是我摔了，就当没看见，好吗？

entries.text: Perhaps. The real question is do I want to?
entries.translated_text: 也许吧。真正的问题在于我想不想？

entries.text: Maybe this is some sort of notice that the protective mechanism is not controlled via tonal architecture.
entries.translated_text: 也许这是某种提示，保护装置不是通过音调架构控制的。

entries.text: I'm not a baby anymore! I'm almost a woman!
entries.translated_text: 我已经不是小孩子了！我快要成为女人了！

entries.text: Definitely a drink, but also a...Oh! I know! A mammoth steak, with fried potatoes and eggs, smothered in Spriggan Sap, and garnished with fire salts!
entries.translated_text: 当然是一杯饮料，但也…哦！我知道！一块猛犸象排，配上炸土豆和鸡蛋，用树精的汁液浸泡，并撒上火盐！

entries.text: Then it can be used while still leaving room toward the back of the lock.
entries.translated_text: 这样他就可以在锁的后部留有空间的同时使用了。

entries.text: Do you hear that music? Cities make me feel so alive!
entries.translated_text: 你听到那音乐了吗？城市让我感觉充满活力！

entries.text: Wow! I think these will go great in a potion. You did great!
entries.translated_text: 哇！我认为这些在药水中会很好用。你做得很好！

entries.text: But-but... Then everything I said... I-I didn't know you were joking!
entries.translated_text: 但是...后面我说的那些事...我根本不知道你在开玩笑！

entries.text: O-oh! I-I love you, too!
entries.translated_text: 哦哦！我、我也爱你！

entries.text: Books.
entries.translated_text: 书本。

entries.text: Books.
entries.translated_text: 书本。

entries.text: Wait... Hey, there's a body up there! Quick, let's see if it has anything useful.
entries.translated_text: 等等...嘿，上面有一具尸体！快，让我们看看他那里是否有什么有用的。

entries.text: I'm not entirely familiar with the Houses of Morrowind. Is House Redoran respectable?
entries.translated_text: 我对晨风的家族并不完全熟悉。瑞多然家族值得尊敬吗？

entries.text: I know you're upset, but venageance is wrong, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你很难过，但报复是不对的，蕾米。

entries.text: Interesting Dwemer Gear
entries.translated_text: 有趣的矮人装备

entries.text: Skyrim should be accepting of all, including Talos worshippers.
entries.translated_text: 天际应该接受所有人，包括塔洛斯信徒。

entries.text: Conjure Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Conjure Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Conjure Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Conjure Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: Conjure Scrap
entries.translated_text: 召唤小渣

entries.text: I travelled from Morrowind.
entries.translated_text: 我来自晨风。

entries.text: ...and the part with the, uh, sweaty feet?
entries.translated_text: ...还有那段，呃，脚臭味的部分？

entries.text: That's not what I said; you're twisting my words- (Sigh) Try not to get killed, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我不是这么说的;你在歪曲我的话——（叹气）尽量不要被杀掉，好吗？

entries.text: I dug too deep into the Silver-Bloods' affairs.
entries.translated_text: 我对银血家族的事情挖得太深了。

entries.text: How does he perceive himself when a werewolf as opposed to when he's...er... human-ish? Is his thinking different?
entries.translated_text: 当他是狼人而不是...呃...人类时，他如何看待自己？他的想法不一样吗？

entries.text: Investigate Solitude.
entries.translated_text: 我调查孤独城。

entries.text: Uh! I just ask because if you're from Stormhaven, you know how silly the gossip can get. Truly unbearable. (Laugh)
entries.translated_text: 我这么问是因为如果你来自风暴港，你就会知道流言蜚语有多愚蠢。真让人受不了（笑）

entries.text: Everything about this seems suspicious. As though someone in power were swaying things their way...
entries.translated_text: 这里的一切似乎都很可疑，仿佛是有权贵在左右事情的进展...

entries.text: Ahmed, we lived!
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德，我们活了下来！

entries.text: Perhaps someday you'll show me?
entries.translated_text: 也许有一天你会给我讲讲？

entries.text: There doesn't seem to be very many Vampire Hunters, does there?
entries.translated_text: 吸血鬼猎人好像不是很多吧？

entries.text: Should be easy enough to remember. Ria. I will call you Ria.
entries.translated_text: 应该很容易记住，利亚，我要叫你利亚。

entries.text: What do you want to do about it?
entries.translated_text: 你想怎么做？

entries.text: See ya'.
entries.translated_text: 再见'。

entries.text: Talk to Remi about the note.
entries.translated_text: 和蕾米谈谈这张纸条。

entries.text: Alright. 'The ruins were cold, hard, and full of steam, as if it were a...' Uh, I'll try and think of a more appropriate simile later.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。“遗址冰冷、坚硬，充满了蒸汽，仿佛是一个...”呃，我以后会试着想出一个更合适的比喻。

entries.text: Yes, but my experiment-
entries.translated_text: 是的，但我的实验——

entries.text: Oh, yes, you've always seemed quite put together to me. I can't imagine what the third apothecary was thinking.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，我一直认为你是相当得体的人。我真无法想象第三位药剂师当时在想什么。

entries.text: Yeah, okay, and... that means you want it?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，好吧，所以...你想要它吗？

entries.text: Oh, I love Elsweyr cuisine! I have quite the sweet-tooth!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我喜欢艾斯维尔美食！我很爱吃甜食！

entries.text: And I might have accidentally used all mine in an experiment. Don't ask.
entries.translated_text: 我可能在一个实验中不小心用完了所有的，别问为什么。

entries.text: Yes, fame doesn't sound so great when you think of it that way.
entries.translated_text: 是的，当你这么想的时候，名望就听起来并不那么好。

entries.text: Oh, well. Now that you point it out, I don't think I'd like someone to take my blood either. Sorry.
entries.translated_text: 那好吧。既然你这么说，我想我也不希望有人拿我的血。对不起。

entries.text: What did Buffy and I do for you to try to kill us? You're so rude!
entries.translated_text: 巴非和我为你做了什么让你想杀死我们？你太粗鲁了！

entries.text: Ulfric is a tosspot.
entries.translated_text: 乌弗瑞克是个蠢货。

entries.text: I'd like to know more about your father.
entries.translated_text: 我想知道更多关于你父亲的信息。

entries.text: Is that those bastards who took our life from us
entries.translated_text: 那些夺走我们生活的混蛋，

entries.text: That's the most thoughtful thing anyone has ever done for me.
entries.translated_text: 你真是所有人中最周到的一个。

entries.text: I am not frightened. I have always liked cities that have an element of danger.
entries.translated_text: 我不害怕。我一直喜欢有危险因素的城市。

entries.text: Well, I'm not too sure. I suppose it depends on your definition of 'worship'?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我不太确定。我想这取决于你对 "信仰"的定义？

entries.text: The letter the courier gave me... It's from my father.
entries.translated_text: 信使给我寄了一封信...是我父亲寄来的。

entries.text: Thinking out loud helps me to sort out complex ideas. I'm not sure what about hearing my own voice makes it easier, but it does.
entries.translated_text: 大声思考有助于我理清复杂的思绪。我不知道为什么听到自己的声音会让我更轻松，但确实如此。

entries.text: I can barely see a thing! Oof, ow! Damn urns in the way.
entries.translated_text: 我几乎什么都看不见！喔喔喔喔！脚下该死的骨灰盒。

entries.text: The Dwemer often used lava as energy sources. I wonder how they accounted for potential dangers? What if something blew up?
entries.translated_text: 锻莫经常使用熔岩作为能源。我想知道他们如何应对风险的？万一出事了怎么办？

entries.text: Amazing! It's THE Aetherium Forge! Look how they used the power of heat to achieve such greatness! Oh, the things I'm learning...
entries.translated_text: 哇塞！是神光水晶熔炉！看看他们是如何利用热能创造出这样的奇迹的！哦，我正在学到这些东西...太令人惊叹了！

entries.text: Amazing! It's THE Aetherium Forge! Look how they used the power of heat to achieve such greatness! Oh, the things I'm learning...
entries.translated_text: 惊人！是神光水晶熔炉！看看他们是如何利用热能达到如此伟大的！哦，我正在学习的东西...

entries.text: Amazing! It's THE Aetherium Forge! Look how they used the power of heat to achieve such greatness! Oh, the things I'm learning...
entries.translated_text: 惊人！是神光水晶熔炉！看看他们是如何利用热能达到如此伟大的！哦，我正在学习的东西...

entries.text: Yes, they're always looking down on us. Especially that Ancano.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他们总是瞧不起我们。尤其是那个安卡诺。

entries.text: Er, y-you aren't... You aren't particular in tune with the rumours around the area, are you?
entries.translated_text: 呃，你不是......你对这附近的传言不是很了解吧？

entries.text: Yes! Yes, I knew there was a reason my mind was so excited to be at the College, but I couldn't remember what it was!
entries.translated_text: 是的！是的，我知道我的大脑在学院里如此兴奋是有原因的，但我想不起来是什么原因了！

entries.text: Sounds great!
entries.translated_text: 听起来不错！

entries.text: So is this drum amazing in some way? Or is its value in its, ugh, 'historical relevancy'?
entries.translated_text: 那么这面鼓在某种程度上是不是很神奇呢？或者它的价值在于它“见证历史”？

entries.text: Our junk is another person's treasure...
entries.translated_text: 我们的垃圾可是别人的宝贝呢...

entries.text: There's not enough drinking in the world today, wouldn't you agree?
entries.translated_text: 如今大家都喝得太少了，你同意吧？

entries.text: Definitely not drinking all your ale, friend.
entries.translated_text: 绝对不要喝完你的麦芽酒，朋友。

entries.text: No? Alright...
entries.translated_text: 不想？好吧...

entries.text: I'm loving how morbid the shop names are here.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢这里奇怪的商店名。

entries.text: How are you doing?
entries.translated_text: 最近如何？

entries.text: How are you doing?
entries.translated_text: 最近如何？

entries.text: What I mean is: this is to thank you for-for being such a great friend to me.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是：这是为了感谢你——感谢你一直是我这么好的朋友。

entries.text: And surely I could get this cog to fit... OW!
entries.translated_text: 我肯定能让这个齿轮装上去……哎哟！

entries.text: Do you suppose they have an initiation test of some sort? I'd be afraid to mess it up. Imagine if a guard was called on me.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得他们会有某种入会测试之类的吗？我可真怕搞砸了。要是因为那样被叫来一个守卫就糟了，想想都让人紧张。

entries.text: This... Not. Going. How. Me. Thought. It. Would. Go.
entries.translated_text: 这。和我。想的。不同。我。会。去。的。

entries.text: Yes. Well. There's nothing for you to apologize for. Besides, I'm your 'sister', right? So I've acquired a family away from home, right?
entries.translated_text: 是的，好吧。你没有什么可道歉的。再说了，我是你的‘姐妹’对吧？所以我在外地也有了家人，对吧？

entries.text: The Dwemer in the Solstheim area definitely had a unique way of building from their western kin. Maybe learning some of it will benefit Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 索瑟海姆的锻莫肯定有不同于他们西方同族的独特的建筑方式。也许学习其中的一些东西会让小渣受益。

entries.text: The Dwemer in the Solstheim area definitely had a unique way of building from their western kin. Maybe learning some of it will benefit Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 索瑟海姆的锻莫肯定有不同于他们西方同族的独特的建筑方式。也许学习其中的一些东西会让小渣受益。

entries.text: Okay, so I hold it like this?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，所以我就这样握着？

entries.text: You mentioned something about your dad and necromancers before.
entries.translated_text: 你之前提到过一些关于你父亲和死灵法师的事情。

entries.text: I'd love to hear more about your deity. While I'm a bit wishy-washy regarding worshipping myself, I want to support your beliefs.
entries.translated_text: 我很想听到更多关于你的神灵的信息。虽然我对自己的信仰有点犹豫不决，但我想支持你的信仰。

entries.text: Okay! I'll mark it down on your map.
entries.translated_text: 好的！我会在你的地图上标出来。

entries.text: You know, you say that an Orc is the perfection of masculinity, 'big, strong, ugly, and mean.'
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，你说兽人是男子气概的完美体现，“高大、强壮、丑陋、卑鄙。”

entries.text: J'zargo, we make for quite an initelligent pair.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格，我们是睿智的一组神偷。

entries.text: The Soul Cairn sounds like just the place I'd want to go on vacation. Can't wait.
entries.translated_text: 灵魂石冢听起来就是我想去度假的地方。等不及了。

entries.text: Boethiah's faithful would kill you if it meant even a small slice of glory in their mind, so yes. Yeah... it did.
entries.translated_text: 波耶西亚的忠实信徒会杀了你，如果这在他们心目中意味着哪怕是很小的荣耀，所以是的。是的……确实如此。

entries.text: Good thinking, with the charcoal and paper.
entries.translated_text: 好思路，用木炭和纸。

entries.text: I can tell by how you say it that it's a bad thing.
entries.translated_text: 从你的说法我可以看出这是一件坏事。

entries.text: Surely this must be akin to a feast for these people?
entries.translated_text: 对这些人来说，这肯定是一场盛宴吧？

entries.text: Yes, I think that last guard we saw was a little suspicious of us.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我认为我们看到的上一个守卫对我们有点怀疑。

entries.text: Oh, are you implying that I'm stronger than Xel? Don't worry; I won't tell him.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你是在暗示我比塞尔强吗？不用担心；我不会告诉他的。

entries.text: This one is staying. This is definitely the third one.
entries.translated_text: 这一个留着了，这绝对就是第三个。

entries.text: I-The Gourmet really needs me, their assistant! I... cut vegetables and-and hand them spoons, and-ah...
entries.translated_text: 我——美食家真的很需要我，他们的助理!我...切蔬菜，递勺子，还有...

entries.text: Do you mean to tell me the Nords have gained horse and cart technology? By the Gods! They're practically Dwarves.
entries.translated_text: 你是说诺德人已经获得了马和车的技术了吗？天哪！他们不会是矮人吧。

entries.text: This lever isn't staying put. I think it's the wrong one. I suppose we'll have to start over.
entries.translated_text: 那些拉杆全部复位了，我们应该搞错了。我想我们得从头来过。

entries.text: Time to head out, Ria?
entries.translated_text: 是时候出发了，利亚？

entries.text: How dare they take Scrap?! If there's a hair out of place...! Well, he doesn't have hair. But the point remains!
entries.translated_text: 他们怎么敢带走小渣？如果他有哪怕一根头发出了问题.....！好吧，他没有头发。但重点还是一样！

entries.text: I can't believe you do that on purpose.
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信你是主动的。

entries.text: Alright, get ready to lose that staff, Sam!
entries.translated_text: 好了，山姆，准备好输掉法杖吧！

entries.text: Just... Try not to drop it on me. Ohhhhh, being crushed is the absolute worst way to die!
entries.translated_text: 只是...尽量不要把它丢在我身上，啊啊啊啊，我不想被石头压死！

entries.text: That fancy talkin' bloke from Wayrest, smelled like lillies, looked like an asshole, but assholes pay well.
entries.translated_text: 一个来自途歇城的滑头，闻起来像百合花，看起来像个混蛋，但他给的报酬很高。

entries.text: We're off to dig around in the rubble of the house, then? Will anything be left? No one has picked it over? Is that not something everyone does?
entries.translated_text: 我们要去挖房子的废墟吗？还能剩下什么吗？没人翻过吗？这不是每个人都会做的吗？

entries.text: That sounds wonderful right about now. Anything other than this cold.
entries.translated_text: 现在听起来很棒，什么都比这里的严寒好。

entries.text: (Gasp) Is this...? Where did you find this vintage?! How did you afford- Oh!
entries.translated_text: （惊叹）这是......？你在哪儿找到这个古董的？你怎么买得起-欧！

entries.text: O-okay. If you think that's for the best.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你觉得这样最好的话。

entries.text: Well, it appears you did not wake up murderer, either. I suppose our new pirate friend really isn't a killer.
entries.translated_text: 看来你清醒时也不是个杀人犯。我想我们的新海盗朋友真的不是凶手。

entries.text: Let's not make this awkward, now.
entries.translated_text: 我们可别让这变得尴尬了。

entries.text: Ugh...
Ugh...
I don't really understand how you thought I wouldn't notice. Did you really have to take them *all*, though?
entries.translated_text: 我真的不明白你怎么会以为我不会注意到。不过，你真的非得全都拿吗？

entries.text: You don't understand because you're not a Nord.
entries.translated_text: 你不明白，因为你不是诺德人。

entries.text: No, I think it'll be fun!
entries.translated_text: 不，我想这会很有趣！

entries.text: Look for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel (Unique Gyro Found)
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔(发现独特的陀螺仪)中寻找有趣的文物

entries.text: And I do a little potion brewing on the side.
entries.translated_text: 我在旁边做了一点药水酿造。

entries.text: And I do a little potion brewing on the side.
entries.translated_text: 我还顺带酿制一些药剂。

entries.text: That's... That's good. Good. Um. Well. I just... I might have. Questions.
entries.translated_text: 那...那很好，很好。嗯，好吧，我只是...我可能有些问题。

entries.text: You really shouldn't be fighting me or Doctor!
entries.translated_text: 你真的不应该和我或医生战斗！

entries.text: There's a ruin in Skyrim I visited before meeting you. I never got to fully explore it. Perhaps one day you will take me?
entries.translated_text: 在遇见你之前，我曾经去过天际省的一处遗迹，但我从未能完全探索过那里。也许有一天你能带我去吗？

entries.text: Of course! I think I'll get one, too. A nice apple juice sounds lovely.
entries.translated_text: 当然我想我也要买一杯，苹果汁听起来就不错。

entries.text: I'll be fine.
entries.translated_text: 我没事。

entries.text: As long as you're doing this for your reasons, not just hers.
entries.translated_text: 只要你是出于自己的原因去做，而不仅仅是为了她。

entries.text: I know you can hear me!
entries.translated_text: 我知道你听得到我！

entries.text: Don't keep me waiting.
entries.translated_text: 不要让我久等。

entries.text: At least, so long as we don't get caught. So let's make sure to stay sneaky, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 至少，前提是我们不被抓到，所以，咱们得保持隐秘，小心行事，对吧？

entries.text: You... You've been in Nchuand-Zel?!
entries.translated_text: 你...你去过楚安德-泽尔？！

entries.text: Keep a hand on your coin purse here.
entries.translated_text: 把手摸在你的钱包上。

entries.text: No way!
entries.translated_text: 没门！

entries.text: 500 Gold.
Generally, I like a bit of spookiness. Ghosts and creepy mysteries are interesting. Caves are only spooky. Nothing interesting to it.
entries.translated_text: 总的来说，我喜欢诡异。鬼魂和令人毛骨悚然的谜团很有趣。洞穴只是令人毛骨悚然。没什么有趣的。

entries.text: Oh, look what you've done now! You can't just run into people like that! The potion I was making... It's all over you now!
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看你现在干的好事！你不能就这么撞到别人！我正在制作的药剂...现在全洒你身上了！

entries.text: Real Nord Food
entries.translated_text: 真正的诺德食物

entries.text: Plus, you did teach me how to read. Far as I'm concerned, we're even. But I appreciate it, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 另外，你确实教了我如何阅读。就我而言，我们是平等的人。但我很感激，蕾米。

entries.text: Mmmm, okay. I'll do my best.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，好吧。我将尽我所能。

entries.text: I don't know. I regret murdering them.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，我后悔杀了他们。

entries.text: We're still going, aren't we?
entries.translated_text: 我们还得去，不是吗？

entries.text: Buffy, I was hoping to talk to you. I need you to settle a debate. Er, well. Maybe later. What did you need?
entries.translated_text: 巴非，我想和你谈谈。我需要你解决一场辩论，呃，好吧，也许得以后。你需要什么？

entries.text: Valenwood.
entries.translated_text: 威木省。

entries.text: What is that...?
entries.translated_text: 那是什么...？

entries.text: You like them?
entries.translated_text: 你喜欢他们吗？

entries.text: Well, I know that it was located somewhere in modern-day Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我知道它位于现代天际的某个地方。

entries.text: Ysolda makes it sound as though this wedding ceremony was so beautiful. It's really a shame I can't recall it.
entries.translated_text: 伊索尔达让这场婚礼听起来很浪漫，真遗憾，我想不起来了。

entries.text: Dunmer consider Boethiah a 'good' daedra. Us Bretons... not so much. She champions betrayal. I'm certainly not a fan, at least.
entries.translated_text: 丹莫认为波耶希亚是一个“好”的魔族。我们布莱顿人...不这么认为。她支持背叛。至少我不是祂的信徒。

entries.text: Okay, Ubbe! We can do this!
entries.translated_text: 好的，乌贝！我们能做到！

entries.text: It's okay if you'd rather write it out. It gives me a chance to write in comments and corrections to your logic.
entries.translated_text: 如果你愿意把它写出来也没关系。这样我就可以对评论你的逻辑并修正它。

entries.text: Between the Silver-Bloods and the Forsworn, sometimes I wonder if it wouldn't be better to set fire to Markarth and start fresh.
entries.translated_text: 在银血家族和弃誓者之间选的话，有时我在想，放火烧掉马卡斯然后重新开始，岂不更好？

entries.text: Of course not.
entries.translated_text: 当然不是。

entries.text: Talk to Remi again after leaving Nchuand-Zel
entries.translated_text: 离开楚安德-泽尔后再次与蕾米对话

entries.text: What is it? Not fond of vampires?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？不喜欢吸血鬼吗？

entries.text: Ah, you're wanting to discuss the philosophical underpinnings of dwemer law, aren't you? That's why you're talking with me? Don't deny it!
entries.translated_text: 啊，你想锻莫法律的哲学基础，不是吗？所以你才和我说话？不要否认！

entries.text: Which isn't a lot, but it's still strange that it's happened twice.
entries.translated_text: 虽然次数不多，但发生两次仍然很奇怪。

entries.text: It's not an excuse! It's a legitimate reason! I've tried reading spell tomes; it just doesn't work.
entries.translated_text: 这不是借口！这就是正当的理由！我试过读法术书，就是没用。

entries.translated_text: 雇佣兵
