entries.translated_text: 雇佣兵

entries.text: Hired Mercenary
entries.translated_text: 雇佣兵

entries.text: So, between the theft and the murder, do you pirates dine like kings? Or is all the space on the ship taken up by the gold?
entries.translated_text: 那么，在不杀人和偷窃时，你们海盗会像国王一样宴饮吗？还是你们船上的地方都装满了金子？

entries.text: All the time.
entries.translated_text: 一直都是。

entries.text: Windhelm
entries.translated_text: 风舵城

entries.text: Relieved that someone's making sure I don't get myself killed, and relieved that I'm better at picking out friends.
entries.translated_text: 真是松了一口气，幸好有人能保护我，和你做朋友真幸运。

entries.text: Agreed. I rely on my sword, not some bizarre corpse ritual.
entries.translated_text: 同意了。我依靠的是我的剑，而不是什么奇怪的尸体仪式。

entries.text: You'll regret trying to make us your prey!
entries.translated_text: 你会后悔让我们成为你的猎物！

entries.text: I tend to prefer more academic texts, but I also love a good adventure story. I suppose I just can't get enough of adventuring, huh?
entries.translated_text: 我更喜欢学术性较强的文章，但我也喜欢好的冒险故事。我想我就是对冒险欲罢不能，是吧？

entries.text: We've shared quite a series of adventures, and I'm glad to be at your side.
entries.translated_text: 我们一起经历了许多冒险，我很高兴能与你并肩而行。

entries.text: (Whisper) Quick, while Brynjolf is marketing his magic fairy potions or whatever. Plant the ring!
entries.translated_text: （低语）快，布林乔夫正在推销他的魔法药水或其他什么，快偷走戒指！

entries.text: It's so difficult for me to memorize things that are terribly boring. Not that I think your worship is boring!
entries.translated_text: 对我来说，背诵那些枯燥得可怕的东西是如此困难。并不是说我认为你的信仰很枯燥!

entries.text: Markarth
entries.translated_text: 马卡斯城

entries.text: Pretty handy for while we're exploring ruins, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 在我们探索遗址时非常方便，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: Uhhhh... Okay, so 200 gold up front... AND whatever goods we find in the ruins are yours, okay? All I need is to look at them.
entries.translated_text: 呃...好吧，预付200金币...而且我们在遗址中找到的任何物品都是你的，好吗？我只需要看看它们。

entries.text: That's precisely the problem. It doesn't translate from text to reality.
entries.translated_text: 这正是问题所在。它不能从文字转化为现实。

entries.text: If you leave me here too long, Buffy, I will take no responsibility for the outcome.
entries.translated_text: 如果你把我留在这里太久了，巴非，我不会对结果负责。

entries.text: What are you going to use it for?
entries.translated_text: 你打算用它做什么？

entries.text: Are you out of your mind?
entries.translated_text: 你疯了吗？

entries.text: (Whispering) Yaz, be careful with how loud you're being. Falmer have superb hearing!
entries.translated_text: （低语）雅扎，小心你的声音。伐莫的听力超强!

entries.text: Let's see if this innkeeper won't give us a discount.
entries.translated_text: 让我们看看这个旅馆老板是否不给我们打折。

entries.text: I wonder what my sister would think of my adventures? We've killed so many things. Do you think she'll notice my new muscles? You see them, right?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道我姐姐会怎么看待我的冒险？我们杀了这么多人。你觉得她会注意到我的新肌肉吗？你看到了，对吧？

entries.text: We'll find out.
entries.translated_text: 我们会知道的。

entries.text: I think Auri is a lovely singer.
entries.translated_text: 我认为奥璃是一位可爱的歌手。

entries.text: Oh, that's Bosmeri, isn't it? Jagga, that is.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那是波兹莫食物，不是吗？贾嘎，就是这样。

entries.text: Four thieves to steal a Lexicon from an ancient Dwemer city. I can't imagine why they thought it'd end well.
entries.translated_text: 四个小偷从一个古老的锻莫城市偷了一本方典。我实在想不出他们为什么会觉得这会有好结果。

entries.text: He wouldn't say. Just that he was a friend of yours.
entries.translated_text: 他没有说。只是他是说是你的朋友。

entries.text: A real piece of processed Aetherium! And the dwemer used it just for a key! Just how much Aetherium did they have access to, to use it so trivially?
entries.translated_text: 真正的加工过的神光水晶！而锻莫只是拿它当钥匙！他们到底弄到了多少神光水晶，用得这么随意？

entries.text: Well, off to the College we go.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们去学院。

entries.text: Imagine living here, under the blue glow of giant fungi and a strange, fake Sun. Actually, what is that orange sphere over the city, anyway?
entries.translated_text: 想象一下生活在这里，在巨大真菌的蓝色光芒和一个奇怪的假太阳下。实际上，这座城市上空的橙色球体到底是什么？

entries.text: Let's do it! Remind me every now and then to tell you our profits.
entries.translated_text: 我们开张吧！我会时不时提醒我告诉你我们的利润。

entries.text: Remember, I'm an Argonian now.
entries.translated_text: 记住，我现在是亚龙人了。

entries.text: Wait for Remi to make the Chaurus Pie.
entries.translated_text: 等蕾米做巢蚁薄饼。

entries.text: She's a painter. Wayrest is already a gem, but her art makes it look like something out of Aetherius.
entries.translated_text: 她是一名画家。维雷斯特本就是一颗明珠，而她的艺术让它看起来仿佛来自艾瑟瑞斯。

entries.text: She's a painter. Wayrest is already a gem, but her art makes it look like something out of Aetherius.
entries.translated_text: 她是个画家。是途歇城的艺术已经是一颗明珠，但她的艺术更胜一筹。

entries.text: Oh! Farillae is such a pretty name! I knew someone named 'Ella' growing up. Your name is a bit more fun, though.
entries.translated_text: 哦！法里拉可真是个好名字！我从小就认识一个叫“艾拉”的人。不过，你的名字更有趣一些。

entries.text: You win! It was apparent Lisbet did not know the value of what she had. They were just laying out on a table. And now they're for you!
entries.translated_text: 你赢了！很明显，利斯拜特并不知道她所拥有的东西的价值。它们就摆在桌子上，现在它们是给你的！

entries.text: No, adventurer, I want to see more of the world.
entries.translated_text: 不，冒险者，我想看到更多的世界。

entries.text: I can only imagine what vampire blood would add to its potency...
entries.translated_text: 我就想吸血鬼的血会增加它的效力...

entries.text: We? No, no, I'm staying here to figure out how the chandelier works. You're off to find the Aetherium.
entries.translated_text: 我们？不，不，我要留在这里，弄清楚吊灯是如何工作的。是你去找。

entries.text: It must be so creepy at night, living in a swamp. I'm almost envious of these people.
entries.translated_text: 住在沼泽里，晚上一定很毛骨悚然，我有点羡慕这些人。

entries.text: Well, I didn't die, so they couldn't have been that bad, right?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我还没有死，所以它们不可能不那么糟糕，对吧？

entries.text: He's offered to send me anything that doesn't sell, so long as we're able to pay for its transportation to us.
entries.translated_text: 他提出，只要我们能够支付其运费，就可以把卖不出去的东西送给我。

entries.text: Did you need something, Buffy?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，巴非？

entries.text: Let's see...
entries.translated_text: 让我们看看...

entries.text: Creepy children? Doesn't get much better than that.
entries.translated_text: 对付胆小的孩子？没有比这更好的了。

entries.text: But you weren't heretics.
entries.translated_text: 但你并不是异端。

entries.text: Being a bard looks like so much fun. Too bad I'm no good at singing.
entries.translated_text: 成为吟游诗人看起来很有趣，可惜我唱歌不好。

entries.text: But if you ever need proof the Gods aren't perfect, look up to the sky an night.
entries.translated_text: 但是，如果你想证明众神并不完美，只需每晚抬头仰望天空。

entries.text: Don't worry, I'll reserve my excitement for truly impressive machines. I'm definitely not going to start fawning over just any random scrap metal.
entries.translated_text: 别担心，我会把兴奋留给真正令人印象深刻的机器。绝对不会对任何随便的废铁就开始如痴如醉。

entries.text: Fantastic idea because I'm very good.
entries.translated_text: 好主意，因为我很强。（Fantastic，F开头）

entries.text: This place really is lovely. No dangerous automaton, an observatory, a big open space...
entries.translated_text: 这个地方真的很可爱，没有危险的机器人，有一个天文台和片大空地...

entries.text: Well... It works. I'm not sure that it was worth the mental scarring of having to disable my own precious, perfect automaton.
entries.translated_text: 好它起作用了。我不确定这是否值得让我自己宝贵又完美的机器人因此关机从而留下精神创伤。

entries.text: After powering up Arkngchal, the door allowing me to progress became stuck. Remi has relayed to me her 'notes' on how to make a metal lubricant, although she apparently cannot read her handwriting. Going off her drawings, she's informed me to mix together "three golden bowls" and "two grey ferns" in the cauldron.
entries.translated_text: 给阿卡切尔供能后，前进的门被卡住了。蕾米向我转述了她写的如何制作金属润滑剂的 "笔记"，尽管她显然看不懂自己的笔迹。根据她的图纸，她告诉我把 "三个金碗 "和 "两个灰色蕨类 "混合在大锅里。

entries.text: Well, I'm a writer. I write things.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我是一个作家。我会写点东西。

entries.text: I'll talk to you later, my love.
entries.translated_text: 稍后我会和你谈谈，我的爱人。

entries.text: Let's just you and I head inside. Please. This is... personal for me.
entries.translated_text: 就让我们两个进去吧。拜托了。这对我来说...是私事。

entries.text: Why aren't you testing it?
entries.translated_text: 你为什么不测试它？

entries.text: Oh. Fair enough. Well, if we find ourselves with free time, maybe we can revisit this topic.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，算你有道理。嗯，如果我们有空的话，也许可以再讨论这个话题。

entries.text: I'm glad you understand, then.
entries.translated_text: 那我很高兴你能理解。

entries.text: Well.... Let's just call it a locator.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我们就叫它定位器吧。

entries.text: Val, were you able to convince anyone to buy that junk I gave to Remi?
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔，你能说服别人买我给蕾米的垃圾吗？

entries.text: Well, now that you mention it...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，既然你提到了...

entries.text: Look at this! This is what stopped me from exploring this ruin completely in the first place!
entries.translated_text: 快看这个！这是阻碍我对遗址进一步探索的原因！

entries.text: Ugh, somethin' about... Er, Morvic? Didn't get the family name; didn't care.
entries.translated_text: 呃，叫...呃，莫维克？我不知道他的姓氏，我不关心这个。

entries.text: If we could find some Sweet Gnocchi, that'd be great.
entries.translated_text: 如果我们能找到一些甜食团子，那就太好了。

entries.text: A profit...? I-I... You- But- If you were there, then-
entries.translated_text: 赚钱......？我...你-但是-如果你在那里的话-

entries.text: I feel a little bad for them... But not that bad.
entries.translated_text: 我为他们感到有点难过……好吧也没那么难过啦。

entries.text: I feel a little bad for them... But not that bad.
entries.translated_text: 我为他们感到有点难过……好吧也没那么难过啦。

entries.text: Those in town regarded him with distrust. After all, how could they trust a man who consorted with the undead so willingly?
entries.translated_text: 城里的人不信任他。毕竟，他们怎么可能信任一个与亡者结盟的男人？

entries.text: I can't imagine a father not encouraging their child to pursue their passions.
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象一个父亲会不支持他们的孩子去追求他们的梦想。

entries.text: Step lightly, and stay alert.
entries.translated_text: 脚步轻快，保持警觉。

entries.text: I'm not too bad with a dagger.
entries.translated_text: 我匕首用的还行。

entries.text: I'm not too bad with a dagger.
entries.translated_text: 我匕首用的还行。

entries.text: Honestly I did wonder whether a horker tusk would get the metaphor across more effectively.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我确实在想，用海象的尖牙是否能更有效地表达这个隐喻。

entries.text: Well, Scrap is quite magical, but he's not really a 'magic' spider. He's a Dwemer spider!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，小渣的确很神奇，但他不是真正的 "魔法 "蜘蛛。他是一只锻莫蜘蛛!

entries.text: Instead of stumbling through the dark and tripping over everything, I could stumble through the light and trip over everything!
entries.translated_text: 与其在黑暗中因为看不见跌跟头，不如在灯光下因为胡思乱想跌跟头！

entries.text: Great! Here we are. Now, that iron ingot, please?
entries.translated_text: 太好了！我们有了，现在，请问那个铁锭？

entries.text: I'll just let you strike the killing blows.
entries.translated_text: 我会让你死的痛快。

entries.text: Welcome home, love. It's been a long and exhausting trip. Are we... heading to bed?
entries.translated_text: 欢迎回家，亲爱的。真是一次漫长而疲惫的旅行，我们...要睡觉了吗？

entries.text: Good day!
entries.translated_text: 日安！（Good，G）

entries.text: Most people wouldn't like that facet.
entries.translated_text: 大多数人不会喜欢这个。

entries.text: Not likely- Unless you go out to the tavern with the thanes.
entries.translated_text: 不太可能-除非你和领主一起去酒馆。

entries.text: I'm curious about how this plot will work out. Won't it seem off that Gaius mysteriously turns up murdered with a letter about killing the emperor?
entries.translated_text: 我很好奇这个情节将如何发展。盖乌斯带着一封关于刺杀皇帝的信神秘地出现了，这看起来不是很奇怪吗？

entries.text: Oh...? Oh! (Chuckle) I'm on it. And I want to talk to you about a business opportunity later...
entries.translated_text: 哦......？我这就去办稍后我想和你谈谈一个商机...

entries.text: That definitely makes sense. You're so used to the quiet it must be jarring. Not to mention sometimes it's even lonelier around so many strangers.
entries.translated_text: 这确实很有道理。你已经习惯了安静的环境，所以那种嘈杂一定让人不适应。更别提，有时候身处一群陌生人中，反而会感到更加孤独。

entries.text: Arkngthamz? That was a center of research for several dwemer cities within the area the Nords call The Reach. Are...are we going?! Please say we are!
entries.translated_text: 阿肯塔兹？那是诺德人称之为边塞领的几个锻莫城市的研究中心。我们...我们要去吗？！求你了，说去！

entries.text: But the way you've stuck the gears... I never would have thought...
entries.translated_text: 但你插圆轮的方式...我真没想到...

entries.text: Not that again.
entries.translated_text: 又是这个。

entries.text: There is no plan. We forget this ever happened.
entries.translated_text: 没打算，忘记发生的事情吧。

entries.text: Oh, no I can't accept that.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，我不能接受。

entries.text: Wait just a moment! You- You've made the conversation about me, when I meant it to be about you and your intelligence!
entries.translated_text: 等一下！你——你把谈话变成了关于我，而我本来是想谈论你和你的智慧的！

entries.text: The results we see from our actions are purely positive: coin. We don't face the disappointment or anger from others.
entries.translated_text: 我们从行动中看到的结果纯粹是积极的：金币，而我们不会面对他人的失望或愤怒。

entries.text: You have a way of inspiring loyalty in unexpected places. I'm glad we're adventuring together, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 你有办法在意想不到的地方激发人们的忠诚。我很高兴我们能一起冒险，我的朋友。

entries.text: There's really no need for us to get involved, although having a purse full of rubies would be nice too.
entries.translated_text: 我们真的没有必要参与进来，尽管有一个装满红宝石的钱包确实很棒。

entries.text: Never mind, it doesn't matter. Listen, it's alright to be strange.
entries.translated_text: 没关系，没什么大不了。听着，古怪也没啥大不了。

entries.text: ...Oh. Oh, I see, you were being sarcastic. Um. You really can't read? That's... Er. I-I'm sorry?
entries.translated_text: …哦，我明白了，你在讽刺我。你真的不会读书吗？那...呃，对不起？

entries.text: Maybe so.
entries.translated_text: 也许吧。

entries.text: (Laugh) You know me too well. I'll treasure this gift.
entries.translated_text: （笑）你太了解我了，我会珍惜这份礼物。

entries.text: That fellow, there. Quick, before he walks too far! Do you suppose it's worth the effort? In your professional opinion, of course.
entries.translated_text: 那边那个人，快，在他走远之前！你觉得这值得一试吗？当然，是从你的专业角度来看。

entries.text: Here you go. Zora asked me to hand out drinks.
entries.translated_text: 给你。佐拉让我给每人发酒。

entries.text: Not really. I guess I should be more familiar, given where we are...
entries.translated_text: 并非如此，我想考虑到我们现在的位置，我应该更熟悉的...

entries.text: Don't tell me you're that naive.
entries.translated_text: 别告诉我你真那么天真。

entries.text: Yes, I guarantee it!
entries.translated_text: 是的，我保证！

entries.text: Reunion of the Fallen
entries.translated_text: 落魄户的重逢

entries.text: Maybe. How do they even move...?
entries.translated_text: 也许。他们如何移动...？

entries.text: Do you have any?
entries.translated_text: 你有吗？

entries.text: You really are dependable, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 你真的很可靠，不是吗？

entries.text: Maybe we'll learn something new together?
entries.translated_text: 也许我们会一起学习新的东西？

entries.text: Maybe we'll learn something new together?
entries.translated_text: 也许我们会一起学习新的东西？

entries.text: Three firewood for you.
entries.translated_text: 三根木柴给你。

entries.text: It's quite nice that Arkngchal didn't use automaton in its security protocol. It made it the ideal place for me to explore by myself.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴阿卡切尔没有在其安全协议中使用自动机器来大肆杀戮，这是我探索的理想场所。

entries.text: If Alva is a vampire, why would Hroggar want to be with her? Do you- Do you think he is a vampire, too, then? Is *everyone* here a vampire??
entries.translated_text: 如果阿尔瓦是吸血鬼，为什么赫鲁加想和她在一起？那你觉得他也是吸血鬼吗？这里每个人都是吸血鬼吗？

entries.text: I should set the metal rods at 45-degree angles for optimal support against the steam pressure, but would that leave enough space for the gears?
entries.translated_text: 我应该将金属杆设置为45度角，以获得最佳的蒸汽压力支撑，但这会为齿轮留出足够的空间吗？

entries.text: But I can see how you may not have been in the right frame of mind, given that Molag Bal was speaking to you.
entries.translated_text: 但我可以理解，鉴于和你说话的是莫拉格·巴尔，就能够理解了。

entries.text: You're not cut out to be a Companion.
entries.translated_text: 你不适合成为战友。

entries.text: You don't seem like a Thalmor?
entries.translated_text: 你看起来不像梭默？

entries.text: You can tell me.
entries.translated_text: 你可以告诉我。

entries.text: It sounds rather exciting, to sneak into an off-limits location and take something that will be watched fairly closely.
entries.translated_text: 潜入禁地，拿走严加保管的东西，这听起来相当刺激。

entries.text: Well, how about our little party of adventurers? Is it an... acceptable number of people?
entries.translated_text: 那我们的这支小小冒险队呢？这个人数...还算可以接受吗？

entries.text: Okay, where to now?
entries.translated_text: 好啦，现在去哪里？

entries.text: Solitude! I'm so happy to be in a proper city, even if it doesn't compare to Wayrest! Although, I suppose the Blue Palace is pretty.
entries.translated_text: 独孤城！我很高兴能在一个不错的城市，即使它比不上途歇城！虽然，我想蓝宫很漂亮。

entries.text: Between the speed you'll be shooting with and the-the *oomph* of my shots... We're unstoppable, Val!
entries.translated_text: 以你的射速和我的火力...我们是无敌的，瓦尔！

entries.text: But I've always wanted to have one for a pet. Can you imagine me riding into battle on a giant frostbite spider?
entries.translated_text: 但我一直想养一只宠物。你能想象我骑着一只巨大的霜噬蜘蛛参战吗？

entries.text: Yep! He was huge, too!
entries.translated_text: 是的！他也很大！

entries.text: Of course, worshipping non-daedra, like Talos, can make you into a target as well.
entries.translated_text: 当然，信仰非魔神，比如塔洛斯，也会让你成为猎杀目标。

entries.text: Just wanted to say I love you.
entries.translated_text: 只是想说我爱你。

entries.text: Have you seen these glow-y plants? They're very pretty. They don't taste too bad either, but... I think they're making me a little... paranoid.
entries.translated_text: 你见过这些发光的植物吗？他们非常漂亮。它们的味道也不太差，但是...我想它们让我有点...恐惧。

entries.text: Wha- Oh! Hello. Sorry, you startled me.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你好。对不起，你吓了我一跳。

texts: Well, I guess it's a good thing we're here, then.
那么，我想我们留在这里是件好事。

entries.text: Well, I guess it's a good thing we're here, then.
entries.translated_text: 那么，我想我们留在这里是件好事。

entries.text: Anyway, yes, moon sugar. D-don't tell anyone, but sometimes my father sends me some of his leftover stock. His, er, completely legal stock.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，是的，月亮糖。不要告诉任何人，但有时我父亲会把他剩下的存货寄给我一些。他的，呃，完全合法的存货。

entries.text: Wine.
entries.translated_text: 葡萄酒.

entries.text: Well, I didn't exactly cook this, but food is food, right?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我没有做这个，但食物就是食物，对吧？

entries.text: Well, beyond Thogra, of course.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，当然，除了托格拉之外。

entries.text: Yes, Skyrim is very different from High Rock, too. What's it like in Elsweyr, J'zargo?
entries.translated_text: 是的，天际与高岩也有很大不同。艾斯维尔那里的情况怎么样，吉'扎格？

entries.text: Oh yes. I'm a bit of a...
entries.translated_text: 哦是的。我有点...

entries.text: Oh yes. I'm a bit of a...
entries.translated_text: 哦是的。我是个...

entries.text: Alright, settle down and listen up. I've heard strange noises.
entries.translated_text: 好了，安静下来，听好了。我听到了奇怪的声音。

entries.text: So could you get me it? Like mean, or wine, or ale?
entries.translated_text: 那你能给我吗？像蜜酒，还是葡萄酒，还是麦酒？

entries.text: They said Avanchnzel is waiting... But it's more like it's readying itself. To fend off thieves and marauders. Like these guys.
entries.translated_text: 都说阿旺晨泽尔在等待...但更像是在准备自己。以抵挡小偷和掠夺者。就像这些家伙一样。

entries.text: (Laugh) Yes, well, in that case, maybe I wouldn't mind a few more scars if I can protect you, too.
entries.translated_text: （笑）是啊，这样说，如果我也能保护你的话，也许我不介意多一些伤疤。

entries.text: I know there's plenty more, but I think it's a good start to give you a brief tour.
entries.translated_text: 我知道还有很多，但我认为这是个好的开始，可以让你们简单了解一下。

entries.text: It's not 'delicious.' It's Divine, a gift of happiness made to be consumed, that will warm you and make you feel mildly sick but in a fulfilling way.
entries.translated_text: 这不是一般的美味。它是极品的享受，是圣灵的恩赐，它会让你感到温暖，虽然会让你感到轻微的不适，但是依旧充实满足。

entries.text: Did you need something Ilia?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，伊利亚？

entries.text: Well, the noise is hardly avoidable given how they function. They move with rotating pieces of metal, some steam power and some other power...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，考虑到它们的功能，噪音几乎是不可避免的。它们随着旋转的金属片、一些蒸汽动力和一些其他动力而移动……

entries.text: I figured with you being so much a Nord, Talos would be important to you, but you... worship Trinimac instead?
entries.translated_text: 我认为你是一个传统的诺德人，塔洛斯应该对你来说很重要，但你...反而信仰崔尼马克？

entries.text: Well, that's another Elder Scroll. A shame Valerica can't join us back in Tamriel, though.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，那是另一个上古卷轴，可惜瓦蕾莉卡不能和我们一起回到泰姆瑞尔。

entries.text: I read that Sotha Sil lost some parts of his factotums in this area. That was eras ago, though.
entries.translated_text: 我读到索萨·希尔在这方面失去了一些他的东西。不过那是很久以前的事了。

entries.text: I'll be here, Taz.
entries.translated_text: 我会在这里，塔兹。

entries.text: Do you suppose animated skeletons not only have the torture of being raised, but also the more benign torture of hearing their bones clanking?
entries.translated_text: 你认为被复生骷髅不仅有被复活的折磨，还会有听到骨头叮当作响的轻微折磨吗？

entries.text: Don't you miss the food from High Rock? You can get some Breton dishes here, of course, but it's not the same.
entries.translated_text: 你不怀念高岩的美食吗？当然，你是可以在这里吃到一些布莱顿菜肴，但那毕竟不一样。

entries.text: I mean... as much as anyone. Not a lot.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是...和别人一样。不是很多。

entries.text: Wow. I didn't know my hero was also my competition.
entries.translated_text: 哇！我不知道我的英雄也是我的竞争对手。

entries.text: 'My mind was in another place.' That's a good one. I'll need to remember it the next time I step in a trap.
entries.translated_text: “我刚才神游了。”这借口不错，下次我再踩到陷阱时得记得用上。

entries.text: and Argonians that seem so mysterious and dangerous, until you share a bond with one. They treat you better than their egg-siblings.
entries.translated_text: 还有看起来神秘又危险的亚龙人，当你真的和其中某人熟悉了后，你会发现他们对你比对他们的血缘上的兄弟姐妹还要好。

entries.text: I'm looking for information. You seem like the right sort to ask.
entries.translated_text: 我想了解一些信息，你似乎是合适的人选。

entries.text: <Sigh> No, it wasn't just the scandal. It was also... my fault.
entries.translated_text: <Sigh>不，这不仅仅是丑闻。这也是……我的错。

entries.text: I do not even know if there is a right thing. But thank you, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我甚至都不知道，是否真的有“对的话”这种东西。不过谢谢你，蕾米。

entries.text: A-a Minotaur? Those actually exist?! Oh, you have to tell me the story!
entries.translated_text: 一、一个牛头怪？这些生物真的存在？哦，你一定要给我讲讲这个故事。

entries.text: If it's you doing the planning, I can wait. But... Just not too long, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 如果是你还在做计划，我可以等待。但是……不要让我等太久，好吗？

entries.text: I wouldn't expect anything less from you, Auri.
entries.translated_text: 奥璃，我对你充满期望。

entries.text: Should've run while you could!
entries.translated_text: 趁你能跑前赶紧跑！

entries.text: I used to buy some goat's milk and take it up into the tree with me, and pretend I was having Jagga.
entries.translated_text: 我曾经买了一些羊奶，带着它到树上，假装我在吃贾嘎。

entries.text: Any time. I love seeing the fear in a merchant's eyes.
entries.translated_text: 任何时候，我都喜欢看到商人眼中的恐惧。

entries.text: Off we go, Suryvel.
entries.translated_text: 我们走吧，苏里维尔。

entries.text: Absolutely. Most bards in Skyrim only seem to bother with about six songs, and two of those are the same song with slightly altered lyrics.
entries.translated_text: 当然。天际中的大多数吟游诗人似乎只对六首歌曲感兴趣，而其中两首是同一首歌曲，只是歌词略有改动。

entries.text: The dwemer built this city? Impressive.
entries.translated_text: 这座城市是矮人建造的？真是让人印象深刻

entries.text: Any progress?
entries.translated_text: 有进展？

entries.text: Thorn, Scrap wanted me to tell you 'hello.' So, hello!
entries.translated_text: 荆棘，小渣想让我跟你说“你好”。所以，你好！

entries.text: Likewise. It's good to meet you, J'zargo.
entries.translated_text: 同样地。很高兴认识你，吉'扎格。

entries.text: Are we done talking, Doctor? Sometimes it's hard for me to tell.
entries.translated_text: 我们说完了吗，医生？有时我很难说。

entries.text: Check with the smuggler in Riften for any news about Remi's note.
entries.translated_text: 向裂谷城的走私者查询有关蕾米纸条的任何消息。

entries.text: Remi's Head
entries.translated_text: Remi'sHead

entries.text: I've figured it out!
entries.translated_text: 我想通了！

entries.text: And look at these living quarters... Very fancy. I think some high-brow dwemer lived here.
entries.translated_text: 看看这些生活区...非常漂亮，我想这里住着一些高尚的锻莫。

entries.text: I'd prefer it if ya' did.
entries.translated_text: 如果你愿意的话，我想我会更喜欢它。

entries.text: Joshua is going to kill you! You shouldn't have fought us!
entries.translated_text: 约书亚要杀了你！你不该和我们战斗！

entries.text: Be careful. Your face will get stuck, and then everyone will wonder why you're so angry.
entries.translated_text: 小心。你的脸会僵住，然后每个人都会问你为什么这么生气。

entries.text: There are rumours of skystones having once been located in Avanchnzel. They could be used to open doorways into Aetherius.
entries.translated_text: 有传言称天空之石曾经位于阿旺晨泽尔。它们可以用来打开通往艾瑟瑞斯的大门。

entries.text: Sometimes the things you say make no sense at all.
entries.translated_text: 有时你说的东西根本就没有意义。

entries.text: I'm so boooreddd. Adventurer, tell me something interesting! Give my brain something to chew on!
entries.translated_text: 我太难了。冒险者，告诉我一些有趣的事情！给我的大脑一些咀嚼的东西！

entries.text: The mysterious castle alone on an island has a spooky abandoned wing? How unsurprising. Oooh, maybe there will be ghosts?
entries.translated_text: 孤岛上的神秘城堡有一片废弃区域？多么不可思议。哦，也许里面会有鬼？

entries.text: I'd never join them.
entries.translated_text: 我永远不会加入他们。

entries.text: I know. I love you, too.
entries.translated_text: 我知道，我也爱你。

entries.text: If he's there, uh, you kill him, okay?
entries.translated_text: 如果他在那里，呃，你杀了他，好吗？

entries.text: Yes, here is one.
entries.translated_text: 是的，给你。

entries.text: Yes, because he's just a barely functioning bunch of scrap metal someone bolted together.
entries.translated_text: 是的，因为他只是一堆几乎没有功能的被用螺栓固定在一起的碎金属碎片。

entries.text: I'm sure someone in Riften will have some information.
entries.translated_text: 我相信裂谷城的人会知道一些信息。

entries.text: Solitude has so many exciting things going on!
entries.translated_text: 独孤城有这么多令人兴奋的事情发生！

entries.text: You know, there's just something about fire. It's so compelling to look at, to play with.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，这只是火灾的一部分。它让人相信，看，去和它玩。

entries.text: It's not that simple. I guess it never is with families, is it?
entries.translated_text: 这事没那么简单。家里的事总是一言难尽，你说对不对？

entries.text: Wouldn't a portable chandelier just be a lantern?
entries.translated_text: 便携式吊灯不就是一个灯笼吗？

entries.text: Okay, here goes... Sorry, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 好的，来这里...对不起，小渣。

entries.text: But if you think you like it, I won't disagree.
entries.translated_text: 但如果你认为你喜欢它，我是不会反驳你的。

entries.text: It's short for Numidium!
entries.translated_text: 它是纳米迪安的缩写！

entries.text: There is skill in magic, there is charm, and there is  strong will. J'zargo will be successful, of this there is no doubt.
entries.translated_text: 魔法中有技巧，有魅力，有坚强的意志。吉'扎格一定会成功，这一点毫无疑问。

entries.text: I don't know. But I'll be angry.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道。但我会很生气。

entries.text: Oooh! So you will do all the- the 'smooth-talking' parts, then? Really?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你说的“花言巧语”你都会做吗？真的吗？

entries.text: Revan and I will kill you! You've made a terrible mistake!
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦和我会杀了你！你犯了一个可怕的错误！

entries.text: ...What?! Don't look so annoyed! You offered.
entries.translated_text: ...什么？！不要看起来那么生气嘛！你答应了的。

entries.text: Not too bad. How about you?
entries.translated_text: 还不错。你呢？

entries.text: Oh, yes, being attacked by Dwarven Centurions is just so exciting! I'm glad we are of one mind on this!
entries.translated_text: 哦，对了，被矮人百夫长攻击实在是太刺激了!我很高兴我们在这方面意见一致!

entries.text: Super fun!
entries.translated_text: 超级好玩！

entries.text: And what does he mean by "purify"?
entries.translated_text: 他所说的“净化”是什么意思？

entries.text: You're familiar with tonal architecture, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 你熟悉不音律结构，是吗？

entries.text: Yeah, he doesn't think I'm girl-ish enough.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他认为我不够少女。

entries.text: Oh I can finally finish my book! I was just getting to the good part last time we left.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我终于可以读完我的书了！上次我们离开时，我才刚刚开始。

entries.text: Me either, but maybe if the weather is nice sometime, we can camp out?
entries.translated_text: 我也是，但如果天气好的话，我们可以露营吗？

entries.text: It doesn't hurt to look, though, does it? Shall we?
entries.translated_text: 不过，看起来没什么坏处，是吗？让我们试试？

entries.text: It doesn't hurt to look, though, does it? Shall we?
entries.translated_text: 不过，看起来没什么坏处，是吗？让我们试试？

entries.text: The people here must live in terror of the Forsworn, even more than before Madanach's escape. I do hope their fear is worth it for the Forsworn.
entries.translated_text: 这里的人们一定生活在对弃誓者的恐惧中，甚至比迈德纳奇逃跑前还要严重。我确实希望对于弃誓者来说，他们带来的恐惧是值得的。

entries.text: Really?! Oh, you won't regret this! I promise!
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？！哦，你不会后悔的！我保证！

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. We have explored Nchuand-zel together, following in the footsteps of a lost expedition. After reading through their journals, we've learned that the spider we killed, Nimhe, was the only thing keeping the falmer from invading Markarth from below. We need to reactivate Nchuand-zel's defenses to ensure the falmer are taken care of.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我们一起探索楚安德-泽尔，追随迷途探险的脚步。在阅读了他们的日记后，我们了解到我们杀死的蜘蛛尼姆赫是唯一阻止伐莫从下方入侵马卡斯城的东西。我们需要重新激活楚安德-泽尔的防御，以确保照顾好猎鹰。

entries.text: I don't answer to you, Serano.
entries.translated_text: 我不必向你回应，塞拉诺。

entries.text: Oooh, yes! Maybe some stew? Or some beef? Beef stew? Maybe a sweetroll to dip in it?
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的!也许一些炖菜？或者一些牛肉？炖牛肉？也许可以用甜卷蘸着吃？

entries.text: ;Asked about books
entries.translated_text: ;Askedaboutbooks

entries.text: We can have another contest! This way, everyone wins.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以再进行一次比赛！这样，每个人都赢了。

entries.text: What's this now?
entries.translated_text: 这又是什么？

entries.text: So now you can capture black souls indefinitely. I wonder how they'd work in powering dwemer machinery... You'll let me test it, right?
entries.translated_text: 所以现在你可以无限制地捕获黑色灵魂。我想知道他们如何为锻莫装置提供动力...你让我测试一下，好吗？

entries.text: I lose track of time so easily...
entries.translated_text: 我太易忘记时间了...

entries.text: For my sister, it was a coin flip every day whether or not we'd hate eacher other's guts. I think that's just how it is to have siblings.
entries.translated_text: 对于我姐姐来说，无论我们是否讨厌对方，每天都像抛硬币一样。我想这就是有兄弟姐妹的样子。

entries.text: You're picking a fight on Buffy? You're in for a rude awakening!
entries.translated_text: 和巴非战斗？你就等着瞧吧！

entries.text: Exactly! Suddenly, the whole world makes sense.
entries.translated_text: 确实！突然，整个世界变得有意义了。

entries.text: Hmm... You might have a point, actually. I'm not sure how I'd reach that particular audience, though.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...你说的也许有道理。不过，我不确定如何接触到这些特定的受众。

entries.text: Mmmm... Do you smell that? Let's see what they're cooking!
entries.translated_text: 嗯……你闻到了吗？让我们看看他们在做什么！

entries.text: Even though I wish I could understand somehow.
entries.translated_text: 尽管我希望我能以某种方式理解。

entries.text: Wait, why even bring it up, then? Oh well.
entries.translated_text: 等等，那为什么还要提出来呢？哦，好吧。

entries.text: I think I've seen a book titled 'ABCs For Barbarians' somewhere. Perhaps Gore would benefit from this?
entries.translated_text: 我想我在某处看过一本名为“野蛮人的ABC”的书。也许格雷能从中受益？

entries.text: Mines scare me just a bit... All sorts of stories of people being trapped after cave ins. Alone in the dark, slowly starving...
entries.translated_text: 矿洞让我有点害怕...各种关于塌方后被困的故事，一个人独自在黑暗中，慢慢挨饿...

entries.text: I admit, it sounds a little far-fetched, but isn't that the best kind of theory if proven correct?
entries.translated_text: 我承认，这听起来有点离谱，但如果这被证明是可行的，那不就是完美的理论吗？

entries.text: Now, Gore, you're someone who understands... people. Right?
entries.translated_text: 格雷，你现在是一个理解……群众的人。对吗？

entries.text: Well? How do you feel?
entries.translated_text: 真的？你感觉如何？

entries.text: Ooh, what do you have? Anything interesting? If you're lucky, I might give it back later.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你有什么？是什么有趣的东西吗？如果你运气好的话，我可能稍后会还给你。

entries.text: After progressing beyond the stuck door, Remi spotted something in the distance and ran off, leaving me behind. I need to figure out how to progress to reach her. There seems to be chests across from automaton statues, that seem strangely like some sort of offering. Perhaps the clue for what items to put into the chests might be found somewhere the Dwemer inhabitants worked on their machines?
entries.translated_text: 在进展到卡住的门之外，蕾米发现了远处有什么东西，然后跑开了，把我甩在后面。我需要弄清楚如何继续前进才能找到她。在机器人雕像的对面似乎有一些箱子，看起来很奇怪，像是某种祭品。也许在锻莫居民研究机器的地方，可以找到关于把什么东西放进箱子的线索？

entries.text: Oh! Woah, they're really getting under your skin, aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 哦！哇，他们真的很讨厌你，不是吗？

entries.text: See anything? It'll likely be some sort of generator. It would seem that it's not able to produce the steam that runs this place.
entries.translated_text: 看到什么了吗？它很可能是某种蒸汽发生器，但它似乎无法产生用于维持这个地方运行的蒸汽。

entries.text: Uh, yes, you sure did just give me rocks...
entries.translated_text: 呃，是的，你确实只 给了我石头...

entries.text: King Pelagius was a prince of Wayrest before High King of Skyrim. The mad king probably lost his mind after living in High Rock half his life.
entries.translated_text: 佩拉吉奥斯国王在天际至高王之前是途歇城王子，疯王大概是在高岩住了半辈子就疯了。

entries.text: Raven, you should really give Scrap a pat. I think it would make all of us happy.
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，你真的应该拍拍小渣，我认为这会让我们所有人都开心。

entries.text: I guess we'll just need to explore for ourselves later.
entries.translated_text: 我猜我们以后只能自己去探索了。

entries.text: Remi has been thinking of a new project, and it has something to do with Tonal Magic. She's not sure where to begin, but she thinks if we can find a book with more information, she might be able to get an idea of what to do. She thinks the book I found her might be what she needs. I just need to wait for her to finish reading it.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米一直在考虑一个新项目，这与音调魔法有关。她不知道从哪里开始，但她认为如果我们能找到一本包含更多信息的书，她可能会知道该怎么做。她认为我找到她的书可能是她需要的。我只需要等她看完。

entries.text: That was a very strange night with Sam, but I can't say I didn't have fun.
entries.translated_text: 和山姆在一起的那个晚上非常奇怪，但我玩的很开心。

entries.text: I suppose you are a bit tall. I imagine I could spot you in a crowd. Although I'm not sure that it's due to eccentricity *or* charm.
entries.translated_text: 我想你有点高，我想我在人群中能认出你，虽然我不确定这是因为古怪还是魅力。

entries.text: Mm, that actually sounds really good. So... in Valenwood, you guys must do a lot of hunting, then?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这听起来真的很好喝。所以...在威木省，你们会经常打猎，然后？

entries.text: Sweet and simple. Thank you!
entries.translated_text: 甜美又简单，谢谢你！

entries.text: That's how it is in High Rock, too. Except it's not just the mages.
entries.translated_text: 高岩也是，只不过不只是法师这样。

entries.text: Quickly?! Not in my experience. I've spent hours with Centurions.
entries.translated_text: 快？！我的经历却不是这样。我曾花上几小时与百夫长们周旋过。

entries.text: Oh, great, that seems to have been the second one.
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了，那应该是第二个。

entries.text: Okay, I'll order something 'healthy' for dinner, but then I'll just get myself dessert before we retire for the night.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我会点一些“健康”的晚餐，但我会在晚上休息前给自己准备甜点。

entries.text: Bring the Shipment back to the Smuggler.
entries.translated_text: 将货物带回走私者那里。

entries.text: I'm rather enjoying killing them. Very heroic.
entries.translated_text: 我很喜欢杀他们。非常有英雄气概。

entries.text: You have a way of inspiring loyalty in unexpected places.
entries.translated_text: 你总是能在意想不到的地方激发出忠诚。

entries.text: But mom, it's so boring.
entries.translated_text: 但是妈妈，这太无聊了。

entries.text: Don't you just love dwemer ruins?!
entries.translated_text: 你难道不觉得锻莫遗址超棒吗？！

entries.text: Aaaaand... through!
entries.translated_text: 然...后...过来了！

entries.text: Wow, look at how these machines are built! They're so efficient; the dwemer who lived here had a unique technique. This gives me some ideas...
entries.translated_text: 哇，看这些机器是怎么造出来的！他们非常有效率；住在这里的锻莫有着独特的技术，这给了我一些灵感...

entries.text: Wow, look at how these machines are built! They're so efficient; the dwemer who lived here had a unique technique. This gives me some ideas...
entries.translated_text: 哇，看这些机器是怎么造出来的！他们非常有效率；住在这里的锻莫有着独特的技术，这给了我一些灵感...

entries.text: Wow, look at how these machines are built! They're so efficient; the dwemer who lived here had a unique technique. This gives me some ideas...
entries.translated_text: 哇，看这些机器是怎么造出来的！他们非常有效率；住在这里的锻莫有着独特的技术，这给了我一些灵感...

entries.text: Skyrim's cities are nice and all, but do they walk?
entries.translated_text: 天际的城市很不错，但他们会走路吗？

entries.text: Have you seen some of these plants? I've been picking all I can see, but I'm running out of room for samples...
entries.translated_text: 你见过这些植物吗？我一直在挑选我需要的东西，但我的样品已经用完了...

entries.text: Lorkhan for us in High Rock is known better as Sheor. He's called the 'Bad Man', so you might see how this is not a good thing.
entries.translated_text: 在高岩，洛克汗对我们来说被称为舒奥尔。他被称为“恶棍”，所以你可能会明白这不是一件好事。

entries.text: When I sense someone is in danger, I forget about my own fears. It's about protecting my liege, and you.
entries.translated_text: 当我感觉到有人处于危险中时，我会忘记自己的恐惧。这是为了保护我的朋友，还有你。

entries.text: 'They have wild magic, Remiel, and they can just as soon sacrifice you as heal you.' That's what my father told me.
entries.translated_text: '他们有荒野魔法，蕾米尔，他们能献祭你，也能治愈你'。这是我父亲告诉我的。

entries.text: We stopped Ancano.
entries.translated_text: 我们阻止了安卡诺。

entries.text: I've never been good at magic myself, but I am an excellent archer.
entries.translated_text: 我自己从来都不擅长魔术，但我是一名出色的弓箭手。

entries.text: The skies in Rivenspire are rarely clear, and that night was no exception. Rodard stole through the shadows, feet silent and sword deadly.
entries.translated_text: 碎裂山峰的天空少有晴天，那天晚上也不例外。罗达德遁入隐形，悄无声息，剑意沸腾。

entries.text: Oh, that rhymes, actually!
entries.translated_text: 哦，其实还挺押韵的！

entries.text: So... When you say 'conscripted', what do you mean?
entries.translated_text: 所以...你说的“应征入伍”是什么意思？

entries.text: Maybe it's conductive with it. Dwemer metal is strange like that.
entries.translated_text: 也许它能导电。矮人金属就是这么奇怪。

entries.text: Well, shouldn't that alone prove you're quite the mage? Why wouldn't people see you as one?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，单凭这一点就应该证明你是个相当了得的法师了吧？为什么人们看不出来你是一名法师呢？

entries.text: Now, Forsworn are a bit interesting. Briarhearts, for example. How do they work? Why does a briarheart make people more powerful?
entries.translated_text: 弃誓者现在是有点有趣，就像荆棘之心。这是如何奏效的？为什么荆棘之心让人更强大？

entries.text: I suppose we do have enough world to see where we are, after all.
entries.translated_text: 毕竟，我想我们确实有足够的世界来看到我们在哪里。

entries.text: Oh most definitely. You didn't really believe I'd be satisfied with seeing just one ruin, did you?
entries.translated_text: 哦，最肯定的。你不会真的相信我会满足于只看到一处遗址吧？

entries.text: Well. At least we lived, right, Yaz?
entries.translated_text: 好吧。至少我们还活着，对吗，雅扎？

entries.text: Oh, the cities aren't that hard to say! It's just how their language formed! Perhaps they didn't see the need for vowels, as they tend to be implied.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这些城市的名字其实并不难念！只是他们的语言就是那样发展起来的！也许他们觉得没必要使用元音，因为元音往往是隐含的。

entries.text: Well. Yes.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，是的。

entries.text: Wait, are we distributing prostitution adverts? What if they think we're the ones who are offering such services?
entries.translated_text: 等等，我们在散发卖淫广告吗？如果他们认为我们是提供这种服务的人怎么办？

entries.text: Yes, well, fools or not, they're more than capable of running me through with a sword.
entries.translated_text: 是的，好吧，不管是不是傻子，他们完全有能力用剑刺穿我。

entries.text: Take Remi to see four dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 带着蕾米去看四个矮人遗迹。

entries.text: Help me...?
Let's stop this line of thought.
entries.translated_text: 我们别说了。

entries.text: It's very peaceful. When I was little, I often went into the woods to collect flowers.
entries.translated_text: 这里很安宁。当我小的时候，我经常去树林里采花。

entries.text: Books and exploration and experimentation.
entries.translated_text: 准确来说是通过书籍和探索和实验。

entries.text: Books and exploration and experimentation.
entries.translated_text: 准确来说是通过书籍、探索和实验。

entries.text: (Laughing) Oh, thank the Divines! I was afraid you'd actually *like* this book. Don't worry, Gore, I have plenty more interesting for you to read.
entries.translated_text: （笑）哦，谢谢圣灵！我担心你真的会喜欢这本书。别担心，格雷, 我有很多有趣的东西要你读。

entries.text: What was growing up in Wayrest like?
entries.translated_text: 在途歇城长大是怎样的？

entries.text: I'll just mold it just so...
entries.translated_text: 我只要把它塑造成这样...

entries.text: (Clears Throat)
entries.translated_text: （清嗓子）

entries.text: Is that...? No, the Snow Elves are all...
entries.translated_text: 就是它...？不，那些雪精灵都是...

entries.text: Let's... let's go.
entries.translated_text: 我们...走吧。

entries.text: At this point, I'm just here with you so I don't die while exploring ruins.
entries.translated_text: 在这一点上，我只是在这里暂时和你在一起，所以我不会陪着你在探索遗迹时去死。

entries.text: Took me a long time to realize that they were just playing around, placing bets on who could make me do the dumbest thing.
entries.translated_text: 我花了很长时间才意识到，他们只是在玩弄我，打赌看谁能让我做出最愚蠢的事。

entries.text: I could tell you a thousand stories of the glory days, but most of them only remind me of how it ended, and what we lost.
entries.translated_text: 我能告诉你很多我们过去的光辉历史，但他们只会让我想起我们最后的结局，以及我们失去的东西。

entries.text: So they're sending the new students to wander around a dangerous ruin and find dangerous magical artifacts?
entries.translated_text: 所以他们要派新学生在危险的遗址中四处游荡，寻找危险的魔法物品？

entries.text: I like to think I have a strong constitution, but there's no way I can watch you... *skin* him. By the Eight...
entries.translated_text: 我自认为自己心理素质挺强的，但绝对没法看着你……剥他的皮，八圣灵在上...

entries.text: I'm sure all the other bards will be terribly envious that you got to commit Ghost regicide. Or maybe they'll just want to write a song about you.
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定，所有其他吟游诗人都会非常嫉妒你弑杀了一位幽灵王，或者他们只是想写一首关于你的歌。

entries.text: Do you have any potions made?
entries.translated_text: 你有制作药水吗？

entries.text: Nords are just predictable that way.
entries.translated_text: 诺德人的性格就是这样。

entries.text: I'm so excited for you! And for me! You *have* to tell me stories like that more often, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我真为你感到兴奋！也为我自己！你一定要更常跟我讲这样的故事，好吗？

entries.text: ;talked to Remi after marriage ceremony
entries.translated_text: ;婚礼结束后与蕾米交谈

entries.text: I think I might have been talking sarcastically again. But at least things are usually over quickly with Centurions.
entries.translated_text: 我想我可能又在说反话了。不过至少和百夫长们打交道通常很快就结束了。

entries.text: (Coughing)
entries.translated_text: （咳嗽）

entries.text: (Laughing) Yes, I do believe I am. Anyway, convenient idiots? Different idiots every time, or the same idiots?
entries.translated_text: （笑）是的，我想时这样。不管怎样，你说用起来方便的白痴？每次都是不同的白痴，还是同样的白痴？

entries.text: Hi, Farillae. What did you need?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，法里拉。你需要什么？

entries.text: Markarth used to be called Nchuand-Zel, back when the dwemer were still around. When they vanished, the Reachmen moved in.
entries.translated_text: 马卡斯城曾经被称为楚安德-泽尔，那时锻莫还在。当他们消失时，边塞人来到了这里。

entries.text: ...Uh, I should clarify that the irony in my statement was unintentional.
entries.translated_text: ......呃，我得澄清一下，我话里的讽刺意味是无心的。

entries.text: You know, I've discovered in my experiments that... Some wires shouldn't be crossed.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我在实验中发现...有些线路不应该交叉。

entries.text: You know, I've discovered in my experiments that... Some wires shouldn't be crossed.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我在实验中发现...有些电线不应该交叉。

entries.text: You're back! Oh, thank the Divines! I couldn't stop picturing you chained to a wall, getting the living shit kicked out of you by Thalmor cronies.
entries.translated_text: 你回来了！哦，感谢各位圣灵！我一直忍不住想象你被锁在墙上，被那些梭默爪牙打得半死的样子。。

entries.text: Ah! Ganbald, something is attacking us! Again!
entries.translated_text: 啊！甘巴尔德，有什么东西又在攻击我们！

entries.text: Oh, you can't even imagine! I don't know how you guessed, but his breath always smelled uniquely terrible. Like sour milk?
entries.translated_text: 哦，你都无法想象！我不知道你是怎么猜到的，但他的口气总是有一种独特的恶臭。像酸奶味？

entries.text: Why would it be shiny? Anyway, I think now's as good a time to test it as any. Bottoms up!
entries.translated_text: 为什么会有光泽？无论如何，我认为现在是测试它的好时机。喝光！

entries.text: What am I supposed to do with these dwemer artifacts?
entries.translated_text: 我应该如何处理这些锻莫文物？

entries.text: Hello, beautiful. What do you need?
entries.translated_text: 你好，美人儿，你需要什么？

entries.text: (Whisper) Oh, by the eight. (To Guards) What seems to be the problem? Definitely nothing suspicious going on here. (Whisper) Nailed it.
entries.translated_text: （低语）哦，八圣灵在上。（对守卫）似乎有什么问题吗？这里绝对没有什么可以的事情发生。（低语）钉上它。

entries.text: Oh, thank Mara! The corpse wasn't stolen. It's just a vampire!
entries.translated_text: 哦，感谢玛拉！尸体没有被偷，只是一个吸血鬼！

entries.text: If you want me to make a contraption for you, all you have to do is ask, you know?
entries.translated_text: 如果你想让我为你做一个装置，你直接开口就行了，你知道吗？

entries.text: Aren't you done with whatever you were doing on your own? Let me know when I can stop waiting around here.
entries.translated_text: 你的私事还没做完吗？好了记得告诉我声

entries.text: Oh, I'm sorry. Didn't mean to bring up a bad memory.
entries.translated_text: 真的很抱歉。我不是故意要唤起你伤心的回忆。

entries.text: Okay... If you're sure.
entries.translated_text: 好吧...如果你确定的话。

entries.text: I feel quite safe with J'zargo around. He's a competent mage.
entries.translated_text: 有吉'扎格在身边，我觉得很安全。他是一个称职的法师。

entries.text: Oh, yes, I saw him! You can never know someone's hidden talents just by looking at them, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是的，我看见他了！我想，你永远不可能只看一眼就知道某人隐藏的才能。

entries.text: That sounds sad.
entries.translated_text: 这听起来很伤感。

entries.text: It's perfectly logical!
entries.translated_text: 这很有条理的!

entries.text: Sure, Mister I've Got An Entire Wing To Myself In Understone Keep.
entries.translated_text: 当然，先生，我知道你在石下要塞里有一整侧的房间归你独享。

entries.text: I really do need to see if my father has received any more shipments of moon sugar. Hm...
entries.translated_text: 我真得去看看我父亲是否又收到了月亮糖。嗯...

entries.text: I know you're upset, but vengeance is wrong, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你很难过，但复仇是错的，蕾米。

entries.text: Um... Val... I-I wanted to. Uh, apologize.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...瓦尔...我想呃，道歉。

entries.text: You've got to drink with us! Tell me you'll drink with us?
entries.translated_text: 你得和我们一起喝酒！告诉我你会和我们一起喝酒吗？

entries.text: I suppose I never thought of that. It would make stealing things a pain.
entries.translated_text: 我想我从没意识过这个。这样就很难偷东西了。

entries.text: Oh, you all are fine. Also, I know all of you, so it is not as bad as being around a bunch of strangers.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你们都很好。而且我认识你们所有人，所以不像待在一群陌生人中那么难受。

entries.text: And, yes, I guess so. Kinship was part of how we learned to trust each other. Does it bother you? I could stop if you like.
entries.translated_text: 而且，是的，我想是的。亲属关系是我们学会相互信任的一部分。它困扰到你了吗？如果你想的话，我可以停止这种称呼。

entries.text: As much as I joke about Nords, having Gore fght with us is quite reassuring. I find that our enemies' heads are gone faster than I can call Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 尽管我经常拿诺德人开玩笑，但有格雷在我很安心。我发现我还没来得及小渣叫出来敌人就人头落地了！

entries.text: What? Oh, that's just Scrap. Scrap, say hello.
entries.translated_text: 什么？哦，那是小渣。小渣，打个招呼。

entries.text: What?! That made perfect sense! I could explain it to you?
entries.translated_text: 什么？这可都是很有意义的东西！要我解释给你听吗？

entries.text: I actually quite liked it! Until I found out later on that it comes from venomous scorpions.
entries.translated_text: 我实际上相当喜欢它！直到我发现它取自毒蝎子。

entries.text: Rumarin is rather... open... about, ah, his private life. Isn't he?
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林他的私生活相当...开放。不是吗？

entries.text: I-I think you just saved my life!
entries.translated_text: 我-我想你刚刚救了我的命！

entries.text: So, the Thieves' Guild runs Riften. Or so the guards say.
entries.translated_text: 所以，是盗贼工会经营着裂谷城。守卫们也这么说。

entries.text: Experimentation?
entries.translated_text: 实验？

entries.text: I know you don't listen to a word I say, adventurer, but I don't care. I'm saying it for me, not for you.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你不听我说的话，冒险者，但我不在乎。我是为我说的，不是为你说的。

entries.text: Okay, here we are. Let me just...
entries.translated_text: 好了，就这样。让我...

entries.text: Ah, Auri, cover me!
entries.translated_text: 啊，奥璃，掩护我！

entries.text: Seeing as his soul gem didn't seem to be filled with anything, souls or otherwise, he would have acted as the source of power instead.
entries.translated_text: 看他的灵魂石里似乎没有任何东西，无论是灵魂还是其他东西，他都会用来充当能源。

entries.text: Ask Remi about her arranged marriage after she's told you more about her family.
entries.translated_text: 在蕾米告诉你更多关于她的家庭的情况后，问问她的包办婚姻。

entries.text: Is that an actual dragon skull on the bridge, or is it just a statue? It'd be more impressive if it were real.
entries.translated_text: 桥上那是一个真正的龙头骨，还是只是一尊雕像？如果这是真的，那会更令人印象深刻。

entries.text: I care about you. A lot. And I'll come with you wherever you want to go.
entries.translated_text: 我很在乎你。非常在乎。而且无论你想去哪里，我都会陪着你。

entries.text: Okay. Let's... go, then. If you ever need to talk about what happened in there... I'm here.
entries.translated_text: 好的。那我们...走吧。如果你需要谈论那里发生的事情...我就在这里。

entries.text: Their immediate world is all that matters to them.
entries.translated_text: 他们眼前的世界对他们来说是最重要的。

entries.text: I'd starve without you. No pressure.
entries.translated_text: 没有你我会饿死的。别有什么压力。

entries.text: I worship multiple gods.
entries.translated_text: 我信仰多个神灵。

entries.text: It doesn't feel very dangerous.
entries.translated_text: 感觉不是很危险。

entries.text: Remiel's Aversion to Magic
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的惧魔毒药

entries.text: Do you know a soul trap spell? I think Scrap might need a new soul gem.
entries.translated_text: 你知道有个法术摄魂陷阱吗？我认为小渣可能需要一个新的灵魂石。

entries.text: Take Remi to see three dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 带着蕾米去看三个矮人遗迹。

entries.text: Oh, I love to read, too! Hm, braiding...? Like... Hair, you mean?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我也喜欢读书！嗯，编织...？比如...头发，你是说？

entries.text: Motierre is such a fancy-sounding name. Do you think they're some rich person?
entries.translated_text: 莫提雷是一个听起来很花哨的名字。你觉得他们是有钱人吗？

entries.text: Not to mention my paranoia...
entries.translated_text: 更别提我的偏执了...

entries.text: Ugh, some of these Nords are just so... Ugh!
entries.translated_text: 呃，有些诺德人就是这样...呃！

entries.text: Perhaps we just need to find people who appear to be more philosophically inclined!
entries.translated_text: 也许我们只需要找到那些看起来更爱哲思的人!

entries.text: Alright, Ahmed, then off we go!
entries.translated_text: 好了，艾哈迈德，那我们出发吧！

entries.text: And they say there are no good careers for childhood bullies.
entries.translated_text: 他们也说，小时候欺凌别人没有前途。

entries.text: This should thoroughly wreck his precious reputation!
entries.translated_text: 这应该彻底毁掉他宝贵的名声！

entries.text: Remi's Outfit
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的服装

entries.text: Why not? He's harmless! Well, to us, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 为什么？他人畜无害！好吧，无论如何，至少对我们来说是这样。

entries.text: But a lot of time. That doesn't make me hear things, though!
entries.translated_text: 但待了很长时间，却没听到什么！

entries.text: Don't you want to give up?! Just tell Doc you want to give up, and maybe we'll leave you alone!
entries.translated_text: 你不想放弃吗？！只要告诉医生你想放弃，也许我们会让你一个人呆着！

entries.text: Aw, but look, Scrap is trying to prove himself. I'm sure if we just let them acclimate for a moment...
entries.translated_text: 哦，但你看，小渣在努力证明自己。我确信如果我们让他们适应一下...

entries.text: Mama! You're home!
entries.translated_text: 妈妈！你回来啦！

entries.text: Do you think I could train Scrap to sneak into houses for me? Hmm... No, he's too loud.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得我可以训练小渣为我潜入房屋吗？嗯...不，他声音太大了。

entries.text: Are we heading out, Raven?
entries.translated_text: 我们要出去了吗，渡鸦？

entries.text: What's wrong?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？

entries.text: What's wrong?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？

entries.text: What's wrong?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？

entries.text: Oh, finally! I've been running through ideas, but I can't settle on what exactly it should say.
entries.translated_text: 哦，终于！我一直在琢磨各种想法，但就是拿不定主意该怎么写才好。

entries.text: A good back-and-forth? Oh? Does this mean I'm still allowed to make fun of you, then? Preferably without feeling guilty about it?
entries.translated_text: 相处不错？哦？那么，这是否意味着我可以继续取笑你？最好没有心理包袱？

entries.text: I'm sure you can't be that bad.
entries.translated_text: 我相信你不会那么糟糕。

entries.text: (Laugh) What? I don't have any snacks right now.
entries.translated_text: （笑）什么？我现在没有零食。

entries.text: It's just... a hard subject. Something that I did ended up...
entries.translated_text: 这只是...一个难以开口的话题。我所做的事情最后...

entries.text: It's nice to officially meet you, Rennec.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴正式认识你，雷内克。

entries.text: You saw the note.
entries.translated_text: 你看到了这张纸条。

entries.text: How shall I exact my revenge against Morvic? What could possibly measure up to sending an assassin after me?
entries.translated_text: 我应该如何对莫维克进行报复？有什么比买凶杀人更狠呢？

entries.text: What was the dumbest thing you did?
entries.translated_text: 你做过最愚蠢的事是什么？

entries.text: I imagine you could get one from Radiant Raiment, but it'll likely cost you an arm and a leg.
entries.translated_text: 我想你可以从锦衣服饰店买一件，但这很可能会让你花大价钱。

entries.text: So how does it feel, show-off?
entries.translated_text: 那么感觉如何，说说？

entries.text: Signing off a note with just one letter is like something I'd read in a mystery book. 'N'! It has an air of intrigue to it, doesn't it?
entries.translated_text: 在纸条上只用一个字母签名，就像我在悬疑小说里读到的一样。“N”！很神秘，不是吗？

entries.text: If I didn't know any better, I'd think that was an excuse. A lame one at that.
entries.translated_text: 要不是我了解情况，我还真会以为那只是个借口——而且还是个蹩脚的借口。

entries.text: I will cherish her forever!
entries.translated_text: 我将永远珍惜她！

entries.text: I'd have to agree. Nordic ruins are always in such sorry states.
entries.translated_text: 连我也得同意，诺德遗址的状况总是如此糟糕。

entries.text: A moth priest? They read Elder Scrolls, you know. I'd love to meet one.
entries.translated_text: 先祖蛾祭司？他们读过上古卷轴，你知道的。我很想认识一个。

entries.text: A moth priest? They read Elder Scrolls, you know. I'd love to meet one.
entries.translated_text: 先祖蛾祭司？他们读过上古卷轴，你知道的。我很想认识一个。

entries.text: Wait...That almost makes sense!
entries.translated_text: 等等...这几乎有点道理！

entries.text: I think it was more the idea of what we were eating that put us off it. I don't think it genuinely tasted awful enough to cause us to puke.
entries.translated_text: 我想更多的是我们吃的东西时的这些想法让我们不喜欢它。我不认为它的味道真的难吃到吐。

entries.text: Hjaalmarch can hardly be called a marsh. What kind of marsh doesn't have fleshflies and green slime?
entries.translated_text: 希雅陲领很难被称为一个沼泽地。什么样的沼泽地没有肉蝇和绿色粘液？

entries.text: Of course, anyone who tries so valiantly to be seen as a good and moral is usually lying. To others, and to themselves.
entries.translated_text: 当然任何一个想让自己被看作高尚而荣誉的人的人，通常都是骗子，骗别人也骗自己。

entries.text: I'd kill for some Rotmeth right now.
entries.translated_text: 我现在就要喝一些罗特米斯。

entries.text: There's nothing for me to even unlock!
entries.translated_text: 这连让我解锁的都没有！

entries.text: Lead the way then. Go ahead and point out all the finer anatomical differences to me. I'll stay right here and learn.
entries.translated_text: 那就带路吧。继续告诉我那些细微的解剖差异。我会留在这里学习。

entries.text: Remiel's Invisibility Potion
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的隐形药水

entries.text: You'll need to build up your strength.
entries.translated_text: 你需要增强你的力量。

entries.text: Just fine?! You weren't comforted by the culture, the lovely climate, the shared traits between the fiefdoms?
entries.translated_text: 还好吗？！你没有被这里的文化、宜人的气候、领地之间的共同特征所安慰吗？

entries.text: Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 算了。

entries.text: Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 算了。

entries.text: Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 算了。

entries.text: Never mind.

entries.text: Why is Degaine so vague about what he's going to use the statue for? Won't he just sell it for liquour?
entries.translated_text: 为什么德加因会对雕像的用途含糊其辞？他不会直接把雕像卖掉换酒喝吗？

entries.text: Attempts to pull Remi out of any scene she may be stuck in.
entries.translated_text: 将蕾米从她卡住的场景中拉出来。

entries.text: Mercenary from High Rock
entries.translated_text: 高岩佣兵

entries.text: Don't tell Remi, but I'm a bit worried the story I showed her might just be incoherent nonsense.
entries.translated_text: 别告诉蕾米，我有点担心我给她看的故事可能只是语无伦次的胡言乱语。

entries.text: I wonder who found out that Hern was a vampire? Do you think someone saw him... eating?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道谁发现了赫恩是吸血鬼？你认为有人看到他...吃东西吗？

entries.text: Didn't I tell you? After what happened with the Order of the Hour, our family's trade business collapsed.
entries.translated_text: 我没告诉你吗？在时序团发生的事情之后，我们家族的贸易业务崩溃了。

entries.text: Great! First, we cook the meat...
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！首先，我们煮肉...

entries.text: O-okay... 'Will be' implies you're not right now though, right...?
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧...“将会”意味着您现在不会，对吧...？

entries.text: Who is Ruki? Who are you talking to? Is it... a ghost?! Ghosts?! In love! Why can't I see them? Is it the amulet? Ohhhh!
entries.translated_text: 茹姬是谁？你在和谁说话？是...鬼魂吗？！鬼魂？！在恋爱！为什么我看不见他们？是因为护符吗？喔！

entries.text: Yes. Like I said, I care more about our relationship.
entries.translated_text: 是的，就像我说的，我更关心我们的关系。

entries.text: So, Gore, when you're shouting at enemies all the various ways you're going to kill them, are these planned out, or off the top of your head?
entries.translated_text: 所以，格雷, 当你想杀死那些敌人时喊出来的话时临时想到还是早就准备好了？

entries.text: Let's go, Scrap. It's time for more adventure!
entries.translated_text: 走吧，小渣。是时候进行更多冒险了！

entries.text: Just be more careful.
entries.translated_text: 只是要注意点。

entries.text: Oh, no. I never said who he was. It is okay.
entries.translated_text: 不。我从来没有说过他是谁。没关系。

entries.text: Uh, hi there. I'm Remi.
entries.translated_text: 呃，你好。我是蕾米。

entries.text: It is dusty and gross and noisy and everything here wants to kill us.
entries.translated_text: 这里灰尘漫天、恶心嘈杂，一切都想杀死我们。

entries.text: But when a tall figure, with too many arms and too many heads and too many eyes, appeared from nowhere before her, she couldn't help but scream.
entries.translated_text: 可当一个高大可怖长满脑袋、手臂和眼睛的身影出现在她面前时，她忍不住尖叫起来。

entries.text: Seeing where these caves have collapsed... sometimes makes me a little nervous. We'll be able to get back out, right?
entries.translated_text: 看到这些洞穴坍塌的地方……有时候会让我有点紧张。我们能顺利出去，对吧？

entries.text: Okay, we've arrived at Candlehearth Hall.
entries.translated_text: 好了，我们到了烛炉堂。

entries.text: Dwarven Oil
entries.translated_text: 矮人油

entries.text: Dwarven Oil
entries.translated_text: 矮人油

entries.text: Dwarven Oil
entries.translated_text: 矮人油
