entries.translated_text: 矮人油

entries.text: Dwarven Oil
entries.translated_text: 矮人油

entries.text: Okay, Buffy, let me just remember what I was doing before talking to you.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，巴非，让我记住在和你说话之前我在做什么。

entries.text: I hope you've written up your will already.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你已经写好遗嘱了。

entries.text: (Whispering) Okay, let's find this person who hates me so much. I'll give them a real reason to dislike me.
entries.translated_text: （低语）好吧。让我们找到这个我的仇家，我会让他们给他们一点颜色瞧瞧！

entries.text: How do you make them all so different?
entries.translated_text: 你是如何使它们都如此不同的呢？

entries.text: Saarthal? Isn't that some Nord thing?
entries.translated_text: 萨瑟尔城？这不是诺德的东西吗？

entries.text: L-let me take a quick inventory... I think I'll make it.
entries.translated_text: 让我快速盘点一下...我想我能做到。

entries.text: Honestly feels more like a small town in comparison. It's a big fish in a small pond.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，与其相比这更像一个小镇。简直小巫见大巫。

entries.text: Who knows what we might be able to get our hands on?
entries.translated_text: 谁知道我们能得到什么？

entries.text: Wait for Remi to read the book.
entries.translated_text: 等蕾米读这本书。

entries.text: MapleSpice
entries.translated_text: MapleSpice

entries.text: Ooooh, well your second mistake is that I'd never be *paying* for the drinks I obtain.
entries.translated_text: 噢，你的第二大错是我永远不会*为我喝的酒付费*。

entries.text: Any time!
entries.translated_text: 随时为你服务!

entries.text: Ha-ha, very funny. This poor Septimus fellow is some sort of genius, so maybe this is the future I want.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈，真有趣。塞普汀默这个可怜的家伙是某种程度上是个天才，所以也许这就是我想要的未来。

entries.text: Remi, Remi! Hey. (Whispering) Do you think you could buy me a drink? I do not think the bar tender will let me buy one.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，蕾米！嘿。（低语）你觉得你可以请我喝一杯吗？我不认为调酒师会让我买。

entries.text: Although they do seem intent on murder, so...
entries.translated_text: 虽然他们似乎有意杀人，所以...

entries.text: I finally sold off all the scrap metal. I saw you sold some of your loot, too.
entries.translated_text: 我终于卖掉了所有的碎金属。我看到你也卖了一些战利品。

entries.text: Oh, thank you, love.
entries.translated_text: 哦，谢谢你，亲爱的。

entries.text: Good eye. Okay, how should we do this? Er, I assume you are participating, right?
entries.translated_text: 好眼力，好吧，我们该怎么做？呃，我想你会参加吧？

entries.text: I can think of ways to make sure the Jarl hears nothing from you. Ever.
entries.translated_text: 我能想到一些办法，确保你永远无法向领主透露任何消息。

entries.text: Urgh!
entries.translated_text: 呃！

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. We have explored Nchuand-zel together, following in the footsteps of a lost expedition. While exploring, Remi found and repaired a dwemer spider who she has decided to take with us. I should ask her about her plans now that we've finished exploring.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我们一起探索楚安德-泽尔，追随迷途探险的脚步。在探索过程中，蕾米发现并修复了一只她决定带走的矮人蜘蛛。既然我们已经完成了探索，我应该问问她的计划。

entries.text: Remiel's Crossbow
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的弩

entries.text: That means he loves us, right?!
entries.translated_text: 那就是说他爱我们吧？！

entries.text: Fine. I'm used to taking care of myself. Nothing new.
entries.translated_text: 好的我能照顾自己，早就习惯了。

entries.text: I was under the impression that they weren't that powerful anymore.
entries.translated_text: 我的印象是他们没那么强大了。

entries.text: Yes, yes. But you forgot that he's a complete and utter bastard, and I can't wait for the day he keels over and dies.
entries.translated_text: 是的是的。但你忘了他是个彻头彻尾的混蛋，我等不及他倒下死去的那一天。

entries.text: What's in it for me?
entries.translated_text: 那我能得到什么好处？

entries.text: 'Don't eat that, Remi.' 'That's poisonous, Remi.' Well, you're not here to stop me now, are you? ... (Retching) Oh Mara, that's disgusting!
entries.translated_text: ‘别吃那个，蕾米。’‘那有毒, 蕾米。’你不是来阻止我的吧？对吗......（干呕）哦，玛拉在上，真恶心！

entries.text: Remember when you asked where we might find a book you need?
entries.translated_text: 还记得你问我们在哪里可以找到你需要的书吗？

entries.text: Hand them over and let me see.
entries.translated_text: 把它们交出来让我看看。

entries.text: I'm happy you're on my side, Buffy.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你站在我这边，巴非。

entries.text: But if you ever feel brave enough, I'd be happy to let you try some.
entries.translated_text: 但如果你觉得足够勇敢，我很乐意让你试一试。

entries.text: Listen, you're... You're not understanding! It's important I go in!
entries.translated_text: 听着，你...你不明白！我必须进去，这很重要！

entries.text: He's saved my life countless times. And he's adorable!
entries.translated_text: 他无数次救了我的命。而且他很可爱！

entries.text: The Dwemer usually had incredibly deadly traps to safeguard their ruins, but Arkngchal uses a more peaceful form of protection, simply locking down.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫通常会用致命的陷阱在保护他们的建筑，但阿卡切尔采用的是更加温和的保护形式————简单地锁定整座建筑。

entries.text: It really is hard to have a conversation when half the topics are about food.
entries.translated_text: 当一半的话题都是关于食物时，这话没法聊了。

entries.text: I don't want your junk.
entries.translated_text: 我不要你的垃圾。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. Remi doesn't know who might want her dead, but she is eager to investigate. We met a sailor in the Winking Skeever who appeared out of place. After some pressing, I managed to convince her to part with a key to the ship in the harbour. We should head there next.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。蕾米不知道谁可能想要她死，但她急于调查。我们在眨眼恶鼠遇到了一个水手，他显得格格不入。经过一番催促，我设法说服她在港口交出一把船的钥匙。我们接下来应该去那里。

entries.text: Hey, so...
entries.translated_text: 呃，那啥...

entries.text: Get tied up in some underground crime rings and end up indebted to a drug lord.
entries.translated_text: 卷入一些地下犯罪团伙，最终欠下毒枭的债务。

entries.text: Do. Not. Hit. Revan!
entries.translated_text: 不要，渡鸦！

entries.text: Here it is!
entries.translated_text: 成了！

entries.text: He's very selfish and power hungry. Only ever cared about his status in the court, but that meant he left me to myself.
entries.translated_text: 他非常自私和渴望权力。只关心他在宫廷上的地位，但这意味着他把我留给了我自己。

entries.text: Mama, can we talk?
entries.translated_text: 妈妈，我们可以谈谈吗？

entries.text: *Getting* hungry?! That growl sounded like you've been hungry for weeks!
entries.translated_text: *饿*了吗？！那种咆哮听起来像是你已经饿了几个星期了！

entries.text: Khash...
entries.translated_text: 卡什...

entries.text: If I slip down the stairs and die, just know I died happy in a dwemer ruin.
entries.translated_text: 如果我从楼梯上滑下来摔死了，就知道我快乐地死在了一个锻莫遗址中。

entries.text: Hmm. You know, there is something that has proven even more resilient than dwarven metal. The only problem is that it's... rather rare.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。你知道，有一种东西已经被证明了比矮人金属更有弹性。唯一的问题是，它...相当罕见。

entries.text: You're telling me that you looked at the Nord with hulking arm muscles but then chose to give *me* things to carry instead of Gore? Hmph.
entries.translated_text: 你是告诉我，明明旁边有一个肌肉发达的诺德人，你不让格雷背，却选择让我来？哼。

entries.text: (Laugh) That's assuming you notice anything besides the next machine that catches your interest!
entries.translated_text: （笑）我还不知道除了机器以外还有什么能引起你的注意！

entries.text: All I can do is work on it, right?
entries.translated_text: 我能做的就是努力，对吧？

entries.text: Hmm... The fires send quite a message. It seems the Thieves' Guild is just as good at the art of thieving as they are at the craft of thieving.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...这些火光传递的信息很明确。看来盗贼公会不仅在偷窃这门技艺上很有一套，在盗窃的艺术上也同样精通。

entries.text: Oh, what a relief. I was afraid we wouldn't be able to break the enthralling.
entries.translated_text: 哦，真是松了一口气。我还担心我们无法打破这种迷惑呢。

entries.text: Just a little one! I was hungry!
entries.translated_text: 只吃了那么一小个！我当时好饿！

entries.text: You want to trade, right? Yeah. I know. God forbid Remi has to carry anything. I got it!
entries.translated_text: 你想交易，对吧？是的。我知道。上天不让蕾米带的东西都交给了我！

entries.text: Never mind that they wiped out an entire race in the process of settling into Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 更别提他们在定居天际的过程中灭绝了一个整个种族。

entries.text: He was right. I didn't mean for it to happen, but...
entries.translated_text: 他是对的，我不是故意的，但是...

entries.text: It's beautiful. The hub of trade in High Rock. Right next to Iliac Bay.
entries.translated_text: 那里很漂亮，是高岩的贸易中心。就在髂骨湾旁边。

entries.text: It's beautiful. The hub of trade in High Rock. Right next to Iliac Bay.
entries.translated_text: 那里很漂亮是高岩的贸易中心。就在伊利亚克湾旁边。

entries.text: A little joint business venture. You want in?
entries.translated_text: 一个小小的合资企业你想加入吗？

entries.text: ...Did you? Er, do you... would you enjoy killing me...?
entries.translated_text: ...你是否？呃，你...你会享受...杀掉我吗？

entries.text: You look lovely today, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 你今天看起来很可爱，蕾米。

entries.text: Was he strong, intelligent, and good-looking? Sounds like me. May have met my Father!
entries.translated_text: 他强壮、聪明和英俊吗？听起来的确很像我。也许能见到我父亲！

entries.text: Oh, hi, Ganbald! Did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 哦，嗨，甘巴尔德！你需要什么吗？

entries.text: Look at all the blood. She was definitely killed here, and quite gruesomely.
entries.translated_text: 看看这些血，她肯定是在这里被杀的，而且当时一定相当惨烈。

entries.text: Your parents run a fencing operation?
entries.translated_text: 你的父母在搞销赃？

entries.text: Ah, well, my hands are all sticky.
entries.translated_text: 啊，好吧，我的手都黏糊糊的。

entries.text: No, I fancy myself a bladebinder. In fact, conjurers are always looking down on us bladebinders.
entries.translated_text: 不，我想我自己是一个束刃者。事实上，法师们总是看不起我们这些束刃者。

entries.text: Don't forget the beds! What a luxury to not have to sleep on the ground!
entries.translated_text: 不要忘了床!不用睡在地上是一件多么奢侈的事情啊!

entries.text: I'll just... live vicariously through you.
entries.translated_text: 我只能...通过你过过瘾了。

entries.text: I didn't do it, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我没有做, 蕾米。

entries.text: No, it's fine. Haven't seen them in awhile. After I up and left, I doubt they much want to see me anyway. Haven't been a very good kid to them.
entries.translated_text: 没事的。我有一阵子没见过他们了。在我离开之后，我怀疑他们也不太想见到我了。我不算是个好孩子。

entries.text: We'll talk some more later, then, Buffy.
entries.translated_text: 我们稍后再谈，那么，巴非。

entries.text: I've long held a suspicion of mages, and magic.
entries.translated_text: 我长期以来对法师和魔法持有怀疑。

entries.text: (Whisper) How was that?
entries.translated_text: （低语）怎么样？

entries.text: Surrounded by nature, independent, and uncaring of the restrictions of civilized society.
entries.translated_text: 被大自然所包围，独立，不关心文明社会的限制。

entries.text: They're for you.
entries.translated_text: 这是给你的。

entries.text: They're for you.
entries.translated_text: 这是给你的。

entries.text: They're for you.
entries.translated_text: 这是给你的。

entries.text: They're for you.
entries.translated_text: 这是给你的。

entries.text: Exactly! Magic is one thing; using necromancy to fight is a whole different thing.
entries.translated_text: 正是如此!魔法是一回事；使用死灵法术来战斗优势一回事。

entries.text: If Namira is the Lady of Decay, why don't these cannibals just eat the draugr in this place? They seem sufficiently decayed.
entries.translated_text: 如果纳米拉是腐朽女神，为什么这些食人族不直接吃掉这里的尸鬼？他们似乎已经腐烂得差不多了。

entries.text: Vampire, yes.
entries.translated_text: 吸血鬼，没错。

entries.text: Scaling giant trees, growing homes from plants, running through the sunlight as it filtered between the leaves.
entries.translated_text: 攀爬巨树，用植物种植房屋，穿过树叶间的阳光。

entries.text: Gods, no, you can't get close with them, so I know very little about them.
entries.translated_text: 神啊，不，你无法接近他们，所以我对他们知之甚少。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. It seems another group of explorers went into the ruins before us, and Remiel wants to follow after them. It's looking like most the party is dead, but there's still one more explorer to find.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。似乎还有一群探险者在我们之前进入了遗址，蕾米想要跟在他们后面。看起来大多数人都死了，但还有一位探险家要找。

entries.text: Is he more guided by instinct? Another important detail: Can he speak to dogs?!
entries.translated_text: 他会不会更多地是被本能驱使？还有一个重要的细节：他能和狗交流吗？！

entries.text: Remi, I found this book in Arkngchal. I can't read it.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我在阿卡切尔发现了这本书。我读不懂它。

entries.text: Let's cut to the chase.
entries.translated_text: 切入正题。

entries.text: Scrap, roll out!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，滚开！

entries.text: Aw, these poor people were forced out of their home. We're going to help them, right?
entries.translated_text: 哦，这些可怜的人被赶出了他们的家。我们会帮助他们的，对吧？

entries.text: When this item is in inventory, locks are 50% easier to pick.
entries.translated_text: 当此物品在库存中时，开锁难度降低50%。

entries.text: Hah... no. If they're dead, I don't touch the bodies. Old habit.
entries.translated_text: 哈……不。如果他们死了，我不会碰那些尸体。老习惯了。

entries.text: I want to stay! I won't keep you. I know you have things to do, but I... have things to do here.
entries.translated_text: 我想留下来！你不用等我。我知道你有事要做，但我...这里也有事要做。

entries.text: Ah, I bet he's worse at singing than I am. That's certainly offensive.
entries.translated_text: 啊，我打赌他的歌唱得比我差，确实很冒犯。

entries.text: Okay, Auri, let's lay down some cover fire!
entries.translated_text: 好的，奥璃，让我们进行一些掩护火力！

entries.text: Oh, Zora. There's beauty in scars...
entries.translated_text: 哦，佐拉。你的伤疤也很有美感……

entries.text: Well, maybe I'll have to use your battle tips for something a little more personal someday.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许有一天我将不得不使用你的战斗技巧来做一些更私人的事情。

entries.text: Alright, and now to...
entries.translated_text: 好了，现在该...

entries.text: Look, already forgotten.
entries.translated_text: 看，已经忘记了。

entries.text: I think you'll be glad that you made this decision.
entries.translated_text: 你会为此满意的。

entries.text: I think you'll be glad that you made this decision.
entries.translated_text: 你会为此满意的。

entries.text: I think you'll be glad that you made this decision.
entries.translated_text: 你会为此满意的。

entries.text: I've already read so many. I think I'd just like a nice story to escape into.
entries.translated_text: 我已经读了好多本了，我想换个口味读本好故事。

entries.text: Perfect! I will take it and make it beautiful!
entries.translated_text: 完美！我会把它变得更漂亮！

entries.text: No I miss some of them more than you can imagine. That's all I will say on it. My blood boils knowing they died for nothing and taught me everything.
entries.translated_text: 对，我想念他们中的一些人，非常想。这就是我要说的所有话。我知道他们白白死掉了，并且还教会了我一切。

entries.text: Look out, Raven! Something wants us dead!
entries.translated_text: 当心，渡鸦！有什么东西想让我们死！

entries.text: I cannot imagine growing up in Riverwood. How did Zora not become bored?
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象在河木镇长大。佐拉怎么不觉得无聊？

entries.text: Grelod must be a truly awful woman if this kid went to the trouble of performing an actual Black Sacrament.
entries.translated_text: 如果这个孩子不小心执行了真正的黑色圣礼，桂罗一定是个非常糟糕的女人。

entries.text: Seems like more trouble than it's worth.
entries.translated_text: 似乎麻烦多于它的价值。

entries.text: I mean, I saw it, and I thought of you right away. Don't ask me why I did, but...
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，我看到了，我马上想到了你，不要问我为什么这样做，但是...

entries.text: I quite like the spooky dead tree near the Companions' guildhall. Although it doesn't quite fit the vision I have of Whiterun.
entries.translated_text: 我很喜欢战友团公会大厅附近的那棵令人毛骨悚然的枯树，虽然它不太符合我对白漫城的想象。

entries.text: Oh no you don't!
entries.translated_text: 哦不，你别！

entries.text: I tried asking what exactly you were doing with all this stuff you tossed about the temple, but you weren't making much sense. I just let you be.
entries.translated_text: 我试着问你到底在做什么，但你只是把这些东西扔到神殿里，无法沟通，我只能任由你。

entries.text: Doctor.
entries.translated_text: 医生。

entries.text: People have died simply by holding it. And yet, here you are.
entries.translated_text: 人们只要拿着它就会死亡。然而，你却安然无恙。

entries.text: Oh by Sheor. I had something I was supposed to tell you. What was it? Well, it wasn't important anyway. Probably.
entries.translated_text: 哦，舒奥尔啊。我有件事要告诉你。那是什么？嗯，反正这并不重要。可能吧。

entries.text: They just replace whichever books go missing, so if you did want to, uh, borrow any of them, go right ahead. Y'know, hypothetically, of course.
entries.translated_text: 它们会换掉丢失的书籍，所以如果你确实想，呃，去借一本，就直接去吧。当然，你知道的，这不好说。

entries.text: Finally, blessed peace.
entries.translated_text: 最后，祝愿平安。

entries.text: Remi's Gauntlets
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的护手

entries.text: Remi adores pc
entries.translated_text: Remiadorespc

entries.text: But I do not care. I was told to not think about what others say.
entries.translated_text: 但我并不在意。有人告诉我，不要去在意别人说什么。

entries.text: Look at all those eyes! Not to mention the legs!
entries.translated_text: 看看那些眼睛！更别提腿了！

entries.text: (Chuckle)
entries.translated_text: （轻笑）

entries.text: (Chuckle)
entries.translated_text: （轻笑）

entries.text: Y-yes! I... I'll have to teach you some rather large words at some point, I think. But you'll be read to read it when the time comes, I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: 是——是的！我...我想以后得教你一些相当大的词。不过我相信，等时候到了，你一定能读懂的。

entries.text: Automaton tend to come prepackaged with fairly predictable behavioral patterns. While outright controlling them is beyond me...
entries.translated_text: 自动机器往往预先安装了有相当可预测性的行为模式，虽然完全控制他们超出了我的能力范围...

entries.text: If she asks to stop and 'read' or something, just ignore it. Okay?
entries.translated_text: 如果她要求停下来“阅读”或其他什么，请无视它。好吗？

entries.text: ;Has heard Remi talk about arranged marriage AND father's Third Consecration
entries.translated_text: ;HasheardRemitalkaboutarrangedmarriageANDfather'sThirdConsecration

entries.text: (Laugh) So, you make a lot of friends this way? Why so much hostility?
entries.translated_text: （笑）那么，你用这种方式交到了很多朋友？那么什么还有这么多仇人？

entries.text: Scrap, protect Khash!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，保护卡什！

entries.text: Like that? Was he not your dad, then?
entries.translated_text: 像那样？那他不是你爸吗？

entries.text: I'd need so many supplies that I just can't afford or can't easily find.
entries.translated_text: 但我需要很多我买不起或很难收集的材料。

entries.text: Now, I'll send it via courier. Don't worry, I'll make sure to conceal my identity.
entries.translated_text: 现在，我会偷偷送出去，别担心，我不会暴露身份的。

entries.text: Wait here.
entries.translated_text: 在这里等着。

entries.text: Oh, I do love dynamo cores! They're beautiful to look at, but also are useful in the construction of gadgets that require energy! Thank you!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我真的很喜欢动力核心！它们看起来很漂亮，而且制造需要能量的小工具时也很有用！非常感谢。

entries.text: Why? What have you found?
entries.translated_text: 为什么？你发现了什么？

entries.text: Okay, now these plans are starting to come together!
entries.translated_text: 好了，现在这些计划开始渐渐成形了！

entries.text: R-really? Why's that?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？为什么？

entries.text: Auri. Auri, I think we're heading out!
entries.translated_text: 奥璃，奥璃，我想我们要出发了！

entries.text: I found out too much about the Forsworn and their plans.
entries.translated_text: 我发现了很多弃誓者和他们预谋的事情。

entries.text: And have there been any worth pursuing?
entries.translated_text: 有什么值得注意的吗？

entries.text: Talk to you later, then.
entries.translated_text: 那以后再说吧。

entries.text: Naturally. I need some dwarven scrap metal, though.
entries.translated_text: 当然。不过，我需要一些矮人碎片材料。

entries.text: Look out, Ubbe! Someone wants to kill us!
entries.translated_text: 当心，乌贝！有人想杀我们！

entries.text: My family name is destroyed! What sway we held has gone up in smoke!
entries.translated_text: 我的家族名声毁了！我们曾拥有的影响力已化为乌有!

entries.text: Remi dislikes PC
entries.translated_text: RemidislikesPC

entries.text: Uhhhh, problem. Problem, there's a problem! The chamber seems to be flooding, adventurer!
entries.translated_text: 呃，出事了，出事了！内室好像进水了，冒险者！

entries.text: Oh! I love you, too! So much!
entries.translated_text: 哦！我也非常爱你！！

entries.text: Well, I write stories. I don't really have a particular genre, I just like writing characters and exploring who they are.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我写故事。我真没有一个特定的流派，我只是喜欢写点人物，探究他们自身。

entries.text: You're so sweet. I love you, too.
entries.translated_text: 你真贴心，我也爱你。

entries.text: The only reason I'd have lost a blade in its presence is because I fell so deeply in love that I forgot anything else existed!
entries.translated_text: 如果我在它面前丢了一把刀刃，唯一的原因就是我深深地爱上了它，以至于忘记了其他东西的存在！

entries.text: Keening simply drew out all of his power until it destroyed his physical essence?
entries.translated_text: 哀恸干脆将他所有的力量都抽出来，直到破坏了他的肉身？

entries.text: Give the book to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 把书带给蕾米。

entries.text: You'd think the Nords would find a more... permanent way of caring for their dead, seeing as their crypts seem to be infested with undead.
entries.translated_text: 你会认为诺德人会找到一种更...永恒的方式来照顾他们的亡者，因为他们的地穴似乎充满了亡灵。

entries.text: It was supposedly harvested and refined by the dwemer to make immensely powerful artifacts.
entries.translated_text: 据说这是由锻莫采集并精炼，用来制造极其强大的神器的材料。

entries.text: Can you tell me about Morvic?
entries.translated_text: 你能告诉我关于莫维克的事吗？

entries.text: Oh, no! You've got it wrong! I've never met a vampire like you before, and I just have so many questions. I'm just trying to rein it in.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不！你误会了！我以前从未遇到过像你这样的吸血鬼，我有太多问题想问。我只是试着克制自己。

entries.text: Wait... What's wrong with this one?
entries.translated_text: 等等...这个怎么了？

entries.text: What?! That can't be right. What makes you think that??
entries.translated_text: 什么？这不可能是对的。你怎么会这样想？

entries.text: Now, I don't want to sound like a Bound Weapon peddler, but you really ought to consider using them.
entries.translated_text: 现在，虽然我不想听起来像卖束缚武器法术的小贩，但你真的应该考虑试试它们。

entries.text: I... Well, yes, I suppose I have, although I've never paid it much mind. Does it mean something?
entries.translated_text: 我…嗯，是的，我想我有看过，虽然我从来没有太在意过。这有什么意义吗？

entries.text: You can take Scrap out of your bag when we relax.
entries.translated_text: 当我们放松时，你可以从你的包里拿出小渣。

entries.text: When our patterns of behavior change, so does our song. The reverse is also true: when our song is altered, our behaviors are altered.
entries.translated_text: 当我们的行为模式改变时，我们的歌声也会改变。反之亦然：当我们的歌声改变时，我们的行为也会改变。

entries.text: This city reminds me a little of Wayrest. Beautiful on the outside. Not so much on the inside.
entries.translated_text: 这个城市让我想起了途歇城。外表漂亮，内部肮脏。

entries.text: Well, Auri, shall we head out?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，奥璃，我们要出去吗？

entries.text: Some posit that Rieklings are an offshoot of Snow Elves. Their propensity towards violence is certainly similar to the Falmer.
entries.translated_text: 一些人认为蓝客灵是雪精灵的一个分支，他们肯定与伐莫一样暴力。

entries.text: They called our family heathens. We abandoned Arkay's teachings by not having the body Consecrated correctly in the first place.
entries.translated_text: 他们称我们家为异教徒，说我们背离了阿尔凯的教义，不尊重逝者尸体。

entries.text: Who's got two thumbs and a bag of Septims for his favourite business partner? This guy.
entries.translated_text: 谁为他最喜欢的商业伙伴准备了两个拇指和一袋金币？这家伙。

entries.text: No, I don't worship Trinimac. I just admire him. I think Orcs are, uh. Well, if man was made perfect... He'd be an orc.
entries.translated_text: 不，我不信仰崔尼马克。我只是佩服他。我认为兽人是，额。如果世界上有完美的男人， 那一定是个兽人。

entries.text: The snow elves can't be brought back, but legal worship of Talos can.
entries.translated_text: 雪精灵已经回不来了，但塔洛斯的合法信仰可以。

entries.text: That's ridiculous. I don't even like skooma. That was a bottle of imitation skooma.
entries.translated_text: 这太荒谬了。我根本不喜欢斯库玛，那是一瓶假斯库玛。

entries.text: That's ridiculous. I don't even like skooma. That was a bottle of imitation skooma.
entries.translated_text: 这太荒谬了。我根本不喜欢斯库玛，那是一瓶假斯库玛。

entries.text: What sorts of Orders are there?
entries.translated_text: 有哪些骑士团？

entries.text: What's this deal?
entries.translated_text: 是什么交易？

entries.text: Don't die, Ria! I'd be very upset with you!
entries.translated_text: 别死，利亚！我会伤心的！

entries.text: Oh, most certainly. Especially to someone like me, who was raised in a bustling city, the height of 'society'.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那肯定的。特别是对像我这样的人来说，我是在一个繁华的城市长大的，非常"社会化"。

entries.text: Well, I just feel that they tend to be group masquerading as heroes of the people when really their morality is as shaky as any other.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我只是觉得他们往往伪装成人民的英雄，而实际上他们的道德观和其他的组织一样不稳定。

entries.text: Despite all our challenges and struggles, here we are!
entries.translated_text: 尽管经历了那么多挑战和挣扎，我们还是走到了这里！

entries.text: Oh! I've visted there- Camlorn specifically. It's really lovely there, despite how glum 'Glenumbra' sounds.
entries.translated_text: 我去过那里，特别是卡姆洛恩。那里真的很很棒，尽管"格林纳巴"听起来很阴郁。

entries.text: It's quite a trek, believe me. Not that I feel bad for her, seeing as she's working with someone who tried to murder me!
entries.translated_text: 相信我，这是一次艰难的旅途，倒不是说我为她感到难过，毕竟她和那个曾试图杀我的家伙合作！

entries.text: At the same time, it seems that it's ended up being rather cruel.
entries.translated_text: 同时，它似乎最终变得那么残酷。

entries.text: We used to play games. Just silly kid games. Steal Dreugh eggs from their nests without getting caught by the mother.
entries.translated_text: 我们以前玩游戏。只是个愚蠢的孩子游戏。在没有被它们母亲抓住的情况下，从它们的巢穴中偷走泥蟹蛋。

entries.text: Well, hello, Tazvir. It's nice to have a name to call you.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你好，塔兹维尔，能叫你的名字真好。

entries.text: You know, two out of three apothecaries say I'm completely sane.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，三个药剂师里有两个都说我完全正常。

entries.text: Thanks for that.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Always good to come out on the winning side. But you did great.
entries.translated_text: 胜利的感觉很棒，但你也不赖。

entries.text: Now this is beginning to sound like a good night!
entries.translated_text: 现在，这听起来像是一个美好的夜晚！

entries.text: I doubt anyone but the dwemer really understood its full functioning.
entries.translated_text: 我怀疑除了锻莫之外，没有人真正了解它的全部功能。

entries.text: Definitely not handy with a sword... The best I've got is my dagger.
entries.translated_text: 使剑肯定不行...我使得最好的就是我的匕首。

entries.text: Val... Give me your hand. Oh! And close your eyes!
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔...把手给我。哦，还有闭上眼睛！

entries.text: The potion! It's ready, Serana!
entries.translated_text: 药水！准备好了，瑟拉娜！

entries.text: Yes, that'd be entirely out of character.
entries.translated_text: 是的，那完全不符合你的风格。

entries.text: Yes, that might be a good idea. I tend to... become distracted.
entries.translated_text: 是的，这也许是个好主意，我容易...分心。

entries.text: That's certainly not suspicious in the least. Although, I must say whatever this is, it smells divine!
entries.translated_text: 这看起来一点也不可疑。尽管，要说点什么的话，它闻起来很神奇！

entries.text: {Sigh} You're not the first person I've tagged along with.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）你不是第一个我跟随的人。

entries.text: Good. I'm sure anyone who would know would be hanging around where the guards can't find them.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我敢肯定，任何知道的人都会在警卫找不到他们的地方闲逛。

entries.text: They remind me of Dwarven Ballistas.
entries.translated_text: 它们让我想起了矮人弩炮。

entries.text: They remind me of Dwarven Ballistas.
entries.translated_text: 它们让我想起了矮人弩炮。

entries.text: This city in the center of Blackreach... It's called the Silent City. I'm certain it was less eerie a name back when the dwemer were still around.
entries.translated_text: 这座位于黑境中心的城市……它被称为寂静之城。我敢肯定，当锻莫还在的时候，这个名字不那么令人毛骨悚然。

entries.text: Khash is rather adorable, isn't she? Don't tell her I said that, okay?
entries.translated_text: 卡什很可爱，不是吗？不要告诉她我说过这话，好吗？

entries.text: Alright, Aela. I'm ready for some of your battle wisdom.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾拉。我已经准备好聆听你的战斗智慧了。

entries.text: (Whisper) Lead the way, then.
entries.translated_text: （低语）那么带路吧。

entries.text: For...?
Wait for the results of Remi's tip-off.
entries.translated_text: 等待蕾米告密的结果。

entries.text: No. Nothing will change it. But watching them suffer can certainly change how I feel about it.
entries.translated_text: 对，没有什么能改变它。但看着他们受苦，肯定能改变我的感受。

entries.text: I'm almost certain Xel will murder me if I let you. I'm sorry, Khash.
entries.translated_text: 我几乎可以肯定如果我让你这么做，赛尔会杀了我的对不起，卡什。

entries.text: Alright, Kodlak, here we come!
entries.translated_text: 好的，克拉科，我们来了！

entries.text: Well, I'm ready to go exploring again if you are!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你愿意，我准备再次探索这里！

entries.text: Hm? What did you- My backpack?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？你做了什么——我的背包？

entries.text: But I have to admit I miss the swamp.
entries.translated_text: 但我不得不承认，我想念沼泽。

entries.text: Yeah, that's because you're too busy answering to Remi. What are you, her personal killer for hire?
entries.translated_text: 是啊，那是因为你忙着回应蕾米的问题，你是她雇来的私人杀手吗？

entries.text: Let's go return the books.
entries.translated_text: 我们把书还回去吧。

entries.text: And I rely on Scrap, not some esoteric magic.
entries.translated_text: 而且我依靠的是小渣，而不是什么深奥的魔法。

entries.text: Feelings? I suppose I'll never hear the end of it if I don't try...
entries.translated_text: 想法？我想如果我不尝试，我永远不会知道它的结局......

entries.text: Although, my sister has always behaved as though she must protect me from everything. I imagine because of my numerous near-death experiences.
entries.translated_text: 尽管如此，我姐姐总是表现得她必须保护我远离一切伤害。我想这可能是因为我无数次的濒临死亡的经历。

entries.text: Oh, woah, why are you yelling? Wait, who are you?
entries.translated_text: 哦，哇，你为什么大喊大叫？等等，你是谁？

entries.text: Not your first choice, I'd guess.
entries.translated_text: 我猜这不是你的首选吧。

entries.text: Well, it also has bandit-bards and Forsworn!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，它也有强盗吟游诗人和弃誓者！

entries.text: Exactly! What about you? What do you do for fun?
entries.translated_text: 确切地！那你呢？你平时有什么娱乐活动？

entries.text: How about Anum-la?
entries.translated_text: 安努姆菈怎么样？

entries.text: That sums up their cities pretty well, yeah. Do they scare you?
entries.translated_text: 这很好地概括了他们的城市，是的。他们吓到你了吗？

entries.text: We scored big, huh? Couple of morons like us really needed someone like Remi. No offense...
entries.translated_text: 我们得分很高，对吗？像我们这样的几个白痴真的需要像蕾米这样的人。没有冒犯的意思...

entries.text: I certainly do. Not for nothing, I hope?
entries.translated_text: 我当然知道，但我觉得也不能白帮忙，你说呢？

entries.text: The dwemer thought worship of the Daedra ridiculous. Some of their ruins in High Rock have temples, though. What were they worshipping?
entries.translated_text: 锻莫认为对魔族的信仰是荒谬的。不过，他们在高岩的一些遗址却有神殿。他们在信仰什么？

entries.text: I'm *so* glad you joined the Companions!
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你加入了战友团！

entries.text: Did you wake up on the wrong side of the bed? You're being a little witch-y!
entries.translated_text: 你是不是起床时踩错边了？你今天有点像个小巫婆！

entries.text: I think your taste buds might be broken, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 我想你的味蕾可能坏了，我的朋友。

entries.text: Of course, pushing so much steam into such a small space is... dangerous. But that's what the Aetherium is for!
entries.translated_text: 当然，把这么多的蒸汽推入这么小的空间是很...危险的。但是，这就是神光水晶的作用!

entries.text: You know how to brighten my day, don't you?
entries.translated_text: 你真是懂得如何明媚我的一天，不是吗？

entries.text: That's completely different. When we were robbing those shopkeepers point blank, we had to face their anger and hatred head-on.
entries.translated_text: 那完全不同。当我们当面抢劫那些店主时，我们不得不直面他们的愤怒和仇恨。

entries.text: I'm sure I can find someone who would be willing to come with me.
entries.translated_text: 我相信我能找到愿意和我一起去的人。

entries.text: That sounds fun.
entries.translated_text: 这听起来很有趣。

entries.text: ;introduced one another
entries.translated_text: ;introducedoneanother

entries.text: Are you the type of Breton who is proud of their elven ancestry, or the type who disavows it?
entries.translated_text: 你是那种以自己的精灵血统为荣的布莱顿人，还是那种不承认精灵血统的那派？

entries.text: I mostly just learned that blood is a covenant, not an obligation or a racial trait. I grew fond of the races that seem shunned here.
entries.translated_text: 我主要只是了解到血统是一种契约，而并非义务或者种族特点。我越来越喜欢这里被歧视的那些种族。

entries.text: Make my presence in Skyrim known, leave some "clues" behind, and you come waltzing right to me!
entries.translated_text: 只要让我在天际的存在为人所知，留下一些 "线索"，然后你就会自投罗网!

entries.text: It makes sense for there to be so many of us Bretons in Skyrim. We are neighbors after all.
entries.translated_text: 天际里有这么多布莱顿是有道理的。毕竟我们是邻居。

entries.text: Raven. Like the bird? I'll be sure to remember it.
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，你喜欢那种鸟吗？我一定会记住的。

entries.text: I feel exhausted.
entries.translated_text: 我感到筋疲力尽。

entries.text: No, but just the scandal of being accused and investigated... It ruined my father's trade business.
entries.translated_text: 不，只是诽谤与诬陷...但它毁了我父亲的贸易生意。

entries.text: Remi's Tension Wrench Prototype
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的张力扳手原型

entries.text: What? Oh, yeah, I was just working on Scrap a bit.
entries.translated_text: 什么？哦，没，我只是在研究小渣。

entries.text: Right. Just a little more embellishment...
entries.translated_text: 对的。再多一点点缀...

entries.text: I don't like how she assumes you're going to murder a man just because she told you to. Are you sure you know what you're getting into?
entries.translated_text: 我不喜欢她认为你会因为她的命令就去杀一个人的观点。你确定你知道自己在做什么吗？

entries.text: Implied... He didn't even guarantee he'd give you the prize?! Figures. Daedric Princes are hardly the picture of good will.
entries.translated_text: 暗示...他都没保证会给你奖励？我就知道，魔神可没什么好心肠。

entries.text: I'd like for you to ride your horse.
entries.translated_text: 我想让你骑你的马。

entries.text: 'A woman of violence,' he says. This is a tree, not his kin.
entries.translated_text: “你是这么暴力的女人，”他说。这是一棵树，不是他的亲属。

entries.text: Do you suppose it's painful? Or does the adrenaline numb the pain, do you think? And think of the phenomenological aspects!
entries.translated_text: 你觉得这会疼吗？还是说肾上腺素会让他感觉不到痛？再想想其中的现象学意义！

entries.text: Oh, and here I though it was because they just hate everyone who isn't a Nord.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我认为这是因为他们只是讨厌所有不是诺德人的人。

entries.text: I know that Tyranus was rather... much. But I do think you could have merely avoided him, rather than... murder him. Just an observation.
entries.translated_text: 我知道提兰奴斯很... 很...但我认为你本可以避开他，而不是...杀掉他。多观察一下。

entries.text: Ilia, you are inhuman. And inmer. Is that a word? Well, you understand.
entries.translated_text: 伊莉娅，你简直非人，也非莫，这是个词吗？嗯，你懂的。

entries.text: Who in Oblivion was that?! They really didn't seem to like you much!
entries.translated_text: 那是什么玩意？！他们似乎真的不怎么喜欢你!

entries.text: When the Reachmen ruled Markarth, they had ties with a cult that stayed in Nchuand-Zel. That cult's leader was Mannimarco.
entries.translated_text: 当边塞人统治马卡斯城时，他们与一个驻扎在楚安德-泽尔的有联系。那个邪教的领袖是曼尼马克。

entries.text: I wouldn't worry too much about it.
entries.translated_text: 我不是太担心这个。

entries.text: The first person to throw up had to pay for the next round of the game.
entries.translated_text: 第一个吃吐的人必须为下一轮游戏买单。

entries.text: I-I-I... Well, that's true. And I suppose I would much prefer for him to be happy and healthy...
entries.translated_text: 我，我，我...嗯，这的确是真的，我想我更希望他快乐健康...

entries.text: It was used to control the amount of power produced by the Heart. Without it, there's no way to control how much power is accessed.
entries.translated_text: 它被用来控制心脏产生的能量。没有它，就无法控制访问的能量。

entries.text: If you really think it's a bad idea, then... I guess I won't go after him.
entries.translated_text: 如果你真的认为这是个坏主意，那么...我想我不会去报复他。

entries.text: Somehow, I'm not sensing the 'love' here.
entries.translated_text: 不知怎么的，我没有感觉到这里的“爱”。

entries.text: I found something... Well, really I stole something...
entries.translated_text: 我发现了一些东西...嗯，我真的偷了东西...

entries.text: Do you have anything in from Skaven?
entries.translated_text: 你有斯卡文寄来的东西吗？

entries.text:
<font face='$HandwrittenBold'>

Note to self-

These dwarves made machines that don't make any damn sense. I've tried so much to get this thing goin', and I think I'm starting to lose track of what I've done. So I'm gonna write it down as I go.

-Hit it with my sword
-Hit it with Rodard's sword
-Pressed the button 'til I was blue in the face
-Hit it with some of the scrap laying around
-Hollered at it
-Gave it a couple a kicks

Think we might be out of luck. This thing is froze in time.

</font>
entries.translated_text:
写给自己

这些矮人制造的机器根本没有任何意义。我想了很久才把这个东西弄好，我想我已经开始不记得我做了什么了。所以我打算边走边写。

-用我的剑打它
-用罗达德的剑打它
-按下按钮
-用周围的一些废品打它
-对着它吼叫
-给它来了几脚

我想我们可能不走运了。这东西似乎被冻结在时间里了。

entries.text: Ha-ha. Being on the surface leaves you more open to attack. This place is as strategic as it is beautiful.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。在水面上会让你更容易受到攻击。这个地方美丽而不失战略意义。

entries.text: So, does that mean you want to shop for a dress?
entries.translated_text: 那么，这是不是意味着你想买一件衣服？

entries.text: What are we going to do for dinner? I mean, I could make something, but you know I'm awful at it...
entries.translated_text: 我们晚饭打算做什么？我的意思是，我可以做点什么，但你知道我做得很糟糕...

entries.text: It's... It's the least I can do. Just... keep this quiet.
entries.translated_text: 这...这是我能做的仅有的事。只是...请给我保密。

entries.text: It was nice. Though, not if you are alone.
entries.translated_text: 那确实挺好的。虽然……如果是一个人的话，就不那么好了。

entries.text: Heh, nice!
entries.translated_text: 哈，不错！

entries.text: Heh, nice!
entries.translated_text: 哈，不错！

entries.text: Someone was trying to pickpocket you earlier, so I pickpocketed them while they were distracted.
entries.translated_text: 早些时候有人想偷你，所以我趁他们分心的时候偷了他们。

entries.text: ...So, yeah, sometimes my mouth gets me in trouble before my brain can catch up to what it's saying.
entries.translated_text: ...所以，是的，有时因为我的嘴不过脑子带来了一些麻烦。

entries.text: I... No... Not right now. Maybe someday, when you know more about my family.
entries.translated_text: 我...不，现在不行。也许有一天，当你对我的家庭有更多了解时我再告诉你。

entries.text: I do think it's time for the Order of the Hour to receive an anonymous tip about another daedra worshipper in Wayrest, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 我确实认为时序团是时候收到关于途歇城另一个魔族信徒的匿名举报信了，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: Legend says Dwarven ruins are haunted.
entries.translated_text: 传说中矮人遗迹会闹鬼。

entries.text: I'm from High Rock. Wayrest, to be exact.
entries.translated_text: 我来自高岩。确切地说，是途歇城。

entries.text: I'm from High Rock. Wayrest, to be exact.
entries.translated_text: 我来自高岩。确切地说，是途歇城。

entries.text: Some of the Jarl's men came by... As if business wasn't slow enough.  Sure, take all my things! Milkdrinkers.
entries.translated_text: 一些领主的手下到了我的摊子上...好像生意还不够烂似的。白痴！当然了，它们拿走了我所有的东西！

entries.text: Oh, good point. Instead of paying off their own, they're putting out new ones on the people who put bounties on them in the first place!
entries.translated_text: 哦，说得好。与其偿还自己的悬赏，他们反而去给最初悬赏他们的人发布新的悬赏！

entries.text: Oh, that won't be a problem. I'll just stay behind you and... observe.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那没问题。我只会待在你后面...观察。

entries.text: Good boy, Scrap! So good!
entries.translated_text: 好孩子，小渣！超级棒！

entries.text: Damn Morvic. This is *my* Dwemer ruin. Well, I suppose it's the Dwemer's. But they're not here to claim it.
entries.translated_text: 该死的莫维克，这是*我的* 锻莫遗址。好吧，我想这是锻莫的。但他们是不会来这里认领的。

entries.text: Some people like to drink with friends, so I am but your humble servant.
entries.translated_text: 有些人喜欢和朋友喝酒，所以我只是你卑微的仆人。

entries.text: I don't *plunder*. I.... discover. And borrow items. If only the automaton thought we were dwemer...
entries.translated_text: 我不“搜刮”。我...发现，以及借用东西。只要那些机械认为我们是锻莫...

entries.text: But that's half the fun of adventuring, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 但这只是冒险乐趣的一半，不是吗？

entries.text: Are you okay? Almost thought I lost you there... You went white as the snow.
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？我差点以为失去你了……你脸色白得像雪一样。

entries.text: I don't like how that Thalmor looks at me. Can't we just pretend he doesn't exist the next time he talks to us?
entries.translated_text: 我不喜欢那梭默看我的方式。下次他和我们说话时，我们就不能假装他不存在吗？

entries.text: Oh, thank Mara. Just thinking of such a-a ritual. It-It's wrong. It made my stomach turn.
entries.translated_text: 哦，感谢玛拉。只是想到这样的仪式。这是个错误。这让我反胃。

entries.text: Shrine of Talos
entries.translated_text: 塔洛斯祭坛

entries.text:
<font face='$HandwrittenBold'>

Can't believe I took this job. This fella is out of his mind! Drags us halfway across Tamriel, and now I'm sittin' in one of them old ruins with the doors behind us stuck and the doors ahead of us stuck. I dunno how we're gonna get outta this place.

Good for us, all of them machines look to be busted. Or maybe they were never workin' to begin with. I dunno. I just hope the whispers of places like this being haunted are made-up stories. Then again, if we don't figure out a way to get these doors open, maybe we'll end up the ones hauntin' the place.

Dunore was saying that they're trapped in the hall beyond, too. They've been hackin' at the walls, trying to get through. Wish they'd hack at the gate stuck between us, but they wanna give that Morvic a piece of their mind, and nothin' is gonna get in their way.

Suppose that Morvic fellow musta offered the ones that didn't get trapped our cut, because they're standin' guard instead of slittin' his throat for draggin' us into this. Damn him.

</font>
entries.translated_text:
不敢相信我接受了这份工作。这家伙真是疯了！让我们跨越了半个泰姆瑞尔，现在我坐在一个古老的遗址里，身后的门卡住了，前面的门也卡住了！

对我们来说是好事，所有的机器看起来都坏了。或者，也许它们从一开始就没有好过。我不知道。我只希望像这样的地方闹鬼的传言是编造出来的。话又说回来，如果我们不能想出办法把这些门打开，也许我们最终会成为这个地方的鬼。

杜诺尔说，他们也被困于大厅外面。他们一直在敲墙，试图通过。希望他们能打开我们之间的门，他们想对莫维克一个交代，似乎没有什么能阻挡他们的路。

我想那个叫莫维克的家伙一定是把我们的钱给那些没被困在里面的人了，因为他们还在站岗，而不是割断他的喉咙。是莫维克把我们拖进了这个怪圈。该死的家伙。

entries.text: I drink MEAD. REAL mead, so keep up if you think you can. Matter of fact, first round's on me. This oughta be hilarious.
entries.translated_text: 我喝蜂蜜酒。真正的蜜酒，所以如果你认为可以喝，请跟着我喝。事实上，我想第一轮该谁喝应该我来决定。这应该很有趣。

entries.text: I would say yes, but I'm pretty sure I saw you eating a sweet roll not too long ago...
entries.translated_text: 我会说是的，但我很确定不久前我看到你在吃甜卷...

entries.text: A bound weapon is so comfortable in your palm. It's like holding a cloud, if clouds were sharp and made to cut people.
entries.translated_text: 束缚武器握在手上很舒服。这就像拿着一朵云，要是云能锋利得足够砍人的话。

entries.text: But we'd spend late nights debating the practicalities of scientific experiments or discussing the attributes of the planes of Oblivion.
entries.translated_text: 但我们会在深夜争论科学实验的实用性，或讨论遗忘位面的属性。

entries.text: Your cat?
entries.translated_text: 你的猫？

entries.text: Ahmed, I think something is trying to kill us!
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德，我觉得有什么东西想杀了我们！

entries.text: Yeah, yeah, you got me. Don't tell anybody, all right? It'll be bad for my reputation. (Laugh)
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，你发现了。不要告诉任何人，好吗？这对我的声誉不利。（笑）

entries.text: Hey, you could've warned me they were about to start yelling?! I could've ended up like Torygg, shouted to pieces!
entries.translated_text: 嘿，你本可以警告我他们要开始龙吼的？！我可是会像托依格一样，被吼声撕成片！

entries.text: The entrance to a dwarven city. All manner of strange traps and machines will be inside.
entries.translated_text: 通向矮人城市的道路，里面肯定充斥着稀奇古怪的陷阱和机器。

entries.text: Oh, friend, I don't feel too hot. I swiped some bread off someone's plate, and I think it must have fallen in the sewer beforehand or something.
entries.translated_text: 哦，朋友，我感觉不太好，我从别人盘子里顺了一块面包，但我觉得那玩意之前可能掉进下水道了还是怎么了。

entries.text: Good! Good. I-I had so many worries, so many imaginings of your fate, I-
entries.translated_text: 很好！很好。我-我太担心了，一直想着你的遭遇，我-

entries.text: No! Nope! You know that's not what I meant!
entries.translated_text: 不！不！你知道我不是这个意思！

entries.text: Thorn, it's essential for me to tell you- Uh. It's essential that you know- Well, I'm sure it will come back to me.
entries.translated_text: 荆棘，我必须告诉你——呃。你知道这一点很重要——嗯，我确信它会回到我身边。

entries.text: So... That note said the staff was broken, right? I can't believe I won a staff for you and you went and broke it immediately! Ow, okay, no yelling.
entries.translated_text: 所以...那张纸条上写着法杖坏了，对吧？我真不敢相信我为你赢得了一根法杖，而你马上就去毁了它！噢，好吧，不要冲动。

entries.text: W-woah! What in Oblivion is this stuff?
entries.translated_text: 哇！这是什么东西？

entries.text: Always a pleasure.
entries.translated_text: 随时乐意。

entries.text: Ahhhh, I think my brain is trying to vibrate out of my head. If you see it oozing out of my ears, just ignore it.
entries.translated_text: 啊啊啊，我想我的大脑正试图从我的头里面振动出来。如果你看到它从我的耳朵中渗出，请别在意。

entries.text: Ish. Not mine, though. Doesn't really bear thinking about; I only miss a few of them.
entries.translated_text: 不是，真的不忍心去想；我只想是怀念其中的一些人。

entries.text: Yeah, yeah, I'll get you next time.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，好吧，我下次再和你玩。

entries.text: [pagebreak] The history of Arkngchal is rich and enduring, and yet the center remains but a shadow compared to others nearby. The others conduct their battles and display their power with little thought to the genius of the scholars who make such things possible. And yet, the proud scholars within Arkngchal continue their work, ever improving the conceptualization of automaton. While the invaluable work that occurs in these walls may go unnoticed, those who live here continue on, their minds focused solely on creating the next great machine. So brilliant are our engineers that those who live here do so for years, sometimes a lifetime. Most dedicate their lives to their science, leaving for fieldwork only to return to their true home in the end. A population of innovative engineers and theorists draws likeminded individuals to Arkngchal, which is how new apprentices come to live out their lives in this proud university. Our designs have been used in the armies of our conquering allies, in the maintenance of our splendid cities, and in the furthering of the intelligence within our automaton. We conduct lectures on the most complex of topics and our members prove their mastery in the most advanced of specialties. We may be forgotten for the grand cities with proud soldiers and famous kings, but we will know for ourselves who made it possible for the them to be great.

entries.text: If you like dressing up, why don't you?
entries.translated_text: 如果你喜欢打扮，为什么不呢？

entries.text: In plain terms, you can use this contraption to locate me, so long as I'm holding this piece of it.
entries.translated_text: 简单来说，只要我拿着它，你就可以用这个装置来定位我。

entries.text: So soon I'll be able to chase after you without them hurting?
entries.translated_text: 这么说，我很快就能追上你而不觉得腿疼了？

entries.text: Wait. It's you. You're the one he sent us to kill! What 're you doin'? You stupid?
entries.translated_text: 等等，是你。你就是我们的目标！你在做什么？你傻吗？

entries.text: You seem to be falling apart out there! Just let us end your suffering already!
entries.translated_text: 你似乎撑不住了！就让我们结束你的痛苦吧!

entries.text: I was surprised to learn that Rumarin is a rather excellent cook! This is great news!
entries.translated_text: 我很惊讶鲁马林是一位相当出色的厨师！这是个好消息！

entries.text: I'm so excited! In Wayrest, we have a holiday celebrating Pelagius the Third. He was terribly insane, as everyone from Wayrest is.
entries.translated_text: 我太兴奋了！在途歇城，我们有一个庆祝佩拉吉奥斯三世的节日。他疯得可怕，就像途歇城的每个人都一样。

entries.text: I... see. Well, I suppose we're the same in that regard. There aren't any friends waiting for me back home, either.
entries.translated_text: 我...明白了。嗯，我想我们在这方面是一样的。我也没有任何朋友在家里等着我。

entries.text: Ouch! Scrap! There are better ways to get attention!
entries.translated_text: 哎哟！小渣！不要这样来吸引注意力！

entries.text: Regarding Our Supplier
entries.translated_text: 关于我们的供应商

entries.text: I think you'll be glad you made this decision.
entries.translated_text: 你会为此满意的。

entries.text: (Laughing) This is the quickest friendship I've ever made! Alright, two!
entries.translated_text: （笑）这是我最快获得的友谊！好，第二杯！

entries.text: So the showdown's going to happen in a dwemer ruin? A perfect setting, if you ask me.
entries.translated_text: 所以对决会发生在锻莫遗址？如果你要说，那是完美的环境。

entries.text: Well, I don't mind explaining it.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我不介意解释一下。

entries.text: ...Uh, not that I condone murder or anything! It's just that otherwise she's a kind-hearted person. Mostly.
entries.translated_text: ...呃,不是说我支持谋杀或任何暴力行为!只是除此之外,她是一个心地善良的人。大概是。

entries.text: You are my world, Remi. Come here?
entries.translated_text: 你是我的全世界，蕾米。来吧？

entries.text: But very well. Just... Let's be quick. I'm not a fan of how much rock is hovering above our heads...
entries.translated_text: 但好吧，只是...我们赶快点，我不喜欢头上悬着这么多石头...

entries.text: Ria, you're always impressive in fights!
entries.translated_text: 利亚，你在战斗中总是令人印象深刻！

entries.text: Well. Maybe something in me is broken, but I've come to accept that.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许我内心的某些东西坏了，但我已经接受了这一点。

entries.text: I guess I am scared of that...
entries.translated_text: 我想我是害怕那个...

entries.text: Why are you looking at me like that?
entries.translated_text: 你为什么那样看着我？

entries.text: Yes, I think you're right, Yaz.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想你是对的，雅扎。

entries.text: Do you think black soul gems would be more effective in dwemer machines? Hmm...
entries.translated_text: 你认为黑色灵魂石在锻莫机器中会更有效吗？唔...

entries.text: Is it time to play Withershins?
entries.translated_text: 是时候玩接首字了吗？

entries.text: While I highly value books compiling research and discoveries, I also love to just have a... nice story to read.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我很重视编撰研究发现的书籍，但我也喜欢仅仅有个...不错的故事来看看。

entries.text: Uh... You know what? Yes. You'll be the first to read the finished product.
entries.translated_text: 呃...你知道吗？是的。您将是第一个阅读成品的人。

entries.text: Hm. Well. At least the market is nice? We could get some meat from the stall for a snack!
entries.translated_text: 嗯。好吧。至少集市还不错？我们可以去摊位买点肉当零食！

entries.text: Then let's head out.
entries.translated_text: 那么我们出发吧。

entries.text: Some of them do seem suspiciously related to frost trolls, don't they?
entries.translated_text: 他们中的一些人看起来确实与冰霜巨魔有可疑的关系，不是吗？

entries.text: Oh, Wylandriah, we've all been there.
entries.translated_text: 哦，维兰瑞亚，我们都有过这样的经历。

entries.text: And another one for me.
entries.translated_text: 再给我来一杯。

entries.text: Remi, Remi! Hey. (Whispering) Do you think you could buy me a drink?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，蕾米！嘿，（低语）你能请我喝一杯吗？

entries.text: Remi, Remi! Hey. (Whispering) Do you think you could buy me a drink?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，蕾米！嘿，（低语）你能请我喝一杯吗？

entries.text: Well, to start, its own king sold out the city. Left the gates open to raiders in the hopes that his enemies would be among those slaughtered.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，首先，它的国王曾经出卖过这座城市，向劫匪敞开大门，希望让入侵者杀死他的政敌。

entries.text: Well, to start, its own king sold out the city. Left the gates open to raiders in the hopes that his enemies would be among those slaughtered.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，首先，它的国王曾经出卖过这座城市。向入侵者敞开大门，希望让入侵者杀死他的政敌。

entries.text: What? You changed your mind before I even got home? Well, I'm not complaining.
entries.translated_text: 什么？我还没回家你就改变主意了？好吧，我不是在抱怨。

entries.text: So... Then I don't disappoint?
entries.translated_text: 所以... 那我不会让人失望吗？

entries.text: Thank the Divines the Thalmor don't have an army of dragons ready to invade. But that leaves the question of where these dragons are coming from.
entries.translated_text: 谢天谢地，不是梭默准备好的入侵的龙族大军，但这留下了问题，这些龙来自哪里。

entries.text: Who's a good boy? Not you! No, you're not!
entries.translated_text: 谁是好孩子？不是你！不，你不是！

entries.text: Well... My dear spouse's silence is making me think...
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我亲爱的爱人的沉默让重新我思考...

entries.text: Is this really how we're deciding our deaths at the hand of our adventurous friend?! Well, it is what it is. Let's begin.
entries.translated_text: 这真的是我们的冒险者朋友决定的死亡方式吗？！好吧，就是这样。让我们开始吧。

entries.text: (Whisper) Got it.
entries.translated_text: （低语）明白了。

entries.text: Well, I wouldn't say *nothing*.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我不会说“一无所知”。

entries.text: And even beyond that, there is a certain... draw toward others. Toward others' bodies. At least, that seems the case for most people.
entries.translated_text: 甚至在这之外，还有某种...对他人的吸引。比如，对他人的身体的吸引。至少，对大多数人来说似乎是这样的。

entries.text: Let's leave these Giants be. They're just living their lives, minding their own business...
entries.translated_text: 让我们离开这些巨人吧。他们只是过着自己的生活，专注于自己的事业...

entries.text: So if I believe revenge is the right course, you won't think any less of me?
entries.translated_text: 如果我认为复仇是正确的做法，你不会因此看轻我吧？

entries.text: I love adventuring, but sometimes I miss Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢冒险，但有时我会想念途歇城。

entries.text: ...Dwemechanic?
entries.translated_text: ...锻莫机械师？

entries.text: Remi, are you okay?!
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你还好吗？！

entries.text: How did Ancano know we'd be here? How did he tell this other Thalmor fellow?
entries.translated_text: 安卡诺怎么知道我们会在这里？他是怎么告诉这个他的梭默同伙的？

entries.text: I suppose I shouldn't judge that, at least; I also have a big appetite. N-not that I eat people, mind you.
entries.translated_text: 我想至少我不应该这么说，我的胃口也很大。当然我不是说吃人。

entries.text: Yeah, I know.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我知道。

entries.text: Trust me, I'm much happier here. What are you curious about, though?
entries.translated_text: 相信我，我在这里的日子更快乐。不过，你在好奇什么？

entries.text: It can be my personal workshop!
entries.translated_text: 它可以当我的个人工作室！

entries.text: Hey, little guy, what's wrong?
entries.translated_text: 嘿，小家伙，你怎么了？

entries.text: It's not lonely with everyone around.
entries.translated_text: 和身边的每一个人在一起并不孤单。

entries.text: There are so many falmer down here... Maybe we should try sneaking by them?
entries.translated_text: 这里有这么多伐莫...也许我们应该尝试从他们那边潜行过去？

entries.text: Wait, you're telling me your idea of 'hunting' is brawling with bears?! Divines spare me the preservation instincts of Nords.
entries.translated_text: 等等，你是在告诉我你的“狩猎”是和熊正面搏斗？！圣灵啊饶了我。

entries.text: They took they Eye!? No!
entries.translated_text: 他们拿走了马格努斯之眼！？不！

entries.text: Destruction.
entries.translated_text: 毁灭系。

entries.text: So did you often fight on behalf of nobles?
entries.translated_text: 所以你经常为贵族而战吗？

entries.text: ...Morvic?!
...The Order of the Hour...?
We did so good this time! Well, we always do good, but this is quite a bit of gold!
entries.translated_text: 我们这次干得不错！嗯，我们一直都做得很好，但这次的钱可不少！

entries.text: (Sigh) Yeah, I made her myself. I came up with the gear arrangement so I can reload faster.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）是啊，我自己做的。我想出了圆轮的排列方式，这样装弹就更快了。

entries.text: (Sigh) Yeah, I made her myself. I came up with the gear arrangement so I can reload faster.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）是啊，我自己做的。我想出了圆轮的排列方式，这样装弹就更快了。

entries.text: I like Serana. Her dry humour gets me.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢瑟拉娜，她干巴巴的幽默吸引了我。

entries.text: My name is... (Names H-N)
entries.translated_text: 我的名字是...（H-N）

entries.text: You are not going to believe what I found in Remi's pocket just now... If I didn't know better, I'd swear she was pranking me.
entries.translated_text: 你肯定不会相信我刚才在蕾米的口袋里发现了什么...如果我不知道，我发誓她在戏弄我。

entries.text: Calcelmo is nothing but a grumpy old man.
entries.translated_text: 卡塞莫不过是个暴躁的老人。

entries.text: That can't be cheap.
entries.translated_text: 那可不便宜。

entries.text: Alright...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: These floating particles... They're mushroom spores, right? Are we okay to be breathing this?
entries.translated_text: 这些漂浮的颗粒...它们是蘑菇孢子，对吧？我们可以吸它们吗？

entries.text: W-well, I thought I might be at first, but it seems I'm still living, as far as I can tell.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，一开始我以为是可能，但据我所知，我似乎还活着。

entries.text: They are quite powerful then?
entries.translated_text: 那他们很有权势？

entries.text: That's all we have for now.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我们现在仅有的。

entries.text: Okay, Ilia! We can do this! They don't stand a chance! Right?
entries.translated_text: 好的，伊利亚！我们能做到！他们一点机会都没！对吗？

entries.text: Ugh... This place is so loud! Remi, how can you stand it?!
entries.translated_text: 呃...这地方太吵了！蕾米，你怎么受得了？！

entries.text: But after the marriage was cut off, he became more hostile toward me. He was very angry that the Order had investigated him as well as me.
entries.translated_text: 但在婚约被取消后，他对我敌意更大了。他非常愤怒，认为骑士团不仅调查了我，也调查了他。

entries.text: Heh, I've... been better, honestly.
entries.translated_text: 呵呵，老实说，我...好多了。

entries.text: And when I eventually get stabbed to death, I'd rather it be by someone intelligent.
entries.translated_text: 当我最终被刺死时，我宁愿被聪明的人刺死。

entries.text: Thank you for-for your understanding.
entries.translated_text: 感谢您的理解。

entries.text: Yes, Scrap, they're leaving us alone now.
entries.translated_text: 是的，蕾米，他们现在要离开我们了。

entries.text: Born and raised.
entries.translated_text: 我是土生土长的。

entries.text: I do love the rain, but it's a bit irritating when it keeps dripping into my eyes.
entries.translated_text: 我确实喜欢雨天，但雨水一直滴进我的眼睛里就有点恼人了。

entries.text: I suppose. Compared to what I'm used to, their value system is very strange, though.
entries.translated_text: 我想。不过，与我习惯的相比，他们的价值体系很奇怪。

entries.text: For the most part, the dwemer lived in what is present-day Morrowind. Of course, even their more distant cities in Skyrim and High Rock are lovely.
entries.translated_text: 在大多数情况下，锻莫生活在今天的晨风。当然，即使是更远的天际和高岩城市也很可爱。

entries.text: Y-y-yes, I'm afraid our friend will have to come back to defrost us if we don't get out of this snow.
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，如果我们不走出这场雪，恐怕我们的朋友将不得不回来为我们解冻。

entries.text: After reading the book I gave her about Chaurus Pie, Remi has decided she wants to try it. I gathered all the necessary ingredients for Remi. We've arrived at the Candlehearth Hall kitchen, and Remi made the pie.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米读了我给她的关于巢蚁薄饼的书后，决定尝试一下。我为蕾米收集了所有必要的原料。我们到了烛炉堂厨房，蕾米做了馅饼。

entries.text: I bet they dream of Sovngaard. I mean, I'd dream of a paradise if I lived somewhere like this.
entries.translated_text: 我打赌他们梦到了松加德。我是说，如果我住在这样的地方，我会梦想我住在天堂。

entries.text: Is it what you need?
entries.translated_text: 这是你需要的吗？

entries.text: Teldryn isn't so bad, is he? And to think I used to be afraid of him.
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因没那么坏，是吗？想想我居然曾经害怕他。

entries.text: I was hoping it wouldn't smell this bad. Okay, here goes.
entries.translated_text: 我本希望它闻起来不会这么糟。好吧，来吧。

entries.text: Remi has decided she wants to make a 'portable chandelier'. She thinks that the only metal that could withstand the power necessary to create this is Aetherium, and she guessed correctly that some could be found in Arkngchal. I should wait for Remi to build the lantern.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米已经决定要做一个 "便携式吊灯"。她认为唯一能承受制造这个所需力量的材料是神光水晶，她猜得没错，在阿卡切尔可以找到一些。我应该等蕾米把灯笼造出来。

entries.text: Always nice to talk.
entries.translated_text: 总是很高兴与你交谈。

entries.text: Well, we'll need to take a copy to Enthir somehow.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我们得想办法带一份副本给恩赛尔。

entries.text: Is... Is that it? Finn's Lute? Wow, it, uh, looks really nice. I think. Are you sure this is it?
entries.translated_text: 是...这个吗？芬恩的鲁特琴？哇，它，呃，看起来真漂亮。我想的话。你确定是它吗？

entries.text: I don't trust this.
entries.translated_text: 我不相信这个。

entries.text: Just thinking how I may never get to ride a dragon.
entries.translated_text: 只是想着我可能永远也没机会骑上龙了。

entries.text: You don't like it, do you?
entries.translated_text: 你不喜欢它，是吗？

entries.text: Oh, most definitely. I can't wait to hear people at the next inn talking about them.
entries.translated_text: 哦，肯定。我迫不及待地想听到下个旅馆的人们讲鬼故事了。

entries.text: Take Remi to Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 带蕾米去阿卡切尔。

entries.text: (Whisper) What is it?
entries.translated_text: （低语）这是什么？

entries.text: You are not gonna believe how much we got paid for the last batch of junk you fixed up. Am I good, or what?
entries.translated_text: 你肯定想不到你上次修理的那批垃圾，我们赚了多少，我是不是很厉害？

entries.text: You write things? Like-like books?
entries.translated_text: 你写东西？就像写书一样？

entries.text: (Laughing) It's pretty heavy, isn't it!? Now you know how I feel all the time!
entries.translated_text: （笑）很重对吧！？现在你知道我一直以来的感受了！

entries.text: Look for the researchers and for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel (Unique Gyro Found)
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔（发现独特的陀螺仪）中寻找研究人员和有趣的文物

entries.text: Oh, isn't that the book about the man who could only engage in conversations alphabetically?
entries.translated_text: 哦，这不是书上那个关于那个只能按字母顺序进行对话的游戏吗？

entries.text: Remiel's Philter of Light Feet
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的潜行奇药

entries.text: And... Good luck out there.
entries.translated_text: 而且...祝你好运。

entries.text: N-no! I shouldn't have- I'm sorry, it's really my fault!
entries.translated_text: 不，对不起，真的是我的错。

entries.text: So we've explored quite a few dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 所以我们已经探索过相当多的锻莫遗迹了。

entries.text: You know what- Yes! There's one that I think would be both mentally stimulating for me and useful for the team.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗-是的！有一个我既感兴趣，又对团队有用东西。

entries.text: By Sheor, that dragon just rose from the dead! Look out, adventurer!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔，那条龙刚刚从死亡中复苏！小心，冒险者！

entries.text: Arkngchal's lift took me quite awhile to get working. I'd been conducting field research on other ruin's lifts, but fixing a lift was another story.
entries.translated_text: 我花了很长时间才让阿卡切尔的升降机重新工作，我对其他遗址的升降机进行过不少实地调查，但修理是它们是另一回事。

entries.text: My liege does enjoy killing them, and perhaps his favourite companion does, too.
entries.translated_text: 我的朋友确实喜欢杀死他们，也许他最喜欢的战友团也喜欢。

entries.text: So this Delphine is an enemy of the Thalmor? Or she's just bluffing and she's actually a Thalmor agent leading you into a trap! I don't trust her.
entries.translated_text: 所以这个戴尔芬是梭默的敌人？或者她只是在虚张声势，而她实际上是梭默特工，将你带入陷阱！我不相信她。

entries.text: Wonderful! Then, yes, exploring ruins is exactly like fighting trolls!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！那就对了——探索遗迹完全就像和巨魔战斗一样！

entries.text: Why yes, I'm a hardened warrior. Skyrim is a dangerous place to travel.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我是一个坚韧的战士。在天际是冒险需要点本事。

entries.text: Sounds like you've reached the part in the cave, with the Flame Atronach and the table covered with sweet rolls and flawless emeralds.
entries.translated_text: 听起来你已经到了山洞里的部分，里面有火焰元素和张铺满甜面包和无瑕绿宝石的桌子。

entries.text: What do you mean? A boy?
entries.translated_text: 你是什​​么意思？一个男孩？

entries.text: There are many more fights to come, and what are a few scars here and there, right?
entries.translated_text: 以后会有各种战斗，挂彩总是难免的，不是吗？

entries.text: (Whisper) Seems to be going well so far...
entries.translated_text: （低语）目前看来进展顺利...

entries.text: Oh! Congratulations on your wedding! Although, I thought you were already married? Well, it's none of my concern.
entries.translated_text: 哦！新婚快乐！不过，我记得你不是已经结婚了吗？嗯，这不关我的事。

entries.text: H-how... Uh.
entries.translated_text: 怎么（How，H开头）...呃。

entries.text: Uh-huh...
entries.translated_text: 嗯哼...

entries.text: Uh-huh...
entries.translated_text: 嗯哼...

entries.text: That's definitely understandable.
entries.translated_text: 这肯定可以理解。

entries.text: That's sweet, but I really think you should maybe go find someone to play tag with...
entries.translated_text: 太好了，但我真的认为你应该去找人一起玩...

entries.text: (Sigh) I suppose I must not have explained it very well. It doesn't matter who it is with, or how much I care for them...
entries.translated_text: （叹气）我想我一定没有解释清楚。和谁在一起并不重要，或者无论我有多在乎他们...

entries.text: Well, I'm suspicious that he's tracing where I've been somehow. Or maybe he just knows me well enough that I'd go to Markarth...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我怀疑他在追踪我去过的地方。或者也许他只是对我足够了解，猜出来了我会去马卡斯城...

entries.text: The artifacts I've discovered in Nchuand-Zel will make history one day.
entries.translated_text: 我在楚安德-泽尔发现的器物总有一天会创造历史的。

entries.text: 'Kagr' likely refers to 'tones'.
entries.translated_text: “Kagr”可能指的是“音调”。

entries.text: (Laugh) All you did was make me think of more delicious-tasting food. Nord food still seems terribly unappealing.
entries.translated_text: （笑）你所做的只是让我想到了更多美味的食物。诺德人的食物似乎仍然非常不讨人喜欢。

entries.text: You know I'm a lightweight, so this is going to end with a hangover. Sounds like we're going to have a blast!
entries.translated_text: 你知道我酒量很差，所以最后肯定会宿醉。听起来我们会玩得很开心！

entries.text: Do you really think so?
entries.translated_text: 你真的这样认为吗？

entries.text: The falmer and the dwemer fought the War of the Crag in Blackreach. This was the falmer uprising, which they won largely because the dwemer vanished.
entries.translated_text: 伐莫和锻莫在黑境进行了岩穴之战。这是一场伐莫起义，他们之所以获胜，主要是因为锻莫消失了。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. We have explored Nchuand-zel together, following in the footsteps of a lost expedition and searching for interesting artifacts. At the conclusion of our journey, Remi noticed a dwemer spider behaving oddly, and she seems to have taken a liking to it.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我们一起探索楚安德-泽尔，追随迷途探险的脚步，寻找有趣的文物。行程结束时，蕾米注意到一只矮人蜘蛛的行为很奇怪，她似乎已经喜欢上了它。

entries.text: I guess I understand. Why he wanted to kill me.
entries.translated_text: 我想我明白了，他为什么要杀我。

entries.text: You know you're important to me, right?
entries.translated_text: 你知道你对我很重要，对吧？

entries.text: Raven, great news! We lived!
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，好消息！我们活了下来！

entries.text: Did I hear you say you're from Wayrest, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 我听说过你来自途歇城，蕾米？

entries.text: You have to take me there! It should be easy for you, since you've already learned the layout!
entries.translated_text: 你必须带我去！这对你来说应该很容易，因为你已经了解了布局！

entries.text: Yes! Exactly like that. So, did you end up fighting the troll, then?
entries.translated_text: 是的！正是这样。那么，你最终与巨魔战斗了吗？

entries.text: I know you're made from dust, but it doesn't mean you have to fight dirty!
entries.translated_text: 我知道你是由尘土构成的，但这不代表你非得打得这么脏！

entries.text: Teldryn is sort of mean, isn't he?
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因有点刻薄，不是吗？

entries.text: I kill when I decide it's necessary.
entries.translated_text: 我认为有必要时就会杀人。

entries.text: Oh, Scrap did so go great, don't you think, Auri?
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣做得真棒，你不觉得吗，奥璃？

entries.text: I mean, they don't *have* to bully people. Probably. Should we join, do you think?
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，他们也不一定非得欺负别人吧。大概是这样。你觉得——我们要加入他们吗？

entries.text: I wouldn't even know where to start with it.
entries.translated_text: 我甚至都不知道从哪里开始。

entries.text: There must be less dangerous ways to make money?!
entries.translated_text: 一定有不那么危险的赚钱方式？！

entries.text: Yay! Swimming! Cannonball!
entries.translated_text: 耶！游泳！炮弹出击！

entries.text: No, of course not. Sometimes there's actual screaming. Bandits... prior expeditions... me...
entries.translated_text: 不，当然不是。有时真的会有尖叫声。强盗......之前的探险......我...

entries.text: Now, don't make things awkward. You don't want to fight as a team?
entries.translated_text: 现在，不要让事情变得尴尬。你不想作为一个团队战斗吗？

entries.text: You're really going to fight me and Joshua?!
entries.translated_text: 你真的要和我和约书亚打架吗？！

entries.text: So when you passed the entrance exam, they also just sort of let me in. Do you think they assumed I know what I'm doing, too?
entries.translated_text: 所以当你通过入学考试时，他们也就顺带让我进来了。你觉得他们也以为我知道自己在干什么吗？

entries.text: Yeah. My mother hoped I'd grow up to be a good Imperial citizen. You can see how that turned out!
entries.translated_text: 是啊，我妈妈希望我长大后能成为一名优秀的帝国公民，你知道原因了吧。

entries.text: Yes, they say it belongs to the Bretons. I'm a Breton, so I guess I own a piece.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他们说它属于布莱顿人。我是布莱顿人，所以我想我拥有一块土地。

entries.text: By the Eight, what a frightening thing to say.
entries.translated_text: 八圣灵，你说出了多么可怕的话。

entries.text: Ah! Bad Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 啊！坏小渣！

entries.text: But my instincts seem to disagree. Vehemently.
entries.translated_text: 但我的直觉似乎并不同意。激烈地反对。

entries.text: As long as you let me pay for it!
entries.translated_text: 只要你让我买单!

entries.text: Sheor, they're destroying Markarth! For a group that wants their land back, they're oddly willing to lay waste to it.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，他们在摧毁马卡斯城！作为一个想要夺回自己土地的族群，他们竟然不惜毁掉它。

entries.text: Dwemer Driller Abilities
entries.translated_text: 锻莫钻机能力

entries.text: Missing out on that, how could I say my life is complete?!
entries.translated_text: 错过了这件事，我怎么能说我的人生是完整的？！

entries.text: We made a couple of rest stops in Bruma and Falkreath, had some fun there... but overall I wouldn't have described it as much of an adventure.
entries.translated_text: 我们在布鲁马和佛克瑞斯停留了一会，在那里玩得挺开心...但总的来说，我不会把那段经历形容为多么刺激的冒险。。

entries.text: Is the Red Mountain as impressive as they say?
entries.translated_text: 红山真如他们所说的那么雄伟吗？

entries.text: Avanchnzel did not have any snow elf slaves. Lucky for us, since I don't particularly want to deal with Falmer right now.
entries.translated_text: 阿旺晨泽尔没有任何雪精灵奴隶，我们很幸运，因为我现在不想和伐莫打交道。

entries.text: Well, let's just say I'm a self-taught dwemechanic.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许我是一个自学成才的机械师。

entries.text: Well, let's just say I'm a self-taught dwemechanic.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许我是一个自学成才的锻莫机械师。

entries.text: Raven. Raven, look at me. Do not forget I am standing here. Don't forget me, Ray.
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，雷文，看着我，别忘了我站在这里，别忘了我，雷。

entries.text: Calcelmo... He let you in?! That bastard...!
entries.translated_text: 卡塞莫...他让你进来的？！那个混蛋...！

entries.text: I'm going to find it squashed and greasy under fourteen Dwemer contraptions in your backpack, aren't I?
entries.translated_text: 我会在你背包你发现它被十四个锻莫装置压得又扁又油腻，不是吗？

entries.text: These assassination targets are... strangers. You wouldn't kill the people you care about.
entries.translated_text: 这些暗杀目标是...陌生人。你不会去杀害你在乎的人。

entries.text: Scrap, come here for a moment.
entries.translated_text: 小渣，过来一会儿。

entries.text: Okay, you've convinced me. But my price is 100 septims and no kissing on the mouth. Okay, maybe once or twice.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你已经说服了我。但我的价格是100金币一次，而且不接受接吻。好吧，也许可以来免费赠送一次。

entries.text: I've also heard of all sorts of interesting creatures that live there. Hoarvors, Thunderbugs, and something called 'Monkeys'.
entries.translated_text: 我还听说过那里生活着各种有趣的生物。哈沃、电甲虫和一种叫做“猴子”的东西。

entries.text: No one can decide on who should rule it now, so it's been in the hands of a council of cut-throats and traitors until a decision is made.
entries.translated_text: 现在没有人可以决定那里由谁统治，所以在做出决定之前，它一直掌握在一群凶徒和叛徒组成的议会手中。

entries.text: I'm... sorry to hear that.
entries.translated_text: 我...很抱歉听到这个。

entries.text: W-what?! I believe I already paid up front! I certainly don't owe you any money.
entries.translated_text: 什-什么？！我已经预先付过款了！我当然不欠你钱。

entries.text: I'm certain these levers are intended to disengage the protections, but the question is in what order they should be pulled.
entries.translated_text: 我确信这些拉杆是用来解除锁定状态的，但问题是我们应该用什么顺序去启动他们。

entries.text: I admire your courage, friend. To face Skyrim's cold and people's stares wearing just your skin.
entries.translated_text: 我佩服你的勇气，朋友，能光着身子面对天际的寒冷和人们的凝视。

entries.text: This is... breathtaking. It tells a story and is beautiful and well-preserved. I could stare for hours.
entries.translated_text: 这...令人叹为观止。它讲述了一个故事，漂亮且保存完好，我可以盯着看几个小时。

entries.text: Including the 'fleshflies'?!
entries.translated_text: 包括 "肉蝇"？

entries.text: But that's awful!
entries.translated_text: 但这太糟了！

entries.text: Don't forget about Val. I fear he might die of fright if he becomes separated from us in here.
entries.translated_text: 别忘了瓦尔。如果他在这里和我们走散了，恐怕会吓死的。

entries.text: (Whisper) Should we really be talking right now?
entries.translated_text: （低语）我们现在真的应该说话吗？

entries.text: Oh! Wow, okay. Why not?
entries.translated_text: 哦！哇，好吧。为什么不呢？

entries.text: Vengeance is sweeter than moon sugar.
entries.translated_text: 复仇比月亮糖更甜。

entries.text: You couldn't tell from the book? It's very detailed.
entries.translated_text: 你从书上看不出来？这写的明明白白。

entries.text: How much do you suppose this lute is worth exactly? Who is Finn? Inge isn't Finn so we really don't need to give this probably priceless lute to her.
entries.translated_text: 你认为这把鲁特琴到底值多少钱？芬恩是谁？因格又不是芬恩，所以我们其实不需要把这把可能是无价之宝的鲁特琴送给她。

entries.text: Anyway, you don't need to fear disease. I'll find a way to cure anything that ails you.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，你不必害怕疾病，我会找到一种方法来治愈任何让你感到不适的东西。

entries.text: I think we make a good team, Revan!
entries.translated_text: 我认为我们是一支优秀的团队，渡鸦！

entries.text: So 'The Aetherium Wars' was plagiarized by her own apprentice. I'd never forgive him were I in her shoes.
entries.translated_text: 所以《神光之战》是她自己的学徒抄袭的，如果我是她，我绝不会原谅他。

entries.text: Yes, I was told as much when I tried to order it at the Silver Blood Inn.
entries.translated_text: 对，当我在银血旅店想点这道菜时，有人说过。

entries.text: All this walking is becoming boring, so I'd think so.
entries.translated_text: 所以我想是的，一直在走路真无聊。（ALL，A开头）

entries.text: They were always spoken about as dangerous, wild, and unpredictable.
entries.translated_text: 他们总是被说成是危险的、狂野的、不可预测的。

entries.text: That's right. We find items together, you arrange the useless parts into something I can sell, and we split the profits.
entries.translated_text: 这就对了。我们一起找东西，你把没用的部分整理成我能卖的东西，然后我们平分利润。

entries.text: The frostbite spider signifies, uh... danger! And, uh, multiple types of danger, as represented by its legs.
entries.translated_text: 霜噬蜘蛛意味着，呃......危险！而且，呃，还是多种类型的危险，就像它的腿所代表的那样。

entries.text: Scratch wanting to ride a dragon. Silt Striders are my new life dream.
entries.translated_text: 放弃骑龙把，阔步沙蚤是我的人生梦想。

entries.text: Well, I'm glad I could help!
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴我能帮上忙！

entries.text: Maybe... It's hard to notice when it's about yourself, you know?
entries.translated_text: 也许...当这事关自己时，你很难意识到，你知道吗？

entries.text: You know, I quite enjoy talking with people! It just seems like I do it wrong, given others' responses to me.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我很喜欢与人交流！只是从别人对我的反应来看，我好像做得不对。

entries.text: These aren't really his research notes if they aren't written by him, are they?
entries.translated_text: 如果这些不是他写的，那就不算是他的研究笔记，对吧？

entries.text: So nice of these bandits to set up camp for us.
entries.translated_text: 这些土匪真好，为我们安营扎寨。

entries.text: That's not what I would call it.
entries.translated_text: 我才不会那样称呼。

entries.text: Amazing that this place has remained hidden so long. Look at how beautiful it is!
entries.translated_text: 令人惊讶的是，这个地方隐藏了这么久。看看它有多美！

entries.text: About what you call me...
entries.translated_text: 关于你该叫我什么...

entries.text: Nope. See, that's forcing it. Just be you; there's only one. Only one Remi, and she's pretty good how she is.
entries.translated_text: 不。听着，不要刻意改变。做你自己就好;世上只有一个蕾米，她很棒。

entries.text: Auri always seems to say what's on her mind. It's nice.
entries.translated_text: 奥璃似乎总会说出她的想法，这真好。

entries.text: Well, bye, Revan. Bye for now, at least.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，再见，渡鸦。至少现在是再见。

entries.text: Ha-ha. Very funny. But really. Next time we're stopped somewhere, I'm going to have a nice, big meal. I'll share with you?
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。非常有趣。但真的。下次我们在什么地方停下来的时候，我要吃一顿丰盛的大餐。你想和我一起吗？

entries.text: Welcome back to the world of the living. I think. It's so bright that maybe we're in a plane of Oblivion. Does your head hurt? Mine sure does.
entries.translated_text: 欢迎回到生者的世界。我想是的。亮得让人怀疑我们是不是在湮灭位面，你的头疼吗？我的确实疼得厉害。

entries.text: So, my loving spouse, what now?
entries.translated_text: 所以，亲爱的，现在怎么办？

entries.text: Do you think dragons can fly to the moons?
entries.translated_text: 你认为龙能飞到月亮上吗？

entries.text: Dead, dead, and dead.
entries.translated_text: 死了，死了，都死了。

entries.text: You'll have to tell me all about Morrowind sometime! Oh, you, ah, you are from Morrowind, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 你什么时候告诉我晨风的事！哦，你，啊，你来自晨风，不是吗？

entries.text: You taught me some reading, so how about I teach you some hunting? Fair warning, I only hunt the animals that don't run away.
entries.translated_text: 你教我读书，我教你打猎怎么样？提前说好，我只猎杀不会逃跑的动物。

entries.text: The disappearance of the dwemer left behind dangerous artifacts. In the wrong hands, they can be catastrophic.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫的消失留下了危险的神器，如果落在坏人手中，那就是灾难。

entries.text: I guess that makes sense, from what I know about you.
entries.translated_text: 根据我对你的了解，我想这是有道理的。

entries.text: Marker Storage Unit
entries.translated_text: 标记储备格

entries.text: I'd rather have steel.
entries.translated_text: 我更想用钢。

entries.text: F-fleshflies?!
entries.translated_text: 肉...肉蝇？

entries.text: I'm not entirely sure this is the best place for a chitchat.
entries.translated_text: 我不完全确定这是闲聊的最佳场所。

entries.text: Wait, *are* you offering them these services?
entries.translated_text: 等等，你要为他们提供这种服务？

entries.text: Perfect, now I will lift from this side.
entries.translated_text: 完美，现在我从这边抬起来。

entries.text: Thanks, ma! I'm going to go play soldier with a tree!
entries.translated_text: 谢谢啦，妈妈！我要去和一棵树扮演士兵了！

entries.text: I've always been obsessed with the dwemer. Don't know if you could tell.
entries.translated_text: 我一直对锻莫很着迷。不知道是否该对你说。

entries.text: I 'may' have sampled moon sugar once or twice in the past, but I didn't realize you could bake with it. I can't wait to see what Remi comes up with!
entries.translated_text: 我以前 "可能 "尝过一两次月亮糖，但没想到还能用来烘焙。我迫不及待地想看看蕾米的创意！

entries.text: Victory is ours!
entries.translated_text: 我们胜利了！

entries.text: Wow, renovating a dwemer ruin is a lot of work!
entries.translated_text: 哇，翻新一个锻莫遗址是一项艰巨的工作！

entries.text: In any case, I propose our main focus should be getting out of here. My skin is crawling with all this rock surrounding us.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，我觉得我们的主要任务是离开这里。周围全是岩石，我浑身都起鸡皮疙瘩。

entries.text: Riften
entries.translated_text: 裂谷城

entries.text: And that'll be your fault. I'll be sure to spread the word that you wouldn't let The Gourmet work at their best!
entries.translated_text: 那将是你的错。我一定会传出去，说是你不让美食家发挥出最佳水平！

entries.text: I can't say I understand the world of fashion, but I suppose that outfit looks... expensive. Maybe we could sell it after you're done modeling.
entries.translated_text: 我虽然不太了解时尚，但我想这套衣服看起来...很贵。也许我们可以在你做完模特后把它卖掉。

entries.text: Certainly. Argonians are no different than you and I, and they make for great friends.
entries.translated_text: 当然。亚龙人和你我没有什么不同，他们也能成为我们的好朋友。

entries.text: Ooooh, does it look like I'm going to die? I feel like I'm dying.
entries.translated_text: 噢，看起来我要死了吗？我感觉自己快死了。

entries.text: I never liked Nord mead.
entries.translated_text: 我从来不喜欢诺德蜜酒。

entries.text: Oh, wonderful, I was feeling a little fancy today.
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了，今天我正想享受一把。

entries.text: A tension wrench, so to speak. Sounds simple enough, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 可以说是个张力扳手，听起来很简单，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: Thank you! I think Val and I will have enough money for a palace soon. Well, maybe not *soon*. But eventually. Would you like to join in?
entries.translated_text: 谢谢，我想瓦尔和我很快就会有足够的钱建造一座宫殿了。也许不是很快，但终究会有的，你想加入吗？

entries.text: Needless to say, I'm not engaged anymore.
entries.translated_text: 不用说，我也不用再订婚了。

entries.text: We used to have a legacy. Not anymore. ...Aela, do you believe vengeance is wrong?
entries.translated_text: 我们曾经也有过传承。不再。...艾拉，你认为复仇是错的吗？

entries.text: He doesn't look very... uh, philosophical. But hey, appearances can be deceiving, right?
entries.translated_text: 他看起来不是很...呃，很有哲思。但嘿，外表是有欺骗性的，对吗？

entries.text: I mean those a-are great skills, and obviously important for your-ah-upbringing. But it's not *education.*
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，那些——那些确实是很棒的技能，而且显然对你的，呃，成长很重要。可那不算是“教育”。

entries.text: But why did he vanish?
entries.translated_text: 但是他为什么消失了？

entries.text: Excited?
entries.translated_text: 兴奋了？

entries.text: I was just wondering about your, ah, necromancy. It's very intriguing.
entries.translated_text: 我只是想知道你的，啊，死灵术。这很有趣。

entries.text: It's Gore.
entries.translated_text: 我叫格雷.

entries.text: I wonder what sorts of experiments everyone is up to?
entries.translated_text: 我想知道每个人都在做什么样的实验？

entries.text: Kill Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 杀死莫维奇。

entries.text: Kill Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 杀死莫维克。

entries.text: 'Nothing' is better than what I could do to get the information. (Intimidate)
entries.translated_text: 你什么也拿不到，要试试吗。（威吓）

entries.text: The use of the Numidium fundamentally broke time. It makes me anxious, wondering if there's another me in another timeline, split due to the dwemer.
entries.translated_text: 纳米迪安的使用从根本上打破了时间。这让我很焦虑，想知道在另一个时间线上是否还有另一个我，因为锻莫而分裂。

entries.text: That was amazing! Scrap really saved us! By himself!
entries.translated_text: 真是太棒了！小渣真的救了我们！就凭他一个！

entries.text: Agreed.
entries.translated_text: 同意。

entries.text: Agreed.
entries.translated_text: 同意。

entries.text: Let's see what I have...
entries.translated_text: 让我们看看我有多少...

entries.text: Well, here's one of those resonance gems. I'm very interested in how they work. 'Resonance' implies some sort of tonal magic at work.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这是其中一种共振宝石。我对它们的工作方式非常感兴趣。“共振”意味着某种音调魔法在起作用。

entries.text: Oh. Okay, if you're sure.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧，如果你确定的话。

entries.text: Yes! Yes, please, I'd love that!
entries.translated_text: 是的！是的，好，我很喜欢！

entries.text: I... I don't know what to do...
entries.translated_text: 我...我不知道该怎么办...

entries.text: Well, bye, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，再见，我想。

entries.text: It looks like a bunch of diamond shapes all overlapping one another. Like a fern? Except gray-ish. So not a fern.
entries.translated_text: 它看起来像一堆钻石形状，彼此重叠在一起。像蕨类植物？除了是灰色这点。所以不会是蕨类植物。

entries.text: Alright, Aela, I'm ready for some of your battle wisdom.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾拉。我已经准备好聆听你的战斗智慧了。

entries.text: Alright, Aela, I'm ready for some of your battle wisdom.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾拉。我已经准备好聆听你的战斗智慧了。
