entries.text: Alright, Aela, I'm ready for some of your battle wisdom.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾拉。我已经准备好聆听你的战斗智慧了。

entries.text: Alright, Aela, I'm ready for some of your battle wisdom.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾拉。我已经准备好聆听你的战斗智慧了。

entries.text: Alright, Aela, I'm ready for some of your battle wisdom.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，艾拉。我已经准备好聆听你的战斗智慧了。

entries.text: Always a bright side.
entries.translated_text: 怎么都棒。

entries.text: Well, except the time one of my hired arms tripped a Dwemer trap and we had to spend a day gathering the various pieces of him...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，除了有一次我的一个雇佣兵绊倒了一个锻莫陷阱，我们不得不花一天时间收集他的各种碎片。

entries.text: We're done talking, Ubbe? Sometimes it's hard for me to tell.
entries.translated_text: 我们聊完了，乌贝？有时我很难说。

entries.text: O-oh. Yes, I think they say that home is a person. Or people in this case.
entries.translated_text: 哦-哦。是的，我想他们说，有人的地方才是家。

entries.text: She ran, panicked and lost in the fog, until she stumbled across a small cabin. She'd never seen it before, but still she pounded on the door.
entries.translated_text: 她惊慌失措地逃跑着，迷失在雾中，直到她偶然发现了一个小木屋。她以前从没见过这座小屋，但她还是敲了敲门。

entries.text: Ahmed, Scrap is shy, but you should know he likes you.
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德，小渣很害羞，但你应该知道他喜欢你。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. I should show Remi this letter.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，她对蕾米尔对他的姓氏的影响感到轻视。我应该把这封信给蕾米看。

entries.text: That's incredible. I love someone telling the Thalmor where they can stick it.
entries.translated_text: 真是难以置信。我就喜欢有人敢当面告诉梭默该滚哪去。

entries.text: 'Oh, so what was your experience traveling Skyrim like, Remi?'
entries.translated_text: ‘哦，那么你在天际旅行的经历是怎样的呢，蕾米？’

entries.text: Go, Scrap! I choose you!
entries.translated_text: 走吧，小渣！我选择你！

entries.text: I got to talk to our friend about it, and I am feeling better about it now. But still I... (Sigh) Okay. Maybe I do not feel better about it.
entries.translated_text: 我必须和我们的朋友谈谈这件事，我现在感觉好多了。但我仍然...（叹气）好吧。也许我对此感觉不太好。

entries.text: No. (Laugh) Not for a second. They're just piles of machinery. If anything, those soul gems raise some questions, though.
entries.translated_text: 不。（笑）从来没有。它们只是一堆机器。如果要说，就只有那些灵魂石有争议。

entries.text: Well, er, my father gives me things that I cannot typically... acquire. He has a lot of such things moving through his inventory.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，呃，我父亲给了我一些我通常无法......获得的东西。他的库存里有很多这样的东西。

entries.text: Surely someone would have noticed a person trailing blood about the city?
entries.translated_text: 肯定会有人注意到一个人在城市里一路滴着血吧？

entries.text: He's actually the one who taught me how to use a dagger. It's a good skill to have when one of your shipments is being raided.
entries.translated_text: 他实际上是教我如何使用匕首的人。当你的货物被劫掠时，这是一项很有用的技能。

entries.text: He's actually the one who taught me how to use a dagger. It's a good skill to have when one of your shipments is being raided.
entries.translated_text: 他实际上就是教我如何使用匕首的人，当你的货物被劫掠时，这是一项很有用的技能。

entries.text: Well, it's good to meet you... Er, I don't actually know your name?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，很高兴认识你...呃，我其实不知道你的名字？

entries.text: Yes, I hoped so.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我希望如此。

entries.text: Look, I think it's obvious I want you to succeed. It would just help if you could explain it to me, me being dumber than a snowberry and all.
entries.translated_text: 听着，我觉得很明显，我是希望你成功的，只是如果你能给我解释一下就好了，毕竟我笨得连雪果都不如。

entries.text: I was thinking... What if I strapped pieces of Dwemer automaton to you, in order to increase your strength?
entries.translated_text: 我刚在想...要是我把一些锻莫机器的部件装到你身上，增强你的力量，会怎么样？

entries.text: It's warm, it's refined, and it'll get you drunk all the same.
entries.translated_text: 它是温暖而精致，也同样醉人。

entries.text: I could say the same about every Nord home. I didn't think Nords were so ugly!
entries.translated_text: 我可以对每个诺德人的家都这么评价。我没想到诺德人的房子都如此丑陋!

entries.text: I'll tell you, a Breton from High Rock in the city of Markarth, and his presence there caused something of a problem.
entries.translated_text: 我告诉你，一个来自高岩的布莱顿人出现在马卡斯城，而他的存在引发了一些麻烦。

entries.text: Oh! I mean...
entries.translated_text: 哦！我是说...

entries.text: Okay, close your hand. Don't peek! You have to guess what it is!
entries.translated_text: 好了，把手合上别偷看你得猜猜这是什么！

entries.text: Hello.
entries.translated_text: 你好。

entries.text: I see. It sounds like you and your sister are close, then?
entries.translated_text: 我懂了。听起来你和你姐姐很亲密，然后呢？

entries.text: Oh! Wow, that's, um.
entries.translated_text: 哦！哇，原来如此，嗯。

entries.text: Really? I must say I'm a bit fond of Sheogorath myself, but... He is a daedra. Okay, writing that.
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？我必须说我自己有点喜欢谢尔格拉，但是...他确实是个魔神。好，就这么写。

entries.text: And the other pile is sorted by which pieces made me the most angry and were banished from my useful pile.
entries.translated_text: 而另一堆则是一些我用不上的破玩意。

entries.text: I wish I had fur like you, J'zargo. Anything to keep warm in this miserable snow.
entries.translated_text: 我希望我有像你一样的皮毛，吉'扎格。在这凄惨的雪地里，有什么可以取暖的。

entries.text: By extension, they said, we abandoned all of the Eight.
entries.translated_text: 他们说，由此可见，我们放弃了八圣灵信仰。

entries.text: Wow, er, Gourmet, this is going to be your best Potage le Magnifique yet.
entries.translated_text: 哇，呃，美食家，这将是你迄今为止最好的超级棒的绝美浓汤。

entries.text: Head there, and you'll get what you're after. I wish you the best of luck.
entries.translated_text: 去那里，你会得到你想要的。祝你好运。

entries.text: Ah, it's something like coward, but a little more... Harsh. There's also 'ruth.' They say that a lot. It's along the lines of 'damn.'
entries.translated_text: 啊，这个词有点像“懦夫”，但语气更……严厉一点。还有一个词是“鲁斯”，他们也经常说。大概相当于“该死”或“他妈的”这样的语气词。

entries.text: Yeah, yeah, I've heard that before. Don't worry; I'll keep my hands from your neck. This time.
entries.translated_text: 对，对，我以前听说过。别担心嘛，我会把手从你的脖子上移开，就这次。

entries.text: Shall I get us some drinks, Rumarin?
entries.translated_text: 我给我们拿些饮品好吗，鲁米勒？

entries.text: Mercer seems off... It makes me nervous. Please be careful, my partner in crime.
entries.translated_text: 墨瑟看起来不对劲...这让我很紧张，请小心我的犯罪同伙·。

entries.text: What in Oblivion are you talking about?
entries.translated_text: 你在到底在说什么？

entries.text: How should I know? They all look the same to me.
entries.translated_text: 我怎么知道？他们看起来都一样。

entries.text: You know, I think dwarven spiders are adorable, but they're too wild to make for good pets.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我觉得矮人蜘蛛很可爱，但它们太狂野了，不适合做宠物。

entries.text: Are you doing okay out there, Ganbald?!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗，甘巴尔德？！

entries.text: Do. Not. Hit. Nar!
entries.translated_text: 不要，纳尔！

entries.text: She taught the birds to sing and gave the rivers their tinkling, ethereal tune.
entries.translated_text: 她教会鸟儿歌唱，赋予河流清脆悦耳的旋律。

entries.text: Just enough to get by, huh? That's me, too.
entries.translated_text: 勉强过得去吧？我也是这样。

entries.text: Just enough to get by, huh? That's me, too.
entries.translated_text: 勉强过得去吧？我也是这样。

entries.text: Dawnguard. I have to say the name is fitting. And it's an added bonus that it sounds pretty cool.
entries.translated_text: 黎明守卫，不得不说，这个名字很贴切。而且额外加分的是，它听起来也挺酷的。

entries.text: What was...? Are you chewing?!
entries.translated_text: 什么...？你在嚼东西吗？

entries.text: ...Really?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？

entries.text: Hey, Rumarin.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，鲁马林。

entries.text: Gods, you're ugly. Don't look, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 天啊，你真丑。别看，蕾米。

entries.text: Oh no, that's certainly not right. Although it seems to be closer to the ideal.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，那肯定不对，不过离成功越来越近了。

entries.text: You'll never believe this, but my mother told me that my great-great-great-great-great aunt was an Altmer. Personally, I think that's unlikely.
entries.translated_text: 你永远不会相信这一点，但我妈妈告诉我，我的曾曾曾曾祖母是一个高精灵。我个人认为这不太可能。

entries.text: Besides I've... um... grown out of it. Definitely don't steal snacks anymore.
entries.translated_text: 此外，我已经...嗯...长大了。绝对不会再偷零食了。

entries.text: You're embarrassing me!
entries.translated_text: 你让我难堪！

entries.text: The two of us together... We're an unstoppable team. Let's go see the world!
entries.translated_text: 我们两个一起...我们是一支不可阻挡的团队。我们去看看这世界吧！

entries.text: Just normal kid stuff.
entries.translated_text: 就是普通的孩子的生活。

entries.text: Some, but not as much as I could if you weren't talking to me.
entries.translated_text: 有一点，但如果你不和我说话的话，我能做得更多。

entries.text: There are a couple theories about why Nchardak sank after the dwemer vanished. The most interesting is that the automatons flooded it to preserve it.
entries.translated_text: 关于为什么纳查达克在锻莫消失后沉没的原因有几种说法。最有趣的说法是，是自动机器们淹没了它以保护它。

entries.text: Write it out? Err... Why do that when I could just say it...?
entries.translated_text: 写出来？额...我既然能说出来为什么要写...？

entries.text: I bet this inn is a lively one.
entries.translated_text: 我打赌这家旅店一定很热闹。

entries.text: You're still pretty naive.
entries.translated_text: 你还是很天真。

entries.text: And you're probably right.
entries.translated_text: 你可能是对的。

entries.text: Watch your step, Teldryn.
entries.translated_text: 注意脚下，泰卓因。

entries.text: Don't. Don't even think of it. I-I'm out of here!
entries.translated_text: 不，想都别想。我，我得离开这里！

entries.text: Whoa, you smell like a leg of goat roast. Was J'zargo trying to cook you?
entries.translated_text: 哇，你闻起来像烤山羊腿。吉'扎格是不是想把你当晚餐烤了？？

entries.text: W-well, I suppose it wouldn't be comforting if you weren't accustomed to it. Perhaps you will show me the places you find better than 'fine' someday?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我想如果你不习惯的话，这不会让人感到安慰。也许有一天你会向我展示你发现比“好”更好的地方？

entries.text: I hope you've brought me some inspiration, Ria. I've run out of my own for now.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你给我带来了一些灵感，利亚。我现在已经用完了自己的。

entries.text: Well... You should probably tell that priest we're having a wedding!
entries.translated_text: 嗯...你应该告诉那个祭司我们要举行婚礼！

entries.text: Most of it I heard with The Ravens.
entries.translated_text: 大多数都是群鸦团的人说过的。

entries.text: And I'll grab some stuff to sell, too, so I can give you more gold when we finish up.
entries.translated_text: 我也会拿些东西卖掉，这样我们完成后我可以给你更多的金币。

entries.text: Perfect. And are these for you, or for me?
entries.translated_text: 完美，这些是给你的，还是给我的？

entries.text: Perfect. And are these for you, or for me?
entries.translated_text: 完美，这些是给你的，还是给我的？

entries.text: Perfect. And are these for you, or for me?
entries.translated_text: 完美，这些是给你的，还是给我的？

entries.text: Perfect. And are these for you, or for me?
entries.translated_text: 完美，这些是给你的，还是给我的？

entries.text: Scrap, it's just occurred to me you've never seen Arkngchal! What do you think? Do you love it?
entries.translated_text: 小渣，我突然想到你从未来过阿卡切尔！你怎么想？你喜欢吗？

entries.text: And in those hunts... eh... are people... sometimes the prey?
entries.translated_text: 在那些狩猎中...呃...人...有时是猎物吗？

entries.text: (Sigh) I guess there's no changing your mind.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）我想你是不会改变主意了。

entries.text: Revan, we lived! Not that I- Not that I doubted we would!
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，我们活了下来了！不只是我——不是我怀疑我们会！

entries.text: I'd starve without you. No pressure, though.
entries.translated_text: 没有你我会饿死的。不过，不要有压力。

entries.text: I can see that.
entries.translated_text: 我明白了。

entries.text: I can see that.
entries.translated_text: 我明白了。

entries.text: I'm very brave! I'm also just... aware of my limitations in battle, is all.
entries.translated_text: 我非常勇敢！我也只是...知道我在战斗中的不足，就是这样。

entries.text: I can't imagine a scenario in which the Stormcloaks and the Imperials sit in the same room without it becoming a bloodbath.
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象风暴斗篷和帝国人坐在同一个房间而不变血流成河的场景。

entries.text: Sheor, there really is a-a whole flock of vampires here? Is that the correct term? Pack? Colony? Drove? A gaggle? A gaggle of vampires?
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，这里真的有一群吸血鬼？这个词正确吗？一群？一聚落？驱赶？一片？一城吸血鬼？

entries.text: What is it, Ganbald?
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德，这是什么？

entries.text: I like to take apart machines and put them together again.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢把机器拆开再组装起来。

entries.text: I like to take apart machines and put them together again.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢把机器拆开再组装起来。

texts: Do you see the busts below the levers? Hit them with this, and I'll know which one you're wanting me to pull!
你看到拉杆下面的半身像了吗？你只需要用这个敲打他们，我就能知道你想拉哪一个！

entries.text: When the previous owner died, did everyone just come in and take her furniture? Although I suppose a dead woman has no use for possessions.
entries.translated_text: 前任房屋主人去世后，大家都是直接进来搬走了她的家具吗？虽然我想一个死去的女人来说对财产也都没有用了。

entries.text: Oh no, oh no. Ilia! Ilia! Something is trying to kill us!
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，哦，不。伊利亚！伊利亚！有什么东西想杀死我们！

entries.text: Let me know if there's anything else you need.
entries.translated_text: 如果你还有什么需要的话，告诉我。

entries.text: Let me know if there's anything else you need.
entries.translated_text: 如果你还有什么需要的话，告诉我。

entries.text: Let me know if there's anything else you need.
entries.translated_text: 如果你还有什么需要的话，告诉我。

entries.text: Serana, your parents aren't exactly... conventional, are they?
entries.translated_text: 瑟拉娜，你的父母不太...传统，是吗

entries.text: Remiel's Potion of Health
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的生命药水

entries.text: Oh, I know! I'll just hire a mercenary to kill it!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我知道！那我就雇个佣兵杀了它！

entries.text: (Whisper) And... open!
entries.translated_text: （低语）还有。。。打开

entries.text: Doing great! Now that we're finally taking a break, I get to read the next chapter of my book.
entries.translated_text: 做的很好！现在我们终于要休息了，我可以阅读我书的下一章了。

entries.text: I have to admit, though... I can't stop looking over my shoulder. It feels like there's someone behind me at every turn.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我不得不承认...我不能停止回头看。感觉每次转身都有人在身后。

entries.text: I can't wait to see what Skyrim has in store for me.
entries.translated_text: 我迫不及待地想看看天际为我准备了什么。

entries.text: I can't wait to see what Skyrim has in store for me.
entries.translated_text: 我迫不及待地想看看天际为我准备了什么。

entries.text: (Laughing) Oh, little Gleda! I wish you could remember poor Ennis's face when you shouted to him that you were taking her to live with a giant.
entries.translated_text: （笑声）哦，小格丽达！我希望你能记得可怜的埃尼斯的脸，当你对他喊着说你要带她去一个巨人一起生活时。

entries.text: If treasure is worth anything, it's never leisurely to get. Trust me, I've delved into many ruins for treasure.
entries.translated_text: 一个真正有价值的宝藏绝不会触手可及。相信我，我曾深入许多遗址里寻找宝藏。

entries.text: How is it going?
entries.translated_text: 最近好吗？

entries.text: What are your hobbies?
entries.translated_text: 你的爱好是什么？

entries.text: I'd never, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我永远不会，蕾米。

entries.text: Do you ever sing?
entries.translated_text: 你会唱歌吗？

entries.text: Do you want me to get you something to eat?
entries.translated_text: 你想让我给你拿点吃的吗？

entries.text: Worship is following the tenets of a Divine.
entries.translated_text: 信仰是遵循圣灵的信条。

entries.text: Now we destroy the Brotherhood.
entries.translated_text: 现在我们要摧毁黑手兄弟会。

entries.text: Get Remi a piece of jewelry.
entries.translated_text: 给蕾米买一件首饰。

entries.text: Farillae.
entries.translated_text: 法里拉。

entries.text: If you really think it's wrong...
entries.translated_text: 如果你真的认为这是错的...

entries.text: I meant that they usually kill quickly. Not that I have much experience with dying to one.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，它们通常很快就会挂掉。我没有太多死在它们手上的经验。

entries.text: I don't even want to hear about it. Whatever happened in that place, I don't want to have any reason to imagine it.
entries.translated_text: 我甚至听都不想听。不管在那个地方发生了什么，我都不想知道。

entries.text: I don't even want to hear about it. Whatever happened in that place, I don't want to have any reason to imagine it.
entries.translated_text: 我甚至听都不想听。不管在那个地方发生了什么，我都不想知道。

entries.text: You still haven't told me what you're figuring out in the first place.
entries.translated_text: 你一开始还没告诉我你在想什么。

entries.text: It's like I'm bringing all the strength of all the beasts inside me.
entries.translated_text: 就像我将所有野兽的所有力量都带入了我体内。

entries.text: Not my favourite topic, but I'm not a murderer. Sometimes you have to kill or be killed, though.
entries.translated_text: 这不是我最喜欢的话题，我不是杀人犯。但有时你不得不杀人否则就会被杀。

entries.text: Val, I need you, er, opinion on a... hobby.
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔，我需要你，呃，关于一个......爱好的意见。

entries.text: On the coldest of nights, in the steam rising from my breath, I see the many faces of the dead.
entries.translated_text: 在最最寒冷的夜晚，从我呼出的白气里，总能看见许多死去的灵魂。

entries.text: Oh! Woah, woah, woah! Be careful, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 哦哇，哇，哇！小心，小渣！

entries.text: And to you, too, I think. That includes me, you know. I've taken a liking to you, too.
entries.translated_text: 我想，对你来说也是如此。这包括我，你知道的。我也喜欢上你了。

entries.text: You took the words right out of my mouth. I am more than comfortable in my own burned skin.
entries.translated_text: 你说出了我的心里话。我现在对自己有烧伤的皮肤已经不那么难过了。

entries.text: Oh, Jaxon, are you okay? Did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 哦，贾克森，你还好吗？你需要什么吗？

entries.text: No, I'll stick to opining sarcastically, thank you.
entries.translated_text: 不，谢谢，我还是坚持发表讽刺性意见就好。

entries.text: Oh? Tell me more?
entries.translated_text: 哦？多告诉我一点？

entries.text: Is this about our mutual 'hobby', Remi? What's the situation?
entries.translated_text: 是关于我们共同的 "爱好 "吗, 蕾米?什么情况？

entries.text: After a long day, a warm drink and a warm bed sounds good, doesn't it?
entries.translated_text: 在漫长的一天后，一杯热饮和一张温暖的床听起来不错，不是吗？

entries.text: Oh! Wow, I just want to visit Valenwood more and more.
entries.translated_text: 哦！哇，我迫不及待想去威木省了。

entries.text: I'm not sure how retrieving a Horn of all things will prove you're Dragonborn, but I guess Arngeir is the boss.
entries.translated_text: 我不确定如何找回号角这些将如何证明你是龙裔，但我猜是艾恩盖尔说了算。

entries.text: Khash said something one of those times we were in battle... "Tusk up some tusker?" What is that?
entries.translated_text: 卡什在我们某次战斗时说了一句话...“戳穿些野兽吧？” 这是什么意思？

entries.text: If you really want to talk to me, watch your words. You're on thin ice.
entries.translated_text: 如果你真想跟我说话，就注意你的言辞，你现在可是如履薄冰。

entries.text: Rieklings are so cute! Being so fierce yet so small just adds to their adorable-ness.
entries.translated_text: 蓝客灵太可爱了！如此凶猛又如此渺小只会让他们更可爱。

entries.text: Scrap and I still have a lot to see, so we'll be... We'll be going now.
entries.translated_text: 小渣和我还有很多东西要看，所以我们会...我们现在就出发。

entries.text: He is rather suspicious. But is it the Thalmor-bit or the magic-bit that makes him that way?
entries.translated_text: 他相当可疑。但是，是梭默还是魔法让他变成这样的？

entries.text: Look for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel (Unique Cog Found)
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔中寻找有趣的文物（发现独特的齿轮）

entries.text: I'm self-taught, which means sometimes my potions have unexpected side effects.
entries.translated_text: 我是自学成才的，这意味着有时我的药水会有意想不到的副作用。

entries.text: I'm self-taught, which means sometimes my potions have unexpected side effects.
entries.translated_text: 我是自学成才的，这意味着有时我的药水会有意想不到的副作用。

entries.text: Living underground allowed the Dwemer to harness heat as energy. Their steam machines are often linked to geothermal vents. Ingenious!
entries.translated_text: 生活在地下让锻莫可以利用热量作为能量，他们的蒸汽机通常与地热喷口相连。巧妙！

entries.text: Rennec Frostbane.
entries.translated_text: 雷内克·冰霜克星。

entries.text: You should give it to me instead! I can offer you... Well, I'm saving that gold for later.
entries.translated_text: 你应该把它交给我！我可以给你...好吧，我会把那些钱存着以后用。

entries.text: Whatchya doin'...?
entries.translated_text: 你在做什么。。。？

entries.text: Nah, I don't think so.
entries.translated_text: 不，我不这么认为。

entries.text: The next time I see that Calcelmo...
entries.translated_text: 下次我看到那个卡塞莫...

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. Remi doesn't know who might want her dead, but she is eager to investigate. The assassin's letter mentioned a ship docked in Solitude. Remi thinks we should look around the city for anyone who might know something about this.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。蕾米不知道谁可能想要她死，但她急于调查。刺客的信中提到了一艘停靠在独孤城的船。蕾米认为我们应该在城里四处寻找可能对此有所了解的人。

entries.text: It was hard on my mother. To lose him twice really tore her apart.
entries.translated_text: 这对我妈妈来说很难，两次失去他，真是让她心碎。

entries.text: Oh well...
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧...

entries.text: Really, who could I have angered so much? Calcelmo? If Calcelmo hired the assassins, I'll march to Markarth and strangle him myself.
entries.translated_text: 说实话，我还能招惹谁？卡塞莫？如果是卡塞莫雇佣的刺客，我马上返回马卡斯城干掉他。

entries.text: You realize you're inviting me to live in my own Dwemer ruin? But I'll humour you. Yes, I will return here whenever we need to part ways.
entries.translated_text: 你知道你在邀请我住在我自己的锻莫遗址里吗？但我会幽默地告诉你，没关系。当我们分道扬镳后，我就会回到这里。

entries.text: So... You won't help me? What am I supposed to do about Morvic, then?
entries.translated_text: 所以...你不会帮我吗？那我该怎么处理莫维克呢？

entries.text: Yay! Bigpig. Come!
entries.translated_text: 耶！大猪，来！

entries.text: Ha-Ha. Do you have any more bad jokes? Because then I'd be out of a job.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。你还有什么烂笑话吗？因为那样的话我就要失业了。

entries.text: On the eve of the Witch's Festival, the Bretons of Camlorn lock their doors and draw their curtains.
entries.translated_text: 在女巫节前夜，卡姆隆的布莱顿人锁上门，拉上窗帘。

entries.text: Doesn't seem smart for the group to leave him behind, but the desire to explore more is understandable.
entries.translated_text: 团队留下他似乎并不明智，但渴望进一步探索是可以理解的。

entries.text: (Laughs) I didn't know Altmer had scales!
entries.translated_text: (笑) 我可不知道高精灵有鳞片!

entries.text: Feels good, doesn't it?
entries.translated_text: 感觉很好，不是吗？

entries.text: I haven't come across the name in my readings, but 'Bthar' translates to something like 'bond' or 'together'. 'Zel' naturally refers to 'city'.
entries.translated_text: 我在阅读中没有遇到过这个名字，但“Bthar”可以翻译成“纽带”或“团结”之类的东西。'Zel'自然指的是'城市'。

entries.text: Don't run away! You can't escape my brilliant ideas!
entries.translated_text: 别这样！你不要放弃这些好点子！

entries.text: Ahmed, you are a bit scary in battle. Well, everything is scary in battle. Am I scary in battle?
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德，你在战斗中有点可怕，嗯，战斗中的一切都很可怕，我在战斗中可怕吗？

entries.text: Don't worry, Raven, I haven't died yet!
entries.translated_text: 别担心，渡鸦，我还没死呢！

entries.text: I mean, I don't *disagree*, but it sounds weird to hear out loud.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，我赞同你的说法，但是听你大声说出来很奇怪。

entries.text: No, I guess it's not.
entries.translated_text: 对，我想是的。

entries.text: I suppose it's naive of me to think that escaping the current authority would be a clean task.
entries.translated_text: 我想我太天真了，以为摆脱当前的权贵是一件轻而易举的事。

entries.text: In my bag...? Oh! You mean Scrap! Well, he's more than a test subject to me, you know.
entries.translated_text: 在我的包里...？哦你是说小渣！你知道的，他对我来说不仅仅是一个测试对象。

entries.text: Only a fool lets himself get surrounded. Back up and make them come at you one at a time.
entries.translated_text: 被多个敌人包围是不明智的。往后退，迫使同一时间他们只能有一个人面对你。

entries.text: A book. It's called 'Chaurus Pie.'
entries.translated_text: 一本书,叫做《巢蚁薄饼》

texts: When I crossed the border, I had the intention of heading to Markarth right away, but then I saw this place!
过境的时候，本来是打算马上去马卡斯的，结果却看到了这个地方！

entries.text: Remi. Remi! I'm about to hug you; stop daydreaming for a moment.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，蕾米！我要抱抱你，别再做白日梦了，停一下。

entries.text: It's a little strange for there to be a Temple of Mara here when Riften is so... Riften.
entries.translated_text: 当裂谷如此...裂谷时，而这里有一座玛拉神殿就有点奇怪。

entries.text: Hag Rock Redoubt Ruin
entries.translated_text: 鬼婆岩据点遗迹

entries.text: Your heart isn't in... eating?
entries.translated_text: 你不想...吃东西？

entries.text: Nice!
entries.translated_text: 不错！

entries.text: Nice!
entries.translated_text: 不错！

entries.text: I'm not sure. After I was betrothed to Morvic, we both felt that it would be wrong to keep being...
entries.translated_text: 我不确定。在我和莫维克订婚后，我们都觉得继续当...是不对的。

entries.text: I'll just need my face not to say that either. Somehow. I'll work on it.
entries.translated_text: 我也只是需要控制好表情。无论如何，我会努力的。

entries.text: Finally got eight of them together!
entries.translated_text: 终于凑齐了八个了！

entries.text: Come on now, you're a sharp one.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，你是一个敏锐的人。

entries.text: Hm? No, I'm not a witch.
entries.translated_text: 嗯？不，我不是女巫。

entries.text: Ahhh, the game isn't over yet! No reason for you to not join in while I continue to drink old Sam here under the table!
entries.translated_text: 啊，游戏还没结束呢! 你可没有理由不加入，而我还能继续在桌下与老山姆对饮!

entries.text: Remi is fond of pc
entries.translated_text: Remiisfondofpc

entries.text: How could it have been your fault?
entries.translated_text: 怎么可能是你的错？

entries.text: Work, hah. That's cute. Hey, lead the way. I'd like to see this play out.
entries.translated_text: 工作，哈哈。真有趣。嘿，带路。我想看看这出戏。

entries.text: Oh. Really? I don't know- That just seems so-so boring! It's not everyday a drunkard challenges you.
entries.translated_text: 哦，真的吗？我不知道——这看起来太——太无聊了！并不是每天都有酒鬼来挑战你。

entries.text: She was very beautiful, but I was more interested in her mind, her thoughts. She had such a different way of thinking.
entries.translated_text: 她非常漂亮，但我对她的思想更感兴趣。她想法独特，有种不同的思维方式。

entries.text: My love, be a dear and let me use you as a stepping stool? I just *have* to get a closer look at that engraving up there...
entries.translated_text: 亲爱的，能让我踩在你身上当下垫脚石吗？我必须得仔细看看上面的那个雕刻……

entries.text: Oo, I am so excited!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我好激动！

entries.text: So, then you don't want anything? Are you sure? Last chance...!
entries.translated_text: 那你什么都不要了？你确定吗？这是最后的机会...！

entries.text: Urp... Nope. Guess not. Hold that thought, okay?
entries.translated_text: ...不。我想不是。别这样想，好吗？

entries.text: Time to head out, Ubbe?
entries.translated_text: 是时候出发了，乌贝？

entries.text: Yes, you probably do.
entries.translated_text: 是的，你可能知道。

entries.text: If you ever have use of those skills... I'll be happy to give you a demonstration.
entries.translated_text: 如果你曾经使用过这些技能...我很乐意给你演示。

entries.text: Alright. (200 gold)
entries.translated_text: 好吧。（200 金币）

entries.text: Alright. (200 gold)
entries.translated_text: 好吧。（200 金币）

entries.text: Alright. (200 gold)
entries.translated_text: 好吧。（200 金币）

entries.text: Oh? What's that?
entries.translated_text: 哦？是什么？

entries.text: Oh? What's that?
entries.translated_text: 哦？是什么？

entries.text: It most certainly is, but... I don't know. Wouldn't it be easier to... not use big, heavy weapons?
entries.translated_text: 当然是，但……我不知道为什么。换把不那么大的武器不是更好吗？

entries.text: But exploring and adventuring with you... There's no where I'd rather be than right here.
entries.translated_text: 但是和你一起探索和冒险...没有什么地方比这里更让我想待下去了。

entries.text: Well, you're getting warmer.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你越来越体贴了。

entries.text: I'll try not to take that as offensive.
entries.translated_text: 我会尽量不把这当成冒犯。

entries.text: I was wondering if I might (clears throat) owe you an apology. The Dark Rose was ah, involved... with that corsair incident back in one eighty-eight.
entries.translated_text: 在想是不是应该（清清嗓子）向你道个歉。黑暗玫瑰号号，嗯，和一八八年的那次海盗事件有点...牵连。

entries.text: Seeing as you're a former Legionnaire, I'm, ah, just going to let you take the lead in this fight, Yazakh!
entries.translated_text: 看在你是前军团成员的份上，我...就让你在这场战斗中打头阵吧，雅扎克!

entries.text: Hm... What? Oh, we're done talking.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...什么？哦，我们说完了。

entries.text: Revan.
entries.translated_text: 雷文。

entries.text: By Akatosh, that hurt!
entries.translated_text: 阿卡托什，好痛！

entries.text: Serana, I've brewed a new potion with the ingredients we picked up, but I can't help but feel like it's missing something.
entries.translated_text: 瑟拉娜，我用我们捡到的原料熬制了一种新的药水，但我不禁觉得它少了点什么。

entries.text: I often found myself imagining a knight in Dwemer armour, whisking me away to a university where I'd be the lead engineering innovator.
entries.translated_text: 我经常发现自己想象着一个穿着锻莫盔甲的骑士，把我带进一所大学，在那里我将成为工程创新的带头人。

entries.text: So... you're a Vampire Lord now? How does it feel? I imagine your throat must hurt?
entries.translated_text: 所以...你现在是吸血鬼领主了？感觉怎么样？我想你的喉咙一定很痛吧？

entries.text: Rumarin is a bit rude, don't you think? I'm not crazy just because I talk to an automaton!
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林有点粗鲁，你不觉得吗？我和机器人说话并不意味着我疯了！

entries.text: Oh. I suppose thinking there was a place where one could be educated in such matters was... too hopeful.
entries.translated_text: 哦。我想，要是有个地方能学这个那真是...太好了。

entries.text: Hey, thanks! I'm not sure what that is either, but at this point it doesn't really matter what I drink.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，谢谢我也不确定那是什么，但在这一点上，我喝什么其实并不重要。

entries.text: I could dig something up if you'd like? I just need to remember which room is mine. It's been a while.
entries.translated_text: 如果你愿意，我可以找找？只不过我得想想我的房间是哪个。以及有段时间了。

entries.text: Oh, I miss Scrap so much!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我好想小渣！

entries.text: You are very right, Khash. The Nords appear to have been the masters of making unwelcoming places.
entries.translated_text: 你说得很对，卡什。诺德人很擅长建造不受欢迎的地方。

entries.text: I do know that I... Well, I noticed some time ago that others seem to... have certain expectations surrounding committed partners.
entries.translated_text: 我确实知道我...好吧，我前段时间注意到，其他人似乎...都希望有忠诚的伙伴。

entries.text: Please don't mark your location on my map.
entries.translated_text: 不要在我的地图上标记你的位置。

entries.text: Some of the armour these Forsworn are wearing... I'm not sure what they're protecting being so exposed, but I guess it must be working for them?
entries.translated_text: 这些弃誓者所穿的一些盔甲...我不确定他们那么暴露是在保护什么，但我想这一定对他们有用？

entries.text: You've never said what you think of Scrap, Rumarin. Do you think he's good, great, wonderful, perfect? All of the above?
entries.translated_text: 你从未说过你对小渣的看法，鲁马林。你觉得他是小好，中好，还是大好？或者说完美无暇？

entries.text: Oh. Okay. Well, thank you for the book all the same.
entries.translated_text: 哦，可以，嗯，还是谢谢你的书。

entries.text: Go, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 走吧，小渣！

entries.text: I find that it works an incredible ten percent of the time!
entries.translated_text: 我发现这种方法有百分之十的成功率！

entries.text: There he is!
entries.translated_text: 他在那里！

entries.text: ...Right. So there isn't even a guarantee of him gifting you the mace? Or anything at all?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这么说他连把钉锤给你的承诺都没有？什么都没有吗？

entries.text: And that horse... That's definitely Morvic's. This confirms it. That bastard is here.
entries.translated_text: 而那匹马...那绝对是莫维克的。这说明了一点。那个混蛋在这里。

entries.text: Here you go.
entries.translated_text: 给你。

entries.text: Here you go.
entries.translated_text: 给你。

entries.text: The Silverbloods flaunting their wealth... Like a siren call to would-be thieves. Perhaps we should pay them a visit, too?
entries.translated_text: 银血家族炫耀着他们的财富...就像在向潜在的盗贼发出诱惑的召唤。也许我们也该去拜访一下？

entries.text: Some of the most unlikely explanations sometimes turn out to be true. And those are my favourites. The stranger, the better.
entries.translated_text: 一些最不可能的解释有时会变成事实。而这些就是我最喜欢的。越奇怪越好。

entries.text: They're fearful of people with pointy ears, too, so it's hard for me to have sympathy.
entries.translated_text: 他们也害怕耳朵尖尖的人，所以我很难有同情心。

entries.text: Remi has been thinking of a new project, and it has something to do with Tonal Magic. She's not sure where to begin, but she thinks if we can find a book with more information, she might be able to get an idea of what to do. We're heading to the Bard's College to see if they have anything to help.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米一直在考虑一个新项目，这与音调魔法有关。她不知道从哪里开始，但她认为如果我们能找到一本包含更多信息的书，她可能会知道该怎么做。我们将前往吟游诗人学院，看看他们是否有什么能够帮忙的。

entries.text: Althought now I'm imagining what sort of sounds bones would make if we could hear them whilst walking.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我现在在想，如果骨头在我们走路时也能出声大概是什么样。

entries.text: Here? Hm... What sort of amenities does it have? Of course, I'll humbly accept your offer either way. But it does have a library... right?
entries.translated_text: 这里？嗯...有什么设施？当然，无论什么方式，我都会虚心接受你的提议。但它确实有一个图书馆...对吧？

entries.text: Oh, Mortu, before you ask, no I did not take it. Okay, that's out of the way. What did you need?
entries.translated_text: 哦，莫尔图，在你问之前，不，我没有吃。好吧，这不碍事。你需要什么？

entries.text: That was a lot of trouble we went through for this Onmund guy. Why didn't we enlist him to help us get Enthir's staff?
entries.translated_text: 为了这个昂蒙德家伙，我们可费了不少功夫。为什么我们不直接让他帮忙一起去拿恩希尔的法杖呢？

entries.text: The key to successful thievery is silence and speed, you see.
entries.translated_text: 你看，成功盗窃的关键是安静和速度。

entries.text: Now I feel stupid.
entries.translated_text: 现在我觉得自己很傻。

entries.text: But what is 'Enkagr?'
entries.translated_text: 但什么是“Enkagr”？

entries.text: These researchers made it farther than I thought they would, although the falmer definitely threw a wrench in their progress.
entries.translated_text: 这些研究者比我想象的要走得更远，尽管伐莫肯定会阻碍他们的进步。

entries.text: Back to it, then.
entries.translated_text: 那么，回到正题。

entries.text: You're a natural, Val! Oh, I think Scrap really likes you!
entries.translated_text: 你很有天赋，瓦尔！哦，我觉得小渣很喜欢你！

entries.text: I barely touched you, though.
entries.translated_text: 但我几乎没碰到你。

entries.text: That's right. Now let's be on our way.
entries.translated_text: 好，现在我们上路吧。

entries.text: Even though we were found innocent in the end, my family was disgraced.
entries.translated_text: 尽管我们最终被认定是无辜的，但我的家人还是因此蒙羞了。

entries.text: Uh, not that I would seriously advoate for that, of course.
entries.translated_text: 呃，当然，我不会真的建议这样做。

entries.text: Just a small tweak...
entries.translated_text: 只是一个小小的调整...

entries.text: Watch your step here.
entries.translated_text: 在这里注意你的脚步。

entries.text: W-wait, by Dibellan arts, you don't mean-
entries.translated_text: 等等，蒂贝拉艺术，你不会是说...

entries.text: So I'm guessing you want to just use my blood, then?
entries.translated_text: 所以我猜你只是想用我的血，然后？

entries.text: Don't let them get you in the back!
entries.translated_text: 别让他们偷袭你的后背！

entries.text: Oh! Oh, he's reading it over! Although he seems to have bad eyesight. Why is he squinting like that?
entries.translated_text: 哦！哦，他在读它！尽管他似乎视力不好。为什么他要这样眯着眼睛？

entries.text: Excellent! I have a few ideas in mind, but I'm struggling with the details.
entries.translated_text: 真好！我有一些想法，但细节还有些问题。

entries.text: It- It sounded like growling... You don't think something is hunting us, do you?
entries.translated_text: 听起来像是在咆哮…你不觉得有什么东西在追杀我们吧？

entries.text: Auri is really scary in battle sometimes. I'm glad she's with us.
entries.translated_text: 奥璃有时在战斗中真的很可怕，我很高兴她和我们是一队的。

entries.text: Find two dwemer cogs. (<Global=HLIORPCCogsCount>/<Global=HLIORPCCogsTotal>)
entries.translated_text: 找两个锻莫齿轮。(<Global=HLIORPCCogsCount>/<Global=HLIORPCCogsTotal>)

entries.text: I remember one Flower Festival, we went to Camlorn. The dancers in the parade didn't wear much. Actually, I think they were with a Temple of Dibella.
entries.translated_text: 记得有一次鲜花节，我们去了卡姆隆。游行中的舞者穿得可不多，其实，我觉得他们好像是蒂贝拉神殿的。

entries.text: Good work out there, Raven!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，渡鸦！

entries.text: Well, bye, Raven. Bye for now, at least.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，再见，渡鸦，至少现在是再见。

entries.text: I guess so? I mean, I think it works for me aesthetically at least.
entries.translated_text: 我想是的？我的意思是，我认为至少在我的审美上是这样的。

entries.text: Ah! Yaz, someone is attacking us!
entries.translated_text: 啊！雅扎，有人在攻击我们！

entries.text: We have a pie! A Chaurus Pie!
entries.translated_text: 我们做出了个馅饼！一个巢蚁薄饼！

entries.text: Somehow, I don't think I'm strong enough to bash aside a warrior's shield.
entries.translated_text: 不知何故，我认为我没有足够的力量来破坏战士的盾牌。

entries.text: What is it, Doctor?
entries.translated_text: 医生，这是什么？

entries.text: Incredible! My own inspiration was dwarven ballistae, which translated into slower reload for more impact!
entries.translated_text: 难以置信！我的灵感来源于矮人的弩炮，这意味着装弹速度更慢，冲击力更大！

entries.text: They're no better than animals. Don't let Braig's story sway you.
entries.translated_text: 他们和禽兽没什么区别。不要因为布莱吉的故事产生动摇。

entries.text: Don't look so sad, friend!
entries.translated_text: 不要看起来那么难过，朋友！

entries.text: My name is... (Names T-Z)
entries.translated_text: 我的名字是...（T-Z）

entries.text: I know you've been to High Rock. Do you ever miss it? I think I'm missing it right now.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你去过高岩省。你想念它吗？我想我现在就在怀念它。

entries.text: Yes, please do tell us what you think.
entries.translated_text: 是的，请告诉我们你在想什么。

entries.text: Okay, this first one seems to be staying...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这似乎第一个要留住的...

entries.text: Oh, good. I thought it'd be rude to say anything, but the sanctuary is really a mess. I'm glad we're fixing it up.
entries.translated_text: 哦，很好。本来以为说什么都是不礼貌的，可是圣所真的是一团糟。我很高兴我们正在修复它。

entries.text: That sounds like famous last words to me.
entries.translated_text: 这听起来像是我的名言。

entries.text: Yes, I must agree with that sentiment. It's unfortunte, but sometimes others must die for you to live.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我必须同意这种看法。这很不幸，但有时别人必须为你而死。

entries.text: I've found it doesn't matter if others agree with you. If you think something is right, you should do it, regardless of others' opinions.
entries.translated_text: 我发现别人是否同意你的看法无关紧要。如果你认为某件事是对的，你就应该去做，不管别人的意见。

entries.text: But I can draw a picture of that if you like.
entries.translated_text: 但如果你愿意的话，我可以画一张照片。

entries.text: Hmmm...
entries.translated_text: 嗯…

entries.text: Hmmm...
entries.translated_text: 嗯…

entries.text: Aw, he wasn't that bad! Although I suppose he didn't say anything and just stared when I handed it to him. But I think he's just shy.
entries.translated_text: 哦，他没有那么坏！尽管我得承认,当我把它递给他时,他什么也没说,只是愣愣地盯着看。但我觉得他只是害羞。

entries.text: How are you faring, Ubbe?!
entries.translated_text: 你过得怎么样，乌贝？！

entries.text: Val, have you pet Scrap recently? He'll start pouting if you don't give him attention.
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔，你最近有没有摸摸小渣？如果你不关心它，它就会生气。

entries.text: Look out for the rest of the pack!
entries.translated_text: 留意其余的包！

entries.text: But I wanted to fight one so bad I did not really get scared by it. Like that?
entries.translated_text: 但我很想打一场，我并没有真正被它吓到。像那样？

entries.text: Your ears are quite pointy. Does that let you hear better, or is it just for show?
entries.translated_text: 你的耳朵很尖。这是让你听得更清楚，还是只是为了好看？

entries.text: Ah, saw that coming. Well, thanks for everything. Sovngarde better have enough mead!
entries.translated_text: 啊，看到了。谢谢你做的一切。松加德最好有足够的蜜酒！

entries.text: I've heard that some Bretons worship him as well.
entries.translated_text: 我听说一些布莱顿人也信仰他。

entries.text: Oooh, creepy. That makes him sound like some sort of necromancer. Good. He could use some defamation like that.
entries.translated_text: 哦，让人毛骨悚然。这让他听起来像是某种死灵法师。好的。他可以配得上这样的诽谤。

entries.text: Well, good luck with that.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，那也只能祝你好运了。

entries.text: Probably! The Dwemer loved making things dangerous!
entries.translated_text: 可能吧！锻莫们都喜欢把事情搞得很危险!

entries.text: I... think I do, yeah.
entries.translated_text: 我...我想我知道，是的。

entries.text: What would you like to talk about?
entries.translated_text: 你想谈些什么呢？

entries.text: You're just asking to embarrass me, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 你只是想让我难堪，不是吗？

entries.text: I think in another moment, the fellow will come up to beg for a copy! I'm sure he'll pay an exorbitant amount!
entries.translated_text: 我想再过一会儿，那家伙会上来求着要一本副本的！我确信他会开很高的价格！

entries.text: I must say, you've got a colourful variety... But I was thinking you could spice it up some?
entries.translated_text: 我得说，你的风格真是多姿多彩...不过我在想，也许你可以再添点“调味料”？

entries.text: No, no, no! Do not attack Ria! Do not attack me!
entries.translated_text: 不 不 不！不要攻击利亚！也不要攻击我！

entries.text: I'm sure you have. They're quite famous all across Tamriel.
entries.translated_text: 我相信你一定听过。他们在整个泰姆瑞尔都很有名。

entries.text: You're very handy with machines. I wonder if you're handy with...something else.
entries.translated_text: 你对机器很熟悉。我想知道你是否对...别的东西很拿手。

entries.text: Wait, so I'm not your favourite companion? It's because I don't wear makeup, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 等等，所以我不是你最喜欢的战友团？这是因为我不化妆，不是吗？

entries.text: 'The incredible work of Yazakh will pull you back into the beauty of philosophical thought and expand your mind.'
entries.translated_text: ‘雅扎克的惊世之作将把你带回哲思之美,并扩展你的思维。’

entries.text: Let me know when you have one.
entries.translated_text: 当你有一个时告诉我。

entries.text: It just seems like an odd title to officially use.
entries.translated_text: 这看起来像是一个奇怪的官方头衔。

entries.text: I know that it is Skyrim's sad attempt at safeguarding its magical knowledge.
entries.translated_text: 我知道这是天际保护其魔法知识的可悲尝试。

entries.text: I know that it is Skyrim's sad attempt at safeguarding its magical knowledge.
entries.translated_text: 我知道这是天际保护其魔法知识的可悲尝试。

entries.text: Never learned archery. Couldn't care less about it.
entries.translated_text: 我从未学过射箭。我才不在乎它。

entries.text: Forsworn are so irritating. They always bothered me when I was exploring my first ruin in Skyrim. Good thing they seem wary of Dwemer machines.
entries.translated_text: 弃誓者真是让人烦透了。我在天际省探险第一处遗迹时，他们总是来打扰我。幸好他们似乎对锻莫机器有所忌惮。

entries.text: By Sheor, those poor bastards.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，这些可怜的家伙。

entries.text: That's done. Well, until you lead us to another fight. Anything to say for yourself, Ubbe? Hm?
entries.translated_text: 就这样，好吧，直到你带领我们进行另一场战斗。有什么要说的吗，乌贝？嗯？

entries.text: Incredible! This statue is beautiful! Oh, and there's Mercer, I guess.
entries.translated_text: 难以置信！这个雕像真漂亮！哦，墨瑟也在，我猜。

entries.text: Yes, I killed Madanach, the Forsworn 'King'.
entries.translated_text: 我没事，我杀了迈德纳奇，弃誓者的“国王”。

entries.text: If a woman the last time we were in town was asking my price, that means she was asking to buy Scrap from me, correct?
entries.translated_text: 上次我们在城里时有一位女士问我的价格，意思是她要从我这里买走小渣，对吗？

entries.text: It's just so... out-of-the-way. And grey. And barren.
entries.translated_text: 只是太......偏僻了。一片灰蒙蒙的荒芜。

entries.text: Ooooh, this focusing crystal is so shiny!
entries.translated_text: 哦哦，这个聚焦水晶好闪亮！

entries.text: I've always wanted to see the White-Gold Tower. And meet a moth priest! They fascinate me to no end.
entries.translated_text: 我一直想看看白金塔。和一个先祖蛾祭司见面！他们让我着迷。

entries.text: Alright, let's meet with our contact. Maybe this one won't be absolutely terrified of you. Probably not, though.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们去见我们的联系人。也许这个不会完全害怕你。不过可能还是会的。

entries.text: And they're sticking in... uncomfortable places.
entries.translated_text: 而且它们还卡在了……不太舒服的地方。

entries.text: But I'm glad that I told you. It feels like a weight is lifted from my shoulders.
entries.translated_text: 但我很高兴我告诉了你。感觉就像从我的肩膀上卸下了一个重担。

entries.text: Oh let me guess! You want to murder us? Incredible.
entries.translated_text: 哦，让我猜猜看！你想谋杀我们？难以置信！

entries.text: He accumulated enough wealth and prestige that he attracted the attention of an aristocratic family. High born. Rich.
entries.translated_text: 他积累了足够的财富和声望，引起了一个贵族家庭的注意。出身高贵，家财万贯。

entries.text: Yeah! I tried to make it more home-y! At least all the rubble is cleared away.
entries.translated_text: 是的！我试着让它更舒适了！至少所有的瓦砾都被清除了。

entries.text: Mm, no, not really. Seeing Scrap all fixed up and happy is worth any amount of blood.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，不，不是这样。只要看着小渣高兴地修好了，流再多的血也值。

entries.text: Auri, Auri! Look what I found! This is such a well-preserved specimen! Look, look!
entries.translated_text: 奥璃，奥璃！看我发现了什么！这是一个保存完好的标本！看看！

entries.text: Remiel's Potion of Plentiful Stamina
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的足量体力药水

entries.text: I've been resisting saying this, but what is the point of reviving the Gildergreen? Just to attract pilgrims? Is the Temple not pretty enough?
entries.translated_text: 我一直在抗拒这么说，但复活镀绿树的意义何在？只是为了吸引朝圣者？神殿还不够漂亮吗？

entries.text: What about you? You never told me what you think about being in the wilderness? I mean, we do travel a lot...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，对你来说呢？你从没告诉过我你怎么看待待在荒野里。我的意思是，我们确实经常在外奔波...

entries.text: I was attacked by an assassin. I should investigate the body for any clues as to why.
entries.translated_text: 我被一个刺客袭击了。我应该调查尸体以找出原因。

entries.text: What? No! I wouldn't steal from you, Zora! I only borrow shiny rocks from... not my friends! Maybe I'll get one for you?
entries.translated_text: 什么？不！我不会偷你的东西，佐拉！我只向……反正不是我的朋友，借闪亮的石头！也许我会为你借一个？

entries.text: A necklace. Thought it'd look nice on you.
entries.translated_text: 一条项链，我认为你戴上会很好看。

entries.text: I say let the province tear itself to shreds. I've seen it, and I'm not impressed.
entries.translated_text: 我说这个省正在自我分裂，我看见了，也不过如此。

entries.text: Yes, they are rather boring. I suppose that's what happens when you aren't adventuring. You run out of fun things to talk about.
entries.translated_text: 是啊，他们确实挺无聊的。我想这就是不去冒险的结果吧——最终连有趣的话题都没得聊了。

entries.text: Can I give you a gift, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 我能给你一份礼物吗，蕾米？

entries.text: What is your history?
entries.translated_text: 你的经历了什么？

entries.text: I mean, I actually love you!
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是，我真的爱你！

entries.text: Ash yams are a testament to how well life adapts to even the poorest environments.
entries.translated_text: 灰烬薯证明了即使是最恶劣的环境，生命也能很好地适应。

entries.text: If you happen to come across a library, do let me know, so I can look around.
entries.translated_text: 如果你碰巧遇到图书馆，一定要告诉我，这样我可以进去看看。

entries.text: Redcap, Redcap. (Whispering) I bet those giants are too tall for you to even reach their knees with your spears.
entries.translated_text: 红帽子，红帽子。（低语）我敢打赌，那些巨人太高了，你连拿长矛都够不到膝盖。

entries.text: Stallion's Potion? What sort of problem does the steward have? A problem with his horse? Is that something to be secretive about?
entries.translated_text: 种马药水？总管遇到了什么问题？他的“马”有问题？这需要保密吗？

entries.text: Do you think they had anything good on them? They're dead, so surely they don't need it?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得他们身上会有什么好东西吗？反正他们已经死了，肯定用不上了吧？

entries.text: I'm looking forward to it.
entries.translated_text: 我很期待。

entries.text: I'm usually not fond of displays of affection, but I guess for you, I'll make an exception.
entries.translated_text: 我通常不喜欢太亲昵，但我想对你来说，我会破例。

entries.text: What is it, Meeko?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了，米科？

entries.text: Auri, I've been thinking about something... What if your skill in archery could be... bottled, so to speak?
entries.translated_text: 奥璃，我一直在想一件事...如果你的箭术可以...被装进瓶子里，怎么说？

entries.text: (Whispering) Look at that! Half the skooma bottles are empty! The guards have definitely been enjoying themselves.
entries.translated_text: （低语）看啊!一半的斯库玛瓶子是空的!守卫肯定是自己用来爽了。

entries.text: Did I... not ask you?
entries.translated_text: 我......没问你吗？

entries.text: You must not let your clients get so much as a scratch.
entries.translated_text: 你绝不能让您的委托人受到任何伤害。

entries.text: That means I'm working them out, right?
entries.translated_text: 这意味着我正在解决它们，对吗？

entries.text: It looks like they chose a bad spot to camp.
entries.translated_text: 看起来他们选了一个不好的露营地点。

entries.text: Ale.
entries.translated_text: 麦芽酒。

entries.text: Ugh, do we have to?
entries.translated_text: 呃，我们必须这样吗？

entries.text: Yes! Yes! ...No, wait, that's entirely wrong.
entries.translated_text: 对的！对的！...不对，等等，这全都是错的。

entries.text: Dalum-Ei told me that vengeance is a powerful weapon, but like all things of great strength, it has the power to consume.
entries.translated_text: 达卢姆-艾告诉我，复仇是一种强大的武器，但就像其他具有强大力量的事物一样，它会消耗很多的力量。

entries.text: Suryvel, you know you are lovely. Just amazing. Incredible. And I'm not telling you these things to distract you from anything else.
entries.translated_text: 苏里维尔，你知道你很可爱，真是太棒了。不可思议，我告诉你这些事情并不是为了分散你对其他别的事情的注意力。

entries.text: What about you? What were your parents like?
entries.translated_text: 那你呢？你的父母是怎么样的人？

entries.text: Yeah, well, tell Remi I'm not talking to her 'til she apologizes for drinking the last mead bottle.
entries.translated_text: 对，好，告诉蕾米我不会和她说话，直到她为最后那瓶蜜酒而道歉。

entries.text: That's so rude!
entries.translated_text: 你怎么能这么多！

entries.text: A, B, C, D, E, F, G, H...
entries.translated_text: A，B，C，D，E，F，G，H...

entries.text: That's not to say I won't accept it, though. What is it?
entries.translated_text: 不过，这并不是说我不接受，这是什么？

entries.text: Hmm... Maybe he could try writing his own music? I'd be interested in finding out what automaton music would actually sound like.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...也许他可以试着写自己的音乐？我很想知道机器人音乐实际上听起来是什么样子。

entries.text: Woah, look at that rock formation!
entries.translated_text: 哇，看那个石阵！

entries.text: Ah, I knew that Nchuand-Zel had to have more to it than what we saw. Convenient that we are able to reach this from the Mine.
entries.translated_text: 啊，我就知道楚安德-泽尔肯定不止我们看到的这些。真方便，我们可以从矿井直达这里。

entries.text: I've never been to Morrowind before! Look at all this ash! <Coughing>
entries.translated_text: 我以前从未去过晨风！看看这些灰烬！<咳嗽>

entries.text: We found a smuggler in Riften who gave us a note detailing Remi's family and their move to Skaven. It sounds like they're doing well. Emboldened by her family's safety, Remiel wrote an anonymous letter to the Order of the Hour in Wayrest to frame Morvic as a daedra worshipper. She told me that she will send it off on her own. Now we wait for any news from Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，他给了我们一张便条，详细说明了蕾米的家人以及他们搬到斯卡文的地方。听起来他们做得很好。受到家人安全的激励，蕾米尔给途歇城的时序团骑士团写了一封匿名信，将莫维克诬陷为魔族信徒。她告诉我她会自己寄出。现在我们等待途歇城的消息好了。

entries.text: Well, then I hope you're ready for another adventure?
entries.translated_text: 那么，我希望你准备好进行另一次冒险了吗？

entries.text: Ria.
entries.translated_text: 利亚。

entries.text: Shall we... shall we get going, then?
entries.translated_text: 那我们...我们走吧？

entries.text: I'll let you know to get out of the way when I throw up...
entries.translated_text: 当我呕吐时，我会告诉你让开...

entries.text: Oh, look at the writings in this ruin! I'm very eager to translate them!
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看这片废墟上的字！我好想翻译！

entries.text: I can see my mother pushing me into the cellar, and my father standing with his old sword at its entrance.
entries.translated_text: 我可以看到我妈妈把我藏到地窖里，我父亲拿着他多年不用的守在地窖的入口。

entries.text: I can see my mother pushing me into the cellar, and my father standing with his old sword at its entrance.
entries.translated_text: 我可以看到我妈妈把我藏到地窖里，我父亲拿着他多年不用的剑守在地窖的入口。

entries.text: There's nowhere else I'd rather be.
entries.translated_text: 我哪儿都不想去，只有这里才是我想待的地方。

entries.text: I've heard wine pairs well with fish dishes. Do they serve any here?
entries.translated_text: 我听说葡萄酒很适合搭配鱼类菜肴，他们这里有提供吗？

entries.text: You can come along.
entries.translated_text: 你可以一起来。

entries.text: They've definitely taken a liking to you.
entries.translated_text: 他们肯定喜欢上你了。

entries.text: Uh...Yeah, I'd say that's a...valid reading. Not quite what I'd intended, although I can't exactly remember what my intention was in the first place.
entries.translated_text: 呃...是的,我会说这是一个...合理的理解。虽然不完全是我最初的意图，尽管我确实记不清最初的意图是什么。

entries.text: Yes, I'm well aware.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我很清楚。

entries.text: I guess Boethiah could have decided to pull an Azura and change our skin and eye colours as a supposed 'punishment'.
entries.translated_text: 我猜波耶西亚可能像阿祖拉一样，改变我们的皮肤和眼睛的颜色，来作为一种所谓的 "惩罚"。

entries.text: Fine. I'll try. Maybe.
entries.translated_text: 好的。我会尝试的。大概

entries.text: There is honour in fighting for what you believe.
entries.translated_text: 为你的信念而战是一种荣誉。

entries.text: So did this hagraven forge Nettlebane? I can't imagine a hagraven near a forge. Their feathers would catch fire, I think.
entries.translated_text: 那么是乌鸦鬼婆锻造了刺草之祸？我无法想想乌鸦鬼婆会靠近锻炉，她们的羽毛可会被点燃，我想。

entries.text: Ha-ha, have your fun.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈，你真有意思。

entries.text: Ha-ha, have your fun.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈，你真有意思。

entries.text: This should make lockpicking significantly easier for you. Just always keep it with you, okay?
entries.translated_text: 现在你开锁应该更容易了，随时带着它，好吗？

entries.text: I wouldn't mind a Kwama Egg Quiche.
entries.translated_text: 我不介意来个夸蚁蛋馅饼。

entries.text: Remi's Alembic
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的蒸馏器

entries.text: I'm not sure why, but he doesn't seem too fond of me. Did I do something wrong?
entries.translated_text: 我不知道为什么，但他似乎不太喜欢我。我做错了什么吗？

entries.text: Yes, I'm rather good at it. If you need me to, just ask.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我比较擅长。如果你需要我，尽管开口。

entries.text: They abandoned him out of shame because even after winning a thousand battles for them, losing even just one was enough for them to turn their backs.
entries.translated_text: 对兽人来说，他们会羞愧地抛弃了他，因为即使他为他们赢得了一千场战斗，哪怕只是输掉一场，也足以让他们转身离去。

entries.text: Well... I guess Kodlak's not getting cured of lycanthropy.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我猜克拉科的狼化病还没有痊愈。

entries.text: Hm. Probably shouldn't let him see how many dynamos I've, er, salvaged. And... How many soul gems have I gotten? One... five... fifteen?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，可能不应该让他看到我，呃，回收了多少动力核心。和...我得到了多少灵魂石？一...五...十五？

entries.text: I've never been to Morrowind!
entries.translated_text: 我还从来没有去过晨风！

entries.text: How... Er... How are you feeling?
entries.translated_text: 怎么...呃...你感觉怎么样？

entries.text: What in Oblivion was that for?! Aren't priests meant to be beyond the infuence of evil, or something like that?! He tried to murder us!
entries.translated_text: 这究竟是为什么？祭司不是不应该受邪恶力量的影响吗？他想谋杀我们！

entries.text: I think we should prove to him that not only am I some 'poncy Breton' but I'm also quite adventurous!
entries.translated_text: 我想我们应该向他证明，我不仅是个“娘娘腔的布莱顿”，而且还很有冒险精神！

entries.text: Didn't pay much attention to the details, but something about good ol' revenge.
entries.translated_text: 这个不太清楚，听说是复仇。

entries.text: Do you suppose it should bother me more, the number of people we've killed? Does it bother you?
entries.translated_text: 你认为我们杀了这么多人应该会困扰我吗？你会感到困扰吗？

entries.text: Bards College
entries.translated_text: 诗人学院

entries.text: I did a very brief stint in the Imperial Legion. Still not sure why I joined, but that's the case for a lot of decisions I make.
entries.translated_text: 我曾在帝国军团短暂服役过一段时间。至今也不确定我为什么会参军,但这倒也是我做许多决定的常态。

entries.text: Remiel's Frenzy Poison
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的狂乱毒药

entries.text: Falkreath's forests feel... different. The trees sigh and weep.
entries.translated_text: 佛克瑞斯的森林感觉...与众不同。树木叹息和哭泣着。

entries.text: I was in the mood for something sweet, thanks!
entries.translated_text: 我很想吃点甜的，谢谢！

entries.text: Fine. No Scrap in battle. But if you change your mind, I'm sure he'll be happy to jump back into the fray.
entries.translated_text: 以后小渣不会加入战斗了，但如果你改变主意，我相信他会很乐意重新投入战斗。

entries.text: Can you tell me about Wyrd Covens?
entries.translated_text: 你能告诉我关于命运巫会的事吗？

entries.text: Maybe you see where I'm going with this? Of course, knowing the right tones to make a song for specific behavior is... basically impossible.
entries.translated_text: 也许你知道我要做什么？当然，知道适合特定行为的歌声的正确音调...基本上是不可能的。

entries.text: Uh, I mean, it's not a relief you said that! It's not like it's a relief to me that you were mean to someone!
entries.translated_text: 呃，我的意思不是说这令人感到宽慰！这不是说着我会因你对别人说了刻薄的话而感到宽慰！

entries.text: Fighting foul sorcery makes me feel like a knight again.
entries.translated_text: 与邪恶的巫术作斗争让我觉得自己又成了一名骑士。

entries.text: Remiel Alchemy Faction
entries.translated_text: RemielAlchemyFaction

entries.text: What do you want?
entries.translated_text: 你想要什么？

entries.text: What do you want?
entries.translated_text: 你想要什么？

entries.text: What do you want?
entries.translated_text: 你想要什么？

entries.text: Makes me feel a little guilty for leaving home. Let's change the subject.
entries.translated_text: 离家出走让我有些愧疚。让我们换个话题。

entries.text: Makes me feel a little guilty for leaving home. Let's change the subject.
entries.translated_text: 离家出走让我有些愧疚，我们换个话题吧。

entries.text: If I had a septim for every time I've been at a wedding that ended with the guests murdering one another, I'd have two septims.
entries.translated_text: 如果我每次参加一场以客人互相残杀而告终的婚礼都有一枚塞普汀，我就会有两枚塞普汀了。

entries.text: You've made some changes to the place.
entries.translated_text: 你把这里改造了一下。

entries.text: There's an East Empire Company warehouse back home in Wayrest, too.
entries.translated_text: 在我途歇城的家乡也有一个东帝国公司的仓库。

entries.text: Well, if you're so inconvenienced by them, I'm sure I could make something useful from them.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果你觉得它们麻烦，我肯定可以用它们做点有用的东西。

entries.text: Dwarven Sphere
entries.translated_text: 矮人机械球

entries.text: The Silver-Bloods! Damn them! They've always been the worst, thinking they run the city.
entries.translated_text: 该死的银血家族！他们一直都是最坏的人，自以为是这个城市的主宰。

entries.text: Live life on the run, afraid of the truth being discovered.
entries.translated_text: 过着逃亡的生活，害怕真相被发现。

entries.text: A lot of the Bretons back home are very... conniving? I wasn't sure if you'd be similar at first. I'm glad that it turned out I get along with you.
entries.translated_text: 家乡的布莱顿人很多都很...阴险？一开始我不确定你是不是也这样，很高兴我和你相处得很好

entries.text: How did you manage to get a copy of this...? Oh... Yeah... Look, it doesn't really matter what your opinion on the orcs is, Trinimac was a hero.
entries.translated_text: 你是怎么设法得到这本书的副本的……？哦...是的...听着，你对兽人的看法并不重要，但崔尼马克的确是一个英雄。

entries.text: Have you ever heard of the Clockwork City? It was supposedly a realm created by the God-King, Sotha Sil. What I would give to see it.
entries.translated_text: 你听说过发条城吗？应该是神王索萨·希尔创造的过度，我愿意付出一切去看一眼。

entries.text: Of course! I say a lot of things, but I don't lie about making money. I think our skills will complement each other nicely.
entries.translated_text: 当然我说过很多话，但我不会在赚钱上撒谎。我觉得我们的技能可以很好地互补。

entries.text: Then, we'll need to make the sauce. Nils says that he makes it from water, tomatoes, salt, and honey.
entries.translated_text: 然后，我们需要做酱汁。纽斯说，他用水、西红柿、盐和蜂蜜制作。

entries.text: Search Riften for someone who has information about Remi's family.
entries.translated_text: 在裂谷中搜寻了解蕾米家人信息的人。

entries.text: Serana, if you want to drink their blood, I won't tell anyone!
entries.translated_text: 瑟拉娜，如果你想喝他们的血，我是不会告诉任何人的！

entries.text: Well, I suppose I was the one who suggested Madanach was trying to play to our sympathies.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想说迈德纳奇在试图利用我们的同情。

entries.text: My real father died when I was a baby. He was a fisherman, and I guess he had a boat accident, or something like that.
entries.translated_text: 我真正的父亲在我还是婴儿的时候就去世了。他是个渔夫，我猜他出了船事故，或者别的事。

entries.text: My real father died when I was a baby. He was a fisherman, and I guess he had a boat accident, or something like that.
entries.translated_text: 我真正的父亲在我还是婴儿的时候就去世了。他是个渔夫，我猜他的船失事了，或者别的事。

entries.text: There's this place in Blacklight that serves the most delicious Kwama Eggs. What I wouldn't give to taste some of those...
entries.translated_text: 黑光城有一家店提供最美味的夸蚂蛋。如果能品尝到这样的美味，我真是求之不得...

entries.text: Oh. Oh! Okay, yeah. You... you'll be good at it, I think.
entries.translated_text: 哦。哦！好的，是的。你...你会很擅长的，我想。

entries.text:
<font face='$DwemerFont'>

I've devised a new test of knowledge, for those who would like to attend the more advanced lectures conducted by our most knowledgeable scholars. As a faculty, we have agreed that only those who demonstrate a basic understanding of architecture and engineering should be able to sit in on these lectures, to prevent derivitive questioning and instead promote higher order thinking.

</font>

The Dwemer really were so full of themselves, weren't they? I, a simple Breton girl, would never have been allowed to attend these lectures, even though I definitely possess more than a "basic understanding" of Dwemeris engineering. Where did they even conduct these lectures? I assume there must be some grand lecture hall toward the far end of the ruin?

<font face='$DwemerFont'>

The proposed test would task those participating with correctly identifying the components fundamental to the creation of three basic types of automaton. This seems like child's play to those of us in the know, but is apparently largely unknown to those lacking handson experience and proper education. If too many are able to pass, we will have to change the measure. However, at this time, we will set up the proposed task in the hall leading to the lecture amphitheater.

</font>

Incredible. What a horribly simple task. 'Identify the components fundamental to the creation of different types of automaton.' Then, what? Just drop them in the corresponding containers as proof of knowledge? If I could get to the hall or the amphitheater this references, I'd easily pass. I'm surprised that in a place supposedly dedicated to furthering the capabilities of automaton, there are so many who would not know what pieces are the most essential to their construction. Surely, they could just look at their own work stations? They must have had some sort of workshop where they learned these basics! All they'd need to know would be apparent there.
entries.translated_text:
<font face='$DwemerFont'>

I've devised a new test of knowledge, for those who would like to attend the more advanced lectures conducted by our most knowledgeable scholars. As a faculty, we have agreed that only those who demonstrate a basic understanding of architecture and engineering should be able to sit in on these lectures, to prevent derivitive questioning and instead promote higher order thinking.

</font>

矮人们真是自负得很，不是吗？尽管我对矮人工程学的理解远不止‘基础’水平，就因为我是个简单的布莱顿女孩，就永远不让参加这些讲座。他们会哪里进行这些讲座？我想，在遗址的深处一定有某个大讲堂吧？

<font face='$DwemerFont'>

The proposed test would task those participating with correctly identifying the components fundamental to the creation of three basic types of automaton. This seems like child's play to those of us in the know, but is apparently largely unknown to those lacking handson experience and proper education. If too many are able to pass, we will have to change the measure. However, at this time, we will set up the proposed task in the hall leading to the lecture amphitheater.

</font>

真是难以置信。这任务未免也太简单了吧。“识别不同类型自动装置的基本组件”，然后呢？只是把它们放进对应的容器以证明自己的知识？如果我能到达这个讲堂或露天剧场，我一定能轻松通过。我很惊讶，在一个据说致力于提升自动装置能力的地方，竟然有这么多人不知道哪些部件是构建它们的最基本部分。他们完全可以看看自己的工作台嘛？他们一定有某种车间，在那里学习这些基础知识！所有他们需要知道的东西都在那儿。

entries.text: Don't get me wrong, I'm sure you have it all figured out.
entries.translated_text: 别误会，我相信你早就把一切都想得清楚了。（Don't，D开头）

entries.text: She sounds nice.
entries.translated_text: 她听起来不错。

entries.text: Aw... Alright. I wasn't doubting you, you know. Well, maybe a little. But if you're sure, I'll just... Also drink. But not, uh, with you guys.
entries.translated_text: 额...好吧，我不是怀疑你，懂的...好吧，也许有一点。但如果你确定，我就...也喝。但不是，呃，和你们一起。

entries.text: Why? It's probably perfectly safe.
entries.translated_text: 为什么？这可是很安全。

entries.text: I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: 我看也是。

entries.text: I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: 我看也是。

entries.text: Oh, the Skaal! I actually know a bit about them from my research into Lorkhan. Some texts say that their 'All-Maker' is a variation of him.
entries.translated_text: 哦，斯卡尔！我实际上在研究洛克汗时了解到一些关于他们的事情。一些文本提到，他们的“造物者”是洛克汗的一个变体。

entries.text: I do sleep! Sometimes. Usually, I save up all my tiredness so that one nice, long sleep will take care of it. More efficient use of my time.
entries.translated_text: 我确实会睡觉!有时会。通常情况下，我会把所有的疲惫积攒起来，这样一个漂亮的长眠就可以解决了。这样能更有效地利用我的时间。

entries.text: I assume you'll be wanting to dive in and plunder it of its riches, as per the usual?
entries.translated_text: 我想你会进去搜刮一些好东西，就像往常一样？

entries.text: By Sheor, for how tough mercenaries want to be, they sure are quick to act like children.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔在上，这些雇佣兵要多强悍就有多强悍，但他们确实很快就会像孩子一样。

entries.text: Khash, if you grew up in the wilds of Cyrodiil... Where did you learn things from?
entries.translated_text: 卡什，如果你是在赛瑞迪尔的荒野长大的...那你是从哪里学到那些东西的呢？

entries.text: Is it true what they said?
entries.translated_text: 他们说的是真的吗？

entries.text: My step-father's rivals jumped on that, spread it like dragon fire.
entries.translated_text: 我继父的对手抓住了这一点，恶言像龙焰般迅速传播开来。

entries.text: I don't want to start lugging around a shield.
entries.translated_text: 我可不想开始背个盾牌。

entries.text: Scrap says 'hello,' Doctor.
entries.translated_text: 小渣说“你好”，医生。

entries.text: Ash Spawn are truly nightmare fuel. The risen corpses of those killed in the Red Year covered in the ash that suffocated them... Gives me chills.
entries.translated_text: 灰烬魔简直是噩梦本身。那些死于红色年代的尸体被复活，浑身覆盖着让他们窒息致死的火山灰...光是想想就让我起鸡皮疙瘩。

entries.text: I must say, though, that experience certainly sounds... dreadful. When did you leave the Legion?
entries.translated_text: 我必须说，虽然，那段经历听起来确实...很可怕。你什么时候离开军团的？

entries.text: When using Remi's cross bow, ignore 60% armor resistance
entries.translated_text: 使用蕾米的十字弓时，无视60%护甲抗性

entries.text: Hey, that Falmer we saw earlier kinda looks like Remi when I wake her up for watch! ...Ouch. Sorry.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，我们之前看见的那个伐莫很像刚被叫醒起床的蕾米！ ...哎哟。对不起。

texts: Not within society, no. An unfortunate turn of events.
不在社会内部，不。不幸的转折。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel Quarters
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔居住区

entries.text: Hm. I don't like wasting food. And it might help with my figure if I ate very healthy.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我不喜欢浪费食物。如果我吃得很健康，可能会有助于我的身材。

entries.text: Don't worry, Ria, I haven't died yet!
entries.translated_text: 别担心，利亚，我还没死呢！

entries.text: There it goes! Quickly, after it! I want its ghost lute!
entries.translated_text: 就是这样！快，找到它！我想要它的幽灵鲁特琴！

entries.text: Couldn't possibly conjure up the energy anymore.
entries.translated_text: 再也提不起那股劲儿了。（Couldn't，C开头）

entries.text: I've read some writings by Vivec that suggest the dwemer vanished due to their attempts to use the Ehlnofey to make themselves Divine.
entries.translated_text: 我读过维威克的一些文章，其中暗示锻莫消失是因为他们试图使用艾尔诺菲使自己成为神。

entries.text: Pet him... like a dog?
entries.translated_text: 摸他......像抚摸狗狗一样？

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. It seems another group of explorers went into the ruins before us, and Remiel wants to follow after them. Two of them didn't make it, but maybe the others are alive.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。似乎还有一群探险者在我们之前进入了遗址，蕾米想要跟在他们后面。其中两个没有成功，但也许其他人还活着。

entries.text: No, you're okay. C'mon, you have to be okay!
entries.translated_text: 不，你没事。来吧，你不能有事！

entries.text: I was just thinking about that last fight we were in.
entries.translated_text: 我只是在想我们最后一场战斗。

entries.text: You've got it!
entries.translated_text: 你明白了！

entries.text: Tazvir.
entries.translated_text: 塔兹维尔。

entries.text: So you can't eat plants... How about drinks? What kind do you like?
entries.translated_text: 所以你不能吃植物...那酒怎么样？你喜欢什么？

entries.text: But there's nothing wrong with having other skills!
entries.translated_text: 但不意味着会其他技能是错事！

entries.text: Those are all useful skills in the right circumstances.
entries.translated_text: 在适当的情况下，这些都是有用的技能。

entries.text: Good work.
entries.translated_text: 干得好。

entries.text: The Temple of Akatosh had the Order of the Hour investigate us.
entries.translated_text: 阿卡托什神殿派了时序团调查我们。

entries.text: The dwemer spent a great amount of effort researching the Ehlnofey. I imagine they were interested in what power those Et'Ada left behind.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫花费了大量精力研究艾尔诺菲。我想他们对那些原灵留下的力量很感兴趣。

entries.text: Word out on the street is that you're a little strange.
entries.translated_text: 街上传言你有点古怪。

entries.text: Huh, I never thought about it that way. I like your way of looking at things.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我从没那样想过。我喜欢你看待事物的方式。

entries.text: Alright, Auri, let's fire at will!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，奥璃，动手吧！

entries.text: I think this place smells the same way that nirnroot sounds. Which I guess means 'pleasant in small doses'?
entries.translated_text: 我觉得这个地方的味道和奈恩根的声音一样。也就是说“适量才美”吧？

entries.text: See you later, Taz.
entries.translated_text: 我们稍后再见，塔兹。

entries.text: Dwemer Scrap Metal
entries.translated_text: 金属边角料

entries.text: Oh, I remember the days when I'd pretend to summon the Dark Brotherhood. My mother very much disapproved, but my father thought it was hilarious.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我记得我假装召唤黑暗兄弟会的日子。我妈妈很不赞成，但我爸爸觉得这很好笑。

entries.text: I'm really happy I stayed, too.
entries.translated_text: 我也很高兴我留在了你身边。

entries.text: O-oh. Er, okay.
entries.translated_text: 哦哦。呃，好吧。

entries.text: Dragons have got it made. They can fly. They can Shout. They can travel through time. I wish I could time travel.
entries.translated_text: 龙已经复活了，他们可以飞，他们可以龙吼，他们还可以穿越时空，我希望我也能穿越时空。

entries.text: This is between Morvic and myself. And I suppose you, too, now that I've dragged you into it.
entries.translated_text: 这是我和莫维克之间的事，但既然我已经把你拖下水了，那你也有份了。

entries.text: Well, that is true... Hm. Well, fine. Will you hold this dwemer gear for me, then?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这是真的 ...嗯,好吧，好吧。那你给我拿着这个锻莫圆轮好吗？

entries.text: Hello?
entries.translated_text: 你好？

entries.text: Analyzing every decision you make, judging your every move.
entries.translated_text: 分析你做出的每一个决定，判断你的一举一动。

entries.text: I've put a lot of thought into this already, so I already have a general sense of what I'll need.
entries.translated_text: 我已经思考了很久了，所以我已经大致了解了我需要什么了。

entries.text: So since this "friend" who left the note has the Horn, does that mean they also technically pass the test to become Dragonborn?
entries.translated_text: 那么，既然这个留下纸条的“朋友”有号角，那是否意味着他们技术上也通过了成为龙裔的测试？

entries.text: Good. One less worry.
entries.translated_text: 很好，又少了件烦心事。

entries.text: Can you tell me about yourself?
entries.translated_text: 你可以介绍你自己吗？

entries.text: (Sigh) Well, then, I hope our friend has enough to cover for all of us.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）好吧，那么，我希望我们的朋友有足够的能力来满足我们所有人的需求。

entries.text: Oh, please, please be okay. Morvic's note makes it sound like they're in real trouble with the law. I hope they were able to make it to safety.
entries.translated_text: 哦，求你，求你别出事。莫维克的字条听起来像是他们真的遇到法律麻烦，我希望他们能够顺利脱身。

entries.text: 'F I kill this milk drinker with one hand behind my back, you gonna get drinks later, Remi?!
entries.translated_text: 如果能我一手背背单手杀掉这个弱鸡，你就去给我拿瓶酒好吗，蕾米？

entries.text: Now, I know we should return the books, but do we need to?
entries.translated_text: 现在我知道我们该还书，但我们真要还吗？

entries.text: Wait for Remi to finish crafting.
entries.translated_text: 等待蕾米完成制作。

entries.text: So I just understand.
entries.translated_text: 所以我才明白。

entries.text: Sure, anytime, Remi. Thanks for listening.
entries.translated_text: 当然，随时都可以，蕾米。谢谢你愿意听我讲这些。

entries.text: Ugh, of course the mages would have something like that. It's really unfortunate that the only literate people in Skyrim seem to also like magic.
entries.translated_text: 呃，法师当然会有那样的东西，很不幸，天际中里只有少数的文化人似乎才喜欢魔法。

entries.text: Ugh, of course the mages would have something like that. It's really unfortunate that the only literate people in Skyrim seem to also like magic.
entries.translated_text: 呃，法师当然会有那样的东西，很不幸，天际中里的文化人似乎也喜欢魔法。

entries.text: Well, that's just awful timing. I wonder if- Wait, you're joking, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那我们得小心了。我想知道...等等，你在开玩笑，不是吗？

entries.text: Talk to Remi about your adventures.
entries.translated_text: 和蕾米谈谈你的冒险经历。

entries.text: I don't mean to be rude, but it seems like killing Logrolf and also not getting that mace is the worst of all the options you had. Just my opinion.
entries.translated_text: 我无意冒犯，但在你所有的选择中，杀死罗格洛夫而又得不到那把钉锤似乎是最糟的。当然只是我的观点。

entries.text: Ugh... It just is a lot.
entries.translated_text: 呃...是很多。

entries.text: So long as your murdering doesn't get in the way of that... Well, I guess nothing's changed on my end. I still need my travelling companion.
entries.translated_text: 只要你的杀戮不妨碍到这一点...嗯，我想对我来说也没什么变化。我还是需要我的旅行伙伴。

entries.text: There's little consensus on Dwemeris translations. Because there's so little written about it, I largely had to decipher and teach it to myself.
entries.translated_text: 关于锻莫语的翻译的共识很少。因为关于它的文章太少了，我在很大程度上不得不自己解读和自学。

entries.text: Wait... What just happened...?
entries.translated_text: 等等...刚刚发生了什么...？

entries.text: There must be a place guards spend their time when they're not being... guard-y. Maybe wherever that is?
entries.translated_text: 一定有一个地方，当守卫们不在...守卫的时候，他们会在那里消磨时间。也许是在哪里？

entries.text: Alright, here you go, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那就给你吧。

entries.text: Alright, here you go, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那就给你吧。

entries.text: Alright, here you go, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那就给你吧。

entries.text: Alright, here you go, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那就给你吧。

entries.text: Imagine if instead of Nords, there were just automatons! It'd be so exciting going into Markarth and discovering a dwemer sphere instead of Kleppr.
entries.translated_text: 想象一下，如果没有诺德人，而只有机器人！当你马卡斯，看见的是一个锻莫机械球而不是克莱珀，那将是多么让人兴奋。

entries.text: The Star is very pretty. Deceptively pretty. I find a lot of dangerous things are pretty. Sometimes they're prettier because of the danger they pose.
entries.translated_text: 那颗星很漂亮，至少假装漂亮，我发现很多危险的东西都很漂亮。有时它们更漂亮是因为它们构成的危险。

entries.text: It rose right from the ground, like a skeleton to its necromancer! This has to be it, right? The Forge must be right beneath our feet!
entries.translated_text: 它从地上升起，就像死灵法师的骷髅！应该是这个吧？熔炉一定就在我们脚下！

entries.text: Well, we'll just have to catch up to the researchers mentioned in this note.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们只好赶上这条笔记中提到的研究人员了。

entries.text: Mostly Marlok.
entries.translated_text: 主要是马洛克。

entries.text: Well, if Nords thought like you, maybe I wouldn't be so afraid of the Stormcloaks.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果诺德人都和你一样想的话，也许我不会那么害怕风暴斗篷了。

entries.text: I came to see the dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 我是来看矮人遗迹的。

entries.text: I came to see the dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 我是来看锻莫遗迹的。

entries.text: We found a smuggler in Riften who gave us a note detailing Remi's family and their move to Skaven. It sounds like they're doing well. It's been some time since Remiel wrote her tip-off to the Order of the Hour. We should check if the smuggler in Riften has any news about Morvic's response.
entries.translated_text: 我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，他给了我们一张便条，详细说明了蕾米的家人以及他们搬到斯卡文的地方。听起来他们过得很好。距离蕾米尔给时序团写信已经有一段时间了。我们应该去看看裂谷城的走私者有没有关于莫维克消息。

entries.text: We found a smuggler in Riften who gave us a note detailing Remi's family and their move to Skaven. It sounds like they're doing well. It's been some time since Remiel wrote her tip-off to the Order of the Hour. We should check if the smuggler in Riften has any news about Morvic's response.
entries.translated_text: 我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，他给了我们一张便条，详细说明了蕾米的家人以及他们搬到斯卡文的地方。听起来他们过得很好。距离蕾米尔给时序团写信已经有一段时间了。我们应该去看看裂谷城的走私者有没有关于莫维克消息。

entries.text: She must be very powerful, then, since you're so good at it.
entries.translated_text: 那么，她一定很强大，因为你也很擅长。

entries.text: Never mind, then.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那算了。

entries.text: Oh, to Scrap. You know, the dwemer spider that travels with me.
entries.translated_text: 哦，和小渣。你知道，和我一起旅行的锻莫蜘蛛。

entries.text: Yep, absolute gibberish.
entries.translated_text: 是的，完全是胡言乱语。

entries.text: Do you think Serana is doing alright? With all this sun?
entries.translated_text: 你觉得瑟拉娜还好吗？整天在阳光下？

entries.text: Disable Automaton
entries.translated_text: 禁用机器人

entries.text: Disable Automaton
entries.translated_text: 禁用机器人

entries.text: Good boy, Scrap! You're such a good boy!
entries.translated_text: 好孩子，小渣！你真是个好孩子！

entries.text: Oo, any others?
entries.translated_text: 哦，还有其他的吗？

entries.text: You're telling me that dragons cannot refuse a call to battle? Now I see why the ancient Nords worshipped them.
entries.translated_text: 你是在告诉我，龙不能拒绝战斗的召唤？现在我明白为什么古代诺德人会信仰他们了。

entries.text: Thank. You! We. Team! But... What. Redcap. Do??
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你！我们，团队，但是...红帽子？？

entries.text: I'd like to hear something somber and emotional... I'm in that kind of mood.
entries.translated_text: 我想听一些忧郁和抒情的东西...我就是那种心情。

entries.text: Beautiful Dwemer ruins, Forsworn raids, rude Thalmor agents, dumb rich Silver-Bloods, labour camps... And Daedra worship!
entries.translated_text: 美丽的锻莫遗址、背誓者袭击、粗鲁的梭默特使、愚蠢但富有的银血家族、劳工营...还有魔族信仰！

entries.text: I'm pretty sure Remi doesn't know how to cook, but I'm not about to tell her that.
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定蕾米不会做饭，但我不会给她说。

entries.text: They kept following him because even after his defeat, he was still Trinimac.
entries.translated_text: 他们之所以一直跟随着他，因为即使在他失败之后，他仍然是崔尼马克。

entries.text: Since I'm here now... Should I come with you? I'm afraid if I let you out of my sight, you'll end up imprisoned again.
entries.translated_text: 既然我来了...要我跟你一起走吗？我怕如果我让你离开我的视线后，你又会被人抓起来。

entries.text: Ooh, Scrap shiny!
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，发光！

entries.text: Very funny. I'm being serious, though!
entries.translated_text: 挺有趣，不过我是认真的！

entries.text: I was just thinking of ordering something. Thank you!
entries.translated_text: 我刚才还在想着点点什么呢，谢谢你！

entries.text: Oh! I was just, eh, fishing. You know?
entries.translated_text: 哦！我只是在，嗯，钓鱼。你懂吗？

entries.text: My mother's husband when I was growing up was not my father. So... He was not my father, but he was. I think... I might understand?
entries.translated_text: 在我成长的过程中，我母亲的丈夫不是我的父亲。所以...他不是我的父亲，但他是。我想...我可能理解？

entries.text: Despite this, their tendency to live free and follow the wilds of nature... It always fascinated me.
entries.translated_text: 尽管如此，他们自由自在的生活和追随大自然的野性的向往...总是让我着迷。

entries.text: Oh! Th-that- I'm so sorry. Er- N-not that there's anything wrong with Rivenspire!
entries.translated_text: 真对不起呃，不是说碎裂山峰有什么问题。

entries.text: Give my regards to Hermaeus Mora!
entries.translated_text: 向赫麦尤斯·莫拉致敬！

entries.text: I wandered the wastes of Vvardenfell. I've spent enough time on Solstheim to last a lifetime. I lived in the Gray Quarter of Windhelm for years.
entries.translated_text: 我在瓦登费尔的废土上徘徊。我在索瑟海姆度过了足够铭记一生的时光。我在风舵城的灰区住了很多年。

entries.text: Come, my friend, let's empty their veins together!
entries.translated_text: 来吧，我的朋友，让我们一起放干他们的血！

entries.text: And Keening is designed to extract power.
entries.translated_text: 而哀恸是为了汲取力量而设计的。

entries.text: I've got six dwarven metal ingots here.
entries.translated_text: 我这里有六个矮人金属锭。

entries.text: I worship a Divine.
entries.translated_text: 我确实信仰某个圣灵。

entries.text: Oh no, you don't. Don't even start putting that into my head.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，你不可能高。想都别想。

entries.text: Bone Meal
entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.text: Bone Meal
entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.text: Bone Meal
entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.text: Bone Meal
entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.text: Bone Meal
entries.translated_text: 骨粉

entries.text: It's a diamond.
entries.translated_text: 这是一颗钻石。

entries.text: Oh, er, not that- Not that that's the point here.
entries.translated_text: 哦，呃，不是说--不是说这是重点。

entries.text: How'd you learn to read, then?
entries.translated_text: 那你是怎么学会阅读的？

entries.text: What were they like?
entries.translated_text: 他们是什么样的人？

entries.text: It's fine. We're not going to be crushed. The ceiling isn't going to cave in. We're not going to be crushed. We're not going to be crushed.
entries.translated_text: 没关系。我们不会被压扁的。天花板不会塌陷。我们不会被压扁。我们不会被压扁的。

entries.text: Was paid enough for two boats this time 'round!
entries.translated_text: 这次得到的钱足够买两艘船了!

entries.text: Hillgrund's Tomb
entries.translated_text: 潜山之墓

entries.text: You really don't mind that I'm an assassin?
entries.translated_text: 你真的不介意我是刺客吗？

entries.text: Oh, you again. Did you need something? I'm a little busy here.
entries.translated_text: 哦，又是你，你需要什么吗？我这里有点忙。

entries.text: Whatever the case, you liked that... mace. Didn't you? He promised you that if you do this?
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，你挺喜欢那把...钉锤。不是吗？如果你找他说的做，他就会给你？

entries.text: Lead the way, Suryvel.
entries.translated_text: 带路吧，苏里维尔。

entries.text: How did you do that?!
entries.translated_text: 你是怎么做到的？！

entries.text: So we're off then, Ubbe? Lead the way.
entries.translated_text: 所以我们走了，乌贝？带路。

entries.text: What can I do for you, my friend?
entries.translated_text: 我能为你做些什么，我的朋友？

entries.text: Physically I'm okay. But I'm furious! And it's... It's... Well, I've never actually been imprisoned like this before.
entries.translated_text: 我身体还好。但是我很生气而且...这...我从没像这样被人囚禁过。

entries.text: My... junk?
entries.translated_text: 我的...垃圾？

entries.text: Just in time! I accidentally spent all my gold betting at the last inn we stayed at. My opponent was a much better cheater than me.
entries.translated_text: 来得正好，在我们住的最后一家旅店时，我不小心把所有金币都赌光了。我的对手比我强多了。

entries.text: From what those two have said, it doesn't sound like Isran is too great at making friends. Who would've thought?
