entries.translated_text: 从这两个人的说法来看，伊士冉似乎不太擅长交朋友。谁能想到？

entries.text: Well, this is supposedly a Nord-Nord meal. And what city is more Nord-y than Windhelm, right?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这应该是一顿诺德餐。还有哪个城市比风舵城更诺德呢，对吧？

entries.text: In Black Marsh, all the drinks taste like the swamp.
entries.translated_text: 在黑沼泽，所有的饮料都有沼泽的味道。

entries.text: Wha? I'm afraid to go down there.
entries.translated_text: 什么？我不敢下去。

entries.text: I... I didn't want my actions to affect you, too! But I couldn't stop it. I couldn't, no more than I could save my own family!
entries.translated_text: 我...我本不想让我的行为也牵连到你！可是我无能为力。我做不到，就像我也救不了我自己的家人一样！

entries.text: It's not.
entries.translated_text: 确实不便宜。

entries.text: It's not.
entries.translated_text: 确实不便宜。

entries.text: What do you mean?!
entries.translated_text: 你是什​​么意思？！

entries.text: Okay, we have the fragment, you're going to be inducted into the Companions, and Farkas is a werewolf. All these things are normal.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我们拿到碎片了，你要加入入战友团了，而法卡斯却是狼人。这些都很正常的。

entries.text: Yes, that groaning sounds like draugr... Not excited.
entries.translated_text: 是的，那呻吟声听起来像尸鬼一样...无趣。

entries.text: Good boy, Scrap!
entries.translated_text: 好孩子，小渣！

entries.text: Just remember that I run out of breath pretty quickly, so don't go leaving me behind.
entries.translated_text: 要记得，我很快就会喘不上气，所以不要离开我。

entries.text: Is that what she meant?
entries.translated_text: 她是这个意思吗？

entries.text: Aww, don't start holding out on me now. We're so close.
entries.translated_text: 哎呀，现在可别开始对我隐瞒了，我们已经这么熟了。

entries.text: I'm just a little distracted by your Psijic friends stealing our orb!
entries.translated_text: 我只是因为被你的赛伊克朋友偷了我们的神器而分心了！

entries.text: How are you floating like that?!
entries.translated_text: 你是怎么像那样漂着的？！

entries.text: ;Let the flirting commence
entries.translated_text: ;Lettheflirtingcommence

entries.text: Alright, now that we're done talking- Wait, Suryvel, we were done talking, right? Sometimes it's hard for me to tell.
entries.translated_text: 好了，现在我们聊完了——等等，苏里维尔，我们已经聊完了，对吧？有时我很难说。

entries.text: Keep going.
entries.translated_text: 继续。

entries.text: Mjoll ran away from that?! She should've been running toward it!
entries.translated_text: 穆月尔从那逃走了？！她应该向那跑回去！

entries.text: Remiel's Potion of Plentiful Magicka
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的足量法力药水

entries.text: Remi is slightly put off by pc
entries.translated_text: Remiisslightlyputoffbypc

entries.text: This city... ignites some righteous fury in me.
entries.translated_text: 这座城市...激起了我心中的正义之怒。

entries.text: Uh, F-fair point!
entries.translated_text: 呃——这、这倒是说得过去！（F-fair，F）

entries.text: (Sigh) And now Morvic's invaded. Let's look around for him. But be careful; he's crafty.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）现在莫维克入侵了。我们找找他吧。不过要小心——他很狡猾。

entries.text: Did you... Are you okay with what happened?
entries.translated_text: 你...你对发生的事情还好吗？

entries.text: It seems real thieves are not as romantic as in the tales.
entries.translated_text: 看来真正的小偷并不像传说中那样浪漫。

entries.text: You're going to try and, uh... promote it? How? Leave pamphlets in inns, stuff like that?
entries.translated_text: 你要尝试，呃...推广它？怎么做？在旅馆里留下小册子，或者类似这样的东西？

entries.text: It's a little awkward with your dwemer sphere here, too. He's like some guy. Who doesn't talk to us. We should program him a voice.
entries.translated_text: 你在这儿的锻莫机械球也有点尴尬。他就像一个人，却不和我们说话，我们应该给他编程一个声音。

entries.text: Lock Pick
entries.translated_text: 撬锁

entries.text: Well, I don't know, Scrap. Maybe if I- Oh! Buffy! Did you want to talk?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我不知道，小渣。也许如果我——哦！巴非！你想谈谈吗？

entries.text: A few months after I joined. It wasn't one big incident that made me decide to leave; I just gradually stopped showing up.
entries.translated_text: 在我加入几个月后，让我决定离开的并不是一件大事。

entries.text: I'm rather confused. How can you enjoy this Bartokh but also hate him?
entries.translated_text: 我感到相当困惑。你怎么能既喜欢这个巴托克又讨厌他？

entries.text: Enhanced Crossbow
entries.translated_text: 强化弩

entries.text: I didn't know anything about the Empire or the Thalmor before I had to flee my home.
entries.translated_text: 在我被迫逃离家园之前，我对帝国或梭默都一无所知。

entries.text: What is it, Farillae?
entries.translated_text: 它是什么，法里拉？

entries.text: Having both Redcap and Khash along with us is very nice. I must seem tall in comparison to them, as people have stopped mistaking me for a child.
entries.translated_text: 有红帽和卡什和我们在一起真是太好了。和他们相比，我一定显得很高，人们就不会把我误认成孩子了。

entries.text: Miraak has a whole temple here, but he's jealous of you? Someone is low confidence.
entries.translated_text: 秘拉克在这里有一整座神殿，但他居然嫉妒你？有人没信心啊。

entries.text: What?! How rude! I have some tricks up my sleeve, too, you know!
entries.translated_text: 什么？！好粗鲁！我也有一些绝招，你知道的！

entries.text: Ghost fight!
entries.translated_text: 鬼在战斗！

entries.text: Focus, Remi. What's our plan?
entries.translated_text: 专注点，蕾米。我们的计划是什么？

entries.text: No clue.
entries.translated_text: 没有任何线索。

entries.text: Do you see the automaton prototypes below the levers? Hit them with this, and I'll know which lever you're wanting me to pull!
entries.translated_text: 你看到杠杆下面的机器原型了吗？用这个打他们，我就知道你想让我拉哪根杆子了!

entries.text: I can't believe it... That beautiful statue... doomed to a watery grave...
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信...那漂亮的雕像...注定要成为一个水坟...

entries.text: So, I'm curious - how did you get to Skyrim? Like, what method did you use to travel here, how did the journey go, and all that?
entries.translated_text: 所以，我很好奇--你是怎么来到天际的？比如你是怎么过来的，路上发生了啥？

entries.text: I was distracted the last battle.
entries.translated_text: 我在上次战斗中分心了。

entries.text: I'm certainly no fan of the law. People dictating what I should or shouldn't do doesn't sit right for me, after all.
entries.translated_text: 我当然不喜欢法律。毕竟，别人来决定我该做或不该做什么会让我不舒服。

entries.text: Still, be careful. These draugr like to play dead.
entries.translated_text: 不过，还是要小心。这些尸鬼喜欢装死。

entries.text: There's danger ahead.
entries.translated_text: 前面有危险。

entries.text: Raven, if you don't die, then I won't die! Deal?
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，如果你不死，那我就不会死！明白？

entries.text: Have you been working on anything new lately?
entries.translated_text: 你最近有没有鼓捣什么新东西？

entries.text: Honestly, I'd take it as a compliment.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我会把它当作一种赞美。

entries.text: It's hard to feel bad for Arniel when he just keeps making deals with Enthir, who has proven to be unreliable at best.
entries.translated_text: 很难对阿尼尔感到同情，他老是和恩希尔做交易，而恩希尔顶多算是个不靠谱的人。

entries.text: You need a slave-driving foreman? Find an Orc.
entries.translated_text: 你需要一个奴隶监工吗？去找个兽人。

entries.text: Temple of Kynareth
entries.translated_text: 凯娜瑞丝神殿

entries.text: Molag Bal has the power to revive the dead? I suppose he is the father of vampires.
entries.translated_text: 莫拉格·巴尔有起死回生的能力？我猜他就是吸血鬼之父了。

entries.text: Anyway, just give me some time, okay? I'll see you later.
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，给我一点时间，好吗？一会儿见。

entries.text: Yeah, there's no way I'm doing that.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我不可能那样做。

entries.text: Buffy, we lived! Oh, maybe I should try to sound less surprised. I'll work on that.
entries.translated_text: 巴非，我们活了下来！哦，也许我应该试着听起来不那么惊讶。我会努力解决这个问题。

entries.text: Oh, no, it's... So good! Really... ah... Chaurus-y!
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，是...太好了！真是...啊...巢蚁！

entries.text: Something has shifted in the moons.
entries.translated_text: 月亮上有些东西发生了变化。

entries.text: Scrap's Extra Damage 2
entries.translated_text: Scrap's Extra Damage 2

entries.text: I sailed from the Summerset Isles.
entries.translated_text: 我从夏暮岛坐船来的。

entries.text: Well, you're not wrong, I guess. I've just been thinking about Vampire Hunters.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我想你没说错。我一直在思考吸血鬼猎人。

entries.text: It didn't have to be this way!
entries.translated_text: 这不必是这样的！

entries.text: It didn't have to be this way!
entries.translated_text: 它不必是这样的！

entries.text: It's admirable to be so willing to fight for what you believe.
entries.translated_text: 愿意为自己的信仰而战值得钦佩。

entries.text: Case of Confiscated Skooma
entries.translated_text: 装着被没收的斯库玛的盒子

entries.text: Case of Confiscated Skooma
entries.translated_text: 装着被没收的斯库玛的盒子

entries.text: Case of Confiscated Skooma
entries.translated_text: 装着被没收的斯库玛的盒子

entries.text: Oh, just enjoying Skyrim's lovely weather.
entries.translated_text: 哦，只是享受天际的可爱天气。

entries.text: Uh, hi. I'm Remi.
entries.translated_text: 呃，你好。我是蕾米。

entries.text: Actually, Remi, never mind going home.
entries.translated_text: 其实，雷米，别回家了。

entries.text: So... how do you feel about it? My father's a heartless bastard, but I still wouldn't want his corpse wandering around.
entries.translated_text: 所以...你对此有何感想？我父亲是个没心没肺的混蛋，但我仍然不希望他的尸体四处游荡。

entries.text: Alright, let's trade. But I am a Breton, as well.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们来交易吧。不过，我也是布莱顿人。

entries.text: Shall we get going?
entries.translated_text: 我们走吧？

entries.text: Shall we get going?
entries.translated_text: 我们走吧？

entries.text: You know, I changed my mind. This is a wonderful field trip!
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我改变主意了。这是一次美妙的实地考察！

entries.text: I hope that Margret can assist the Imperials in procuring ownership of the Mine. Although, I suppose they'd also just use it as a labour camp.
entries.translated_text: 我希望玛格丽特能协助帝国获得矿场的所有权。不过，我想他们也会把它当作一个劳改营。

entries.text: Do you want to try summoning spirits tonight? Contact souls in Aetherius? Ask them what being dead is like?
entries.translated_text: 今晚要不要尝试召唤幽灵？召唤艾瑟瑞斯的灵魂？问下他们死亡是什么感觉？

entries.text: Or is it just called that because Aetherium is blue... and glows?
entries.translated_text: 还是因为神光水晶是蓝色的...而且会发光？

entries.text: This stuff goes down smooth! Thanks!
entries.translated_text: 这酒真顺口！谢谢你！

entries.text: I've noticed people tend to become offended if I wander off into my thoughts too often. They seem to think it means I don't find them interesting.
entries.translated_text: 我注意到，如果我经常胡思乱想，人们往往会感到不快。他们似乎认为这说明我对他们不感兴趣。

entries.text: Wonderful. Now we can get the base done.
entries.translated_text: 精彩的。现在我们可以完成基础了。

entries.text: We don't have time for that.
entries.translated_text: 我们没有时间这样做。

entries.text: Oh, don't be a tease! What was that all about?
entries.translated_text: 哦，别逗我了！那到底是怎么回事？

entries.text: People say Sujamma makes you as strong as an ox. I think most drunk people believe they're strong as an ox, though.
entries.translated_text: 人们说苏加玛能让你像牛一样强壮。不过，我认为大多数醉酒的人都认为自己像牛一样强壮。

entries.text: Nchardak was a powerhouse of a city, back in its prime. It created complete automatons very quickly.
entries.translated_text: 纳查达克是城市中的望族，在巅峰鼎盛时期，他们曾创建了完善的自动工坊。

entries.text: Yes and no. From my understanding, they are Druids except... more extreme. *Very* into being Druids.
entries.translated_text: 是，也不是。根据我的理解，他们是德鲁伊，但是...更极端。*非常*的德鲁伊化。

entries.text: I discovered that I am the Listener.
entries.translated_text: 我发现我是聆听者。

entries.text: You really think I'm going to carry your stuff? No way.
entries.translated_text: 你真以为我会背你的东西？没门。

entries.text: Ganbald. Do you perhaps have Nord ancestors? Or were your parents fond of Nordic names? It's just a very Nord-y name.
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德。你有诺德祖先吗？或者你的父母喜欢诺德名字？这就是一个非常诺德味儿的名字。

entries.text: That's a good start, but jewelry is where the real money is. I've listed three rings with gemstones today. I even left the fingers behind!
entries.translated_text: 这是一个好的开端，但珠宝才是真正赚钱的地方。我今天得到了三枚镶有宝石的戒指。甚至是从手指上摘下来的！

entries.text: I know quite a bit of magic.
entries.translated_text: 我懂很多魔法。

entries.text: I've seen exactly Cyrodiil... Never left the province. But yeah, we has some Boethiah faithful among our ranks that... yeah.
entries.translated_text: 我确实见过赛瑞迪尔……当时从未离开过这个省。但是，是的，我们的队伍中有一些波耶西亚信徒……是的。

entries.text: Hmm? Sorry, were you talking to me?
entries.translated_text: 唔？对不起，你是在说我吗？

entries.text: It's like being born. Every time.
entries.translated_text: 每次都像是获得了新生一样。

entries.text: Get the ore for her. And stop staring at me, merchant. Don't want that to be the last look on your ugly face. You can do better than that.
entries.translated_text: 去给她拿矿石。别再盯着我了，商人。不要让这成为你丑脸上最后的表情。你应该表现好点。

entries.text: Oh, how mysterious. What could Arniel be working on? I can think of hundred of things he could use Dwarven cogs for.
entries.translated_text: 哦，多么神秘。阿内尔能做什么？我能想到他可以用锻莫齿轮做很多事。

entries.text: Well, maybe we can steal for... us?
entries.translated_text: 也许我们可以为...我们自己偷？

entries.text: I prefer dogs.
entries.translated_text: 我更喜欢狗。

entries.text: Anyway, follow me, and you can behold my mastery of engineering in action!
entries.translated_text: 总之，跟着我，我会让你看到我的技术的！

entries.text: They look upon us and see only thieves.
entries.translated_text: 他们看到我们就认为我们是贼。

entries.text: What are you implying...?
entries.translated_text: 你在暗示什么...？

entries.text: So- Do you actually like Windhelm, or are we just here out of obligation?
entries.translated_text: 所以-你真的喜欢风舵城吗，还是只是出于义务？

entries.text: I worship none.
entries.translated_text: 我什么都不信仰。

entries.text: The Frozen Hearth Cellar
entries.translated_text: 冻炉旅店地窖

entries.text: You caused him a lot of trouble.
entries.translated_text: 你给他添了不少麻烦。

entries.text: No, it was terrible.
entries.translated_text: 不，太糟糕了。

entries.text: Maybe magic spiders have a special diet. Maybe we should leave him to eat Dwarves.
entries.translated_text: 也许魔法蜘蛛有特殊的饮食。也许我们应该让他去吃矮人。

entries.text: I'm happy you're on my side, Doc.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你站在我这边，医生。

entries.text: So all this grease from fiddling with machinery isn't noticeable? Good to know.
entries.translated_text: 所以，我摆弄机械弄得满手油腻也不明显吗？好吧，知道了。

entries.text: Your intellect rivals the dwemer themselves.
entries.translated_text: 你的智力可以与锻莫相媲美。

entries.text: Perfect. These will make sure the crossbow is nice and sturdy.
entries.translated_text: 完美,这些将确保弩既美观又坚固。

entries.text: (Gasp) I can't go on.
entries.translated_text: （喘气）我不能继续了。

entries.text: You keep trying to talk to me, so renovation is not going well at all.
entries.translated_text: 你一直想跟我说话，所以装修一点也不顺利。

entries.text: Oh. Ohhhh, I thought... I see. Um. Well, don't tell anyone else, okay? But I don't see the harm in a... sip of ale.
entries.translated_text: 哦。哦，我以为...我明白了。嗯。好吧，不要告诉别人，好吗？但我看不出喝一口麦芽酒有什么害处。

entries.text: I see. So the Thalmor don't *really* rule Valenwood?
entries.translated_text: 我懂了。所以梭默不会*真的*统治威木省？

entries.text: Oh! Well, only one more, since this is definitely the fourth one!
entries.translated_text: 噢！好，只有一个了，因此这绝对是第四个了！

entries.text: Well, this one time I was talking to Greta- you know, from Solitude?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，有一次我在和格瑞塔谈话--你知道吗，那个独孤城的？

entries.text: ...This might be a touchy subject, but where is he?
entries.translated_text: ...这可能是一个敏感的话题，但他在哪里？

entries.text: Let's bring that priest to him.
entries.translated_text: 让我们把祭司带给他。

entries.text: Scrap, rip them open!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，撕开它！

entries.text: (Laughs) Well, I can't say I didn't have my own suspicions.
entries.translated_text: (笑)好吧，我也同意。

entries.text: Hm, I don't think I can sme- ...Ugh, Malacath's sweet taint that's *horrible*.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我想我不能抹...唉，玛拉凯斯的甜蜜污染真是太*可怕*了。

entries.text: Suryvel. Am I saying that right? Suryvel. Suryvel. Okay, I've committed it to memory.
entries.translated_text: 苏里维尔，我说得对吗？苏里维尔，苏里维尔，好的，我已经把它记在心里了。

entries.text: A Falmer hive.
entries.translated_text: 一个伐莫巢穴。

entries.text: Ahh, Serana, get them!
entries.translated_text: 啊，瑟拉娜，拿下他们！

entries.text: If you're getting food, Zora, I'd also like to place an order.
entries.translated_text: 如果你有吃的东西的话，佐拉，我也想要。

entries.text: What did you need, my friend?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么，我的朋友？

entries.text: I'm strong, I'm fast, I'm smart, I can do anything!
entries.translated_text: 我很强壮，我很快，我很聪明，我无所不能！

entries.text: It's easier to go graverobbing in crypts than in cemeteries. Digging is a lot of work.
entries.translated_text: 在地穴里盗墓比在墓地里更容易，挖掘可是一个累活。

entries.text: That can't be good for you.
entries.translated_text: 这样对你没好处。

entries.text: Uh... Remi. No, I can't read. I never learned.
entries.translated_text: 呃...蕾米。不，我不会读书。我从未学习过。

entries.text: No one knows how the Dwemer made their metal. Think of what I could build if I could just crack their code!
entries.translated_text: 没有人知道锻莫是如何制造金属的。想想如果我能破解他们的秘诀，我能造出什么！

entries.text: Did you need something, Revan?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，雷文？

entries.text: So... What? You're not eating?! I can't even imagine. I love eating.
entries.translated_text: 那么…什么？你不吃饭？！我甚至无法想象。我就喜欢吃。

entries.text: Well, then, meet Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 那么，来见见小渣吧。

entries.text: It might do you good to get rid of that bounty on your head. Unless your tour of the jail made being locked away seem appealing?
entries.translated_text: 你最好把头上的悬赏解决掉。除非你参观监狱时觉得被关起来还挺吸引人？

entries.text: That rush of adrenaline when you hear-What was that?!
entries.translated_text: 当你听到——“那是什么？！”时，那股肾上腺素会突然激增！

entries.text: Drunk already, huh? Save some for the rest of us!
entries.translated_text: 已经喝醉了，是吗？给我们其他人留点吧！

entries.text: Don't people in Skyrim wear that, um, when they're... interested in someone?
entries.translated_text: 天际的人是不是会戴上那个，嗯，当他们……对某人感兴趣时？

entries.text: Whatever you say.
entries.translated_text: 都听你的。

entries.text: Oh no! I thought you were being rude to me! I'm not usually mean to others!
entries.translated_text: 哦，不！我以为你羞辱我！我通常不会对别人太刻薄！

entries.text: Harkon's reign is coming to an end. Let's finish this.
entries.translated_text: 哈孔的统治即将结束，让我们终结它。

entries.text: ...What jokes are you talking about...?
entries.translated_text: ...你在说什么笑话...？

entries.text: Either way, I look forward to such history repeating itself.
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，我都期待着这样的历史重演。

entries.text: Well, it's small and doesn't like strangers, but I actually love small towns.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，它又小又排外，但我实际上喜欢小镇。

entries.text: You're right, but I wish you'd humour me, at least.
entries.translated_text: 你说得对，但我真希望你至少能顺着我一点。

entries.text: 'Bend Will?' So this shout is responsible for everyone in Solstheim essentially sleepwalking to Miraak's Temple.
entries.translated_text: “意志屈服？”所以是这个吼声控制着索瑟海姆的每个人，基本上都是梦游到的秘拉克神殿。

entries.text: That's a lot of locks on his door. I don't blame him for his caution, but I wonder who he's been trusting enough to get food from.
entries.translated_text: 他的门上有很多锁，我不会因为他的谨慎而责备他，但我想知道他信任谁来获得食物。

entries.text: Even when I'm not knee-deep in dwemer metal, I don't quite have the... attention necessary for paying attention to such things.
entries.translated_text: 即使在我没有深陷于锻莫材料的时候，我也没有足够的...注意力来关注这种事情。

entries.text: Well, all that I know about. And that was a lot!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我知道的全去过，很多！

entries.text: Well, all that I know about. And that was a lot!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我所知道的一切。那是很多！

entries.text: Oh, well, I like hunting and reading. Okay, well, I attempt to read. But I really love braiding!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我喜欢打猎和阅读。好吧，其实我只是努力在读书啦。不过我真的很喜欢编织！

entries.text: Lead the way, Revan.
entries.translated_text: 带路吧，渡鸦。

entries.text: By the Eight, how far did we travel? I thought I had more blisters than usual! Whiterun to Rorikstead to Markarth. All in one night? By Sheor.
entries.translated_text: 八圣灵呐，我们走了多远？我磨出了好多水泡！从白漫城到洛利克镇到再到马卡斯城。一夜之间？舒奥尔啊。

entries.text: I, er, I mean... I... love you.
entries.translated_text: 我，呃，我是说...我...爱你。

entries.text: Find six dwarven metal ingots. (<Global=HLIORPCIngotsCount>/<Global=HLIORPCIngotsTotal>)
entries.translated_text: 找到六个矮人金属锭。(<Global=HLIORPCIngotsCount>/<Global=HLIORPCIngotsTotal>)

entries.text: Nice to be making some coin again.
entries.translated_text: 又赚一笔的感觉很不赖。

entries.text: It's like they were just here.
entries.translated_text: 就像他们刚刚在这里一样。

entries.text: Skooma.
entries.translated_text: 斯库玛。

entries.text: Yes, very. I would like to wear an elegant gown, the kind they have on the islands, where every day is a summer one.
entries.translated_text: 是啊。我想穿一件优雅的礼服，就像夏暮岛上的那种，那里每天都是夏天。

entries.text: I'm almost certain I'd win there, too.
entries.translated_text: 我几乎可以肯定我也会在那里获胜。

entries.text: Remiel's Draught of Resist Magic
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔的魔法抗性高级药水

entries.text: Like the best of friends.
entries.translated_text: 就像最好的朋友一样。

entries.text: Is immortality worth what you've become?
entries.translated_text: 不朽值得你变成那样吗？

entries.text: A local specialty! Excellent!
entries.translated_text: 当地特产！真棒！

entries.text: He's a renown scholar! I, um, read his books once. I'm just saying we could learn a lot from him... Besides, he might PAY US for the things we find.
entries.translated_text: 他是一位著名的学者！我，嗯，曾经读过他的一些书。我只是想说我们可以从他那里学到很多东西...而且，他可能会为我们发现的东西买单。

entries.text: I have no idea.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道。

entries.text: And I do like people, so characters are fun, too. Are any of your stories... available? For reading?
entries.translated_text: 而且我确实喜欢人物，所以说人物也很有趣。你写的故事...带着吗？我能看看吗？

entries.text: Hi there, what- ...Sorry, a very important thought needed my attention for a moment. What were you going to say?
entries.translated_text: 你好，怎么了--...对不起，我有个很重要的想法需要好好想一下。你要说什么来着？

entries.text: Well, I read it, like I said I would, and definitely not because I ran out of other reading material, and...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我读了它，就像我说的那样，肯定不是因为我没有其他阅读材料了，而且...

entries.text: That's right! I think you two will be great friends.
entries.translated_text: 这就对了！我想你们两个会是好朋友的。

entries.text: Now that was a fight!
entries.translated_text: 现在战斗开始了!

entries.text: Nope, our friend's enemies deserve it. Mine never did. Mostly farmhands, or whoever got conscripted.
entries.translated_text: 不，我们朋友的敌人罪有应得。我的敌人却不是。主要是农场工人，或一些被应征入伍的人。

entries.text: This place is much prettier than the Temple! Perhaps they should just have pilgrims come here. Although it seems there's already some milling about.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方比神殿要漂亮得多！也许他们应该让朝圣者来这里。不过，似乎已经有一些人在转悠了。

entries.text: I-I... Well, I've been surrounded by... heavier substances than mead in my life.
entries.translated_text: 我-我……好吧，我这辈子到处……都是比蜂蜜酒更让人沉重的东西。

entries.text: Khajiit are not known as mages, so J'zargo has much to prove. J'zargo has worked hard on learning new spells, trying new things.
entries.translated_text: 虎人并不以法师闻名，所以吉'扎格有很多需要证明很多。吉'扎格一直在努力学习新法术，尝试新事物。

entries.text: Here's your share of our most recent sale, Remi. Don't spend it all in one place!
entries.translated_text: 这是你在我们最近的生意中所有的份额，蕾米。别一下花光了！

entries.text: Wine stains easily. Hopefully I don't get so drunk that I spill it all over again.
entries.translated_text: 葡萄酒很容易留下污渍，希望我别喝到醉得又洒得到处都是。

entries.text: And you were right! There are more dwemer ruins calling my name.
entries.translated_text: 你是对的！有更多的锻莫遗址在呼唤我的名字。

entries.text: Are they all going to be alright here, with Ancano... doing whatever he's doing?
entries.translated_text: 他们都在这里好吗，还有安卡诺...在为所欲为？

entries.text: Teldryn sure is well-travelled. I hope to go to as many places as he has.
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因肯定见多识广，我希望能像他一样去很多地方。

entries.text: Alright, let's go.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我们走吧。

entries.text: And you? What about your family?
entries.translated_text: 你呢？那你的家庭是怎样？

entries.text: Are we heading out, then? Make sure to tell Yaz.
entries.translated_text: 那我们要出去吗？一定要告诉雅扎。

entries.text: It seems this Sinderion was in Blackreach to study... Nirnroot, of all things. An entire legendary dwemer city, and he was picking flowers...
entries.translated_text: 看来这个辛德莱昂是在黑境研究...奈恩根，最重要的是。在一整个传说中的锻莫城市中，他在采花...

entries.text: I... It's hard to talk about.
entries.translated_text: 我……很难说。

entries.text: Oh, by the Eight...
entries.translated_text: 哦，八圣灵在上……

entries.text: It's so nice to see Arkngchal again. I wish it were under different circumstances.
entries.translated_text: 再次看见阿卡切尔真是太开心了。虽然我觉得换种方式会更好。

entries.text: Well, then I guess I'll have to get good at getting out of the way.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那我想我得好好躲闪。

entries.text: Yes, alright.
entries.translated_text: 是的，计划通。

entries.text: I'm from Wayrest. It's spectacular there, too. Have you travelled a lot?
entries.translated_text: 我来自途歇城。那里也很壮观。你经常旅行吗？

entries.text: I must admit, I have no idea what Yaz's story was about. Don't tell her; I don't want her to think I'm not as smart as she is.
entries.translated_text: 我必须承认，我不知道雅扎的故事是怎么回事。不要告诉她；我不想让她认为我没有她想的那么聪明。

entries.text: And here I thought I wasn't going to have any fun!
entries.translated_text: 我觉得我在这里找不到任何乐子！

entries.text: Well, we'd better watch our backs.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们最好小心点。

entries.text: Ouch! Ouch! That's hot! Really hot!
entries.translated_text: 哎哟！哎哟！太热了！好热！

entries.text: Ooh, so you've taken to worshipping Mara now?
entries.translated_text: 哦，所以你现在开始信仰玛拉了？

entries.text: What's the point in having an assistant if I don't make them do some work?
entries.translated_text: 如果助手没有活儿，那他们还有什么意义呢？

entries.text: What's wrong? Are Ahmed and I more than you can handle?!
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？应付不了艾哈迈德和我？

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: Hawk Beak
entries.translated_text: 鹰喙

entries.text: No offense, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 无意冒犯，小渣。

entries.text: You better not  break the law when you're with me.
entries.translated_text: 你和我在一起的时候最好不要触犯法律。

entries.text: Great!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！

entries.text: Great!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！

entries.text: Great!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了！

entries.text: You know, Ria, I am looking forward to our next Dwemer ruin. We're going to another one. Right?
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，利亚，我很期待我们的下一个锻莫遗址。我们又要去一个了，是吗？

entries.text: But I was helping in spirit, trust me.
entries.translated_text: 但我在精神上提供了帮助，相信我。

entries.text: Let there be light.
entries.translated_text: 照亮这里.

entries.text: Someone who hasn't even given you a promise... Well.
entries.translated_text: 但一个连承诺都不肯给你的人...好吧。

entries.text: Excellent! Well, I'm sure the people in Solitude would have news about any new boats in the harbour. We can start by asking around.
entries.translated_text: 太好了！好吧，我敢肯定，港口有任何新船的消息孤独城的人们都会知道。我们可以从四处打听开始。

entries.text: Doctor, are you okay? Knowing your name references a medic, it feels odd for me to be checking your wellbeing.
entries.translated_text: 医生，你还好吗？知道你的名字指的是治疗师，而我检查你的健康状况感觉很奇怪。

entries.text: Ha-Ha. Do you have more bad jokes? Then I'd be out of a job.
entries.translated_text: 哈-哈。你还有别的烂笑话吗？那我就没事干了。

entries.text: Hah!
entries.translated_text: 哈！

entries.text: Do you think my skin will melt off if I try to touch it?
entries.translated_text: 你认为如果我试着去碰它，我的皮肤会融化掉吗？

entries.text: I'll see you at home, then.
entries.translated_text: 那就家里见吧。

entries.text: Alright, alright, you win.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，好吧，你赢了。

entries.text: Didn't you see that vision of that monk?
entries.translated_text: 你没看到那个僧侣的那个异象吗？

entries.text: It was in between jobs for her and she'd returned home for a short while to visit. It was her going-away gift from her before she left for Glenumbra.
entries.translated_text: 当时正值她的工作间隙，她回家探望了一小段时间。这是她离开格林纳巴时别人送给她的饯别礼物。

entries.text: It's... not as shiny as I was expecting.
entries.translated_text: 这...没我想象的那么有光泽。

entries.text: They say there's a bard here who looks like a bandit.
entries.translated_text: 他们说这里有个吟游诗人看起来像个强盗。

entries.text: I was just admiring this metallurgy.
entries.translated_text: 我只是在欣赏这种冶金术。

entries.text: I also cannot fathom what you would see in such a rusty excuse for a weapon. So, no dealings with Molag Bal for us.
entries.translated_text: 我也不知道你们能从这把锈迹斑斑的武器上看到什么。所以，我们别和莫拉格·巴尔打交道。

entries.text: A-are you okay?!
entries.translated_text: 你没事吧？

entries.text: A-are you okay?!
entries.translated_text: 你没事吧？

entries.text: A-are you okay?!
entries.translated_text: 你没事吧？

entries.text: Hm. Smells good! Okay, so the sauce goes onto the chaurus meat. And now the pie itself...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，闻起来很香！好的，所以酱汁会流到巢蚁肉上。现在来做馅饼本身...

entries.text: Ugh. What did Morvic do? Trip every alarm in this place? I can't continue forward, and from what I can tell, neither can you.
entries.translated_text: 哇哦，莫维克做了什么？难道他触发了这里所有警报吗？看来我们都不能继续前进了。

entries.text: It's Una, then? Then I will be calling you that soon-a. I'm sorry, that was very terrible. It sounded funnier in my imagination. Una. You are Una.
entries.translated_text: 那么，尤娜？那我会很快叫你...对不起，那太可怕了，在我的想象中，这听起来会更有趣，尤娜。你是尤娜。

entries.text: By all means, do what you feel drawn to, but I... will be an observer and nothing more.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，做你想做的事吧，但我...只是一个旁观者，仅此而已。

entries.text: Who am I gonna tell? Don't worry, I just want to know what you're plotting. It might be fun!
entries.translated_text: 我要告诉谁？别担心，我只想知道你在密谋什么，也许会很有趣。

entries.text: That fire is so relaxing. Making me sleepy. I hope we're staying awhile.
entries.translated_text: 那个火焰太让人放松了，让我昏昏欲睡，我希望我们能呆一会儿。

entries.text: Well, Scrap, it's time to fight again!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，小渣，是时候再次战斗了！

entries.text: Yes, yes, thank you and all that. How did you get it? No, never mind, I probably shouldn't know.
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，谢谢你。你怎么弄到的？不，没事了，我可能不应该知道。

entries.text: I'm always up for some good, old-fashioned revenge. Let's wipe these Silver Hand thugs out.
entries.translated_text: 我一直都喜欢来点老派的复仇！让我们消灭这些白银之手的恶棍。

entries.text: Well, that 'milk drinker' had horrendous taste. Er. So you're trying to... teach yourself to read? It doesn't seem to be going well.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，那个“小鬼”身上味道很难闻。呃，所以你想…自学阅读？事情似乎不太顺利。

entries.text: Check out what my friend and I found!
entries.translated_text: 看看我和我的朋友发现了什么！

entries.text: I'm not sure. Time is difficult for me to keep track of at the best of times, never mind when we're delving into ruins.
entries.translated_text: 我不确定，即使是在平时我也很难判断时间，更别说我们现在在遗址里。

entries.text: I hope the Nords here don't notice Scrap. They don't seem like the understanding type.
entries.translated_text: 我希望这里的诺德人不会注意到小渣。他们看起来不像能理解这些。

entries.text: I wonder if the Houses of Morrowind have noticed how it turned out for the Direnni? Or perhaps their arrogance blinds them to it.
entries.translated_text: 我想知道晨风的家族是否注意到迪伦尼家族的结局？或者也许他们的傲慢蒙蔽了他们的双眼。

entries.text: Were you going to ask me something, Ria?
entries.translated_text: 你打算问我什么吗，利亚？

entries.text: I really do love this adventuring thing. Even when we're not in dwemer ruins, there's always just something interesting to see!
entries.translated_text: 我真的很喜欢这些冒险的东西。即使我们不在锻莫遗址中，也总能看到一些有趣的东西！

entries.text: Is that another form of worship?
entries.translated_text: 这是另一种形式的信仰吗？

entries.text: Remi's Class
entries.translated_text: Remi'sClass

entries.text: Yes, the Arcanaeum! Hooray, let's go!
entries.translated_text: 好耶，秘藏馆！万岁，我们走吧！

entries.text:
<font face='$DwemerFont'>

Reading this book, you can hardly understand what's being said. Some of it even appears to be in a different language.

</font>
entries.translated_text:
<font face='$DwemerFont'>

Reading this book, you can hardly understand what's being said. Some of it even appears to be in a different language.

</font>

entries.text: Good pig. Scrap. Just. Wants. To be. Friends!
entries.translated_text: 好猪。小渣，只是，想，成为，朋友！

entries.text: They really were sacrificing spriggans here. I'm not sure I'll ever understand hagravens' pastimes.
entries.translated_text: 他们真的在这里献祭了树精，我不太确定我会理解乌鸦鬼婆的过去。

entries.text: What will we find?
entries.translated_text: 我们会发现什么？

entries.text: I wish I could play the lute... Last time I tried, I think I could hear every animal in the area all screaming out in horror at the same time.
entries.translated_text: 我希望我能弹弹鲁特琴……上次我尝试的时候，我想我听到了那里所有生灵发出了惊恐的声音。

entries.text: Hey, Remiel, someday I'm going to show you how to forest-couple.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，蕾米尔，总有一天我会教你如何成为森林伴侣。

entries.text: Do you hear those sounds? Do you think there are automaton up ahead? Hurry, let's go see!
entries.translated_text: 你听到那些声音了吗？你觉得前面有机器吗？快，我们去看看！

entries.text: Well, you're not the worst person I've ever traveled with.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你不是我旅行时遇过的最糟糕的人。

entries.text: Oh... That rock is so shiny. Why is it shiny? I quite like it. Pretty, shiny rock.
entries.translated_text: 哦......那块石头真亮。为什么闪闪发光的？我挺喜欢的漂亮闪亮的石头。

entries.text: I'd recommend caution going forward here.
entries.translated_text: 我建议在这里谨慎行事。

entries.text: Whatever they're paying you, I can do better. (Bribe <BribeCost> gold.)
entries.translated_text: 不管他们付给你什么，我都能给更多。（贿赂<BribeCost>金币。）

entries.text: Wow, and here I was avoiding even thinking about the possibility of my failure.
entries.translated_text: 哇，而我却一直在逃避去想我失败的可能性。

entries.text: 'The inns are better,' she says, because that most certainly makes up for it.
entries.translated_text: “旅店要舒适一些，”就好像这样说绝对能弥补那些遗憾一样。

entries.text: I think you've sent poor Constance into a panic. The kids don't seem to mind, though. Makes me wonder what horrible things they've seen here.
entries.translated_text: 我想你让可怜的康斯坦斯陷入了恐慌,不过，孩子们似乎并不介意。让我想知道他们在这里看到了什么可怕的事情。

entries.text: No, it's really not. You see, I was imagining having a grand meal, seated at a long table with friends and family knocking back warm drinks.
entries.translated_text: 不，并不是这样。你看，我正在想象着吃一顿大餐，坐在一张长桌前，和朋友家人一起敲着温暖的酒杯。

entries.text: Greenshade... That's in...?
What if you were learning something more adventurous? Like... forbidden knowledge?
entries.translated_text: 如果你是学习更刺激的东西呢？比如...禁忌知识？

entries.text: Is that all?
entries.translated_text: 就这样？

entries.text: Okay...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Keening is one of Kagrenac's tools. He's the chief dwemer credited with creating the Numidium.
entries.translated_text: 哀恸是卡格雷纳克的工具之一。他是创造纳米迪安的首席锻莫。

entries.text: No need to worry. I'm think it'll just leave a nasty bruise, but nothing more.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心。我想这只会留下一块严重的瘀伤，但不会更严重了。

entries.text: These giant mushrooms remind me of our time in Blackreach. I wonder if they're related somehow?
entries.translated_text: 这些巨大的蘑菇让我想起了我们在黑境的时光。我想知道他们是否有某种关系？

entries.text: The conquering hero returns!
entries.translated_text: 英雄凯旋归来！

entries.text: Lame excuse. I'm another step closer to being the champion here!
entries.translated_text: 抱歉。我离成为这里的冠军又近了一步！

entries.text: Val, with all the honesty I can muster: If you eat this, you'll likely drop dead. Don't tell our friend that, though. I made them take it.
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔，我很诚实地告诉你如果你吃了这个，很可能会死掉。不过别告诉我们的朋友是我让他们吃的。

entries.text: This may be the drink talking, but you are absolutely correct! Hey, adventurer! You've got to try some of this!
entries.translated_text: 虽然可能是酒后醉话，但你是对的！嘿，冒险者！你得试试这个！

entries.text: Have you deduced the order to pull the levers? Or should be just guess at random?
entries.translated_text: 你推断出拉杆顺序了吗？还是在瞎猜？

entries.text: Very good! Now you have to guess where it came from!
entries.translated_text: 非常好！现在你得猜猜它是从哪儿来的！

entries.text: I mean, I have killed bigger things. But Marlok used to say the greatest game is man. Or was it mer...?
entries.translated_text: 我杀过更大的东西。但马洛克曾经说过，最伟大的猎物是人...或者是莫？

entries.text: I haven't told many people about my family. It's not something I want people to know...
entries.translated_text: 我没有告诉太多人我的家庭，这不是我想让人们知道的事情...

entries.text: (Laugh) Say something nice. After all, if we don't trust each other, how can we work together?
entries.translated_text: （笑）说点好话。毕竟，如果我们不相互信任，我们怎么能一起工作呢？

entries.text: The dwemer obviously believed in the Aedra and Daedra. Hard to deny their existence. They simply didn't see them as worthy of worship.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫显然相信伊德拉和迪德拉（魔族）的存在，他们不否认他们的存在，但根本不认为他们值得信仰。

entries.text: Someday, I will find something so amazing in these ruins that even you will become fond of them, Khash.
entries.translated_text: 总有一天，我会在这些遗址中发现甚至连你也会喜欢上的东西，卡什。

entries.text: Halted Stream Camp
entries.translated_text: 静溪营地

entries.text: Got it.
entries.translated_text: 了解。

entries.text: I mean the last thing I did was steal that flawless sapphire, but I'm sure no one saw me.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是我做的最后一件事就是偷了那颗完美无瑕的蓝宝石，但我敢肯定没有人看到我。

entries.text: Aela is really scary.
entries.translated_text: 艾拉真的很可怕。

entries.text: How do you feel about Draugr, Yazakh?
entries.translated_text: 你怎么看待尸鬼？雅扎克？

entries.text: Mm, my history, too. It seems it's that way for a lot of people.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我的过去也是如此。似乎很多人都是这样。

entries.text: Are you very up-to-date with the goings-on back in High Rock? I know many Bretons who seem to know updates to the political landscape instantly.
entries.translated_text: 你对高岩省的近况了解吗？我认识很多布莱顿人，他们似乎对最新的政治局势了如指掌。

entries.text: You are very dangerous, my friend. To kill an emperor is no small feat. I'd say you should be proud, but I'm not sure that's the right word for this.
entries.translated_text: 你很危险，我的朋友。杀死一个皇帝可不是一件小事。我会说你应该感到自豪，但我不确定这是否对。

entries.text: Dinner and drinks at the tavern! It'll be my treat to our party tonight.
entries.translated_text: 在小酒馆吃吃喝喝！今晚派对我请客。

entries.text: Scrap, please tell me, do you experience a sense of self? An awareness of being? Are you aware you are an animunculi?
entries.translated_text: 小渣，请告诉我，你体验过自我意识吗？你存在意识吗？你知道你是一个蒸汽机械吗？

entries.text: Besides, that's supposedly where this Nils fellow cooks the pie. So that's exactly what we'll do!
entries.translated_text: 此外，据说这是纽斯做馅饼的地方。所以这正是我们要做的！

entries.text: Hey! You skipped 'H'! I win!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！你跳过了“H”！我赢了！

entries.text: Ah, a man after my own heart. All it takes to learn his secret is some good wine. Although my secrets are usually spilled after I'm a few bottles in.
entries.translated_text: 啊，一个合我心意的人，了解他的秘密只需要一些好酒，虽然我的秘密通常在我喝了几瓶后也会泄露出去。

entries.text: Ah. Does it count if I'm one of the poor?
entries.translated_text: 啊。如果我也是穷人，这算数吗？

entries.text: What are our plans, Rennec? Hopefully something fun.
entries.translated_text: 我们的计划是什么，雷内克？希望能有好玩的东西。

entries.text: We became more familiar with the... underside of Wayrest. Needless to say, I'm not engaged anymore.
entries.translated_text: 我们对途歇城的...阴暗面变得更加熟悉了。不用说，我不用再结婚了。

entries.text: I still can't believe you were framed for murder! I always knew Markarth had a dark underside, but I never imagined that could happen to you!
entries.translated_text: 我还是不敢相信你被陷害了谋杀罪！我一直都知道马卡斯有它黑暗的一面，但我从没想过这种事会发生在你身上！

entries.text: What?! Why?! I specifically programmed him to be helpful to me- I mean, us! To make sure we don't die in battle!
entries.translated_text: 什么为什么？我明明是特意编程让他帮助我——我是说，我们！为了确保我们不会被人杀掉！

entries.text: I've heard the Exodus is appropriately tragic. If you come across that one, maybe you'd get it for me?
entries.translated_text: 我听说《远行记》是本不错的悲剧。如果你遇到了，也许你可以为我搞到一本？

entries.text: And they agreed. 'Oh yes, I can play that for you.' And then they just played 'Ragnar the Red'! Again!
entries.translated_text: 他们也同意了。‘哦，是的，我可以为你演奏这首。’然后他们就弹了'红衣拉格纳'!又开始了!

entries.text: The dwemer tried to use tonal architecture to change their essence from mortal to immortal. I wonder if they succeeded.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫试图用音律结构将他们的本质从凡人变为不朽。我想知道他们是否成功了。

entries.text: No! (Whisper) I mean, no! Give me that!
entries.translated_text: 不！（低语）我是说，不！把那个给我！

entries.text: Can't wait for you to discover I've been practicing mentally.
entries.translated_text: 等你发现我其实一直在心里偷偷练习的时候，我可等不及看你的反应了。（Can't，C开头）

entries.text: Well, on a grand scale, it's the Dwarves' fault. On a smaller scale, so they can sneak around more easily. Right?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，从大的方面来说，这是矮人的错。往小了说，这就是他们擅长潜行的原因。对吗？

entries.text: Ru, you've got to stop trying to sell people bound weapons.
entries.translated_text: 鲁，你别成天推销你的束缚武器了。

entries.text: Oh, I hope I didn't offend Zora. You don't think I offended her, do you?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我希望我没有冒犯佐拉。你不认为我冒犯了她，是吗？

entries.text: Well, that'd be our adventurous companion, wouldn't it?
entries.translated_text: 那会是我们的冒险伙伴，不是吗？

entries.text: Having a wedding in Morvunskar is... far from picturesque. But you couldn't be convinced otherwise. Personally, I'd have gone for Nyzchaleft Falls.
entries.translated_text: 在莫万斯卡举行婚礼...这里远不算风景如画，但你就是不听劝。就我个人而言，我会去尼兹卡莱夫特瀑布。

entries.text: But I've done it the same as every other day?
entries.translated_text: 但我不是我每天都这样吗？

entries.text: (Sigh) Try not to get killed, okay?
entries.translated_text: （叹气）尽量不要送命，好吗？

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel translates to something like 'Radiant City'. Let's hope it lives up to its name!
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔的意思是“光辉之城”，希望它名不虚传！

entries.text: So, Khash, as a hunter, what is the greatest game you've ever taken down?
entries.translated_text: 那么，卡什，作为一名猎人，你曾经拿下过的最伟大的猎物是什么？

entries.text: Basically, I mess around with automatons and pipes and tonal locks and... Well, you get it.
entries.translated_text: 总的来说，就是我擅长摆弄自动机器、管道和音调锁……嗯，你现在你懂了吧。

entries.text: Basically, I mess around with automatons and pipes and tonal locks and... Well, you get it.
entries.translated_text: 总的来说，就是我擅长摆弄机器、管道和音调锁...嗯，你现在你懂了吧。

entries.text: Where are we supposed to find Aetherium?
entries.translated_text: 我们应该在哪里找到神光水晶呢？

entries.text: Leave a guy some soul gems next time, eh?
entries.translated_text: 下次给他留点灵魂石吧？

entries.text: It was really tough, but Marlok and the others were able to take it down.
entries.translated_text: 确实很艰难，但马洛克他们还是能拿下的。

entries.text: But the Forsworn have always been dangerous to me! When I stayed in Arkngchal, they'd try to enter and hurt me.
entries.translated_text: 但对我来说，弃誓者一直都很危险！我在阿卡切尔的时候，他们就曾试图闯进来伤害我。

entries.text: A cave. What will we find? Trouble or treasure?
entries.translated_text: 一个山洞。我们会发现什么？麻烦还是财富？

entries.text: Good.
entries.translated_text: 很好。

entries.text: Good.
entries.translated_text: 很好。

entries.text: That was a lot of work. Scrap was very upset with me.
entries.translated_text: 那是很多活，小渣对我很不高兴。

entries.text: Nords sure do love their warpaint, don't they? What do you suppose is the significance of Gore's?
entries.translated_text: 诺德人确实喜欢他们的战纹，不是吗？你认为格雷战纹的象征是什么？

entries.text: I mean... Isn't it scary, thinking of fighting people?
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是...想想看和人战斗是不是很可怕？

entries.text: Did I ever tell you, I wanted to be an adventurer since I was about ten years old?
entries.translated_text: 我有没有告诉过你，我十岁左右就想成为一名冒险者？（Did，D开头）

entries.text: It's like fighting a sea of ants!
entries.translated_text: 这就像与蚂蚁海战斗！

entries.text: I know you'd probably think I want a book on the dwemer, but...
entries.translated_text: 我知道你可能会认为我想要一本关于锻莫的书，但是...

entries.text: Is that where you picked it up from?
entries.translated_text: 你是在那里被捡到的吗？

entries.text: Okay, Doc! We can do this!
entries.translated_text: 好的，医生！我们能做到的！

entries.text: I might follow the tenets of Julianos, if he weren't so focused on mages. Otherwise, I quite like Mara. She seems genuinely good.
entries.translated_text: 我可能会遵循尤里安诺思的信条，如果他不是那么专注于法师的话。另外，我相当喜欢玛拉。她看起来真的很好。

entries.text: I'll do my best.
entries.translated_text: 我尽力吧。

entries.text: I'll do my best.
entries.translated_text: 我尽力吧。

entries.text: Yea, that does. As long as I do not have to go into the ocean.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这样就好，只要我不用下海就行。

entries.text: I'm glad, then.
entries.translated_text: 那我很高兴。

entries.text: I can practically see the  ideas running through your head. What are you up to?
entries.translated_text: 你在想的东西已经明明白白摆在脸上了，你想做什么？

entries.text: The mystery of it is so fascinating, isn't it? That's half the reason I go into dwemer ruins so much.
entries.translated_text: 它的奥秘是那么迷人，不是吗？这就是我进入锻莫遗迹的一半原因。

entries.text: I didn't notice much of a difference.
entries.translated_text: 我没有注意到有太大的不同。

entries.text: Feeling? I suppose I'll never hear the end of it if I don't try...
entries.translated_text: 感觉？我想，如果我不尝试的话，我永远也不会知道结果......

entries.text: Jaxon.
entries.translated_text: 贾克森。

entries.text: Take Remi to see two dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 带着蕾米去看两个矮人遗迹。

entries.text: ...I'm listening.
entries.translated_text: ……我在听。

entries.text: I'd recognize you no matter what, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，我都会认出你，蕾米。

texts: It's a word I made up to describe someone with mechanical knowledge of dwemer machines. Rolls off the tongue, right?
这是我编出来的一个词，用来形容对锻莫机器很了解的人。听起来不错，对吗？

entries.text: Ugh. Fine, fine. You're no fun, you know that?
entries.translated_text: 唉。好吧，好吧你一点都不有趣，知道吗？

entries.text: Hm. Well, in that case, I suppose I worship many Divine... and many not-Divine.
entries.translated_text: 哼。那么，在这种情况下，我想我信仰了许多圣灵...和许多非圣灵。

entries.text: You're not from Skyrim, are you?
entries.translated_text: 你不是天际本地人，对吧？

entries.text: I visited Sentinel often with my father. It was a beautiful city, with all the gold. I remember watching some plays while we were there, too.
entries.translated_text: 我曾经常和父亲一起去哨兵城。那是一座漂亮的城市，到处都是黄金。我记得我们在那里的时候也看过一些戏剧。

entries.text: It has a rounded bottom? It actually looks a bit like a children's spinning toy. Or maybe a bowl? A gold-coloured bowl?
entries.translated_text: 它有一个圆底？实际上它看起来有点像儿童的旋转木马。或者是一个碗？一个黄金色的碗？

entries.text: Don't just stand still to do your big wind-up blows. Which way you're moving changes what happens and can be a big advantage.
entries.translated_text: 不要只是静止不动地做大幅度的挥击，保持移动状态，就可以改变战斗局面，也可以使你处于更有利的位置。

entries.text: I'm glad you were there; I don't know what I would've done without you.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你在那里，我不知道没有你我该怎么办。

entries.text: (Sigh) I guess I'll have to be satisfied with my daydreams.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）我想我只能做白日梦了。

entries.text: Tell Remi once you've acquired all the ingredients.
entries.translated_text: 一旦你找到了所有的原料，就告诉蕾米。

entries.text: You need to eat. You're just skin and bones! (Laugh)
entries.translated_text: 你得吃饭，只剩皮包骨了！（笑）

entries.text: Scrap, keep Una safe, okay?!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，保证尤娜的安全，好吗？！

entries.text: So you know how you use only a lockpick right now? Sometimes, it's hard to use that alone to get the right sort of leverage.
entries.translated_text: 所以你知道你现在只使用了开锁器吗？但有时开锁器很难利用杠杆原理发力。

entries.text: Good work, Redcap! I told you we make a good team!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，红帽子！我告诉过你我们是一支好团队！

entries.text: No, this is much too entertaining, I think. I'm so excited for you to find out all the nonsense you got into!
entries.translated_text: 不，这太有有趣了，我想。我很高兴你能发现你的那些胡言乱语!

entries.text: The city vanished like the dwarves.
entries.translated_text: 这座城市会像矮人一样消失。

entries.text: And what do you want, hmm?
entries.translated_text: 你想要什么？

entries.text: No! Of course it's not!
entries.translated_text: 不！当然不是！

entries.text: I think I'm going to join.
entries.translated_text: 我想我会加入。

entries.text: Well. He is right, though, it is the corundum I want.
entries.translated_text: 是的，他是对的，这是我想要的刚玉。

entries.text: How pretty! I like that it sounds very regal. Viella.
entries.translated_text: 多漂亮啊！我喜欢它听起来华贵的样子，维埃拉。

entries.text: My father eventually explained that some people didn't like to be told things so directly.
entries.translated_text: 父亲最后解释说，有些人不喜欢别人这么说话这么直接。

entries.text: Sorine sounds like someone I'd get along with.
entries.translated_text: 索琳听起来像是和我相处得好的人。

entries.text: You don't have to worry, Buffy, I'll keep up. Probably.
entries.translated_text: 你不用担心，巴非，我会跟上的。可能。

entries.text: Perhaps there will be more time for that later. I will do my best to make it.
entries.translated_text: 也许以后会有更多的时间。我会尽我最大的努力举办一个。

entries.text: Never thought I'd be travelling with vampires.
entries.translated_text: 从没想过我会和吸血鬼一起旅行。

entries.text: Orcs are surly.
entries.translated_text: 兽人都是。

entries.text: Ray, can we end this soon?! I'm getting tired!
entries.translated_text: 雷，我们能快点结束吗？！我累了！

entries.text: Absolutely not! He wouldn't use anything we give him appropriately. I'd rather sell to a Forsworn.
entries.translated_text: 绝对不行！我们给他的东西，他都不会好好利用。我宁可卖给弃誓者。

entries.text: Give it here, I'll break it in half.
entries.translated_text: 递过来，我会把它破成两半。

entries.text: Although, I imagine the Nords wouldn't like being automatons, so maybe not our best idea.
entries.translated_text: 虽然，我想象诺德人不会喜欢成为机器人，所以也许这不是什么好主意。

entries.text: Just what are you and Remi up to?
entries.translated_text: 你和蕾米在忙什么？

entries.text: I've seen some Dwemer spiders shoot electricity. Maybe some in Mzulft do too, and I can see how it works?
entries.translated_text: 我见过一些锻莫蜘蛛发射电流。也许树皮遗址的一些也会，我可以了解到它是如何工作的？

entries.text: I've seen some Dwemer spiders shoot electricity. Maybe some in Mzulft do too, and I can see how it works?
entries.translated_text: 我见过一些锻莫蜘蛛发射电流。也许树皮遗址的一些也会，我可以了解到它是如何工作的？

entries.text: But you're a bard now, so shouldn't you write the song yourself? Maybe that's what the other bards will be envious of.
entries.translated_text: 但你现在是吟游诗人了，难道不应该自己写歌吗？也许这正是其他吟游诗人所羡慕的。

entries.text: When I was young, the other kids would tease me because I couldn't use magic. As I got older, I tried to avoid talking to them.
entries.translated_text: 当我还小时，其他孩子会因为我不会使用魔法而取笑我。随着年龄的增长，我尽量避免与他们交谈。

entries.text: By Sheor, that's you, isn't it?! Can you understand me? Do... Do you recognize me? Are you still in there somewhere? Please come back to us.
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔，那是你，不是吗？！你能听懂我说话吗？你...你认得我吗？你还在里面的某处，对吗？请回来吧，我们需要你。

entries.text: Yeah! Actually. Thanks, Remi. I owe you one.
entries.translated_text: 是啊！确实。谢谢，蕾米。我欠你一个人情。

entries.text: I didn't want to try and tell you what to do. Mara knows I never do as I'm told. But I am oddly pleased that you chose to dispose of Eola.
entries.translated_text: 我不想告诉你该怎么做。玛拉都知道我从按别人说的做。但我很高兴你选择处理掉爱欧拉。

entries.text: It's similar with the killing. We don't have to awkwardly walk by them in the streets, with their hateful eyes on us. They're dead, after all.
entries.translated_text: 这和杀人有些相似,我们不必在街上尴尬地走过去，感受他们满是仇恨的目光,毕竟，他们已经死了。

entries.text: Well, are you regretting attacking Ed yet?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你后悔攻击艾德了吗？

entries.text: I got you a present, Ma!
entries.translated_text: 我给你买了礼物，妈！

entries.text: Unless, of course, you're the dwemer. Even then, the most that they could do was change the physical world. The mind is an entirely different game.
entries.translated_text: 当然，除非你是锻莫。即使在那时，他们所能做的最多的就是改变物理世界。而思想世界并不适用。

entries.text: Some of the dwemer ruins I've been in have had plants growing, but this tree is one of the bigger ones I've seen.
entries.translated_text: 我去过的一些锻莫遗址里也长了植物，但这棵树是我见过的最大的几棵。

entries.text: (Sigh) That's alright. I'm not sure that I even really understand.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）那好吧。我甚至不确定我是否真的理解。

entries.text: You don't like killing? So being here with our friend is unpleasant for you?
entries.translated_text: 你不喜欢杀人？所以和我们的朋友在一起对你说并不愉快？

entries.text: I sometimes say things and people become offended. I don't understand why they are so angry all the time, but if I've ever done it to you, I'm sorry.
entries.translated_text: 我有时会说一些话，人们就会生气。我不明白他们为什么一直这么生气，但如果我曾经对你这样做过，我很抱歉。

entries.text: Well, if they're trading, we should swap, too, Zora.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果他们要交易，我们也应该交换东西，佐拉。

entries.text: Ah! So much fighting! I'll just stay behind you, Ilia!
entries.translated_text: 啊！这么多的战斗！我就留在你后面，伊利亚！

entries.text: We should get our spiders matching soul gems!
entries.translated_text: 我们应该让我们的蜘蛛适配灵魂石！

entries.text: Mazte.
entries.translated_text: 马兹酒。

entries.text: It was the Dark Brotherhood. They kidnapped me.
entries.translated_text: 那是黑暗兄弟会。他们绑架了我。

entries.text: What was- Revan, did you hear something?
entries.translated_text: 什么——渡鸦，你听到什么了吗？

entries.text: Of course I'll help Remi. Why wouldn't I?
entries.translated_text: 我当然会帮蕾米，为什么不呢？

entries.text: I don't think that's a Lisbet problem; Markarth just smells like that in general.
entries.translated_text: 我认为那不是利斯拜特的问题；是整个马卡斯都是这样。

entries.text: When we were at that last inn, a woman asked me if she could 'offer me her services'. But I already have you to guard me, so I turned her down.
entries.translated_text: 当我们在最后一家旅馆时，一位女士问我是否可以“为我服务”。但我已经有你保护我，所以我拒绝了她。

entries.text: I think she might be the antithesis of my existence.
entries.translated_text: 我想她可能与我完全相反。

entries.text: Don't worry, it isn't a secret now, is it? You know, I could have a thing for female Bretons.
entries.translated_text: 别担心，这已经不是秘密了，不是吗？你知道的，我可能对布莱顿女人情有独钟。

entries.text: Yeah, yeah, joke away. I think you're just trying to cover for being afraid of the ruin.
entries.translated_text: 是啊，还是玩笑。我想你只是想掩饰你其实害怕这些遗址。

entries.text: (Sigh) I know what I'm doing. You worry about your part.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）我知道自己在做什么。你管好你自己的部分吧。

entries.text: Well, what do you suggest then? You drink it?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你有什么建议呢？你喝吗？

entries.text: In return for her protection and blessing, we swore to never eat or harm any plantlife or vegetation.
entries.translated_text: 为了回报她的保护和祝福，我们发誓永远不吃或伤害任何植物和蔬菜。

entries.text: What are the odds that I'd run into another Breton from Stormhaven in Skyrim?
entries.translated_text: 我在天际遇到另一个来自风暴港的布莱顿人的几率有多大？

entries.text: So tell me, does your fur cause you to get hot more quickly? Isn't in warm in Elsweyr? It seems disadvantageous.
entries.translated_text: 那么告诉我，你的皮毛是否会使你更快地变热？在埃尔斯威尔不是很温暖吗？这似乎不太妙。

entries.text: We're done talking, then, Farillae?
entries.translated_text: 我们说完了，那么，法里拉？

entries.text: Get that stur'cherakac, Remi!
entries.translated_text: 拿下那个“斯图'切拉卡克”，蕾米！

entries.text: Mead.
entries.translated_text: 蜜酒。

entries.text: Ask Remi to marry you while wearing an Amulet of Mara.
entries.translated_text: 带着玛拉护符让蕾米嫁给你。

entries.text: It sounds like you were a noble.
entries.translated_text: 听起来你好像是个贵族。

entries.text: You know, I'm beginning to suspect that bandits just aren't very smart.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我开始怀疑土匪就是不怎么聪明。

entries.text: I don't know...
entries.translated_text: 我不知道...

entries.text: Who knows what interesting secrets we'll find here. And not in an old Nord ruin.
entries.translated_text: 谁知道我们会在这里而不是在一处古老的诺德废墟中发现什么有趣的秘密呢。

entries.text: Her sharp fingers tore through his chest, but he hardly felt it beyond his sorrow. As he fell, he swung his sword one last time.
entries.translated_text: 她锋利的手指穿过他的胸膛，但除了悲伤之外，他几乎没有感觉。当他要倒下时，他挥出了最后一剑。

entries.text: It's the capitol of the Aliki'r Desert. It is a huge city, right off the Iliac Bay. I'd sail there often. It's... a lot.
entries.translated_text: 那是阿里克尔沙漠的首都，一座巨大的城市，就在髂骨湾边上。我以前常常乘船去那里。那地方...真是太不一样了。

entries.text: Yes! Oh, look at that! It's quite something, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 是的！哦，看那个！这很重要，不是吗？

entries.text: He certainly seems well-informed in such matters, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，他在这些问题上肯定是消息很灵通的。

entries.text: I really appreciate your help!
entries.translated_text: 我真的很感谢你的帮助！

entries.text: They seem like they'd taste very sweet, like some sort of candied fruit. Is that how they are?
entries.translated_text: 它们看起来味道很甜，像某种蜜。是这样的吗？

entries.text: Great! I just got done working on Scrap, and he's better than ever!
entries.translated_text: 真棒！我刚刚完成了对小渣的工作，他比以往任何时候都好！

entries.text: Good!
entries.translated_text: 很好！

entries.text: Joshua, why does everything want to kill us?!
entries.translated_text: 约书亚，为什么一切都想杀我们？！

entries.text: Remiel
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔

entries.text: What are you talking about?
entries.translated_text: 你在说什么啊？

entries.text: I don't mean to pry, but about your birth father. I couldn't help but overhear he was raised by necromancers. I thought that was illegal in High Rock
entries.translated_text: 我并不是想打听隐私，但关于你的亲生父亲，我无意中听到他是死灵法师复活的。我还以为在高岩省这是非法的。

entries.text: It was pretty cool.
entries.translated_text: 这很酷。

entries.text: Bye, then.
entries.translated_text: 那再见。

entries.text: Tell Remi what Lever to Pull.
entries.translated_text: 告诉蕾米要拉什么拉杆。

entries.text: Smart people can do this incredible thing where they're funny without trying, yet they don't end up as the butt of the joke.
entries.translated_text: 聪明的人可以很轻易就做出这种令人难以置信的事情，他们很有趣，但他们最终不会成为笑柄。

entries.text: Filthy necromancer. He deserves worse. This death was too merciful.
entries.translated_text: 肮脏的亡灵法师，他理应有更凄惨的下场。这种死法太仁慈了。

entries.text: Yes. I'm perhaps not too...
entries.translated_text: 是的，我也许不是太...

entries.text: I have your Skooma.
entries.translated_text: 你的斯库玛在我这。

entries.text: Greetings, traveler.
entries.translated_text: 你好，旅行者。

entries.text: Well, yeah! If all it took to drive me away was a bit of murder, I wouldn't be much of a friend, would I?
entries.translated_text: 是啊！如果仅仅一场谋杀就能把我赶走，那我也不算什么好朋友，对吧？

entries.text: You're right: it's wrong. If they truly want revenge, they should focus on hurting the correct people.
entries.translated_text: 你说得对：他们做错了事。如果他们真的想复仇，就该知道冤有头债有主。

entries.text: If you're going to talk to Gore, make sure to tell him he owes me. He knows what for.
entries.translated_text: 如果你要和格雷谈谈，一定要告诉他他欠我的。他知道为什么。

entries.text: I'll get started as soon as we stop to rest next.
entries.translated_text: 我们下一次停下来休息时，我就开始读。

entries.text: Dawnstar is such a fitting name. Makes me think of cold early mornings and pale light.
entries.translated_text: 晨星就是这样一个合适的名字,让我想起寒冷的清晨和苍白的光线。

entries.text: Peacocks are those silly-looking birds with colourful tails, right? I've seen drawings of them.
entries.translated_text: 孔雀是那些看起来傻乎乎的有五颜六色尾巴的鸟对吗？我见过它们的图画。

entries.text: I worry about you, Simba. I worry about us. We walk so much. My feet hurt.
entries.translated_text: 我担心你，辛巴。我担心我们，我们走得太久了，我的脚很痛。

entries.text: 'One requires magic', of course!
entries.translated_text: 当然是"需要魔法"！

entries.text: We're after information out of Wayrest, about the Riscel family in particular.
entries.translated_text: 我们正在寻找途歇城的信息，尤其是关于里塞尔家族的信息。

entries.text: What's wrong? Regretting fighting me and Ubbe?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？后悔与我和乌贝打架？

entries.text: Sometimes I wonder if a lot of bards are just very sophisticated automatons. Although, you'd probably like them a lot more if they were.
entries.translated_text: 有时我想知道很多吟游诗人是否只是非常复杂的机器人。虽然，如果他们真的是，你可能会更喜欢他们。

entries.text: I'm sure there is.
entries.translated_text: 我确定有。

entries.text: Do you see what I mean? She's having her followers murder one another! She's awful!
entries.translated_text: 你明白我的意思吗？她让她的追随者互相残杀！她好可怕！

entries.text: Alright, now to plant the letter.
entries.translated_text: 好的，现在开始偷这封信。

entries.text: Alright-y.
entries.translated_text: 好吧-呀。

entries.text: Do you have a favourite dish, Remi?
entries.translated_text: 你有最喜欢的菜肴吗，蕾米？

entries.text: <Hiccup>
entries.translated_text: （打嗝）

entries.text: Ha ha ha ha! It's all just rocks!
entries.translated_text: 哈哈哈哈！全是石头！

entries.text: Can you imagine studying in Arkngchal your entire life? Many of the Dwemer here not only lived here, but died here. Incredible.
entries.translated_text: 您能想象你一辈子都在阿卡切尔里学习吗？这里的许多锻莫生在这，住在这，也死在这。

entries.text: Just another body to add to our count.
entries.translated_text: 又一具加入我们战果的尸体。

entries.text: Mine either. I've heard... things... about Nords. And they're not all untrue.
entries.translated_text: 我也是。 我听说过...关于诺德人的一些事情。 而且它们不全是假的。

entries.text: Remi uses healing spells
entries.translated_text: Remiuseshealingspells

entries.text: Yeah, I don't think it's helped any by who's in charge of it.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我认为谁来统治都是很糟糕。

entries.text: (Laugh) These moths sure like you!
entries.translated_text: （笑）这些先祖蛾肯定喜欢你！

entries.text: Well, we have officially passed the Kagrumez Trials. Not that I had any doubts we would.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们已经正式通过了卡谷梅兹试验。我并不是说我不认为我们会做到。

entries.text: Well, look who's finally awake. You know, I thought you could hold your liquour, but I was so, so wrong. At least you had fun?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，看看谁终于醒了。你应该知道，我原以为你能喝掉你的酒，但我错了。至少你玩得很开心？

entries.text: (Gasp) O-okay! I'm alive. Una is alive. Scrap is alive. Everything is alive. Well, except what we killed.
entries.translated_text: （倒抽一口气）哦——好吧！我还活，尤娜还活着，小渣活的，一切都是活生生的，嗯，除了我们杀的。

entries.text: In my old company, it was me who played the jester.
entries.translated_text: 在我以前的团队里，扮演小丑的都是我。

entries.text: (Whisper) Yes?
entries.translated_text: （低语）什么？

entries.text: Guards?! What did they catch you doing?!
entries.translated_text: 警卫？！他们抓到你在干什么？！

entries.text: I don't think we're alone.
entries.translated_text: 我认为我们并不孤单。

entries.text: When you have some junk metal, give it to me, and I'll make the junk pretty looking. Ask Val for the gold from sales. That's his job.
entries.translated_text: 当你有废金属时，把它给我，我会把废金属弄得漂漂亮亮的。至于卖成钱，那是瓦尔的工作。

entries.text: Well, as a Breton, I also have a knack for spells.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，作为布莱顿人，我也掌握了一些法术。

entries.text: Slaves, maybe? If so, we're doing them a favour.
entries.translated_text: 也许是奴隶？如果是这样，我们就帮了他们一个忙。

entries.text: I'm glad you're here, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你在这里，蕾米。

entries.text: All sorts of people passing through. The smell of the water. So many languages. Art. Knowledge.
entries.translated_text: 各种旅人弥散着海洋的气味。无数语言，艺术，知识交织在一起。

entries.text: All sorts of people passing through. The smell of the water. So many languages. Art. Knowledge.
entries.translated_text: 各种旅人弥散着海洋的气味。无数语言，艺术，知识交织在一起。

entries.text: Redgrass? Oh, he means scathecrow, right?
entries.translated_text: 红草？哦，他的意思是苦痛草，对吧？

entries.text: Hey, what's that over there?
entries.translated_text: 嘿，那边是什么？

entries.text: Go ahead.
entries.translated_text: 去吧。

entries.text: I must ask - are you from High Rock, too?
entries.translated_text: 我想问一下，你也是从高岩省来的吗？

entries.text: Eventually, the raiders were ousted, but the devestation they wrought... And the king went missing afterwards.
entries.translated_text: 虽然，劫匪最终被赶跑，但他们造成的破坏不可估量...随后国王失踪了。

texts: Eventually, the raiders were ousted, but the devestation they wrought... And the king went missing afterwards.
虽然，入侵者最终被赶跑，但他们造成的破坏不可估量……随后国王失踪了。

entries.text: You know how to ue it, right?
entries.translated_text: 你会用，对吧？

entries.text: So Auriel's Bow is in Darkfall Cave. Let's get there quickly, before Harkson somehow catches word of this.
entries.translated_text: 所以奥瑞丽的弓在暗临洞穴中。在哈孔不知怎么听到这个消息前，我们快点到那里。

entries.text: Kidnapping for ransom, extortion, blackmail... and lollygagging.
entries.translated_text: 还有绑架勒索、敲诈、讹诈...游手好闲什么的。

entries.text: It certainly is, isn't it? Well, we'll just have to pay his contact a visit, next time we're nearby.
entries.translated_text: 那当然，不是吗？好吧，下次我们在附近时，我们只需要拜访他的联系人就好了。

entries.text: What? Oh, Rumarin, I'm sorry, my mind was in another place. What were you saying?
entries.translated_text: 什么？哦，鲁马林，对不起，我刚才神游了。你在说什么？

entries.text: Just... please forgive me if I say something that might be taken the wrong way. I always have more to learn.
entries.translated_text: 只是...如果我说了一些可能被误解的话，请原谅我。我还有很多东西要学。

entries.text: Absolutely right.
entries.translated_text: 当然，对对对。（当然--Absolutely，A开头）

entries.text: Please mark your location on my map.
entries.translated_text: 在我的地图上标出您的位置。

entries.text: Not today. Too many things on my mind.
entries.translated_text: 今天不行。脑子里想的东西太多了。

entries.text: I'm happy to have you. I hired mercenaries when exploring ruins in High Rock, but they were a bit... scary.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴有你在。我在高岩省探险废墟时雇佣过雇佣兵，但他们有点……吓人。

entries.text: It's perfectly legible, and- Oh. Yes, I suppose I do see what you mean.
entries.translated_text: 非常清晰，而且--哦。我明白你的意思了。

entries.text: Scrap, what have you been eating!? You weigh more than a mammoth!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，你到底吃了什么！？要比长毛象还重了！

entries.text: Let's see... Are they growing anything tasty here?
entries.translated_text: 让我们看看...他们在这里种植了什么好吃的东西吗？

entries.text: So if being a bard is more than music, what, er, do you do, exactly?
entries.translated_text: 那么，如果说作为一个吟游诗人不仅仅是音乐，那么，呃，你到底要做什么？

entries.text: Board the Ship in the Harbour.
entries.translated_text: 在港口登船。

entries.text: Oh, made from Saltrice, right? Does Solstheim grow Saltrice?
entries.translated_text: 哦，是用盐粳米酿造的，对吧？索瑟海姆会种植盐粳米吗？

entries.text: Maybe that practice carried over into some Breton beliefs? I'm not too familar with that.
entries.translated_text: 也许这种做法延续到了布莱顿人的信仰中？我对此不太清楚。

entries.text: I'll give it a try.
entries.translated_text: 我会去试试看。

entries.text: Adventurer Jaxon. Mm. No, that's a mouthful. Just Jaxon. Did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 冒险者贾克森，嗯，不，这太拗口了，只叫贾克森好了。你需要什么吗？

entries.text: I think I see where this is going.
entries.translated_text: 我想我知道这是怎么回事。

entries.text: Cave walls feel slimy.
entries.translated_text: 洞穴壁感觉黏糊糊的。

entries.text: You're probably thinking more clearly than I am. I'm quite angry and feeling impulsive.
entries.translated_text: 你可能比我想得更清楚。我很生气，非常生气。

entries.text: You're a terrible alchemist, right?
entries.translated_text: 你是个糟糕的炼金术士，对吧？

entries.text: You're a terrible alchemist, right?
entries.translated_text: 你是个糟糕的炼金术士，对吧？

entries.text: Don't tell him I said this, but this Orthorn guy's a moron, right?
entries.translated_text: 别告诉他是我说的，但奥拓恩这个家伙是个白痴，对吧？

entries.text: You seem to have forgotten to even it out. There's only a bunch under your eyes.
entries.translated_text: 你似乎忘了把它弄平。你的眼睛下面只有一串。

entries.text: Dinner and drinks at the nearest tavern! It'll be my treat to our party tonight.
entries.translated_text: 去最近的小酒馆享用吃饭喝酒吧，今晚我请客。

entries.text: There was an opportunity to make a large profit, so... we were there.
entries.translated_text: 有机会赚大钱，所以......我们就去了。

entries.text: Yeah. Um, of course! Absolutely! Next batch of moon sugar goes to a pastry just for you!
entries.translated_text: 是的。嗯，当然！绝对！下一批月亮糖会专门用来给你做点心！

entries.text: J'zargo will go wherever he can to learn more. Oblivion itself, if need be.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格愿意到任何他可以学到更多东西的地方去。只要有需要，就算湮灭也愿意去。

entries.text: How very... Nordic of them.
entries.translated_text: 多么……诺德气。

entries.text: Good riddance.
entries.translated_text: 干得漂亮。

entries.text: I don't think you realize how brave you can be.
entries.translated_text: 我认为你没有意识到你能有多大的勇气。

entries.text: Oh... You're being sarcastic! You know, I don't like it so much when other people do it to me.
entries.translated_text: 哦...你在讽刺我！你知道，我不太喜欢别人对我这样做。

entries.text: But yeah... It would be nice to learn how not to stick my foot in my mouth so often.
entries.translated_text: 但是，是的...如果能学会如何不经常说错话，那就更好了。

entries.text: Let's hurry and find out what's going on, okay?
entries.translated_text: 让我们快点找出发生了什么，好吗？

entries.text: (Laughs) She would make a great jester, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: （笑）她会成为一个伟大的小丑，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: If I see one more Nord giving me a dirty look, I'm going to rip off their face and eat it in front of them.
entries.translated_text: 如果我再看到一个诺德人用肮脏的眼神看着我，我会撕下他们的脸，当着他们的面吃掉。

entries.text: An extract from taproot has surprisingly similar properties to Dwemer oil. Mixing them together was exactly what I needed.
entries.translated_text: 从直立根提取的精华与矮人油的特性惊人地相似，我需要做的就是把它们混合在一起。

entries.text: My clan once knew me as Anum-La, but fighting folk call me The Swamp Knight.
entries.translated_text: 我的族人曾经知道我叫安努姆菈，但战士们叫我沼泽骑士。

entries.text: Mortu.
entries.translated_text: 莫尔图。

entries.text: Well, see this here? This allows a transference of power from the soul gem to one of the legs. It gives it the ability to walk.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你看这个吗？这个可以将灵魂石的力量转移到一条腿上。它赋予了腿行走的能力。

entries.text: But while staying in Evermore, I came across some studies of Arkngchal. Well, 'studies' is perhaps too generous.
entries.translated_text: 但是当我呆在永恒城时，我发现了一些关于阿卡切尔的研究。好吧，说"研究"也许有点过头。

entries.text: Hircine wants us to kill Sinding? He's already been through so much. Can't we just leave him alone?
entries.translated_text: 海尔辛想让我们杀死辛丁？他已经经历了这么多。我们不能让他一个人呆着吗？

entries.text: Haven't met Remi yet
entries.translated_text: Haven'tmetRemiyet

entries.text: Oh, you want me to show you how to do up your face!
entries.translated_text: 哦，你想让我教你怎么化妆！

entries.text: Odd that the technology of the Dwemer was never stolen by the other races.
entries.translated_text: 奇怪的是，锻莫的技术从未被其他种族逆向。

entries.text: Tell me he didn't just say 'Calcelmo'. Please tell me we're not going to talk to that old bastard. Why aren't you answering?
entries.translated_text: 告诉我他刚才没说'卡塞莫'。拜托告诉我我们不用去找那个老混蛋，你为什么不回答我？

entries.text: Did you need something, Raven?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，渡鸦？

entries.text: Not happening.
entries.translated_text: 不可能。

entries.text: Perhaps using Keening on his modified soul gem caused Keening to attempt to transfer power between the two of them?
entries.translated_text: 或许是在他改造过的灵魂石上使用哀恸，让哀恸试图在两人之间传递力量？

entries.text: That's a little steep, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 这有点高，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: The falmer seem to have some sort of culture. That's a good sign for their species, right?
entries.translated_text: 伐莫似乎有着某种文化，这对他们的物种来说是一个好兆头，对吧？

entries.text: That's a compliment, by the way.
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，这是一种恭维。

entries.text: You mean, was I ever engaged to someone else? No.
entries.translated_text: 你是说，我曾经和别人订过婚吗？没有。

entries.text: Remi's Scar
entries.translated_text: Remi'sScar

entries.text: Honestly, this place is just sad.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，这个地方只有悲伤。

entries.text: Remi's Home
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的家

entries.text: What is- You're healing me?! Stop! I don't want your help!
entries.translated_text: 你在给我治病？住手，我不要你帮忙！

entries.text: Oh no, I don't want to be a third wheel.
entries.translated_text: 哦不，我不想当多余的人。

entries.text: Can you stop having Scrap fight with us?
entries.translated_text: 你能不能别再让小渣为我们战斗了？

entries.text: You know, some Bretons have pointy ears, too. But they tend to be less obvious than ears such as yours. Ah, that wasn't meant to be rude, by the way.
entries.translated_text: 要知道，有些布莱顿人也有尖耳朵。但和你比都没那么明显。啊，顺便说一句，我不是有意冒犯的。

entries.text: You look like you have something on your mind, Elf. Don't worry, it'll pass.
entries.translated_text: 你看起来像有心事，精灵。别担心，会过去的。

entries.text: ...I, er, that was. I'm joking. By the way.
entries.translated_text: ……我，呃，那是。我在开玩笑。顺便说一句。

entries.text: Okay, all set!
entries.translated_text: 好了，一切就绪！

entries.text: (Sigh) If only there were somewhere decent to eat in Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: （叹气）要是天际里能有个像样的地方吃饭就好了。

entries.text: You look like you have something on your mind. Keep digging, Elf, you'll find it in there somewhere.
entries.translated_text: 你看起来有心事。继续挖吧，精灵，你会在某个地方找到的。

entries.text: Are you good at escaping jails, adventurer? I've never had to. The thefts I've been caught at have been too minor for jailing.
entries.translated_text: 你擅长越狱吗，冒险者？我从来没有过。我被抓到盗窃罪太轻微，还不够判刑。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. We have explored Nchuand-zel together, following in the footsteps of a lost expedition. After reading through their journals, we've learned that the spider we killed, Nimhe, was the only thing keeping the falmer from invading Markarth from below. We reactivated the dwemer defenses, but Remi has noticed one automaton behaving oddly.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我们一起探索楚安德-泽尔，追随迷途探险的脚步。在阅读了他们的日记后，我们了解到我们杀死的蜘蛛尼姆赫是唯一阻止伐莫从下方入侵马卡斯城的东西。我们重新启动了矮人防御，但蕾米注意到一个机器人表现得很奇怪。

entries.text: Wonderful! I can't wait!
entries.translated_text: 太棒了，我等不及了。

entries.text: Maybe you'll find out when you wake up with one in your ass.
entries.translated_text: 也许等你醒来发现屁股里插了一把的时候，你就会明白了。

entries.text: Maybe you'll find out when you wake up with one in your ass.
entries.translated_text: 也许有天你会在你醒来时发现你的屁股少了一块。

entries.text: I think we should spare poor Faleen and toss her letter into a brazier.
entries.translated_text: 我认为我们应该放过可怜的法琳，直接把给她的信扔进火盆里。

entries.text: I won't pretend to be a political mastermind, but canceling a *party*?! Elisif would have a riot on her hands were she Queen of Camlorn.
entries.translated_text: 我不会假装自己是分幕后首脑，但是取消*集会*？！如果艾利西弗是卡姆洛恩的女王，她手上会发生暴乱。

entries.text: The Arch-Curate was... He was going to murder Serana. Divines, that could've been bad.
entries.translated_text: 大主教是...他要谋杀瑟拉娜。天啊，那可能很糟。

entries.text: You just want to try it, don't you?
entries.translated_text: 你只是想试试，不是吗？

entries.text: I think with you by my side, I can take on anything.
entries.translated_text: 我想有你在我身边，我可以承担任何事情。

entries.text: I can see you've no appreciation for scholarship.
entries.translated_text: 我看得出你对奖学金不屑一顾。

entries.text: But. Since you trust me... I suppose I'm running from Wayrest. No, more like Breton society.
entries.translated_text: 但。既然你信任我……我想我是在逃离途歇城。不，应该是远离布莱顿社会。

entries.text: I just knew they'd have us get rid of the gaggle of vampires. Investigators, judges, and executioners.
entries.translated_text: 我就知道他们会让我们去解决那群吸血鬼。调查员、法官和刽子手。

entries.text: Although, something seems a little off about these automatons. Why aren't they protecting their armoury?
entries.translated_text: 虽然，这些机器人似乎有点不对劲。他们为什么不保护他们的军械库？

entries.text: But surely there must be some sort of indication? Let me know in what order you'd like me to pull them! I'll wait here.
entries.translated_text: 但会有某种迹象吗？让我知道你想让我用什么顺序拉动拉杆！我会在这里等你。

entries.text: When the dwemer vanished, they supposedly left someone behind. His name was Yagrum Bagarn, and he was in another dimension at the time.
entries.translated_text: 当锻莫消失的时候，他们应该是落下了一个人，他的名字叫亚格鲁姆·巴加恩，当时他在另一个维度。

entries.text: You're not going to make me carry its bones, are you?
entries.translated_text: 你不会让我带着它的骨头，是吗？

entries.text: And that's four gems. That should be enough to open those doors, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 四颗宝石了，这应该足以打开那些门，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: I have quite a bit (5).
entries.translated_text: 我有很多(5)。

entries.text: It took me a long time to get an understanding of how dwarven spiders work. Imagine the day when I finally understand centurians!
entries.translated_text: 我花了很长时间才了解矮人蜘蛛的工作原理，期待着我最终了解百夫长的那一天！

entries.text: Ilia, please don't forget I'm standing here. I'm serious, Ilia. Don't forget me.
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚，请不要忘记我站在这里。我是认真的，伊利亚，别忘了我。

entries.text: Daedra worship? There really is just everything happening in Markarth, isn't there?
entries.translated_text: 魔族崇拜？在马卡斯城，真的是无奇不有，不是吗？

entries.text: (Laugh) I'm glad I can joke about it. I was afraid I'd be awkward after seeing that. Um, I actually do have a question, though.
entries.translated_text: （笑）我很高兴我可以拿它开玩笑，我怕看到之后会尴尬，嗯，不过我确实有一个问题。

entries.text: Skyrim's wolves are much fiercer than wolves in High Rock. It's a shame; their aggression means we probably can't tame them.
entries.translated_text: 天际的狼比高岩中的狼凶猛得多。真是可耻，他们的侵略性意味着我们可能无法驯服他们。

entries.text: Druids revere nature but still want some part of society. Wyrd Covens have completely given themselves over to nature.
entries.translated_text: 德鲁伊崇尚自然，但仍希望有社会的影响。命运巫会已经完全把自己交给了自然。

entries.text: Hey! To be fair, I have seen dozens of mechanical spiders, and Scrap is the firt one that hasn't been trying to kill me.
entries.translated_text: 嘿！公平地说，我见过几十种机械蜘蛛，小渣是第一个没有试图杀死我的。

entries.text: Especially since I've been writing out sentence ideas to prepare for this.
entries.translated_text: 尤其是当我一直在把想到的句子写下来时。（Especially，E开头）

entries.text: They either remembered to bring spare linen wraps, or they didn't, and that's part of their outfit of the day they had to cut off in a pinch.
entries.translated_text: 他们要么带了亚麻布包裹，要么没带，而这是他们当天的一部分着装，他们不得不在紧急关头将其剪掉了。

entries.text: Have you found any Aetherium? No? Well, don't worry, I still haven't figured out the chandelier yet.
entries.translated_text: 你找到神光水晶了吗？没有？好吧，别担心，我还没有搞清楚吊灯的奥秘。

entries.text: It seems like you're more interested in the possibility of what something could be rather than what it used to be?
entries.translated_text: 你似乎更关注事物的可能，而不是它的过去？

entries.text: I'm glad you think so, since I agree.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你这么认为，因为我也同意。

entries.text: (Laughs) You don't want to hear me singing either, so I suppose we're on the same page there.
entries.translated_text: （笑）你也不会想听我唱歌，所以我想我们在这方面是一致的。

entries.text: Skyrim is so different from High Rock.
entries.translated_text: 天际与高岩是如此不同。

entries.text: Remi's Crossbow Crucible
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的弩

entries.text: I got you something.
entries.translated_text: 我给你一些东西。

entries.text: Can I have some?
entries.translated_text: 可以给我一些吗？

entries.text: Zora is easy to like.
entries.translated_text: 佐拉很容易讨人喜欢。

entries.text: Here, take this. It's all in that note.
entries.translated_text: 来，拿这个。都在这张纸条里。

entries.text: I always make sure to look up and wave at the windows. Eventually, they might start thinking I'm someone important.
entries.translated_text: 我总是记得抬头向窗户那边挥手。也许哪天，他们会开始以为我是个什么重要人物呢。

entries.text: Most Nords I've met have racist undertones... But the Nords in this city take the cake.
entries.translated_text: 我遇到的大多数诺德人都有点种族歧视的倾向……不过这个城市的诺德人简直是其中的翘楚。

entries.text: Part of me wishes we had continued, despite the engagement. But we didn't, and we haven't spoken since then.
entries.translated_text: 我们虽然希望我们能够继续下去，尽管我已经订婚了。但我们最终没有，而且从那时起我们就没有说过话了。

entries.text: Coffin
entries.translated_text: 棺材

entries.text: Remi?! What is this thing?! It's not bleeding...
entries.translated_text: 蕾米？！这是什么？！没流血...

entries.text: Because of my father's success, I was supposed to marry into the family. My fiancee's name was Morvic.
entries.translated_text: 因为我父亲的成功，所以我应该嫁给这个家族。我未婚夫的名字是莫维克。

entries.text: You really shouldn't be trying to fight us!
entries.translated_text: 你就不该想着与我们战斗！

entries.text: Oh, right.
entries.translated_text: 哦，对了。

entries.text: B-but you're okay. Good. When I heard the news, I-I... Well, I'm just glad to have found you out here. Saved me from having to break in.
entries.translated_text: 但-但你没事。太好了。当我听到这个消息时，我-我...嗯，我很高兴能在这里找到你。我就不用劫狱了。

entries.text: Oh! And thus, the Green Pact. It's a pact with Y'ffre.
entries.translated_text: 哦！因此，绿色公约。就是与伊’弗尔的约定。

entries.text: Put two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份放入釜中？

entries.text: Put two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份放入釜中？

entries.text: Put two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份放入釜中？

entries.text: Put two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份放入釜中？

entries.text: Honestly, I've deconstructed enough Ballistas that I could almost certainly replicate the firing force onto a crossbow.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我已经拆解过很多的弩炮了，我现在肯定地能将它们的火力复制到弩上。

entries.text: Honestly, I've deconstructed enough Ballistas that I could almost certainly replicate the firing force onto a crossbow.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我已经拆解过很多的弩炮了，我现在肯定地能将它们的火力复制到弩上。

entries.text: And if you consider your weapon an extra forearm, an extension of your own, it's simply a better wrist in all aspects.
entries.translated_text: 如果你把你的武器认作一个额外的前臂，当成你自我的一个延伸，那么手腕将会在各方面都能表现优秀。

entries.text: I'm infuriated by Thonar! He sent us to prison in the first place! Now he acts as though he's doing us a favour by pardoning us?!
entries.translated_text: 托纳尔惹怒我了！当初是他把我们送进监狱的！现在他又好像在帮我们的忙，赦免了我们？

entries.text: What?!
entries.translated_text: 什么？！

entries.text: Shhh, Scrap... The dead are sleeping...
entries.translated_text: 嘘，小渣...亡者正在沉睡...

entries.text: Who... Nazeem??
entries.translated_text: 谁...纳奇姆？？

entries.text: The first thing I did in Arkngchal was figure out how to lock the entrance. The last thing I needed was Forsworn cornering me inside.
entries.translated_text: 我在阿卡切尔做的第一件事就是弄清楚如何锁住入口，这样就一点也不用担心弃誓者了。

entries.text: And three of the others are about the exact same subject. There's nowhere near enough variety.
entries.translated_text: 而其他三首是关于完全相同的主题。种类远远不够。

entries.text: Who in Oblivion is 'Madanach'? How does he have so much influence on the goings-on of Markarth, if he is locked away?
entries.translated_text: 这该死的“迈德纳奇”是谁？既然他都被关起来了，那他怎么会对还马卡斯城发生的事情有这么大的影响力？

entries.text: I wasn't aware that was something you could... forget how to do?
entries.translated_text: 我不知道你会……忘记该怎么做？

entries.text: I've got your back, friend.
entries.translated_text: 我支持你，朋友。

entries.text: Complex Dynamo Core
entries.translated_text: 复杂的动力核心

entries.text: There you are! There are quite a few levers up here. It seems that this was some sort of utility access.
entries.translated_text: 你来了！看，这好多拉杆，这似乎是某种实用的启动装置。

entries.text: It's not unlike how some automaton power down when taken from their home cities, except instead of removing tones, I'd be altering them.
entries.translated_text: 这与一些自动机器从他们的家乡城市被带走时如何断电没有什么不同，除了没有去除音调，我会改变它们。

entries.text: Nchuand-Zel Control
entries.translated_text: 楚安德-泽尔控制室

entries.text: Hey, you've got something on your face.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，你脸上有东西。
