entries.text: You should, after all our time together!
entries.translated_text: 你当然了，毕竟我们在一起的时间那么长！

entries.text: Skyrim's college entrance exam is much simpler than exams in Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 天际冬堡学院入学考试比途歇城的考试要简单得多。

entries.text: Tell me everything good about you!
entries.translated_text: 告诉我你有什么优点！

entries.text: But, since I like you, I'll ignore it.
entries.translated_text: 但是，既然我喜欢你，我就不会在意它。

entries.text: I need inspiration! Ideas! Come on, come on, adventurer! Throw out some thoughts! My brain is bored!
entries.translated_text: 我需要灵感！想法！来吧，来吧，冒险者！抛出些想法来！我的大脑很无聊！

entries.text: Buffy, something is trying to kill us again!
entries.translated_text: 巴非，有什么东西又想杀我们了！

entries.text: It is a pleasure to officially make your acquaintance, Jaxon.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴正式认识你，贾克森。

entries.text: That rush of adrenaline would be like nothing I've experienced before...
entries.translated_text: 那种肾上腺素的激增是我以前从未经历过的...

entries.text: If you ever have an issue with fleas, just let me know. I know some excellent concoctions to get rid of them.
entries.translated_text: 如果你对跳蚤有不满，请告诉我。我知道一些很好的混合物可以去除它们。

entries.text: Remi seemed to like the necklace just fine, but she said that Scrap was feeling left out. I guess I should get something for Scrap as well.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米似乎很喜欢这条项链，但她说小渣感觉被忽视了。我想我也应该为小渣买点东西。

entries.text: No, you should go home.
entries.translated_text: 不，你应该回家。

entries.text: Grave Concoctions... What a great name.
entries.translated_text: 坟墓内线...多么棒的名字。

entries.text: I'm so excited! My dear adventurer, you won't know what hit you!
entries.translated_text: 我太激动了，我亲爱的冒险者，你不会知道是什么击中了你的！

entries.text: Scrap needs to stay put away even when we're relaxing.
entries.translated_text: 当我们在放松时，小渣也要藏好。

entries.text: Get Remi a sweet roll.
entries.translated_text: 让蕾米吃甜食。

entries.text: Someone must've slipped something into my mead... No way I just puked a little. You're cheating!
entries.translated_text: 肯定有人在我的蜜酒里下了东西。。。我不会才吐这点。你在作弊！

entries.text: Wait a minute, you're being sarcastic, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 等等，你是在讽刺我吧？

entries.text: Why in Oblivion would you just come out and ask someone that? I mean, yes, you're right, but still!
entries.translated_text: 为什么你会出来问别人这种问题？我是说，是的，你是对的，但还是让我不舒服！

entries.text: Why in Oblivion would you just come out and ask someone that? I mean, yes, you're right, but still!
entries.translated_text: 为什么你会出来问别人这种问题？我是说，是的，你是对的，但还是让我不舒服！

entries.text: Out of curiosity, when will we arrive at the next inn? It's just that I'm terribly hungry, and everything we have is... not speaking to me.
entries.translated_text: 出于好奇，我们什么时候才能到达下一个旅馆？只是我非常饿了，而我们所拥有的一切都...不和我说话。

entries.text: My mother always told me never to play with fire. And yet here we are.
entries.translated_text: 我妈妈总是告诉我永远不要玩火。然而，她管不着。

entries.text: I'd say we'd be fine if we kept our heads down, but our mutual friend isn't very inconspicuous. What do you think?
entries.translated_text: 我会说如果我们保持低调就可以了，但我们共同的朋友并不是很不起眼。你说呢？

entries.text: You be safe, too!
entries.translated_text: 你也注意安全！

entries.text: I don't know about a 'suspicion of mages', but not understanding magic does cause me to feel a certain way about them.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道什么是 "对法师的怀疑"，但不了解魔法确实导致我对他们有某种感觉。

entries.text: Okay. Um. I'm not really sure how to go about this. Should I... just hit him with it?
entries.translated_text: 可以，嗯，我不太确定该怎么办。我应该...用这个敲他吗？

entries.text: You really want to join the Companions, then? To each their own, I suppose. I think I'll just watch from afar as you beat up this Vilkas fellow.
entries.translated_text: 你真的想加入战友团，那么？每个人都有自己的选择吧，我猜。我想我会远远地看着你揍这个威尔卡斯。

entries.text: You're telling me everyone in that house was a Forsworn?! I am starting to feel as though all Markarth citizens are secretly Forsworn.
entries.translated_text: 你是说那房子里的每个人都是弃誓者？我开始觉得好像所有的马卡斯城公民都是潜在的弃誓者。

entries.text: Let's part ways. I'll see you at home.
entries.translated_text: 让我们分道扬镳，我会在家里见。

entries.text: Really? Is it... really okay?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？难道...真的好吗？

entries.text: Also I noticed people tend to have rounder faces down there. Might be due to the sunshine.
entries.translated_text: 我还注意到，那里的人往往脸比较圆。可能是由于阳光的关系。

entries.text: In the wilderness...? Wait, how old are you? Why the wilderness?
entries.translated_text: 在旷野...？等等，你几岁了？为什么是荒野？

entries.text: I see... Well... I'm sorry, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我明白了……嗯……对不起，蕾米。

entries.text: Try to slip something embarrassing into the pocket of a Knight of the Hour without them noticing.
entries.translated_text: 试着在他们不注意的情况下，把一些令人尴尬的东西塞进时序团骑士的口袋里。

entries.text: Mm. I suppose it is a bit of a journey, even just from Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 嗯我想，即使只是从天际开始，这也是一段旅程。

entries.text: Oh, so your Psijic firend does exist after all. I'm not sure if that makes me feel better or worse.
entries.translated_text: 哦，所以你的赛伊克朋友是真的存在的，我不确定这是好事还是坏事。

entries.text: For a second there I thought I was going to have to avenge you.
entries.translated_text: 有那么一刻，我都在想我必须为你报仇了。

entries.text: Although I guess that does leave Winterhold exposed.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我猜这确实让冬堡曝光。

entries.text: Imagine receiving a lovely poem and then talking to Calcelmo . The dichotomy would be jarringly miserable. This poor woman.
entries.translated_text: 想象一下，那个女人收到一首浪漫情诗后迫不及待地去和卡塞莫交谈，发现和诗中写的完全不同，真是可怜的女人。

entries.text: It's cold and wet and boring. Oh, I know. Truth or dare? Great! I dare you to lick Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 它又冷又湿又无聊。哦，我懂。真心话大冒险？太棒了！我要让你舔小渣。

entries.text: Shimmering Dwemer Gyro
entries.translated_text: 闪光锻莫陀螺

entries.text: By Sheor, have you never looked in a book? Wait- Are you saying... You don't know how to read and write?!
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，你从没看过书吗？等等-你是说。。。你甚至不知道怎么读写？！

entries.text: That's a lot.
entries.translated_text: 这太多了。

entries.text: Yes, I agree.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我同意。

entries.text: So, Yazakh, are you from Skyrim? Originally, I mean?
entries.translated_text: 那么，雅扎克，你是天际人吗？我是说原来？

entries.text: We have been docked to the Northeast of Solitude for well over a month, and with no sign of shipping out anytime soon.
entries.translated_text: 我们停靠在独孤城东北已经有一个多月了，而且不知道什么时候才能出发。

entries.text: And ensure that each connection is knotted five-and-a-half times, angled parallel to the corresponding gears-
entries.translated_text: 并确保每个连接处都打上五个半结，角度与相应圆轮平行就好了。

entries.text: Remi? That is a really nice name. It is pretty.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米？这是一个非常好的名字。它很漂亮。

entries.text: Be careful with that fire, Teldryn!
entries.translated_text: 小心那把火，泰卓因！

entries.text: Hm. Well, yes. I think that's natural. But I was way more curious than afraid, so it worked out. Not that I'd, uh, advocate going into ruins alone.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。嗯，是。我认为这很自然。但我更多的是好奇而不是害怕，所以它成功了。并不是说我会，呃，主张独自进入遗址。

entries.text: Oh, okay.
entries.translated_text: 噢，好吧。

entries.text: He said something about danger at the college.
entries.translated_text: 他说学院里有危险。

entries.text: Aetherial Light
entries.translated_text: 神光水晶灯

entries.text: It's either that or one of us is going to have to learn how to cook!
entries.translated_text: 要么是这样，要么我们中的一个人将不得不学习如何做饭！

entries.text: (Sigh) Just... maybe tell me when you're going to do that. So I know where you are?
entries.translated_text: （叹气）只是……也许你可以告诉我你打算什么时候做那件事？这样我就知道你在哪里了？

entries.text: Morvic doesn't seem to be here.
entries.translated_text: 莫维克似乎不在。

entries.text: Awoo!
entries.translated_text: 啊呜！

entries.text: I'd done nothing to them but deign to exist in the ruin they'd decided to invade.
entries.translated_text: 我对他们什么也没做过，我只是躲在那个他们欲要占领的遗址里而已。

entries.text: I agree! Hopefully we'll be very rich, very soon. Maybe you're interested in being a business partner, too?
entries.translated_text: 我同意！希望我们很快就会变得非常富有。也许你也有兴趣成为我们的生意伙伴？

entries.text: An ancient Blade temple? I'm... intrigued.
entries.translated_text: 古老的刀锋卫士神殿？我……很感兴趣。

entries.text: Yes. Why?
entries.translated_text: 是啊，怎么了？

entries.text: Yes. Why?
entries.translated_text: 是啊，怎么了？

entries.text: Sometimes I wonder why you keep me around.
entries.translated_text: 有时我想知道你为什么把我留在身边。

entries.text: Joshua.
entries.translated_text: 约书亚。

entries.text: They also claim their ancestors were rebels against the Direnni way back in the first era.
entries.translated_text: 他们还声称他们的祖先在第一纪元中是对抗迪仁尼的叛军。

entries.text: Oh, but Joshua, I still wanted to tell you- Er. I- I forgot. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 哦，但是约书亚，我还是想告诉你——呃，我——我忘了，没关系。

entries.text: So during that time I tried to figure out when I should show myself, 'cause I wanted to help take down a Minotaur.
entries.translated_text: 所以那段时间我一直在想，什么时候该现身，因为我想帮忙一起打倒那头牛头怪。

entries.text: But for now, let's enjoy the weather.
entries.translated_text: 但现在，让我们享受一下这天气。（But，B开头）

entries.text: And what if I get lost? What then?
entries.translated_text: 如果我迷路了呢，怎么办？

entries.text: Translating Dwemeris often relies on comparing it to Aldmeris. Their society separated from the Aldmer early on though, so it's hardly very precise.
entries.translated_text: 翻译锻莫语通常依赖于将其与奥德莫语进行比较。不过，他们的社会很早就与奥德莫分离了，所以它几乎不是很精确。

entries.text: Our friendship is more important to me than how you make coin. Or even what type of things you derive enjoyment from.
entries.translated_text: 我们的友谊对我来说比你怎么赚的钱更重要，甚至比你从什么事情中获得乐趣更重要。

entries.text: No, you have the wrong idea, sorry.
entries.translated_text: 不，抱歉，你误会了。

entries.text: I just can't focus right now. Too many thoughts running through my head.
entries.translated_text: 我只是现在无法集中注意力。太多的想法在我脑海中闪过。

entries.text: You know, if you bothered learning how to thrash a man so thoroughly with your arm, you wouldn't need us. Almost felt bad for the wretch.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，如果你好好学学如何用你这粗壮的手臂暴打别人，你就不需要我们了。那个被打的可怜虫会很惨。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. It seems another group of explorers went into the ruins before us, and Remiel wants to follow after them. I should keep a look out for interesting artifacts.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。似乎还有一群探险者在我们之前进入了遗址，蕾米想要跟在他们后面。我应该留意有趣的文物。

entries.text: Worse, if you can believe it. I dunno, they were my family, I guess. But they were mercenaries, and loyalty wasn't something that saw you to old age.
entries.translated_text: 更糟，如果你相信我的话。我不知道，我猜他们是我的家人。但他们是佣兵，忠诚并不足以让你活到寿终正寝。

entries.text: Listen up. I heard something. There's danger ahead.
entries.translated_text: 听，我听到了什么，前面有危险。

entries.text: That's unfortunate. Maybe the next cave we raid will be "Lots of Treasure Cave." Imagine how much more motivated we'd be.
entries.translated_text: 这很不幸。也许我们突袭的下一个洞穴将是“大量宝藏洞穴”。想象一下，我们会更有动力的。

entries.text: That makes sense. You were... You didn't seem like you were all there. At the time. But I'm sure it'll be better next time. I hope.
entries.translated_text: 这说得通。当时你...看起来并不像完全清醒的样子。但我相信下次会好些的。希望如此吧。

entries.text: Hah, got you! Ubbe, did you see that?!
entries.translated_text: 哈，抓到你了！乌贝，你看到了吗？！

entries.text: I think some sweat got into my eyes. They are stinging worse than a Giant Scorpion!
entries.translated_text: 我想有些汗水进入了我的眼睛。这比大蝎子蜇人还痛!

entries.text: Uh... The name's Yazakh. You just noticed what? Please tell me I haven't got any food stuck on my tusks again...
entries.translated_text: 呃...名字叫雅扎克。你刚刚注意到什么？别告诉我的牙齿上又卡着食物...

entries.text: Oh, are you a mercenary?
entries.translated_text: 哦，你是佣兵吗？

entries.text: Could the machines tell the difference? They seem like the angry type. Although granted, we did just break into their home.
entries.translated_text: 机器能分辨出区别吗？他们似乎是见人就打。虽然这理所当然的，我们确实闯入了他们的家。

entries.text: It does not matter how strong or smart one is. It only matters what one can do.
entries.translated_text: 一个人有多强壮或多聪明并不重要。重要的是一个人能做什么。

entries.text: Good Bilgemuck! Come with us now!
entries.translated_text: 好，污底！现在就和我们一起来吧！

entries.text: You better be nice to Redcap, do you understand? It's quite unusual that someone else wants to play with you, so don't ruin it!
entries.translated_text: 你最好对红帽子好点，明白吗？平时难得有人和你玩，所以不要毁了这个机会！

entries.text: Excluding treasure, the possibilities are truly endless.
entries.translated_text: 排除宝藏，可能性真的是无穷无尽的。

entries.text: Ooh!
entries.translated_text: 哦!

entries.text: Ooh!
entries.translated_text: 哦!

entries.text: Really?! Well, let's going by the book, shall we?
entries.translated_text: 真的？！好吧，让我们照着书做吧，好吗？

entries.text: I know how that feels.
entries.translated_text: 我知道那是什么感觉。

entries.text: Hmmm...? Oh, sorry, I was thinking about something.
entries.translated_text: 嗯……？哦，对不起，我在想一件事。

entries.text: I'm not particularly fond of guards on a normal day, but the fact that one approached you to threaten you... This investigation seems dangerous.
entries.translated_text: 平日里我就并不特别喜欢卫兵，但现在真有个卫兵来当面威胁你...这次调查的似乎很危险。

entries.text: Easy. I just don't want to see you hurt.
entries.translated_text: 放松，我只是不想看到你受伤。

entries.text: No, no! Scrap likes you, he's just... a little bit chaotic. Don't take it personally, okay?
entries.translated_text: 不，不！小渣喜欢你，他只是...有点混乱，别往心里去，好吗？

entries.text: We found it fair and square!
entries.translated_text: 我们是光明正大地找到它的！

entries.text: And it seems to be working quite well for me.
entries.translated_text: 而这对我来说似乎效果很好。

entries.text: If you were anybody else, I'd probably be taking blood from you for asking that.
entries.translated_text: 如果换作别人问这个问题，我大概早就从他身上吸血了。

entries.text: But if I can't do it, and I've wasted all this time delving into ruins for nothing...
entries.translated_text: 但如果我做不到，我就白白浪费时间钻遗址了...

entries.text: I'm sorry, but your friend's name is 'Gore'? As in, blood and guts? That's such a Nord name.
entries.translated_text: 抱歉，你朋友的名字叫“格雷”？就像，血液和胆量？这真是一个诺德人会取的名字。

entries.text: My greatest fear, huh?
entries.translated_text: 我最大的恐惧，嗯？

entries.text: I'm sure spider legs are a delicacy somewhere!
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定蜘蛛腿在某处是美味佳肴！

entries.text: I'm not like other Bretons, so you don't have to be like other Argonians. You know?
entries.translated_text: 我不像其他布莱顿人，所以你不必像其他亚龙人一样。你懂吗？

entries.text: (Sniffing)
(Sniffing)
How else would this Nils fellow cook? There must be a kitchen area. If we go in with enough confidence, they'll never question us.
entries.translated_text: 不然这个叫纽斯的家伙还能在哪儿做饭？一定会有一个厨房区域。只要我们表现得足够自信，他们就不会怀疑我们。

entries.text: Well, either way, he sounds rather important to you.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，不管怎样，他对你来说听起来很重要。

entries.text: Sorry. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 对不起，别在意。

entries.text: Oh excellent. This is the type of sneak thievery I excel at, and I won't have to look them in the eyes while we rob them.
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了。这是我擅长的潜行偷窃，当我们搜刮他们时，我不必看着他们的眼睛。

entries.text: And a bit more selfishly... So long as your actions do not impede my research... I will not part from such a reliable travel companion.
entries.translated_text: 再自私一点...只要你的行为不妨碍我的研究...我不会离开这么可靠的旅伴。

entries.text: Bend the end a little bit, I think...
entries.translated_text: 把末端弯曲一点，我想...

entries.text: Honningbrew or Black-Briar? Eh, I don't actually care which.
entries.translated_text: 是蜜之酿的还是黑棘家的？呃，其实我不在乎是哪个。

entries.text: Just enjoying our travels.
entries.translated_text: 尽管享受我们的旅行。

entries.text: Don't worry, Ganbald, I haven't died yet!
entries.translated_text: 别担心，甘巴尔德，我还没死呢！

entries.text: You seem pretty indifferent about it.
entries.translated_text: 你似乎对此无动于衷。

entries.text: If I could find a way to capture sound, we could carry music everywhere with us.
entries.translated_text: 如果我能找到捕捉声音的方法，我们就可以随身携带音乐。

texts: He's a merchant. I guess my mother has a thing for sailors. He travels between High Rock and Hammerfell, making sales and finding deals.
他是个商人。我猜我妈妈喜欢水手。他在高岩和落锤之间穿梭，进行贸易。

entries.text: He's a merchant. I guess my mother has a thing for sailors. He travels between High Rock and Hammerfell, making sales and finding deals.
entries.translated_text: 他是个商人，我猜我妈妈喜欢水手。他在高岩和落锤之间旅行，进行贸易。

entries.text: So, then you've only got a kill count of twenty-five percent. How about you, Rumarin? Have you been counting?
entries.translated_text: 所以，你只杀了百分之二十五的。你呢，鲁米勒？你一直在数吗？

entries.text: We could try the Bard's College.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以试试诗人学院。

entries.text: I don't want anything from him.
entries.translated_text: 我不想从他那里得到任何东西。

entries.text: I wish I could show you dwemer cities through my eyes, Khash.
entries.translated_text: 我希望能够向你展示我眼中的锻莫城市，卡什。

entries.text: It must have been disappointing to see they just use regular old horses.
entries.translated_text: 看到他们只是骑着普通的老马，这一定令你很失望。

entries.text: Find three pieces of wood. (<Global=HLIORPCWoodCount>/<Global=HLIORPCWoodTotal>)
entries.translated_text: 找到三块木柴。(<Global=HLIORPCWoodCount>/<Global=HLIORPCWoodTotal>)

entries.text: Scrap, keep Nar safe, okay?
entries.translated_text: 小渣，保证纳尔的安全，好吗？

entries.text: Keep your hands to yourself. Do you realize that at the snap of my fingers, I can bring the entire Markarth city guard to my defense?
entries.translated_text: 管好你的手。你知不知道，我随便打个招呼，全马卡斯的守卫都会来保护我？

entries.text: So we need to find these 'resonance gems' to participate in trials. Well, we can start looking around here, right?
entries.translated_text: 所以我们需要找到这些‘共振宝石’来参与试炼。好吧，我们可以开始四处看看了，对吧？

entries.text: I know I'm not too great in combat... I let you and Scrap handle it.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我在战斗中并不太出色...我让你和小渣来处理。

entries.text: Well, at least we won't have to go very far.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，至少我们不必走太远。

entries.text: I should just be satisfied with tarnishing his family name. Right. I can be happy with that.
entries.translated_text: 我应该满足于玷污他的家族名声，对吧，是的，我可以知足了。

entries.text: Even though Zora uses magic, she uses it so sparingly that I can pretend she doesn't at all. Another Breton who doesn't use magic! I'm not alone!
entries.translated_text: 尽管佐拉使用魔法，但她使用魔法的方式非常谨慎，以至于我可以假装她根本不使用魔法。另一个不使用魔法的布莱顿人！我不是一个人！

entries.text: In this life, you have to do what's best for you, regardless of what others think. Always value yourself first, adventurer.
entries.translated_text: 在这一生中，你必须做对你最好的事，不管别人怎么想。永远把自己放在第一位，冒险者。

entries.text: You don't have to worry, Joshua, I'll keep up. Probably.
entries.translated_text: 你不用担心，约书亚，我会跟上的，可能吧。

entries.text: What an absolute fool! I wanted Morvic to feel compelled to come see me himself, but I was hesitant to think he'd be that foolish. I'm pleased he is.
entries.translated_text: 真是个傻瓜！我的确想逼莫维克亲自来找我，但我不敢相信他会那么愚蠢。我很高兴他这么蠢。

entries.text: Your home is beautiful, adventurer.
entries.translated_text: 你的家很漂亮，冒险者。

entries.text: Well... You're putting me on the spot here. Hmm...
entries.translated_text: 嗯...你把我留在了这里。唔...

entries.text: Oh! Well, I traveled east along the Bjoulsae until I hit Evermore, then headed south. I cut through Hammerfell and entered Skyrim from the border.
entries.translated_text: 哦！好吧，我沿着玻西河往东走，直到抵达永恒城，然后往南走。我穿过落锤省，从边境进入天际。

entries.text: When you two get arrested, I'll come visit you in prison.
entries.translated_text: 你们俩要是被抓了，我会去探监的。

entries.text: What sort of content do you write? Adventures? Mysteries? Or perhaps more practical topics? Scientific observations? Theories on the forces of Nirn?
entries.translated_text: 你写什么内容？探险？神秘事件？或者是更实用的话题？科学观察？关于奈恩力量的理论？

entries.text: So that old bastard Calcelmo already had a research team down here. That's why he wouldn't let me in.
entries.translated_text: 原来那个老混蛋卡塞莫已经在这里有一个研究小组了，难怪他不让我进去。

entries.text: And where are they going to put the old Gildergreen? Are they going to chop it down? Do you suppose its wood holds any unique properties? Hm.
entries.translated_text: 他们打算把旧的镀绿树放在哪里？他们会把它砍掉吗？你认为它的木材有什么独特的特性吗？嗯。

entries.text: There are some experiences I can live without, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 我想，有些经历我可以没有。

entries.text: (Laugh) Oh, I completely agree with this!
entries.translated_text: （笑）哦，我完全同意这一点！

entries.text: Thank you! I work really hard on them, you know.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你！你知道吗？我真的付出了很多心血，你知道的。

entries.text: I guess I just don't understand, and I don't know if I ever will.
entries.translated_text: 我想我还是不明白，我也不知道我是否会想明白。

entries.text: I don't want to haul you back to Jorrvaskr on my back.
entries.translated_text: 我不想背着你把你拖回勇士之家。

entries.text: When I say we slept together, I do not mean it in the way others seem to suggest. Rather, we merely... laid near one another.
entries.translated_text: 当我说我们睡在一起时，我并不是指其他人似乎暗示的那种方式。相反，我们只是...彼此躺在一起。

entries.text: Wait, you want to go inside? (Laughs) Very well.
entries.translated_text: 等等，你想进去吗？(笑)太好了。

entries.text: Yay!! This is going to be *so* fun! I just know it! Sam! Sam, another round, but this time with our friend here!
entries.translated_text: 耶！！这将是*如此*有趣！我就知道！山姆！山姆，再来一轮，但这次是和我们的朋友一起！

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: What is it?
entries.translated_text: 什么？

entries.text: Well, that's another murder under our belt. At least we actually committed this one. Though I doubt anyone will care about Grisvar's death.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这又是一起谋杀案。至少我们这次是真的杀人了，虽然我觉得没人会在意格利斯瓦死了。

entries.text: And... Well, I like shiny things. And sometimes those shiny things... Are in pockets. So I got pretty good at fishing, if you know what I mean.
entries.translated_text: 而且...好吧，我喜欢闪亮的东西。有时候那些闪亮的东西...会在别人的口袋里。所以，如果你懂我的意思，我在“钓鱼”方面也变得非常拿手。

entries.text: His plan to unleash a horde of mudcrabs on the city.
entries.translated_text: 他计划在城市里放出一大群泥沼蟹。

entries.text: So, Khash, you've mentioned someone I don't know... Marlok?
entries.translated_text: 所以，卡什，你提到了一个我不认识的人...马洛克？

entries.text: That's nonsense! Why would it scare people? I think it's inspiring!
entries.translated_text: 真是胡说八道!它为什么会吓到人？我觉得它很鼓舞人心!

entries.text: By Sheor, leave me alone!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔，别管我！

entries.text: By the Divines... Khash, you don't know wiriting? I thought you could read at least a bit? This is terrible news!
entries.translated_text: 天哪...卡什，你不会写字？我还以为你至少会读懂一点呢？这可太糟了！

entries.text: Do- do pirates murder? They never have in the books I've read...
entries.translated_text: 海盗会杀人吗？在我读过的书中，他们从未杀过人...

entries.text: I'm compiling a list of words beginning with 'A'. As, After, And... Don't look at me like that; I'm not going to cheat at Withershins.
entries.translated_text: 我正在整理一份以“a”开头的单词列表。As，Afer，And...不要那样看着我；我不打算作弊。

entries.text: And what will this tip-off say?
entries.translated_text: 要在举报信里写什么？

entries.text: No, I'm afraid I didn't see any monk.
entries.translated_text: 不，恐怕我没有看到任何僧侣。

entries.text: Tell me his name.
entries.translated_text: 告诉我他的名字。

entries.text: How convenient for you! Except I don't take orders from you or anyone else.
entries.translated_text: 对你来说真是方便！不过我不会听从你或者任何其他人的命令。

entries.text: So I haven't even gone to the kitchen. Not once.
entries.translated_text: 所以我甚至连厨房都没去过，一次都没有。

entries.text: Often, but I had a bartering chip. Pay me more than the other guy will, because I could kill your peasants blindfolded.
entries.translated_text: 经常，但我有一个可供交换的筹码。他们得付给我比别人更多的钱，因为我蒙着眼都能杀死他们的农民。

entries.text: I'm so confused! I need the sun!
entries.translated_text: 我很烦！我需要太阳！

entries.text: So now you're talking to dead people?
entries.translated_text: 所以现在你在和死人说话？

entries.text: It's rather odd that it's up to you who Fastred ultimately courts. This is taking indecision to a new level, I think.
entries.translated_text: 真是奇怪，居然让你来决定谁能获得法斯莱德的爱，真是优柔寡断到不行。

entries.text: Oh, I know none of that stuff. Marlok did not either. Well, at least writing. (Mumbling) I do not think he knew science either...
entries.translated_text: 哦，我对那些东西一窍不通，马洛克也一样。至少，他不会写字。（喃喃自语）我觉得他大概也不懂什么科学……

entries.text: I'm not afraid of anyone!
entries.translated_text: 我才不怕任何人！

entries.text: That's what I wanted to hear!
entries.translated_text: 这就是我想听到的！

entries.text: I see.
entries.translated_text: 明白了。

entries.text: Seems your purse is lighter than you thought.
entries.translated_text: 你的钱包似乎比你想的要轻一些。

entries.text: These are the most Nord Nords I have ever seen.
entries.translated_text: 这些是我见过的最诺德的诺德人。

entries.text: Oh! You think I'm getting weak or something?
entries.translated_text: 哦！你觉得我变弱了还是怎么的？

entries.text: Alright, Far, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好了，法尔，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: Not within society, no. An unfortunate turn of events, that.
entries.translated_text: 不再有立锥之地，哎，这是一场不幸的变故。

entries.text: No. You're still you. Being an assassin is just one facet of you.
entries.translated_text: 不，你还是你，当刺客只是你的一个方面。

entries.text: Perhaps it's similar to when you see a cousin you once knew when you were young, but now that you're older, you're essentially strangers.
entries.translated_text: 也许，这就像你见到小时候曾经认识的表兄妹，但现在你们长大了，也不再熟悉。

entries.text: Alright, then time to make dinner!
entries.translated_text: 好了，接下来该做晚饭了！

entries.text: Ah! Oh wow, maybe I should aim before pulling that, huh?
entries.translated_text: 啊!哦，哇，也许我应该在拉它之前瞄准，是吧？

entries.text: Oooh, look at all these gems they're displaying.
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看他们展示的这些宝石。

entries.text: A lot of people in Wayrest don't like Redguards much. But the mercantile families trade often with Sentinal, so we get along fine with them.
entries.translated_text: 途歇城的很多人不太喜欢红卫人。但是商业家族们经常和哨兵城交易，所以我们和他们相处得很好。

entries.text: Bandit camps always smell of sweat. Wait, is that us? No, we bathe more regularly than bandits. I think.
entries.translated_text: 强盗营地总是弥漫着汗臭味，等等，那不就是我们吗？不，我们比土匪更经常洗澡的。

entries.text: Oh! Um, you do? ...Well, I appreciate you. And you admitting to some feelings. (Laugh)
entries.translated_text: 哦！嗯，你是这样吗？...嗯，我很感激你。和你承认的一些感受。（笑）

entries.text: Like... they contracted you? Did you... do it?
entries.translated_text: 就像...他们沾染上了你？你...干了？

entries.text: Oh, I... I'm the lucky one!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我...我是幸运儿！

entries.text: Ugh. I get that not everyone's comfortable with songs about Daedra, but at least have the guts to admit it. There's no shame in it.
entries.translated_text: 呃。我知道不是每个人都能接受关于魔族歌曲，但至少要有勇气承认这一点。这并不丢人。

entries.text: Remi researched and developed a "Tuning Fork" to do some sort of Tonal Magic and shut down automaton. So long as she's able to get close to them without being noticed, she should be able to take out automaton before they become a problem for us.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米研究并开发了一种“音叉”来实现某种音调魔法并关闭机器人。只要她能在不被注意的情况下接近它们，她就应该能够在让那些锻莫机器人失效。

entries.text: In a way, those jealous families freed me to explore to my heart's content. And allowed me to meet you.
entries.translated_text: 在某种程度上，那些嫉妒我们的家族，给了我机会可以尽情探险，而我因此见到了你。

entries.text: Are you planning on attending a lecture?
entries.translated_text: 你打算参加讲座吗？

entries.text: This is what happens when you leave the necromancer alive in your basement. Another kill.
entries.translated_text: 这就是你让亡灵法师在你的地下室里苟活着的后果，又一个人被杀了。

entries.text: Just blame it on the 'stupid Elf', and then point at me, and I'll wave or something.
entries.translated_text: 只要把它归咎于“愚蠢的精灵”，然后指着我，我会挥挥手什么的。

entries.text: Book from a Coffin in Arkngchal
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔棺材里的书

entries.text: Nothing illustrates more that the Thalmor are idiots than the fact that there is openly a Temple to Talos, and Ondolemar cares more about Ogmund.
entries.translated_text: 没有什么比公开设立塔洛斯神庙更能说明梭默是白痴了，昂多勒马该多关注下欧格蒙。

entries.text: Oh, I'm sure. There aren't many Argonians in Skyrim, so I imagine people would take more notice of you.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我确实相信。在天际没有多少亚龙人，所以我想人们会更加注意你。

entries.text: That is... I got our friend here.
entries.translated_text: 那是...我把我们的朋友带到了这里。

entries.text: The first option is that he successfully recreated the disappearance of the dwemer.
entries.translated_text: 第一个选择，是他成功重现了锻莫的消失。

entries.text: Has always been there for me since I can remember.
entries.translated_text: 从我记事起就一直在我身边。

entries.text: Skyrim
entries.translated_text: 天际

entries.text: But there's something so appealing about a group that doesn't much care about society.
entries.translated_text: 但是，对于一个不太关心社会的群体来说，这些东西是如此吸引人。

entries.text: You're a little too much brawn over brains, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 你是不是有点四肢发达，头脑简单啊？

entries.text: Y-yea. That sounds nice. Thank you, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 是的。听起来不错。谢谢你，蕾米。

entries.text: You lost me on the first part, but if you tie your knots like this... they won't slip anymore.
entries.translated_text: 前半部分我听不懂，但如果你这样打结......它们就不会再滑了。

entries.text: Somehow, I'm not surprised by that.
entries.translated_text: 不知何故，我对此并不感到惊讶。

entries.text: Not yet.
entries.translated_text: 还不行。

entries.text: The guy should be faster next time, then.
entries.translated_text: 那他下次应该搞快点。

entries.text: Enjoy yourself while you're at it! Arkngchal is a marvel, you know!
entries.translated_text: 趁着这个机会好好享受吧!阿卡切尔是一个奇迹，你知道的!

entries.text: He'll be able to help you fight and protect me. Two birds with one stone!
entries.translated_text: 他将能够帮助你战斗并保护我,一石两鸟！

entries.text: Mor, if you're going to ask me to carry something, I will look at you with really sad eyes.
entries.translated_text: 莫尔，如果你要让我带什么东西，我就会用非常悲伤的眼神看着你。

entries.text: Oh, what an easy mark... No, I shouldn't. But maybe I should...? Oh! I know!
entries.translated_text: 哦，小菜一碟...不，我不应该，但也许我应该......？我知道了!

entries.text: Nah, don't worry about it. Nothing wrong with being curious.
entries.translated_text: 不，不要担心。好奇没有错。

entries.text: Yes, it is!  Now, I've had some time to stew over Morvic's idiocy. He played a part in my family's ruin before, and now he's gone a step too far.
entries.translated_text: 是的！现在，我有一些时间来和莫维克算总账了。在我家落魄时他出了力，而现在他又越界了。

entries.text: I am far better looking, and I'm not even a mercenary anymore, mind you.
entries.translated_text: 我长得好看多了，而且注意，我现在甚至不是什么佣兵。

entries.text: Despite living underground, the dwemer studied the stars extensively.
entries.translated_text: 尽管生活在地下，矮人对星星的研究还是很广泛。

entries.text: That all sounds really complicated...
entries.translated_text: 这一切听起来真的很复杂...

entries.text: They're just so fascinating and intricate... I'd love to put one together.
entries.translated_text: 它们迷人又复杂...我也想要一个。

entries.text: They're just so fascinating and intricate... I'd love to put one together.
entries.translated_text: 它们迷人又复杂...我也想要一个。

entries.text: I like your paint, Rumarin.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢你的战纹，鲁米勒。

entries.text: Oh? What questions?
entries.translated_text: 哦？什么问题？

entries.text: He'll look happy! And you'll probably feel happy!
entries.translated_text: 他会看起来很开心！你可能也会觉得开心！

entries.text: I have a headache.
entries.translated_text: 我头疼。

entries.text: I'm waiting.
entries.translated_text: 我在等。

entries.text: I'm waiting.
entries.translated_text: 我在等。

entries.text: Yes, someday.
entries.translated_text: 是的，总有一天。

entries.text: Is that why you're the 'Swamp' Knight? Because you're Argonian?
entries.translated_text: 这就是你成为 "沼泽 "骑士的原因吗？因为你是亚龙人？

entries.text: I've always liked the Treasury House, ever since first arriving in Markarth. Staying at an inn can be expensive, so a stable income source is lovely.
entries.translated_text: 自从第一次来到马卡斯城，我就一直很喜欢珍宝屋。住在旅馆里开支不低，所以有一个稳定的收入来源就很不错。

entries.text: A dragon?! Here?!
entries.translated_text: 一条龙？！这里？！

entries.text: Remi despises pc
entries.translated_text: Remidespisespc

entries.text: Nooo, it's just a baby...
entries.translated_text: 不，这只是一个宝宝...

entries.text: Uh, well, yes.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，是的。

entries.text: Alright, then. Let's steal those oh-so-precious research notes. He thinks locked doors will stop me? The fool.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那么。让我们偷走那些无比珍贵的研究笔记，他认为锁着的门能阻止我吗？傻瓜。

texts: But apparently not lost enough, since it ws found under the employ of a band of necromancers in the next Fiefdom over, Alcaire.
但显然还不够，因为它是在下一个封地阿尔凯尔的一群死灵法师的雇佣下被发现的。

entries.text: You're the best! Thanks!
entries.translated_text: 你是最棒的！谢谢！

entries.text: None are quite as fun as the things you've had, I'm sure. But I do quite like Brewet. It tastes wonderful *and* reminds me of festivals!
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定，这些都不如你的那些东西有趣。但我确实很喜欢浓汤炖菜。它的味道很棒，*而且*让我想起了节日！

entries.text: I've read some books that give accounts of the dwemer being able to speak telepathically, even when far apart from each other.
entries.translated_text: 我读过一些关于锻莫能够通过心灵感应说话的书籍，即使彼此相距很远也可以。

entries.text: You'd really do that?
entries.translated_text: 真的可以吗？

entries.text: O-oh, wait, no. I didn't mean- Well, I shouldn't have said- I- It's hardly noticeable, really.
entries.translated_text: 不，等等，我不应该这么说，我是说，嗯，你那伤疤并不显眼。

entries.text: Don't sound so irritated! I'm not your personal servant to follow you around everywhere!
entries.translated_text: 不要听起来那么生气嘛！我不是你到处跟着你的贴身仆人！

entries.text: Remi, step lightly, and stay alert.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，脚步轻点，保持警惕。

entries.text: Hair, cloth, ropes. I like to braid a lot of stuff. But mostly hair. I just think the hairstyles are so pretty!
entries.translated_text: 头发、布料、绳索。我喜欢编很多东西。但主要是头发。我只是觉得发型好漂亮！

entries.text: So... thank you. You're the most important person in my life.
entries.translated_text: 所以谢谢，你是我生命中最重要的人。

entries.text: Ilia, please be careful!
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚，请小心！

entries.text: Oh yeah. Our 'Metal Recycling Program' is going very well!
entries.translated_text: 哦，当然。我们的 "金属回收计划 "进展顺利！

entries.text: Joshua. Joshua. Joshua. I'm trying to make sure the name doesn't escape my mind in the future. Joshua. I will call you Joshua.
entries.translated_text: 约书亚、约书亚、约书亚。我正在努力确保这个名字将来不会从我的脑海中消失。约书亚，我要叫你约书亚。

entries.text: Anyway, he's offered me a rather generous deal.
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，他给了我提供了一个相当慷慨的交易。

entries.text: There is a distinct lack of automaton here. That's unfortunate. I'd love to see some of Skyrim's animunculi.
entries.translated_text: 真不幸，这里没有什么自动机器，我很想看看一些天际的蒸汽机械。

entries.text: Glenumbra.
entries.translated_text: 格林纳巴。

entries.text: Okay, well I'll be around. I smell something really good cooking, so I think I'll go find whatever that is.
entries.translated_text: 好的，我会在附近的。我闻到了一些非常好吃的东西，所以我想我会去找找什么。

entries.text: Deep breaths, Remi. The cave's definitely not going to collapse and crush the life out of you. Deep breaths.
entries.translated_text: 深呼吸，蕾米。洞穴绝对不会塌陷并压扁你的小命。深呼吸。

entries.text: Hello, Una. Did you have something you needed to talk to me about?
entries.translated_text: 你好，尤娜，你有什么需要和我谈谈的吗？

entries.text: You don't seem to mind the cold. You're pretty strong. Not to mention recklessly brave.
entries.translated_text: 你似乎并不在意寒冷，你很强大，更不用说你那种无所畏惧的勇气了。

entries.text: Wait... I've seen others wearing that before...
entries.translated_text: 等等...我以前见过其他人戴那个...

entries.text: Hmm?
entries.translated_text: 嗯？

entries.text: I had hoped.
entries.translated_text: 我以前挺希望的。

entries.text: By the way, if Gore asks you something about his mead, I know nothing, okay?
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，如果格雷问你关于他蜜酒的事，我什么都不知道，好吗？

entries.text: Hush. Don't make it obvious... I'm just going to bump into them...
entries.translated_text: 嘘。不要说得太明显了...我只用撞到他们...

entries.text: It's hard to tell when I have an opening, though. I just don't think I have the brain for battle strategy.
entries.translated_text: 不过，要判断何时有机会可不容易。我只是觉得自己没有足够的头脑去搞战术。

entries.text: Uh, yeah of course.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，当然。

entries.text: Thorn.
entries.translated_text: 荆棘。

entries.text: Exploring by your side has been... Well, I wouldn't trade it for anything.
entries.translated_text: 能在你身边探险...任何东西也不能换走。

entries.text: Well, it works in my favour, as I don't have to worry about accidentally transgressing your beliefs.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，这对我挺好，因为我不必担心不小心触犯了你的信仰。

entries.text: We all have music unique to our patterns of behavior, which are our songs. They are how we help to shape Aurbis, however miniscule.
entries.translated_text: 我们都有自己独特的声音，这就是我们的歌曲。它们是我们助力塑造奥比斯的方式，无论这行为本身多么微小。

entries.text: He does give off an air of someone who knows a lot. I think.
entries.translated_text: 他确实给人一种知道很多事情的人的感觉。我觉得。

entries.text: ;ghost stories, yay
entries.translated_text: ;ghoststories,yay

entries.text: Are you alright?! What just happened?! Where's the Arch-Mage?!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗？！刚才发生了什么？！首席法师在哪里？！

entries.text: They kept some sort of torture room in their home?
entries.translated_text: 他们在家中设置了某种酷刑室？

entries.text: What in Sheor's name was that? That spider was huge!
entries.translated_text: 那是什么鬼东西？那只蜘蛛也太大了！

entries.text: I see. One mistake of his lead to everyone shunning him, and him losing everything. I... I think I understand you a little better, Gore.
entries.translated_text: 我懂了。他的一个错误导致所有人都背叛了他，他失去了一切。我……我想我更了解你了，格雷。

entries.text: O-oh, no.
entries.translated_text: 噢，不。

entries.text: I was joking about the everlasting blood spring before. I can't believe this is a real thing.
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信之前开玩笑说的是永恒的血泉居然是真的。

entries.text: Well, no, I actually don't know destruction well, but it just seems...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，不，我其实不太了解毁灭系魔法，但它似乎。。。

entries.text: That bastard! He thinks his life is ruined?! He'll pay for this.
entries.translated_text: 那个混蛋！他以为自己的人生就这样毁了？！他会为此付出代价的。

entries.text: What's the plan, then?
entries.translated_text: 那接下来有什么打算？

entries.text: My parents are back home in Wayrest. We always got along quite well, although I'm afraid they're lonely with both my sister and I out of the home.
entries.translated_text: 我的父母回到了途歇城的家了。我们一直相处得很好，虽然我担心我和姐姐都不在家里，他们会很孤独。

entries.text: I-I... Cavities...?
The Retching Netch
entries.translated_text: 呕吐气母

entries.text: Right, my mistake. Divines spare me the preservation instincts of a Nord with the spirit of an Orc.
entries.translated_text: 对，这事我的错。圣灵们让我保留了诺德人的本能和兽人的精神。

entries.text: I don't know if they deserved it, but I did what I had to.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道他们是否应得，但我做了我必须做的。

entries.text: Uhm... Wait, when did you get here? Who are you?
entries.translated_text: 嗯...等等，你什么时候来的？你是谁？

entries.text: Absolutely not!
entries.translated_text: 当然不会！

entries.text: Love you.
entries.translated_text: 爱你。

entries.text: Just need find someone armed to the teeth with a lot of scars.
entries.translated_text: 只需要找到一个武装到牙齿还有很多伤疤的人就行。

entries.text: Oh! Oh, yeah, okay!
entries.translated_text: 哦！哦，是的，好吧！

entries.text: Here are the two dwemer cogs.
entries.translated_text: 这是两个锻莫齿轮。

entries.text: And Ria- Oh, you're walking away.
entries.translated_text: 还有利亚——哦，你要走开了。

entries.text: Which wouldn't be a problem if I weren't wanting to carry it around with me when it gets dark.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我只要不天天把它待在身上就应该不会出问题。

entries.text: The buyer will never notice how useless this is when I'm done with it!
entries.translated_text: 当我完成后，买家永远不会发现这有多没用的！

entries.text: What should I do when we stop next? I can finish reading my book? Or maybe finish reading my other book? Or maybe I could finish my other other book?
entries.translated_text: 下次停下时我该怎么办？我能读完我的书吗？或者也许读完我的另一本书？或者也许我可以完成我的另一本书？

entries.text: Singing.
entries.translated_text: 唱歌。

entries.text: And what would I write, exactly? 'Could you stop implying I'm going to die, love Remiel'?
entries.translated_text: 我到底要写什么？“你能不能别再暗示我要死了，亲爱的蕾米”？

entries.text: Okay, try testing this out for me, okay?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，试着帮我测试一下，好吗？

entries.text: Oooh, is this one of those tragic love stories people talk about? A bird and her lover, turned against one another. It's a shame-I quite liked Moira.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这是人们谈论的悲剧爱情故事吗？一只鸟和她的爱人，彼此反目成仇。真遗憾，我很喜欢莫伊拉。

entries.text: What? Oh! You're hugging me! By Akatosh, I love you.
entries.translated_text: 什么？哦！你抱我！阿卡托什在上，我爱你。

entries.text: Just picked this up offa' whatever milk drinker we killed at the last camp.
entries.translated_text: 这只是从我们上个营地杀的一个胆小鬼身上捡到的。

entries.text: What I would give to see the sword-singers' homelands, or walk among the fauna of Valenwood and sup on our enemies.
entries.translated_text: 我更愿意去看看剑客们的故乡，或者在威木省的动物群中漫步然后把我们的敌人做成晚餐。

entries.text: [pagebreak] The history of Arkngchal is rich and enduring, and yet the center remains but a shadow compared to others nearby. The others conduct their battles and display their power with little thought to the genius of the scholars who make such things possible. And yet, the proud scholars within Arkngchal continue their work, ever improving the conceptualization of automaton. While the invaluable work that occurs in these walls may go unnoticed, those who live here continue on, their minds focused solely on creating the next great machine. While the invaluable work that occurs in these walls may go unnoticed, those who live here continue on, their minds focused solely on creating the next great machine. So brilliant are our engineers that those who live here do so for years, sometimes a lifetime. Most dedicate their lives to their science, leaving for fieldwork only to return to their true home in the end. A population of innovative engineers and theorists draws likeminded individuals to Arkngchal, which is how new apprentices come to live out their lives in this proud university. While the invaluable work that occurs in these walls may go unnoticed, those who live here continue on, their minds focused solely on creating the next great machine. 阿卡切尔的历史丰富而漫长，然而与附近的其他矮人城市相比，它的中心却显得黯然失色。其他城市进行战争彼此攻伐展示力量时，常常忽略了这群将不可能化为现实的天才。然而，阿卡切尔中骄傲的学者们继续他们的工作，不断改进自动机器。虽然他们的工作默默无闻，但他们仍将继续，完成一个个伟大杰作。 So brilliant are our engineers that those who live here do so for years, sometimes a lifetime. Most dedicate their lives to their science, leaving for fieldwork only to return to their true home in the end. Our designs have been used in the armies of our conquering allies, in the maintenance of our splendid cities, and in the furthering of the intelligence within our automaton. We conduct lectures on the most complex of topics and our members prove their mastery in the most advanced of specialties. We may be forgotten for the grand cities with proud soldiers and famous kings, but we will know for ourselves who made it possible for the them to be great. 我们的工程师居功甚伟，许多人在此奉献多年乃至一生。大多数人将他们的生命献给了他们的科学，只有在进行实地研究时才会暂时离开。一群富有创新精神的工程师和理论家将志同道合的人吸引到阿卡切尔，这就是为什么新学徒能在这所引以为豪的大学中度过自己的一生。 我们的设计被用于征服盟友的军队中，用于维护我们辉煌的城市，并推动我们自动装置的智能发展。我们进行最复杂的课题讲座，我们的成员在最先进的专业领域证明了他们的精通。虽然我们可能会因那些拥有骄傲士兵和著名国王的宏伟城市而被遗忘，但我们将清楚地知道，正是我们使他们的伟大成为可能。

entries.text: Remi...
entries.translated_text: 蕾米...

entries.text: Khash, please be careful... I could not live with myself if someone so young died on me.
entries.translated_text: 卡什，拜托一定要小心...如果这么年轻的你出了什么事，我一辈子都不会原谅自己。

entries.text: If I grew up in Morthal, I bet I would've play pretended I was living in Black Marsh instead of in Valenwood.
entries.translated_text: 如果我在莫萨尔长大，我敢打赌我会假装自己住在黑沼泽而不是威木省。

entries.text: I don't want you to do that.
entries.translated_text: 我不想让你那样做。

entries.text: I fear nothing.
entries.translated_text: 我什么都不怕。

entries.text: Good memories... Hm. Maybe... No, not that. I could- No... Ugh! I can't think of anything! What are you spending your share on?
entries.translated_text: 美好的回忆，也许...不，不是那个我可以-不..！我什么都想不起来了，你那份都花在哪儿了？

entries.text: I feel... different somehow. More myself.
entries.translated_text: 我感觉……有些不一样了。更像是找回了真正的自己。

entries.text: Well, in this case, it'd be *your* opponent's. And trust me, between the improvements I've made and your skill, they won't stand a chance.
entries.translated_text: 当遇到这种情况时，那就是*你*的对手了。相信我，在我的改良后，他们不会有任何机会。

entries.text: Hi, Ren. Did you need something?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，任，你需要什么吗？

entries.text: Not sure the rain has what it takes.
entries.translated_text: 不知道雨有多大。

entries.text: We're after some more rumours.
entries.translated_text: 我们正在寻找更多的传闻。

texts: Now, any worth persuing is a different question.
现在，每个任何值得探讨的都是不同的问题。

entries.text: I agree! Although its beauty seems more superficial than anything. What with the Silverbloods and the warrens and the mine overseers...
entries.translated_text: 我同意！不过它的美似乎只是表面上的。银血家族、弃誓者和矿场监工...

entries.text: Far, don't just leave me here forever. I'll miss you.
entries.translated_text: 法尔，不要就这样把我永远留在这里，我会想你的。

entries.text: I do not mind.
entries.translated_text: 我不介意。

entries.text: Alright, maybe we take up a completely different hobby, like... writing? Poetry?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许我们有一个完全不同的爱好，比如…写作？诗

entries.text: His awful breath.
entries.translated_text: 他的口臭惊世骇俗。

entries.text: No. Unless the secret is what I had for breakfast.
entries.translated_text: 不。除非那个秘密是我早饭吃的什么。

entries.text: What do you mean?
entries.translated_text: 你是什么意思？

entries.text: Come on, legs, we have to-ah!-move.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，腿，我们必须-啊！-动起来。

entries.text: Absolutely not.
entries.translated_text: 当然没有。

entries.text: Absolutely not.
entries.translated_text: 当然没有。

entries.text: For all I care, you could fall into a pit, and I'd be happy to wipe my hands of you.
entries.translated_text: 说实话，你掉进坑里都无所谓，我很乐意就此和你一刀两断。

entries.text: Okay, then.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那么这样吧。

entries.text: If they weren't so unethically made, I'd have to get a taste.
entries.translated_text: 如果不是他们的制作过程违背了我的道德，我一定会尝尝。

entries.text: I'm going to ruin your face like you ruined my family!
entries.translated_text: 我要毁掉你的脸，就像你毁掉我的家庭一样！！

entries.text: Cuts into the profits. Would you be open to doing business together?
entries.translated_text: 利润少了，你们还愿意一起做生意吗？

entries.text: 'Just wonderful! Killed some draugr, froze in blizzards, and joined a fanatical cannibal cult. All completely normal adventurous things.'
entries.translated_text: 真是太棒了！杀几个尸鬼，在暴雪中冻僵了，还加入了一个狂热的食人邪教。这些都是完全正常的冒险经历。

entries.text: You have a bizarre taste in enjoyable activities, Anum-La.
entries.translated_text: 你对愉快的活动的定义很奇怪，安努姆菈。

entries.text: It took me a long time to really get that.
entries.translated_text: 我花了很长时间才真正明白这一点。

entries.text: It's a word I made up just now to describe someone with mechanical knowledge of dwemer machines. Rolls off the tongue, right?
entries.translated_text: 这是我刚才编造的一个词，用来形容一个有锻莫机械知识的人，刚想出来的，不错吧？

entries.text: I definitely agree!
entries.translated_text: 完全同意！

entries.text: My mind wasn't turned off!
entries.translated_text: 我仍然在思考！

entries.text: That's from Elsweyr orginally. Are you surprised I knew?
entries.translated_text: 那是来自艾斯维尔传来的美食。我知道这个，惊讶吧？

entries.text: So we're off, then, Joshua? Lead the way.
entries.translated_text: 那么，我们出发了，约书亚？带路。

entries.text: Alright, let me play along. Why did this monk appear to you?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我一起玩。为什么这个僧侣会出现在你面前？

entries.text: Maybe you should just... forget I said anything.
entries.translated_text: 也许你应该…忘了我说过什么。

entries.text: I'm no stranger to doing questionable things for items I covet, after all.
entries.translated_text: 毕竟，我也常为了自己梦寐以求的东西做过一些有争议的事情。

entries.text: Blast it. Oh, never mind.
entries.translated_text: 他妈的。哦，别在意。

entries.text: And... thank you. Sometimes I can't seem to find my words, so I... appreciate you stepping in there.
entries.translated_text: 对了...非常感谢。有时候我会不知道说什么...我...非常感谢你帮我解围。

entries.text: That depends on what you want to know.
entries.translated_text: 这取决于你想知道什么。

entries.text: That depends on what you want to know.
entries.translated_text: 这取决于你想知道什么。

entries.text: Me? I never get mail! Who is it from?
entries.translated_text: 我？我不知道谁会给我寄信！这信是谁的？

entries.text: ... Put her back. I know she didn't just say I look like every other mercenary.
entries.translated_text: ……把她放回去。我知道她不只是说我看起来像其他雇佣兵。

entries.text: And isn't something wrong with it?
entries.translated_text: 那它是不是有什么问题？

entries.text: Here we are... The Tower of Mzark. This is where Septimus said to look for the Elder Scroll, right?
entries.translated_text: 我们在这儿...扎克之塔。这就是塞普汀默斯说要寻找上古卷轴的地方，对吧？

entries.text: If I expect Nords to be welcoming of other races, I should also expect them to want the freedom to worship as they please.
entries.translated_text: 如果我希望诺德人对其他种族更包容，我也应该理解他们想要自由崇拜自己信仰的权利。

entries.text: Rings are easy to remove with some grease or oil. 'Clumsily' spill something, apologize profusely and while the mark is distracted you make the grab.
entries.translated_text: 戒指很容易用一些油脂或油取下。“不小心”洒了东西，然后大声道歉，趁着目标分心的时候，你就上手。

entries.text: While you're at it, check in on Khash, too, okay?
entries.translated_text: 当你在数的时候，也注意一下卡什，好吗？

entries.text: Maybe I could try throwing some healing spells your way, too?
entries.translated_text: 也许我也可以尝试用你的方式施放一些治疗法术？

entries.text: I think we understand each other.
entries.translated_text: 我想我们能互相理解。

entries.text: Well, not *everything*. But, yes, I suppose if you are not a fan of dust, that's unavoidable. Don't you think the machines are extraordinary, though?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，不是*一切*。但是，是的，我想如果你不喜欢灰尘，那是不可避免的。你不觉得这些机器很特别吗？

entries.text: Not permanently! Just for a bit. I have a few design ideas for this place!
entries.translated_text: 不是永久！就一会。我在这个地方有一些设计思路！

entries.text: Hmm... I'm not sure I'd like my writing to attract the kind of person who would call themselves a genius...
entries.translated_text: 嗯...我不确定我是否希望我的作品能吸引到那种自称天才的人...

entries.text: Lever puzzles are simple, yet effective in safeguarding. I'm sure I can use a similar method to make sure no one else can rewire Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 杠杆拼图很简单，但在保障方面却很有效。我相信我可以用类似的方法来确保没有人可以重新连接小渣。

entries.text: I- Well, I suppose I've never really thought of it. But now that it's been pointed out, I see that's a rather silly question, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 我...嗯，我还从没真正想过这个问题。但现在既然有人提出来了，我想这是一个很蠢的问题，不是吗？

entries.text: I'd be concerned if you weren't tired. That looked like quite the... quite the experience.
entries.translated_text: 你要是不累我才会担心，看起来那真是一次...相当特别的经历。

entries.text: Now aren't you a strange one. Well, J'zargo is surprised. And pleased!
entries.translated_text: 哈哈，你还真是个奇怪的人。好吧，吉'扎格很惊讶。并且很高兴！

entries.text: Were you going to ask me something, Ubbe?
entries.translated_text: 你打算问我什么吗，乌贝？

entries.text: I bet you're wondering where payment the Giant made to you for Gleda went. I'll just say you're very open to suggestion when drunk out of your mind.
entries.translated_text: 我打赌你肯定想知道巨人给你的买格丽达的钱去哪儿了。我只想说，当你醉得神志不清时，你很乐意接受别人的建议。

entries.text: Are you actually going to sacrifice someone to Boethiah? Why are you looking at me like that? You better not be thinking what I'm afraid you are.
entries.translated_text: 你真的要为波耶希亚献祭吗？你为什么这样看着我？你最好不要想我害怕你的事。

entries.text: Bust Target
entries.translated_text: Bust Target

entries.text: But tomorrow is a new day, right?
entries.translated_text: 但明天是新的一天，对吧？

entries.text: Morvic
entries.translated_text: 莫维克

entries.text: Come on; let's head out.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，我们出去吧。

entries.text: Okay, Scrap sort of likes you. Of course, that doesn't mean you can have him! Just, ah, to make sure you're aware.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，小渣似乎还算喜欢你。当然，这并不意味着你可以得到他！就，啊，要确保你知道。

entries.text: You're telling me that we're just going to make up the verse? After we went through all the trouble to find it? We should've just started with that!
entries.translated_text: 你是说我们还要编造这节诗吗？尤其是在我们费尽周折才找到它之后？我们应该一开始就编。

entries.text: I don't see any Divines or Daedra taking me out to see the local Dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 我没有看到任何圣灵或魔神带我出去看当地的锻莫遗迹。

entries.text: I cannot do this. I'm sorry, but I just can't. You... you can find me in the Silverblood Inn after... After.
entries.translated_text: 我不能做到这一点。抱歉，但我就是做不到。你...你可以在...之后之后在银血旅店找到我。

entries.text: I'm kind of trying to sneak here.
entries.translated_text: 我有点想试试潜行。

entries.text: Well, you have the Ebony Mail. Better be worth it. Watch your back from now on. Who knows when Boethiah will tire of you being her Champion?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你有黑檀链甲了，最好值得。从现在开始小心你的背后，谁知道波耶希亚什么时候会厌倦你成为她的勇士？

entries.text: Oh, hi Khash. Wait, a bit? And you didn't say anything?! Uh. Well, anyway, my name is Remi.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你好卡什。稍等一会？你什么都没说？！呃。好吧，无论如何，我的名字是蕾米。

entries.text: But the Bosmer would always say something about eating their enemies, and I loved seeing the colour rain from their faces.
entries.translated_text: 但波兹莫总是说着要吃掉他们的敌人，我喜欢看到他们脸上的彩色雨露。

entries.text: When I first began traveling toward Skyrim, I had the intention of heading straight to Markarth.
entries.translated_text: 当我最初开始前往天际省时，我本打算直接去马卡斯。

entries.text: It's infuriating that my first prison excursion would be for something I didn't actually do! What are we going to do?!
entries.translated_text: 我的第一次监狱之旅竟然是因为背锅，这实在是太让人生气了！我们该怎么办？

entries.text: Using a corpse for a ritual... I know it's different. I know! But it's also not. Thank you. Thank you for not doing it.
entries.translated_text: 用尸体举行仪式...我知道这不一样，我知道！但这也依旧困扰我。谢谢你没有这么做。

entries.text: The city fell to daedric influences.
entries.translated_text: 这座城市沦陷于魔族的影响之下。

entries.text: Scrap was so impressive! I'll never forget today.
entries.translated_text: 小渣是如此出色！我永远不会忘记今天。

entries.text: Before the engagement to Morvic, I had been meeting with someone consistently.
entries.translated_text: 在与莫维克订婚之前，我一直在与一个人持续约会。

entries.text: M-me?! I-I don't think-
entries.translated_text: 我-我？！我——我不认为——

entries.text: I'd like for you to stop riding your horse.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你别再骑你的马了。

entries.text: I'd like for you to stop riding your horse.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你别再骑你的马了。

entries.text: I'd like for you to stop riding your horse.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你别再骑你的马了。

entries.text: This cog looks like it might fit, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: 这个齿轮看起来很合适，小渣。

entries.text: Really?! Oh, wow, what should I get?! We're rich now, so maybe I can get something fancy! Then again, this is Skyrim. I won't find anything fancy.
entries.translated_text: 真？！哦，哇，我应该得到什么？！我们现在很有钱，所以也许我能得到一些花哨的东西！话又说回来，这是天际，我可找不到什么花哨的东西。

entries.text: Oh... Yeah, I... definitely get that. I have to ask, did you choose to live out in the wilds? You seem comfortable enough in them as we travel.
entries.translated_text: 哦...是啊，我...完全能理解这种感觉。不得不问一下——你是自己选择住在荒野里的吗？一路上看你在那种环境里挺自在的。

entries.text: I would be scared to go into ruins alone.
entries.translated_text: 我害怕一个人走进废墟。

entries.text: That's rather... thoughtful. So creating these characters is a form of training for mind-reading. Or training for guessing at mind-reading.
entries.translated_text: 这倒是挺...周到的。所以创造这些人物是一种练习阅读他人内心的方式。或者说,是练习猜测他人心理的训练。

entries.text: Isn't it a bit dangerous to, I don't know, swing a sword and blast fire at the same time?
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，一边挥剑一边放火球是不是有点危险？

entries.text: But you saying that... This is the closest I've felt to understanding Nords. Sometimes it's hard to care about the larger picture.
entries.translated_text: 但你这么说...这是我感觉最接近了解诺德人的一次,他们有时很难关心大局。

entries.text: Errand boy.
entries.translated_text: 小跟班。

entries.text: It's making me sleepy.
entries.translated_text: 它让我昏昏欲睡。

entries.text: I'd sooner knock your teeth out.
entries.translated_text: 我宁愿把你的牙齿敲掉。

entries.text: I mean, I would like to stop worrying about it, but... I don't know. I'd almost rather he wasn't here.
entries.translated_text: 我是说，我不想再担心了，但……我不知道。我几乎宁愿他不在这里。

entries.text: It's a shame they go against the Green Pact. I think you'd like them.
entries.translated_text: 很遗憾这些食物违反了绿色公约，如果不是那样，我想你会喜欢的。

entries.text: They sound strange.
entries.translated_text: 他们听起来很奇怪。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: Alright.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。

entries.text: What's the matter with you?!
entries.translated_text: 你怎么了？！

entries.text: Shall we head to this Sanctuary you mentioned?
entries.translated_text: 要不要去你说的这个圣所？

entries.text: (Laughs) She would make a great jester, don't you think, Rumarin?
entries.translated_text: (笑)她会成为一个伟大的小丑，你不觉得吗，罗米勒？

entries.text: Oh! Finally! I'm not going to lie, the curiosity has been killing me.
entries.translated_text: 哦！最后说一下！我没有说谎，我也很好奇。

entries.text: The Arcanaeum
entries.translated_text: 秘藏馆

entries.text: Hm. It seems a little... not great. And dangerous for someone as clumsy as I am. There are probably traps.
entries.translated_text: 哼。这似乎有点...不够宏伟。对于像我这样笨拙的人来说很危险。小心有陷阱。

entries.text: Ah! Nar! Don't let me die! Wait, don't let you die!
entries.translated_text: 啊！纳尔！别让我死了！等等，你别死了！

entries.text: Processed Aetherium
entries.translated_text: 加工过的神光水晶

entries.text: Hm. Alright. You impress me more by the day!
entries.translated_text: 嗯。好吧。你给我留下的印象越来越深了!

entries.text: Oh. Well, that's fine. More for Val and I, then. I suppose you could live in whatever fancy mansion we end up buying with the profits, though.
entries.translated_text: 嗷，那好吧，没关系。我和瓦尔能分得更多，不过，我像你可以住在我们最后赚钱买的豪宅里。

entries.text: It's amazing how widespread the creation of automata are in Dwemer cities. I've encountered very few ruins without them.
entries.translated_text: 在锻莫城市里，自动机器的造物是如此的普遍，这真是令人惊讶，我去过的遗址中很少没有它们的身影。

entries.text: Just test a couple locks and tell me if it works alright!
entries.translated_text: 只需测试几把锁，然后告诉我它是否可以正常工作！

entries.text: Anyway, are we to assume that this 'lost verse' is carved in stone? I'm sure if it was written on paper, it wouldn't be quite legible at this point.
entries.translated_text: 总之，我们是不是该假设这首“失落的诗词”是刻在石头上的？我敢肯定，如果是写在纸上的话，现在恐怕已经无法辨认了。

entries.text: I just... Um... Could I stay close to you? Or like, um, could I hold your hand?
entries.translated_text: 我只是...嗯...我可以靠近你一点吗？或者，那个...我可以握住你的手吗？

entries.text: Exactly how many have you killed? Approximately, I mean, I don't expect you to have a count.
entries.translated_text: 你到底杀了多少人？大概，我的意思是，我不指望你会数数。

entries.text: The East Empire Company's influence stretches even this far.
entries.translated_text: 东帝国公司的影响力甚至延伸到了这里。

entries.text: About that crossbow idea...
entries.translated_text: 关于那个弩的构想...

entries.text: It's sad to see my brother Nords turn their noses up at Yokudan warriors, the communal Khajiit that, given an opportunity make the best of kin,
entries.translated_text: 我看到我的诺德人兄弟们对犹库达战士们嗤之以鼻就感到悲哀。以及社区里的虎人，如果有机会，他们本可以联合起来，

entries.text: So... you don't like mead. What sort of argonian drinks do you recommend, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么...你不喜欢蜜酒。那么，你有什么亚龙人饮料推荐吗？

entries.text: Gloomreach Hive
entries.translated_text: 阴郁河段蜂房

entries.text: Ow, ow, ow! Yazakh, I need help! Now, would be preferable!
entries.translated_text: 嗷，嗷，嗷！雅扎克，我需要帮助！现在，最好是现在！

entries.text: Piracy on the High Seas, smuggling, kidnapping for ransom, extortion, blackmail... and lollygagging.
entries.translated_text: 我在公海上的海盗行为、走私、绑架勒索、敲诈勒索......以及偷渡。

entries.text: Let's go ahead and relax for awhile.
entries.translated_text: 让我们继续放松一下。

entries.text: I'd rather not.
entries.translated_text: 我才不。

entries.text: I'd rather not.
entries.translated_text: 我才不。

entries.text: Why exactly are the Nords mad at the Empire?
entries.translated_text: 为什么诺德人对帝国如此愤怒？

entries.text: That sounds almost... fun!
entries.translated_text: 听起来几乎…很有趣！

entries.text: Won't the Aldmeri Dominion come after Skyrim once it has separated from the Empire?
entries.translated_text: 如果天际从帝国分离，先祖神洲不会乘虚追击吗？

entries.text: I can't say I'm feeling any more confident.
entries.translated_text: 我真的要没信心了。

entries.text: Not to mention, you were able to guess at my use of corundum as an alloy with dwemeris metals.
entries.translated_text: 更别说，你可以猜到我将刚玉制作矮人金属的合金。

entries.text: You would've been fine exploring on your own, but I'm glad you stayed with me.
entries.translated_text: 我知道你一个人也能探险，但我很高兴你和我在一起。

entries.text: Oh, how about, 'nothing to write home about'? That's quite a good pun, Remi. I think Yazakh will certainly laugh.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这个“没什么可写的”怎么样？这个双关语不错，蕾米。我想雅扎克一定会笑出声。

entries.text: Hey, if you're ever feeling too tired after a sleepless night, let me know.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，如果您在一个不眠之夜后感到太累，请告诉我。

entries.text: What about you? Do you know much about magic?
entries.translated_text: 那你呢？你对魔法了解得多吗？

entries.text: The Winking Skeever
entries.translated_text: 眨眼恶鼠

entries.text: This is so exciting!
entries.translated_text: 这太令人兴奋了！

entries.text: Well?! How was Apocrypha?! Maybe it's good I can't go in... I don't think I could bring myself to return.
entries.translated_text: 好了？！阿波科法是什么样的？！也许我不能进去是件好事...我想我自己不能回来。

entries.text: Solitude is home to some many exotic delicacies. An adventurer can get spoiled here.
entries.translated_text: 独孤城是许多异国美食的家园。冒险者在这里可能会丧失斗志。

entries.text: Sorry, you're right. We'll keep letting him fight.
entries.translated_text: 对不起，你说得对。我们会让他继续战斗。

entries.text: Glad you're finally listening. Come on, let's move.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴你终于开始听了。走吧，我们继续前进。

entries.text: I see. You desire relationships without the physical aspects.
entries.translated_text: 我明白了。你渴望没有身体方面的关系。

entries.text: Well, I recall that he seemed to think he was those things, and yet I can't say that he really lived up to his words.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我记得他自己是这么认为的，但是它实际上也并没有和他的想法相差太远。

entries.text: Oh, I know! We should have a-a-a special greeting! Like a hand signal only we know!
entries.translated_text: 哦，我知道！我们应该有一个特别的问候方式！就像只有我们知道的手势！

entries.text: Bet getting the hang of it took a lot of practice.
entries.translated_text: 敢打赌，要掌握这种技巧可得练上好一阵子。（Bet，b开头）

entries.text: I began adding on various phrases, such as 'not to be rude', or 'I don't mean this to sound offensive'.
entries.translated_text: 所以，我开始添加各种短语，比如“冒犯了”，或者“无意冒犯”。

entries.text: I'm not sure how much you'll like what I'm drinking, but you can try a bit of it.
entries.translated_text: 我不确定你会喜欢我喝的东西，但你可以尝尝。

entries.text: Let's talk about something else.
entries.translated_text: 我们来聊点别的吧。

entries.text: Shh!
entries.translated_text: 嘘！

entries.text: The 'Eyes of the Falmer', huh? I certainly wouldn't mind getting my hands on those.
entries.translated_text: “伐莫之眼”，嗯？我当然不介意得到这些。

entries.text: So Wyrd Covens are Druids?
entries.translated_text: 所以，命运巫会是德鲁伊？

entries.text: Steam breath
entries.translated_text: 蒸汽吐息

entries.text: Steam breath
entries.translated_text: 蒸汽吐息

entries.text: Adventuring is wonderful. I become bored if things are the same every day.
entries.translated_text: 冒险是件美妙的事。如果每天都是一成不变，那我会无聊的。

entries.text: Remi has been thinking of a new project, and it has something to do with Tonal Magic. She's not sure where to begin, but she thinks if we can find a book with more information, she might be able to get an idea of what to do. I've found a book that seem promising. I should probably show it to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米一直在考虑一个新项目，这与音调魔法有关。她不知道从哪里开始，但她认为如果我们能找到一本包含更多信息的书，她可能会知道该怎么做。我找到了一本看起来很有用处的书。我应该把它给蕾米看。

entries.text: A man? Really, I thought it'd be something bigger...
entries.translated_text: 一个人？真的，我以为会是更大的东西...

entries.text: I hope you don't mind my saying, but if you fell into a pit, I don't think I'd be inclined to retrieve you.
entries.translated_text: 希望你别介意我这么说，但如果你掉进了坑里，我可能不会有兴趣把你救上来。

entries.text: Now, since you're giving me these things to carry, I assume you're also giving Xel a similar amount.
entries.translated_text: 既然把这些东西让我拿，那我想你也应该给了塞尔差不多的东西吧。

entries.text: ;PC has asked where Remi is from
entries.translated_text: ;PChasaskedwhereRemiisfrom

entries.text: Well, are you regretting attacking Buffy, yet?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你后悔攻击巴非了吗？

entries.text: Okay, understood!
entries.translated_text: 好的，明白了!

entries.text: Scathecrows are oddly beautiful.
entries.translated_text: 苦痛草漂亮得奇怪。

entries.text: Just because I carry Scrap around doesn't mean I have spare muscle to carry your stuff, you know. But I suppose since it's you.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我随身携带小渣并不意味着我有多余的力气来拿你的东西。但既然是你要求的，就依你了。

entries.text: And Doctor- Oh, you're walking away.
entries.translated_text: 然后医生 - 哦，你要走开了。

entries.text: My father explained then that sometimes people could be mean just because they thought it was fun.
entries.translated_text: 我父亲当时解释说，有时人们可能只是因为他们认为这很有趣而变得刻薄。

entries.text: What did I eat to make me so sick...?
entries.translated_text: 我吃了什么让我这么恶心...？

entries.text: I haven't been able to find my favourite piece of charcoal since arriving in Markarth. Ugh, that means I probably left it in Arkngchal. Great.
entries.translated_text: 自从来到马卡斯城，我就再也找不到我最喜欢的那块木炭了。唉，这意味着我可能把它落在阿卡切尔了。好极了。

entries.text: The next morning, her parents woke to find her gone. And no matter how they searched and called for her, Agryval was never seen again.
entries.translated_text: 第二天早上，她的父母醒来发现她不见了。无论他们如何寻找和呼唤她，阿格里瓦尔都再也没有出现过。

entries.text: Oh! I know! I bet it just needs a little help. I know a recipe to make a lubricant for metal.
entries.translated_text: 哦！我知道了，我敢打赌它只需要小小的调整一下，我知道怎么制作润滑剂。

entries.text: Oh no, here it comes...
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，又来了...

entries.text: That was partly my fault as well...
entries.translated_text: 这也部分是我的错...

entries.text: A new contract? Let's get to it, then.
entries.translated_text: 新契约？那么，让我们开始吧。

entries.text: Wait! Ghost Bard! Come back! By Sheor.
entries.translated_text: 等下！幽灵吟游诗人！回来！舒奥尔在上。

entries.text: Yes, I think that's what I'm craving.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想这就是我渴望的。

entries.text: Ria, what do we do that makes everything want us dead?!
entries.translated_text: 利亚，我们做了什么让一切都想让我们死？！

entries.text: Suryvel, before you go- Oh, you're already leaving. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 苏里维尔，在你走之前——哦，你已经走了。没关系。

entries.text: Yes, exactly! I asked one of the bards once to play 'The Coldharbour Compact', since it revolves around such a fascinating tale.
entries.translated_text: 是的，没错！我曾经要求一个吟游诗人演奏《冷港契约》，因为它讲述了这样一个精彩的故事！

entries.text: Good, that's a relief. I really thought for a moment that you've never read a book.
entries.translated_text: 很好，这让我释怀了。我真的很难想象，你怎能从来没有读过书。

entries.text: So... Guild Master... What is our next job? I could go for some fishing, personally, but it's your call.
entries.translated_text: 那么...会长...我们的下一份工作是什么？我个人可以去做点钓鱼活，但还是你来决定。

entries.text: Okay, one more time...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，再来一次……

entries.text: I suppose I understand why Wilhelm would tell Narfi his sister would return. It's much less... difficult to say than the alternative.
entries.translated_text: 我想我明白为什么了威尔海姆会告诉纳菲他姐姐会回来，这比起其他的话要...更容易开口。

entries.text: So many Bretons seem to think that they are heroes.
entries.translated_text: 很多布莱顿人似乎认为他们是英雄。

entries.text: Yes, I suppose setting up camp is good for us, but bad for them. Makes it pretty obvious where they're hiding out.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想建立营地对我们来说是好事，但对他们来说是坏事。这使他们的藏身之处变得非常明显。

entries.text: Probably derived from souls, but maybe I shouldn't tell you that since you're... uh... Well, young.
entries.translated_text: 可能来自灵魂，但也许我不应该告诉你，因为你...呃...嗯，年轻。

entries.text: Then, I'll ask you this again.
entries.translated_text: 然后，我再问你一次这个问题。

entries.text: Gladly, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 很高兴，我的朋友。

entries.text: Let's see...
entries.translated_text: 我们来瞧一瞧...

entries.text: Let's see...
entries.translated_text: 我们来瞧一瞧...

entries.text: Sujamma.
entries.translated_text: 苏贾玛酒饮。

entries.text: You've really grown as a person, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 你真的成长了，蕾米。

entries.text: At last! The anticipation has been suffocating me! I'll return shortly, okay?
entries.translated_text: 终于！我迫不及待了！我很快就回来，好吗？

entries.text: Whoa, what in Sheor's name is this thing?
entries.translated_text: 哇，以舒奥尔的名义,这是什么？

entries.text: Oh, my birth father. Yeah, he was reanimated by necromancers a few years back.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我的亲生父亲。是的，他死后几年被死灵法师复活了。

entries.text: This is... what I wanted.
entries.translated_text: 这是...我想要的。

entries.text: Then he'll have to let me in.
entries.translated_text: 然后他就只能让我进去。

entries.text: Yes, I suppose we have!
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想探索了很多！

entries.text: If you're picking up supplies, don't forget to get me food, too.
entries.translated_text: 如果你要搞点补给，别忘了也给我弄点吃的。

entries.text: It seems a bit on the nose to murder Vittoria and hope that the emperor comes to Skyrim. Isn't it a bit obvious of a trap?
entries.translated_text: 谋杀维多利亚并希望皇帝来到天际似乎有点不合时宜。陷阱是不是有点不合时宜？

entries.text: This is a bulk order, Remi (10).
entries.translated_text: 这是批量订单，蕾米（10）。

entries.text: I had numerous texts about them, including many about the Heart of Lorkhan and the Numidium.
entries.translated_text: 我有很多关于他们的资料，包括很多关于洛克汗之心和纳米迪安的。

entries.text: Ubbe.
entries.translated_text: 乌贝。

entries.text: Some people just don't like talking about their religion. Seems like a personal thing.
entries.translated_text: 有些人只是不喜欢谈论他们的宗教信仰。似乎是很私人的事情。

entries.text: That's all I ask.
entries.translated_text: 这就是我要问的。

entries.text: I'm happy you're on my side, Ubbe.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴你站在我这边，乌贝。

entries.text: 'So you think you are intelligent? You're lacking stimulating reading, stagnant in your thoughts? All of Skyrim's writing too dull for your genius?
entries.translated_text: ‘所以你认为自己很聪明？你缺乏激发思考的读物，思维停滞不前？天际的所有著作对你的天才头脑来说都太过乏味？’

entries.text: As someone who values being stealthy, I certainly understand that she can't be on all the time.
entries.translated_text: 作为一个重视隐藏的人，我能够理解。

entries.text: Is that so? You know, I have heard tales of dashing rogues who steal from the rich to give to the poor.
entries.translated_text: 是这样吗？你知道吗，我听过一些劫富济贫的故事。

entries.text: Yes, I'm sure too.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我也很确定。

entries.text: I wanna come with you. I just get so excited thinking about it!
entries.translated_text: 我想和你一起去。我只是想想就很兴奋！

entries.text: Why come to Skyrim to see them?
entries.translated_text: 为什么要来天际看遗址？

entries.text: I liked it! I'm not sure how you knew I'd like it when I didn't know I would, but thank you. But...
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢它！我不确定你是怎么知道我会喜欢的，毕竟连我自己都没想到，但谢谢你。不过...

entries.text: Y'know, it's nice having someone around that thinks I'm so strong. Compared to the Orcs I used to ride with, I was a twig.
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我很高兴有人认为我很强壮。但与我曾经骑过的兽人相比，我就像一根树枝。

entries.text: If you're stealing artefacts and sailing on a ship, you might as well call yourself a pirate.
entries.translated_text: 如果你要偷走神器并乘船出逃，还不如去当海盗。

entries.text: Oh. Well, I suppose I was close enough. I'm from High Rock, by the way. I suppose we'll be traveling together?
entries.translated_text: 哦。好吧，和我猜的差不多。顺便说一句，我来自高岩。我想我们会一起旅行吧？

entries.text: Well, I...
entries.translated_text: 呃…我……

entries.text: Woah, look at this thing! Icy ghost snake!
entries.translated_text: 哇，看看这个东西！冰冷的鬼蛇！

entries.text: BrokenScrapFX
entries.translated_text: BrokenScrapFX

entries.text: Brrrr....
entries.translated_text: 噗噜噜噜...

entries.text: Give me a hug?
entries.translated_text: 给我个拥抱好吗？

entries.text: Probably Black-Briar, though.
entries.translated_text: 不过可能是黑棘的。

entries.text: Well, my imagination had that glow-y yellow sheen of something I am remembering as better than it actually was.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我的想象力总是闪闪的发着金光，想象总是充满美好的。

entries.text: He's... just hitting it? Somehow I don't think that's how it was intended to be used with the Heart.
entries.translated_text: 他...只是敲了一下？不知何故，我不觉得这是和那神之心一起用。

entries.text: Don't worry, Meeko. Scrap's just jealous. Aren't you, Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 别担心，米科。小渣只是嫉妒。你没有吗，小渣？

entries.text: Tell Remi what Lever to Pull by casting the spell at the corresponding machine prototypes below the levers.
entries.translated_text: 通过对杠杆下方相应的机器原型施法，告诉蕾米要拉什么杠杆。

entries.text: Point taken.
entries.translated_text: 好像是这样。

entries.text: You know what? I like you. You're not afraid to get your hands dirty.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗？我喜欢你。你不怕弄脏自己的手。

entries.text: Very sweet! He's been sweet from the moment I met him, all broken down in that ruin!
entries.translated_text: 太那么可爱！从我遇见他的那一刻起，他就一直很乖，我在那片遗迹中碰到它时感到一切都有了新的意义！

entries.text: Where are you, part with the dog? You can't hide from me.
entries.translated_text: 你在哪儿，和狗有关的部分？你躲不过我的眼睛。

entries.text: The automotons here are likely impressively strong. Scrap, what do you think?
entries.translated_text: 这里的机器人可能是惊人的强大造物。小渣，你怎么看？

entries.text: The automotons here are likely impressively strong. Scrap, what do you think?
entries.translated_text: 这里的机器人可能是惊人的强大造物。小渣，你怎么看？

entries.text: Come on! We have to get through to get to that bastard, Morvic!
entries.translated_text: 来吧！我们得赶快才能找到莫维克那个混蛋！

entries.text: I know I don't say it as often as I should but, I'm really thankful to share these adventures with you.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我不会经常说，但是，我真的很感谢与你分享这些冒险经历。

entries.text: *I've*, er, acquired 384 Septims just this morning, Val. From a number of sources, mind, not from just one person. And you?
entries.translated_text: *我*，呃，今天早上刚弄到了384枚金币，瓦尔。这些钱来自很多人而不只是出自一个人，你呢？

entries.text: This was the first ruin I explored in Skyrim! I crossed the border from Hammerfell, and immediately headed here.
entries.translated_text: 这是我在天际探索的第一个遗址！我刚从落锤越过边境，就立即前往了这里。

entries.text: Getting your hands dirty, outlander?
entries.translated_text: 你也来挖矿吗？外地人。

entries.text: You know what I miss? Parties. Why doesn't Skyrim ever seem to have any parties?
entries.translated_text: 你知道我在想什么吗？派对。为什么天际似乎从未举办过任何派对？

entries.text: Well, I'm not dead, so that's a win in my book. You?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我没有死，以我来看就是胜利了。你？

entries.text: Alright...?
entries.translated_text: 还好吗...？

entries.text: Ahmed.
entries.translated_text: 艾哈迈德。

entries.text: Yuck. What are you spitting at me? Remind me to collect some after we're done.
entries.translated_text: 呀，你朝我吐了什么？一切结束后我要采集一些样本。

entries.text: Uhhhhhh...
entries.translated_text: 呃呃呃...

entries.text: He had no idea I was in there. We traveled for awhile.
entries.translated_text: 他完全不知道我在里面。我们一路走了好一阵子。

entries.text: Remiel is quite passionate about Dwemer, isn't she?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米尔对锻莫很有兴趣，不是吗？

entries.text: (Chuckle) All right, I do like surprises...
entries.translated_text: （轻笑）好吧，我喜欢惊喜......

entries.text: W-well. That's all I wanted to ask. Thank you, adventurer.
entries.translated_text: 好吧我就想问这么多谢谢你，冒险者。

entries.text: A fellow seafarer, then? Or you lived in the deserts?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你是个随行的海员？还是你曾生活在沙漠里？

entries.text: No one was enough of an idiot to lose their coin to me twice, at least not in the same week. Where'd you learn to put down drink like this anyway?
entries.translated_text: 没有人是白痴到两次把他们的钱输给我的，至少不会在同一周内。无论如何，你从哪里学会这样喝酒的？

entries.text: Another adventure. Let's make some more stories.
entries.translated_text: 又一次冒险。让我们再创造一些新的故事吧。

entries.text: But there was not time to talk about it, so he told me to run, and I mean, I did. But I made sure to still shoot at it from the distance.
entries.translated_text: 可那时候根本来不及多说什么，他让我快跑——我确实跑了。但我还是确保在远处朝那东西射了几箭。

entries.text: It's incredible how long all this had lasted. Maybe... If I can mimic how these machines are built, it might make Scrap a bit tougher.
entries.translated_text: 令人难以置信的是，这一切持续了多久。也许...如果我能模仿这些机器的制造方式，它可能会使小渣变得更坚硬。

entries.text: It's incredible how long all this had lasted. Maybe... If I can mimic how these machines are built, it might make Scrap a bit tougher.
entries.translated_text: 令人难以置信的是，这一切持续了多久。也许...如果我能模仿这些机器的制造方式，它可能会使小渣变得更坚硬。

entries.text: It's incredible how long all this had lasted. Maybe... If I can mimic how these machines are built, it might make Scrap a bit tougher.
entries.translated_text: 令人难以置信的是，这一切持续了多久。也许...如果我能模仿这些机器的制造方式，它可能会使小渣变得更坚硬。

entries.text: Well, it depends, I suppose. Are you in it for the gold, or for the protecting others thing?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我想这要看情况了。你是为了金子，还是为了保护别人？

entries.text: Khash? Khash? Alright, who was in charge of watching Khash?
entries.translated_text: 卡什？卡什？好吧，谁负责看着卡什？

entries.text: That... That means a lot, Auri. I... I'm just thinking of... Well, it's not something I like to talk about.
entries.translated_text: 那...这对我来说意味着很多，奥璃。我...我只是在想...嗯，这不是我喜欢谈论的话题。

entries.text: Hello there. That is you, right? It's dark in here.
entries.translated_text: 有人吗，那是你，对吧？真黑啊。

entries.text: Yes?
entries.translated_text: 什么?

entries.text: Yes?
entries.translated_text: 什么?

entries.text: Yes?
entries.translated_text: 什么?

entries.text: Yes?
entries.translated_text: 什么?

entries.text: Yes?
entries.translated_text: 什么?

entries.text: We just have to hold out a bit longer, Ria!
entries.translated_text: 我们只需要再坚持一会儿，利亚！

entries.text: Aw, poor Kodlak. Doesn't want to be a werewolf. Not sure if these Witch heads will be of any us, but I guess it doesn't hurt to try.
entries.translated_text: 噢，可怜的克拉科，不想成为狼人，不确定这些女巫头是否属于我们，但我想尝试一下也无妨。

entries.text: That centurion was so beautiful!
entries.translated_text: 那个百夫长太漂亮了!

entries.text: Let's go back to my earlier questions.
entries.translated_text: 让我们回到刚才的话题。

entries.text: And I am craving some Spicy Wyress Wine.
entries.translated_text: 我很想来点辛辣的途歇城酒。

entries.text: That's a part of it. Nords should rule Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 这是其中的一部分原因，天际是诺德人的天际。

entries.text: Woah, are you really that good?
entries.translated_text: 哇，你真的有那么厉害吗？

entries.text: Hello, Simba. Did- You're staring. Does that mean you need me to do something?
entries.translated_text: 你好，辛巴。难道——你在盯着看，这是否意味着你需要我做点什么？

entries.text: Okay, Farillae, back to- What were we doing? Hm.
entries.translated_text: 好了法里拉，回到——我们在做什么？嗯。

entries.text: Sometimes revolutions also hurt innocents. It's unavoidable.
entries.translated_text: 有时，革命也会伤及无辜。这是不可避免的。

entries.text: My mother is great at keeping secrets-and selling them. My father is a shrewd negotiator in the buying and selling stolen items.
entries.translated_text: 我妈妈很擅长保守秘密——然后再合适的时候出卖他们。我父亲在买卖赃物方面是个精明的谈判者。

entries.text: HEY! You're trying to break the closest thing I'll ever get to an education! Gonna tear you apart for that, s'wit!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！你想伤害我现在的老师！我会把你撕成碎片的，傻子！

entries.text: Oh whoops. I need to pay more attention to where I'm walking, sorry.
entries.translated_text: 哦，糟了。我得多注意点我走的路，抱歉。

entries.text: Talos... Ha! Trinimac would wipe his ass with that milk-drinker. No, that's all. No need to 'write' anything.
entries.translated_text: 塔洛斯...崔尼马克会会把那个胆小鬼用来擦屁股。不，仅此而已。不需要“写”任何东西。

entries.text: By the gods.
entries.translated_text: 我的神啊。

entries.text: Remi's Aetherial Lantern
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的神光水晶灯

entries.text: Remi has an idea for making lockpicking a quicker process. We traveled to the Markarth Forge, where she created her prototype tension wrench, but it didn't seem to work very well. Remi has made some adjustments to it, which has made it significantly more useful. I should keep this with me so that lockpicking is easier.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米有个想法，让开锁变得更快。我们去了马卡斯城锻造厂，她在那里制造了她的原型张力扳手，但它似乎不太好用。蕾米对它进行了一些调整，这使得它的用处明显增加了很多。我应该随身携带这个，以便更容易开锁。

entries.text: Shiny jewelry, dwemeris technology, knowledge, research, pretty houses, and even just interesting conversations with others.
entries.translated_text: 闪亮的珠宝，锻莫的技术，知识，研究，漂亮的房子，甚至只是与他人进行有趣的交谈。

entries.text: Don't be a baby, Scrap. It's not even that scary in here. Ah, what's that?! Oh... Just a pillar... Ha...
entries.translated_text: 不要做小孩子，小渣。这里甚至没有那么可怕。啊，那是什么？！哦...只是一根柱子...哈...

entries.text: Truly an honour.
entries.translated_text: 真是荣幸。

entries.text: And I've fixed up Scrap a bit, so I think he'll be very useful to us.
entries.translated_text: 而且我已经修好了小渣，所以我认为他会对我们非常有用。

entries.text: Maybe this one is haunted by the ghosts of all of the husbands and wives sent off to war!
entries.translated_text: 也许这一个充满了被派去打仗的丈夫和妻子的鬼魂！

entries.text: Magic spiders, huh.
entries.translated_text: 魔法蜘蛛，呵呵。

entries.text: Here we go.
entries.translated_text: 我们开始吧。

entries.text: Take Remi to the College of Winterhold.
entries.translated_text: 带蕾米去冬堡法师学院。

entries.text: Something tells me these Bretons underestimate us, Elf.
entries.translated_text: 直觉告诉我，这些布莱顿人在小瞧我们，精灵。

entries.text: Well, sorry to let you down, but Nchuand-Zel is just the start of my Skyrim adventure.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，很抱歉让你失望了，但楚安德-泽尔只是我天际冒险的开始。

entries.text: So... In your bardic training, they teach you... how to talk to people. Don't they, Yaz?
