entries.translated_text: 那么...在你的吟游诗人训练中，他们会教你...如何与人交谈。不是吗，雅扎？

entries.text: That's half the fun!
entries.translated_text: 这正是乐趣之一！

entries.text: Yes, really! No Khash of mine is going to go about, unable to read and write! I just need to find a proper book for you to start with!
entries.translated_text: 没错，当然是真的！我这儿的卡什可不能到处乱跑却不会读写！我得先给你找一本合适的书，让你从头开始学！

entries.text: Well, bye, Una. Bye for now, at least.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，再见，尤娜，至少现在是再见。

entries.text: Oh...
Maybe we could've avoided this.
entries.translated_text: 也许我们可以避免这种情况。

texts: Just... Try not to drop it on me. Ohhhhh, being crushed is that absolutely worst way to die!
只是，尽量别让它砸到我了，我可不想被压在石头下面。

entries.text: Well, I hate to be the one to ask for more.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我也不想要求更多了。

entries.text: Wait, no 'well'! Pretend I didn't say 'well'!
entries.translated_text: 等等，没有“well”！假装我没说过“well”！

entries.text: Uh... I'm not sure I understand what you're talking about.
entries.translated_text: 呃...我不太明白你在说什么。

entries.text: You mean to tell me that all this time, Rumarin was joking with me? Why didn't anyone tell me?
entries.translated_text: 你是说鲁马林一直在跟我开玩笑？为什么没有人告诉我？

entries.text: Rodard was not a man who frightened easily, but he was also a man who could not seem to make friends. He did not talk with many, and he lived alone.
entries.translated_text: 罗达德勇敢无惧，但也不近人情。他很少与人说话，总是独自居住。

entries.text: Sorry, I don't really like being touched unless I know you well. Nothing personal.
entries.translated_text: 对不起，除非我很了解你，否则我真的不喜欢被触摸，与是谁无关。

entries.text: So much blood...
entries.translated_text: 这么多血...

entries.text: (Nervous Laughter) Don't say a word, Scrap.
entries.translated_text: (紧张的笑声)不要开口，小渣。

entries.text: These Nordic crypts are so spooky... I love it!
entries.translated_text: 这些诺德地穴太诡异了……我喜欢它！

entries.text: It was... fun, right?
entries.translated_text: 这...很有趣，对吧？

entries.text: At least I can check 'talking to the adventurer' off my chore list for now.
entries.translated_text: 至少我现在可以把“跟冒险者说话”从我的待办清单上划掉了。

entries.text: Yes, you can come with me.
entries.translated_text: 是的，你可以和我一起走。

entries.text: Is it rude to say that Grisvar had this coming? He decided to partner with a group of people willing to sacrifice innocents for their cause.
entries.translated_text: 说这是格利斯瓦自找的会不会太无礼了？他居然决定与一群愿意为自己的事业牺牲无辜的人合作。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. Remi doesn't know who might want her dead, but she is eager to investigate. We met a sailor in the Winking Skeever who appeared out of place.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。蕾米不知道谁可能想要她死，但她急于调查。我们在眨眼恶鼠遇到了一个水手，他显得格格不入。

entries.text: After crawling through this dungeon, I think we both need one.
entries.translated_text: 闯过这个地牢后，我想我们都需要洗个澡。

entries.text: Suspiciously Large Pipe
entries.translated_text: 可疑的大管子

entries.text: I'm stronger than I look, and I tend to draw attention.
entries.translated_text: 我比我的外表看起来更强壮，而且我很容易引起别人注意。

entries.text: Remi, did you take my ring?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你拿了我的戒指吗？

entries.text: I imagine it would involve a lot of clanking. So, probably not all that different from traditional Orcish music, to be honest.
entries.translated_text: 我想它会有大量的叮当声。所以，说实话，可能和传统的兽人音乐没有什么区别。

texts: Give me that! That's mine! Ah!

entries.text: Oh, Sweet Mara, what is that?! Are you- Are you okay?! I-I'll get you out! Somehow.
entries.translated_text: 哦，亲爱的玛拉，那是什么？你没事吧？！我-我无论如何都会救你出来的！

entries.text: The dwarves were so ingenious with all their tiny gadgets.
entries.translated_text: 矮人们的所有的小玩意儿都很巧妙。

entries.text: T-thirteen?! Because you like the wilderness... Uh... Well, I guess that's fair? Um. Don't you have, uh, parents? Or something?
entries.translated_text: 十、十三岁？！因为你喜欢荒野...呃...好吧，我想，这也算合理？嗯。你、你没有父母之类的人吗？

entries.text: It's a shame we had to return the Lexicon. On the bright side, I know where to find it. Er, not that I'm going to come back for it or anything.
entries.translated_text: 很遗憾我们不得不归还方典。从好的方面来说，我知道在哪里可以找到它。呃，不是说我会来找它或者别的什么。

entries.text: I see why my benefactor needed some more experienced muscle.
entries.translated_text: 我明白为什么我的金主需要一些更有经验的打手了。

entries.text: That sounds beautiful. The closest I can think of is Falkreath Hold.
entries.translated_text: 听起来很美。我能想到的最接近的是佛克瑞斯领。

entries.text: Yes, I suppose I'll do that and see how adjusting the frequency affects him.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想我会这样做，看看调整频率对他有什么影响。

entries.text: Auri is quite the archer. I never worry about her accidentally hitting me in combat.
entries.translated_text: 奥璃是相当出色的弓箭手，我从不担心她在战斗中会不小心击中我。

entries.text: You won't be immortal for long!
entries.translated_text: 你的不朽很快就会终结！

entries.text: J'zargo, do *not* hit Scrap with lightning magic. It can't possibly be good for his circuits.
entries.translated_text: 吉'扎格，千万别用闪电魔法击中小渣，这对他的线路有危害。

entries.text: What were you like as a kid?
entries.translated_text: 你小时候是什么样的？

entries.text: It's a good thing they didn't head further north. The noble houses in Rivenspire probably would have taken it as a sign of aggression.
entries.translated_text: 幸好他们没有往更北走，不然碎裂山峰的贵族家族可能会将其视为侵略。

entries.text: (Laugh) Oh, you noticed finally!
entries.translated_text: （笑）哦，你终于注意到了！

entries.text: Then why bother with these ruins?
entries.translated_text: 那么为什么要在这些遗址上费心呢？

entries.text: Yes!
entries.translated_text: 好耶！

entries.text: Yes!
entries.translated_text: 好耶！

entries.text: Yes!
entries.translated_text: 好耶！

entries.text: Yes!
entries.translated_text: 好耶！

entries.text: Yes!
entries.translated_text: 好耶！

entries.text: You do realize that's impossible, don't you?
entries.translated_text: 你应该知道这是不可能的，不是吗？

entries.text: No! Not happening! I've already paid for their services, so I'm afraid you're stuck with me, Mr. Mercenary. Or Mr. Not Mercenary. Whichever.
entries.translated_text: 不！不可能！我已经付了钱，所以恐怕你得留在我身边，佣兵先生，或者不是佣兵先生。

entries.text: Oh thank Akatosh, you're awake. I wasn't sure if she was telling the truth about saving you or not.
entries.translated_text: 哦，感谢阿卡托什，你醒了。我不确定她说的在就你的真相是真是假。

entries.text: Hmm... Hold still and let me take a look...
entries.translated_text: 嗯...别动，让我看看...

entries.text: No, terrible.
entries.translated_text: 不，不喜欢。

entries.text: Doc, shh. I think I heard something.
entries.translated_text: 医生，嘘。我想我听到了什么。

entries.text: But I wanted to help, you know? So I snuck into the cart Marlok traveled with.
entries.translated_text: 但你知道吗，我想帮忙，所以我偷偷钻进了马洛克乘坐的那辆马车里。

entries.text: Well, it's definitely not that. I should probably adjust in the opposite way, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，绝对不是这样。我可能应该换种方式调整，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: Okay, understood.
entries.translated_text: 好的，明白了。

entries.text: Okay, understood.
entries.translated_text: 好的，明白了。

entries.text: Really?! You, too?
entries.translated_text: 真的吗？你也是？

entries.text: Oh, look what I found! Redcap, can you give this to our adventurous friend next time they speak with you?
entries.translated_text: 哦，看看我发现了什么！红帽子，下次他们和你说话时，你能把这个给我们的冒险者朋友吗？

entries.text: Oh, okay. That's... definitely okay. I'll just eat it by myself and explode. Totally fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦,好吧。那...绝对没问题。我自己吃到撑就行。完全没事。

entries.text: They're scared, and they'll spread the word.
entries.translated_text: 他们害怕了，就会到处宣扬。

entries.text: Now, Gore. You're more than intimidating enough without threatening the poor fool.
entries.translated_text: 格雷。 你即使不威胁别人就够吓人的了。

entries.text: I love a good hunt!
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢打猎！

entries.text: Okay, but you should probably stop before the part with the dog. People haven't liked that part before.
entries.translated_text: 好吧,但你可能应该在涉及那条狗的部分之前停下来。人们以前对那部分并不喜欢。

entries.text: Are you ready to head out?
entries.translated_text: 你准备好出发了吗？

entries.text: Stay away from my cheese wheel, you rat!
entries.translated_text: 远离我的奶酪，你这个老鼠！

entries.text: Check in with Remi.
entries.translated_text: 与蕾米对话。

entries.text: How about you? I think I overheard something about High Rock, but you know what they say about assumptions.
entries.translated_text: 你呢?我想我无意中听到了些有关高岩的事，但你知道那都是些流言。

entries.text: Congratulations, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 恭喜，我想。

entries.text: Skyrim was on that list, but... consider it "checked off". Seen on Nordic ruin, seen 'em all.
entries.translated_text: 天际曾在这份清单上，但...它已经被排除了。就这些诺德遗址，我已经看过了。

entries.text: But... The Dwemer ruins there! Beautiful and plentiful! I spent quite a while there, before I even began truly traveling.
entries.translated_text: 但是...那里有锻莫的遗迹又美又多，我还没开始真正的旅行时，就在那里待了很久。

entries.text: You worry too much.
entries.translated_text: 你担心得太多了。

entries.text: Incredible! Are you sure? How did he manage? He must be quite the mage!
entries.translated_text: 难以致信！你确定吗？他是怎么做到的？他一定是个法师！

entries.text: Oh! Okay, that's... That's fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦！好吧，那...没关系。

entries.text: Yes! Come on, at least try it!
entries.translated_text: 是的！来吧，至少尝试一下！

entries.text: They're a perfect place to get trapped, and an even better place to be rescued.
entries.translated_text: 它们很适合用来被困，也更适合用来获救。

entries.text: Get information from the smuggler.
entries.translated_text: 从走私者那里获取信息。

entries.text: I can help you find out what that is.
entries.translated_text: 我可以帮你找出那是什么。

entries.text: Yes, we've returned, safe and sound! What have you been up to?
entries.translated_text: 是的，我们回来了，安然无恙！你最近都在做什么？

entries.text: Is it me, or do Dwarves have something against vowels?
entries.translated_text: 是我多心了吗？还是说矮人真的对元音有什么意见？

entries.text: Send your horse away. We're walking.
entries.translated_text: 把你的马送走。当时在走。

entries.text: Part of me wants Khash to stay safe at home, but then I remember how I was as a teen... Yeah, I wouldn't have stayed home either.
entries.translated_text: 我有一部分希望卡什能待在家里安全点，但后来我又想起自己十几岁的时候...是啊，我那时候也不会乖乖待在家里的。

entries.text: Maybe you can look out for me when you're around other stormcloaks?
entries.translated_text: 当你在其他风暴斗篷附近时，也许你可以留意下我？

entries.text: I'm here, Ria. If not in mind, at least in body. But I'll try to keep my mind here for you, too.
entries.translated_text: 我在这里，利亚。即使不是心灵，至少也有身体 但我也会试着把我的心留在你身边。

entries.text: Well, you see, I was imagining having a grand meal, seated at a long table with friends and family knocking back warm drinks.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你看，我在想象着吃一顿大餐，坐在一张长桌前，和朋友及家人一起喝着热饮。

texts: It has a rounded bottom? It actually looks a bit like a children's spinning toy. Or maybe a bowl?
它有一个圆底？它看起来有点像儿童旋转木马。或者是一个碗？

entries.text: Yes. You know, there is a story about Y'ffre that my mother told me when I was very young. When we're somewhere safe, perhaps I could tell it to you.
entries.translated_text: 是的。要知道，在我很小的时候，我妈妈就给我讲过一个关于伊’弗尔的故事。等我们到了安全的地方，也许我可以告诉你。

entries.text: Can't you give me the abridged version?
entries.translated_text: 你不能给我说得简洁点吗？

entries.text: You're one of the smartest people I know.
entries.translated_text: 你是我认识的最聪明的人之一。

entries.text: BIGPIG! Come. Here! Stop. Being. Scared-pig!
entries.translated_text: 大猪！来，这！不要。担心受怕！

entries.text: We make a good team, Doctor!
entries.translated_text: 我们是一支优秀的团队，医生！

entries.text: Dwarven Spider
entries.translated_text: 矮人蜘蛛

entries.text: Dwarven Spider
entries.translated_text: 矮人蜘蛛

entries.text: Was that all, Ganbald?
entries.translated_text: 就这些吗，甘巴尔德？

entries.text: I can't say I've ever read anything about that, so maybe? Although, I'm interested to learn about it.
entries.translated_text: 我倒是没读过这方面的东西，所以也许吧？不过，我倒是很想了解一下。

entries.text: Is Yaz right? Does all of Markarth really smell of rotten meat? I thought it was just Lisbet. Wait, does that mean I smell like rotten meat?
entries.translated_text: 雅扎是对的吗？整个马卡斯城真的有腐肉的味道吗？我以为只有利斯拜特。等等，这是否意味着我闻起来像块腐肉？

entries.text: I don't mean to be rude, but you hardly seem qualified to be an investigator. I mean, your questioning of these witnesses was hardly very...thorough.
entries.translated_text: 我无意冒犯，但你似乎没有资格成为一名调查者，我的意思是，你对这些证人的质询比较...彻底。

entries.text: We work well together, don't we, Ria?
entries.translated_text: 我们合作得很好，不是吗，利亚？

entries.text: Here, watch, give me that a moment.
entries.translated_text: 看，给我一点时间。

entries.text: So now you are a Nightingale in power as well as name. Hopefully this power can help save the guild.
entries.translated_text: 所以现在你是有权有名的夜莺了，希望这个力量可以帮助拯救公会。

entries.text: Good choice! Excellent choice would have been the dwemer books, but I'll let it slide. Do you know all the sounds the symbols make?
entries.translated_text: 不错的选择！最好的选择应该是锻莫的书，但我尊重你的选择。你知道这些符号读什么吗？

entries.text: Finally! A dwemer ruin!
entries.translated_text: 终于！一片锻莫遗迹！

entries.text: Usually, I'm uncomfortable underground as well, but being in dwemer ruins is almost comforting to me now.
entries.translated_text: 平时在地下待着也很不舒服，不过现在在矮人遗迹里，也算是一种安慰了。

entries.text: And...
entries.translated_text: 然后...

entries.text: And...
entries.translated_text: 然后...

entries.text: He's still good!
entries.translated_text: 他依然很棒！

entries.text: Illness.
entries.translated_text: 疾病。

entries.text: Depends on whose side you're on. Wait, so we're considered heroes if we kill bandits, then? Should we be killing more?
entries.translated_text: 这取决于你站在哪一边。等等，所以如果我们杀了强盗，我们就被认为是英雄了？我们应该杀更多人吗？

entries.text: Yes, whatever you need.
entries.translated_text: 是的，无论你需要什么。

entries.text: Don't die, Joshua! I'd be very upset with you!
entries.translated_text: 别死，约书亚！我会非常伤心的！

entries.text: You get to keep Azura's Star. Surely she wouldn't mind me just... studying it? Right?
entries.translated_text: 你可以留着阿祖拉之星。她肯定不会介意我只是...研究它？对吗？

entries.text: I think Scrap should fight with us again.
entries.translated_text: 我认为小渣应该再次与我们战斗。

entries.text: O-oh! Uh! Well, thank you! That's so nice, actually. Um... Where did you come from, exactly...?
entries.translated_text: 哦哦！呃！嗯，谢谢！真是太好了，真的。嗯...你到底是从哪里来的...?

entries.text: Ha! Don't I know it.
entries.translated_text: 哈！我不知道吗。

entries.text: I'm sure he'd figure I'd go there. We can look there for clues!
entries.translated_text: 我相信他会认为我会去那里。我们可以在那里寻找线索！

entries.text: What should I buy first?! Food? Metal? Jewelry? A house?! Is this enough for a house? How much can a house in Skyrim cost. It's not Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 我应该先买什么？食物？金属？珠宝？房子？这些够买房子吗？在天际买一栋房子要多少钱？这又不是途歇城。

entries.text: W-well, that's over with, at least.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，至少已经结束了。

entries.text: Some pretty flowers. I picked them all by myself!
entries.translated_text: 一些美丽的花朵。我自己摘的！

entries.text: No wonder these people needed new books. Look at all the books in here! What'd they do, set fire to the place?
entries.translated_text: 难怪这些人需要新书。看看这些书！他们做了什么，放火烧了这个地方？

entries.text: Yaz! Yaz, do you have a quill prepared?! Are you ready to transcribe my observations of this ruin into prose?!
entries.translated_text: 雅扎！雅扎，你准备好羽毛笔了吗？你准备好把我对这片遗址的观察编写成诗文了吗？

entries.text: Oooh, shiny. J'zargo, do you want a new necklace?
entries.translated_text: 哦，闪闪亮亮的。吉'扎格，你想要一条新项链吗？

entries.text: Oh, Sweet Mara, what is that?! What sort of trap is that?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，亲爱的玛拉，那是什么？那是什么陷阱？

entries.text: I've acquired the dwarven metal, as well as the water that will be heated into steam.
entries.translated_text: 我已经有矮人金属了，以及将被加热成蒸汽的水。

entries.text: What are you gawking at, outlander?
entries.translated_text: 你在看什么东西，外地人？

entries.text: W-what?! You-you were *there*?! Why? How?
entries.translated_text: 什么？你在那儿？为什么？怎么会？

entries.text: No to mention the vampiric powers. I imagine they come from Molag Bal? Or does it come just from drinking blood? What is it like?
entries.translated_text: 还有那些吸血鬼的力量。我猜它们来自莫拉格·巴尔？还是仅仅通过饮血获得的？那是什么感觉？

entries.text: Obscured Passage
entries.translated_text: 暗处通道

entries.text: It was compelling to me, to see how someone could be so intelligent but in a way so entirely different from myself.
entries.translated_text: 这对我来说很有吸引力，看到有人可以如此聪明，和自己又完全不同。

entries.text: It's really not! You're just overthinking it.
entries.translated_text: 真的没有，你只是想太多了。

entries.text: Believe me, no one's as surprised as I am that I've lived this long.
entries.translated_text: 相信我，没有人像我一样对我活了这么久感到惊讶。

entries.text: Hold on. You're just gonna go along with this?
entries.translated_text: 等一下你就打算这样过去？

entries.text: So good to turn off the mind every once and awhile.
entries.translated_text: 偶尔让大脑停下来，真是太舒服了。

entries.text: This is excellent news! I can't believe it worked!
entries.translated_text: 这是个好消息！我不敢相信它奏效了！

entries.text: Oh, fantastic! And?
entries.translated_text: 哦，太棒了！有什么吗？

entries.text: Sounds like a plan.
entries.translated_text: 听起来是个好计划。

entries.text: Read the note.
entries.translated_text: 读字条。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. Remiel is worried about the safety of her parents, and suggested we head to Riften to search for merchants who may be familiar with her family.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，他对蕾米尔对自己家族名声的影响而心怀怨恨。蕾米尔担心她父母的安全，并建议我们前往裂谷寻找可能与她家人熟悉的商人。

entries.text: I've heard of how different Morrowind is from High Rock, but this is truly an alien land. I love it!
entries.translated_text: 我听说晨风与高岩有多么不同，但这真是一片异世界，我喜欢它！

entries.text: I bet there's a way to get the power running again. It'll likely be some sort of heat source that helps produce steam.
entries.translated_text: 我敢打赌有办法让动力源重新启动，它可能是某种用于制造蒸汽动力的热力源。

entries.text: Wow, it's amazing how petty Leigelf's reason for murder is. I thought people who hired the Dark Brotherhood would have more... interesting motives.
entries.translated_text: 哇，令人惊讶的是，雷盖尔夫的理由是多么可笑。我认为雇佣黑暗兄弟会的人会有更多...有趣的动机。

entries.text: The White-Gold Concordat saved Skyrim. The Nords just can't accept it.
entries.translated_text: 白金协定拯救了天际，诺德人只是无法接受。

entries.text: Thank you, Zora.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你，佐拉。

entries.text: (Whisper) Shush, Scrap! You're so noisy!
entries.translated_text: （低语）嘘，小渣！你太吵了！

entries.text: You know, Remi might be the most brilliant person I've ever met. I think she could figure out anything she puts her mind to.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗，雷米可能是我见过的最聪明的人。我觉得她只要下定决心，就能搞定任何事情。

entries.text: I hope you're not planning on saying anything rude this time.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你这次不打算说任何粗鲁的话。

entries.text: Markarth is one of the prettier cities in all of Skyrim.
entries.translated_text: 马卡斯是整个天际最漂亮的城市之一。

entries.text: Yes! Oh, that'd be so fun! It makes me almost nostalgic. But... Maybe we'd have to avoid Sentinel. I don't know that you'd enjoy it.
entries.translated_text: 是啊！那一定会很有趣！光是想想就有点让人怀念了。不过...也许我们得避开哨兵城。我不太确定你会喜欢那地方。

entries.text: Ganbald, are you okay? Alive and well? At least alive?
entries.translated_text: 甘巴尔德，你还好吗？还活着吗？至少还活着？

entries.text: Forsworn hate Nords, right? Nords sure do know how to make friends...
entries.translated_text: 弃誓者讨厌诺德人，对吧？诺德确实知道如何交朋友...

entries.text: I think that's more complicated than you realize. I'm gonna need to practice that.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得这比你想象的要复杂得多，我需要练习一下。

entries.text: My stomach...
entries.translated_text: 我的胃...

entries.text: Sorry, but we're not makin' any deals this time!
entries.translated_text: 对不起，这次我们不会做任何交易了!

entries.text: I've decided to help you get the Skooma.
entries.translated_text: 我决定帮你弄到斯库玛。

entries.text: Anyway, it's at least up there! Here, Scrap, meet your new best friend!
entries.translated_text: 不管怎样，至少它在上面了！来，小渣，认识你的新朋友！

entries.text: Fine. I'll find my own way in. Surely that old man has to sleep eventually, and when he does... There'll be no one to stop me.
entries.translated_text: 好吧,我会自己想办法进去的,那老头子肯定要睡着了，而当他睡着的时候...没有人能阻止我。

entries.text: Let me check... Yes!
entries.translated_text: 让我检查一下...是的！

entries.text: Okay, Gourmet, let's go!
entries.translated_text: 好的，美食家，我们走吧！

entries.text: I'll keep that in mind.
entries.translated_text: 我会记在心上的。

entries.text: What's on your mind, my friend?
entries.translated_text: 你在想什么，我的朋友？

entries.text: Did you just *gush* to me?! I've never heard you so excited before?! This is incredible! That's such a great story!
entries.translated_text: 你刚刚是在对我“滔滔不绝”吗？我从没听过你这么兴奋过？！这太棒了！那真是个好故事！

entries.text: Ilia.
entries.translated_text: 伊利亚。

entries.text: Aela, what does it feel like to transform?
entries.translated_text: 艾拉，变身是什么感觉？

entries.text: Oh. This Narfi fellow seems to be... quite different. You know, I'm rather experienced in being quite different, so I think I'd like to help him.
entries.translated_text: 哦。这个叫纳菲的家伙似乎...很不一样，你知道，我在特立独行的方面颇有经验，所以我想帮助他。

entries.text: What about you? What is your family like?
entries.translated_text: 那你呢？你有什么样的家庭？

entries.text: I've actually already taken care of that spider.
entries.translated_text: 我实际上已经解决了那只蜘蛛了。

entries.text: All the forests are quite pretty.
entries.translated_text: 所有的森林都非常漂亮。

entries.text: Well, whatever name you want it to have, I think it is going to make us a lot of gold. Maybe you'd be interested in joining in?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，不管你想给它起什么名字，我想它对我们来说都会钱景无量。也许你有兴趣加入？

entries.text: (Whisper) And take this! Sell this piece of junk to them. The shopkeeps never know the difference.
entries.translated_text: （低语）拿着这个！把这个破烂卖给那些店主们，他们永远不会知道其中的差别。

entries.text: Nar, do you think the amount of blood that left my body is acceptable? Nar? Nar?
entries.translated_text: 纳尔，你觉得我的血量可以还接受吗？纳尔？纳尔？

entries.text: Hey, did you eat all my sweet rolls?
entries.translated_text: 嘿，你把我的甜卷都吃光了？

entries.text: Well, that's certainly ominous.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，听起来不是好事。

entries.text: I wouldn't have been able to use it at all!
entries.translated_text: 我根本无法使用它！

entries.text: Add three of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将种材料添加三份进釜中？

entries.text: Markarth Ruins
entries.translated_text: 马卡斯城遗址

entries.text: Wow, did you read my mind?
entries.translated_text: 哇，你读懂了我的想法吗？

entries.text: I don't know how I could've changed anything, though. Not that that will stop me from wondering.
entries.translated_text: 不过，我不知道自己本可以怎么改变这一切，尽管如此，这并不会阻止我去思考。

entries.text: Oh, I like your necklace, by the way.
entries.translated_text: 哦，顺便说一句，我喜欢你的项链。

entries.text: It's over now.
entries.translated_text: 现在结束了。

entries.text: Yes, not to mention the Bard's College nearby. Maybe we'll actually get some song variety here!
entries.translated_text: 是的，更不用说附近的吟游诗人学院了。也许我们真的会在这里得到一些歌曲！

entries.text: Skooma is a dangerous substance.
entries.translated_text: 斯库玛是一种危险的物质。

entries.text: Oh! Yes, thank you for reminding me. We had plenty of buyers. Let's hope they don't commit any obvious crimes with what they bought.
entries.translated_text: 哦！是的，感谢你提醒我。我们有不少买家。希望他们不会拿买到的东西做什么明显的罪行。

entries.text: In the cities, they are looked down upon as wild and uncivilized. I secretly wanted to join a Druidic Coven as a child.
entries.translated_text: 在城市里，他们被看成是野蛮的象征。我从小就偷偷地想加入德鲁伊教团。

entries.text: All that work just for this?
entries.translated_text: 做这些只是为了这个？

entries.text: Frostbane? Your family name makes you sound like Magnus. You rise to the sky and melt away all the frost.
entries.translated_text: 冰霜克星？你的族名让你听起来像玛格努斯，升上天空，融化所有的霜冻。

entries.text: I can't believe this! I was afraid to bring it up, with you being a bard and whatnot, but I've always found the music selection in Skyrim atrocious!
entries.translated_text: 我真不敢相信！我很怕提起这件事，因为你是个吟游诗人，但我一直觉得天际的音乐偏好真很糟糕！

entries.text: Remi's Aetherial Lantern.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的神光水晶灯.

entries.text: I'm curious Yazakh... Do you have any family back in Cyrodiil?
entries.translated_text: 我很好奇，雅扎克...你在赛瑞迪尔有家人吗？

entries.text: Yes, well. That puts my idea at a stand-still. It's really not something that is intuitive to anyone other than the dwemer.
entries.translated_text: 是的，嗯。这让我也不知道该怎么办，我只对锻莫有些认知。

entries.text: Oh, don't worry. I'm more excited than anything else. I wonder if we'll see any animunculi other than spiders and spheres?
entries.translated_text: 哦，别担心。我比谁都兴奋。不知道除了蜘蛛和球，我们还会看到其他蒸汽机械吗？

entries.text: I don't mean to sound inconsiderate. I promise I'll read it!
entries.translated_text: 我无意显得不体贴，我保证会认真看的！

entries.text: Scrap keeps poking me in the back of the head.
entries.translated_text: 小渣不断地戳我的后脑勺。

entries.text: Add two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份进釜中？

entries.text: Add two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份进釜中？

entries.text: Add two of what ingredient into the cauldron?
entries.translated_text: 将哪材料添加两份进釜中？

entries.text: I'm fine, Remi, but they had me kill someone for them.
entries.translated_text: 我很好，蕾米，但他们让我为他们杀人。

entries.text: Remi, you know I might actually have to take you up on those books about the Dwemer... Did you know about this?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，你知道我可能真的要带你去读那些关于锻莫的书……你知道吗？

entries.text: Traps or no, another camp chock full of bandits means more bounties for us.
entries.translated_text: 无论是否有陷阱，一个满是强盗的营地意味着我们能有更多的赏金。

entries.text: I am a bit uneasy with the implication that she is... undead? But. Well. I guess you're not the one who made her that way.
entries.translated_text: 我有点不安，感觉她是不是...亡灵？不过，嗯，我猜你不是让她变成那样的人。

entries.text: Yes, if I move this here... And replace this...
entries.translated_text: 是的，如果我把它移到这里...并替换它...

entries.text: (Whisper) Done!
entries.translated_text: （低语）完成！

entries.text: Oh no, oh no! Nar! Nar! Something is trying to kill us!
entries.translated_text: 哦不，哦不！纳尔！纳尔！有什么东西想杀死我们！

entries.text: Well, that's a very good question. I'd like to give a deep, thoughtful answer that doesn't just sound like incoherent philosophical babbling...
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这是个很好的问题。我想给你一个深刻的、深思熟虑的答案，而不只是听起来像语无伦次的哲学胡扯...

entries.text: I do! In my bag!
entries.translated_text: 是我！是我包里的！

entries.text: Oh, that can't be good for his stomach, can it? Well, it certainly sounds like a bad thing to do.
entries.translated_text: 哦，这对他的胃不太好，是吗？好吧，这听起来确实是件坏事。

entries.text: Victory!
entries.translated_text: 大胜利!

entries.text: (Sigh)
entries.translated_text: （叹气）

entries.text: (Sigh)
entries.translated_text: （叹气）

entries.text: Now this is a city! Do you smell that ocean water? That baking bread? The sewer water below our feet? Like being back home.
entries.translated_text: 这才是城市！你闻到海水的味道了吗？烤面包的味道？脚下的下水道水？就像回到了家乡。

entries.text: Oh! Yeah, that was a dumb question, wasn't it? I recognized you, too. Even with all the fur and teeth and claws.
entries.translated_text: 哦！是的，这是一个蠢问题，不是吗？我也认出了你，即使有那样的毛发、牙齿和爪子。

entries.text: It's different from... but... it also doesn't feel different. I-I feel a bit sick.
entries.translated_text: 这与...不一样，但...感觉也没什么不同。我觉得有点不舒服。

entries.text: If I were the Jarl of Whiterun, I'd be very easy to convince to imprison a dragon in my keep. I imagine the real Jarl won't be quite so enthusiastic.
entries.translated_text: 如果我是白漫城的领主，我会很容易说服自己将一条龙囚禁在我的地牢中。我想真正的领主就不会那么热情。

entries.text: Er, I mean- I'm glad that you were able to visit. I do quite like High Rock. Did you like it there?
entries.translated_text: 呃，我是说--我很高兴你能来参观。我很喜欢高岩省，你喜欢那里吗？

entries.text: We could... create a situation.
entries.translated_text: 我们可以......创造一个局面。

entries.text: Oh, because you could make something better?
entries.translated_text: 哦，难道你可以做得更好？

entries.text: If I go ahead and spit in Ulfric's face, do you think we can run fast enough to get away?
entries.translated_text: 如果我继续说乌弗瑞克的坏话，你觉得我们能轻易脱身吗？

entries.text: Serana?
entries.translated_text: 瑟拉娜？

entries.text: Um, Farillae, I think we're being attacked!
entries.translated_text: 嗯，法里拉，我想我们被袭击了！

entries.text: Why, do you think I'm handy with something else?
entries.translated_text: 为什么，你认为我还对别的事情很拿手吗？

entries.text: Do you see the wrinkle in the line of his clothes there on the left?
entries.translated_text: 你看到左边他衣服上的褶皱了吗？

entries.text: So, I'll just be going on in...
entries.translated_text: 所以，我会继续...

entries.text: Ah, a wanderer, yes?
entries.translated_text: 啊，一个流浪者，是吗？

entries.text: Remi, I have questions about what's going on with the assassin.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我对刺客的情况有疑问。

entries.text: Ooh, I just remembered when I broke my family's tea set. It'd been in the family for six generations. Ugh, why did I have to remember that?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我只记得我打破了家人的茶具。它已经在这个家族中流传了六代。呃，我为什么要记起这个？

entries.text: Beauty fades, or is ripped away. My beauty was all that I had. If the accident never happened...
entries.translated_text: 漂亮会褪色，或被夺走。我的美貌曾是我的全部，如果那些事没有发生过。。。

entries.text: But it all passed us over. I mostly remember complaining that I was bored and wanted to go out to play.
entries.translated_text: 但这一切都过去了。我主要记得当我很无聊，抱怨着想出去玩。

entries.text: But it all passed us over. I mostly remember complaining that I was bored and wanted to go out to play.
entries.translated_text: 但这一切都过去了。我主要记得当我很无聊，抱怨着想出去玩。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. After talking to Calcelmo, I made a deal to kill Nimhe, a giant spider, in the excavation site in exchange for access to Nchuand-zel.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。与卡塞莫交谈后，我做了一笔交易，在挖掘现场杀死巨蜘蛛尼姆赫，以换取楚安德-泽尔的访问权。

entries.text: Stooping to his level won't solve anything.
entries.translated_text: 堕落到和他一样的层次并不能解决任何问题。

entries.text: They'd need to be capable of channeling extreme power within a small space. I think even dwarven metal would be insufficient.
entries.translated_text: 在一个狭小的空间里引导强大的力量，即使是矮人金属的强度也不够。

entries.text: Left to right, actually! That seems to be consistent across locations, all the way from Rkundaleft to Bamz-Amschend.
entries.translated_text: 实际上是从左到右！从瑞因达莱夫特到巴姆-阿姆钱德，这在各地似乎都是一致的。

entries.text: Well, in that case, I think you should take the lead. No, I insist.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，在这种情况下，我认为应该你带头。不，就这样。

entries.text: Well, save for-
entries.translated_text: 嗯，除了-

entries.text: I'll make it up to you, I promise.
entries.translated_text: 我会补偿你的，我保证。

entries.text: But I respect you, and I think you know what you're doing. And you're of course free to live and believe however you please, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 但我尊重你，而且我认为你知道自己在做什么。当然，无论如何，你可以自由地生活和相信你喜欢的方式。

entries.text: What is with these mages making deals with Enthir? Clearly it never works out for them.
entries.translated_text: 这些法师和恩希尔做交易是为了什么？显然，这对他们来说永远不会奏效。

entries.text: Alright, let's talk.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我们谈谈。

entries.text: I was around ten when it happened.
entries.translated_text: 事情发生时我大约十岁。

entries.text: I was around ten when it happened.
entries.translated_text: 事情发生时我大约十岁。

entries.text: Is everyone still alive?
entries.translated_text: 大家都还活着吗？

entries.text: Y-your stomach?!
entries.translated_text: 你的胃？！

entries.text: Be careful; looks like this place is infested with Frostbite Spiders.
entries.translated_text: 当心！看起来这个地方到处都是霜噬蜘蛛。

entries.text: Yes, this place is dark... and kind of smelly.
entries.translated_text: 是的，这个地方很黑…并且有点臭。

entries.text: That's unfortunate. (Sigh)
entries.translated_text: 真不幸。(叹气)

entries.text: Hi, Rennic. Oh, Scrap also says 'hi.'
entries.translated_text: 嗨，雷内克。哦，小渣也说'嗨'。

entries.text: What?! What do you mean?
entries.translated_text: 什么？什么意思？

entries.text: Call Remi
entries.translated_text: 召唤蕾米

entries.text: Call Remi
entries.translated_text: 召唤蕾米

entries.text: Murder, necromancy, torture... that I can abide, but Talos worship? Kill the lawbreakers! Sorry, Thalmor joke.
entries.translated_text: 谋杀，死灵法术，酷刑...我都可以忍受，但信仰塔洛斯？处死这些违法者！——抱歉，开个梭默玩笑。

entries.text: Oh! I have an idea! If he's able to figure out where in Skyrim I've gone, I have a good idea of another place he might have gone!
entries.translated_text: 哦！我有个主意！如果他能够弄清楚我去了天际的哪些地方，那我很清楚他可能去过的另一个地方！

entries.text: No, I... I think I should.
entries.translated_text: 不，我……我想我应该。

entries.text: I'm not sure about this...
entries.translated_text: 我不确定这个...

entries.text: Take this! Oh, Buffy will be proud of that hit!
entries.translated_text: 尝尝这个！哦，巴非会为这一击自豪的！

entries.text: So picky and yet so passionate. As for me, I'll just have that apple I packed a few days ago.
entries.translated_text: 你如此挑剔，却又如此热情。至于我，我只吃几天前打包的那个苹果。

entries.text: What is this thing? Why did you have Redcap give it to me?
entries.translated_text: 这是什么？你为什么让这红帽子给我？

entries.text: I told you before my father is a merchant.
entries.translated_text: 我告诉过你我父亲以前是个商人。

entries.text: Just don't get in my way.
entries.translated_text: 别给我碍事就行！

entries.text: So he wasn't even a ghost?! This is awful news. Well, sort of. I mean, he seems to have developed some ghost potion, which I'd love to have.
entries.translated_text: 所以他甚至不是一个鬼魂？这真是个可怕的消息。嗯，算是吧。我的意思是，他似乎已经制造了一些鬼魂药水，我很想要。

entries.text: And yet, no one was able to catch the killer in the act?
entries.translated_text: 然而，没有人能够抓到凶手的现行？

entries.text: Oh, sure.
entries.translated_text: 行，可以。

entries.text: Let me just slot this in here...
entries.translated_text: 让我把这个插在这里...

entries.text: *Plotting*? Don't make it sound so nefarious. We're... collaborating.
entries.translated_text: *密谋*？别把它说得那么邪恶。我们是...合作。

entries.text: Yes, I am from Wayrest! I've never been to Cyrodiil. I've always imagined it's just inhabited by Imperial soldiers. What is it like there?
entries.translated_text: 是的，我是途歇城人!我从来没有去过赛瑞迪尔。我一直以为那里只住着帝国士兵。那里是什么样子的？

entries.text: I have some questions for you, Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我有一些问题要问你，蕾米。

entries.text: Teldryn, I bought you something. The alchemist said it would heal up aches from old wounds.
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因，我给你买了点东西。炼金术士说它可以治愈旧伤的疼痛。

entries.text: Eh.... Not that I would. Not now that I know you'd definitely not enjoy that as much as I would.
entries.translated_text: 呃...我不会啦，不是现在，我知道你肯定不会像我一样喜欢它。

entries.text: Of course he does! I created him, to an extent. And I talk to him so much because he's just so good!
entries.translated_text: 当然啦！某种程度上说，是我创造了他。而且我那么常跟他说话，是因为他实在太棒了！

entries.text: I'll admit, I forgot where we were going next. I'll just stick close to you, Ria.
entries.translated_text: 我承认，我忘了我们下一步要去哪里，我就跟你在一起，利亚。

entries.text: Don't worry, your death won't be in vain! Your corpse will be used to further science!
entries.translated_text: 别担心，你不会白死的！你死后还能继续为科学做贡献！

entries.text: I cannot fathom what about it seems bad. It doesn't seem much different than eating roasted boar's head.
entries.translated_text: 我无法理解这有什么不好的。这似乎与吃烤野猪头没有什么区别。

entries.text: Oh, nice attack! Scrap, take notes!
entries.translated_text: 哦，漂亮的攻击！小渣，记下来！

entries.text: Who's a good boy? You are. Yes you are.
entries.translated_text: 谁是好孩子？你是。是的，你是。

entries.text: I just... I don't know what to think. What to feel.
entries.translated_text: 我只是...我不知道在想什么，你感觉如何。

entries.text: I just... I don't know what to think. What to feel.
entries.translated_text: 我只是...我不知道在想什么，你感觉如何。

entries.text: The Temple of Mara makes me uncomfortable, to tell you the truth. Reminds me too much of my arranged marriage.
entries.translated_text: 说实话，玛拉神殿让我感到不自在。让我想起了我的那场包办婚姻。

entries.text: So your obsessions have always gotten you into trouble.
entries.translated_text: 所以你的投入总是让你陷入困境。

entries.text: Hey, N'wah, you like picking on scholars?! I eat bullies. Alive.
entries.translated_text: 嘿，奴隶，你喜欢转挑学者吗？！我专吃恶霸。还得是活的。

entries.text: What's our plan, now?
entries.translated_text: 我们现在有什么计划？

entries.text: Well, it's just a cave, so most likely trouble.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这只是一个洞穴，所以很可能会有麻烦。

entries.text: Perhaps. Although I can't complain about the current situation. So far it's been working pretty well.
entries.translated_text: 也许吧。虽然我想抱怨目前的状况。到目前为止，情况还不错。

entries.text: Dwarves have always confused me with that. Why place seats right next to your security system? To watch?
entries.translated_text: 矮人总是让我糊涂。为什么把座位放在安全系统旁边？只是坐在那儿看着？

entries.text: Dunmer that despise Thalmor and fight fiercely with the elements a Nord rarely masters,
entries.translated_text: 鄙视梭默的丹莫们会使用诺德人难以掌握的元素们战斗与梭默战斗，

entries.text: He's in Skyrim trying to hunt me down!
entries.translated_text: 他追杀我一直追到了天际！

entries.text: Hm... chewy? Well, if they taste good, I suppose it's worth it being uncomfortable to eat. Tell me more! Tell me about all your fancy meals!
entries.translated_text: 嗯......有嚼头？好吧，如果它们味道不错，我想吃起来不舒服也是值得的，告诉我更多事情，跟我说说你的美味佳肴。

entries.text: Agh!
entries.translated_text: 啊！

entries.text: Agh!
entries.translated_text: 啊！

entries.text: Agh!
entries.translated_text: 啊！

entries.text: You needn't try to convince that fellow to hand over the key. I can easily get us into Weylin's room.
entries.translated_text: 你不用取说服那个家伙交出钥匙。我很容易就能打开韦林的房间。

entries.text: The city defenses are down!
entries.translated_text: 城市防御顶不住了！

entries.text: Don't worry. I don't judge.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心。我不会说闲话的。

entries.text: Don't worry. I don't judge.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心。我不会说闲话的。

entries.text: What's wrong? Are Doc and I more than you can handle?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？是对付不了我和医生吗？

entries.text: Calcelmo? What about him?
entries.translated_text: 卡塞莫？他怎么了？

entries.text: Really?! Well, of course you do! He's the best, the greatest! You won't regret this decision, I'm sure.
entries.translated_text: 真的？当然了！他是最棒的，最棒的！我相信你不会后悔这个决定。

entries.text: When we get into port, everyone looks forward to a soft bed, fresh company, and good food. That's what all the gold is for!
entries.translated_text: 当我们进港时，大家都盼着能睡个好觉、找个新欢、再好好吃一顿。

entries.text: ...What makes you say that...?
entries.translated_text: ...为什么...你要这么说？

entries.text: R-rings? As in, right off the fingers? Amaz- Ah, that- That's a lucky morning.
entries.translated_text: 戒指？从手指上摘下来的？真是个幸运的早晨。

entries.text: The-the Dark Brotherhood?! Dibella's tits, are you okay?! Well, you're alive at least. Unless you're actually an undead abomination?!
entries.translated_text: ——黑暗兄弟会？该死，你还好吗？！好吧，至少你还活着，除非你其实是个不死的怪物？！

entries.text: Investigate the assassin's corpse.
entries.translated_text: 调查刺客的尸体。

entries.text: Raven, if you could kill them now, I'd really appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，如果你现在能杀了他们，我真的很感激！

entries.text: When you eat a stomach, is it like having extra food to eat? First the stomach itself, then whatever is in the stomach?
entries.translated_text: 当你吃一个胃的时候，是不是就像有额外的食物可以吃？首先是胃本身，然后是胃里的其他东西？

entries.text: Bandit lairs are so conspicuous, aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 强盗营地很显眼，不是吗？

entries.text: I know I rub a lot of people the wrong way. Maybe they think I'm empty headed instead of... what it is that's going on up there.
entries.translated_text: 我知道我让很多人不满意。也许他们认为我头脑空空，而不是...有思想的人。

entries.text: I've progressed throughout Arkngchal in its entirety.
entries.translated_text: 我已经探索了整个阿卡切尔。

entries.text: I've progressed throughout Arkngchal in its entirety.
entries.translated_text: 我已经探索了整个阿卡切尔。

texts: 这事没那么简单。家里的事总是一言难尽，你说对不对？
这事没那么简单。家里的事总是一言难尽，你说对不对？

entries.text: Watch Remi.
entries.translated_text: 看蕾米。

entries.text: Watch Remi.
entries.translated_text: 看蕾米。

entries.text: If my father were like Erik's, I'd have simply run away to do what I wanted. It makes me remember how grateful I am to have my own father.
entries.translated_text: 如果我的父亲像艾瑞克的父亲那样，我就会直接跑掉，做我想做的事，他的遭遇让我更加感谢我的父亲。

entries.text: Maybe I'll take you there again one day?
entries.translated_text: 也许有一天我会再带你去那里？

entries.text: Aaaand... There you go!
entries.translated_text: 啊，还有...给你!

entries.text: You reprogrammed it that fast? That's... amazing! I'm impressed. Maybe you could show me how you did that sometime?
entries.translated_text: 你这么快就重新编程好了了？那真是...了不起！真让我佩服。也许你可以告诉我你是怎么做到的？

entries.text: That's... that's good. Good. Um. Well. I just... I might have. Questions.
entries.translated_text: 那...那很好，很好。嗯，嗯...我只是...可能有些问题。

entries.text: Be careful of the rest of the Netch herd!
entries.translated_text: 小心其余的气母群！

entries.text: Not specifically. Pick any Orc chieftain and that's probably who Bartokh is supposed to be. They don't exactly like standing out from each other.
entries.translated_text: 不是具体指谁。随便挑一个兽人酋长，那大概就是巴托克了。他们之间也没有什么脱颖而出的地方。

entries.text: I found something in Val's pocket. No, I won't say what it is. Just know that it is what you would least expect.
entries.translated_text: 我在瓦尔的口袋里发现了一些东西。不，我不会说是什么。你只要知道那是你最想不到的东西就行了。

entries.text: Get Scrap some dwarven oil.
entries.translated_text: 去拿些矮人油。

entries.text: Yes! Tell me.
entries.translated_text: 是的！告诉我。

entries.text: Well...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Well...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Well...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Well...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Well...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Well...
entries.translated_text: 好吧...

entries.text: Remi is waiting for me to signal in what order to pull the levers blocking our way in Arkngchal. She gave me a spell to hit the stationary automaton prototypes beneath each lever.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米正在等我发出信号，准备按照我的顺序拉动拉杆打通拦住我们的通道。她给了我一个咒语，让我去打中每个杠杆下面对应的矮人机器人。

entries.text: What do you know about Morvic Riscel?
entries.translated_text: 你对莫维克·里塞尔了解多少？

entries.text: I hate Markarth even more than I did before, and yet I've never been so happy to lay eyes on it.
entries.translated_text: 我虽然比以前更讨厌马卡斯城，但我从未如此高兴能看到它。

entries.text: It's just... Not for me.
entries.translated_text: 这只是...不适合我。

entries.text: Will it work now?
entries.translated_text: 现在能用吗？

entries.text: Gossiping, bickering, throwing dinnerware... If some things don't get you angry, then you cease to be mortal.
entries.translated_text: 闲聊、争吵、扔餐具……如果没有事情能让你生气，那么你就不再是凡人了。

entries.text: Olaf? Are they- Are they about to have a ghost fight? A ghost fight?!
entries.translated_text: 奥拉夫？他们——他们要打鬼斗了吗？一场鬼斗？！

entries.text: We did it! I can't wait to see these automatons in action!
entries.translated_text: 我们做到了！我迫不及待地想看到这些机器人动起来了！

entries.text: Maybe... a sweet roll? No, pie!
entries.translated_text: 也许…一个甜卷？不要！

entries.text: Best to keep the subject of religion to yourself, it seems.
entries.translated_text: 看来，宗教信仰自己知道就行了。

entries.text: Are you okay, Revan?!
entries.translated_text: 你还好吗，渡鸦？！

entries.text: So. What went on in the Sanctuary?
entries.translated_text: 所以，圣所发生了什么？

entries.text: Kids can be mean.
entries.translated_text: 孩子们可能很刻薄。

entries.text: Eight-eighteen? Back then...? Then you're... Oh! You're old!
entries.translated_text: 八十八？那时候......？那你就...哦！你老了！

entries.text: Everyone seems to have dreamed of either becoming a warrior or going on adventures.
entries.translated_text: 每个人似乎都梦想着成为一名战士或着去冒险。（Everyone，E开头）

entries.text: Yes! By the Divines, yes! That was amazing, Dragonborn! Did you see the look on his face when you brought him to the ground?!
entries.translated_text: 是的！圣灵在上，是的！太神奇了，龙裔！当你把他吼到地上时，你看到他脸上的表情了吗？！

entries.text: Khash, you seem... antsy when other Argonians are around. Do you wish you were traveling with them...?
entries.translated_text: 卡什，当其他亚龙人在附近时，你似乎...很焦躁。你希望你和他们一起旅行...？

entries.text: And I mean 'bizarre' in the best way possible. Are Kwama eggs similar to chicken eggs? I admit, I'm not even sure what a 'Kwama' is.
entries.translated_text: 我的意思是我想用最好的方式表达 "怪异"。夸蚁蛋与鸡蛋像吗？我承认，我甚至不确定 "夸蚁"是什么。

entries.text: That's right! He's more of a friend-machine than a killing-machine! Although you will be killing together, but as friends!
entries.translated_text: 没错！与其说他是杀人机器，不如说他是朋友机器！虽然你们会一起杀人，但也能作为朋友！

entries.text: Well, no. I'd much prefer it to be smaller. I already have to carry Scrap everywhere.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，不。我更希望它能小一点。我小渣已经很重了。

entries.text: Tell Remi to Pull the Lever
entries.translated_text: 告诉蕾米拉动杠杆

entries.text: Yes, I wonder if they're even able to recognize that they have been abandoned? It's a lonely thought.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我想知道他们是否能意识到自己被遗弃了？真是孤独。

entries.text: Be careful, these things live in groups! There's probably more in the ash!
entries.translated_text: 小心，这些东西是群居的！灰烬中可能还有更多！

entries.text: Why are you asking me?
entries.translated_text: 你为什么要问我呢？

entries.text: And I, uh... was not supposed to go.
entries.translated_text: 而我，呃...本不应该去的。

entries.text: Well, let me try and think back on them...
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我试着回想一下...

entries.text: You mean other than him being my once-upon-a-time fiancee?
entries.translated_text: 我不是说过他是我曾经的未婚夫？

texts: Is it absolutely necessary for you to be bothering me right now? What do you want?
你现在有必要打扰我吗？你想要什么？

entries.text: Such history in these old Nord ruins. Yet a draugr crypt is a scary place.
entries.translated_text: 在这些古老的诺德遗址中埋藏着很多不为人知的历史。然而，地下墓穴是个可怕的地方。

entries.text: That's not the impressive part. You were asleep. The part you should be focusing on is how great fighting is going to be for you now!
entries.translated_text: 这只是小菜一碟，你当时在睡觉。你应该关注的是，你现在战斗有这把剑能有多厉害！

entries.text: Agryval wandered into the fog, until it was so thick that she could not see even her hand in front of her eyes.
entries.translated_text: 阿格里瓦尔在迷雾中徘徊，直到雾气浓烈伸手不见五指。

entries.text: We'll see.
entries.translated_text: 等着瞧。

entries.text: Well, like I said before, I never really knew him.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，就像我之前说的，我从来没有真正了解过他。

entries.text: Remi! Payday is here...
entries.translated_text: 蕾米！该分钱了...

entries.text: There's no way I'm doing that.
entries.translated_text: 我不可能那样做。

entries.text: Do you need to ask? You're the best friend I've ever had.
entries.translated_text: 这还需要问吗？你是我这辈子最好的朋友。

entries.text: Oh, it's Serana! I mean-Oh no, a vampire.
entries.translated_text: 哦，是瑟拉娜！我的意思是——哦不，是吸血鬼。

entries.text: But to think...
entries.translated_text: 但想想...

entries.text: A mysterious meeting underneath the Skyforge? Seems shady. So right up my alley.
entries.translated_text: 天空熔炉地下的神秘会议？好像很阴暗就在我的小巷里。

entries.text: Debug Effect
entries.translated_text: Debug Effect

entries.text: Well, you wouldn't be using it. I would.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，你不必做什么。我来就行。

entries.text: Val! Where did you get this? She's beautiful!
entries.translated_text: 瓦尔你从哪儿弄来的？她真漂亮！

entries.text: And... we win. We're not dying today, Yazakh! Unless we die in the next fight. Then we're dying today.
entries.translated_text: 而且...我们赢了。我们今天死不了，雅扎克！除非我们西在下一场战斗中。那样的话,我们今天就死定了。。

entries.text: But they were inspirational on the field, and Boethiah seemed to be a rallying front even to our enemies.
entries.translated_text: 但他们在战场上却很鼓舞人心，甚至对我们的敌人来说，波耶西亚似乎也是一个团结阵线。

entries.text: Like what's it like to be undead? Do you have a pulse? How does drinking blood keep you alive? Does it soak through your stomah into your veins?
entries.translated_text: 像是，当亡灵是什么感觉？你有脉搏吗？饮血是如何让你维生的？血液是通过你的胃渗透到你的血管里的吗？

entries.text: My mother was a Companion. And her mother. And all the women in my family.
entries.translated_text: 我的母亲是一位战友。还有她的妈妈。还有我家所有的女人。

entries.text: Surely not all Orcs are like that?
entries.translated_text: 当然不是所有的兽人都是这样？

entries.text: It looks like this is where dwemer scholars spent their days. This academic atmosphere and the presence of an Elder Scroll... It sounds amazing.
entries.translated_text: 看来这里是锻莫学者们度日的地方，这种学术氛围，还有上古卷轴的存在...听起来很神奇。

entries.text: Wuuthrad? I assume this is some Nord thing? It seems important to them, though. And if you do it, you can be a true Companion, so I'll help you.
entries.translated_text: 精灵屠戮者？我想这是诺德人的东西？不过，这对他们来说似乎很重要。如果你做到了，你可以成为一个真正的战友，所以我会帮助你。

entries.text: Oh, man.
entries.translated_text: 哦，一个人。

entries.text: Take Remi to the Bard's College.
entries.translated_text: 带蕾米去吟游诗人学院。

entries.text: Yes, I tried it. No, I didn't get sick. Honestly, I seem to be able to eat just about anything. Doesn't mean I enjoyed it, though.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我喝过了。不，我没有生病。老实说，我似乎什么都能吃。但这并不意味着我喜欢吃。

entries.text: You said before that you'd give me the earnings from our time in Nchuand-Zel.
entries.translated_text: 你之前说过，你会把我们在楚安德-泽尔的收入给我。

entries.text: Such things do not occur to me in my love, and when I am confronted with the more carnal aspects... I cannot stomach it.
entries.translated_text: 这种东西不会发生在我的爱情中，而当我面对更多的肉体方面时...我就无法忍受了。

entries.text: They must pass rigourous testing, are tasked with protecting the royal family of Daggerfall, and even know the Dragon tongue. Or so they say.
entries.translated_text: 他们必须通过严格的测试，负责保护匕落的皇室，甚至得懂得龙语。或者他们是这么宣传的。

entries.text: Using prisoners to mine silver... Seems like you're just asking for innocent people to be given fraudulent charges.
entries.translated_text: 用囚犯开采银子...这不就是在变相鼓励给无辜的人安上虚假的罪名吗？

entries.text: Do you think Remi would let me braid her hair sometimes? I want to ask, but I am a bit nervous.
entries.translated_text: 你觉得蕾米会让我帮她编头发吗？我很想问她，但有点紧张。

entries.text: Yeah, a mom and a dad. Both Orcs, both pretty normal and functional people.
entries.translated_text: 是的，一个妈妈和一个爸爸。都是兽人，都是相当正常和实在的人。

entries.text: I will miss the spooky centerpiece to Whiterun, but I suppose an alive tree looks... nice enough.
entries.translated_text: 我会想念白漫城中心的诡异装饰品，但我想一棵活着的树看起来...不赖。

entries.text: (Laughs) I used to think Nords all lived in igloos. There are ice caves around which are similar, but it seems like trolls live in them instead.
entries.translated_text: (我曾经认为诺德人都住在冰屋里。周围有类似的冰洞，但似乎巨魔就住在里面。

entries.text: Oh, that won't be a problem. (Laughs)
entries.translated_text: 哦，没有问题。(笑)

entries.text: Should I be embarrassed that a thirteen-and-a-half-year-old is better in combat than I am? Hm, I'll just not think about it.
entries.translated_text: 我是不是该为一个十三岁半的孩子比我还能打而感到尴尬？嗯...还是别想这事了。

entries.text: Oh, fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧。

entries.text: Oh, fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧。

entries.text: Oh, fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧。

entries.text: I'm right behind you, Nar.
entries.translated_text: 我就在你身后，纳尔。

entries.text: The Psijic Order?
entries.translated_text: 赛伊克教团？

entries.text: I-is that true? What happened to Braig? Adventurer, I need to talk to you.
entries.translated_text: 是真的吗？布莱吉怎么了？冒险者，我要和你谈谈。

entries.text: The Dwarves were no stranger to torture.
entries.translated_text: 矮人对酷刑并不陌生。

entries.text: It's unfortunate that Dwemeris only lives on in written form. I'd love to know if I'm using correct pronunciation or not.
entries.translated_text: 可惜锻莫语现在只剩文字了。我很想知道我的发音是否对。

entries.text: I have to admit, newly baked pies and tarts smell lovely.
entries.translated_text: 我得承认，新鲜出炉的馅饼和塔派闻起来真是香极了。

entries.text: A cave. You'd think caves would be a great place to meet adventurers like us.
entries.translated_text: 一个山洞。你肯定认为洞穴是个很好的地方来迎接像我们这样的冒险者。

entries.text: Empathy really isn't your strong suit, is it?
entries.translated_text: 你真没有同理心，不是吗？

texts: Reading this book, you can hardly understand what's being said. Some of it even appears to be in a different language.
阅读这本书后，你很难理解它在说什么。其中一些内容甚至似乎是用不同的语言描述的。

entries.text: Reading this book, you can hardly understand what's being said. Some of it even appears to be in a different language.
entries.translated_text: 阅读这本书后，你很难理解它在说什么。其中一些内容甚至似乎是用不同的语言描述的。

entries.text: He seems to be under the impression that my Breton palate couldn't handle this Chaurus Pie he's invented.
entries.translated_text: 他似乎有一种印象，那就是我的布莱顿人的味觉无法体味到他发明的这种巢蚁薄饼。

entries.text: I want to face my fears, too!
entries.translated_text: 我也想面对我的恐惧！

entries.text: Windmills harness the air for grain, but what if we could store that energy instead? Use it for lights or heat?
entries.translated_text: 风车利用空气生产谷物，但如果我们可以储存这些能量呢？是用来照明还是取暖？

entries.text: Well, that's a lie. I have a lot of ideas. I just don't know if any of them explain that.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，撒了个谎，我确实有很多想法。只是我不确定其中有没有能解释这个的。

entries.text: We're home! Are you cooking, or am I? I can, but just don't blame me if we get food poisoning, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我们到家了！你做饭，还是我做饭？我可以，但如果我们食物中毒了，请不要怪我，好吗？

entries.text: Look for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔寻找有趣的文物

entries.text: What did you write on the flyer, exactly? I don't think you showed me.
entries.translated_text: 你在传单上到底写了什么？我想你还没有给我看过。

entries.text: Probably. But we'll be ready.
entries.translated_text: 大概吧，但我们会做好准备。

entries.text: Why do these Dunmer stay here...?
entries.translated_text: 为什么这些丹莫会留在这里……？

entries.text: How strange!
entries.translated_text: 真奇怪！

entries.text: Have you done it? Don't keep me waiting.
entries.translated_text: 你搞完了吗，别让我等太久。

entries.text: I... What happened with Morvic, I know it made you... angry. I'm- I'm not sorry that I did it. But I am sorry that I... upset you.
entries.translated_text: 我...莫维克的事，我知道让你... 很生气我并不后悔我做的事但我很抱歉... 让你生气了。

entries.text: Ha-ha.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。

entries.text: Ha-ha.
entries.translated_text: 哈哈。

entries.text: ...Oh... Sorry, I got carried away there.
entries.translated_text: ...哦...对不起，我搞偏。

entries.text: Oooooh, Scrap, I'm so sorry! I promise I'll erase this from your memory banks afterward.
entries.translated_text: 哦哦，小渣，我很抱歉！我保证以后我会把这段经历从你的记忆库中删除。

entries.text: The Thu'um is a type of tonal magic! These greybeards are manipulating reality with their voices!
entries.translated_text: 吐姆是一种音调魔法！这些灰胡子正在用他们的声音操纵现实！

entries.text: B-b-b-break it?! My wrist or my dagger?!
entries.translated_text: 破...破...破开它？！是我的手腕还是匕首？！

entries.text: Not at all.
entries.translated_text: 完全没有。

entries.text: Oh no, I certainly have. I've had the typical desires, to be near to them, to hold hands, to share thoughts and feelings.
entries.translated_text: 哦，不，我当然有。我有正常的欲望，想靠近他们，牵手，分享思想和情感。

entries.text: Did they deserve it?
entries.translated_text: 他们罪有应得吗？

entries.text: Being in the College is like being back in Wayrest. Magic everywhere you look. I miss it a little, I think.
entries.translated_text: 在学院里就像回到了途歇城，随处可见的魔法。我有点想念它了，我想吧。

entries.text: I'll tell you about it later, okay?
entries.translated_text: 我稍后再告诉你，好吗？

entries.text: Sheogorath.
entries.translated_text: 谢尔格拉。

entries.text: So, Simba, my wise adventurer and leader. Where are you leading us to next?
entries.translated_text: 所以，辛巴，我睿智的冒险者和领袖，您接下来要带我们去哪里？

entries.text: Besides the obvious?
entries.translated_text: 除了那些显而易见的？

entries.text: What do you mean, 'my awkwardness?'
entries.translated_text: “我尴尬的样子”是什么意思？

entries.text: I hate that it happened.
entries.translated_text: 我讨厌这种事情的发生。

entries.text: Did you need something, Nar?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么吗，纳尔？

entries.text: This place has evidence of complex engineering. Surely replicating the way it is powered would be beneficial to Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 这个地方有复杂工程的残留。当然，复制它的动力方式对小渣也是有好处的？

entries.text: This place has evidence of complex engineering. Surely replicating the way it is powered would be beneficial to Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 这个地方有复杂工程的残留。当然，复制它的动力方式对小渣也是有好处的？

entries.text: Sometimes it's the reverse. I've found that I don't really know what to think of them. I cannot decide one way or the other.
entries.translated_text: 有时情况正好相反。我发现我真的不知道该如何看待它们。我无法决定喜欢还是不喜欢。

entries.text: 200 gold?
200 gold?
Suggesting I become a jester?
entries.translated_text: 建议我成为小丑？

entries.text: Oooh fancy! You know you don't have to get the pricey stuff for me, but I appreciate it.
entries.translated_text: 哦，真讲究！你知道不用给我买这么贵的东西，不过我很感激。

entries.text: I have to note down this ruin on my map. I'm going to come back and study that lock. If I could recreate it for a defense system for my own home...
entries.translated_text: 我必须在我的地图上记下这个遗址，我要回来研究那把锁，如果我可以为我自己的家重新创建一个防御系统...

entries.text: Revan, you are very good at leading. At least, I think you are. I'm following you, in any case.
entries.translated_text: 雷文，你很擅长领导。至少，我认为你是这样。无论如何，我都在关注你。

entries.text: Well, I was just thinking of something. Can I ask you a question?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我刚在想一件事。我可以问你一个问题吗？

entries.text: Can't you just let me observe you in peace? You're more a test subject than a companion.
entries.translated_text: 你就不能让我静静地观察你吗？你更像是一个测试对象而不是一个战友。

entries.text: Well, he's not technically my father.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，严格来说，他不是我的父亲。

entries.text: Well, he's not technically my father.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，严格来说，他不是我的父亲。

entries.text: You're bleeding!
entries.translated_text: 你在流血！

entries.text: I imagine the scholars in Arkngchal were improving upon automaton designs in order to provide more refined versions to nearby cities.
entries.translated_text: 我想阿卡切尔的学者们当时在改进机器人设计，以便为附近的城市提供更先进的型号。

entries.text: It's an acceptable reaction.
entries.translated_text: 这是反应可以接受。

entries.text: Just pinched my finger; nothing to worry about.
entries.translated_text: 只是夹到手指了，没什么好担心的。

entries.text: I can't imagine becoming a soldier. I'd rather not pretend to take orders from someone who things they are in charge of me.
entries.translated_text: 我无法想象自己会成为一名士兵。我也不会假装听从某人的命令，让那人觉得自己可以支配我。

entries.text: (Whisper) Oh, it's so pretty!
entries.translated_text: （低语）哦，真漂亮！

entries.text: Woah, woah, woah. You think I'm intimidated by some scrawny engineer and some ugly bastard?
entries.translated_text: 哇，哇，哇，哇。你认为我被某些瘦小的工程师和一些丑陋的混蛋所吓倒？

entries.text:
L，

根据我们上次的通信，我已经敲定了我们的协议。时序会骑士团可能认为她不会对高岩的稳定构成威胁，但这并不意味着这座城市的其他人可以原谅她对坏人的崇拜。我几乎与她分享的名字被玷污了。尽管与她的家人断绝交往并拒绝与她建立贸易关系，但其他人仍将我视为同情者。我花了数年时间谴责她的家人并将他们赶出市场，以恢复我以前的尊严。

而就在我终于克服被许配给一个魔神崇拜者的屈辱时，她的父母暴露了他们是渣滓！经营击剑行动，在贵族耳边窃窃私语，贩卖非法商品——甚至是斯库马！现在审问我的不是骑士团，而是该死的城市守卫！

我登上途歇城王座的机会被破坏了，守卫没有抓住那些该死的傻瓜，而是让他们从指缝中溜走。虽然他们在外面某个地方，可能离我的掌握越来越远，但这些警卫居然有勇气调查我！

现在，她的父母可能已经消失了，但我听到了可疑的谣言。我们东边的邻居一直在窃窃私语一个强大的人，在诺德人的土地上漫游。在这个人的公司里有一个奇怪的女孩，带着一个宠物的矮人机器。我可能有一段时间没见过蕾米尔了，但毫无疑问，这就是她。

我听说过关于你的雇佣军的可怕事情，我的意思是作为一种恭维。杀了她。把她的头带给我作为证据，给我我应得的报复。我厌倦了她的行为困扰我的生活。我的薪水会很丰厚，但如果你证明她在结束前受苦，你会发现我的付出会更大。

-莫维克·里塞尔

entries.text: Yes. Yes, you're right, Val. Thank you.
entries.translated_text: 是的，是的，你是对的，瓦尔。谢谢。

entries.text: Yikes, it seems like the title of Dragonborn is a coveted one. This Miraak seems to be envious of you.
entries.translated_text: 哎呀，似乎龙裔的称号很诱人，这个秘拉克似乎很羡慕你。

entries.text: I love the Gourmet's recipes.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢美食家的菜。

entries.text: It's the hammer used to 'tune' the Heart, so to speak.
entries.translated_text: 可以这么说，它是用来“调整”心脏的锤子。

entries.text: You're aware of the stereotype that us Bretons are excellent cooks, right? I'm not one, unfortunately. Are you?
entries.translated_text: 您知道别人都觉得我们布莱顿人厨艺精湛吧？可惜我不是，你呢？

entries.text: Just... Let's move on, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 就...让我们翻篇吧，好吗？

entries.text: The Aetherium Wars likely happened thousands upon thousands of years ago... Perhaps Bthar-Zel was simply lost to time?
entries.translated_text: 神光之战，恐怕是千百年前的事了...或许，巴泽尔只是被时间湮灭了？

entries.text: I should ask Teldryn about Blacklight sometime.
entries.translated_text: 我应该找个时间问问泰卓因关于黑光城的事。

entries.text: They've killed many like you, Scrap! Be careful!
entries.translated_text: 他们杀了很多像你一样的人，小渣！当心！

entries.text: I will! Don't you worry. I'll be... just very careful from now on!
entries.translated_text: 我会的，别担心我会...从现在开始非常小心的！

entries.text: Yeah... Yep... I just think... The potion needs a little more work.
entries.translated_text: 是的...嗯...我只是觉得...这药水可能还需要再调一调。

entries.text: Remi's Crossbow Bolts
entries.translated_text: 蕾米的弩箭

entries.text: (Gasp) Look up there! That engraving! Adventurer, lift me up there immediately now! Oh, wait. That's the same as... Never mind.
entries.translated_text: （吸气）看上面！那个雕刻！冒险者，马上把我抬上去！哦，等等，这和...没关系

entries.text: She woke to a soreness on her wrists, and an uncomfortable warmth around her. Opening her eyes, she found herself tied to a slab, flames around her.
entries.translated_text: 她醒来时发现手腕酸痛，周围有一种不舒服的温度。睁开眼睛，她发现自己被绑在一块石板上，周围燃烧着火焰。

entries.text: Scrap, keep Ganbald safe, okay?!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，保护好甘巴尔德，好吗？！

entries.text: Yes.
entries.translated_text: 是的。

entries.text: Yes.
entries.translated_text: 是的。

entries.text: Yes.
entries.translated_text: 是的。

entries.text: No! Get up!
entries.translated_text: 不！起来！

entries.text: Illusion.
entries.translated_text: 幻术系。

entries.text: Black Marsh has always sounded quite unlike High Rock.
entries.translated_text: 黑沼泽一听起来就很不像高岩。

entries.text: And they're dead, and Ganbald and I are alive. We win!
entries.translated_text: 他们已经死了，而甘巴尔德和我还活着，我们赢了！

entries.text: Uh, hello, I'm Remiel.
entries.translated_text: 呃，你好，我是蕾米尔。

entries.text: Maybe a secret sign is not such a bad idea.It will be our little secret. Although, secrets don't make friends.
entries.translated_text: 也许暗号并不是一个坏主意。这将是我们的小秘密。虽然，秘密不能交朋友。

entries.text: That seems like an understatement. I've never met a werewolf before, actually. Do you... Well do you think he'd let me take a sample of his blood?
entries.translated_text: 这话听起来太轻描淡写了，我其实从没见过狼人，你觉得...嗯，你觉得他会让我取一点他的血样吗？

entries.text: Dragonborn! That's the dragon we saw at Kynesgrove!
entries.translated_text: 龙裔！那是我们在凯娜之林看到的龙！

entries.text: Well, maybe it's not so sinister as that. We're the ones who assume they're dead. Maybe they're just napping.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，也许没有那么险恶。我们认为他们已经死了。也许他们只是在打盹。

entries.text: Don't die, Nar! I'd be very upset with you!
entries.translated_text: 别死，纳尔！我会非常伤心的！

entries.text: But if you think so... maybe I have. It's a nice sentiment.
entries.translated_text: 但如果你这么想...也许我的确是。这是个不错的想法。

entries.text: I feel a bit miffed that J'zargo is just so good at magic, and I've barely got any despite being a Breton.
entries.translated_text: 我有点郁闷，吉'扎格魔法那么厉害，而我身为布莱顿人，却几乎没什么魔法天赋。

entries.text: Looks like that's it. Got to go.
entries.translated_text: 信也送到了，我得走了。

entries.text: This is a Debate Hall. I'm sure the dwemer loved to debate one another, but I don't see the appeal. Arguing like that sounds terrifying.
entries.translated_text: 这是一个辩论厅。我敢肯定锻莫喜欢互相辩论，但我看不出有什么吸引力，这样的争论听起来很可怕。

entries.text: The essence of my answer to your original question is...
entries.translated_text: 我对你最初问题的回答的实质是...

entries.text: Let's just say, he ain't freezin' his ass off in Skyrim. If yer rich, you don't have to leave home.
entries.translated_text: 这么说吧，他不用在天际忍饥挨饿，有钱人办事根本不用踏出家门半步。

entries.text: Sometimes the Orders themselves are awful, but when speaking with one of the individual members, they are incredibly pleasant.
entries.translated_text: 有时骑士团本身很糟糕，但与其中一个人交谈时，它们却往往会不可思议的能与你交谈甚欢。

entries.text: Er-That sounds bad. I just mean: It's alright! To be different.
entries.translated_text: 呃——听起来好像不太对。我是说：没关系的！与众不同也没什么不好。

entries.text: We Who Challenge the Sun
entries.translated_text: 与日争辉

entries.text: Oh, so that's a tactic, too, huh? I'm a genius.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那也是一种策略，对吧？我是天才。

entries.text: What use do the dead have for gold? It's much more useful in my pockets.
entries.translated_text: 钱对死人有什么用？它在我的口袋里更有用。

entries.text: Arkngchal
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔

entries.text: Arkngchal
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔

entries.text: Arkngchal
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔

entries.text: Then why bother adventuring?
entries.translated_text: 那为什么还要冒险呢？

entries.text: These texts on Lorkhan-on Sheor-were used as evidence towards our heretical tendencies.
entries.translated_text: 这些关于洛克汗或舒奥尔的文字被当成了我们异端倾向的证据。

entries.text: Do you ever have a dream that just... stays with you? I had such an odd one.
entries.translated_text: 你有没有想过。。。和你在一起？我有一个很奇怪的想法。

entries.text: (Whisper) Better to make it quick.
entries.translated_text: （低语）最好快点。

entries.text: Well, beyond our adventurous friend here, I suppose.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，除了我们这位冒险朋友之外，我想。

entries.text: (Muttering) Since I won't get caught.
entries.translated_text: （喃喃自语）因为我不会被抓到的。

entries.text: Your loss, but if you change your mind, I'll be here.
entries.translated_text: 那是你的损失，但如果你回心转意了，来这里找我。

entries.text: But it was.
entries.translated_text: 不，它是。

entries.text: Uh, hi.
entries.translated_text: 呃，你好。

entries.text: Alright. Let Auri know we're done, okay?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让奥璃知道我们已经搞定，好吗？

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. We found a smuggler in Riften who seems to have the information about Remi's family, but he will only give us the information if we recover a case of skooma that the Riften guard took from him.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，他对蕾米尔对自己家族名声的影响而心怀怨恨。我们在裂谷城发现了一个走私者，他似乎掌握了蕾米家人的信息，但只有在我们找回裂谷城守卫从他那里拿走的一箱斯库玛时，他才会给我们信息。

entries.text: Elsweyr is an arid land of deserts and rocky canyons, where the sun shines warmly, always.
entries.translated_text: 艾斯维尔是一个到处都是沙漠和岩石峡谷的不毛之地，那里总是充满着阳光。

entries.text: Rumarin clearly values being alive, so him being willing to engage in my experiments makes me think he must trust me! Right?
entries.translated_text: 鲁马林显然很惜命，所以他愿意参与我的实验，就说明他肯定信任我！对吗？

entries.text: What he said... About me bringing him down with me...
entries.translated_text: 他说的...关于我让他遭遇的不幸...

entries.text: Incredible! I wish I- Wait, how did the stew not leak out the bowls if they were punctured by the tusks?
entries.translated_text: 难以置信！我希望我...等等，如果碗都被獠牙刺穿了，炖肉是怎么不掉出来的？

entries.text: Yes, and we decided that Skyrim apparently doesn't appreciate reading?
entries.translated_text: 是的，我们认为天际人显然不喜欢阅读？

entries.text: In the wind? I don't smell anything.
entries.translated_text: 新鲜事？我什么都不知道。

texts: So. Yes. Three bowls and two ferns. Or something like that. Throw those in that cauldron and I'm sure it will work out. Probably.
所以，是的。三个碗和两个蕨类植物。或者类似的东西。把这些扔到大锅里，我肯定会成功的。可能吧。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically. After following clues to a ship docked in Solitude, I discovered that the mercenaries were hired to kill Remi by her ex-fiancee, Morvic, who feels slighted by the impact Remiel had on his family name. We found a smuggler in Riften who will only give us information if we recover a case of skooma that the Riften guard took from him. We found the skooma, so we should return it to him.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一个专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击了。在追踪一艘停靠在孤岛的船只的线索后，我发现雇佣军是被她的前未婚夫莫维克雇佣来杀死蕾米的，她对蕾米尔对他的姓氏的影响感到轻视。我们在裂谷城找到了一个走私者，只有在我们找到裂谷城守卫从他那里拿走的一箱斯库玛时，他才会向我们提供信息。我们找到了斯库玛，所以我们应该把它还给他。

entries.text: I think Teldryn is growing on me a bit.
entries.translated_text: 我觉得我开始有点喜欢泰卓因了。

entries.text: Be careful looting these chests, my partner in crime.
entries.translated_text: 翻箱子时小心点，我的犯罪同伙。

entries.text: Ah, you're...
entries.translated_text: 啊，你是...

entries.text: A-a *woman?!*
entries.translated_text: 一、一个*女人？！*

entries.text: Yes, Elder Scrolls are used to peer through time itself... With his intelligence, Septimus will probably be able to make sense of an Elder Scroll.
entries.translated_text: 是的，上古卷轴是用来窥视时间本身的...以他的智慧，塞普汀默斯可能能够理解上古卷轴。

entries.text: Well, no reason you can't still! We could go visit!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你不能就这么停下来！我们可以去参观！

entries.text: Doubtful that you ever had the energy to begin with.
entries.translated_text: 我可怀疑你一开始就没那股劲儿。（Doubtful，D开头）

entries.text: Does that make it a good tourist destination?
entries.translated_text: 这还是一个好的旅途目的地吗？

entries.text: You don't scare me.
entries.translated_text: 你吓不倒我。

entries.text: Have you seen the writing around the Book's case? 'Enkagr Bcharn?'
entries.translated_text: 你看到书匣周围的文字了吗？“Enkagr Bcharn”？

entries.text: That's so impressive!
entries.translated_text: 这真厉害！

entries.text: There are many. Like I said, High Rock loves her knights.
entries.translated_text: 有很多。就像我说的，高岩爱她的骑士们。

entries.text: What is it? Let me see.
entries.translated_text: 什么？让我看看。

entries.text: I think with the right tools, I might be able to attentuate to one part of their song, a specific tone.
entries.translated_text: 我认为使用正确的工具，我也许能够减弱他们歌声的一部分，一种特定的音律。

entries.text: And I remember when it all happened. There I was, hiding under a blanket. I remember hearing talking, and then shouting, and then BOOM!
entries.translated_text: 我还记得事情发生的那一刻。我就那样躲在一条毯子下面。我记得先是听到说话声，然后是喊叫声，接着——砰！

entries.text: Alright, then.
entries.translated_text: 那就好。

entries.text: Once or twice.
entries.translated_text: 一两次吧。

entries.text: And you want me to get them back.
entries.translated_text: 你想让我把他们找回来。

entries.text: Maybe we can talk when we're out of the rain?
entries.translated_text: 也许等雨停了再谈？

entries.text: I'm glad we're adventuring together, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 我很高兴我们能一起冒险，我的朋友。

entries.text: Scrap, get this one!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，拿下这个！

entries.text: I do like Dwarven ruins. So ancient and so mysterious. Beautiful, but deadly.
entries.translated_text: 我确实喜欢矮人遗迹。如此古老，如此神秘。漂亮，但致命。

entries.text: I am.
entries.translated_text: 准备好了。

entries.text: And how can it be replicated?
entries.translated_text: 以及如何复现？

entries.text: Well, he did say the guards took it. Is there a particular place they take confiscated items?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，他确实说守卫没收了它们。是否会有一个守卫用来存放没收物品的地方？

entries.text: Blackreach wasn't originally a dwemer construction. It belonged to a clan of vampires in the Merethic Era. The Reachmen called them the Night Lords.
entries.translated_text: 黑境最初并不是一个锻莫构造，它属于精灵纪元的一个吸血鬼部落，边塞人称他们为午夜领主。

entries.text: I imagine you'll come around. Eventually.
entries.translated_text: 我想你迟早会改变主意的。

entries.text: I-I knew that Markarth was rife with-with shady dealings and terrible people, but I never thought it ran so deep as to-
entries.translated_text: 我知道马卡斯城充斥着腐败和恶徒，但我从没过会这么严重--

entries.text: I've always imagined food in the stomach to have become mush. Is it like eating mashed potatoes?
entries.translated_text: 我一直想象着食物在胃里已经变成了浆糊。这就像吃土豆泥一样吗？

entries.text: When I traveled through Evermore, I ran into the Order of Saint Pelin.
entries.translated_text: 当我在永恒城旅行时，我遇到了圣佩林团。

entries.text: Hi, there.
entries.translated_text: 你好呀。

entries.text: Oh? And what would that be?
entries.translated_text: 哦？是什么？

entries.text: While you're at it, you might as well be an Argonian, and Anum-La can be an Altmer.
entries.translated_text: 既然如此，你还不如做个亚龙人，而安努姆菈可以做个高精灵。

entries.text: Oh, Scrap, you're okay! Thank the Divines! I missed you so much, *so much*! Everything is okay now, I promise!
entries.translated_text: 哦，小渣，你没事！感谢圣灵，我好想你，*特别想*！现在一切都没事了，我保证。

entries.text: Yep! I've been cooped up for too long already!
entries.translated_text: 是的！我已经被困太久了！

entries.text: I once heard a story of a man who ate a soul gem and gained knowledge of intricate machine workings. Unrelated, how do you think soul gems taste?
entries.translated_text: 我听过一个故事，说有个人吃了一颗灵魂石后，获得了精密机械运作的知识。无关紧要的问一句，你觉得灵魂石尝起来是什么味道？

entries.text: How about you? Do you worship?
entries.translated_text: 你呢？你有信仰吗？

entries.text: What happened?
entries.translated_text: 发生什么事了？

entries.text: Whose hard work? Yours, or the people you send into ruins in your stead?
entries.translated_text: 谁的辛苦工作？你的，还是你代替你进入遗址的人？

entries.text: I'm sure it's hard to believe, but I was once a bold adventurer like you, ready to face any danger.
entries.translated_text: 我知道这很难让人相信，但我之前也像你一样热衷冒险，无所畏惧。

entries.text: Ummm...
Ummm...
Remi! Me. Play. With. Scrap?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米！我，和，小渣，玩？

entries.text: Oh. Well that's a bit rude. Although I suppose he does make people nervous. Fine.
entries.translated_text: 哦，嗯，这有点不太礼貌，不过我猜他确实让人紧张。好吧。

entries.text: A dynamo core.
entries.translated_text: 一个动力核心。

entries.text: No, I didn't.
entries.translated_text: 不，我没有。

entries.text: Nothing personal.
entries.translated_text: 这可不是个人恩怨。

entries.text: Worship is communing with a Divine and following their instructions.
entries.translated_text: 信仰是与圣灵交流并遵循他们的指示。

entries.text: Arkngchal was absolutely some sort of Dwemeris university. Dwemer of all ages stayed here, sometimes years, studying and researching.
entries.translated_text: 阿卡切尔绝对是某所锻莫大学。在这里学习和研究的锻莫在各个年龄段都有，有的会在这里待数年。

entries.text: I'm not sure my dagger is getting through its wool!
entries.translated_text: 我不确定我的匕首是否穿透了它的羊毛！

entries.text: Thank you, friend.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你，朋友。

entries.text: Thank you, friend.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你，朋友。

entries.text: This lever isn't working either. I think... I think it doesn't have any power running to it.
entries.translated_text: 这个拉杆也不起作用。我认为...我认为是因为没有动力。

entries.text: I need to practice my reading. Then once you finish it, I will be able to understand all of it.
entries.translated_text: 我需要练习阅读。等你看完了，我就能全部看懂了。

entries.text: When I think of home, I don't think of the clouds of fleshflies. I think of the old company.
entries.translated_text: 当我想到家的时候，我想的不是漫天的肉蝇。我想到的是老家的老朋友。

entries.text: Ok. What about in general? What's it like being a werewolf?
entries.translated_text: 好的。一般来说呢？成为狼人是一种怎样的体验？

entries.text: Don't risk combat if you can avoid it.
entries.translated_text: 如果可以避免，请不要冒险战斗。

entries.text: You're in trouble now!
entries.translated_text: 你现在有麻烦了！

entries.text: Not that I'm uneducated, mind you.
entries.translated_text: 才不是说我没有受过教育，请注意。

entries.text: I wanted to ask you something... It's about a boy.
entries.translated_text: 我想问你一件事...是关于一个男孩的。

entries.text: How long will this take you to make?
entries.translated_text: 这需要你多长时间？

entries.text: What in Mara's name... Ew. I think I'm going to be sick.
entries.translated_text: 以玛拉之名...呕，我想我要吐了。

entries.text: Farillae, how do you feel? I worry about how much we walk, sometimes.
entries.translated_text: 法里拉，你感觉如何？有时，我会担心我们走了多少路。

entries.text: It's so nice out! Ohhh, can we go swimming?
entries.translated_text: 出来真好！哦，我们可以去游泳吗？

entries.text: That's... relieving.
entries.translated_text: 那真是...让人松一口气。

entries.text: The way we use block-and-tackle pulleys to lift heavy loads on the ship gave me the idea.
entries.translated_text: 我们在船上使用滑轮组拉起重物的方式给了我这个灵感。

entries.text: The way we use block-and-tackle pulleys to lift heavy loads on the ship gave me the idea.
entries.translated_text: 我们在船上使用滑轮组拉起重物的方式给了我这个灵感。

entries.text: Everyone has those nights.
entries.translated_text: 每个人都有这样的夜晚。

entries.text: I know Blisterworts sound gross, but they're actually pretty good for you.
entries.translated_text: 我知道气泡草听起来很恶心，但它们实际上对你有益。

entries.text: This is getting too mushy.
entries.translated_text: 确实有点太感伤了。

entries.text: I agree. You know, if we have some coin left over, I was thinking of something fun for us to do.
entries.translated_text: 我同意。你知道，如果我们还剩下一些钱，我在想一些有趣的事情来做。

entries.text: Did you have to drink some to compare to Dwemer oil? Did it make you sick?
entries.translated_text: 你需要和一点才能与矮人油比较吗？你因为这个生过病吗？

entries.text: These vampires know how to theme. Look at this castle! Perfect!
entries.translated_text: 这些吸血鬼还真懂得营造氛围。看看这座城堡！完美！

entries.text: Why yes, I fancy myself a fairly decent chef.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我觉得自己是个相当不错的厨师。

entries.text: It's so pretty, isn't it? And it is so good at being a lantern! I love her!
entries.translated_text: 它是多么漂亮，不是吗？而且它很适合做灯笼!我超爱她!

entries.text: I honestly don't even *want* to imagine you in the Legion. No offence.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我甚至不*愿*想象你在军团中的样子。无意冒犯。

entries.text: Er... Just be careful, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 呃...小心点，是吗？

entries.text: It's so cold here. I'd say let's go to the inn, but I'm afraid I'll be kicked out.
entries.translated_text: 这里太冷了。我想说我们去旅馆吧，但我怕我会被赶出去。

entries.text: Your hair is cute today.
entries.translated_text: 你今天的头发很可爱。

entries.text: We fight alongside each other, and occasionally with each other, but always with love.
entries.translated_text: 我们并肩作战，偶尔也会相互争斗，但总是充满爱。

entries.text: That's a shame, where could it have gone?
entries.translated_text: 太可惜了，它去哪儿了？

entries.text: Buffy and Remi, an unstoppable killing team! That sounds bad, doesn't it? Oh well.
entries.translated_text: 巴非和蕾米，势不可挡的杀戮团队！这听起来很糟糕，不是吗？哦，好吧。

entries.text: Remi has been thinking of a new project, and it has something to do with Tonal Magic. She's not sure where to begin, but she thinks if we can find a book with more information, she might be able to get an idea of what to do. It's been some time since I gave her the book I found; surely she's finished reading it by now?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米一直在考虑一个新项目，这与音调魔法有关。她不知道从哪里开始，但她认为，如果我们能找到一本包含更多信息的书，她可能会知道该怎么做；她现在肯定读完了吗？

entries.text: I love you more than I love studying the dwemer. It's a close call, though, so don't you go looking so smug.
entries.translated_text: 我爱你胜过爱研究锻莫，不过这还真是难分高下，所以你不要看起来那么自鸣得意。

entries.text: Do you not like what I call you? What did you have in mind?
entries.translated_text: 你不喜欢我这样称呼你吗，你想怎么称呼？

entries.text: You can't declare our living statuses for us, Ru.
entries.translated_text: 你可别替我们胡说，鲁。

entries.text: You again! That fancy bloke ended up paying me more. A lot more!
entries.translated_text: 又是你！那个滑头最后给了我更多钱，很多！

entries.text: You again! That fancy bloke ended up paying me more. A lot more!
entries.translated_text: 又是你！那个滑头最后给了我更多钱，很多！

entries.text: Driller
entries.translated_text: 钻机

entries.text: Wait! That means you can get into Nchuand-Zel! You have to take me!
entries.translated_text: 等下！这意味着你可以进入楚安德-泽尔！你必须带我去！

entries.text: Here, you can have it back.
entries.translated_text: 给你，你可以把它拿回来。

entries.text: No need to worry, Auri, I've been in way more dangerous dwemer ruins.
entries.translated_text: 不用担心，奥璃，我去过更危险的锻莫遗址。

entries.text: Trader dropped by recently with some lovely pieces, if you'd like to have a look.
entries.translated_text: 有商人最近路过这里，留下了一些好货，你愿意去看看吗？

entries.text: (Chuckle) I understand.
entries.translated_text: （笑）我明白了。

entries.text: Do you think I pass as a Nord? I don't want anyone here to know I'm a Breton.
entries.translated_text: 你认为我作为一个诺德人通过去吗？我不想让这里的任何人知道我是布莱顿人。

entries.text: Okay, Gore, pay close attention. The creatures in this den are the ones bear traps are intended for, okay?
entries.translated_text: 好的，格雷，注意了。这个巢穴里的生物就是捕熊陷阱的目标，明白吗？

entries.text: Let's continue our journey together, yeah?
entries.translated_text: 让我们一起继续我们的旅程，好吗？

entries.text: I've seen quite a few dwemer ruins with Remi at my side. I should ask her about our adventures so far.
entries.translated_text: 我和蕾米一起去过了不少矮人遗迹。我应该问她到目前为止我们的冒险经历。

entries.text: Ohhhh, don't worry, you'll be okay. Physically because I'll repair you. And mentally because you'll have no memory of this.
entries.translated_text: 哦，别担心，你会没事的，无论是身心，我都会把你修好，你也不会记起这件事。

entries.text: Well, not quite sympathizing... I can just see from his perspective.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，不是很同情...我只是从他的角度来看。

entries.text: A 'Tuning Fork' devised by Remi. She says it "allows her to replicate a tone that resonates with automaton in such a way that they are shut down permanently". Only she knows how to use it.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米设计的“音叉”。她说这“让她能够复制一种与机器人产生共鸣的音调，从而使它们永久关闭”。只有她知道如何使用它。

entries.text: And of course, you can't beat authentic Dwemer metal for durability.
entries.translated_text: 当然，真正的锻莫金属在耐久方面也是无可匹敌的。

entries.text: You were fairly close for merely guessing on your own. This symbol here is pronounced 'I'. It's Tiber, rather than 'tibber'.
entries.translated_text: 你的猜测已经很近了。这里的这个符号读作“I”。是台伯，而不是提伯。

entries.text: Oh, you think so? They do have an awful lot of books, although I can't imagine they'd have something so complex as a manuscript on tonal magic.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你这么认为吗？他们确实有很多书，尽管我无法想象他们会有像音律魔法手稿这样复杂的东西。

entries.text: Oh, you think so? They do have an awful lot of books, although I can't imagine they'd have something so complex as a manuscript on tonal magic.
entries.translated_text: 哦，你这么认为吗？他们确实有很多书，尽管我无法想象他们会有像音律魔法手稿这样复杂的东西。

entries.text: What? Oh! How could I have possibly forgotten. Your reward, of course... of course.
entries.translated_text: 什么？噢！我怎么可能忘。当然，当然...你的报酬。

entries.text: (Whisper) Oh wow, look at the carvings in the wall. Dwemer weren't typically taken to fanciful design, but... Oh. Right. Being quiet. Sorry.
entries.translated_text: （低语）哇哦，看看墙上的雕刻。锻莫一般可不采用这些花哨的设计，但是...哦。对的，安静，对不起。

entries.text: And another thing I'm positive about...
entries.translated_text: 还有一件事我很肯定...

entries.text: Out of Place Cauldron
entries.translated_text: 错位的釜

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣

entries.text: Scrap
entries.translated_text: 小渣
