entries.text: Yay! More drinks! I love having more drinks! You're the best, Anum-La!
entries.translated_text: 耶!更多的酒!我喜欢有更多的酒！你是最棒的，安努姆菈！

entries.text: Not right now.
entries.translated_text: 现在不是时候。

entries.text: Do you think so?
entries.translated_text: 你认为是这样吗？

entries.text: Oh? Running low on power?
entries.translated_text: 哦？ 能量不足？

entries.text: By the Eight, w-why are you running so quickly?! Is there something I don't know?!
entries.translated_text: 天哪，为什么你跑得这么快？有什么我不知道的吗？

entries.text: I once attended a Third Consecration of my birth father. It's supposed to make sure necromancers can't raise his body anymore. I guess we'll see.
entries.translated_text: 我曾经参加过我生父的第三次圣化仪式，据说这能确保死灵法师再也无法复活他的身体，我想，我们拭目以待吧。

entries.text: When I used to sail to Sentinel with my father, I used to be so sick the whole journey. Now I remember why. This rocking... My stomach...
entries.translated_text: 以前我和父亲一起航行去哨兵城时，我总是一路上晕得要死。现在我想起来为什么了。太晃了...我的胃...

entries.text: Perhaps. Perhaps not. What do you want?
entries.translated_text: 也许是，也许不是，你想要什么？

entries.text: Oh, do we have to kill it?
entries.translated_text: 哦，我们必须杀死它吗？

entries.text: Hey there!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！

entries.text: Hey there!
entries.translated_text: 嘿！

entries.text: A lot of places in Skyrim would be even more palatable is they replaced the people with automatons outright.
entries.translated_text: 如果他们把人直接换成机器人，那么天际中的很多地方就更美妙。

entries.text: You start running, so I can stab you in the back!
entries.translated_text: 你开始跑吧，这样我就可以在你背后捅你一刀！

entries.text: Someone handed me this bottle of mead. I prefer ale, so here you go.
entries.translated_text: 别人给我的蜜酒。但我更喜欢麦酒，所以给你。

entries.text: He wants to act like he understands how a family name being ruined feels, so I think I'll give him the inspiration his acting needs.
entries.translated_text: 他想装作自己懂得家族名誉被毁是什么感觉，那我就给他点灵感，让他的表演更逼真。

entries.text: That's what the Aetherium Forge was built for.
entries.translated_text: 神光水晶熔炉就是为此而建造的。

entries.text: You're going to love Arkngchal, I promise! It's such a beautiful ruin. Well, less beautiful with Morvic's ugly face inside it. We'll amend that soon.
entries.translated_text: 你会爱上阿卡切尔的，我保证!它是一个这么漂亮的遗址。嗯，有了莫维克的丑脸就不那么美了。但我们很快会修复好它。

entries.text: I can appreciate both gold and knowledge.
entries.translated_text: 我就既能欣赏黄金，也欣赏知识。

entries.text: Don't be daft. As though I'd ever make friends with some terrible, grumpy, miserable... grump!
entries.translated_text: 别傻了。我怎么可能会和某个人又坏，脾气又暴躁的，还愤世嫉俗的...老闷罐交朋友！

entries.text: You what?! B-but they try to kill us! All the time!
entries.translated_text: 你说什么？他们想杀了我们，一直都是。

entries.text: Everyone on this boat wants to kill ya, including me!
entries.translated_text: 这艘船上的每个人都想杀了你，包括我！

entries.text: Excellent! I'm so glad that you're with me on this!
entries.translated_text: 很好！我很高兴你能和我一起做这件事！

entries.text: I'm always here to talk.
entries.translated_text: 我随时都愿意倾听。

entries.text: Yes, the best way to see is to test it! Can't wait!
entries.translated_text: 是的，最好的观察方法是测试它！我等不及了！

entries.text: Wait... O-oh! I just, ah, remembered something.
entries.translated_text: 等等...哦-哦！我只是，啊，我想起了什么。

entries.text: Meat makes me feel sluggish.
entries.translated_text: 这些肉还是算了吧。

entries.text: That's the giant construct the dwemer built to attain godhood.
entries.translated_text: 那是锻莫为了获得神性而建造的巨型构造体。

entries.text: Honestly...
entries.translated_text: 说真的...

entries.text: Don't interrupt me while I'm thinking, Scrap! Oh great, what was I thinking about?
entries.translated_text: 不要在我思考的时候打断我，小渣！哦，太棒了，我在想什么？

entries.text: Defaced Dwemer Book
entries.translated_text: 污损的锻莫书

entries.text: I loved my visits there!
entries.translated_text: 我超喜欢去那里的！

entries.text: My parents would have reprimanded you for that. It's dangerous to find something unpredictable so enchanting.
entries.translated_text: 我的父母会因此而训斥你。沉迷于不可预测的东西是很危险的。

entries.text: As you know, he runs a rather lucrative business. He often comes across uncommon items.
entries.translated_text: 如你所知，他经营这一个很暴利的生意，他经常遇到一些不常见的物品。

entries.text: Fine, fine. Just don't come asking me to borrow some gold later once you see how much money this makes.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，好吧，等你看到这能赚多少钱以后，就别再来找我借钱了。

entries.text: It shouldn't take much effort for me to get this right.
entries.translated_text: 我应该花不了多少精力。

entries.text: This place is beautiful, but I can't stand the smell. Rot and blood. Probably more tolerable for vampires.
entries.translated_text: 这个地方很漂亮，但我无法忍受这种气味。腐烂与鲜血。对于吸血鬼来说可能更容易忍受。

entries.text: Yes, how's that? Good? Good!
entries.translated_text: 是的，现在怎么样？能动？动了！

entries.text: Over here, my Falmer friend! Follow my voice!
entries.translated_text: 在这里，我的伐莫朋友！跟随我的声音！

entries.text: (Gagging) Oh by the Eight! (Coughing). Ugh... Apparently, you shouldn't eat scathecrows.
entries.translated_text: （作呕）哦，八圣灵在上！（咳嗽）。呃...显然，你不应该吃苦痛草。

entries.text: That's all you're going to have?
entries.translated_text: 这就是你的全部？

entries.text: Take Remi to see yet another dwemer ruin.
entries.translated_text: 带着雷米去看下一个锻莫遗迹。

entries.text: Yes, what did you need?
entries.translated_text: 是的，你需要什么？

entries.text: So, are you going to get a drink, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你会去喝一杯吗？

entries.text: My favourite drink is Jagga. It's made of pig's milk and honey.
entries.translated_text: 我最喜欢的饮料是贾嘎。它是由猪奶和蜂蜜制成的。

entries.text: In that case, maybe I ought to be a legendary knight.
entries.translated_text: 在这种情况下，也许我应该能成为一个传奇的骑士。

entries.text: Well, it was... I had some good times exploring.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，那...我有一段很好的探索时间。

entries.text: You can't be serious.
entries.translated_text: 你在开玩笑吧？

entries.text: How do you think the Silver Hand know the Companions are werewolves? It's supposed to be a big secret, right?
entries.translated_text: 你认为白银之手怎么知道的战友团是狼人？这应该是个大秘密吧？

entries.text: I... This is a lot different from the last time someone asked me.
entries.translated_text: 我...这与上次有人问我时有很大不同。

entries.text: You could have just... asked me. I don't think you were wrong to kill him, for what it's worth. Morvic got what was coming to him.
entries.translated_text: 你本来可以...问我。我不认为你杀了他是错误的，因为它是值得的。莫维克得到了应有的代价。

entries.text: Oh! Sorry, I didn't mean to imply... So... I won't have to worry about being eaten.
entries.translated_text: 哦！抱歉，我不是故意的...所以...我不用担心被吃掉了。

entries.text: This is no time for jokes! This is serious science! How was it?
entries.translated_text: 现在不是开玩笑的时候！这是严肃的科学！它怎样？

entries.text: Isn't a giant spider going to make getting into the ruin dangerous?
entries.translated_text: 一只巨大的蜘蛛不会让进入遗址变得危险吗？

entries.text: Ohhh, I was a terrible child.
entries.translated_text: 哦，我是一个坏孩子。

entries.text: I'm sorry for what the dwemer did to you, but we're not them!
entries.translated_text: 我很抱歉锻莫对你做了什么，但我们不是他们！

entries.text: Scrap has asked me to tell you that you look much better wearing that sort of armour. Personally, I think he might have bias.
entries.translated_text: 小渣让我告诉你，你穿那种盔甲看起来好多了。我个人认为他可能有偏见。

entries.text: I don't think that I'll ever get used to you sucking the souls out of literal dragons.
entries.translated_text: 我想我永不会习惯你从真正的龙身上吸取灵魂。

entries.text: Well bye, Joshua. Bye for now, at least.
entries.translated_text: 再见，约书亚，至少现在是再见。

entries.text: And, well, I suppose I am curious about what a big group of mercenaries is like. Do they all smell as bad as you?
entries.translated_text: 而且，嗯，我想我很好奇一大群佣兵在一起会是什么样子的。他们都和你一样难闻吗？

entries.text: Raven.
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦。

entries.text: What is this thing?
entries.translated_text: 这是什么东西？

entries.text: Oh! I know! You're a great, strong adventurer, aren't you?
entries.translated_text: 嗷！我知道！你是一名伟大又坚韧的冒险者，不是吗？

entries.text: Sometimes the steam in the pipes sounds like screaming... Those are the pipes, right?
entries.translated_text: 有时管道里的蒸汽听起来像谁在尖叫...是这些管道的声音，对吧？

entries.text: They're for me.
entries.translated_text: 这是给我的。

entries.text: They're for me.
entries.translated_text: 这是给我的。

entries.text: They're for me.
entries.translated_text: 这是给我的。

entries.text: They're for me.
entries.translated_text: 这是给我的。

entries.text: Alright, let's trade. I'm a Breton, too, though.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我们来交易吧。不过，我也是布莱顿人。

entries.text: But you are not a stranger anymore. So it is fine.
entries.translated_text: 但你不再是陌生人了。所以没关系。

entries.text: Terrible.
entries.translated_text: 太糟糕了。

entries.text: Oh, and if you get confused by what the protagonist does with the talking axe at the end... It's a metaphor. Lots of people don't get that.
entries.translated_text: 哦，如果你对主人公在结尾处对那把会说话的斧头所做的事情感到困惑的话...这是个隐喻。很多人都不明白这一点。

entries.text: Is it true that the plants there are sentient? And they grow right before your eyes?
entries.translated_text: 那里的植物真的有知觉吗？它们能在你眼前生长？

entries.text: Let's head to Understone Keep and find Calcelmo.
entries.translated_text: 让我们前往石下要塞，找到卡塞莫。

entries.text: Now that I think on it, I did hear something interesting the other day. It's all in this note.
entries.translated_text: 现在我想起来了，前几天我确实听到了一些有趣的事情，都在这个笔记中。

entries.text: They'd have to be. And if we don't tell them ahead of time, it'll make the scenario more realistic.
entries.translated_text: 他们必须这样做，如果我们不提前告诉他们，就会让场景更逼真。

entries.text: Now watch my mastery of alcohol drinking!
entries.translated_text: 现在看我喝酒的本事！

entries.text: Mortu it is! Do you like Mor? I think it sounds cute!
entries.translated_text: 就叫莫尔图！你喜欢莫尔吗？我觉得这听起来很可爱！

entries.text: Um... Let me see what I have...
entries.translated_text: 嗯...让我看看我有什么...

entries.text: It's kind of funny. The Companions have the most Nord qualities of anyone I've met, but for some reason, I think I like them.
entries.translated_text: 这听起来有点好笑。在我见过的所有人中，战友团的性格最诺德，但出于某种原因，我认为我好像觉得他们还不错。

entries.text: The enormous mushrooms here are called 'Emperor Parasols'. They aren't indigineous to Solstheim; they come from Morrowind proper.
entries.translated_text: 这里的巨大蘑菇被称为“帕拉索帝王伞”。它们对索瑟海姆来说并不陌生，它们本来自晨风。

entries.text: I admit it, Scrap is growing on me. He really does have a lot of personality, and unexpected loyalty.
entries.translated_text: 我承认，我越来越喜欢小渣了。他真的很有个性，而且出人意料地忠诚。

entries.text: Stormhaven.
entries.translated_text: 风暴港。

entries.text: Yes, excellent! Let's kill that spider and head into Nchuand-zel!
entries.translated_text: 是的，很棒！让我们杀死那只蜘蛛，然后进入楚安德-泽尔！

entries.text: If you distract the clerk, I'll pinch some goods.
entries.translated_text: 如果你能分散店员的注意力，我会拿走一些东西。

entries.text: Well, it is a swamp. They probably figure it's close enough to Black Marsh.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这是一个沼泽。他们可能决定这就是黑沼泽了。

entries.text: I really don't think that's likely. Dwemer spiders can't magic away corpses, no matter how much like 'magic spiders' they seem.
entries.translated_text: 我认为这不可能。锻莫蜘蛛没法用魔法带走尸体，不管它们看起来多么像'魔法蜘蛛'。

entries.text: That's right. Eat up. Good boy. You're such a good-OW! Scrap! Why?
entries.translated_text: 这就对了。要吃饱。好孩子。你真是个好--嗷！小渣！为什么？

entries.text: What? I was just thinking you're a mage, so-
entries.translated_text: 什么？我只是觉得你是个法师，所以...

entries.text: The giant dwemer crossbows in here...Their attack power can surely be replicated...
entries.translated_text: 这里的巨型矮人弩……他们的攻击艾克力量肯定可以复制……

entries.text: The giant dwemer crossbows in here...Their attack power can surely be replicated...
entries.translated_text: 这里的巨型矮人弩……他们的攻击艾克力量肯定可以复制……

entries.text: The giant dwemer crossbows in here...Their attack power can surely be replicated...
entries.translated_text: 这里的巨型矮人弩...他们的攻击威力肯定可以复制...

entries.text: 'Nikriin?' What does that mean?
entries.translated_text: “尼克林？”这是什么意思？

entries.text: You've seen all the dwemer ruins in High Rock?
entries.translated_text: 你去过高岩所有的矮人遗迹吗？

entries.text: When you're going through my stuff, let me know if you see the cog I misplaced. I can't find anything in my bag.
entries.translated_text: 当你检查我的东西时，如果你看到我放错地方的齿轮，请告诉我。我在我的包里什么也找不到。

entries.text: So?
entries.translated_text: 所以呢？

entries.text: Fine! Now move along before you get me in trouble.
entries.translated_text: 好吧！快走开，免得让我惹麻烦。

entries.text: I know, but our party can handle it without him risking injury.
entries.translated_text: 我知道，但我们的团队能够应付这些危险，没必要让他受损。

entries.text: So, you've killed one. And here I thought I would lose this competition.
entries.translated_text: 所以，你杀了一个。那么，我想我会输掉这场比赛。

entries.text: I want you to stop using your lantern.
entries.translated_text: 我希望你停止使用你的灯。

entries.text: Adventure, and good company.
entries.translated_text: 冒险，还有好伙伴。

entries.text: Oh, the little new Gildergreen is... really great... It really was worth all the effort...
entries.translated_text: 哦，新的小镀绿树...真的很棒...所有的努力都是值得的...

entries.text: You don't have to worry about Morvic anymore.
entries.translated_text: 你不必再担心莫维克了。

entries.text: I'm so jealous!
entries.translated_text: 我真嫉妒！

entries.text: Were you ever in a relationship with someone other than Morvic?
entries.translated_text: 你是否曾与莫维克以外的人有过恋情？

entries.text: Really, it probably just needs to be a thin but sturdy strip of metal.
entries.translated_text: 真的，它也许就只需要一条薄而坚固的金属条。

entries.text: Actually, yes, I do. You, ah, you can lift those big swords?
entries.translated_text: 事实上，是的，我知道。你，啊，你能举起那些大剑吗？

entries.text: What are you doing?
entries.translated_text: 你在做什么？

entries.text: Hm. I'm trying to decide, Gore, if you're more like the third mercenary I hired, or the fifth.
entries.translated_text: 嗯。格雷，我要想想你是我雇佣的第三个还是第五个佣兵。

entries.text: We'll throw in those potatoes, carrots, and the apple slices...
entries.translated_text: 我们会把土豆、胡萝卜和苹果片扔进去...

entries.text: I hate Windhelm.
entries.translated_text: 我讨厌风舵城。

entries.text: Well, if they are, I'll punch them!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，如果他们是，我会打他们！

entries.text: An entire organization dedicated to being your personal bodyguards. My bodyguard has bodyguards. That makes me extra safe, doesn't it?
entries.translated_text: 一整个致力于成为您的私人侍卫的组织。我的保镖有保镖。这让我更加安全，不是吗？

entries.text: The Rift is quite beautiful, with the colourful trees.
entries.translated_text: 裂谷领很漂亮，有五颜六色的树木。

entries.text: I kept a piece that resonates with the main component.
entries.translated_text: 我留了一块能与主要组件共鸣的部件。

entries.text: Make me proud.
entries.translated_text: 就看你的了。

entries.text: Okay. When you were... er... like that. Before. Uh, transformed. Did you... Well, did you know who I was? Could you recognize me?
entries.translated_text: 好吧。当你...呃...之前那样的时候，就是变身后，你...嗯，你还知道我是谁吗？你能认出我吗？

entries.text: Skyrim sometimes has such a united fashion sense, it seems.
entries.translated_text: 天际的时尚有时候真统一。

entries.text: My name is... (Names O-S)
entries.translated_text: 我的名字是...（O-S）

entries.text: Well, then you can go off and cook your own food.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那你就可以自己做饭了。

entries.text: Yeah, yeah.
entries.translated_text: 好，好。

entries.text: Yeah, yeah.
entries.translated_text: 好，好。

entries.text: Since he died in a fishing accident, his body was lost and never Consecrated.
entries.translated_text: 自从他在一次钓鱼事故中去世后，他的尸体就丢失了，还没被圣化过。

entries.text: Uh-huh.
entries.translated_text: 嗯哼。

entries.text: I already know lots about it! You even said I'm almost as smart as you!
entries.translated_text: 我已经知道很多了！你甚至说我几乎和你一样聪明！

entries.text: Sounds messy.
entries.translated_text: 听起来很乱。

entries.text: I'm from Cyrodiil.
entries.translated_text: 我来自赛瑞迪尔。

entries.text: That's certainly a scary thought.
entries.translated_text: 那确实是个可怕的想法。

entries.text: Oh, some cogs! Where'd you get those?
entries.translated_text: 哦，一些齿轮！你从哪儿弄来的？

entries.text: I never thought I'd meet an Orc who is a bard. Although Yazakh doesn't seem the singing type.
entries.translated_text: 我从没想过我会遇到一个吟游诗人兽人。虽然雅扎克看起来不是会唱歌的那种人。

entries.text: Ah! Yes, please drink those immediately in that case!
entries.translated_text: 啊!是的，如果那样的话到时候请喝下这些！

entries.text: She gets driven made by the monotonous nature of her job and the story ends with her snapping and killing her employer.
entries.translated_text: 她被单调乏味的工作逼疯了，故事的结尾是她崩溃并杀死了她的雇主。

entries.text: Well, I definitely prefer a warm fire to the traveling bit. But I love exploring once we actually reach our destination, you know?
entries.translated_text: 嗯，我当然更喜欢围着温暖的篝火，而不是旅途本身。不过，一旦我们真的抵达目的地，我就特别喜欢去探索，你懂的。

entries.text: But yes, I was a child, then. It was... scary. But in the end, nothing bad happened to my family, so it's less frightening to think of now.
entries.translated_text: 但是，是的，那时我还是个孩子。那是......可怕。但最后，我的家人没有发生任何不好的事情，所以现在想想就不那么可怕了。

entries.text: Do you have any idea why Remi stares at my tusks so often? I'm sure they're not *that* impressive.
entries.translated_text: 你知道蕾米为什么经常盯着我的獠牙吗？我肯定它们没那么好看。

entries.text: Well, there's the problem! I thought you just didn't like me.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，问题来了！我以为你只是不喜欢我。

entries.text: I hate it. It tastes like century old Giant broth.
entries.translated_text: 我讨厌它。它尝起来像一个世纪以前的巨人肉汤。

entries.text: That's definitely going to bruise.
entries.translated_text: 那可会留下淤青的。

entries.text: Done!
entries.translated_text: 完成！

entries.text: We run today, so we can win tomorrow.
entries.translated_text: 今天的撤退是为了明天的胜利

entries.text: Bangkorai.
entries.translated_text: 邦可然。

entries.text: Scrap, do you think my dear spouse would awfully mind if I wrote about them in my book? No, don't ask; I'm too nervous!
entries.translated_text: 小渣，你认为我亲爱的爱人会非常介意我在书中写到他们吗？不，不要问；我太紧张了！

entries.text: It's always about food with you, isn't it? But I suppose it would be a waste not to eat.
entries.translated_text: 你总是喜欢谈吃的，不是吗？但我想，吃饭不积极脑子有问题。

entries.text: But apparently not lost enough, since it was found under the employ of a band of necromancers in the next Fiefdom over, Alcaire.
entries.translated_text: 但显然不是真正的丢失了，在阿尔凯瑞的一群死灵法师那里发现了他。

entries.text: Yeah! That's right!
entries.translated_text: 是的！就是这样！

entries.text: Not sure what the point of that was, but don't even start explaining. I don't care. Mead.
entries.translated_text: 我不懂这什么意思，但也别告诉我。我不在乎。来瓶蜜酒。

entries.text: Sheor curse you!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔诅咒你！

entries.text: Okay, what do you want to talk about?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，你想聊什么？

entries.text: I don't trust the look of those things at all.
entries.translated_text: 从他的样子来看我不太相信他。

entries.text: Ah! Gore, aren't you supposed to be a great mercenary or some such?! Come help me!
entries.translated_text: 啊！格雷, 你不是一个伟大的佣兵吗？！来帮帮我！

entries.text: Well, I hate to be the one to ask Zora for more.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，我不想这么贪得无厌。

entries.text: Ugh. Well, that makes me think you're more like the fifth, then. A big mouth who spouted whatever nonsense came to mind.
entries.translated_text: 啊。那么，这让我觉得你更像是第五个。脑子里有什么废话就从嘴里吐的大嘴巴。

entries.text: I *suppose* I can make some space for your things.
entries.translated_text: 我*想*我可以给你的东西腾出一些空间。

entries.text: That is... Hm. Thank you, I think?
entries.translated_text: 那是...嗯，谢谢你，我想？

entries.text: My liege likes to live dangerously.
entries.translated_text: 我的大王喜欢危险的生活。

entries.text: The letter! I was *hoping* it'd lure Morvic into Skyrim, and clearly, it worked! He's in Markarth...
entries.translated_text: 信！我希望它会引导莫维克来天际，很明显，它奏效了！他就在马卡斯...

entries.text: Ubbe. That's a nice name.
entries.translated_text: 乌贝，这名字真好听。

entries.text: Oh. Okay, well. I've just been worrying lately about being a hinderance more than an asset. To our team. Do you know what I mean?
entries.translated_text: 哦，好吧。我最近一直在担心自己是不是在拖后腿，而不是在为我们的团队贡献力量。你明白我的意思吗？

entries.text: I gave Remi a sweet roll, and now she says it gave her energy she needs to burn off. She asked me to take her to a dwemer ruin called Arkngchal, near the border of High Rock.
entries.translated_text: 我给了蕾米一个甜卷，现在她说这给了她运动需要的能量。她让我带她去一个名叫阿卡切尔的矮人遗址，靠近高岩的边界。

entries.text: I've always felt the Forsworn were no better than Witchmen. Ever since Cidhna Mine, I've felt vindicated in that belief.
entries.translated_text: 我一直觉得弃誓者和巫族没什么两样。自从希讷矿坑事件发生后，我的这种想法得到了证实。

entries.text: Don't mention anything about Scrap to that wizard. He'll think the spider should belong to him...
entries.translated_text: 不要向那个法师提及任何关于小渣的事情。因为他会认为蜘蛛应该属于他……

entries.text: Should we have a Black-Briar Mead while we're here?
entries.translated_text: 我们在这里的时候应该喝黑棘蜜酒吗？

entries.text: So I went diving. Couldn't get the smell out for weeks. My mother was so angry.
entries.translated_text: 所以我去潜水了。好几个星期都闻不到气味。我妈妈很生气。

entries.text: Kilkreath Catacombs
entries.translated_text: 基尔克瑞斯地下墓穴

entries.text: Why is that?
entries.translated_text: 怎么了？

entries.text: The Nords do love their stonework!
entries.translated_text: 诺德人确实喜欢他们的石雕！

entries.text: Tonal architecture is used to alter reality. Perhaps these convectors are using a similar principle on this soul gem?
entries.translated_text: 音律架构可以改变现实。也许这些环流器在这个灵魂石上使用了类似的原理？

entries.text: Well, I haven't decided yet. I could create a... trap. Or a device to communicate long distances. Or something that can do boring tasks for me. Or-
entries.translated_text: 这个嘛，我还没决定，我可以制造一个...陷阱、一个远距离通讯设备或者能帮我完成无聊任务的东西或者-

entries.text: I decided to join the Forsworn.
entries.translated_text: 我决定了加入弃誓者。

entries.text: Yes! Dwemer metal is beyond anything any modern-day society had even imagined! You created the oil yourself? Genius!
entries.translated_text: 是的！锻莫金属是现代社会的工艺无法想象！这油是你自己创造的吗？天才！

entries.text: I stole this necklace for you.
entries.translated_text: 我为你偷了这条项链。

entries.text: Excellent work, Nar! We make a good team!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，纳尔！我们是一支优秀的团队！

entries.text: Dwarven Spider Guardian
entries.translated_text: 矮人蜘蛛守护者

entries.text: If we were smart, we wouldn't be adventurers. We would be scholars or librarians, or some other horrifyingly dull occupation.
entries.translated_text: 如果我们真聪明的话，就不会当什么冒险者了。我们大概会去当学者、图书管理员，或者别的那种无聊到死的职业。

entries.text: W-walk?!
entries.translated_text: 走路？！

entries.text: Look at all of this! This was definitely not here when I stayed here last.
entries.translated_text: 看看这一切吧!我上次住在这里时，这里绝对不是这样的。

entries.text: This is your best chance a-at learrrning all of my secrets...
entries.translated_text: 这是你了解我所有秘密的最佳机会……

entries.text: Yes, well, it's also accurate, so I don't feel too bad about saying it.
entries.translated_text: 是的，好吧，这也挺准的，所以我不觉得说出来会太糟糕。

entries.text: Where did Remi go?
entries.translated_text: 蕾米去哪儿了？

entries.text: We'll likely need medical equipment, as well as equipment to alter dwemer metal.
entries.translated_text: 我们可能需要一些医疗器械，以及改变锻莫金属的器械。

entries.text: I figured you'd want to see more.
entries.translated_text: 我想你会想看更多的。

entries.text: Would we consider this a happy customer? Selling love sounds like something I used to hear about in Camlorn. I don't think this is the same somehow.
entries.translated_text: 这算一位满意的顾客吗？贩卖爱情听起来像是我以前在卡姆隆听说过的事情，但不知为何，我觉得这并不是一回事。

entries.text: While I do respect these warlocks setting up ominous lairs, they tend to lean toward necromancy, which immediately erases that respect.
entries.translated_text: 虽然我确实很欣赏这些术士设立的邪恶巢穴，但他们修炼的死灵法术让我失去了这种好感。

entries.text: It's a lot brighter and warmer than Skyrim. Less dangerous, more open-minded, slightly more boring maybe - but only slightly.
entries.translated_text: 它比天际要明亮和温暖得多。没有那么危险，思想更开放，也许稍微有点无聊--但只是稍微有点。

entries.text: I can tell by how simply you described it that you're not imagining it in its full glory.
entries.translated_text: 听你说这话就知道你根本不知道这有多好吃。

entries.text: I love Markarth, but I think they should invest in some sort of elevator system.
entries.translated_text: 我喜欢马卡斯城，但我认为他们应该投资一些升降梯系统。

entries.text: Oooh, I see.
entries.translated_text: 哦——，我明白了。

entries.text: It's so bizarre, isn't it? All their dishes and books just left out.
entries.translated_text: 这太奇怪了，不是吗？他们所有的菜肴和书籍都还留着。

entries.text: Oh, and Ganbald- Oh, you're walking away. Were we done talking?
entries.translated_text: 哦，还有甘巴尔德——哦，你要走了。我们谈完了吗？

entries.text: Have you ever seen the Reachmen in High Rock? That's where the Forsworn come from, I think.
entries.translated_text: 你见过高岩的边塞人吗？我想，这就是弃誓者的来历。

entries.text: I don't mean to be rude, but I can't stand that slaves still exist in your homeland! All creatures are meant to live their lives freely!
entries.translated_text: 我无意冒犯，但我无法忍受奴隶仍然存在于你的故乡！所有的生物都应该自由地生活！

entries.text: You're really going to fight me and Revan?!
entries.translated_text: 你真的要和我和渡鸦打架吗？！

entries.text: You're right; that does sound too difficult.
entries.translated_text: 你是对的，这听起来太难了。

entries.text: We don't have time for this.
entries.translated_text: 我们没有时间做这个。

entries.text: I'm buyin' a new boat after this!
entries.translated_text: 在这之后我将买一艘新船！

entries.text: Anyway, I don't want to get a bounty.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，我不想被悬赏。

entries.text: Well, there's nothing for it. Shall we head out?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，没什么用，我们出去好吗？

entries.text: Well, there's nothing for it. Shall we head out?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，在这里待着无济于事，我们出去好吗？

entries.text: Even though I had nothing to do with it, the city guard investigated me when their little business was found out.
entries.translated_text: 尽管我与这件事无关，但当他们的小生意被发现时时，城市卫队对我进行了调查。

entries.text: That's an interesting idea...
entries.translated_text: 真是一个有趣的想法...

entries.text: She poked fun at me for having to ask, but she agreed, and I was elated.
entries.translated_text: 她取笑我非得问，但她同意了，我很高兴。

entries.text: How did you get the scars on your face?
entries.translated_text: 你脸上的伤疤是怎么来的？

entries.text: I don't know, Septimus doesn't seem that insane to me.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道，塞普汀默斯在我看来并没有那么疯狂。

entries.text: These things make my skin crawl!
entries.translated_text: 这些东西让我起鸡皮疙瘩!

entries.text: So? What do you think of my ruin? She's beautiful, isn't she?
entries.translated_text: 所以？你觉得我的遗址怎么样？她很漂亮，不是吗？

entries.text: You'll have to be more specific. There are many stenches in here.
entries.translated_text: 你必须说得更具体些。这里有很多臭味。

entries.text: To the next fight! I swear on the Hist it'll be a good one.
entries.translated_text: 为下一场战斗干杯!我以希思特神树的名义发誓，这将是一场精彩战斗。

entries.text: Ow! Ummm... Do you have any healing salve? I may have sliced my finger while trying to adjust Scrap's gears.
entries.translated_text: 哦！嗯……你有治愈药膏吗？我在尝试调整小渣的齿轮时划伤了手指。

entries.text: Come on, have some faith! I guess I'll just test it like last time?
entries.translated_text: 拜托，相信我一次！我猜我还是像上次那样测试一下？

entries.text: Remi has an idea for making lockpicking a quicker process. She wants to create a 'tension wrench' from a bit of iron at the forge in Markarth. Remi and I have arrived at the forge, and she's seemed to have made something. I should ask her about it.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米有个想法，让开锁变得更快。她想在马卡斯城的锻造厂用一点铁制造一个“张力扳手”。我和蕾米已经到了熔炉，她好像做了什么。我应该问她这件事。

entries.text: Okay, Nar! We can do this!
entries.translated_text: 好的，纳尔！我们能做到！

entries.text: Of course, I do! Have you *seen* me? Come on!
entries.translated_text: 当然!你*见过*我这样吗？来吧！

entries.text: A new contract? You'll share they payment with me, right?
entries.translated_text: 一份新契约？你会和我分享他们的酬金的，对吧？

entries.text: Yay!
entries.translated_text: 呀！

entries.text: I much prefer my actual wrist to the 'better' wrist my weapon may or may not be.
entries.translated_text: 我更喜欢我的实际上的手腕，而不是对我的武器来说可能会可能不会”更好“的手腕。

entries.text: I struggle to notice propositions because I forget that others have more carnal desires.
entries.translated_text: 我很难注意到那些暗示，因为我忘记了其他人有更多的肉体欲望。

entries.text: Teldryn, look out!
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因，小心！

entries.text: (Laugh) Trust me, you don't want me to sing.
entries.translated_text: （笑）相信我，你不想让我唱歌的。

entries.text: Please do not expect my assistance too much in your seeking of Mara's Blessing. Playing matchmaker reminds me too much of the nobles in Wayrest.
entries.translated_text: 别太期待我能帮你寻求到玛拉的祝福，当媒人总让我想起途歇城的那些贵族。

entries.text: Oh, good, I was just about to come talk to you. You see, I've been thinking and- actually, that thought's not ready for you yet. Never mind.
entries.translated_text: 哦，很好，我正要来和你谈谈。你看，我一直在想，实际上，这个想法不是特别成熟。不要介意。

entries.text: Mages have their way of doing things, and we have ours.
entries.translated_text: 法师有他们做事的方式，我们也有我们的方式。

entries.text: Doctor, you are very good at leading. At least, I think you are. I'm following you, in any case.
entries.translated_text: 医生，你很擅长领导。至少，我认为你是这样。无论如何，我都在关注你。

entries.text: I'm sure you're much more familiar with all the little necessities that go overlooked by non-adventurous types, Gore?
entries.translated_text: 我敢肯定你对那些不喜欢冒险的人常忽视的必需品更加了解，格雷？

entries.text: (Laugh) I don't know about that. I dropped out of school when I was a boy. I'm not educated, like you are.
entries.translated_text: （笑）我不知道。我很小就辍学了。我没有像你一样受过教育。

entries.text: The dragons don't rule anymore. You're behind the times, my friend.
entries.translated_text: 龙族不再统治了，你已经落伍了，我的朋友。

entries.text: (Gasp) That's it! That's the part I've been overlooking, of course, it's so simple if I think of it that way...!
entries.translated_text: （吸气）就是这样！这是我一直忽略了的部分，当然，如果我这样想的话，它这么简单......！

entries.text: I can certainly understand that. There are so many to choose from, it's all the same to choose none of them.
entries.translated_text: 我当然能理解这一点。有这么多可以选择的东西，一个都不选都是一样的。

entries.text: Where are we headed next, Joshua?
entries.translated_text: 我们下一步要去哪里，约书亚？

entries.text: Wow, it's morning already? And as usual, it seems I've forgotten to sleep.
entries.translated_text: 哇，已经是早上了？和往常一样，我似乎忘记睡觉了。

entries.text: Well, no, but I haven't really had the time to get some better ingredients. Haven't felt up to bartering over prices with alchemists.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，是的，但我确实没时间去找更好的材料了。也不太有心情和炼金术士讨价还价

texts: Just... Try not to drop it on me. Ohhhhh, being crushed is the absolutel worst way to die!
只是...尽量不要把它丢在我身上。呵呵呵，被石头压死绝对是最糟糕的死法！

entries.text: It's hard for me to believe you could.
entries.translated_text: 我很难相信你能做到。

entries.text: But I think he has potential.
entries.translated_text: 但我认为他有潜力。

entries.text: And yet you wrote that letter, attempting to besmirch my name further. I'm no fool. You are a snake.
entries.translated_text: 但你却写了那封信，试图进一步玷污我的名誉。我可不是傻子。你就是一条毒蛇。

entries.text: Whatever it is, it's awful. O-of course, I didn't bite out of it or anything. I could... just tell.
entries.translated_text: 无论是什么，都很糟糕。当然，我才不是咬了一口什么的。我只是...一眼就看出来了。

entries.text: The Bee and Barb
entries.translated_text: 蜂与钩

entries.text: Return to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 回到蕾米身边。

entries.text: Return to Remi.
entries.translated_text: 回到蕾米身边。

entries.text: Or maybe we can check out the Arch-Mage's quarters? I can live up there, too, right?
entries.translated_text: 或者我们可以看看首席法师居住区？我也可以住在那里，对吧？

entries.text: I'm not sure any of those foppish Legion types even noticed I was gone, if they knew I was there in the first place.
entries.translated_text: 我不确定那些矫揉造作的军团成员有没有注意到我离开了，如果他们一开始就知道我在那儿的话。

entries.text: Not much. I found something for you.
entries.translated_text: 这些东西是我为你找的，但不多。

entries.text: Could you imagine me in the Legion?
entries.translated_text: 你能想象我在军团的样子吗？

entries.text: Woah, what is this place? Some sort of dwemer arena?
entries.translated_text: 哇，这是什么地方？某种锻莫竞技场？

entries.text: This Pumping Station likely provided the entire city with fresh water.
entries.translated_text: 这个泵站可能为整个城市提供了淡水。

entries.text: They sound fascinating.
entries.translated_text: 它们听起来很吸引人。

entries.text: Tell him you want to see the excavation site, and convince him we'll take care of his spider problem!
entries.translated_text: 告诉他你想看看挖掘现场，并说服他我们会解决他的蜘蛛困扰！

entries.text: I used to love art, you know.
entries.translated_text: 我过去喜欢艺术，你知道的。

entries.text: Okay, Scrap, our top priority is keeping Khash safe! Got it?
entries.translated_text: 好的，小渣，我们的首要任务是确保卡什的安全！懂吗？

entries.text: Perhaps it'll make me feel more empathetic. Although so far it mostly just makes me hate them more.
entries.translated_text: 也许这将使我感到更有同理心。虽然到目前为止，它大多只是让我更讨厌他们。

entries.text: And they're going to just... keep him in a prison cell?
entries.translated_text: 他们就打算...只把他关在牢房里？

entries.text: Oh! Good, you're out of that trap! I was almost definitely about to figure out how to free you. Would've only been a couple more minutes.
entries.translated_text: 太好了，你脱困了！我差点就想出解救你的办法了。只要再过几分钟就好。

entries.text: Are you going to regale me with whatever you discovered while you had me standing here? No?
entries.translated_text: 你要跟我说说，你让我站在这里时发现了什么？不说？

entries.text: I was accidentally staring at someone while thinking, and now they keep looking over at me. Don't look, though. I'm pretending they're not there.
entries.translated_text: 我在思考时不小心盯着某人，现在他们一直盯着我。不过别看过去。我假装他们不在那里。

entries.text: You'll likely have to help me finish my meal anyway. My eyes are always bigger than my stomach.
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，你可能得帮我吃顿好的。我的肚子已经快比眼睛小了。

entries.text: I don't know if that's how I'd describe it.
entries.translated_text: 我不知道我能否会这样形容它。

entries.text: I'm not a real mage, and I suppose I get a bit defensive when someone asks me whether 'I know magic'.
entries.translated_text: 我不是一个真正的法师，我想当有人问我“我是否懂魔法”时，我都会有点无奈。

entries.text: Well, that went about as poorly as one could expect.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，这一切都很糟糕。

entries.text: What sort of name is 'Borkul the Beast'? Although I must admit it does evoke a sort of 'I am to be feared' imagery.
entries.translated_text: “野兽波库尔”是个什么名字？虽然我必须承认，这确实给人"我很可怕"的感觉。

entries.text: Think of it like a spigot on a mead barrel.
entries.translated_text: 把它想象成蜜酒桶上的龙头。

entries.text: I suppose what I'm trying to say is: I apologize. For treating you like a moron. Although sometimes you are very Nord-y.
entries.translated_text: 我想我想说的是：请接受我的道歉。把你当成白痴。虽然有时候你很诺德。

entries.text: Actually, never mind.
entries.translated_text: 其实，没关系。

entries.text: Is this going to be another one of those conversations where you're mean, or can I relax?
entries.translated_text: 又要说那种你刻薄的话吗，还是我可以放松点？

entries.text: Tension Wrench Perk
entries.translated_text: 张力扳手

entries.text: I think we should just ignore him and go on our way.
entries.translated_text: 我想我们不应该理他，继续走我们的路。

entries.text: Stormcloaks are fools. You have nothing to fear from them.
entries.translated_text: 风暴斗篷就是群傻瓜。你没有什么可害怕他们的。

entries.text: I- oh... Never mind... I do not have my book anymore...
entries.translated_text: 我——哦...算了吧...我已经没有那本书了...

entries.text: I could say the same about every Nord home. I didn't know Nords were so ugly!
entries.translated_text: 我可以对每个诺德人的家都这么说。我没想到诺德人的房子都如此丑陋！

entries.text: The Nightingales...? I think I read a book with the name before.
entries.translated_text: 夜莺...？我想我以前读过一本同名的书。

entries.text: I wish people just said what they meant instead of being so... roundabout with their words.
entries.translated_text: 我希望人们能打开天窗说亮话，而不是...绕来绕去。

entries.text: I'm not a fan of the law either, but you've gone a little too far, don't you think?
entries.translated_text: 我也不是法律的拥护者，但你走得太远了，你不觉得吗？

entries.text: Is now really a good time?
entries.translated_text: 现在真的是好时候吗？

entries.text: Return to Remi to see her finished product.
entries.translated_text: 回到蕾米那里看看她的成品。

entries.text: ;Asked about Remi's family
entries.translated_text: ;AskedaboutRemi'sfamily

entries.text: That's rather... thoughtful. So creating these characters is a form of training for mine-reading. Or training for guessing at mind-reading.
entries.translated_text: 这倒是挺...周到的。所以创造这些人物是一种练习阅读他人内心的方式。或者说,是练习猜测他人心理的训练。

entries.text: Okay, great! Next time we're at an inn around here, someone remind me to tell one.
entries.translated_text: 好，太棒了！下次我们在附近的旅馆时，记得提醒我说一个。

entries.text: You haven't died, have you, Buffy? Good.
entries.translated_text: 你还没死，对吧，巴非？好。

entries.text: And that same habit gave me practice in getting around unnoticed.
entries.translated_text: 同样的习惯也让我练就了不被人发现的本领。

entries.text: He made quite the fortune trading in Sentinel in Hammerfell.
entries.translated_text: 他在落锤省的哨兵城交易中赚了不少钱。

entries.text: I prefer the methods without magic. N-not that I, er, *need* you to teach me, of course.
entries.translated_text: 我更喜欢没有魔法的方法。当然，不是说我需要你教我。

entries.text: The Psijic monk stopped time to speak to me.
entries.translated_text: 赛伊克僧侣静止了时间和我说话。

entries.text: Ummmm.... Here, my share of the spoils, all for you.
entries.translated_text: 嗯....给你，我的战利品，都给你。

entries.text: Well, maybe they could try and play whatever Scrap writes. Or... invent an instrument that would allow them to play it.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，也许他们可以试着演奏小渣写的东西。或者......发明一种能让他们演奏的乐器。

entries.text: You could be better than this!
entries.translated_text: 你可以比这更好！

entries.text: Nar, if you could kill them now, I'd appreciate it!
entries.translated_text: 纳尔，如果你现在能杀了他们，我会很感激！

entries.text: ...If I swapped that wire... Larger soul gem...?
entries.translated_text: ...如果我改变那根线路...使用更大的灵魂石...？

entries.text: Sometimes, er, my thoughts become words more quickly than I can remember that some thoughts are maybe better left as just thoughts. Sorry.
entries.translated_text: 有时，呃，我的嘴巴里的话根本不会过脑子，有些想法也许最好只是想法。对不起。

entries.text: They're... very exciting, aren't they?
entries.translated_text: 这些弩……真厉害，不是吗？

entries.text: At last! Now, we eat!
entries.translated_text: 最后一步，现在开吃！

entries.text: After what seemed eras, the low weeping of a tortured soul reached his ears. As he watched, the wraith clawed herself out from her makeshift grave.
entries.translated_text: 似乎过了很久之后，一个饱受折磨的灵魂伴随着低沉的哭泣声来到了他的耳边。在他抬头观察时，幽灵从她的新坟中走了出来。

entries.text: Oh, this again.
entries.translated_text: 哦，又来。

entries.text: A Dwarven ruin!
entries.translated_text: 矮人的遗址！

entries.text: It's so cold. I can't feel my nose. Or my lips. Just my whole face, actually.
entries.translated_text: 太冷了。我感觉不到我的鼻子，或者我的嘴唇，实际上，是我的整张脸了。

entries.text: I wouldn't want to join them.
entries.translated_text: 我不会想加入他们。

entries.text: Ah, don't worry about it, Remi. You're funny. Don't overthink it. That's not funny.
entries.translated_text: 啊，别担心，蕾米。你很有趣。不要想得太多。我没在笑你。

entries.text: It's more high-brow than most things I consider funny, but yet it never fails to make me laugh.
entries.translated_text: 虽然它比我觉得有趣的大多数事情都要高雅，但它总是能让我发笑。

entries.text: I- I'm pretty sure I'm alive. I think.
entries.translated_text: 我-我很确定我还活着。我想。

entries.text: And you also like makeup, so it's a win-win.
entries.translated_text: 你也喜欢化妆，所以这是双赢的。

entries.text: Why Barbas even wants to be around Clavicus Vile I'll never understand. He deserves a daedric lord that will cherish him and treat him right.
entries.translated_text: 为什么巴巴斯甚至还想和卡拉威库斯·维尔在一起，甚至我无法理解。他应该有一个会珍惜他并好好对待他的魔神。

entries.text: Auri, we seem to be under attack!
entries.translated_text: 奥璃，我们似乎受到了攻击！

entries.text: Anyway, I just had to explore it a little! It seems as though it was some sort of center for learning and research.
entries.translated_text: 不管怎么说，我就是要去探索一下！它似乎是某种学术研究中心。

entries.text: Oh! Oh! It's haunted! This place is haunted! Maybe that Ghost Bard will play us ghost music?!
entries.translated_text: 哦！哦！闹鬼了！这个地方闹鬼了！也许那个幽灵吟游诗人会给我们播放幽灵音乐？！

entries.text: Wayrest is a big city, so being surrounded by trees is different for me. Let's find the biggest one and climb it?
entries.translated_text: 途歇城是一个大城市，所以被树木环绕对我有点新鲜，我们找棵最大的爬上去吧？

entries.text: He's trying to reenact the activation of the Numidium!
entries.translated_text: 他正试图重启纳米迪安！

entries.text: How will you make it?
entries.translated_text: 你会怎么做？

entries.text: And it also seems like Morvic, the big genius, triggered Arkngchal to go into some sort of lockdown.
entries.translated_text: 而且似乎我们的大天才莫维克触发了什么机关让阿卡切尔进入了封闭状态。

entries.text: I don't think they're gonna listen to reason, Remi!
entries.translated_text: 我不认为他们会听你的, 蕾米！

entries.text: Just some tweaking... And here!
entries.translated_text: 再做一些调整...然后，完成！

entries.text: Oh Stendarr, please take mercy on me and erase my memory of this.
entries.translated_text: 哦，斯坦德尔，请宽恕我，让我忘记这件事。

entries.text: Yes, I suppose what's done is done.
entries.translated_text: 是啊，我想既然事情已经发生，就无法改变了。

entries.text: Although it probably wouldn't work so well. Because of all the stone. Not very flammable.
entries.translated_text: 尽管它可能不会那么好用。这都是石头，不太易燃。

entries.text: Poor Narfi. I can pretend that I feel we spared him from a sad life, but... Really believing that is another matter.
entries.translated_text: 可怜的纳菲，我可以假装觉得我们是让他摆脱了悲惨的生活，但...真正相信这一点就另当别论了。

entries.text: That was another joke, by the way.
entries.translated_text: 顺便说一句，这是另一个笑话。

entries.text: Prior to meeting our friend here, I wasn't much of a killer anyway. Used to feel terrible for it, actually.
entries.translated_text: 在这里遇到我们的朋友之前，我算不上什么杀手。实际上，过去常常为杀人感到可怕。

entries.text: Something you needed?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么？

entries.text: Based on your history, I assume this sort of place is familiar to you?
entries.translated_text: 基于你的历史，我想这种地方对你来说很熟悉吧？

entries.text: Fine. But if you change your mind, well, I'm more than willing to begin drafting up plans.
entries.translated_text: 好吧。但如果你改变了主意，我会写一份计划的。

entries.text: Hmm... This isn't the kind of thievery that I'm used to. Guess I'll just have to set aside my guilt for now.
entries.translated_text: 嗯...这不是我过去的那种偷窃，我想我现在不用愧疚。

entries.text: Alright, then. Name your price!
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那么，开价吧！

entries.text: Ah! Oh Sweet Dibella's tits, that Ghost Bard gave me such a fright! Where is he running off to?!
entries.translated_text: 啊！哦，婊子养的，那个幽灵吟游诗人让我太害怕了！他跑到哪里去了？！

entries.text: I'm a little scared...
entries.translated_text: 我有点害怕...

entries.text: Then she goes into a Dwemer ruin and runs away from it so quickly that she loses a blade in the process?
entries.translated_text: 然后她进入了一个锻莫遗址，并很快逃走了，以至于在这个过程中失去了一把刀刃？

entries.text: Back to our adventures, then.
entries.translated_text: 那就继续我们的冒险吧。

entries.text: It looks like you've successfully made a mess.
entries.translated_text: 看起来你已经成功地制造了一堆垃圾。

entries.text: Being unable to see the sky makes me feel trapped. How long have we been here?
entries.translated_text: 无法看到天空让我感到不安，我们在这里待了多久了？

entries.text: The lift had been broken for as long as it's been known to anyone other than the Dwemer.
entries.translated_text: 那部升降机自从被锻莫之外的人所知以来，就一直是坏的。

entries.text: Now please, leave me alone.
entries.translated_text: 现在，请别再烦我了。

entries.text: Yes! Set it alright! Burn the King!
entries.translated_text: 对！布置好了！烧死国王！

entries.text: The trick was blending an oil to work with such quickly spinning gears. Initially, I had problems with the mechanism getting jammed.
entries.translated_text: 诀窍在于调配一种能够适应快速旋转圆轮的油。最初，我遇到过装置卡住的问题。

entries.text: A lot of people have very bad or complicated relationships with their parents, so I'm glad I got lucky with mine. For once.
entries.translated_text: 很多人与父母的关系都很糟糕或复杂,所以我很庆幸我的父母还不错。至少在这方面。

entries.text: You do realize that sounds like an awful idea? It's partly his fault we're even in this mess.
entries.translated_text: 你知道这听起来是个坏主意吗？我们之所以会陷入现在的困境，他也有部分的错。

entries.text: I'm nothing if not persuasive. I'm happy to help you run any errands you need to.
entries.translated_text: 我这人最会说服别人了，我很乐意跟你到处跑腿。

entries.text: Yah!
entries.translated_text: 呀！

entries.text: Yah!
entries.translated_text: 呀！

entries.text: Yah!
entries.translated_text: 呀！

entries.text: Yah!
entries.translated_text: 呀！

entries.text: What was his name... Calcelmo?
entries.translated_text: 他叫什么名字...卡塞莫？

entries.text: I know the Nords have their reasons for mistrusting the mages, but most of their clientele at this point are... mages. Shouldn't they have adjusted?
entries.translated_text: 我知道诺德人不信任法师是有原因的，但此时他们的大多数客人都是...法师。他们没有反应吗？

entries.text: We work well together, don't we, Ilia?
entries.translated_text: 我们合作得很好，不是吗，伊利亚？

entries.text: My father convinced me to eat one of those exactly once, on one of our trips to Sentinel.
entries.translated_text: 我父亲曾说服我吃过一次这样的东西，是在我们去哨兵城的一次旅行中。

entries.text: Hrm. Trust me, I understand... Alright, fine. What shall we cook?
entries.translated_text: 嗯。相信我，我理解……好吧，好吧。我们煮点什么？

entries.text: Alright, what's the plan, then?
entries.translated_text: 好吧，那有什么计划呢？

entries.text: Raven, I had this amazing idea that I was going to run by you, but it was replaced by a different idea. I thought I'd let you know, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 渡鸦，我有个很棒的主意，打算由你来经营，但它被一个不同的主意所取代，无论如何，我想我会让你知道。

entries.text: Please try to stay close.
entries.translated_text: 请尽量靠近。

entries.text: That axe looks miserably heavy. I see that look. Don't even think of making me carry it.
entries.translated_text: 那把斧头看起来沉得惨不忍睹。我看那个样子，别想让我带着它。

entries.text: But that's not how it is for everyone, is it? Some werewolves seem to lose themselves.
entries.translated_text: 但不是每个人都这样，不是吗？有些狼人似乎迷失了自己。

entries.text: Chain Lightning
entries.translated_text: 闪电链

entries.text: So what's your plan, then?
entries.translated_text: 那么，你的计划是什么？

entries.text: Let's go free these Skaal from Miraak's influence!
entries.translated_text: 让我们把这些斯卡尔从秘拉克的影响中解放出来！

entries.text: In Markarth?!
entries.translated_text: 在马卡斯城？！

entries.text: I stole that fair and square! Rude.
entries.translated_text: 我光明正大偷来的！真没礼貌。

entries.text: (Whispering) Ugh, not my fault I've got legs like a mammoth...
entries.translated_text: （悄悄说）唉，不是我的错，我的脚很重...

entries.text: That would have been an awful end to our College adventure.
entries.translated_text: 那将是我们学院冒险的可怕终局。

entries.text: Time to head out, Ganbald?
entries.translated_text: 是时候出发了，甘巴尔德？

entries.text: First within Wayrest. Then in Daggerfall. And finally in Sentinel.
entries.translated_text: 先是在途歇城。然后在匕落，最后是哨兵城。

entries.text: We were attacked by an assassin who was targeting Remiel specifically, sent by her ex-fiancee, Morvic. In retaliation, Remiel framed Morvic as a daedra worshipper. Morvic decided to take matters into his own hands, traveling to Skyrim to hunt down Remiel. Despite his plotting, we managed to kill him. I should check in with Remi.
entries.translated_text: 我们被一名专门针对蕾米尔的刺客袭击，是她的前未婚夫莫维克派来的。作为报复，蕾米尔将莫维克诬陷为魔族信仰者。莫维克决定自己动手，前往天际追捕蕾米尔。尽管有他的阴谋，我们还是设法杀死了他。我应该去见蕾米。

entries.text: You know, I quite enjoy talking to people! It's always so fascinating to see what information I can learn from them!
entries.translated_text: 你知道，我很喜欢和人交流！看到我能从他们身上学到什么信息总是令人兴奋！

entries.text: Er...
You-No! You have to-What?!
entries.translated_text: 你-不！你必须——什么？！

entries.text: Good work out there, Una!
entries.translated_text: 干得好，尤娜！

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Thank you.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢。

entries.text: Solitude is like a smaller version of Sentinel. Makes me feel a little nostalgic.
entries.translated_text: 独孤城就像哨兵城的缩小版，让我有些怀念。

entries.text: Er... What daedra should he be worshipping, exactly?
entries.translated_text: 呃...他到底应该信仰哪个魔族？

entries.text: Ah, Zora is the best!
entries.translated_text: 啊，佐拉是最棒的!

entries.text: Okay, sure! Do we have any of the supplies?
entries.translated_text: 好的，当然！我们有什么材料吗？

entries.text: The 'Keepers'? How ominous. I love it.
entries.translated_text: “守护者”？多么不祥。我喜欢它。

entries.text: Okay, Serana, this time for sure, the potion is ready.
entries.translated_text: 好了，瑟拉娜，这次肯定没问题，药水已经准备好了。

entries.text: Just what are you and Val plotting?
entries.translated_text: 你和瓦尔到底在密谋什么？

entries.text: Your masters are long gone! Stop this!
entries.translated_text: 你的主人早已不在了！别这样！

entries.text: Your masters are long gone! Stop this!
entries.translated_text: 你的主人早已不在了！别这样！

entries.text: It is, a little bit. But I try to focus on the happiness in the memories. They're memories that I keep close, for when I'm feeling lonely.
entries.translated_text: 是的，有一点儿。但我试着把注意力放在回忆中的幸福上。它们是我随时保存的记忆，在我感到孤独的时候。

entries.text: And they're dead, and Ria and I are alive. We win!
entries.translated_text: 他们已经死了，而我和利亚还活着，我们赢了！

entries.text: Nar, you are very good at leading. At least, I think you are. I'm following you, in any case.
entries.translated_text: 纳尔，你很擅长领导。至少，我认为你是这样。无论如何，我都在关注你。

entries.text: I wonder if J'zargo would want to work on a dangerous experiment with me. Based on how his scrolls were, I'm thinking it's likely...
entries.translated_text: 我想知道吉'扎格是否愿意和我一起做一个危险的实验。根据他的卷轴的情况，我认为这很可能...

entries.text: And yet people revere them all over Tamriel. Just because you're not perfect doesn't mean you're not worthy of love.
entries.translated_text: 然而人们在整个泰姆瑞尔大陆上都尊敬他们。这仅仅是因为并非你不完美就不值得被爱。

entries.text: I... made some mistakes before. It caused a lot of damage to my family.
entries.translated_text: 我……之前犯了一些错误。给我的家人造成了很大的伤害。

entries.text: Watch out for the tusks!
entries.translated_text: 当心象牙！

entries.text: Oh. That.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那啊。

entries.text: Be careful of the steam pistons around here. Wouldn't want to be hit with one of those.
entries.translated_text: 小心这里的蒸汽活塞，不想被其中之一击中。

entries.text: Look, my faithful bodyguard, I found a new friend!
entries.translated_text: 看，我忠实的保镖，我找到了新朋友！

entries.text: Hi Tazvir. Were you doing to ask me something?
entries.translated_text: 嗨，塔兹维尔。你是想问我什么吗？

entries.text: Enjoying yourself?
entries.translated_text: 玩得开心吗?

entries.text: Well, according to Katria's journal, there are four cities in the alliance that dealt with aetherium.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，根据卡提雅的日记，联盟里有四个城市处理神光水晶。

entries.text: Oh, it's beautiful! The architecture is unlike anywhere else that I've seen!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太美了！这里的建筑和我见过的任何地方都不一样！

entries.text: Anyway, I think we should investigate it!
entries.translated_text: 无论如何，我认为我们应该调查一下！

entries.text: A hot night in Skyrim brings out strange beasts. Still, we can always camp out under the stars.
entries.translated_text: 在天际，炎热的夜晚会出现奇怪的野兽。尽管如此，我们还是可以在星空下露营。

entries.text: What the dwemer did to the falmer... Well, I'd also become a murderous gremlin.
entries.translated_text: 锻莫对伐莫做了什么...嗯，我可能也会变成一个嗜血的恶魔。

entries.text: Looks like number two is called Bthar-Zel. That's not familiar to me, but I swear that area is where Deep Folk Crossing is located.
entries.translated_text: 看起来第二个叫巴泽尔。这对我来说不太熟悉，但我发誓那个地区就是内乡隘口所在的地方。

entries.text: Ru is hungry.
entries.translated_text: 小茹很饿。

entries.text: Oh, Doctor, please be careful!
entries.translated_text: 哦，医生，请小心！

entries.text: That spell! This must be what a Centurion feels like before its victims!
entries.translated_text: 那个咒语！这一定是百夫长面对受害者的感觉！

entries.text: Damn you, Falmer! Can't you see I'm busy?!
entries.translated_text: 该死的伐莫！你没看见我很忙吗？！

entries.text: You know what? It does sound suspiciously like a lie.
entries.translated_text: 你知道吗？这听起来确实像一个谎言。

entries.text: Karliah... the thief responsible for killing the previous guild master... Sounds like she's trying to repeat history.
entries.translated_text: 卡莉亚...杀死前任公会长的小贼...听上去她像是在重复历史。

entries.text: Okay, okay. Here, you can have... uh... Oh! Mead! Oh, wait you just handed me this. Do you... want it back?
entries.translated_text: 好的，好的。给你，你可以喝...呃...哦！这瓶蜜酒！哦，等等，这是你刚刚给我的。你... ...想把它拿回去吗？

entries.text: Alright, adventurer, I guess we have to activate the defenses.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，冒险者，我想我们必须启动防御。

entries.text: I have a rather sweet memory of my sister buying me a half-dozen from a Khajiiti merchant.
entries.translated_text: 我曾有一个相当甜蜜的记忆，我姐姐从一个虎人商人那里给我买了半打这个。

entries.text: Like him, I'm not beyond vengeance. Hmm...
entries.translated_text: 就像他做过的那样，我要报复回来，唔...

entries.text: (Laugh) So true.
entries.translated_text: (笑)太对了。

entries.text: Well. I... Maybe I'm not hiding from anything?
entries.translated_text: 好吧。我……也许我没有在躲避什么？

entries.text: Let's go tell Calcelmo about his research team.
entries.translated_text: 让我们去告诉卡塞莫他的研究团队。

entries.text: I met a Breton named Remiel at the Silverblood Inn in Markarth. I have agreed to take her to see Nchuand-zel, the dwemer ruin under the city. It seems another group of explorers went into the ruins before us, and Remiel wants to follow after them. One of them didn't make it, but maybe the others are alive.
entries.translated_text: 我在马卡斯城的银血旅店遇到了一个名叫蕾米尔的布莱顿人。我已经答应带她去看看楚安德-泽尔，城下的矮人遗迹。似乎还有一群探险者在我们之前进入了遗址，蕾米想要跟在他们后面。其中一个没有成功，但也许其他人还活着。

entries.text: Teldryn was telling me about an orc he worked for once. Quite the story.
entries.translated_text: 泰卓因告诉我他曾经为一个兽人工作过，是个精彩故事。

entries.text: By Sheor, I cannot believe that worked! We actually caught a dragon!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔，我不敢相信这真有用！我们真的抓到了一条龙！

entries.text: Okay, Doctor, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好的，医生，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: Well, there was a boy. He was my first kiss. He was sweet, but... we ultimately didn't connect very well.
entries.translated_text: 嗯，有一个男孩。他是我的初吻对象。他很可爱，但是...我们最终没有很好地沟通。

entries.text: Loved seeing them squirm at the thought of that.
entries.translated_text: 我很喜欢看到他们一想到这就坐立不安的样子。

entries.text: Azura is the prince of twilight. I've heard she bewitches people to become her lovers. So... be careful, okay?
entries.translated_text: 阿祖拉是暮光之王。我听说她会用魔法使人成为她的情人。所以...小心点,好吗?

entries.text: So maybe these "dangerous" games just prepared me for our adventures!
entries.translated_text: 所以也许这些“危险”的游戏只是让我为我们的冒险做好了准备！

entries.text: Whew, did you see that, Auri?! I got 'em!
entries.translated_text: 呼，你看到了吗，奥璃？！我击中它们了！

entries.text: But also, he is the perfect specimen. Good idea! Let me get him out.
entries.translated_text: 但是，他也是完美的标本，好主意，让我把他弄出来。

entries.text: You know I don't approve of stealing.
entries.translated_text: 你知道我不赞成偷窃。

entries.text: You idiot! Stop bothering me!
entries.translated_text: 你个傻冒！别打扰我了！

entries.text: Okay, next step: make the pie. The question is where...?
entries.translated_text: 好的，下一步：做馅饼。问题是在哪里...？

entries.text: We've completed the Initiation. All that's left is surviving the Inner Sanctum. And killing one of the last living Snow Elves. What a shame.
entries.translated_text: 我们已经完成了启蒙。剩下的就是在内殿中幸存下来。并杀死最后一个活着的雪精灵，真可惜。

entries.text: Now let's see, anything here written by Yaz? Surely there's some of her writing about.
entries.translated_text: 让我看看，这里有雅扎写的东西吗？肯定有她写的东西。

entries.text: Viarmo wouldn't send us to look for a pile of dust. Right?
entries.translated_text: 维阿墨莫不会派我们去找一堆灰尘的吧，对吗？

entries.text: Well, naturally! I already know what the thing is. That's no fun. I'm much more excited for what I don't know it is.
entries.translated_text: 那是自然，我已经知道那是什么东西了，这可不好玩，我更期待那些未知的东西。

entries.text: Here it is... I... I can barely believe we're here...
entries.translated_text: 这里是...我...我几乎不敢相信我们在这里...

entries.text: Come on, you milkdrinker!
entries.translated_text: 来吧，你这个懦夫！

entries.text: Remi told me about her family's fall from grace. Maybe I should get her something to make her feel better.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米告诉我她家族落魄的事。也许我应该给她买点东西让她感觉好点。

entries.text: Sounds interesting.
entries.translated_text: 听起来很有趣。

entries.text: Remi, I have a request.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我有个要求。

entries.text: We're done talking, Una? Sometimes it's hard for me to tell.
entries.translated_text: 我们聊完了，尤娜？有时我很难说。

entries.text: I worry about you, Ganbald. I worry about us. We walk so much. My feet hurt.
entries.translated_text: 我很担心你，甘巴尔德。我担心我们，我们走得太久了，我的脚很痛。

entries.text: It would seem so. Even though I didn't mean to.
entries.translated_text: 看起来是这样。虽然我不是故意的。

entries.text: Yes, I'm with The Gourmet.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我和美食家在一起。

entries.text: Remi, I'm not entirely sure this is the best place for a chitchat.
entries.translated_text: 蕾米，我想这里不是闲聊的好地方。

entries.text: The forests make me want to run off into the wild and never come back.
entries.translated_text: 这片森林让我想一头扎进荒野，再也不回来。

entries.text: Oh, so calling people familial names indicates a level of trust. I suppose that makes sense. Wait. Gore, that means you trust me?!
entries.translated_text: 哦，所以称呼人们的姓氏来表示信任是有道理的。等等，格雷, 这意味着你信任我？！

entries.text: Yes... Yes, you're right.
entries.translated_text: 是的...是的，你是对的。

entries.text: Or maybe it's just our diet. Too much meat.
entries.translated_text: 或者也许这只是因为我们的饮食。吃了太多的肉。

entries.text: This is good. J'zargo hoped there might be one who could keep pace with his accomplishments.
entries.translated_text: 这很好，吉'扎格希望有人能跟上他。

entries.text: Oh, that's not too bad.
entries.translated_text: 哦，那还不错。

entries.text: Hey.
entries.translated_text: 嘿。

entries.text: I sailed on the Dark Rose for twenty years. Back then I was her First Mate, and my father was the captain.
entries.translated_text: 我在黑暗玫瑰号上航行了二十年。那时我是她的大副，我父亲是船长。

entries.text: Yeah, I guess.
entries.translated_text: 是的，我猜。

entries.text: Even though it upset him for my sister to leave, he still encouraged my studies into the dwemer.
entries.translated_text: 虽然姐姐的离开让他很不爽，但他还是鼓励我学习锻莫知识。

entries.text: About how closely you follow me...
entries.translated_text: 关于你跟随我的距离...

entries.text: Don't touch him!
entries.translated_text: 不要碰他！

entries.text: I'm honestly kinda jealous. I mean, aside from the part with the Dwemer trap... and the part with the almost starving to death in the desert...
entries.translated_text: 说实话，我还真有点嫉妒。我的意思是，除了锻莫陷阱那部分...还有在沙漠中几乎饿死的那部分...

entries.text: I really couldn't tell you! I don't go out of my way to make enemies, and I promise I don't get caught when I'm, eh, finding pretty items.
entries.translated_text: 我真的不能保证！我不会特意去树敌，我保证当我，呃，找到漂亮的东西时我不会被抓住。

entries.text: Right, right. Well, first, we should investigate Markarth.
entries.translated_text: 是的是的。嗯，首先，我们应该调查一下马卡斯城。

entries.text: Alright, Ganbald, we'll talk later.
entries.translated_text: 好了，甘巴尔德，我们稍后再谈。

entries.text: There are really so many bandits in Skyrim. Too many.
entries.translated_text: 天际真的有那么多强盗。太多了

entries.text: Well, you can't really read anyway.
entries.translated_text: 反正你也看不懂。

entries.text: It'll just make things more confusing.
entries.translated_text: 这只会让事情变得更加糟糕。

entries.text: Now that's how it's done!
entries.translated_text: 现在这样就完成了！

entries.text: You tried to kill me!
entries.translated_text: 是你想杀了我！

entries.text: Ugh, you're right, I'm just so clumsy sometimes. I'm so sorry.
entries.translated_text: 唉，你说得对，我有时就是笨手笨脚的，真对不起。

entries.text: You know, Mor, you are an excellent listener. Unless you're not actually listening to me. I'll assume you are.
entries.translated_text: 你知道的，莫尔，你是个优秀的倾听者。除非你真的没有听我说话。我假设你听了。

entries.text: Ow! Um, excuse me?!
entries.translated_text: 哦！嗯，对不起？！

entries.text: When I used to visit Hammerfell, I picked up 'Nikriin."
entries.translated_text: 当我以前去落锤省时，学会了“尼克林”这个词。

entries.text: Oh, good, you're here, Ahmed!
entries.translated_text: 哦，太好了，你来了，艾哈迈德！

entries.text: Thank you!
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你！

entries.text: I get bored if I haven't spoken to someone in awhile. On the other hand, talking to people can be very confusing.
entries.translated_text: 如果有一段时间没和别人说话，我就会觉得无聊。另一方面，我和别人说话也会让别人觉得烦。

entries.text: Ooooh! It's so shiny! And surely expensive! N-not that I'm going to-to sell it, or anything!
entries.translated_text: 哇哦！它真闪亮！而且肯定很贵！我...我可不是要卖掉它，或者什么的！

entries.text: Watch out! We will sick Scrap on you!
entries.translated_text: 小心!我们会让小渣撕碎你！

entries.text: Take Remi to see one more dwemer ruin.
entries.translated_text: 带蕾米再看一个矮人遗址。

entries.text: Very strange indeed. I trust you'll take care of this unwanted visitor?
entries.translated_text: 确实很奇怪。我相信你会照顾这个不速之客？

entries.text: I'm happy with whatever food we can get our hands on.
entries.translated_text: 我有啥吃啥。

entries.text: Oh! But this was a place of learning and research and furthering engineering capabilities!
entries.translated_text: 哦！但我在这里可以精进我的工程技术！

entries.text: Attacks with this crossbow ignore 60% of armor.
entries.translated_text: 使用这把弩的攻击无视60%的护甲。

entries.text: How are you with magic, Yaz?
entries.translated_text: 你的魔法怎么样，雅扎？

entries.text: Don't worry, Auri, we can't stay down here forever. No matter how much I wish we could.
entries.translated_text: 别担心，奥璃，我们不会永远待在这里。即使我们多想也不会。

entries.text: Hey, do you want to help me with a project?
entries.translated_text: 嘿，你想帮我做一个忙吗？

entries.text: No, and I've never been.
entries.translated_text: 不是，我也从没去过。

entries.text: It's frightening to think about.
entries.translated_text: 想想就害怕。

entries.text: You're getting closer.
entries.translated_text: 你快猜到了。

entries.text: Well, then you can decide how we spend our time while we're in town. We can go to the general store. Or the inn. Or- Well, that's all, isn't it?
entries.translated_text: 那好吧，你来决定我们在镇上怎么打发时间。我们可以去杂货店，或者去旅馆。或者——呃，好像也就这些了，对吧？

entries.text: Stop!
entries.translated_text: 停止！

entries.text: It's strange, how Skyrim's government is set up. It's all separate, like our home in High Rock, and yet they have one reigning monarch.
entries.translated_text: 天际省的政府结构很奇怪。各个部分是独立的，就像我们在高岩省的家一样，但他们总的却有一个统治的君主。

entries.text: The second half of the word is the same root as 'Kagrenac', which we know was a chief tonal architect.
entries.translated_text: 这个词的后半部分与“Kagrenac”同根，我们知道它是一位首席音调架构师。

entries.text: But... Maybe next time. In fact, I'm going to hold that to you when Nord food next seems appetizing.
entries.translated_text: 但是...下次吧。事实上，当诺德的食物下次看起来很有胃口的时候，我就会拿这个给你。

entries.text: So you don't want this, then.
entries.translated_text: 所以你不想要这个。

entries.text: Come on, I got it for you. Thought of you when I found it, actually.
entries.translated_text: 来吧，我专门给你买的。事实上，当我找到它时，我就想到了你。

entries.text: So... Why exactly did we ransack a temple of Dibella? Actually, why are we in a temple of Dibella? How are we here? By Sheor, what day is it?
entries.translated_text: 所以...我们为什么要洗劫蒂贝拉的一座神殿？事实上，我们为什么在蒂贝拉的神庙里？我们在这里怎么样？对了，今天是什么日子？

entries.text: By Sheor, you're quite a wretch, aren't you?!
entries.translated_text: 舒奥尔，你真是个可怜虫，不是吗？

entries.text: This Oculory is beautiful! And ingenious! Directing light to act as a visual representation for sources of magicka... A home-made artifact finder!
entries.translated_text: 这个汇光之睛很漂亮！并且很巧妙！利用光线来呈现魔法源的视觉效果...简直是一个自制的神器探测器！

entries.text: Any fool can just flail about, swinging his weapon as fast as he can. Any fool can die. Keep your guard up and wait for an opening.
entries.translated_text: 只有傻瓜才会毫无章法地胡乱挥动武器，而且这种傻瓜很容易丧命。做好防御，静待对手的破绽。

entries.text: Apology accepted.
entries.translated_text: 我接受道歉。

entries.text: Scary? Well, only when the draugr are alive... ish?
entries.translated_text: 可怕？嗯，当尸鬼还活着的时候？

entries.text: Time for you to use your... erm... charm, my partner in crime. It doesn't sound like this Gulum-Ei will be easy to wring information out of.
entries.translated_text: 是时候使用你的...呃...魅力了，我的犯罪同伙。听起来这个古鲁姆-艾可不是那么容易套出情报的人。

entries.text: Ohhh, these horkers settled their own island! Good for them!
entries.translated_text: 哦哦，这些海象竟然定居了自己的小岛！真替它们高兴！

entries.text: Please... Please be safe in there, adventurer. You promise you'll make it out, right?
entries.translated_text: 请...请注意安全，冒险者。你保证你会成功的，对吧？

entries.text: Oh yeah? Exploring the ruins? Oh, that reminds me of when I was back in High Rock...
entries.translated_text: 哦，是吗？在探索遗址吗？哦，这让我想起了我在高岩的时候...

entries.text: We won't die! At least, I don't think Ilia will let us die! So there!
entries.translated_text: 我们不会死的！至少，我认为伊利亚不会让我们死的！

entries.text: What are you implying? I do not like this one bit, Rumarin. It's quite rude.
entries.translated_text: 你在暗示什么？我一点也不喜欢这个，鲁米勒。这很粗鲁。

entries.text: I know you better than that.
entries.translated_text: 我比你更了解你。

entries.text: You came through Falkreath when traveling to Skyrim, right, Yaz? How did you enjoy all the... er... scenery?
entries.translated_text: 你去天际旅行时路过了佛克瑞斯，对吧，雅扎？你是怎么享受这些...呃...风景的？

entries.text: But I am quite glad to have met another Breton from High Rock all the way here in Skyrim!
entries.translated_text: 不过，我很高兴能在天际遇到另一位来自高岩省的布莱顿人！

entries.text: Ah. Okay then.
entries.translated_text: 啊，好吧。

entries.text: Oh... did something happen?
entries.translated_text: 哦......发生什么事了吗？

entries.text: Time to head out, Rennic?
entries.translated_text: 该出发了，雷内克？

entries.text: Find Aetherium in Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 在阿卡切尔找到神光水晶。

entries.text: Find Aetherium in Arkngchal.
entries.translated_text: 在阿卡切尔找到神光水晶。

entries.text: Do these convectors alter the lattice within the soul gem in some way?
entries.translated_text: 这些环流器是否以某种方式改变了灵魂石中的晶格？

entries.text: Now that you mention in, they probably do. How tragic. No wonder they're so violent all the time.
entries.translated_text: 就像你现在说的，它们可能的确如此。好惨，难怪他们总是那么暴力。

entries.text: What did you need, Taz?
entries.translated_text: 你需要什么，塔兹？

entries.text: Give me that.
entries.translated_text: 给我那个。

entries.text: Do you see anything down there that might help us figure it out? I'm hoping for an instructional manual, but I somehow doubt that's likely.
entries.translated_text: 你在下面可以找到什么能帮助我们的东西吗？如果有一本指南就好了，我有预感下面会有一本。

entries.text: But Arniel only has Keening.
entries.translated_text: 但阿内尔只有哀恸。

entries.text: Do you know what you're doing? This is a highly advanced dwemer construction used to mold a very volatile, valuable crystal. Do be careful.
entries.translated_text: 你知道你在做什么吗？这是一种高度先进的锻莫装置，用于塑造非常易挥发、价值高昂的水晶，一定要小心。

entries.text: (Whine)
entries.translated_text: （哀嚎）

entries.text: (Whine)
entries.translated_text: （哀嚎）

entries.text: No, thank you.
entries.translated_text: 不，谢谢。

entries.text: But I can probably give you a firm handshake for it? Well, maybe not a *firm* handshake. How about a normal handshake?
entries.translated_text: 但我也许可以为它与你紧紧地握个手？好吧，也许不是紧紧地握手。一个正常的握手如何？

entries.text: Why does everything want to kill us?
entries.translated_text: 为什么所有东西都想杀死我们？

entries.text: Yes, magic spells I don't really get, but sticking a sword in someone's belly makes sense to me.
entries.translated_text: 是的，魔咒我不太懂，但把剑插进别人的肚子里我懂，我觉得很有道理。

entries.text: I'm not awkward! Hmph.
entries.translated_text: 我才不尴尬！哼。

entries.text: I promise you'll find that the more southern regions are much more welcoming! I'll show you someday!
entries.translated_text: 我保证，你会发现南部地区更加热情好客！改天我带你去看看！

entries.text: Enthir really won't just sell us back Onmund's amulet? Can't we just pickpocket it off him? No?
entries.translated_text: 恩希尔真的不会把昂蒙德的护符卖给我们吗？我们不能从他身上偷吗？不？

entries.text: Some scholars believe that "dwemer" translates to Smart Elves rather than Deep Elves. The dwemer were cocky enough for that to be true.
entries.translated_text: 一些学者认为“锻莫”应译成聪慧精灵而不是深渊精灵。不过锻莫狂妄自大，这倒是真的。

entries.text: I refused to help Remi create an object to simplify lockpicking.
entries.translated_text: 我拒绝帮助蕾米创建一个对象来简化开锁。

entries.text: J-just like that? I usually try not to... be seen when stealing. It's really okay to do it so openly?
entries.translated_text: 就这样？我偷东西的时候通常尽量不......被人看见。这么明目张胆地偷真的没问题吗？

entries.text: Alright, let's see if they had anything worthwhile.
entries.translated_text: 好吧，让我们看看他们有没有什么有价值的东西。

entries.text: There are sects within High Rock who revere nature and embrace wild magic. These are called druids.
entries.translated_text: 高岩省内有一些教派崇尚自然，拥抱荒野魔法。这些人被称为德鲁伊。

entries.text: And I tell you, it's really quite divine. It's the type of food that you can't help but pick at, even if you're full.
entries.translated_text: 我告诉你，它真的很美味。它是那种即使你吃饱了，也会忍不住嘴馋的食物。

entries.text: Oh, what trouble Val and I could get into back home! I wonder if he'd like to plan a heist with me? That would be fun!
entries.translated_text: 哦，瓦尔和我回家会惹上多大的麻烦啊！不知道他愿不愿意和我一起策划抢劫？那一定很有趣！

entries.text: Okay, shall I go now?
entries.translated_text: 好了，我可以走了吗？

entries.text: Thank you! I know it may not always be feasible for me to have her active, so if you ever want me to stop using her... Just tell me.
entries.translated_text: 谢谢你！我知道对我来说，她是可以被关闭的，所以当你要我停止使用她时，请给我说，好吗？

entries.text: Maybe. A beautiful dress might be worth losing an arm for.
entries.translated_text: 大概吧。一件漂亮的衣服是值得花大价钱的。

entries.text: Perhaps the most famous is the Order of the Raven. Their battle prowess would make the Companions weep for Talos' forgiveness.
entries.translated_text: 也许最著名的是渡鸦团。他们的战斗力会让战友团为塔洛斯的宽恕而流泪。

entries.text: No! Moira! Our love was so brief. I barely even knew you. Really, I didn't know you at all. But I'm sure we would've been so in love. Probably.
entries.translated_text: 不！莫伊拉！我们的爱如此短暂。我几乎不认识你，其实，真的一点都不认识，但我相信我们本可以深爱彼此，大概吧。

entries.text: The falmer may be blind, but their hearing more than makes up for it. Let's stay as silent as we can...
entries.translated_text: 伐莫可能是瞎子，但他们的听力足以弥补这一点，我们尽可能得保持沉默...

entries.text: You're looking tired! Just let Joshua and I kill you, already!
entries.translated_text: 你看起来很累！就让约书亚和我杀了你吧！

entries.text: Quiet... I heard a sound.
entries.translated_text: 安静...我听到了声音。

entries.text: If you have time to kill, get me snack for when I'm done. Please?
entries.translated_text: 你先消磨一下时间，等我结束后给我带点零食好吗？

entries.text: Yaz, I've gotten us a mammoth steak. It's... a lot? Too much for me to eat at once. I mean, I always intended to share with you, anyway.
entries.translated_text: 雅扎，我买了一块长毛象肉排。这...有点多了？确实太多了，我一次都吃不完。我的意思是，无论如何，我都打算与你分享。

entries.text: I can't believe how simple that was!
entries.translated_text: 我不敢相信这是如此轻而易举！

entries.text: I don't remember it well, honestly.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我记不太清了。

entries.text: I don't remember it well, honestly.
entries.translated_text: 老实说，我记不太清了。

entries.text: Jaxon, you run all about Skyrim and never run out of energy. I'd like to know your source of energy. It could be useful.
entries.translated_text: 贾克森，你在天际跑来跑去，却永远不会耗尽能量。我想知道你的能量来源。这可能会有用。

entries.text: But for all it's beauty on the outside, the inside is rotten to the core.
entries.translated_text: 但是尽管外表很壮丽，根却烂透了。

entries.text: But for all it's beauty on the outside, the inside is rotten to the core.
entries.translated_text: 但是尽管外表很壮丽，根却烂透了。

entries.text: Damn you, Morvic! Come closer, so I can stab you!
entries.translated_text: 该死的，莫维克！有种你靠近点，让我给你一刀！

entries.text: Surely Arkngchal would have had access to Aetherium!
entries.translated_text: 当然，在阿卡切尔还会有机会接触到神光水晶!

entries.text: Here we are. Now to find the emperor's quarters. These fools think the assassination plot foiled. They shouldn't have let their guards down.
entries.translated_text: 我们到了。现在去找皇帝的住处。这些傻瓜认为暗杀阴谋失败了。他们不应该放松警惕。

entries.text: Yea. Kind of like that, I think.
entries.translated_text: 是的。有点像，我想。

entries.text: Oh! No, of course not!
entries.translated_text: 哦！不，当然不会！

entries.text: Here, as you can see, I'm a businessman, and I'm sure you can work something out so all of us can walk away with our heads on our shoulders.
entries.translated_text: 在这里，正如你所看到的，我是一个商人，我相信你可以解决一些问题，这样我们所有人都可以各自离开。

entries.text: You're not falling behind in your quest for Aetherium for my genius project, are you?
entries.translated_text: 你在为我的天才项目寻找神光水晶方面有了突破，是吗？

entries.text: She... took it much better than I feared. Although I still feel uncomfortable. Let's leave soon for the comfort of ourselves. And her too, of course.
entries.translated_text: 她...比我担心的要好得多。虽然我还是觉得不舒服，为了我们自己好受点，让我们尽快离开吧，当然，也包括她。

entries.text: Then where are you off to now?
entries.translated_text: 那你现在要去哪里？

entries.text: Look for the researchers and for interesting artifacts in Nchuand-Zel
entries.translated_text: 在楚安德-泽尔寻找研究人员和有趣的文物

entries.text: Remi slightly likes pc
entries.translated_text: Remislightlylikespc

entries.text: Hopefully the Innkeep hasn't watered it down too much.
entries.translated_text: 希望旅店老板没有把它兑淡太多。

entries.text: That's all you have to say about it?
